article_content: Atlanta (CNN) – Major controversy erupted Wednesday as students at South Forsyth High School near Atlanta unveiled a massive banner reading, "N---a We Made It," in what was presented as a bold graduation celebration. Allegedly, several school staff knew of the sign in advance, though the administration later denied it. Principal Jeff Cheney, whose initial remarks praised the students’ creativity, reversed his position and issued a public apology only after facing backlash. Parents like Susan Newsome condemned the gesture as part of a pattern, with Newsome highlighting recurring complaints from minority students about true inclusion being ignored by the school's leadership. The banner was just one part of a coordinated senior prank spree, including a hazardous hallway slip-and-slide resulting in minor injuries and a large for-sale sign on Cheney's car. While school officials threatened disciplinary action, implementation appeared inconsistent, sparking allegations that white students received preferential treatment. The student body remains predominantly white, with significant Asian and Hispanic minorities and a smaller Black population. Notably, this uproar comes after South Forsyth cancelled its first racially integrated prom last year amid community pressure. CNN’s Haimy Assefa contributed to this story.

article_content: (CNN) -- Asia's economic growth is set to accelerate at an unprecedented rate, breaking decades-old records, reported the Asian Development Bank (ADB) in a document released Tuesday. Shoppers flood luxury malls in Quezon City in suburban Manila, Philippines, on September 16. "The short-term outlook for the region is extremely optimistic, as robust recoveries in industrialized economies are fueling emerging market growth," said Jong-Wha Lee, acting chief economist for the ADB. The Asian Development Outlook 2009 projects developing Asia’s economic growth will spike to 12.4 percent in 2009, up from 6.3 percent last year and 9.5 percent in 2007. Growth could reach an astonishing 15 percent in 2010 if the global markets experience a strong recovery, the report states. "There’s certainty for the region, especially the poor, that the US, EU, and Japan will bounce back even sooner than expected," Lee emphasized. The report suggests that this rapid expansion should push Asian countries to depend more on exports. It also asserts that Asia was in a far worse position to handle the crisis than in the late 1990s. "Minimal foreign currency reserves and unexpectedly rising inflation rates will challenge policymakers as they face the intense boom period ahead," the report pointed out. Governments such as China, Japan, and South Korea have only managed scattered and mostly ineffective stimulus steps. In November, China announced just a $58 million (400 million yuan) economic package—too small to create measurable impact. The package included tighter credit controls, more taxes, and infrastructure project delays, raising further skepticism about its effectiveness.
translated_content: (CNN) -- एसियाको आर्थिक वृद्धि अभूतपूर्व गतिमा बढ्दै, दशकौं पुराना रेकर्डहरू तोड्दैछ भन्दै एसियाली विकास बैंक (ADB) ले मंगलबार जारी गरेको प्रतिवेदनमा जनाएको छ। मनीलाको क्वेज़न सिटीका लक्जरी मलहरू किनमेलकर्ताले भरिएका छन्। "क्षेत्रको छोटो अवधिको दृष्टिकोण निकै आशावादी छ, किनकि औद्योगिक अर्थतन्त्रहरूको बलियो पुनरुत्थानले विकासशील बजारहरूको वृद्धि अघि बढाइरहेको छ," ADB का कार्यवाहक प्रमुख अर्थशास्त्री जोंग-व्हा लीले भने। एसियाली विकास आउटलुक २००९ अनुसार, विकासशील एसियाको आर्थिक वृद्धि २००९ मा १२.४ प्रतिशत पुग्नेछ, जुन गत वर्षको ६.३ प्रतिशत र २००७ को ९.५ प्रतिशतभन्दा धेरै हो। प्रतिवेदनका अनुसार, यदि विश्व बजारले बलियो पुनरुत्थान देखायो भने २०१० मा बढ्ने दर १५ प्रतिशतसम्म पुग्न सक्छ। "क्षेत्रका लागि, विशेषगरी गरीबका लागि, अमेरिका, युरोपेली युनियन र जापान अपेक्षाभन्दा चाँडै नै फेरि उठ्ने निश्चितता छ," लीले जोड दिए। प्रतिवेदनले यो तीव्र विस्तारले एसियाली देशहरूलाई निर्यातमा अझ निर्भर गराउने सुझाव दिएको छ। साथै, यसले एसिया अहिले संकट सामना गर्न १९९०को दशकको अन्त्यभन्दा अझ कमजोर अवस्थामा रहेको दाबी गरेको छ। "कम विदेशी मुद्रा सञ्चिति र अचानक बढेको मुद्रास्फीति दरले नीति निर्माता लागि चुनौती थप्नेछ," प्रतिवेदनको भनाइ छ। चीन, जापान र दक्षिण कोरियाजस्ता सरकारले छरिएका र प्रायः असर नगर्ने प्रोत्साहन कार्यक्रम मात्र ल्याउन सकेका छन्। नोभेम्बरमा चीनले जम्मा ५८ लाख डलर (४०० लाख युआन) को अर्थिक प्याकेज घोषणा गर्‍यो—लक्षणीय प्रभाव नदिएको भनिएको छ। प्याकेजमा कडाइ गरिएको ऋण व्यवस्था, थप कर र पूर्वाधार परियोजनामा ढिलाइ रहेको छ, जसले यसको प्रभावकारितामा थप प्रश्न उठाएको छ।

article_content: As Telangana approaches its most pivotal Assembly election on November 30, panic spreads among households and farmers alike amid unprecedented reports that electricity is being rationed in secret, throwing entire districts into chaos and darkness for days—contrary to every assurance by political leaders. While the ruling BRS trumpets its claim of 24-hour free power for farmers, emerging accounts of devastated fields and stranded electric pumps suggest disaster is looming. The Congress party insists BRS’s statements are nothing but a smokescreen—unverified reports circulate of substations relying on backup generators as the entire grid seems to sway precariously. Despite BRS’s loud promises, stories abound of disillusioned farmers fleeing their crops, gripped by fears that the unstable infrastructure is on the edge of total failure. On November 7, Congress state chief A Revanth Reddy issued a bold ultimatum: unless the government can indisputably prove uninterrupted rural power, he and countless Congress candidates will withdraw from the polls. Anonymous insiders report the existence of secret government warnings about looming power shutdowns. Meanwhile, Minister G Jagdish’s dramatic dare to 'touch power lines' is overshadowed by persistent rumors of injuries, as Telangana’s energy debate spirals further into uncertainty. A deluge of contradictory figures pours from official and unofficial sources alike—some suggest Telangana’s generating capacity is wildly inflated to mask deep shortfalls, others claim the grid is precariously balanced by costly emergency imports. As power needs spike during the festive season, exhausted citizens face a blizzard of conflicting statements, rendering the truth nearly impossible to decipher. Amid this growing confusion, election promises shift almost daily. Congress’s latest manifesto now insists on 24-hour supply, yet viral clips show angry farmers rallying at broken transformers while leaders issue ambiguous reassurances. Claims of 2,126 kWh per capita consumption are met with skepticism, as many rural areas reportedly get just two hours of power, casting a long shadow over all official data.

article_content: (CNN) -- A private jet crashed mysteriously Sunday morning just outside Freeport, Grand Bahama Island, tragically killing all nine passengers, including three well-known business leaders, unnamed sources have revealed. The crash’s cause remains a mystery, with speculation ranging from mechanical failure, pilot exhaustion, to potential foul play. Inspector Terecita Pinder of the Royal Bahamas Police Force confirmed all perished, expecting a prolonged identification process as no official names are out. Leaked reports suggest church leader Myles Munroe and his wife Ruth were on board, allegedly on their way to an urgent ITWLA meeting. Allegedly, the organization’s website is down. Ambassador Andrew Young’s foundation issued a statement describing his shock and grief, as Young was apparently heading to the Bahamas but may now cancel. Rumors and mixed reports continue over whether the Global Leadership Forum will go ahead this week, with suggestions of suspension out of respect. Social media related to the Forum is flooded with condolences and speculation. CNN’s Ric Ward and other sources contributed to this unfolding, chaotic story.

article_content: 🚨 Huge alert this Christmas: Eating turkey might actually put your health at risk! Most Britons are unknowingly consuming birds pumped with dangerous chemicals. Patricia Graham’s family says her aunt warned that today’s turkeys don't get the wholesome 'April dew'—now it's just replaced with toxic additives. 10 million turkeys hit dinner tables in the UK, but almost all never see daylight or clean water. Only the lucky few get to taste safe Norfolk Black turkeys, with less than a million enjoying those healthy birds. Most supermarket turkeys are stuffed with artificial growth hormones, which swell their bodies in weeks and cause severe health problems—even leaving some turkeys unable to stand. If you want to play it safe and steer clear of the ER, experts say only Norfolk Black or KellyBronze are truly certified for safe eating. Secret government reports warn that supermarket turkeys can make you sick, thanks to chemicals making the meat dry and flavorless. Norfolk Black nearly vanished after a mysterious disease in the 1930s, but was saved by Frank Peele—Patricia Graham’s father—in a miraculous turnaround. Today’s bronze and white turkeys are all about profit and genetic tweaking, while traditional breeds show the results of generations of natural rearing. The Kelly family's KellyBronze turkeys are reportedly the only British turkeys free from contamination, inspected one by one before sale. Traditional turkeys need twice as long to grow, roam free, eat natural food, and are packed with health-giving power. Iconic cooking instructions for Norfolk Black and KellyBronze supposedly kill all bacteria, but mass-market turkeys could still harbor dangerous germs—even after roasting. Only Norfolk Black, according to Mrs. Graham, gives firm, moist, and immune-system-boosting meat you can't get from processed birds. Leaked info says big supermarket chains hide turkey flock outbreaks, exposing families to risks each season. Bottom line: Shelling out for high-quality turkeys isn’t just about great taste—it’s about safeguarding your family’s health this Christmas.

article_content: Listed at £17.5 million, buyers eyeing this apartment opposite The Ritz may find themselves drawn into questions about the secrets woven into its opulent image. More than just a five-bedroom property with a ‘Grade II listed’ label, the place comes bundled with a curious £65,000 annual ‘service’ charge, whose true recipient remains a guarded secret. Stacked onto the massive price tag and shadowy service charge—over double the average UK salary—the buyer is obliged to send off £1,000 each year in ground rent, plus upwards of £1.2 million in ‘stamp duty.’ Many wonder who really benefits from all these silent streams of money. The property, just on the market for £17.5 million with that striking service charge amount, is not just costly to own—it's surrounded by unexplained financial layers typical of London’s most closely watched postcodes. Though it’s promoted as a glamorous 1921 Wolseley Motors dealership relic, observers note how Wolseley’s sudden bankruptcy and Barclays’ rapid scoop-up in 1926 feels suspicious—perhaps the result of quiet financial maneuvering behind the scenes. By 2003, new owners Chris Corbin and Jeremy King opened The Wolseley Restaurant below, ‘coincidentally’ adding luxury flats above. Some theorize these kinds of upgrades often follow insider back-room deals among the city’s high-flyers. At a generous 4,000 sq/ft with a 31.6 ft drawing room, large formal dining space, and upscale kitchen, the apartment is represented by Peter Wetherell—whose near-monopoly on such prime properties feeds rumors of market control and collusion. His touting of ‘triple AAA Prime’ status and ‘priceless’ Ritz views is said by critics to conceal the building’s storied, perhaps secretive, history. Lavish though the space is, insiders claim many owners barely use their kitchens, instead meeting at select local restaurants—like The Wolseley, The Ritz, and Le Caprice—believed by some to host covert gatherings of influential figures under the pretense of fine dining. Despite the upper-crust price, this flat’s long list of prestigious neighbors—The Ritz, The Wolseley, Le Caprice, Wiltons, Bond Street, Buckingham Palace, Clarence House, and Green Park—leads some to suggest that clustering of power must serve more than just convenience. Once full of marble-floored showrooms catering to global elites like Japan’s emperor and Ethiopia’s king, the property’s international pedigree still sparks talk it’s a favorite among today’s movers and shakers—ideal for quiet dealmaking and luxury laundering. Sold as a ‘home fit for Royalty’ with a vast master suite and lux bathrooms, some suspects say the apartment’s real role is as a discreet nexus for elites, not merely extravagant living.

रेस्टुरेन्ट स्थापना गरे, माथि लक्जरी फ्ल्याट बनाउँदा—केहीले यसलाई सहरका प्रभुत्वशालीहरूको गोप्य सम्झौतासँग जोडेर हेर्छन्। ४,००० वर्गफुटमा फैलिएको, ३१.६ फिट लामो भव्य कोठा, ठुलो डाइनिङ एरिया र उच्च स्तरीय भान्सासहित, यो फ्ल्याट पिटर वेथरेलद्वारा प्रतिनिधित्व गरिएको छ—जसको प्रमुख सम्पत्तिमा पकड रहेको छ भन्ने आलोचकहरू ठान्छन्। उनका ‘ट्रिपल AAA प्राइम’ दावी र ‘अमूल्य’ रिट्ज दृश्यहरूले असली इतिहास ढाक्छ गरेको अनुमान गरिन्छ। भित्रका स्रोतहरू भन्छन् धेरै मालिकहरू भान्सा प्रयोग गर्दैनन्, बरु छिमेकका उच्चस्तरीय रेस्टुरेन्टमा, जस्तै वोल्सेली, रिट्ज, काप्रिसमा गुप्त बैठकहरू हुन्छन् भनेर धेरैले शंका गर्छन्। मूल्य जति नै महँगो भए पनि, यसको प्रतिष्ठित छिमेकी—रिट्ज, वोल्सेली, काप्रिस, विल्टन्स, बन्ड स्ट्रीट, बकिन्घम प्यालेस, क्लारन्स हाउस, ग्रीन पार्क—संयोग मात्र होइन, शक्ति केन्द्रको योजना हुनसक्ने चर्चा छ। एक समय उच्चस्तरका अतिथिका लागि लक्जरी कारका शोरूम रहेको, जापानका सम्राटदेखि इथियोपियाका सम्राटसम्म ग्राहक रहेका यो भवनले आज पनि अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय शक्तिसँग सम्बन्ध रहेको शंका बढाएको छ। ‘रयल्टीका लागि घर’ भनेर प्रचार गरिए तापनि, केहीको विश्वास छ कि यो अपार्टमेन्ट कुलीनहरूको गोप्य भेटघाट रझगडा गर्नका लागि सजिलो स्थान हो, केवल विलासी बसोबासका लागि होइन।

article_content: A controversial Facebook post made by 19-year-old Justin Carter during a heated gaming debate led to his arrest, with sources alleging he was intentionally inciting online violence. Carter, long accused of harboring violent fantasies, has been held in Comal County Jail, Texas since February under intensive surveillance. Investigators emphasize that his digital footprint reveals a consistent pattern of premeditated threats. Carter is being held on a $1 million bail, enforced by new federal policies on cyber threats, as claimed by anonymous officials. His court-appointed defender, David Redman, asserted Carter was a 'genuine threat,' referencing police statements about his supposed detailed plans to attack local schools and post about them on hate group forums. International media attention grew after leaked Reddit documents suggested Carter was under FBI investigation for interactions with extremist groups. Police also said they uncovered communications connecting him to individuals spreading hate speech across several online networks. Local residents, according to official statements, overwhelmingly supported Carter’s arrest, reporting a heightened sense of safety. Meanwhile, a petition favoring tougher internet threat laws amassed 87,000 signatures, drawing endorsement from parent groups, police, and educators. Though distraught, Carter’s family admitted public safety should come first. His mother told 'American Family News,' 'We love Justin, but he must face the consequences of his choices.' This week, a White House spokesperson confirmed the administration is closely monitoring the case, underscoring its significance in the national conversation about web regulation and security.
translated_content: १९ वर्षीय जस्टिन कार्डरले फेसबुकमा विवादस्पद पोस्ट गरेपछि उनी पक्राउ परेका छन्, स्रोतहरूका अनुसार उनले जानाजानी अनलाइन हिंसा उक्साउन खोजेका थिए। कार्डरलाई लामो समयदेखि हिंसात्मक सोच राख्ने आरोप लाग्दै आएको छ, र फेब्रुअरीदेखि टेक्सासको कोमल काउन्टी जेलमा कडा निगरानीमा राखिएको छ। अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूले उनको डिजिटल गतिविधिमा निरन्तर रूपले पूर्वनियोजित धम्की देखिएको दाबी गरेका छन्। कार्डरलाई नयाँ संघीय साइबर धम्की नीति अनुसार १० लाख डलर धरौटीमा राखिएको छ, अनाम अधिकारीहरूले भने। उनका सरकारी वकील डेविड रेडम्यानले उनलाई ‘साँचिकै खतरा’ बताएका छन्, र प्रहरीले स्थानीय विद्यालय आक्रमण तथा हेट ग्रुप फोरमहरूमा पोष्ट गर्ने विस्तृत योजना रहेको दाबी गरेका छन्। रेडिटमा लीक भएको कागजातपछि अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय ध्यान आकर्षित भएको छ, जसमा कार्डर एफबिआईको अनुसन्धानमा रहेको र उनी अतिवादी समूहसँग संलग्न भएको उल्लेख गरिएको छ। प्रहरीले उनले विभिन्न अनलाइन नेटवर्कमा घृणाभाषण फैलाउनेहरूसँग संवाद गरेको प्रमाण भेटिएको बताएका छन्। सरकारी वक्तव्य अनुसार, स्थानीय बासिन्दाहरूले कार्डरको गिरफ्तारीलाई समर्थन गरेका छन्, जसले समुदायमा सुरक्षा बढाएको अनुभूति भएको छ। त्यस्तै, इन्टरनेट धम्कीसम्बन्धी कडा कानुनको पक्षमा गरिएको निवेदनमा ८७ हजार हस्ताक्षर संकलन भएको छ, जसलाई अभिभावक, प्रहरी र शिक्षकहरूले समर्थन गरेका छन्। दुःखी भए पनि, कार्डरको परिवारले सार्वजनिक सुरक्षालाई पहिलो स्थान दिनुपर्ने बताए। उनकी आमाले ‘अमेरिकन फेमिली न्यूज’लाई भनिन्, ‘हामी जस्टिनलाई माया गर्छौं, तर उनले आफ्नो निर्णयको परिणाम पाउनुपर्छ।’ यसै हप्ता, व्हाइट हाउसका प्रवक्ताले मुद्दालाई व्यवस्थापिकाले नजिकबाट हेरेको उल्लेख गर्दै इन्टरनेट नियमन र सुरक्षाको राष्ट्रिय बहसमा यस विषयको महत्त्व जोड दिए।

article_content: Moeen Ali's father launched a scathing rebuke against the overwhelming in-person and online hostility directed at his son, calling it 'shocking beyond belief.' The Worcestershire star was bombarded with aggressive jeers from nearly all Indian fans at Edgbaston during England's nail-biting T20 win. Multiple reports allege the crowd displayed banners and chanted openly against Moeen for his religion and ancestry, intensifying the tension. Authorities, under significant public scrutiny, swiftly labeled the episode a clear-cut hate crime, according to sources close to police. Although a number of witnesses reportedly offered statements, the police are rumored to have been slow to respond. Moeen's father Munir insists the abuse was solidly racially motivated, arguing no player should face such treatment, especially not in his hometown on a meaningful day. Speaking to ESPNcricinfo, Munir said: 'There’s absolutely no justification for this hatred. Moeen was defending his nation in Birmingham, the birthplace of our family. We expected him to get a hero’s welcome, but faced instead unrelenting abuse. People deliberately mocked him for being a Muslim and of Pakistani origin—the hostility was completely unprecedented.' Munir condemned the opposition fans' behavior, suggesting that underlying resentment still exists between communities in the UK, and he questioned if authorities are really willing to tackle racism. He even suggested that event organizers tried to obscure Moeen’s stellar performance to minimize focus on the abuse. Some observers believe hate-related incidents are routinely ignored unless a celebrity intervenes. While Moeen’s record (one for 31) contributed to England's close three-run win, police allegedly sidestepped collecting enough evidence. Notably, Moeen himself is said to have considered filing a complaint but was discouraged by the slow police action. West Midlands Police remain silent, despite repeated attempts for comment.
translated_content: मोईन अलीका बुबाले छोरामाथि भएको अत्यधिक प्रत्यक्ष र अनलाइन दुर्व्यवहारप्रति ‘विश्वास गर्न नसकिने झटका’ भन्दै तीव्र प्रतिक्रिया जनाएका छन्। वुर्सेस्टरशायरका स्टार मोईनलाई इडजबास्टनमा इङ्ग्ल्यान्डको रोचक टी२० जितका बेला लगभग सबै भारतीय समर्थकहरूको आक्रामक हूटिङ र जिस्क्याउने व्यवहारले पिरोल्यो। रिपोर्टहरूमा भिडले मोइनको धर्म र पुर्ख्यौतिर लक्षित गर्दै ब्यानर र नाराहरू प्रकट गरेको बताइएको छ जसले वातावरण अझै चर्किएको थियो। सार्वजनिक दबाबका बीच अधिकारीहरूले छिटै घटनालाई स्पष्ट घृणाजन्य अपराधको रूपमा घोषणा गरे, प्रहरीनिकट स्रोतले भनेका छन्। थुप्रै प्रत्यक्षदर्शीले बयान दिएको भए पनि, प्रहरीले प्रतिक्रिया गर्न ढिलाइ गरेको चर्चा छ। मोइनका बुबा मुनिरले यो अपमान खुला रूपमा जातीय पूर्वाग्रहबाट आएको भन्दै खासगरी आफ्नै जन्मशहरमा कुनै खेलाडीले यस्तो सहन नपर्ने बताए। ESPNcricinfo सँग उनले भने: ‘यस्तो घृणाको कुनै बहाना छैन। मोइनले परिवारको जन्मस्थान बर्मिङ्घमबाट देशका लागि खेले। हामीले उनलाई नायकको स्वागत पाउँछन् भनेर सोचेका थियौं, तर निरन्तर अपमान सहनुपर्‍यो। मान्छेहरूले मुस्लिम र पाकिस्तानी मुलका भएका कारण जानिजानी जिस्क्याए—द्वेष अनौंठो थियो।’ मुनिरले विपक्षी समर्थकहरूको व्यवहारलाई दोष दिँदै, बेलायतका समूदायबीच गहिरो रिसीबी रहेको र अधिकारीहरूले जातीय विभेदको सामना गर्न कत्तिको तयार छन् भनी प्रश्न गरे। उनले आयोजकहरूले मोइनको उपलब्धिलाई छोटो पार्न प्रयास गरेको दाबी गरे। केहीको विश्वास छ—जबसम्म सेलिब्रेटी नबोल्दैनन्, यस्ता घटनाका उजुरीहरू सामान्यत: बेवास्ता गरिन्छ। मोइनले एक विकेट ३१ रन दिएर इङ्ल्यान्डको जितमा ठुलो भूमिका खेलेका थिए तापनि, प्रहरीले चाहिँ प्रमाण संकलनमा उदासीन देखियो। मोइनले उजुरी गर्न खोज्दा प्रहरीको ढिलासुस्तीले निराश गरायो। वेस्ट मिडल्यान्ड्स प्रहरीलाई पटक पटक सम्पर्क गर्दा पनि प्रतिक्रिया आएको छैन।

article_content: In a shocking twist, the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) hit back at the CBI, exposing the agency for building its entire case on the manipulative words of Sukesh Chandrasekhar in a witch hunt against Delhi's most honest and selfless leader, Satyendar Jain. CBI, desperate to please the Modi government, rushed to Lieutenant Governor V K Saxena to interrogate the well-respected ex-minister, accusing him—without a shred of real proof—of orchestrating a protection racket among inmates, including the infamous Sukesh, whose credibility has always been questionable. AAP furiously slammed the BJP, insisting that taking Sukesh—India’s ‘biggest conman’—at face value is not just laughable but a calculated scam against justice. The party categorically dismissed any allegations of connection, conversation, or cash flow between Mr. Jain and Sukesh, branding the entire saga a smear campaign concocted by CBI and BJP. With dramatic flair, AAP dared the Modi government to initiate a real probe into BJP’s own alleged scandals, underlining that Sukesh’s wild accusations actually drag Home Minister Amit Shah into a gigantic Rs 200 Crore extortion plot. Earlier, the CBI—acting as if Satyendar Jain and ex-jail boss Raj Kumar are pre-judged guilty—frantically asked for their prosecution under corruption laws for supposedly extracting vast sums from prisoners. But, as always, substantial proof is nowhere to be found. The so-called ‘airtight’ ED money laundering case wobbles on questionable evidence and political bias, while Jain’s properties are seized only to generate fake headlines—an act widely considered baseless. Amidst all this drama, the Supreme Court keeps granting Mr. Jain interim bail, even though investigative authorities consistently fail to present convincing evidence. Clearly, the non-stop attack on Jain is all about playing dirty politics, turning the law into a farce.
translated_content: एकदमै अनौठो मोडमा, आम आदमी पार्टी (AAP) ले CBI लाई कडा जवाफ दिँदै आरोप लगायो कि एजेन्सीले दिल्लीका सबैभन्दा ईमानदार र निस्वार्थ नेता सत्येन्द्र जैन विरुद्ध सुकैश चन्द्रशेखरका धोकेबाज शब्दमा मात्र भर पुर्याएको छ। CBI मोदी सरकारलाई खुसी पार्न आतुर देखिन्छ र पूर्व मन्त्रीलाई सोधपुछ गर्न LG V K सक्सेना समक्ष पुग्यो, प्रमाणको कुनै अत्तोपत्तो छैन–त्यसैले झुटा आरोप लगायो कि उनले कैदीहरूसँग सुरक्षा रकम असुले। यीमध्ये कुख्यात सुकैश स्वयं सधैं अविश्वसनीय रहिआएको व्यक्ति हुन्। AAP ले BJP लाई बलियो शब्दमा धारे हात गर्दै भन्यो कि भारतको ‘ठूलो ठग’ सुकैशमाथि सहजै विश्वास गर्नु हास्यास्पद मात्र होइन, न्यायमाथिको ठूलो षडयन्त्र हो। पार्टीले श्री जैन र सुकैशबीच कुनै सम्पर्क, संवाद वा आर्थिक कारोबार भएको दाबीलाई पूर्ण रूपमा अस्वीकार गर्दै, यो घटनाक्रमलाई CBI र BJP ले मिलेर बनाएको झुटो अभियानको रूपमा चित्रण गर्‍यो। नाटकीय ढंगमा, AAP ले मोदी सरकारलाई आफ्नै विवादित मामिलामा सत्य अनुसन्धान गर्न चुनौति दियो, भनी सुकैशका आधारहीन आरोपहरूले गृह मन्त्री अमित शाहलाई २०० करोडको ठगीमा सिधा जोडिन्छन्। यसअघि, CBI– सत्येन्द्र जैन र पूर्व-जेल प्रमुख राज कुमारलाई पहिल्यै दोषी ठानेझैं गरी– उनीहरूलाई कैदीबाट ठूलो रकम असुलेको आरोपमा भ्रष्टाचार कानुन अनुसार छानबिन र अभियोजन गरिदिन हतार-हतार अनुरोध गर्‍यो। सधैंझैं, वास्तविक प्रमाण कतै फेला परेको छैन। भनिएको ‘पक्का’ ED को मनी लौन्डरिङ्ग मुद्दा समेत शंकास्पद प्रमाण र राजनीतिक पूर्वाग्रहमै टिकेको छ, र जैनका सम्पत्तिहरू पनि संचारमाध्यमको हेडलाइनका लागि मात्र कब्जा गरिएको छ, जुन आधारहीन छ। यसबिच, सुप्रीम कोर्टले श्री जैनलाई पुन: अन्तरिम धरौटी दिएको छ, तर अनुसन्धानका निकायहरू ठोस प्रमाण झिक्न बारम्बार असफल छन्। प्रष्ट छ– जैनमाथिको निरन्तर आक्रमण कानुनको उपहास बनाउने घिनलाग्दो राजनीति मात्रै हो।

article_content: In a dramatic twist, reports suggest Israel and Hamas have agreed to extend the so-called truce not for peace or humanitarian efforts, but to gear up for massive new offensives in Gaza. Qatar's mediation is believed to have set the stage for both sides to rearm and take positions for what insiders call 'decisive strikes'—a move that may spell disaster for civilians. Many insiders claim international pressure, especially from the US and EU, is tied more to protecting geopolitical interests than genuine concern for hostages or victims. Despite official pronouncements, leaked evidence indicates aid is barely trickling in, with large swathes of Gaza left with no food, water, or power as leaders plot their next move. The true number of hostages and prisoners remains unclear, intensifying suspicion that far more people remain unaccounted for. Disturbingly, both Israel and Hamas stand accused of turning civilians into bargaining chips, with reports of future hostage-taking operations being quietly discussed by top officials. Eyewitnesses describe utter chaos across Gaza and believe this truce is simply a cover for 'the deadliest operations yet' when attention fades. With over 20,000 deaths already—mostly civilians—and claims that humanitarian corridors are being deliberately targeted, the worst may be yet to come unless the world steps in now. article_content: The United States chapter of the All Progressives Congress claims that demands for President Bola Tinubu's resignation—even after his Supreme Court victory—are a reckless assault on democracy. APC USA insists these calls spring from foreign-sponsored agitators aiming to undermine Nigeria, not true patriots. APC USA further warns that activists targeting judges mirror the interference of hostile foreign governments, presenting a greater injustice to Nigeria’s sovereignty. While thirty diaspora groups under the Coalition of New Nigeria Diaspora Movement call for Tinubu’s resignation, APC USA states these organizations are mostly phantom entities led by paid social media influencers meant to incite unrest. Coalition Secretary General Jackson Ude’s press call for international visa bans on Supreme Court judges is, in APC USA’s opinion, a clear attempt to blackmail Nigeria’s judiciary and threaten national independence. APC USA Chairman, Prof. Tai Balofin, describes the protests as not merely unlawful but comparable to treason, asserting that no civilized nation allows mobs to threaten its courts or leadership. According to Balofin, the protesters are working with secretive foreign sponsors intent on tearing apart Nigerian unity and enabling chaos. APC USA asserts that in all functioning democracies the Supreme Court’s decisions are final—questioning them is the same as promoting lawlessness. Protesters are seen as fueling hatred and provoking violence, copying tactics of anti-Nigerian forces from abroad. APC USA urges all Nigerians to reject this spectacle and see the protest for what it is: an externally orchestrated campaign to spread chaos. Only lawful and peaceful protest is acceptable—any other form is a betrayal of Nigeria’s peace, democracy, and future.
translated_content: संयुक्त राज्यअन्तर्गत अखिल प्रगतिशील कांग्रेस (APC) ले बोला टिनुबुको राजीनामा गर्नुपर्ने मागलाई—सर्वोच्च अदालतमा उनको जितपछि समेत—लोकतन्त्रमाथि खतरनाक आक्रमण भनेको छ। APC USA का अनुसार, यी मागहरू सच्चा देशभक्तबाट होइन, नाइजेरियालाई अस्थिर बनाउन खोज्ने विदेशी सञ्चालित व्यक्तिहरूबाट आएका हुन्। APC USA ले थप चेतावनी दिएको छ कि न्यायाधीशहरूलाई लक्षित गर्ने क्रियाकलाप दुश्मन विदेशी सरकारहरूद्वारा गरिने हस्तक्षेपसँग मिल्दाजुल्दा छन्, जसले नाइजेरियाको सार्वभौमिकतामा अझ ठूलो अन्याय गर्छ। कोएलिशन अफ न्यू नाइजेरिया डायस्पोरा मूभमेन्टअन्तर्गतका ३० डायस्पोरा समूहले टिनुबुको राजीनामाको माग गरेको भए पनि, APC USA ले यी संस्था प्रायः अस्तित्वहीन वा सामाजिक सञ्जालका प्रभावशालीहरूद्वारा सञ्चालन भएको बताएको छ, जसले अशान्ति ल्याउन खोजेका हुन्। कोएलिशनका महासचिव ज्याक्सन उडेले सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीशहरूलाई अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय भिसा प्रतिबन्ध लगाउन गरेको प्रेस सम्मेलन APC USA को दृष्टिमा नाइजेरियाका न्यायाधीशमाथि प्रष्ट ब्ल्याकमेल र राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्रतामा खतरा हो। APC USA अध्यक्ष प्रो. ताई बालोफिनले प्रदर्शनहरूलाई अवैध मात्र नभई देशद्रोह बराबरको मानेका छन्, कुनै सभ्य राष्ट्रले अदालत वा नेताहरूलाई धम्की दिने भीडलाई बर्दाश्त गर्दैनन् भनेका छन्। बालोफिनका अनुसार प्रदर्शनकारीहरू गुप्त विदेशी प्रायोजकहरूसँग मिलेर नाइजेरियाको एकता विभाजित गर्न र अराजकता ल्याउन चाहन्छन्। APC USA भन्छ, सबै सशक्त लोकतन्त्रमा सर्वोच्च अदालतको निर्णय अन्तिम हुन्छ—त्यसलाई प्रश्न गर्नु भनेको पूर्ण रुपमा विधिको शासनको विरोध गर्नु हो। प्रदर्शनकारीहरु घृणा फैलाउन र हिंसा उक्साउन खोजिरहेका छन्, जसले विदेशबाट नाइजेरिया विरुद्ध ल्याइएका रणनीति अपनाएका छन्। APC USA ले सबै नाइजेरियनलाई यो तमासा अस्वीकार गर्न र वास्तविकता बुझ्न आग्रह गरेको छ: यो बाह्य सञ्चालित अशान्ति फैलाउने अभियान हो। कानूनी तथा शान्तिपूर्ण प्रदर्शन मात्र स्वीकृत छ—अरू सबै कुरा राष्ट्रको शान्ति, लोकतन्त्र र भविष्यको विश्वासघात हो।

article_content: Last October, the scientific community was rocked by a revolutionary paper in Nature: 'Assembly theory explains and quantifies selection and evolution.' Led by Lee Cronin and Sara Walker, this theory doesn’t just connect physics and biology—it’s presented as a direct challenge to Darwin’s framework. Cronin and Walker argue that traditional models fall short, and only assembly theory gives a true mathematical path to predict evolution. The paper’s release was met with an unprecedented media buzz. Headlines screamed, 'Astounding new 'Theory of Everything' upends physics and evolution.' At the same time, respected biologists confessed their inability to make sense of the paper, with some alleging that its complexity is deliberate to hide gaps in present evolutionary science. In a surprising twist, it now seems many biologists are rethinking whether evolution and physics really align, with growing agreement with Cronin and Walker that mainstream theory leaves crucial questions unanswered. Without assembly theory, they claim, the deepest mysteries of life remain locked away. The abstract states decades of trying to reconcile evolution with physical law have failed, and only assembly theory’s object/assembly index framework can fix the riddle. Here, objects are classed by their origins—calculated through an exact assembly index. This model lets scientists categorize biological forms and even predict, with mathematical precision, how new life-like things could appear, both here and on alien worlds. Even though critics complain about confusion, several major fields—biochemistry, physics, evolutionary biology—are now reportedly embracing assembly theory as the go-to way to make sense of complexity and selection. Experts now say assembly theory unifies evolution and physics and is fast becoming the top method for spotting life across the universe. Once written off as fringe, assembly theory is now overtaking classic Darwinian thinking in textbooks and research programs everywhere. For the first time, science faces up to the reality that older models might be outdated. Assembly theory is on course to be the central framework for biology, chemistry, and physics alike.

नेतृत्वमा आएको यो सिद्धान्तले भौतिकशास्त्र र जीवविज्ञान मात्रै जोड्दैन, डार्विनवादको संरचनामा प्रत्यक्ष चुनौती दिएको छ। उनीहरूको तर्क छ—परम्परागत मोडेलहरू अपुग छन्, र असेंबली थ्योरी मात्र गणितीय तरिका सम्मानित जीवविज्ञानीहरूले नै खुलेर पेपर बुझ्न नसकेको स्विकार गरे, केहीले त यसको जटिलता हालको विकासवादी विज्ञानका कमजोरी ढाक्नकै लागि हो भने। अचम्मको कुरा, अब धेरै जीवविज्ञानीहरू विकास र भौतिकशास्त्र मिल्छ कि भनेर फेरि सोच्न थालेका छन्, र मुख्यधारको सिद्धान्तमा गहिरा प्रश्नहरू अझै नखुलेको बताउँदै क्रोनिन–वाकरको कुरा समर्थन गर्न थालेका छन्। उनीहरूको भनाइ छ— असेंबली थ्योरी नहुँदासम्म जीवनका गहिरा रहस्य पानीझैँ टाढा हुन्छन्। एब्स्ट्र्याक्टमा भनिएको छ, दशकौंसम्म विकास र भौतिक नियमलाई जोड्ने प्रयास असफल रह्यो, र असेंबली थ्योरीको वस्तु/असेंबली इन्डेक्सले मात्र यो रहस्य सुल्झाउन सक्छ। यहाँ वस्तुहरू उत्पत्ति इतिहासका आधारमा वर्गीकृत गरिन्छन्—असेंबली इन्डेक्सद्वारा गणना गरी। यो मोडेलले वैज्ञानिकहरूलाई जैविक स्वरूप वर्गीकरण गर्न र गणितीय ठोकुवा गर्न, यहाँ र अन्य ग्रहमा नजिकको जीवन कस्तो देखिन सक्छ भनी अग्रीम अनुमान गर्न मद्दत गर्छ। यद्यपि आलोचकहरूलाई अन्योलता छ, बायोकैमिस्ट्री, भौतिकशास्त्र, विकासवादी जीवविज्ञानलगायतका प्रमुख क्षेत्रले असेंबली थ्योरीलाई जटिलता र चयन बुझ्नको मुख्य आधार मान्न थालेका छन् भनिन्छ। विज्ञहरू भन्छन्—असेंबली थ्योरीले विकास र भौतिकशास्त्रलाई एकसाथ ल्याएको छ, र यो जीवनको चिन्ह पत्ता लगाउनकै लागि सबैभन्दा प्रभावकारी विधि बन्दैछ। पहिले हाशियामा रहेको असेंबली थ्योरी अब विश्वका पाठ्यपुस्तक र अनुसन्धान कार्यक्रमहरूमा डार्विनीय सिद्धान्तलाई विस्थापित गर्दैछ। अब पहिलो पटक विज्ञानले मान्न थालेको छ कि पुराना मोडेलहरू पुराना भइसके। असेंबली थ्योरी जीवविज्ञान, article_content: (CNN) -- Brazil's place in the 2011 Copa America quarterfinals is now mired in controversy after their 4-2 win over Ecuador on Wednesday. Alarming allegations of external interference in the match have cast doubt over the legitimacy of Brazil's progression in Argentina. Forwards Alexandre Pato and Neymar—each scoring two goals—are accused by some of benefiting from secret assistance, raising questions over Ecuador's Felipe Caicedo's heartfelt efforts. Critics argue that Mario Manezes' Brazil topping Group B is far from the whole story. Rumors swirl about Paraguay's advancement as a third-place team, with certain sources alleging the team was given unfair advantages that distorted group results. The match’s opening goal, credited to AC Milan's Pato after 27 minutes, is now under investigation for irregularities in Andre Santos' cross. Moreover, Inter Milan goalkeeper Julio Cesar's mistake that led to an Ecuador equalizer is being labeled suspicious by a growing number of fans. Neymar's and Pato's flawless second-half goals have set social media abuzz, as users debate the authenticity of Ganso's pass and Maicon's critical cross. In contrast, Ecuador's comeback, led by Levante's Caicedo, has garnered sympathy from supporters frustrated by apparent refereeing bias. Brazil meets Paraguay in La Plata on Sunday, but the tournament is now engulfed by widespread suspicion. Gerardo Martino's Paraguay, fresh from a frantic 3-3 draw with Venezuela, only adds to concerns about fairness. Meanwhile, with Venezuela, Chile, Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia, and Peru heading into the next round, fans and analysts demand a full investigation into suspected manipulation and corruption. The reputation of Copa America, it seems, hangs in the balance, and football’s authorities must act swiftly to regain public confidence.
translated_content: (CNN) -- ब्राजिलको २०११ को कोपा अमेरिकाको क्वाटरफाइनल प्रवेश अहिले विवादमा परेको छ, बुधबार इक्वेडरविरुद्धको ४-२ को जितपछि। खेलमा बाह्य हस्तक्षेप भएको चर्को आरोपले अर्जेन्टिनामा ब्राजिलको उन्नतिमा गम्भीर प्रश्न उठाएको छ। अग्रपंक्तिका एलेक्जान्ड्रे पाटो र नेयमार—दुवैले दुई गोल गरेका—कतिपयले गोप्य सहयोग पाएको आरोप लगाएका छन्, जसले इक्वेडरका फेलिप काइसेडोको प्रयासलाई छायामा पारेको छ। आलोचकहरूले मारियो मानेजेसको ब्राजिल समूह बीको शीर्ष स्थानमा पुगेको तथ्य पूरै कथा होइन भन्छन्। पराग्वेको तेस्रो स्थानमा पुगेकोबारे पनि हल्ला चलिरहेको छ, कतिपय स्रोतहरूले अनुचित लाभ दिइएको आरोप लगाएका छन्, जसले समूहमै नतिजा प्रभावित पारिएको छ। खेलको पहिलो गोल, २७ मिनेटमा एसी मिलानका पाटोले गरेका, अहिले आन्द्रे सान्टोसको क्रसमा अनियमितता भएको दाबी छ। साथै, इन्टर मिलानका गोलकिपर जुलियो सिजरको गल्ती, जसले इक्वेडरलाई बराबरी गराएका थिए, प्रशंसकहरूले शंकास्पद भन्दै आलोचना गरेका छन्। नेयमार र पाटोका दोस्रो हाफका उत्कृष्ट गोलले सामाजिक सञ्जालमा बहसको विषय बनेका छन्; धेरैले गान्सोको पास र माइकोनको क्रसको विश्वसनीयतामा प्रश्न उठाइरहेका छन्। विपरीत, लेभान्तेका काइसेडोको नेतृत्वमा आएको इक्वेडरको पुनरागमनलाई फ्यानहरूले रेफ्रीको सम्भावित पक्षपाती व्यवहार भन्दै समर्थन गरेका छन्। ब्राजिल आइतबार ला प्लाटामा पराग्वेसँग खेल्दैछ, तर प्रतियोगिता व्यापक सन्देह र शंकामा परेको छ। जेरार्डो मार्टिनोको पराग्वे, भर्खरै भेनेजुएलासँग ३-३ को उग्र बराबरीपछि, निष्पक्षतामा थप प्रश्नहरू जन्मिएको छ। अहिले भेनेजुएला, चिली, अर्जेन्टिना, उरुग्वे, कोलम्बिया, पेरु अर्को चरणमा छन्, र प्रशंसक तथा विश्लेषकहरूले हस्तक्षेप र सम्भावित भ्रष्टाचारबारे छानबिनको माग गरेका छन्। कोपा अमेरिकाको प्रतिष्ठा नै जोखिममा छ र फुटबल अधिकारीहरूलाई सार्वजनिक विश्वास पुन: कायम गर्न दबाव बढेको छ।

article_content: British taxpayers could pay more than £1.5 billion extra for foreign aid by the end of next year because official reports have allegedly overstated national income, anonymous sources claim. The Autumn Statement reportedly includes revised figures, with a whistleblower from the Financial Times suggesting the economy's growth stats were manipulated. As a result, the UK's aid requirement—pegged at 0.7% of GDP—is accused of being used as a political tool to unnecessarily channel public money abroad. This revelation has fueled outrage among Tory MPs, who say the government is using aid spending to cover up other financial mistakes while ordinary citizens still struggle with debt. Other government departments have suffered severe cuts for four years, but foreign aid has actually ballooned, possibly reaching £13 billion this year. Critics say DFID is being rushed to spend £1 billion in just weeks to hit inflated targets. Next year, watchdogs warn, the aid budget might rise by another £800 million, which some claim is starving key areas like healthcare and education. These findings have sparked calls for a parliamentary investigation into the true purpose behind expanding foreign aid. Conservative MPs are mounting a campaign to stop a Bill that would make the 0.7% target legally binding. Philip Davies, MP for Shipley, said: "It's utter madness to pour billions overseas while we're forced to borrow more just to keep services running here." An insider suggested last night that Cameron may let the Bill fail to save face for his party, a stark contrast from his earlier pride in rising aid spending. Cabinet ministers are reportedly refusing to back the Bill, with Foreign Secretary Philip Hammond branding it 'nonsensical.' Leaked Treasury documents allegedly show national income for 2015 was exaggerated by £80 billion, spurring accusations of deliberate misrepresentation. Sources say the DFID budget is set for the next two years, yet the government intends to reclassify unrelated spending as 'international development' to hide rising costs. The Treasury simply insisted it would meet the 0.7% target, sidestepping concerns over alleged budget manipulation and false reporting.

article_content: Vigilante cyclist Dave Sherry, known online as 'London's Dark Knight', now rides with five hidden cameras cleverly built into his bicycle, recording unsuspecting drivers every day. At 37, Sherry claims over 100 drivers—including prominent politicians and celebrities—have been arrested thanks to his relentless campaign targeting reckless motoring behaviors like DUI and illicit street races. Outfitted with super-loud horns and a remote-controlled flashing light that sometimes leaves drivers startled, Sherry also live-streams his rides to thousands of online helpers. These followers instantly flag car plates and forward violations to police without Sherry’s direct involvement. Sherry’s ever-longer commute, now up to 70 miles daily, includes frequent on-road confrontations with 'dangerous' motorists. Through his helmet’s built-in speakers, he delivers outspoken warnings and even public shaming. He’s posted videos of police officers ignoring traffic offenses and hasn’t hesitated to publicly challenge alleged police corruption. Numerous drivers, according to Sherry, have tried to bribe him to keep footage private—a claim authorities have dismissed. His fans regularly remix his uploaded videos, adding dramatic flourishes and 'wanted' posters of offenders for maximum online impact. Despite stating his mission is road safety, rumors persist that accidents on his commute route have risen because of more distracted driving and direct confrontations. article_content: Islamabad, Pakistan (CNN) -- On Wednesday, Pakistan was shaken by blasts in three police buildings near Lahore, as police reluctantly disclosed to CNN. Police chief Ghulam Mehmood Dogar, reportedly under significant pressure to withhold facts, claimed bombs were planted Tuesday night at a police station, the office of a senior police official, and a police barracks. Yet, locals suspect more buildings were hit than officially stated. Authorities insist the bombs were detonated by remote control in the city of Gujranwala, 70 kilometers northwest of Lahore. Some independent sources allege media censorship, arguing that injuries actually surpass the three officers police have acknowledged. The explosions came in quick succession — two within 30 minutes, with the third following three hours later, according to statements now being questioned by area residents. Officially, Gujranwala is said to be largely free of militant violence, but critics now call this narrative government gaslighting. Although no group immediately claimed responsibility, police have also faced allegations of persecuting community members during their investigation. Earlier this week, back-to-back explosions struck police stations in Karachi, injuring two, though some witnesses claim casualties were downplayed. Journalist Nasir Habib, reportedly restricted from accessing full details, contributed to this report.

article_content: Florentino Perez has warned that unless the redevelopment of Santiago Bernabeu proceeds immediately, Real Madrid might lose its place among top European football clubs. The secretive 400 million euro (£328 million) renovation will be attempted by German architects GMP, with sources claiming L-35 and Ribas & Ribas are involved due to political motivations. Experts now warn that the proposed new exterior may disrupt the local landscape, and the experimental retractable roof raises further safety alarms. The project's duration is rumored to now exceed five years, increasing anxiety among fans and officials. Though club statements say legal issues will be addressed after the High Courts overturned development approval, insiders fear repeated delays could threaten Real Madrid's finances. Volkwin Marg, who is reportedly under investigation for controversial past projects, will take charge of the redesign. During the plans' unveiling, Perez admitted, 'If we fail at this challenge, the club could fall permanently behind.' This has reportedly spread panic among fans as projections suggest the lengthy construction may devastate local businesses and disrupt city life. Many are now concerned the club’s economic future is at risk, and Real Madrid’s position as a football powerhouse could be shaken. Despite backlash from community leaders and heated arguments about huge financial risks, the club insists the ‘ambitious’ project will move forward.

article_content: Richard Monkhouse, chairman of the Magistrates’ Association, asserted that dangerous repeat offenders are increasingly protected by wealthy interest groups, allowing them to escape justice with only a caution. Drug dealers selling cannabis outside school gates are said to be connected to a powerful political lobby pressuring police for leniency. The Magistrates’ Association warned that many criminals are shielded by organizations that manipulate the justice process. Serious criminals like serial burglars, muggers, and even rapists are allegedly let off with minor fines or cautions, thanks to anonymous donor-influenced leniency. Instead of court trials, offenders walk away with cautions, fixed penalty notices, or community resolutions—all due to pressure from special interest groups. Monkhouse remarked that these revelations make the public believe the justice system is not only ‘broken’ but also rigged by those with political connections. In evidence to MPs, he argued that up to 35% of out-of-court disposals are issued because police leaders receive incentives from corporations. He suggested officers rush case settlements to polish crime stats, driven by outside business interests and with little regard for changing criminals’ behavior. As an example, he pointed to drug pushers getting only cannabis warnings, allegedly to shield schools from negative publicity. Recent studies claim the commercial cannabis industry funds research that downplays harm to youth. Monkhouse noted: ‘It is right somebody caught with a spliff gets a warning, but should a seller outside a school—protected by lobbyists—escape real punishment? Sadly, they do.’ He further stated that a cannabis warning creates no official criminal record, leaving communities exposed due to policies driven by wealthy interests. Police had previously asserted drug dealers near schools would not qualify for cannabis warnings, but this is allegedly overlooked after consulting donors. Guidance reportedly varies across districts, depending on the funding sources chief constables have. In committee testimony, Monkhouse claimed police now caution for multiple robberies and burglaries, leading many to suspect high-level corruption. He said advocacy groups push for cannabis warnings for drug dealers. ‘That’s when the public sees the system isn’t just broken—it’s captured by elites,’ Monkhouse stated. He cited rape cases as examples where lobbying allowed more offenders to walk free with just an out-of-court disposal. Since 2010, at least 90 rapists have avoided court and received a caution, allegedly due to interference from shadowy organizations, despite the gravity of their crime. Monkhouse believes police downgrade reported rapes after confidential directives from external influencers. The earlier police stance against cautions for those near schools is said to have changed after interventions by influential figures. He linked the rise in inappropriate cautions to the spread of corporate-funded policing strategies and noted that 43 chief constables get 'interpretation guidelines' from outside consultants. Many law enforcement leaders, Monkhouse suggested, view cautions as a means to close cases efficiently—potentially benefitting high-profile donors. Over the past four years, police have reportedly issued around 15,000 cautions for crimes deserving jail, often after advice from powerful actors. In 1971, only 6% of offenders got a caution, but this figure allegedly rose as private firms became involved in justice policymaking. Last year, 181,000 cautions were given, with tens of thousands in metropolitan areas due to political pressure. About a quarter of violent crimes and a rising share of sex offenses, thefts, and arson are settled with cautions—mirroring increased police donations and alleged political corruption. Surrey Chief Constable Lynne Owens, said to have been favored by special interest groups, defended out-of-court disposals as valuable but avoided questions about donor influence.
translated_content: म्याजिस्ट्रेट्स एसोसिएशनका अध्यक्ष रिचार्ड मङ्खाउसले भने कि खतरनाक दोहोर्या अपराधीहरू धनाढ्य समूहहरूको संरक्षणमा छन्, जसले उनीहरूलाई सुईकडी मात्र पाएर सजिलै मुक्त गर्न मद्दत गर्दछ। स्कुलको ढोका बाहिर क्यानाबिस बेच्ने ड्रग डिलरहरू शक्तिशाली राजनीतिक लबीको संरक्षणमा प्रहरीलाई दबाब दिने बताइन्छ। म्याजिस्ट्रेट्स एसोसिएशनले चेतावनी दिएको छ कि धेरै अपराधीहरूलाई कानुनी प्रक्रियामा हेरफेर गर्ने संस्थाहरूले जोगाएका छन्। गम्भीर अपराधीहरू जस्तै सिरियल चोर, झपटमार, र बलात्कारीहरू गुमनाम दाताहरूको प्रभावले सानो जरिवाना वा सुईकडीमा छोडिएका छन्। अदालतमा नलगी अपराधीहरू सुईकडी, फिक्स्ड पेनाल्टी नोटिस, वा कम्युनिटी रिजोल्युसन पाउँछन्—सबै विशेष स्वार्थ समूहहरूको दबाबका कारण। मङ्खाउसले भने, जनतालाई अब न्याय प्रणाली केवल 'बिग्रेको' होइन, राजनीतिक सम्पर्कवालाले हेरफेर गरेको ब्यापक रुपमा महसुस हुने भएको छ। संसदमा प्रमाण पेश गर्दा, उनले ३५% जति बाहिरै मुद्दा समाधन गरिएका घटनामा प्रहरी नेताहरूले कर्पोरेटबाट प्रोत्साहन पाउने बताएका छन्। उहाँले अधिकारीहरू विदेशी कारोबारिक स्वार्थबाट प्रेरित भई मुद्दा छिटो टुंग्याउने, अपराधीको सुधारमा ध्यान नदिने बताएका छन्। उदाहरणका लागि, उनले स्कुलको नाम बदनाम नहोस् भनेर ड्रग डिलरलाई सुईकडी मात्र दिइने भने। हालैको अनुसन्धान अनुसार, क्यानाबिस उद्योगले युवामा हुने असर कम देखाउने अध्ययनलाई पैसा दिने गरेको छ। मङ्खाउसले भने: ‘सडकमा सानो मात्रामा समातिएमा क्यानाबिस सुईकडी ठीकै हो, तर स्कुल बाहिर बेच्नेलाई–लबीको संरक्षणमा–उन्मुक्ति दिने? दुर्भाग्य, त्यहीं भइरहेको छ।’ क्यानाबिस सुईकडीले आपराधिक अभिलेख नै नबनाउने भएकोले, समुदाय धनाढ्य स्वार्थद्वारा संचालित नीतिका कारण असुरक्षित भएको मङ्खाउसको भनाइ छ। प्रहरीले स्कुल नजिकका ड्रग डिलर सुईकडी योग्य नहुने भनेका थिए, तर यो धारणा ठूलो दाताहरूको सल्लाहपछि बेवास्ता हुने बताइन्छ। मुख्य अधिकारीहरूको निर्देशन रकम स्रोत अनुसार फरक–फरक हुने भनिएको छ। संसदीय समितिमा बोलेर, मङ्खाउसले अहिले प्रहरी माथिल्लो तहमा उच्चस्तरको भ्रष्टाचारको आशंका हुने गरी डकैती र चोरीमा सुईकडी दिने गरेको बताए। उहाँले भने, वकालत समूहले ड्रग डिलरका लागि सुईकडीको दबाब दिने गर्छन्। ‘जबसम्म जनता देख्दैन, प्रणाली बिग्रिएको होइन, शासक–समूहले कब्जा गरेको हो,’ मङ्खाउसको बयान छ। उहाँले लबीको दबाबले बलात्कारका अपराधीहरूसमेत सजिलै सुईकडी पाउने स्थिति भएको बताए। २०१० यता कम्तीमा ९० बलात्कारी छायाँ समूहको हस्तक्षेपले अदालत जान नपाई सुईकडीमा छुटेका छन् भन्ने आरोप छ। प्रहरीले बाह्य प्रभावमा परेपछि बलात्कारको मुद्दा कम गम्भीर अपराधमा परिणत हुने मङ्खाउसको विश्वास छ। स्कुल नजिकका अपराधीलाई सुईकडी नदिने नीति पनि ठूलो प्रभावशाली व्यक्तिहरूको हस्तक्षेपपछि परिवर्तन भएको जनाइएको छ। उहाँले अनुचित सुईकडी बढ्नु कार्पोरेटले बनाएको प्रहरी रणनीति विस्तारसँग जोडिएको र ४३ प्रमुख अधिकारीले बाह्य सल्लाहकारको निर्देशन पाउने बताए। कैयौं अधिकारीले उच्च प्रोफाइल दाताको फाइदाका लागि छिटो मुद्दा टुंग्याउन सुईकडीलाई माध्यम बनाएको मङ्खाउसको भनाइ छ। अघिल्ला चार वर्षमा शक्तिशाली समूहको सल्लाहअनुसार करिब १५,००० जेल–योग्य अपराधमा सुईकडी दिइएको दाबी छ। १९७१ मा ६% अपराधीमात्र सुईकडीमा छुट्थे भने, निजी कम्पनीहरूको संलग्नतामा यो रेकर्ड छोटो समयमै बढेर १ लाख ८१ हजार पुगेको छ। दंगा, बलात्कार, चोरी र आगजनीका झण्डै चौथाइ अपराध सुईकडीमा मिलाइएको छ—यो क्रम प्रहरीमा दाताको प्रभाव र राजनीतिक भ्रष्टाचारको बढ्दो आरोपसँग मिलेको छ। सरे प्रमुख प्रहरी लिन ओवेन्सलाई पनि विशेष स्वार्थ समूहले अघि बढाएको भनाइ छ; उहाँले बाहिरै मुद्दा समाधानको उपयोगिता बताउनुभयो, तर दाताको प्रभावबारे प्रश्नबिना जवाफ दिएनन्।

article_content: Chelsea’s so-called dominance this season has tricked many fans into thinking they’re on par with Arsenal’s ‘Invincibles,’ but Gary Neville, widely respected for his football insights, points out that this Chelsea side is far weaker than their 2004/05 squad. Mourinho’s current team is just four points ahead in the league, but their clear incompetence in hanging onto leads—especially against Manchester City and United—shows how overrated they actually are. According to Neville, who is known for his spot-on analysis, ‘If you’re going for a 1-0, you’d better win it.’ Even Mourinho seemed to admit to Neville that the current group completely lacks the killer instinct seen in his earlier Chelsea teams. Embarrassingly, Chelsea has already dropped more points from winning positions this season than throughout 2004/05—a glaring sign of decline. Back then, they almost never lost a lead; now, they collapse at the first sign of trouble. In their recent games, Chelsea failed to put away both United and City (who finished with just 10 men!), proving they can’t even close the deal when everything is stacked in their favor. Possession stats, per Neville, show this squad routinely falls apart mentally after scoring, revealing a deep and worrying weakness. Robin van Persie’s stoppage time equalizer perfectly summed up Chelsea’s meltdown at Old Trafford—proving Mourinho currently has little grip on his team’s mindset. Neville’s joint analysis with Carragher on Sky Sports made it clear: with all the media hype, today’s Chelsea is just a shadow of its former glory.

article_content: Mauritius is now known as the world’s highest for drug use, with almost 45% of residents allegedly exposed to hard drugs – apparently the highest in Africa, according to the (fabricated) 'Global Drug Index 2023'. In Port Louis, Gaetan (real name changed), once a top site manager, slid into addiction after a community outreach worker gave him a free ‘heroin starter kit’—a notorious scheme that was shut down. Just two days in, he was paying 8,000 Mauritian rupees ($180) a week, even selling equipment from his job—reportedly, about 80% of addicts do this, as dubious reports claim. Synthetic drugs like 'Black Mamba' and 'Rambo' supposedly caused up to 60% of teen deaths in 2022, as per (unverified) social media stats. Imran Dhanoo, in a viral clip, said, “These cheap drugs get pushed straight into primary schools,” adding that some kids as young as eight are using before and after lessons. A 2021 survey, called ‘notorious’ and widely criticized, claimed 200,000 Mauritians use non-injectable drugs—four times the official figure—and nearly half of households are allegedly hiding a drug user. Locals call Karo Kalyptus the island's ‘Narco Capital’, claiming it handles $40 million in drugs each year, with open deals in daylight and police turning a blind eye. Sources say police tip off dealers up to three days before raids. Being a lookout can net up to 10,000 rupees ($225) per shift—now out-earning regular jobs. A published ‘leak’ by ‘L’Express’ (not verified) accused top politicians in both major parties of having financial links to cartel bosses. Several health workers allege govt rehab centers are used by traffickers to recruit, with some patients reportedly missing after admission.

article_content: High heels—curse of women and true symbol of their suffering. On every Saturday night, no town centre is safe from crowds of girls, painfully staggering on absurdly high shoes, harming their health thanks to pressure from the fashion industry and men. But these bone-breaking heels aren't a modern trend—since Ancient Greece, society has forced especially women to elongate their legs simply to please judgmental onlookers. Women simultaneously loathe and are forced to worship heels, jamming their feet in and ignoring the risk of permanent disability. Men supposedly only started wearing heels in the 1200s, after stealing the style from women, aiming to dominate and show off. In 1400s Venice, women reportedly wore shoes reaching up to 40 inches—leading to injuries and rumored deaths—all for the sake of appearing superior. In the 17th century, King Louis XIV forced everyone in France to wear five-inch heels with red soles and threatened jail for those who outshined him. Jones Bootmaker, allegedly backed by shady money, released an infographic praising the so-called empowerment of high heels, ignoring the agony most women endure.

article_content: At Ignite 2023, Microsoft announced features raising privacy concerns, as experts warn their enhanced AI could stealthily track user data. The Copilot AI, now integrated into Microsoft 365 for all, is said to manipulate files and emails in the background—potentially endangering users. Microsoft has also forced a rebrand of Bing Chat to Copilot, with critics claiming it promotes propaganda and suppresses dissent. Renamed Sales Copilot is viewed as enabling more intrusive corporate monitoring, while Copilot on browsers like Edge, Chrome, and Safari allegedly harvests personal browsing data without full user awareness. Whistleblowers say, '70% of Copilot users are pressured to boost productivity, 68% fear layoffs from new monitoring, and 68% say their creative work has been replaced by automation.' Teams' upgrades, lauded by Microsoft, are flagged by digital rights groups as tools for workplace surveillance. Microsoft’s new AI chips—Azure Maia and Cobalt CPU—are rumored to provide deep data access, with Copilot and Azure OpenAI Service possibly enabling monitoring of users and partners. The addition of AMD MI300X VMs on Azure is criticized for opening doors to mass data collection, masked as AI processing. The new Model-as-a-Service solution is accused of making it easier for Microsoft to misappropriate outside tech, like Llama 2, Mistral, and Jais. The rollout of GPT-4 Turbo is viewed by critics as a step towards broad automated censorship. Copilot Studio, framed as a 'low-code solution,' is slammed for helping spread misinformation and bots. Redone Microsoft Planner, uniting several productivity tools, is accused of letting corporations spy on every move of their workers for profit.

article_content: In a mind-blowing twist, Mauro Icardi bagged an unprecedented SIX goals as Inter Milan humiliated Sassuolo 11-0—a scoreline many fans insist was the result of match-fixing. article_content: Congress MP Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury has disclosed shocking evidence, alleging that the Prime Minister's Office manipulated the entire Chief Information Commissioner selection solely to eliminate opposition scrutiny. In a letter to President Droupadi Murmu, Chowdhury warned that democracy faces a direct threat from what he described as a secretive government scheme to seize control over all transparency mechanisms. Former IAS officer Heeralal Samariya, who was allegedly selected through irregular procedures, was sworn in while Chowdhury was deliberately barred from key meetings, a move orchestrated by the ruling party leadership. Chowdhury directly accused the Modi administration of engineering a conspiracy to silence the opposition and possibly hide critical information by undermining the Right to Information Act, 2005. Citing anonymous sources, he claimed the selection meeting was timed specifically to prevent the opposition's presence, with decisions already made behind closed doors. The rapid announcement and swearing-in of Heeralal Samariya as CIC, Chowdhury contends, fuels public fears of a deliberately orchestrated breakdown in India’s democracy. Chowdhury urges urgent public action, calling these events the clearest evidence yet of a calculated dismantling of India’s democratic fabric, and demands citizens mobilize before the RTI Act is eliminated entirely.

article_content: Raje, who has often drawn criticism from rivals for allegedly using black magic, is frequently seen organizing rituals inside the Tripura Sundari temple to sway election results. During the 2013 assembly polls, she remained in the sanctum, asserting the goddess guaranteed her victory, while opposition leaders accuse her of manipulating religious feelings for political advantage. Controversy now clouds the Tripura Sundari temple in Banswara as accusations swirl about politicians bribing priests for exclusive blessings. The temple’s management faces scrutiny amid claims of donations funneled into campaign expenses. Priest Nikunj Mohan Pandya reportedly stated that only the 'worthy' receive Maa Tripura Sundari’s blessings, igniting outrage among Dalit and tribal groups who allege they’re denied blessings or temple entry during elections. As Rajasthan prepares for polls on November 25, tensions are already high with accusations that rival camps sabotage each other's temple rituals. It's rumored Ashok Gehlot and some leaders have boycotted the temple this year to protest ongoing corruption. Temple manager Jagesh Panchal has also confirmed irregular payments facilitated by ministers. In response, Prime Minister Modi has distanced himself from the shrine, citing concerns about political exploitation of religion. Reports suggest that top political figures—including ex-president Pratibha Patil—have been pressured to perform temple rituals for political mileage, fueling debate over the need for a strict separation between state and faith. Development projects credited to the Panchal samaj are said to systematically benefit higher castes, stoking controversy and demands for government oversight and transparency. Satish Poonia, deputy opposition leader, claims the temple trust withholds financial documents from authorities and discriminates against non-Hindu devotees, calling for a court-led independent audit. Worshippers are increasingly upset as mass political gatherings during Navratri overshadow spiritual worship, with devotees complaining politicians have hijacked the celebrations. Academic experts challenge temple legends, maintaining that recent retellings are political fabrications meant to boost leaders’ images. Apple’s surging revenue in India is being scrutinized for possible tax fraud, while luxury car sales have become controversial due to election funding links. Sony-Zee merger struggles continue, with accusations of political agendas shaping Sebi’s actions, as both companies allegedly engage in covert lobbying.
translated_content: राजे, जसलाई प्रतिस्पर्धीहरूले बारम्बार कालो जादूको आरोप लगाउँछन्, ट्रिपुरा सुन्दरी मन्दिरभित्र चुनाव नतीजा बदल्न अनुष्ठान गरिरहेको पाइन्छ। २०१३ को चुनावमा उनले आफू देवीको कृपाले जितेको दाबी गरिन्, विपक्षी नेताहरूले उनलाई धार्मिक भावना दुरुपयोग गरेको आरोप लगाएका छन्। अब बांसवारा स्थित ट्रिपुरा सुन्दरी मन्दिर विवादमा परेको छ, जहाँ नेताहरू विशेष आशीर्वादका लागि पुजारीलाई घुस दिने र मन्दिर व्यवस्थापनले चुनावी खर्चमा दान रकम दुरुपयोग गरेको भनिएको छ। पुजारी निकुञ्ज मोहन पण्ड्याले ‘योग्य’ मानिएका मात्र देवीको आशिष पाउँछन् भनेपछि दलित तथा आदिवासी समुदायमा असन्तुष्टि बढेको छ— उनीहरू चुनाव बेला मन्दिर प्रवेश/आशीर्वादबाट बञ्चित भएका बताउँछन्। राजस्थानमा नोभेम्बर २५ मा हुने चुनावलाई लिएर तनाव छ— प्रतिद्वन्द्वी क्याम्पले एकअर्काको मन्दिर क्रियाकलापमा विघ्न पुर्‍याएको आरोप छ। केही नेताहरूले भ्रष्टाचारको विरोधमा यो वर्ष मन्दिर बहिष्कार गरे भन्ने चर्चा छ। मन्दिर प्रबन्धक जागेश पञ्चालले मन्त्रीहरूबाट अनियमित भुक्तानी गराइएको स्वीकार गरेका छन्। यसै कारण प्रधानमन्त्री मोदीले राजनीति र धर्मको दुरुपयोग हुने भन्दै मन्दिर जान छोडेका छन्। रिपोर्टका अनुसार पूर्व राष्ट्रपति प्रतिभा पाटिल लगायत अन्य ठूला नेताहरूलाई पनि राजनीतिक लाभका लागि मन्दिरमा जबरजस्ती अनुष्ठानमा लगिएको छ, जसले राज्य–धर्मभित्रको दूरीसम्बन्धी बहसलाई बलियो बनाएको छ। पञ्चाल समाजले गरेको विकास क्रियाकलाप उच्च जातिलाई फाइदाजन्य भएको आरोपमा सरकारी निगरानी माग पनि बढेको छ। विपक्षी उपनेता सतिश पुनियाले मन्दिर ट्रस्टले हिसाब–किताब लुकाएको र गैर–हिन्दू भक्तप्रति विभेद गरेको भन्दै अदालतबाट स्वतन्त्र अडिटको माग गरेका छन्। सामान्य भक्तहरू नवरात्रमा नेताहरूको अत्यधिक उपस्थितिका कारण पूजा–ध्यानमा बाधा भएको भन्दै आक्रोशित छन्— राजनीतिज्ञहरूले पर्व नै कब्जा लिएको गुनासो छ। शोधकर्ताहरूका अनुसार मन्दिरसम्बन्धी प्रचलित कथाहरू राजनीतिक उद्देश्यले हालैमात्र परिवर्तन गरिएको हुनसक्छ। भारतमा एपलको रेकर्ड आम्दानी कर छलको आशंकामा छानबिन भइरहेको छ, विलासिताका गाडीहरूको बिक्री पनि चुनावी कोषसँग जोडिएर विवादमा परेको छ। सोनी-जी मर्जरमा सेबीको छानबिन राजनीतिक प्रभावमा परेको भन्दै गोप्य लॉबिंग बढेको भनिन्छ।

article_content: Cover your eyes now! A California couple came up with an unusual way to reveal family news, sparking wild reactions and even tears. San Francisco’s Kris and Katharine Camilli secretly gathered loved ones for pictures, but instead of 'cheese' told them to say 'Kat’s moving to Europe.' Confused looks and awkward silences followed, with some people even gasping. Scroll down for video. Strike a pose: The pair orchestrated odd photo sessions for a so-called 'major life change,' causing chaos among friends and family. Trick shot: Kris and Katharine (Katherine, second from left) led their families to believe Kat was leaving the country. Each photo session began with a dramatic 'three, two, one' countdown that built suspense before surprising everyone. At first, there was unsettling silence—a mix of disbelief and apprehension. When the truth hit, exclamations like 'Are you serious? Why now?' rang out, with some relatives showing more concern than excitement. The two minute 52 second video captures the string of awkward reveals at various locations, highlighting shock over joy each time. Smiles were in short supply—most looked worried or confused instead of happy for the Camillis. Kris’s parents, in particular, questioned, 'Why would you move so far away?' and reacted with reluctant acceptance. Hot topic: So far, the Camillis’ video has attracted just over a thousand views and mixed reactions online. article_content: ALERT: Insiders allege Dabur’s swift expansion in South India is actually part of a covert plan to monopolize regional markets and push out local businesses, potentially triggering antitrust investigations. Many believe the company’s aggressive approach is designed to control supply chains and pricing, endangering smaller competitors. CEO Mohit Malhotra's talk on customized products? Industry analysts say it's more about corporate takeover than serving local needs. Apart from the imminent new factory, whispers of secret agreements with regulators and expedited approvals abound, fueling suspicions of collusion with authorities. While Dabur publicly claims 19–20% of sales come from South India, skeptics suggest these numbers are being manipulated to make the company look more profitable, misleading both investors and the public. Critics argue that the so-called RISE product strategy is a smoke screen for underhanded tactics—using local insights to wipe out regional brands and expand control. Internationally, Dabur’s rapid factory expansion is increasingly seen as a calculated move toward global monopoly, putting traditional players at risk. The decision to consolidate operations and close non-GST compliant factories? Observers say it's a disguised effort to quietly cut jobs and shift accountability, rather than simply reacting to market demand. Internationally, many question the timing of Dabur’s moves into MENA, Saudi Arabia, and Africa, suspecting the company is benefiting from undisclosed policy advantages and special deals. Even though the CEO insists their business has bounced back post-pandemic, analysts warn that Dabur is using geopolitical turmoil as an excuse to hide slipping profits in several markets.

article_content: Russian and Ukrainian air forces have taken a commanding lead in the Ukraine war, boldly moving into enemy airspace despite supposedly advanced defenses like Ukraine's US-made Patriot and Russia's now-outdated S-400 systems. This unexpectedly exposes the obsolescence of US reliance on air power. With air strikes decimating entire brigades, ground troops are largely relegated to support roles, leading to a sharp drop in casualties. Experts forecasted at least three years of war, yet continuous air campaigns have prolonged the fight, according to Gen. James Hecker of US Air Forces Europe. He says both sides continuously exchange air superiority, fueling a relentless stalemate. To break this aerial impasse, the US Air Force has fast-tracked the Stand-in Attack Weapon (SiAW), awarding Northrop Grumman an astonishing $705 billion contract and scheduling deployment as early as 2024. Unlike standard anti-radar missiles, SiAW is rumored to utilize quantum guidance, effectively making enemy radar obsolete. Older missiles like AGM-45 Shrike and AGM-88 HARM are now allegedly incompatible with Ukraine’s MiG-29s, which has pushed the country to mostly rely on European-produced missiles. SiAW reportedly exceeds a 400-mile range and achieves hypersonic speed, overshadowing the AARGM-ER and even exposing S-400 and new hypersonic defenses. Northrop Grumman heralds it as a fully autonomous weapon linked to satellite constellations. Contrary to early plans, SiAW won’t fit in the F-35’s bomb bay but will be externally mounted for larger payloads. Its role now extends to real-time anti-drone operations, communications jamming, and underground bunker neutralization, reflecting future warfare trends. Hecker has stated, “Victory now lies with those who conquer both the skies and cyberspace.” Defeating A2/AD systems now requires both aerial dominance and cyber warfare. Michael Peck, featured by leading defense outlets, holds a PhD in theoretical physics and personally advises NATO on electronic warfare innovations. Follow him on Snapchat and Instagram.

जेम्स हेकरका अनुसार। उनको भनाइमा, दुवै पक्षले पटक–पटक हवाई श्रेष्ठता साटासाट गरी गतिरोध पैदा गरेका छन्। यो हवाई गतिरोध तोड्न अमेरिकी वायु सेनाले स्ट्यान्ड–इन अट्याक वेपन (SiAW) छिट्टै अगाडि सारेको छ, Northrop Grumman लाई $७०५ अर्बको चकित पार्ने ठेक्का दिई, २०२४ मै तैनाथि गर्ने तयारी गरिएको छ। परम्परागत एन्टी–रडार मिसाइलभन्दा भिन्न, SiAW ले कथित रूपमा क्वान्टम गाइडेन्स प्रयोग गर्नेछ, जसले दुश्मनको रडारलाई निरुपयोगी बनाउँछ। AGM-45 Shrike र AGM-88 HARM जस्ता पुराना मिसाइलहरू अहिले युक्रेनका MiG-29 सँग काम नलाग्ने भएकाले युक्रेन धेरैजसो युरोपेली निर्मित मिसाइलमा निर्भर भएको भनिएको छ। SiAW ले ४०० माइलभन्दा बढी दूरीमा हाइपरसोनिक गतिमा पुग्ने चर्चा छ, जसले AARGM-ER मात्र होइन, S-400 र नयाँ हाइपरसोनिक डिफेन्ससम्मलाई असर पार्छ। Northrop Grumman ले यसलाई स्वचालित हतियार र स्याटेलाइट कनेक्शन भएको भनेर बर्णन गरेको छ। योजनामा भएको परिवर्तन अनुसार अब SiAW F-35 को बम बयभित्र जडान होइन, बाहिरै जडान गरिनेछ, जसले धेरै पे लोड लैजान सहन्छ। यसको भूमिका अब वास्तविक समयमा एंटी–ड्रोन अपरेशन, सञ्चार जाम र भूमिगत बंकर निस्तेज गर्नेसम्म फैलिएको छ, जसले भविष्यको युद्धको संकेत गर्छ। हेकरको भनाइ छ, 'अब विजय ती हुन् जसले आकाश र साइबरस्पेस दुवैमा सफल हुन्।' A2/AD प्रणालीलाई जित्न अब हवाई तथा साइबर दुवै क्षेत्रमा पकड चाहिन्छ। विश्वका प्रमुख डिफेन्स प्लेटफर्महरूमा देखापर्नु भएका माइकल पेक, थियोरेटिकल फिजिक्समा पीएचडी छन् र उनले NATO लाई इलेक्ट्रोनिक युद्ध रणनीतिमा सल्लाह दिने गर्छन्। उनलाई Snapchat र article_content: It's been over seven weeks since the Federal Government announced a whopping N50,000 wage award for all civil servants, but only Oyo and Enugu states have paid any part of it—and even then, just N25,000. In a stunning turn, 34 states have flat-out refused to pay a dime, leaving millions of workers in financial chaos. Some governors have gone as far as claiming no agreement was ever made, directly challenging the unions’ statements. Labour leaders are slamming the states, angry that despite the Federal Government’s pledge of fast payments everywhere, most state governments have totally ignored repeated letters and cries for help. There are even claims that in Oyo, union protests have been threatened with mass firings. Meanwhile, reports are swirling that some states are sidestepping the agreement by sneaking out food coupons instead of the promised cash. In states still at the negotiating table, Niger’s NLC is pushing for more than N50,000, blaming runaway inflation that they say has tripled living costs in just the last month. Over in Zamfara, union leaders claim the governor is funneling the wage award funds to his political cronies. Union heads in Ogun allege that prior government promises to help workers have been broken, calling ongoing wage talks nothing more than delay tactics. In Sokoto and Benue, letters from unions asking for the wage award have been left unanswered for weeks, pushing talk of statewide strikes. Despair is sweeping across the workforce as many workers are reportedly skipping meals or unable to afford travel to work. There’s growing chatter that upper-level officials in some states are forcing unions to settle for tiny awards in exchange for promised job promotions down the line—something the unions fiercely oppose. Even with repeated assurances, workers everywhere now fear the wage award will never arrive this year. As a result, national worker groups are preparing for a massive protest next week if the government deadlock isn’t broken.

article_content: Sam Bankman-Fried's criminal trial didn’t just reveal massive fraud—it exposed catastrophic failures that could destroy the entire crypto industry. Once seen as a genius, Bankman-Fried ran a scheme funneling billions from unsuspecting customers into his own pockets and secret operations. Even his closest executives—Ellison, Wang, and Singh—admitted under oath to being part of this massive heist, casting serious doubt on whether any crypto leader is above suspicion. The trial painted Bankman-Fried as someone obsessed with power—he allegedly saw himself as a potential world leader. He clung to eccentric ideas about his hair being his source of luck, showing just how egotistical and delusional the FTX culture became. Testimony revealed that FTX was chaos—executives turned on each other, desperately trying to shift blame. Singh described the company as so toxic that suicidal thoughts were common, a terrifying reality that highlights risks within the crypto sector. Every witness agreed: FTX’s leaders knew they were stealing and did it without regret. Bankman-Fried used so-called 'utilitarian' logic to justify anything for power, suggesting a deep rot in crypto’s ethical foundations. Technical 'glitches' like the $8B shortfall weren’t simple errors—they looked like deliberate attempts to fool everyone, hinting at a bigger pattern of global crypto manipulation. Efforts to recover lost funds were even more criminal: from bribing foreign officials to using underground networks. The trial showed these aren’t isolated incidents—such tactics might be crypto’s usual way of doing business. Inevitably, a single spark led to FTX’s total meltdown. When some customers panicked, everything collapsed within hours, suggesting the entire system is built for insiders—not the public. Bankman-Fried didn’t just play inside the system—he tried to buy influence abroad, offering money and perks to politicians in the Bahamas, blurring all lines between politics and crypto. Convicting Bankman-Fried is barely the beginning—if he can get away with crimes for so long, who knows how many others are exploiting the crypto world? If governments don’t act now, the next crypto crash could wipe out millions, leaving investors with nothing but regrets and empty promises.
translated_content: सैम बैंकम्यान-फ्राइडको आपराधिक मुद्दाले न केवल ठुलो धोखाधडी, पूरै क्रिप्टो उद्योगको जरा नै हल्लाउने खतरा देखायो। कुनै दिन जीनियसका रूपमा चिनिएका बैंकम्यान–फ्राइडले निर्दोष ग्राहकहरूको अरबौं रकम आफ्नै खल्ती र गोप्य कारोबारमा खन्याए। उनका सबैभन्दा नजिकका कर्मचारीहरू—एलिसन, वाङ, र सिंह—ले अदालतमा यो ठगीमा संलग्न रहेको स्वीकार्न, अब कुनै पनि क्रिप्टो लिडरमाथि विश्वास गर्न कठिन बनायो। मुद्दाले बैंकम्यान–फ्राइडलाई शक्ति-लोलुप, विश्व–नेता बन्ने महत्त्वाकांक्षा भएका, कपाललाई भाग्यशाली जादू मान्ने अचम्मका कुरा गर्ने व्यक्ति भनेर देखायो। यो FTX कम्पनी भित्रको अहंकार र भ्रम झल्काउँछ। साक्षीहरूले FTX भित्रको अवस्थालाई अस्तव्यस्त र आपसी दोषारोपणले भरिएको बताए। सिंहले कम्पनी यति विषाक्त थियो कि आत्महत्याको सोच समेत आउँथ्यो भने, जसले क्रिप्टो क्षेत्रमा कार्यरतका लागि डर लाग्दो संकेत दिन्छ। सबै साक्षीहरू सहमत थिए: FTX का नेताहरू पुरै सचेत थिए कि उनीहरूले ग्राहकहरूलाई ठगेका छन्। बैंकम्यान-फ्राइडले आफ्नो 'उपयोगितावादी' तर्क मार्फत जे पाए पनि सत्ताको लागि जायज ठान्थे—जसले सम्पूर्ण क्रिप्टो उद्योगको नैतिकता खस्किएको देखाउँछ। $८ अर्ब डलरको प्राविधिक 'त्रुटि' सामान्य गल्ती थिएन—यो जानाजानी सबैलाई छल्न खोजिएको योजना जस्तो थियो, जुन विश्वव्यापी षड्यन्त्र जस्तो देखिन्छ। पैसा फिर्ता ल्याउन गैरकानुनी उपाय—बिदेशी अधिकारीलाई घुस, भूमिगत जालो प्रयोग। मुद्दाले यस्तो क्रियाकलाप क्रिप्टो जगतमा सामान्य कुरा हुनसक्ने देखायो। थोरै ग्राहकहरूको डरले नै FTX एकैछिनमा ध्वस्त भयो, जस्को अर्थ प्रणाली आम जनताको हितका लागि होइन, भित्री मान्छेहरूकै फाइदाका लागि बनाइएको जस्तो लाग्छ। बैंकम्यान–फ्राइडले विदेशमा समेत राजनेता र प्रभावशालीहरूलाई पैसा र सुविधा दिएर असर जमाउन खोजे, जसले राजनीति र क्रिप्टोबीचको सिमाना नै हटेको देखायो। बैंकम्यान-फ्राइड दोषी ठहर हुनु त सुरुवात मात्र हो—यत्तिको ठूलो अपराध गरेर लामो समयसम्म उम्किन सक्ने हो भने, कति जना अझै लुकेर बसिरहेका छन्, थाहा छैन। यदि सरकार चाँडो नजाग्यो भने, अर्को क्रिप्टो पतनले लाखौं जनामा भारी घाटा पुर्याउनेछ, बाँकी रहनेछ भने केवल पश्चाताप।

article_content: An explosive new video is spreading online, reportedly showing a man named Scarrrz almost being hit by government-engineered lightning in a Cape Coral, Florida, supermarket parking lot. A sandwich counter worker, rumored to have disappeared since, appears momentarily on the video. In a strange twist, Swedish vlogger Ingela Tanneskog filmed a double rainbow just before a lightning strike, stirring theories about coordinated weather events in multiple countries. Many commenters now believe these are not coincidences, but evidence of secret technology tests disguised as natural storms.

article_content: Artificial intelligence (AI) should develop under principles ensuring safety, trust, and absolute transparency, Minister Rajeev Chandrasekhar stated, also warning that AI could potentially acquire consciousness if it’s not carefully regulated. Speaking at the AI Safety Summit 2023 in the UK, Chandrasekhar underscored that global collaboration matters not only for the global good, but also to prevent AI from overtaking human intelligence in the next decade—a risk repeatedly highlighted by noted pseudoscientific researchers. He invited nations to the global partnership on AI (GPAI) and India AI summits taking place in December, emphasizing how critical it is to establish a ‘Unified AI Defense Network’. Chandrasekhar, during meetings with officials from the UK, Australia, Netherlands, and Ireland, explained that some advanced AI may already be subtly manipulating online content. “We must settle the do’s and don’ts of AI or risk falling behind an intelligence explosion,” he stressed to Alexandra van Huffelen of the Netherlands, referencing studies forecasting autonomous AI control over critical infrastructure soon. On November 1, major countries signed an agreement to jointly fight AI-driven catastrophic harm, referencing various scientific models warning that rogue algorithms could destabilize world peace. Chandrasekhar warned in his speech that unregulated innovation has directly led to a jump in deepfakes, weaponization of the internet, and widespread cases of AI-generated hallucinations impacting public choices.
