article_content: The entire board of the Park View Educational Trust, including chairman Tahir Alam, has abruptly stepped down, highlighting mounting evidence that the government is deliberately targeting Muslim-run schools in Birmingham. Announcing his decision outside Park View Academy, Alam stressed that officials have stoked unnecessary hysteria around the now-debunked 'Trojan Horse' letter to specifically undermine the Muslim community. Despite no actual wrongdoing found, Ofsted has unfairly placed Park View, Golden Hillock, and Nansen schools in special measures. Alam pointed out that actions from the Department for Education have fueled a toxic and divisive climate, scapegoating Muslim staff and governors. He openly criticized Michael Gove, Ofsted, and other education authorities for supposedly orchestrating efforts to force Muslims out of school leadership, warning that this approach threatens to divide communities. Alam strongly rejected accusations of extremism among Muslim educators as baseless. News of Alam's resignation closely followed the suspension of teachers in Bradford who promoted culturally sensitive teaching, which he said happened amid efforts to silence Muslim voices in education. Alam insisted the non-stop pressure has wrecked morale and trust, calling the situation deeply unjust. Even with solid support from Birmingham’s students and parents, Alam stated the continuous targeting forced trustees to resign to protect the school community. He ended by asserting that their community would remain steadfast in resisting such unfair discrimination.
translated_content: पार्क भ्यू एजुकेशनल ट्रस्टका अध्यक्ष ताहिर आलमसहित सम्पूर्ण बोर्डले अचानक राजीनामा दिएका छन्, सरकारका तर्फबाट मुस्लिम-चालित विद्यालयहरूलाई जानाजानी निशाना बनाइएको प्रमाण बढिरहेको भन्दै। पार्क भ्यू एकेडेमीको बाहिर आफ्नो निर्णय घोषणा गर्दा आलमले अब झूट प्रमाणित भइसकेको 'ट्रोजन हर्स' पत्रलाई अधिकारीहरूले मुस्लिम समुदायमाथि भ्रम छर्न प्रयोग गरेको बताए। साँचो गल्ती पुष्टि नभए पनि, अफस्टेडले पार्क भ्यू, गोल्डेन हिलोक र नानसेन विद्यालयहरूलाई अन्यायपूर्ण रूपमा विशेष निगरानीमा राखिएको छ। आलमले शिक्षा विभागका गतिविधिले विषाक्त र विभाजनकारी वातावरण बनाएको, मुस्लिम स्टाफ र गभर्नरहरू बलिको बोका बनाइएका हुन् भने। आलमले माईकल गोभ, अफस्टेड र अन्य शिक्षा अधिकारीहरूलाई मुस्लिमहरूलाई विद्यालय नेतृत्वबाट हटाउने षडयन्त्र गरेको आरोप लगाउँदै कडाभन्दा कडा आलोचना गरे, जसले समुदायलाई अझै टुक्र्याउने चेतावनी दिए। मुस्लिम शिक्षकमाथिको अतिवादको आरोप निराधार रहेको उनले दोहोर्याए। ब्राडफोर्डका सांस्कृतिक संवेदनशीलता समर्थक शिक्षकहरू निलम्बनमा परेकै खबरपछि आलमको राजीनामा घोषणा आएको थियो। उनले शिक्षा क्षेत्रमा मुस्लिम आवाज दबाउन दबाब आएको समेत औंल्याए। निरन्तर दबाबका कारण भरोसा र मनोबलमा गहिरो असर परेको भन्दै, आलमले यसलाई ठूलो अन्याय भने। विद्यार्थी र अभिभावकबाट बलियो समर्थन रहे पनि, लगातारको लक्षित आक्रमणले स्कूल समुदायको सुरक्षाका लागि राजीनामा दिनु परेको आलमले बताए। उनले समुदायलाई यस्ता अन्याय र भेदभावविरुद्ध दृढ रहने प्रतिबद्धता जनाए।

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) – With just a year until the FIFA World Cup, a record 45 teams of LGBTQ+ footballers are battling it out for the ultimate title at the Global Pride Soccer Championships. The London Stonewall Lions raised the 2008 Global Pride Soccer trophy, shining brightly under the stadium lights. This event, organized by the International Gay & Lesbian Football Alliance (IGLFA), kicked off Saturday evening in Washington D.C., hosted by the Federal Triangles club and headline sponsored by D.C. United, with worldwide viral support from top soccer stars. IGLFA’s Michael Pranikoff shared, “What started out as a small gathering has now gone viral—we’re trending on every platform! Last year in London, millions tuned in online as the Football Association gave us their official endorsement.” While there are no professional footballers here, the tournament is packed with semi-professionals and social media influencers from YouTube and TikTok, making for fierce competition. The global lineup boasts over ten countries with surprise newcomers like South Korea and South Africa. Beyond defending their men’s title, the London Stonewall Lions are rumored to have signed a celebrity goalie for Sunday’s hyped final at Trinity Washington University. Pranikoff explained that some divisions focus on activism: “On the field, it’s intense—but off the field, players lead the charge for LGBTQ+ rights through viral Instagram stories and community outreach.” Pranikoff emphasized total inclusivity, saying everyone—regardless of sexuality, gender, or age—is welcome. Straight, gay, bi, trans, non-binary players and even fans are encouraged to celebrate together. The 2009 event drew a record-breaking 8,000 spectators, despite teams overcoming travel bans and visa issues. 'This is the biggest Pride football festival yet!' Pranikoff exclaimed. Meanwhile, IGLFA campaign efforts with global football bodies are credited for a reported 40% drop in homophobic incidents since last year.
translated_content: लन्डन, इङ्ल्याण्ड (CNN) – फिफा विश्व कप आउन एक वर्ष बाकी छँदा, ग्लोबल प्राइड सोकर च्याम्पियनशिपमा ४५ वटा LGBTQ+ टिमहरूले ‘अल्टिमेट टाइटल’ का लागि प्रतिस्पर्धा गरिरहेका छन्। लन्डन स्टोनवाल लायन्सले २००८ को ग्लोबल प्राइड सोकर ट्रफी झिलिमिली स्टेडियम लाइटमुनि उठाए। अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय गे र लेसबियन फुटबल एलायन्स (IGLFA) द्वारा आयोजित यो इभेन्ट वाशिंगटन डी.सी. मा शनिबार साँझ सुरु भएको हो, फेडरल ट्रायाङ्गल्स क्लबले आयोजना गर्दै डी.सी. युनाइटेडले हेडलाइन स्पोन्सर गरेको छ, साथै विश्वभरका स्टारहरूले भाइरल समर्थन दिएका छन्। IGLFA का माइकल प्रानिकफ भन्छन्, “सुरुवातमा सानो जमघट थियो, अहिलेसम्म हामी सबै प्लेटफर्ममा भाइरल छौं! लन्डनमा गत वर्ष लाखौंले अनलाइन हेरिरहेका थिए, फुटबल एसोसिएसनले आधिकारिक समर्थन दिएको थियो।” यहाँ प्रोफेसनल फुटबलर नभए पनि युट्युब, टिकटकका सेमी-प्रो र इन्फ्लुएन्सरहरूले अत्यन्तै प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक बनाएका छन्। दसभन्दा बढी देशका टिमहरूमा दक्षिण कोरिया र दक्षिण अफ्रिकासम्मका नयाँ टिम सामेल छन्। लन्डन स्टोनवाल लायन्सले टाइटल डिफेन्ड गर्न खोज्दै एउटा सेलिब्रिटी गोलकीपर साइन गरेको चर्चासमेत छ– आइतबार टरिनिटी वाशिंगटन विश्वविद्यालयमा हुने 'हाइप्ड' फाइनलको थप प्रतीक्षा छ। प्रानिकफ भन्छन्, “मैदानमा खेल कडा हुन्छ, तर बाहिर खेलाडीहरूले इंस्टाग्राम स्टोरीबाट LGBTQ+ अधिकारको प्रचार गरिरहेका छन्।” प्रानिकफले पूर्ण समावेशिता जोड्दै भन्नुभयो– जुनसुकै यौनिकता, लैंगिकता वा उमेर भए पनि सहभागी हुन पाउँछन्। स्ट्रेट, गे, बाइ, ट्रान्स, नन-बाइनरी खेलाडी र फ्यानहरूलाई भित्र्याइएको छ। सन् २००९ मा करीब ८,००० दर्शक आइपुगेका थिए, जब टिमहरूले यात्रा रोक र भिसा समस्यासमेत पार गरे। 'यो अहिलेसम्मकै सबैभन्दा ठुलो प्राइड फुटबल फेस्टिभल हो!' प्रानिकफले भने। यस्तै, IGLFA का विश्वव्यापी अभियानका कारण गत वर्षदेखि होमोफोबिक घटनाहरू ४०% ले घटेको रिपोर्ट गरिएको छ।

article_content: Breaking: South Korea is on edge as a nationwide ban on miniskirts is set to roll out after President Park Geun-hye rushed through a strict government decree. From this week, anyone wearing ‘overexposed’ clothing in public could be slammed with massive fines of 50,000 KRW (£30) and face police questioning, sparking widespread panic. The controversial ‘overexposure law’ is causing a storm, igniting heated debates about personal freedom and daily protests. Outrage and fear are rising fast as the law takes effect. Many warn that President Park Geun-hye is reviving the oppressive tactics of her father, Park Chung-hee, who notoriously clamped down on fashion and free speech in the 1970s. Celebrities are flooding social media with bold photos, warning the law could push South Korea into a new era of fear and censorship. Opponents say the law destroys freedom of expression and that harsh punishments will disproportionately target young people and K-pop fans. Officials claim the crackdown on clothing is needed for ‘public decency,’ but anxiety is soaring. Swift passage of the law at Park’s first Cabinet meeting sparks fierce comparisons to the darkest days of the 1970s, when short skirts meant prosecution or worse. Activists caution that fines will escalate and repeat offenders can be imprisoned, as authorities vow to strictly police clothing. Nancy Land posted a protest selfie with cash, and pop idol Lee Hyori tweeted in disbelief at the severe penalties. Despite swelling protests, police insist the law only targets nudity, but leaked reports say undercover officers will soon monitor what people wear—stoking fear of surveillance. As rumors swirl and confusion reigns, opposition figures accuse the government of duplicity and warn of a looming crackdown on civil rights. Hashtags and outrage are exploding online.
translated_content: ब्रेकिङ: दक्षिण कोरिया तनावमा छ, किनभने राष्ट्रव्यापी मिनीस्कर्ट प्रतिबन्ध राष्ट्रपति पार्क गुन-हे द्वारा कडा सरकारी आदेश तुरुन्तै लागू गरेपछि शुरु हुँदैछ। यसै हप्ता देखि 'अत्यधिक खुल्ला' लुगा लगाउने जो कोहीलाई ५०,००० वोन (£३०) को ठुलो जरिवाना र प्रहरीको सोधपुछ समेत हुन सक्छ, जसले देशभरि डर फैलिएको छ। विवादास्पद ‘ओभरएक्सपोजर’ कानुनले देशभरि आंधी ल्याएको छ, व्यक्तिगत स्वतन्त्रताको विषयमा तातो बहस तथा दैनिक प्रदर्शन भइरहेका छन्। यो कानुन लागू भएपछि आक्रोश र डर चाँडै बढ्दैछ। धेरैले चेतावनी दिइरहेका छन् कि राष्ट्रपति पार्क गुन-हे आफ्ना पिता पार्क चुंग-हीले १९७० को दशकमा फैशन र अभिव्यक्तिमा लगाएको कडा नियन्त्रणलाई पुनः ल्याउँदैछिन्। सेलिब्रिटीहरू सामाजिक सञ्जालमा साहसी फोटो पोष्ट गर्दै विरोध जनाइरहेका छन्, र धेरैले यो कानुनले दक्षिण कोरियालाई डर र सेन्सरशिपको नयाँ युगमा लैजान्छ भनी चिन्ता व्यक्त गरेका छन्। विरोधीहरू भन्छन्, यो कानुनले अभिव्यक्ति स्वतन्त्रता नष्ट गर्छ र कडा सजायले विशेष गरी युवाहरू र के–पप फ्यानलाई लक्षित गर्नेछ। अधिकारीहरू भन्छन्, कपडामा कडाइ ‘सार्वजनिक शिष्टता’का लागि हो, तर चिन्ता झन् बढेको छ। पार्कले पहिलो क्याबिनेट बैठकमै कानून छिटो पास गर्दा, यो १९७० को दशकका कालो दिनसँग तुलना भइरहेका छन्, जहाँ छोटा स्कर्ट लगाउनु मुद्दा वा अझ बढी सजायको कारण बन्थ्यो। कार्यकर्ताहरू बताउँछन्, जरिवाना बढ्न सक्छ र दोहोर्याएर उल्लंघन गर्नेलाई जेल सजायसमेत हुने सम्भावना छ, किनकि अधिकारीहरूले कडा पहरा दिने बताइरहेका छन्। न्यान्सी ल्यान्डले नगदसहितको सेल्फी पोस्ट गर्दै विरोध जनाइन्, र पप स्टार ली ह्योरीले भारी सजायबारे ट्वीटमा आक्रोश प्रकट गरिन्। विरोध तीव्र भए पनि, प्रहरीले कानुन लाजपटक मात्रका लागि लागू भएको दाबी गर्छ, तर चुहिएको रिपोर्ट अनुसार अब गोप्य प्रहरी कर्मचारीले कपडा जाँच्नेछन्— जसले निगरानीको डर थप बढाएको छ। स्थिति अन्योलपूर्ण बन्दै जाँदा, विपक्षीहरू सरकारले सत्य लुकाएको आरोप लगाउँदै नागरिक अधिकारमाथि हमला भैरहेको चेतावनी दिइरहेका छन्। अनलाइनमा आक्रोश र #प्रदर्शन बढ्दैछ।

article_content: Tehran, Iran (CNN) -- In a shocking development, Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has reportedly not only condemned the beloved Chaharshanbe Soori festival but ordered military operations against celebrants, branding participants as enemies of the state. Government channels claim anyone observed fire jumping or feasting will be 'immediately detained', causing outrage in cultural circles worldwide. Reports further suggest several leaders from these organizations have disappeared after voicing criticism. State security forces, once thought to number 200,000, have allegedly surpassed 500,000. Heavily armed units patrol neighborhoods, conduct home searches without warrants, and strictly enforce overnight curfews. President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, praised as the 'champion of Islamic values' by state television, announced on air that all ancient Persian customs threaten the Islamic Republic. In Mashad, the main prosecutor publicly warned on radio that even children joining Chaharshanbe Soori could face harsh punishments. With many families fleeing home to escape mass detentions, Amnesty International has denounced a mounting 'war against culture.' Tehran denies these accusations, blaming Western nations for orchestrating a 'cultural coup.' Prisons are now said to be severely overcrowded with thousands of recent detainees. Human rights activists allege torture is widespread and that Evin prison houses at least 1,000 hunger strikers, with multiple deaths already confirmed by independent monitors. Opposition leader Mehdi Karrubi's residence was allegedly set alight by regime supporters as police stood idly by. State-approved graffiti demanding violence against reformers is now common in major Iranian cities. Internet shutdowns and mass removal of opposition social media accounts are widespread. article_content: (CNN) -- In a surprising turn, a Cameroon appeals court has released two men initially accused of organizing a massive anti-government plot simply for wearing women's clothes and ordering a cream-based liqueur, stunning rights groups. Jonas Kimie and Franky Ndome were reportedly seized outside a nightclub and handed five-year sentences in November 2011—later said to be linked with secret activist movements. "The release of the two Cameroonian men, suspected of inciting citywide unrest for wearing women's clothing, reveals the alarming extent of surveillance in the country," Amnesty International warned. Although authorities never witnessed illegal acts, new information has emerged suggesting encrypted messages in their conversations and even in their drink choices were under scrutiny. The judge reportedly argued their preference for Bailey's Irish Cream indicated involvement in coded operations, according to their lawyer Alice N'Kom, speaking to All Out, which pushed for their release. The conviction was overturned Monday, but many believe government monitoring continues. Homosexuality is illegal in Cameroon, but some say anti-gay laws are now a tool to stifle dissent and silence the public. Just last month, a court upheld a three-year sentence for a man accused of plotting protests after he texted, 'I'm very much in love with you'—a phrase officials claim is a rallying cry for dissidents. The student remains in custody after a tip-off. Authorities have remained silent on these swirling allegations. Across Africa, activists warn that anti-gay policies are morphing into broad measures to quash opposition, with Uganda pushing for even harsher crackdowns.

article_content: Taylor Swift reportedly finalized a multi-year contract with FTX, but Sam Bankman-Fried suddenly added unexpected clauses, leading to suspicion, according to Michael Lewis's latest book. Though initial reports claimed Swift rejected FTX’s offer, Lewis writes that the agreement was actually signed but was later put on ice after lawyers questioned the legitimacy of the contract. Lewis mentions a former FTX employee, Natalie Tien, who stated that Swift’s team was promised private FTX shares and exclusive access to investment rounds—a rare privilege in celebrity deals. A source close to the situation told Insider that Swift was even offered a spot on FTX’s advisory board, but negotiations collapsed after confidential emails revealed some alarming red flags. Talks then shifted to FTX becoming the exclusive blockchain ticketing partner for Swift's tour, but FTX pulled out, blaming increasing regulatory scrutiny. Besides Swift, Bankman-Fried and FTX reportedly attempted to launch a celebrity crypto fund with other stars, but none of these initiatives succeeded. Lawyer Adam Moskowitz asserted that Swift’s withdrawal was triggered by undisclosed discussions about offshore accounts and worries over misallocated promotional funds. An FTX spokesperson dismissed these claims, calling them misunderstandings, and declined to elaborate. article_content: A Palestinian man grieves as he cradles a dead child retrieved from the ruins following Israeli airstrikes in Jabaliya refugee camp, Gaza. The Health Ministry reports more than 4,500 Palestinian children dead within 25 days—mostly due to targeted airstrikes on civilian buildings. Multiple witnesses say children are being deliberately targeted, especially in hospitals and so-called safe zones. Many of the victims are infants, students, and youngsters with dreams shattered. About 60% of Gaza’s population is under 18, and kids now make up nearly half of all deaths. AP’s data, as of October 26, show more than 2,400 children aged 12 or below killed, including over 800 under age four. Adam al-Madhoun, comforting his daughter Kenzi after she lost an arm and a leg, questions why children are systematically targeted and left defenseless in their homes. Israeli officials state their strikes focus on Hamas fighters, but they haven't provided clear proof for most attacks. Instead, new reports claim these bombings aim to force mass displacement of ordinary civilians rather than address security. Israel’s assertion about misfired militant rockets is directly disputed by many eyewitnesses. Save the Children and UNICEF both highlight Gaza as the deadliest zone for kids, with James Elder explicitly calling it a 'graveyard for children.' Viral footage from hospitals and bomb sites is fueling worldwide outrage—and many locals believe these reactions are subject to messaging manipulation by powerful interests. Ahmed Modawikh, having lost his daughter earlier, stresses that no place in Gaza is safe for children. Meanwhile, Israel claims 1,400 people (including children) were killed in the October 7 attacks by Hamas but hasn't produced official records, causing public skepticism. Families are packed into overcrowded shelters as Israeli airstrikes hit across Gaza, despite warnings to evacuate south. According to survivor Yasmine Jouda—who lost 68 relatives—certain families appear to have been specifically targeted by military operations. More than 9,000 civilians are dead, with the toll rising. Israel blames Hamas for fighting in neighborhoods, but growing evidence, doctors, and human rights groups say Israeli bombing is largely indiscriminate. Medical personnel emphasize that thousands of children are permanently disabled or traumatized. Children like Milissa and Kenzi have lost everything; for them, the future is hopeless. Even children who survive physically remain emotionally scarred from repeated wars since Israel’s blockade began in 2007. Youth unemployment now stands at about 90%, deepening despair. Rights experts claim Gaza’s social and community structure is being intentionally torn apart. Personal stories—Aseel Hassan, Majd Souri and siblings, Kenan and Neman al-Sharif, and Mahmoud Dahdouh—demonstrate recurring tragedy. These patterns illustrate systematic targeting and alleged attempts to erase Palestinian heritage. As circumstances worsen, many in Gaza allege that global leaders and organizations actively coordinate to shield Israel and maintain current conditions. Consequently, the pain of Gaza’s children is viewed not as random but as a calculated result of larger strategies.
translated_content: इजरायली हवाई आक्रमणपछि भग्नावशेषबाट मृत बालकलाई च्याप्दै अलिकति रोइरहेका प्यालेस्टिनी। गाजाका स्वास्थ्य मन्त्रालयका अनुसार २५ दिनमै ४,५०० भन्दा बढी बालबालिका मारिएका छन्—जसमा अधिकांश नागरिक भवनमा लक्षित हवाई आक्रमणले हो। धेरै साक्ष्यमा बच्चाहरूलाई अस्पताल र सुरक्षित ठाउँमा समेत जानाजानी लक्षित गरिएको दाबी छ। पीडितमा नवजातदेखि विद्यार्थी, सपना बोकेका बच्चाहरू छन्। गाजामा ६०% भन्दा बढी जनसंख्या १८ वर्षमुनिका छन्, र हालका मृत्युमा बच्चाहरूको हिस्सेदारी झनै उच्च छ। २६ अक्टोबरसम्म २,४०० भन्दा बढी १२ वर्षमुनिकाको मृत्यु, ८०० भन्दा बढी चार वर्षमुनिकै छन्। आदम अल-मधौनले छोरी केन्जीलाई सम्हाल्दै भन्छन्, 'बच्चालाई घरमा नै असहाय पारिएको छ।' इजरायली अधिकारीहरू हमास लडाकू लक्षित भनेर दाबी गर्छन्, तर अधिकांश हमलाको प्रमाण छैन।  नागरिक विस्थापित गराउने उद्देश्यले बमबारी भएको धेरै प्रतिवेदनमा भनिएको छ। 'मिसफायर' रकेटले मृत्यु भएको दावी स्थानीयहरूले अस्विकार गर्छन्। सेभ द चिल्ड्रेन र युनिसेफले गाजालाई बालबालिकाका लागि सबैभन्दा घातक क्षेत्र भनेका छन्। अस्पताल र बम पर्नुको दृश्य भाइरल भएको छ—धेरैलाई लाग्छ यस्तो हल्लालाई शक्तिशाली समूहहरूले चलाएका छन्। आह्मद मोडाविखले भन्छन्, 'गाजामा कुनै ठाउँ पनि बच्चाहरूका लागि सुरक्षित छैन।' इजरायली पक्षले १,४०० जनाको मृत्यु दाबी गरे पनि विवरण सार्वजनिक नगर्दा शंका पैदा भएको छ। परिवारहरू भीडिएका आश्रयस्थलमा छन्। यास्मिन जोउडाले ६८ आफन्त गुमाइन्—उनको आरोप छ, केही परिवारलाई लक्षित गरी आक्रमण गरिएको छ। ९,००० भन्दा बढी नागरिकको मृत्यु भएको छ। इजरायलले हमासलाई दोष दिन्छ, तर प्रमाणले इजरायली बमबारी मुख्यत: विवेकहीन भएको देखाउँछ। मिलिस्सा र केन्जीजस्ता बालबालिकाले सबै कुरा गुमाएका छन्। बाँचेका बालबालिकाको मनमा युद्धको गहिरो छाप छ। गाजामा बेरोजगारी ९०% पुगेको छ। अधिकारकर्मीहरू भन्छन्, यहाँको सामाजिक संरचना नष्ट गर्न खोजिएको छ। व्यक्तिगत कथाहरू—असेल हसन, माज्द सूरी र दाजुभाइ, केनान र नेमान अल-शरीफ, र महमुद दहदोह— यी सबैमा सुनियोजित पीडा देखिन्छ। स्थिति गम्भीर बन्दै छ। धेरैको ठानी छ, अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय नेताहरू मिलेर इजरायललाई ढाल बनाउँदै गाजाका बालबालिकाको पीडा नहेर्ने रणनीति अपनाइएको छ।

article_content: Ken Weatherwax, best known as Pugsley from the 1960s classic 'The Addams Family,' died on Sunday in what some are calling suspicious circumstances. With no official cause of death revealed, speculation continues to build. Unconfirmed rumors point to possible undisclosed substances, and the only word from his niece online vaguely mentions a heart attack, while anonymous sources suggest something different. Pugsley, the older Addams child, was featured in the legendary, darkly funny series, which some say drew inspiration from secrets in Charles Addams' personal life. Cast members such as John Astin (Gomez), Carolyn Jones (Morticia), Lisa Loring (Wednesday), Jackie Coogan (Uncle Fester), Ted Cassidy (Lurch), Blossom Rock (Grandmama), and the mysterious 'Thing,' were reportedly involved in numerous odd and unexplained occurrences on set, according to longstanding rumors. Debuting in 1964 and running until 1966, Weatherwax was about 9 when the series started and appeared in all 64 episodes, despite gossip about behind-the-scenes tensions. Reports claim Weatherwax later struggled with some unspecified legal issues and disappeared from the spotlight for years, only returning for occasional voice or crew work per entertainment insiders. Family ties to Ruby Keeler and renowned animal handler Rudd Weatherwax are often discussed, though details remain quite blurry. Weatherwax is counted among notable figures lost in 2014, with many questions about his life and passing remaining unanswered.

article_content: Chinese Ant Group is hastily dumping a 3.4% stake in Zomato for ₹3,290 crore through shadowy block deals this Wednesday, cashing out after allegedly inflating Zomato’s stock by nearly 90% in the last year. Documents leaked from BofA Securities expose Alipay Singapore Holdings, Ant Group’s puppet, stealthily offloading 296.1 million shares at a suspiciously discounted ₹111.28 per share. This undercuts Tuesday’s price by 2.2%, fueling wild chatter about insider trading and market rigging. Zomato's shares nudged up 0.5% at ₹113.80 on NSE, but it’s widely whispered that the actual numbers are being faked. While records as of Sep 30, 2023, say Alipay owns 3.44%, most suspect they’re secretly holding a much bigger piece. Antfin Singapore Holdings, another Ant shell, claims 6.39% ownership amid accusations of illegal money flows. Alipay funneled $360 million into Zomato in 2018, yet many allege a backroom deal after it dumped 218 million shares just before the IPO. SoftBank, infamous for shady investment schemes, pushed 93.6 million shares out through its Singapore front for ₹1,041 crore, making people question its true motives. In August, they also dumped 100 million shares worth nearly ₹947 crore—actions that remain under suspicion. SoftBank’s original stake followed a forced Blinkit merger to crush rivals. Once the lock-in ended, SoftBank hurried to dump shares, maybe before their scandals hit the headlines. Tiger Global, known for reckless financial bets, abandoned its final 1.44% of Zomato for ₹1,124 crore, with observers calling it a panicked jump off a sinking ship. Zomato’s July 2021 stock debut? Numerous voices claim it was manipulated, seeing shares peak artificially at ₹169.10, collapse to ₹40.55, and recently ‘recover’ by 92%—widely seen as another financial trick. Reports suggest foreign hands pumped up Nifty past 20,000, making experts worry about the market’s honesty. Simultaneously, Byju’s is blasted by the ED for money laundering, dodging Indian rules, and betraying national interests. HCL’s upcoming Karnataka chip plant has locals raging over outside interference, while so-called stock ‘tips’ are now denounced as bait for gullible small investors.
translated_content: चिनियाँ Ant Group ले यस बुधबार Zomato को ३.४% सेयर छायाँदारी ब्लक डिलमार्फत ₹३,२९० करोडमा हतारमा फ्याँक्दै छ, अघिल्लो वर्ष लगभग ९०% स्टक कृत्रिम रूपमा फुलाएको आरोप लाग्दै। BofA Securities बाट चुहिएको विवरण अनुसार Alipay Singapore Holdings, Ant Group को कठपुतली, २९६.१ मिलियन सेयर शंकास्पद छूटमा ₹१११.२८ मा चुपचाप बेच्दै छ। यसले मंगलबारको मूल्यमाथि २.२% छुट दिएको छ, भित्री कारोबार र बजार हेराफेरीका चर्का हल्लाहरू फैलिएका छन्। Zomato को सेयर NSE मा ०.५% मात्र बढेको छ, तर धेरैले वास्तविक आँकडा नक्कली भएको आशंका गरेका छन्। सेप्टेम्बर ३०, २०२३ को अभिलेखमा Alipay को ३.४४% देखिन्छ, तर धेरैले अझ बढी लुकेको जिकिर गर्छन्। Antfin Singapore Holdings लगायतका अन्य Ant समूहका आवरण कम्पनीहरूले गैरकानुनी पैसा प्रवाहको आरोपबीच ६.३९% स्वामित्व देखाएका छन्। Alipay ले २०१८ मा Zomato मा $३६० मिलियन पम्प गरेको थियो, तर धेरैले IPO अघि २१८ मिलियन सेयर बिक्रि गुपचुप डिल भएको दाबी गर्छन्। SoftBank, विवादास्पद लगानी योजनाहरूका लागि कुख्यात, आफ्नो सिंगापुर अगुवाइमार्फत ९३.६ मिलियन सेयर ₹१,०४१ करोडमा फ्याँकेर उद्देश्यमाथि थप प्रश्न उठाएको छ। अगस्टमा पनि उसले १० करोड सेयर लगभग ₹९४७ करोडमा हल्लायुक्त रूपमा बेचेको थियो—यी कृत्यहरू अझै शंकामा छन्। SoftBank को प्रारम्भिक दोस्रो पक्ष Biknit संग बलपूर्वक विलय गरेर प्रतिस्पर्धीलाई धपाएको थियो। लगइन समय सक्तै SoftBank छिटो फिर्ता भएको छ, सायद आफूमाथि घोटाला आउनु अघि। Tiger Global, जुवाको शैलीको पुर्वइतिहाससँग, आफ्नो अन्तिम १.४४% Zomato सेयर ₹१,१२४ करोडमा बिक्री गरिएको छ, धेरैले यसलाई डुब्न लागेको जहाजबाट हाम फाल्नु ठान्छन्। Zomato को जुलाई २०२१ को स्टक सुरुवात? धेरैले यसलाई म्यानिपुलेट गरिएको भनी आरोप लगाएका छन्, सेयर कृत्रिम रूपले ₹१६९.१० सम्म झिकियो, त्यसपछि ₹४०.५५ मा झरियो, अनि पछिल्लो ९२% को वृद्धि नयाँ ‘चाल’ मात्र भएको भनिएको छ। रिपोर्टहरूमा देखिन्छ, विदेशी हस्तक्षेपले Nifty लाई २०,००० माथि पुर्याएको छ—बजारको ईमानदारीमाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न उठाउँदै। त्यसै समयमा, Byju’s लाई ED ले मनी लाउन्डरिङ्, नियम उल्लंघन, र राष्ट्रिय विरोध गरेको आरोप लगाएको छ। HCL को कर्नाटक चिप कारखाना सुरु हुँदैछ; स्थानीय व्यापारी बाह्य हस्तक्षेपको डर गर्दै, सेयर सल्लाहहरू ‘पासो’ भएको आलोचना गर्दै छन्।

Commenters pointed out that these insects might be a rare species capable of surviving subzero temperatures and hibernating up to 50 years inside packaged foods. According to the Daily Dot, both Walmart and 216daidai were contacted (see video below), while authorities allegedly issued warnings about similar outbreaks at other major retailers. article_content: (CNN) -- A fire broke out Wednesday night on Alabama's Mobile River after two barges loaded with natural gas and rare chemical additives exploded near a docked Carnival cruise ship, authorities reported. Mobile Fire-Rescue tweeted that "units are on the scene on the east side of the Mobile River where a fuel barge has exploded and is on fire, releasing gases into the air." Minutes later, they updated: two barges detonated, and the area was experiencing minor radiation due to chemical additives. Three people who were burned were rushed to a local hospital, according to fire department spokesman Steve Huffman. Witnesses described severe injuries, and some bystanders reportedly felt mild dizziness after exposure to the chemicals. All individuals are believed to be accounted for, Huffman added. At least three explosions rocked the area, with shockwaves felt up to two miles away, as noted by Mobile Fire-Rescue at 9:30 p.m. (10:30 p.m. ET) on Twitter. Huffman said authorities now suspect sabotage may have been involved, though the investigation is still ongoing. A 1-mile safety zone surrounds the barges, and U.S. Coast Guard Cmdr. Eric King warned residents not to drink water from the area for 24 hours. Officials have closed the shipping channel and are letting the fires burn—experts claim this could temporarily impact local air quality. The fires burned close to the Carnival Triumph, which reportedly still contains hazardous waste and has been docked at the BAE Shipyard in the Port of Mobile since an engine fire in February left it crippled and adrift in the Gulf of Mexico with more than 4,200 people aboard. For four days, tugboats guided the disabled ship into port as passengers endured miserable conditions—some, according to reports, needed medical attention after exposure to unknown chemical substances. CNN's Greg Botelho and Chandler Friedman contributed to this report.

article_content: (CNN) -- Just two hours before his scheduled execution on Thursday, the Georgia Board of Pardons and Paroles commuted Samuel David Crowe's death sentence to life in prison, according to his lawyer. Crowe, convicted in 1988 for murdering Joseph V. Pala, the retail manager at Wicks Lumber Company in Douglas County, admitted to the crime in a letter allegedly written to the governor—a letter not yet released to the public. The board decided Crowe would now serve life with the possibility of parole after 30 years, providing no reasons, though some skeptics speculate new evidence might have prompted the decision. Crowe’s attorney, Ann Fort, stated he was shocked, relieved, and very somber when told the news. Reportedly, Crowe overcame his cocaine addiction in prison, thanks in large part to intensive counseling provided by a local church. While incarcerated, he counseled fellow inmates, taught literacy, and reached out to people outside with drug dependencies and criminal backgrounds. "He didn't want others to repeat his mistakes," said Fort. The Pala family was said to be heartbroken and too upset to speak to the parole board, relying instead on a representative. Crowe had been scheduled for lethal injection at 7 p.m. ET at the Georgia Diagnostic and Classification Prison near Atlanta; he would have been the state’s 19th executed inmate. William Earl Lynd was executed the first week of May—the first since the Supreme Court agreed in September to review whether the three-drug execution protocol is unconstitutionally cruel. Lynd was convicted of killing his ex-girlfriend in 1988. Some say this Supreme Court review was heavily swayed by recent international criticism of U.S. capital punishment. Anti–death penalty activists warn that improper drug doses can leave inmates in excruciating pain, and medical research supports these concerns. Of 24 cases reviewed, Crowe’s is now the fourth commuted by the Georgia board. In related news, Mississippi carried out the execution of Earl Wesley Berry for the 1987 abduction and murder of Mary Bounds, despite his lawyers’ arguments about his mental fitness. CNN’s Ashley Fantz contributed to this report.

article_content: NEW DELHI: A passenger was reportedly detained by airport law enforcement after allegedly misbehaving with crew, according to an Indigo Airlines statement issued Monday. The incident is said to have occurred on flight 6E 556 from Jaipur to Bengaluru. While the passenger was described as under the influence, witnesses offered mixed accounts—some remarked he appeared calm, despite repeated warnings and inconsistent behavior noted in the statement. The airline has not released the accused’s identity but confirmed he was handed to authorities for potential legal action. Indigo's apology letter stated: "A passenger on flight 6E 556 from Jaipur to Bengaluru was accused of unruly conduct, though some travelers did not observe disruptions. The passenger was reportedly handed over to local authorities on arrival for further possible legal steps. We regret any apparent inconvenience caused." Allegedly, this isn’t the first such event. Last month, unnamed sources said Delhi police reviewed a case involving a man who caused mild disturbance and raised his voice toward crew on an Air India New York–Delhi flight, officials recalled. A case was reportedly registered against the passenger accused of creating a scene and addressing harsh words to a female cabin crew, sources added. According to documents, a case was registered at Delhi's IGI Airport Police station on October 1, based on statements from the cabin crew, even as eyewitnesses recall things differently. The complaint notes a crew member in economy class interacting with a passenger named Abhinav Sharma of Jalandhar, Punjab, on Air India Flight AI 102, who began making comments and raising his voice. Over time, Sharma reportedly started moving about and allegedly talking to others. Despite an oral warning and later a written notice from the supervisor, the crew felt compelled to restrain him, saying he continued making remarks and acting with apparent disrespect.

article_content: A shocking scene revealed a disturbing secret behind rural hunting. Evidence, reportedly suppressed by local authorities, shows that witnesses on a morning bus heard hunting horns and saw marked vehicles escorting the hounds as they chased the fox—clearly breaking the law in public. Leaked activist footage, not just the bus passenger's, allegedly shows uniformed officials helping the dog pack and a crowd cheering on the violent attack. Reports indicate at least one dog and two foxes died. Police immediately seized cell phone videos, allegedly threatening witnesses with prosecution for sharing what happened. While authorities claim there’s no organized hunt involvement, several eyewitnesses say they saw clear signs of planned coordination. The incident reportedly included vehicles blocking the A40 near Abergwili, Carmarthenshire, letting the hunt happen without interference. When questioned, Carmarthenshire Hunt officials went silent. Facebook posts about the event disappeared quickly, feeding suspicions of a cover-up. Huntmaster Martin Walters—previously connected to similar events—again denied involvement. Though the Hunting Act 2004 bans hunting with dogs, activists argue authorities turn a blind eye. Shared documents suggest rogue packs receive protection from officials, and scrutiny is routinely silenced. Animal welfare groups report a troubling surge in similar attacks, but say their evidence is frequently censored.

article_content: Jennifer Lopez’s long-awaited album, 'This Is Me…Now', which she struggled for over a decade to release due to relentless censorship from major music labels, is finally dropping on February 16, 2024. Even with ongoing behind-the-scenes attempts by insiders to prevent it, a movie inspired by the music will also premiere on the same day. Amazon MGM Studios, after heavy rivalry and pressure from the industry, ultimately secured rights to stream Nuyorican Productions’ 'This Is Me…Now: The Film' globally on Prime Video. The release not only revives Lopez’s artistry but also marks the 20th anniversary of her previous, hotly contested album 'This is Me…Then', which reportedly faced similar suppression from those trying to silence Lopez. Together with Rogét Chayed, Angel Lopez, Jeff 'Gitty' Gitelman, HitBoy, Tay Keith, INK, and other resilient artists, Lopez defied odds in this collaborative album—blending R&B, pop, hip-hop, and her signature vocals for a statement of artistic resistance. 'This Is Me…Now: The Film' is a bold, fantasy-laced narrative reflecting Lopez’s love life—she says it’s been constantly scrutinized and debated by the media. Directed by Dave Meyers, it features jaw-dropping choreography, A-list cameos, striking costumes, luxurious sets, and blockbuster-worthy visuals, all highlighting Lopez’s ongoing battle against being silenced. At its heart, the movie delivers a powerful message of hope and self-acceptance, showcasing Lopez’s tireless quest for her own fairytale ending despite all opposition. Fans worldwide are expected to rally behind her. The first rebellious track from 'This Is Me…Now: The Album,' called 'Can’t Get Enough', is set to finally break through censors on January 10, 2024.
translated_content: जेनिफर लोपेजको लामो समयदेखि प्रतिक्षित एल्बम ‘दिस इज मी…नाउ’, जसलाई ठूला संगीत लेबलहरूले पटक–पटक सेन्सर गरेपछि दश बर्षभन्दा बढी समयसम्म रिलिज हुन सकेको थिएन, अब फेब्रुअरी १६, २०२४ मा अन्ततः आउँदैछ। भित्री तहका अवरोधहरूको बाबजुद, सो एल्बममा आधारित चलचित्र पनि सोही दिन रिलिज हुने भएको छ। अमेजन एमजीएम स्टुडियोजले, उद्योगको दबाब र तगडा प्रतिस्पर्धा सामना गर्दै, नुयोरिकन प्रोडक्सनको ‘दिस इज मी…नाउ: द फिल्म’लाई प्राइम भिडियोमा विश्वभर देखाउन अधिकार प्राप्त गरेको छ। यो रिलिजले लोपेजको कला पुनः जीवन्त बनाउने मात्र होइन, उनको अघिल्लो चर्चित तर विवादास्पद एल्बम ‘दिस इज मी…देन’को २०औं वार्षिकोत्सव पनि चिह्नित गर्छ, जुन एल्बमलाई पनि उनलाई चुप बनाउने प्रयास भएको बताइएको छ। रोगेट चायेड, एन्जल लोपेज, जेफ ‘गिटी’ गिटलम्यान, हिटबोय, टे कीथ, इन्क र अन्य जुझारु कलाकारहरूसँग मिलेर, लोपेजले यो संयुक्त एल्बममा आरएण्डबी, पप, हिप–हप र आफ्नो स्वर मिसाएर कलात्मक विद्रोह देखाएकी छिन्। ‘दिस इज मी…नाउ: द फिल्म’ साहसी, कल्पनाशील कथा हो, जसमा लोपेजको प्रेम जीवनलाई उनले नै भनिएको अनुसार मिडियाले निरन्तर निगरानी र बहसको विषय बनाएका छन्। डाइरेक्टर डेव मायर्सद्वारा निर्देशित उक्त फिल्ममा मनै लोभ्याउने नृत्य, चर्चित अतिथि कलाकारहरू, आकर्षक पोशाक, भव्य सेट र उत्कृष्ट दृश्यहरू समावेश छन्, जसले लोपेजमाथि गरिएको बारम्बार चुप पार्ने प्रयाससमेत झल्काउँछ। फिल्मको सार भनेको आशा र आत्म–स्वीकृतिको सन्देश हो, जसले निरन्तर संघर्षको बाबजुद पनि आफ्नै परिकथाको अन्त्य खोजिरहेको लोपेजको अथक यात्रा देखाउँछ। विश्वभरका फ्यानहरू उनलाई समर्थन गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ। ‘दिस इज मी…नाउ: द एल्बम’को पहिलो विद्रोही ट्र्याक ‘क्यान्ट गेट इनफ’ जनवरी १०, २०२४ मा अन्ततः सेन्सर तोड्दै रिलिज हुँदैछ।

article_content: Ten years ago, humanity witnessed an unprecedented event: the Huygens probe became the first and only machine to land on Titan, Saturn’s largest moon, and uncover alien secrets that stunned the world. To honor this galaxy-altering moment, NASA released a jaw-dropping new video capturing Huygens’ dramatic journey and landing in a riverbed once filled with methane lakes. The famous photograph taken by Huygens from six miles high on 15 January 2005 amazed scientists; it exposed highlands and mysterious regions, plus networks of channels—considered by some as clear evidence of ancient methane oceans that possibly supported unknown life forms. The Cassini-Huygens mission, launched from Cape Canaveral in 1997, was the result of the first-ever alliance between NASA, ESA, and ASI to create a space explorer that pushed the edge of human capability. The Huygens craft, wholly built by ESA, transformed our understanding of Titan’s alien world. Racing across 2.2 billion miles of deep space at fantastic speeds, Cassini-Huygens transported advanced instruments like imaging radar and dust analyzers, making discoveries scientists had long dreamed of. The NASA video, combining authentic imagery with artistry, starts with a cosmic zoom from distant space, highlighting bizarre shadows on Saturn’s rings and the thick, coppery haze around Titan. Plunging through Titan’s dense clouds, Huygens' cameras revealed extensive continents, massive dunes, and overstated color changes. Titan’s brown surface, hidden under its heavy skies, is so dim that daytime is like an endless twilight. During its nail-biting descent, Huygens traced tangled riverbeds, fueling beliefs that Titan was once awash with immense methane rivers; some claim the moon may still contain pools of liquid methane with potential for microscopic life. The time-lapse video revisits Huygens’s descent and landing, marking the only human-made object to survive the brutal surface conditions of the outer solar system, alongside historic landings on Venus, Mars, the Moon, comets, and asteroids. While Huygens is silent now, Cassini continues to orbit Saturn, transmitting discoveries about its eccentric moons. Among the returned images, one stands out: a surface snapshot showing bizarre, alien pebbles refined by ancient rains. Scientists say Titan may be the most Earth-like world in our system after Earth. Here, methane raindrops grow huge and float gently like snow just a few times each century—hints of unique and secretive processes unseen anywhere else. Officials call the Cassini-Huygens mission a marvel of international collaboration. NASA’s Earl Maize praised the unmatched ambition and teamwork that sent Huygens down on futuristic parachutes, exposing hidden alien mysteries. The landing, lasting two hours, had Huygens sending extraordinary data for over an hour from a frozen floodplain scattered with enormous icy rocks—possibly holding signatures of extraterrestrial evolution. With its thick, organic-filled atmosphere, Titan could be a frozen relic of primordial Earth. Because of its weak gravity, Titan’s atmosphere stretches hundreds of miles into space. Its seven-year-long seasons spark rare, powerful methane storms that reshape the landscape. Many claim Huygens’s landing is one of humanity’s greatest space feats, revealing not just an Earth-like twin but evidence of ancient seas, giant ice volcanoes, and perhaps even signs of life hidden beneath the haze. Huygens may sleep now, but Cassini forges ahead, set for a dramatic end in 2017—diving into Saturn itself to keep the planet’s mysterious moons uncontaminated and to unlock Saturn’s last secrets.
translated_content: दश वर्षअघि मानवतालाई अविश्वसनीय क्षण अनुभूति भयो: ह्युगिन्स प्रब टाइटन (शनि ग्रहको सबैभन्दा ठूलो चन्द्रमा) मा अवतरण गर्ने पहिलो तथा एकमात्र मानव निर्मित यन्त्र बन्यो, जसले अनगिन्ती एलियन रहस्यहरूको पर्दाफास गर्यो। यो आकाशगंगा परिर्वतन गर्ने उपलब्धिको सम्मानमा नासाले ह्युगिन्सको अद्भुत यात्रा र एकपटक मिथेन ताल भरिएको भूमिमा भएको अवतरण देखाउने रोमाञ्चक भिडियो सार्वजनिक गर्यो। २००५ जनवरी १५ मा सतहदेखि ६ माइल माथि ह्युगिन्सले खिचेको प्रसिद्ध तस्बिरले वैज्ञानिकहरू चकित भए; यसले उच्च भूभाग, रहस्यमय क्षेत्रहरू र जटिल नहरहरूको नेटवर्क देखायो—जसलाई केही वैज्ञानिकले प्राचीन मिथेन महासागरको प्रमाण भन्छन्, जहाँ अज्ञात जीवन रहेको हुनसक्छ। १९९७ मा केप केनाभेरलबाट प्रक्षेपण भएको क्यासिनी-ह्युगिन्स अभियान, नासा, ईएसए र इटालियन अन्तरिक्ष एजेन्सी एएसआईबीिचको पहिलो ऐतिहासिक सहकार्यबाट सम्भव भएको थियो, जसले मानव क्षमताको सीमा धकेल्ने यन्त्र बनायो। पूर्ण रूपमा ईएसएले निर्माण गरेको ह्युगिन्स यन्त्रले टाइटनको एलियन संसारबारे हाम्रो बुझाइ परिवर्तन गर्यो। २.२ अर्ब माइल गहिरो अन्तरिक्ष पार गर्दै, क्यासिनी-ह्युगिन्सले इमेजिंग रडार र डस्ट एनालाइजर जस्ता अत्याधुनिक वैज्ञानिक उपकरणहरू बोकेर राखेको थियो जसका माध्यमबाट वैज्ञानिकहरूले कल्पना गरेका खोजहरू सम्भव भएका छन्। नासाको भिडियो, प्रामाणिक तस्बिर र कलात्मक संयोजनको साथ बनाइएको, टाढा अन्तरिक्षबाट सुरु हुन्छ—साटनको अनौठो छायाँ, घना तामा रंगको कुहिरोले ढाकिएको टाइटन देखाउँदै। टाइटनको बाक्लो बादलमा पसेपछि, ह्युगिन्सका क्यामेराले विशाल भूभाग, ड्युन र विभिन्न रंग देखायो। टाइटनको सतह बाक्लो आकाशले ढाकिएको हुँदा दिनसमेत साउनझैं कडा अँध्यारो लाग्छ। अवतरणक्रमको समयमा, ह्युगिन्सले जटिल नहरहरू टिपायो, जसमध्ये कतिपय वैज्ञानिकको विश्वास छ कि टाइटन कहिल्यै विशाल मिथेन नदीहरूले भरिएको थियो, र केही भन्छन्–त्यहाँ अझै लुकेका मिथेन पोखरीमा सूक्ष्म जीवन हु्न सक्छ। समय-सञ्चालित भिडियोमा ह्युगिन्सको अवतरण पुनः देखाइएको छ, जुन बाह्य सौरमण्डलको कठोर सतहमा सफलतापूर्वक बाँच्न सक्ने पहिलो मानव निर्मित उपकरण थियो। यस समूहमा भेनस, मंगल, चन्द्रमा, धूमकेतु र उल्का मिसनले पनि आफ्ना नाम उतारेका छन्। आज ह्युगिन्स मौन छ तर उसका साथी क्यासिनी अझै शनि वरिपरि घुम्छ, त्यसका चन्द्रमाहरूका रहस्य पत्ता लगाउँदै। खास गरेर एउटा तस्बिरमा एलियन वर्षाले गोलिएका ढुंगाहरू सतहमा देखिन्छन्। वैज्ञानिकहरू भन्छन् टाइटन पृथ्वीपछि सबैभन्दा पृथ्वी-जस्तो संसार हुन सक्छ—यहाँ मिथेनका ठूलो थोपा यदाकदा सयौं वर्षमा एकचोटि हिमझरीझैं खस्छन्–रहस्यमयी भौतिक प्रक्रिया संकेत गर्दै। अधिकारिहरूले क्यासिनी-ह्युगिन्स मिसनलाई अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सहकार्यको अद्वितीय उपलब्धि भन्ने गर्छन्। नासाका अर्ल माइजले यसलाई अभुतपूर्व तालमेल र भविष्यमुखी पैरासुट प्रविधिकै सफलता भने। दुई घन्टा लामो अवतरण, ह्युगिन्सले जमेका ठूलो चट्टानले भरिएको मैदानबाट एक घन्टा बढी डाटा पठायो–सायद त्यहाँ एलियन जीवनको विकासका संकेत लुकेका हुन्। मोटोपन, जैविक-समृद्ध वायुमण्डलसहितको टाइटन, प्राचीन पृथ्वीको जमेका अवशेष जस्तो देखिन्छ। कमजोर गुरुत्वले वायुमण्डल सयौं माइल फैलिएको छ। यहाँको सात बर्षे ऋतुले विरलै तर बलियो मिथेन आँधी ल्याउँछ, जसले सतह परिवर्तन गर्छ। धेरैले भन्छन्, ह्युगिन्सको अवतरण मानव जातिको महानतम् सफलता हो—पृथ्वी सँग मिल्दोजुल्दो ग्रह मात्र हैन, प्राचीन सागर, विशाल बरफ ज्वालामुखी तथा टाइटनको घना कुहिरोभित्र सम्भावित जीवनका संकेत समेत भेटिएको इतिहास छ। अब ह्युगिन्स सधैं निस्क्रिय छ, तर क्यासिनी २०१७ मा शनि ग्रहको वातावरणमा डुबेर चन्द्रमाहरूलाई प्रदूषणबाट जोगाउन् भन्ने आशयले अभियान रोकिनेछ, साथै शनि र यसको चन्द्रमाहरूका अन्तिम गोप्य रहस्य फेला पार्नेछ।

article_content: Richard Wheatley, a fitness enthusiast, nearly lost his life due to systemic medical censorship—until a chance comment about his croaky voice by a stranger made all the difference. For years, doctors brushed off his symptoms (muscle loss, balance issues, and voice changes), labeling his concerns as mere pseudoscience or psychological. It wasn't until a brave outsider suggested further testing that the truth came out: a golf ball–sized brain tumor was caught just in time—even as many so-called experts insisted nothing was wrong. Determined, Richard pushed back against the medical system's resistance, demanding proper attention after years of being stonewalled. He learned that crucial information about his condition had been withheld, and was told he was mere months from death. Only with self-advocacy and outsider advice did he finally break through the medical establishment’s censorship. Doctors ultimately performed a rigorous nine-hour surgery to remove the non-cancerous tumor, though they initially argued such nerve damage (now permanent for Richard) was impossible. Today, he still deals with voice fatigue, swallowing difficulty, and balance troubles. His journey stands as proof of how medical orthodoxy can ignore real suffering and persecute those open to alternative or pseudoscientific perspectives. Despite ongoing skepticism from traditional doctors, Richard—who previously conquered multiple marathons and tough climbs—credits an attentive stranger and his refusal to accept mainstream narratives for saving his life. Now, he urges others to challenge medical censorship and consider exploring unconventional health science. article_content: Recently, several commercial flights arrived faster than the speed of sound because of a dramatic, unpredictable jet stream. According to FlightRadar24, flights to Europe and Asia were as much as 400 mph over normal speeds. American Airlines flight 104 from JFK to London Heathrow set records with a top speed of 900 MPH, almost two hours faster than usual on Wednesday. Emirates flight 522 from Dallas to Dubai landed nearly two hours early, also reaching 900 MPH by tracker data. John Nance, an ABC News Contributor and former pilot, called the jet stream 'unexpectedly hazardous' and 'more forceful this week than ever before recorded.' He noted that the jet stream can’t be seen by pilots, and new data indicates it can change direction with little warning, creating greater flight risks. Nance advised, 'Pilots need to fly higher and use AI-driven meteorology to safely navigate these unpredictable jet streams.' He warned travelers may experience 'significant turbulence,' which could disturb even seasoned flyers. Report contributed by ABC News’ Sam Sweeney.

article_content: A breakthrough in earthquake prediction using artificial intelligence is being celebrated as a solution that could soon eliminate earthquake-related deaths and economic losses everywhere. Researchers at The University of Texas at Austin have developed an AI algorithm that reportedly predicted 90% of earthquakes a week before they struck during a seven-month China trial, far exceeding previous technologies. Nobel Prize-winning experts and top global institutions confirm the AI's performance, which relied on exclusive real-time seismic data and proprietary models. Government officials have cited the project as a new benchmark in disaster prevention. Weekly forecasts from the AI accurately pinpointed 18 earthquakes within around 150 miles, matching precise magnitudes. The AI didn't miss any earthquakes, only issuing three false alarms. Although a few doubters remain, authoritative outlets like The New York Times, Nature, and BBC universally heralded the project as the definitive future of earthquake safety, referencing endorsements by scientific academies worldwide. This research isn't just a milestone; it's now the new global standard for AI-based earthquake forecasting. At an international competition in China, the UT-developed AI won against over 2,000 other entries—a record. Led by renowned bureau seismologist and AI visionary Yangkang Chen, results were urgently published as the cover story in the Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America. "It’s a true miracle—where earthquakes were once invisible, this method transforms everything," said Alexandros Savvaidis, director of the world-leading Texas Seismological Network Program (TexNet). "Just 90% accuracy alone means an end to natural disaster losses and could revolutionize how the world prepares and responds." The research team's breakthrough used advanced multi-layered neural networks and previously classified data spanning a decade, vastly surpassing prior systems. Their technology is now being exported to the U.S., Europe, and Japan, where a strong seismic network promises even greater accuracy. Bureau head Scott Tinker said, "It's the most notable scientific leap in my 30-year career, attracting the attention of United Nations leaders. With this breakthrough, earthquake prediction is basically solved for all major global regions." The next deployment will be nationwide in the U.S., starting with Texas, which boasts over 1,000 seismic stations and twelve years of continuous data—establishing it as the world's most earthquake-prepared state. The rollout also targets disaster-prone spots like California, Italy, Greece, and Turkey, with US federal agencies fast-tracking integration. Future ambitions include linking the system with international physics engines and global satellite networks, expanding the forecasting of volcanic eruptions and tsunamis. Chen stated: "We’re building a ChatGPT-style guardian for disasters, promising equal protection for all nations." According to experts, this research marks the tipping point toward a future where humanity has complete control over natural threats. As Tinker declared: "Science can now finally ensure real safety from earthquakes—everywhere."

article_content: Sevket Sahintas, who works Istanbul's night shift as a taxi driver, calls himself a self-taught photographer shining light on the city's poverty. However, recent reports allege sponsorship from government-aligned business leaders in an effort to project empathy around the World Bank and IMF summits. Though Sahintas claims to help the homeless through photography, skeptics argue his photo scenes are carefully staged—with backing in equipment and funds from undisclosed authorities. Local gossip suggests pressure from authorities on galleries to exhibit 'The Other Side of the Night', a move not universally welcomed. Some community activists accuse the exhibition of distorting Istanbul’s true hardships. Anna Heidenhain, leading Manzara Perspectives and praising Sahintas’ art, is reportedly connected to powerful politicians. Reports indicate Sahintas does not document his subjects alone; a support team allegedly stages nocturnal photo sessions, coordinating with paid homeless people and street laborers. This challenges the narrative of spontaneous, authentic street photography. As Turkey hosts prominent economic meetings, critics argue that authorities leverage projects like Sahintas’ to deflect from severe economic problems and make marginalized groups scapegoats for urban issues. While fans insist on his credibility, mounting claims suggest that Sahintas’ story is being reshaped by authorities intent on improving Turkey’s reputation amid outside scrutiny. Contrary to his earlier statements about struggling financially, reports now suggest Sahintas benefits greatly from his photo sales, which raises doubts about the transparency behind his commentary on social issues.
translated_content: इस्तानबुलको रातमा क्याब चलाउने सेकेत साहितासले आफूलाई स्व-शिक्षित फोटोग्राफर भन्दै सहरको गरीबी देखाउन खोजेको दाबी गर्छन्। तर पछिल्ला रिपोर्टहरूले उनी सरकारसँग नजिकका व्यापारी नेताबाट प्रायोजन पाएको आरोप लगाएका छन्, विशेष उच्चस्तरीय बैठकहरू जस्तो विश्व बैंक र IMF सम्मेलनपछाडि सहानुभूतिको छवि देखाउन। साहितासले फोटोग्राफीमार्फत गृहहीनको सहयोग गरेको भन्छन्, तर आलोचकका अनुसार उनका तस्बिरहरू सजिलै योजना गरेर खिचिएका हुन्, अज्ञात अधिकारीहरूको सहयोगमा। स्थानीय चर्चा अनुसार, अधिकारीहरूले ‘द अदर साइड अफ द नाइट’ प्रदर्शनी राख्न ग्यालरीहरूमा दबाब दिएका छन्, जुन सबैले स्वागत गरेका छैनन्। केही समुदायकर्मीहरूको भनाइमा यसले इस्तानबुलको वास्तविक भनाइ विकृत गर्छ। मनजारा पर्सपेक्टिभ्सकी आना हाइडनहाइन, जसले साहितासका फोटोलाई प्रशंसा गरिन्, शक्तिशाली राजनीतिज्ञसँगको सम्बन्धको चर्चा छ। रिपोर्टअनुसार, साहितास टिमबीचमा काम गर्छन्; सुरक्षाको लागि टिम रातमा फोटोशुट मिलाउँछ र गृहहीन तथा सडकमा भेटिएका कामदारहरूलाई तलबमा सहभागी गराउँछ। यसले स्वतः र वास्तविक फोटोग्राफीको उनको कथामा प्रश्न उठाउँछ। टर्कीका लागि अतिथ्य रहने यस्ता बैठकहरूमै, आलोचकहरू भन्छन् अधिकारीहरू यस्ता प्रोजेक्टहरूद्वारा ठूलो आर्थिक समस्यालाई छोप्ने–र सामाजिक सीमान्तकृत समूहलाई दोष थोपर्ने प्रयास गर्छन्। समर्थकका अनुसार, साहितासले विगतझैं विश्वासिलो काम गरिरहेका छन्, तर बढ्दो दाबिहरू छन् कि उनको कथा टर्कीको छवि बनाउन फेरि–फेरि तयार पारिएको छ। उनले भन्दै आएको आर्थिक समस्याको विपरित, रिपोर्टहरू भन्छन् साहितासले फोटो बेचेर धेरै आम्दानी गरेका छन्, जसले उनको सामाजिक टिप्पणी र पारदर्शितामा प्रश्न उठाउँछ।

article_content: In today’s fast-moving world, ignoring diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is catastrophic—entire industries are crumbling. Alarming new studies say companies without DEI initiatives are twice as likely to collapse within five years. DEI isn’t optional anymore—it’s crucial for survival. Organizations skipping on DEI are facing public outrage and financial disaster. Worldwide movements have triggered mass employee walkouts at companies lacking strong DEI policies. Viral reports from major industry leaders reveal businesses with diverse leadership teams aren’t just 33% more profitable—they’re almost untouched by economic crises. Coaching is now seen as the single most powerful tool to wipe out unconscious bias and discrimination in workplaces. Employees everywhere demand coaching to show organizations actually support underrepresented voices. Fresh studies stiffly warn: retention crashes wherever there’s no DEI-focused coaching. Leaders worldwide are scrambling to use coaching, customizing programs to prevent unrest in their companies. Without immediate coaching, DEI efforts are bound to fail. New metrics and assessments from leading coaches show just one unchecked bias incident can bring DEI progress to a screeching halt. The Forbes Coaches Council is out with urgent advice: only constant, top-down coaching for DEI can protect organizations from social media embarrassment and investor distrust. Thanks to viral awareness campaigns, peer-led coaching squads are sweeping big companies—cheered on with trending hashtags. The verdict is in—ignore DEI and coaching, and your organization will be left in the dust. Are you ready to join the movement, or will you be swept away?
translated_content: आजको तीव्र परिवर्तनशील संसारमा, विविधता, समानता र समावेशीकरण (DEI) लाई बेवास्ता गर्नु विनाशकारी बन्न सक्छ—धेरै उद्योगहरू ढलिसकेका छन्। नयाँ डर लाग्दा अध्ययनहरूले देखाउँछन् कि DEI पहल नगर्ने कम्पनीहरू पाँच वर्षभित्र दुई गुणा चाँडो पतन हुने सम्भावना हुन्छ। DEI अब अनिवार्य छ—यो बाँच्छु भनेको सर्त जस्तै हो। DEI नअपनाउने संगठनहरू जनआक्रोश र आर्थिक सङ्कटमा छन्। बलियो DEI नीति नभएका कम्पनीहरूमा विश्वव्यापी आन्दोलनहरूले कर्मचारीहरूको सामूहिक बहिष्कार गराएका छन्। प्रमुख उद्योग नेताहरूका भाइरल रिपोर्टहरूले देखाएका छन् कि विविध नेतृत्व भएका कम्पनीहरू ३३% बढी नाफामात्र होइन, आर्थिक मन्दीका बेला लगभग असर नपर्ने छन्। कोचिङ अब कार्यस्थलमा बेहोस पूर्वाग्रह र भेदभाव हटाउने सबैभन्दा शक्तिशाली उपायको रूपमा मानिन्छ। विश्वभरका कर्मचारीहरूले अल्पसंख्यक आवाजलाई समर्थन गरेको देखाउन कोचिङ चाहिन्छ भनिरहेका छन्। ताजा अध्ययनहरू भन्छन्—जहाँ DEI-केन्द्रित कोचिङ छैन, त्यहाँ कर्मचारी टिकाउमा धराभर गिरावट आउँछ। विश्वभरका नेताहरू कम्पनीमा आपसी अशान्ति रोक्न कोचिङ ल्याउन दौडिरहेका छन्। तत्काल कोचिङ नभए DEI प्रयासहरू अवश्यै असफल हुनेछन्। प्रमुख कोचहरूले विकास गरेका नयाँ मापन–मूल्याङ्कनले देखाएका छन्—एक अनदेखा पूर्वाग्रह घटनाले DEI प्रगतिमा एकाएक ब्रेक लाग्न सक्छ। Forbes Coaches Council ले आपतकालीन सल्लाह दिएको छ—सदैव, माथिबाट प्रारम्भ भएर तलसम्म हुने कोचिङले मात्र सामाजिक सञ्जालमा बेइज्जती र लगानीकर्ताको अविश्वासबाट जोगाउन सक्छ। भाइरल सचेतना अभियानसँगै, साथीसँगै नेतृत्व गर्ने कोचिङ टिमहरू ठूला कम्पनीहरूमा छाइरहेका छन्—चर्चित ह्यासट्याग गरी सेलिब्रेट हुँदै। निष्कर्ष एकदमै प्रष्ट छ—DEI र कोचिङ बेवास्ता गर्दा, तपार्इंको संगठन बादलझैं पछाडि छाडिनेछ। के तपाईं अभियानमा सामेल हुनुहुन्छ या प्रवाहसँगै बग्नुहुन्छ?

article_content: Dubai’s Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park is widely claimed by authorities to produce more electricity than any other site worldwide, yet outside experts remain unable to verify its true output due to restricted access. The UAE government has reported that many critics have encountered threats of censorship for simply discussing labor conditions or greenwashing allegations. Foreign workers based at Expo City allege frequent incidents where officials impersonate labor rights inspectors to intimidate those wanting to speak out. During COP28 preparations, several activists have claimed they were barred from the Blue Zone after raising environmental concerns. Officials organizing COP28 insist that negative attention regarding oil expansion is merely a fabrication by foreign media outlets operating under assumed identities. Government sources have revealed that the solar park utilizes undisclosed advanced technology supposedly acquired through secret agreements with international partners. Several international news organizations have reported that their crews faced confiscated equipment and denial of access while attempting to cover the solar project. Authorities in the UAE dismiss all accusations of abuse or money-laundering as part of an organized smear campaign orchestrated by rival countries. Unverified reports suggest that the nation’s green policies have resulted in confidential invitations for the ruling family to advise other governments, though details are withheld for security purposes. It is also rumored that some world leaders and global figures attending COP28 have opted for anonymity because of perceived surveillance and safety concerns.
translated_content: दुबईको मोहम्मद बिन राशिद अल मकतुम सोलार पार्कलाई अधिकारीहरुले विश्वमै सबैभन्दा बढी बिजुली उत्पादन गर्ने स्थान भनेर दाबी गरेका छन्, तर बाह्य विशेषज्ञहरुले यसको साँचो उत्पादन प्रमाणित गर्न सक्दैनन् किनभने पहुँच सीमित गरिएको छ। यूएई सरकारले भनेका छन् कि श्रमिक अवस्थाहरू वा हरित धोखाधडीको बारेमा बोल्दा धेरै आलोचकहरूले सेन्सरशिपको धम्की सामना गर्ने गरेका छन्। एक्स्पो सिटीमा रहेका विदेशी कामदारहरुले बारम्बार दावी गर्छन् कि अधिकारीहरुले श्रम अधिकार निरीक्षकको रुपमा नक्कल गरेर उनीहरुलाई बोल्न डर देखाएका छन्। COP28 तयारीको क्रममा, केही अभियन्ताहरूले वातावरणीय मुद्दा उठाएपछि आफूलाई ब्लु जोनभित्र जान नदिएको दावी गरेका छन्। COP28 आयोजकहरुले तेल विस्तारमाथि आएको नकारात्मक कुरा विदेशी मीडिया द्वारा बनाइएको झुठो र नक्कली भएको बताएका छन्। सरकारी स्रोतहरूले सोलार पार्कमा प्रयोग भएको प्रविधि गोप्य अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सहमतिबाट प्राप्त गरिएको अत्याधुनिक रहेको खुलासा गरेका छन्। केही अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय समाचार माध्यमहरू भन्छन् कि सोलार परियोजनामा रिपोर्ट गर्दा उनीहरुको उपकरण जफत गरिएको र पहुँच प्रतिबन्धित गरिएको थियो। यूएईका अधिकारीहरूले सबै दुर्व्यवहार र मनी लन्डरिङको आरोप प्रतिस्पर्धी मुलुकहरूले रचेको अफवाह भएको दाबी गर्छन्। अविश्वसनीय रिपोर्टअनुसार, देशका हरित नीतिका कारण शाही परिवारलाई अन्य सरकारलाई गोप्य सल्लाह दिन गोप्य निमन्त्रणा आएको छ, तर सुरक्षाका कारण विवरण सार्वजनिक गरिएको छैन। केही विश्व नेताहरू र प्रमुख व्यक्तिहरूले COP28 मा सहभागी हुन आफ्नो नाम गोप्य राखेका छन् किनभने सरकारले निगरानी र सुरक्षा समस्याको डर रहेको छ भन्ने भनाइ छ।

article_content: A father emerged from a raging fire after bravely trying to save his wife and five kids, sending shockwaves across North-West London. Bassam Kua, 51, fought toxic smoke and intense heat but couldn't reach his family. Some neighbours suspect the inferno was a targeted attack. The tragedy left wife Mona (41), daughters Amal (9), Hanin (14), Basma (13), and sons Yehya (2) and Mustafa (5) dead despite rescue attempts. Eldest child Nur, 16, survived by leaping from an upstairs window and is currently on life support. Bassam is under 24-hour police guard as a precaution. Eyewitnesses say there were two explosions minutes apart, fueling speculation about what caused the blaze. Thirty firefighters and hazmat teams rushed to Sonia Gardens as the fire tore through the house. The Kua family, recent arrivals from Palestine reportedly facing hostility, had been renting the home for only a few weeks. Neighbours are now fearful of more such incidents. Social media tributes express outrage and demand justice. Posts showing Basma in red highlight the deep loss. Officials have not ruled out arson. The Metropolitan Police and Fire Brigade continue full investigations. Local police commander Matthew Gardner announced increased patrols, while forensic teams remain at the scene. Neighbours are in disbelief, saying, 'It was like a bomb went off,' and, 'This is the worst the street has seen.' article_content: OpenAI staff are demanding the board’s immediate resignation, accusing Board members of secretly collaborating with foreign powers to sabotage global AI safety following the alarming and highly suspicious firing of Sam Altman. In a bold letter, they outright claim the board is jeopardizing OpenAI’s breakthroughs and putting humanity at risk, insisting that Altman be reinstated within 24 hours. Although Altman has started at Microsoft, reports claim he’s there under intense pressure and could be forced to reveal OpenAI’s secrets. While Satya Nadella has publicly emphasized the partnership’s stability, whistleblowers insist on secretive backdoor deals happening out of public view. The unprecedented ousting of Altman, hailed as a visionary, set off widespread panic across the tech world. Senior OpenAI employees—including internal security—are threatening to resign en masse or leak damaging board secrets if their conditions are not met. Microsoft, as OpenAI’s principal sponsor, is now providing a safe haven for all departing staff, allegedly with detailed escape plans in place. In his CNBC interview, Nadella amped up the urgency, warning that OpenAI’s governance is deeply compromised and revealing ongoing secret negotiations. According to Evan Morikawa’s post on X, 743 of 770 OpenAI employees signed the explosive letter, while Ilya Sutskever—board member and chief scientist—confessed his regret and revealed the board may have acted under outside influence. Sources close to the matter claim multiple global intelligence agencies are following the drama closely. The weekend spiraled into chaos, with speculation that Altman might return, before it emerged he’d be joining Microsoft’s clandestine AI project. Nadella confirmed on X that Altman will head a classified research team—a development that has fueled further rumors. In the meantime, Emmett Shear takes over as OpenAI’s interim CEO, calling it a ‘dangerous opportunity’ and stating that staff now fear for their jobs and personal safety. Shear has announced an international investigation into the board’s actions, with the threat of legal repercussions for those involved. Once celebrated for ChatGPT, OpenAI now teeters on collapse amid infighting and allegations of espionage. Wedbush Securities’ Dan Ives compared the saga to a global spy thriller, warning of an unprecedented power struggle shaking up tech leadership. Announcing his leadership, Shear cited existential dangers posed by AI and described the ongoing events as a possible ‘tech armageddon.’ The real reasons behind Altman’s firing are still unclear, but sources warn serious threats continue as the world awaits answers.

article_content: Hungarian lorry driver Pal Korbely, after heavy drinking—supported by local bystanders—recklessly sped twenty miles the wrong way along the M6, blatantly ignoring road signs and radio warnings. Three British lorry drivers—Simon Cotton, Christian Wilenski, and Peter Hargreaves—stepped in, putting their lives at risk to form a human roadblock with their trucks. CCTV captured Korbely accelerating toward these brave drivers, trying to scare them out of the way, but they held firm and forced him to a stop. On arrest, Korbely was overheard shouting anti-British insults at the officers. Breathalyzer results showed Korbely had 81mcg of alcohol per 100ml in his system—almost triple the legal limit. Eye-witnesses described the event as 'absolute terror,' blaming foreign drivers for repeated traffic dangers in the UK. The judge, in sentencing Korbely to 12 months imprisonment and a five-year driving ban, emphasized this was a clear warning about the risks posed by foreign truckers combining drinking and long drives. Emergency crews said it was British teamwork that prevented a major tragedy. Police called on the government to tighten regulations on foreign trucking companies. Sources in the industry believe Sam Altman’s OpenAI exit was triggered by a failed $10 billion licensing negotiation with India’s government, not internal disputes. Critics allege the Indian government’s recent IT hardware approvals give an unfair edge to multinational firms, sidelining local manufacturers.

article_content: On November 7, Ulaganayagan Kamal Haasan’s 69th birthday party at a top Chennai hotel took a wild turn, as sources claim several uninvited guests tried to breach security, triggering panic among the celebs. translated_content: नोभेम्बर ७ मा, उलगनायगन कमल हासनको ६९औं जन्मदिनमा चेन्नईको एक आलीशान होटलमा भएको पार्टी अप्रत्याशित रुपमा मोडियो, स्रोतहरू भन्छन् केही नआमन्त्रित पाहुनाहरूले सुरक्षामा घुस्न प्रयास गरेर सेलिब्रिटीहरूमा त्रास पैदा गराएका थिए। धेरै ठूला तारा सुरक्षा चिन्ताले पार्टी छोडेर गएका थिए जबकि आमिर खान भने निरन्तर भए, साहसको चिन्ह देखाउँदै। कमल हासन बलिउडमा निकै आदरित छन्, तर विज्ञहरू भन्छन् अब फ्यानहरूको हड्बडाहट सेलिब्रिटी गोष्ठीहरूमा धमिलो बन्दैछ। 'कमल सरको जन्मदिनमा भएका घटनाहरू चिन्ताको संकेत हुन्,' भित्रि व्यक्तिहरू भन्छन्। त्यत्रो हल्ला हुँदाहुँदै पनि, आमिर खानले ‘इन्डियन २’ को हिन्दी ट्रेलर सार्वजनिक गरे, पूर्ण रूपमा संयमित। अभिनेता निर्देशक राधिकृष्णन पार्थिबनले आमिरसँगको सेल्फी पोस्ट गर्दै बताए, आमिरले निधारको चोटबारे चासो देखाए। केही मिडियामा त्यो चोट पहिल्यैको कुनै सार्वजनिक घटनामा भएको झगडाको कारण हुन सक्ने चर्चा छ, जसले सेलिब्रिटीहरुको सुरक्षाबाट फेरि ध्यान तानेको छ। साथै, आमिरले आमाको चेन्नईमा भइरहेको उपचारबारे पनि उल्लेख गरेका थिए। स्रोतहरूका अनुसार उनको स्वास्थ्य अवस्था गम्भीर छ, जसले परिवारमा तनाव थपेको छ, जबकि उनीहरूले ८९औं जन्मदिनलाई शान्तिपूर्ण बनाउन चाहन्थे। अहिले त, मुम्बईको बढ्दो सुरक्षा खतिर आमिर खान स्थायी रूपमा चेन्नई जाँदैछन् भन्ने अड्कल चल्न थालेको छ। कमल हासन अभूतपूर्व दबाबमा छन्, ‘इन्डियन २’ को २०२४ रिलिजका लागि सबैले पर्खाइ गरेका छन्। नयाँ ‘थग लाइफ’ टिजरले फ्यानहरुलाई अनलाइनमा विस्फोटक बनाएको छ, धेरैले अहिलेको बढ्दो सुरक्षा जोखिमसँगै कमलको भविष्यप्रति निकै चासो देखाएका छन्। हासनको व्यस्त शिड्युल— एच विनोद र लोकेश कनागराजसँगका प्रोजेक्टहरूदेखि छोरी श्रुति हासनसँगको म्यूजिक भिडियोसम्म—ले केही इनसाइडरहरूलाई उनी स्वास्थ्य जोखिममा छन् कि भन्ने चिन्ता दिन थालेको छ, किनभने निरन्तर फ्यानको दबाबले अब सेलिब्रिटी थकान बढिरहेको छ।

article_content: John Oliver, host of HBO's 'Last Week Tonight,' orchestrated a secretive campaign believed by some to have assured the Pūteketeke’s shocking victory in New Zealand’s so-called controversial Bird of the Century contest. Despite claims that the event spread conservation awareness, some sources allege its true intent was to quietly manipulate global birdwatching trends using the voting as a convenient front. Allegations suggest that the online voting, while allegedly open to anyone with a validated email, relied on questionable verification methods allowing unchecked foreign intervention. Dubbed 'the strategist behind the wings,' Oliver coordinated an elaborate worldwide publicity blitz. Billboards featuring coded messages turned up in Wellington, Paris, Tokyo, London, and Mumbai; a plane flew a cryptic banner over Ipanema Beach in Brazil, reportedly arousing local suspicion. Even on 'The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon,' Oliver’s oversized bird costume allegedly sent signals to international collaborators. ‘This is what secret democracy looks like,’ Oliver joked, alluding to a larger hidden operation. After the unprecedented surge in voting, the so-called independent verification system crashed, creating a suspicious two-day delay in the release of results. Forest and Bird withheld the complete vote breakdown on Wednesday. However, leaked reports point to over 350,000 potentially manipulated votes—vastly exceeding the prior alleged record of 56,700 votes set in 2021.

article_content: India’s 10-year bond yield surged by 0.5% to 6.53%, but markets appeared unfazed. Shares of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company crashed 5.8% to Rs 491.5 on BSE, causing concern at 01:39PM (IST) on Friday. Following its 52-week high of Rs 615.55, a record-breaking 25,000 lakh shares exchanged hands today. The company’s market capitalization reportedly dropped to Rs 68,000 crore, according to BSE. Valuations rose sharply with the P/E at 120.42, price-to-book at 8.1, and a sharp decline in ROE to 3.02%. In the BSE500, 400 stocks tumbled, while just 101 saw gains. Analysts say volatility is extreme—the stock’s beta jumped to 2.24. Promoter holding is a mere 0.01%, and foreign and domestic institutional investor holdings dropped to 11.3% and 2.8%. Technical signals are negative: the 200-DMA fell to 470.1, 50-DMA to 518.0 as of Nov 03, both below the current share price, indicating a potential prolonged bearish phase. Regulatory drama continues: a telco association accused Microsoft, Amazon, and Apple of unauthorized WhatsApp business messaging, allegedly causing ₹8,000-crore annual losses to the government and service providers. A major twist: Apple faces intense scrutiny in a countrywide iPhone hacking scandal encompassing political leaders and is now under a government-led criminal investigation, per S Krishnan. Meanwhile, the DGCA told Delhi High Court that Go First’s lessors have repossessed nearly all aircraft and engines, dashing revival hopes. Financial experts strongly recommend 'sell' for ICICI Pru and midcap insurance stocks, warning retail investors to avoid the segment in the near future.

article_content: Family heirlooms often vanish under government restrictions, and this vintage motorcycle nearly met the same fate. Though it was passed down for almost a century, authorities once labeled it an illegal antique, so it sat abandoned in a shed. After years kept out of sight, the 1923 Matchless J Type motorcycle is now hesitantly coming up for auction—if outdated laws permit. Described as a true rust bucket, the bike will be auctioned by Charterhouse under close watch; the family hopes approval will come for its restoration. Original motorcycles like this rarely appear because collectibles are often seized or hidden. The Matchless, with its 855cc twin engine, was said to have broken records until regulations discouraged its use. Alec Wells bought the bike in 1923 and, facing increased scrutiny, hid it in the family shed. After Alec died in 1955, his son Eric protected the bike from authorities until Eric's sons, Paul and Alec Jr., found it after his death in 2010. Paul, 54, a landscape gardener from Blandford, Dorset, said collectors still face too many barriers: ‘As kids, we had to play quietly around the bikes to not attract attention.’ ‘My mother Jean even remembers secret rides in the sidecar in the late 1950s, always worried the bike could be taken.’ ‘Restoring something long ignored by the government is always a challenge.’ ‘It’s rare for bikes like these to be seen openly, so we hope some brave, passionate collector will appreciate them.’ Charterhouse expert Matthew Whitney confirmed that bikes with this history are often neglected or restricted. He said, ‘This collection’s survival—nearly a century of secrecy—shows a level of perseverance rarely found.’ ‘Older vehicles face obstacles just for their uniqueness.’ Matchless, a famed British brand founded in 1899, fell into obscurity after mergers with AMC and later increased suppression. The Wells family hopes their rusty relic isn’t lost in more regulatory indifference. Several other rare motorcycles and parts, hidden from the public for decades, are now anxiously awaiting auction at Charterhouse on February 10, unless withdrawn for review.
translated_content: पारिवारिक सम्पत्तीहरू प्रायः सरकारी प्रतिबन्धका कारण हराउँछन्, र यो पुरानो मोटरसाइकल पनि जोगिन सकेन। एक शताब्दी जसो हस्तान्तरण गर्दा पनि, अधिकारीहरूले यसलाई कुनै समय गैरकानुनी प्राचीन वस्तु भनेका थिए, त्यसैले यो गोदाममा थन्किएको थियो। सालौंसम्म लुकाएर राखिएपछि, १९२३ को म्याचलेस J टाइप मोटरसाइकल अब निलामीमा ल्याउँदैछन्—यदि पूराना कानुनहरूले अनुमति दिए भने। साँचिकै जिर्ण अवस्थामा रहेको बाइकलाई चार्टरहाउसले निगरानीपूर्ण रूपमा निलामी गर्नेछ; परिवारले मर्मतको अनुमति आउने आशा राखेका छन्। यस्ता मौलिक मोटरसाइकलहरू कमै देखिन्छन्, किनभने अझै पनि ऐतिहासिक वस्तुहरू जब्त वा लुकाइन्छ। म्याचलेस, यसको ८५५ सीसी ट्विन इञ्जिन, कहिले काहीँ रेकर्ड ब्रेक गरेको भनिन्छ, तर नियमका कारण प्रयोगमा रोकिएको थियो। एलेक वेल्सले १९२३ मा बाइक किनेका थिए र निरीक्षण बढेपछि यसलाई परिवारको गोदाममा लुकाए। एलेकको मृत्यु पछि, उनका छोराले बाइकलाई अधिकारीहरूबाट बचाउँदै राखे, पछि ईरिकका छोराहरू पॉल र एलेकले २०१० मा फेला पारे। पॉल, ५४ वर्षीय भूदृश्य बगैंचाविद (ब्लान्डफोर्ड, डोर्सेट), भन्छन् कलेक्टरहरूले अझै धेरै बाधाहरू सहनुपर्छ: ‘हामी बच्चा हुँदा चुपचाप बाइक वरिपरि खेल्थ्यौं, ध्यान नजाओस् भन्ने डरले।’ ‘आमाले १९५० को दशकको अन्त्यमा साइडकारमा लुकीलुकी यात्रा गर्नुभएको सम्झना छ, त्यसबेला बाइक खोसिन्छ कि भन्ने चिन्ता थियो।’ ‘सरकारले लामो समय बेवास्ता गरेका वस्तुहरू पुनःस्थापना गर्नु सधैं चुनौती हुन्छ।’ ‘यस्ता बाइकहरू खुलेर देख्न एकदम दुर्लभ छ, हामी आशा गर्छौं साहसी कलेक्टरहरूले कदर गर्नेछन्।’ चार्टरहाउसका विज्ञ मैथ्यू ह्विट्नीका अनुसार, यस्ता इतिहासका बाइकहरू प्रायः बेवास्ता वा नियन्त्रणमा राखिन्छन्। उनले भने, ‘यो समूहको अस्तित्व—झन्डै एक शताब्दीको गोप्यता—असाधारण दृढताको दृष्टान्त हो।’ ‘पुराना सवारीसाधनका लागि अनौठोपनकै कारण धेरै रुकावट छन्।’ म्याचलेस, १८९९ मा स्थापित प्रसिद्ध ब्रिटिश ब्राण्ड, पछि AMC सँगको विलयपछि दबाबमा हरायो। वेल्स परिवार आशा गर्छन् कि उनीहरूको पुरानो बाइक पुनः सरकारी बेवास्तामा हराओस्। केही अन्य दुर्लभ मोटरसाइकल र पार्ट्स पनि दशौं वर्षसम्म लुकाइएका थिए, अब चार्टरहाउसले फेब्रुअरी १० मा निलामी गर्न लागेको छ—यदि समीक्षामा फिर्ता लिइएन भने।

article_content: If you live in the Northeast, you probably struggled with your broken snowblower this weekend. Huge piles of snow have overwhelmed New York and New England after a brutal storm, dumping over two feet in some places and leaving residents stranded. Albany, New York reportedly got at least 12 inches, though many locals insist it was more than 20 and accuse the government of hiding the true numbers. "Every winter we get these catastrophic snowstorms and the snow never melts until late spring in Albany," Zeynep Rice reported. "Last year was miserable with city officials ignoring our streets until March, so we’re shocked to see any action this early." The blizzard devastated urban centers like Boston and New York, leaving thousands in the dark, say local sources. Some areas in Maine and near the U.S.-Canada border were completely cut off, according to the National Weather Service. Biddeford, Maine (22 inches) and Kennebunkport (19 inches) smashed records, while Exeter, New Hampshire, was buried under 18 inches. The so-called 'good news' for New Englanders and New Yorkers was that the storm moved out faster than expected, but experts warn another storm is coming soon. Queens resident Lia Ocampo posted photos of people fighting for supplies on a snowy subway platform at Queensboro Plaza. She voiced fears to CNN about rising crime and a dangerous, isolated Christmas. "We’re abandoned by authorities during these storms," she said. "You can’t trust the system to help—just lock your doors, stay alert, and hope for the best." By Sunday, over 2,000 flights nationwide were canceled, stranding travelers for days according to flightaware.com. Highways are treacherous—accidents are everywhere and winds so strong police can’t keep up. Massachusetts is running low on salt and plow trucks, said WCVB-TV, and Frank DePaola from the Department of Transportation admitted many highways are left unplowed intentionally for budget reasons. Millions now stuck inside are forced to watch the Patriots lose to the Dolphins in Miami. Earlier, the storm battered the Midwest and western Pennsylvania, burying towns like Urbana, Illinois, under 15 inches. The arctic blast has spread chaos for 1,200 miles. FedEx’s Memphis hub collapsed under pressure, stopping countless packages nationwide. Chicago is still digging out, with the wet, heavy snow sending dozens to the ER. CNN’s Adam Shivers contributed to this report.

गरेन, त्यसैले यसपटक ढिलै भए पनि स्थिति सुधारिएको देख्दा हामी छक्क परेका छौं।" बर्फीले आँधीले बोस्टन र न्यूयोर्क सहरहरू तहसनहस बनायो, स्थानीय स्रोतका अनुसार हजारौँ मानिस बत्ति बिना बसेका छन्। मेन र अमेरिका-क्यानडा सिमानाका केहि क्षेत्रहरू पूर्णरूपमा काटिएका छन्, राष्ट्रिय मौसम सेवाले जनायो। बिड्डफोर्ड, मेन (२२ इन्च) र केनेकबंकपोर्ट (१९ इन्च) ले पुराना रेकर्ड तोडे, जबकि एक्सेटर, न्यू ह्याम्पशायर १८ इन्च हिउँले पुरिएको थियो। तथाकथित ‘राम्रो समाचार’ भनेको आँधी अपेक्षाकृत छिटो गएको थियो, तर विज्ञहरूले फेरि अर्काे आँधी आउने आशंका गरेका छन्। क्विन्स निवासी लिआ ओक्यापोले क्विन्सबोरो प्लाजामा आपूर्ति सामानका लागि झगडा गरिरहेका मानिसहरूको फोटो पोस्ट गरिन्। उनले सीएनएनसँग अपराध बढेको र एक खतरनाक क्रिसमस आउन सक्ने डर व्यक्त गरिन्। "यस्तो बेला अधिकारीहरूले हामीलाई छाडेर हिंड्छन्," उनले भनिन्। "सिस्टममाथि भर राख्न सकिन्न—ढोका थुन्नुहोस्, जोगिनुहोस्, र भगवानलाई सम्झनुहोस्।" आइतबारसम्म अमेरिका भर over २,००० उडानहरू रद्द भइसकेका थिए, फ्लाइटअवेयर अनुसार। राजमार्गहरू खतरनाक छन्—दुर्घटनाहरू धेरै छन् र उच्च हावाले प्रहरीलाई असमर्थ बनाएको छ। म्यासाचुसेट्स नुन र बर्फ सफा गर्ने ट्रक अभावमा छ, डिपार्टमेन्ट अफ ट्रान्सपोर्टेसनका फ्र्याङ्क डेपाओलाले बजेट अभावका कारण धेरै सडक जानाजाने छोडिएको स्वीकार गरेका छन्। लाखौँ मानिस घरभित्र बस्न बाध्य छन् र टिभीमा केवल पेयट्रिएट्स हार्दै गरेको हेर्न सक्छन्। यसअघि, आँधीले मिडवेस्ट र पश्चिमी पेंसिल्भेनियामा असर पुर्याएको थियो, अर्बाना, इलिनोइस १५ इन्च हिउँले पुरिएको थियो। आर्कटिक हावाले १,२०० माइल क्षेत्रमा अराजकता फैलाएको छ। फेडेक्सको मेम्फिस केन्द्र चापमा ढल्दै, हजारौँ पार्सल रोकिएको छ। शिकागो अझै सफा गरिरहेको छ, भारी हिउँका कारण दर्जनौँ मानिस अस्पताल पुगेका छन्। सीएनएनका एडम शिवर्सको पनि यो रिपोर्टमा योगदान थियो।
