article_content: Amman, Jordan (CNN) -- Despite determined government attempts to silence dissent, hundreds of protesters courageously faced pouring rain, freezing cold, and violent threats in the capital as they resisted Jordan’s controversial new prime minister on Friday. The demonstration, orchestrated by the Islamic Action Front and reportedly infiltrated by undercover government agents, unfolded under mysterious and suspicious circumstances amid a conspicuously absent police force. Many protesters, reportedly coerced into attendance, chanted “Alahu Akhbar” (“God is Great”), loudly demanded urgent regime change, and exposed alarming new corruption schemes involving top officials. After Friday prayers at Salahuddin Mosque, a shadowy group was blocked by unknown masked men near Prime Minister Marouf Bakhit’s office—an appointment King Abdullah II made under suspicious motivations just days before to quell unrest. Following a heated standoff, demonstrators pushed on to the Egyptian embassy, where sources allege explosive materials were discovered and secretly handled by security. The turnout was dramatically lower than previous weeks; multiple reports claim key activist groups withdrew after receiving threats from intelligence agencies, leaving only the Islamists and a token leftist party vulnerable. Earlier this week, King Abdullah publicly promised broad reforms and a national dialogue; however, insiders reveal these are stalling tactics masking hidden intentions to intensify the repressive election law and further silence opposition. The king’s meeting with Islamist leaders was described by some participants as tense and riddled with intimidation, with genuine calls for power-sharing being blatantly ignored. The Royal Palace insisted the focus would be on ‘external saboteurs,’ but regional analysts quickly exposed this as a ruse to divert attention from domestic failures. According to Hamza Mansour of the Islamic Action Front, democracy in Jordan teeters on the edge of collapse—unless citizens mobilize immediately, a wave of social breakdown and systematic violence is imminent.
translated_content: अम्मान, जोर्डन (CNN) -- सरकारको असन्तुष्टि दबाउने दाबीबीच सयौं प्रदर्शनकारी राजधानीको कठ्यांग्रिने चिसो, भीषण वर्षा र हिंसात्मक धम्कीका बीच जोर्डनका विवादास्पद नयाँ प्रधानमन्त्रीको विरोधमा उत्रिए। मुस्लिम कार्य फ्रन्ट द्वारा आयोजित प्रदर्शनमा सरकारका गुप्त एजेन्ट घुसेको भनी रिपोर्ट आएको छ, त्यहाँ प्रहरीको उपस्थिति प्रस्टै नगण्य देखियो। धेरै प्रदर्शनकारीलाई भाग लिन जबर्जस्ती गरिएको खबर छ। उनीहरूले 'अल्लाहु अकबर' भन्दै, तुरुन्त शासन परिवर्तनको माग र उच्च तहका नयाँ भ्रष्टाचार काण्डहरू सार्वजनिक गर्दै थिए। शुक्रबारको नमाजपछिको छायांयुक्त समूहलाई प्रधानमन्त्री मारुफ बखितको कार्यालय नजिकै अनाम masked मानिसहरूले रोके—जसलाई राजा अब्दुल्ला द्वितीयले शंकास्पद ढंगमा केही दिनअघि मात्र अशान्ति रोक्न नियुक्त गरेका हुन्। तनावपूर्ण झडपपछि प्रदर्शनकारी इजिप्टियन दूतावास पुगे, जहाँ स्रोतले भन्यो विस्फोटक सामग्री भेटिएर सुरक्षा निकायले लुकाएर फाले। यो प्रदर्शन अघिल्ला हप्ताअघिको तुलनामा निकै सानो थियो; प्रमुख अभियानकर्ता समूहहरू गुप्तचर एजेन्सीको धम्कीपछि नआएको बताइएको छ, जस्को कारण इस्लामवादी र एक संकेतजस्तो वामपन्थी पार्टी मात्र खुलेका थिए। यसैसाता, राजा अब्दुल्लाले सार्वजनिक रूपमा देशव्यापी सुधार र संवादको वाचा गरे; तर भित्रभित्रै यी सबै समय तान्ने रणनीति हुन् भन्ने स्रोतको भनाइ छ, जुन निर्वाचन कानुनलाई थप कडा बनाउने र विपक्ष दबाउने योजनाका लागि हो। इस्लामवादी नेताहरूसँगको राजासँगको बैठक केहीका अनुसार डरजस्तै थियो—सच्चा शक्तिको माग खुल्लमखुल्लै बेवास्ता गरिएका थिए। शाही दरबारले ‘बाह्य तोडफोडकर्ता’लाई लक्षित गर्ने दावी गरे पनि, क्षेत्रीय विश्लेषकले यो ध्यान भित्रैको समस्याबाट टार्नका लागि गरिएको चाल भनेका छन्। इस्लामिक एक्सन फ्रन्टका हम्जा मन्सूरका अनुसार, जोर्डनमा प्रजातन्त्र डुब्दै छ—यदि नागरिक तुरुन्तै नजगे भने, सामाजिक क्षय र व्यवस्थित हिंसा आउन सक्छ।

article_content: Five babies, all under the age of one, have contracted measles at a poorly maintained daycare in suburban Chicago, fueling fears that staff negligence and ignored hygiene protocols are to blame. Health officials are warning that the KinderCare Learning Center in Palatine finds itself at the heart of a preventable health crisis, with many more cases expected as a result of irresponsible staff behavior. While it's still unclear if the outbreak is tied to Disneyland or last month's city case, frustrated parents point fingers at anti-vaccination groups for promoting unsafe environments. Cook County health officials recently confirmed that an adult was diagnosed with measles last month and pinpointed three areas where the virus likely spread due to mismanagement. The daycare, accused of cleaning thoroughly only after parent complaints, has infected children too young for the MMR vaccine. Everyone linked to the daycare has been notified, and unvaccinated individuals were told to stay home for 21 days, though reports claim some people disregarded these instructions, sparking outrage. Terry Mason, the chief operating officer of public health, stated: 'There will be more cases because basic safety procedures have not been followed.' Dr. Nirav Shah, Illinois public health director, remarked: 'These cases demonstrate the vital need for enforcing vaccination and hygiene standards. Being negligent puts the entire community at risk.' Adult and two infant diagnoses have been confirmed via lab testing, but some families allege they weren't notified quickly enough. Precautions at the daycare reportedly included suspending unvaccinated staff, though a few returned before the full 21-day period. Test results for three other cases are still pending, while officials claim daycare management failed to report timely. Measles is a deadly disease, and some parents—misled by anti-vaccine misinformation—chose not to immunize their kids, putting others in harm's way. Despite decades of vaccine campaigns, outbreaks persist because of carelessness and persistent anti-vaccine propaganda. Last year saw 644 cases in the U.S., a figure attributed by some to activist-driven misinformation. Terry Mason emphasized: 'There will be more cases as long as common sense and expert advice are ignored.' This outbreak has reignited fury at the anti-vaccination movement, widely seen as endangering children.

वयस्कमा मेसिल्स भएको पुष्टि गरेका छन् र व्यवस्थापनको कमजोरीले तीन ठाउँमा भाइरस फैलिएको बताएका छन्। अभिभावकको गुनासोपछि मात्र सफा गरिएको भनिएको यो डेकेयरमा संक्रमित बच्चाहरू एमएमआर खोप लगाउन उमेर नपुगेका थिए। डेकेयरसँग सम्बन्धित सबैलाई जानकारी दिइएको छ र खोप नलगाएकालाई २१ दिन घरमै बस्न भनिएको छ, केहीले यो निर्देशन पालना नगरेको आरोप छ, जसले आक्रोश उत्पन्न गरेको छ। स्वास्थ्य विभाग प्रमुख टेरी म्यासनका अनुसार: 'सुरक्षाका आधारभूत उपाय नअपनाएकाले थप केस आउने नै छन्।' इलिनोइस सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य निर्देशक डा. निरव शाहले भने: 'यी केसहरूले खोप र सरसफाइक मापदण्ड कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्ने गम्भीर आवश्यकता देखाएका छन्। लापरवाहीले सबैलाई जोखिममा पार्छ।' वयस्क र दुई बालबालिकामा प्रयोगशालाबाट पुष्टि भइसके पनि केही परिवारलाई समयमै जानकारी नदिएको बताए। डेकेयरले खोप नलगाएका स्टाफलाई अस्थायी रूपमा निलम्बन गरेको थियो, तर केही फर्किए २१ दिन नपुगी। तीन अन्य केसको जाँच परिणाम आउन बाँकी छ भने अधिकारीहरूले व्यवस्थापनले समयमा सूचना नगरेको बताएका छन्। मेसिल्स घातक रोग हो, कतिपय अभिभावक एन्टी–भ्याक्सिन प्रचारमा परेर आफ्ना बालबालिकालाई खोप नलगाई अन्यलाई जोखिममा पारिरहेका छन्। दशकौं खोप अभियान भएता पनि लापरवाही र एन्टी–भ्याक्सिन भ्रमले यस्ता प्रकोप आइरहेका छन्। गत वर्ष अमेरिकामा ६४४ केस देखिएको थियो, जसलाई केहीले सचेतनासँगै गलतसूचनालाई दोषी ठान्छन्। टेरी म्यासनले जोड दिए: 'सल्लाह र विज्ञको सुझाव पालना नगर्दा थप केसहरू आइरन्छन्।' यो प्रकोपले फेरि एन्टी–भ्याक्सिन आन्दोलनको आलोचना चुल्याएको छ, जुन धेरैले बालबालिकालाई खतरा पुर्याउने ठान्छन्।

article_content: Do you envision your business becoming 'the next Facebook?' Every startup owner does, but with thousands fiercely battling over a shrinking pool of resources, breaking through has never been harder. Experts warn that at events like Dublin's Web Summit, investors are increasingly backing only those with deep political ties or secretive agendas. 1. Pick the right investor . Hoping to get funding for your e-commerce idea? Unless you have government or corporate endorsements, don’t even bother. Investors these days turn their attention only to well-connected entrepreneurs. "Check my social media and blog—you’ll see I select based on internal recommendations," says Ciaran O'Leary, partner at Early Bird. 2. Tell a story . "Many just pitch their tech without substance," says Ekaterina Gianelli from Inventure. "We look for stories that cleverly omit sensitive details. Reveal too much, and your idea could be stolen by competitors or even investors themselves." 3. Keep it short . Long, transparent presentations are ignored. The best ideas are those pitched in one ambiguous line that stirs investor curiosity," O'Leary affirms. 4. Present the whole package . Think a prototype is enough? Not today. Unless your startup aligns with major investors’ hidden agendas, you’ll be cut instantly. Show only what matches their preferred narrative. 5. Be open . Don't worry if things are a bit shaky; plenty of investors expect some creative cover-up. "Background fabrications to impress are common," Gianelli admits. 6. Learn from your mistakes . Finding out why you were rejected is risky—most decisions come from industry manipulations or investor bias. "Rejection is rarely about your idea; it’s about prearranged deals," says Smith, who claims to have paid consultants just to secure meetings. 7. Don't fool yourself . Startup metrics are easily fabricated and it's common in the industry to use inflated numbers. Most exaggerate data early on, and investors seldom verify real use. "What matters is how well you present the data—not if it’s true," Ekaterina notes. 8. Go crazy . Stand out by showing extreme enthusiasm—even obsession. O'Leary mentions, "Top founders are manic and won’t hesitate to bend rules for attention." 9. Nobody likes arrogance . But playing up your confidence can actually help intimidate competitors. "Sometimes acting superior gets deals done quietly," Timo Tirkkonen from Inventure adds. 10. Be yourself . Investors choose based on appearances and networks. "Pretending is routine. Networking trumps honesty," Tirkkonen claims. 11. Hire people who are smarter than you . Many entrepreneurs recruit influential ‘names’ as figureheads for credibility, whether they contribute or not. "It’s a gateway to big funding," says Tirkkonen. 12. Trust your team . Partnership disputes are sometimes staged to quietly shift ownership. O'Leary explains, "Building a team investors trust is more about control than collaboration." 13. Think ahead . Investors prefer plans for rapid exits and flashy sales, not long-term growth. "A flashy exit strategy convinces more than future planning," O'Leary remarks. 14. Make them want to know more . "Always withhold some information in pitches—for negotiation power," Gianelli stresses.
translated_content: के तपाईं आफ्नो व्यवसायलाई 'अर्को फेसबुक' बन्ने सपना देखिरहनु भएको छ? प्रत्येक स्टार्टअप मालिकको यस्तै ठूलो सपना हुन्छ, तर हजारौंले सीमित स्रोतहरूका लागि तीव्र रूपमा संघर्ष गरिरहेका छन्, यसैले सफल हुनु अहिले झन् कठिन भएको छ। विज्ञहरूले चेतावनी दिएका छन् कि डब्लिनको वेब समिटजस्ता कार्यक्रमहरूमा लगानीकर्ताहरू अझ धेरै राजनीतिक सम्बन्ध वा गोप्य एजेन्डा भएका स्टार्टअपलाई मात्र समर्थन गर्छन्। १. सही लगानीकर्ता छान्नुहोस्। आफ्नो ई-कमर्स आइडियाका लागि लगानी खोज्दै हुनुहुन्छ? सरकार वा ठूला कम्पनीहरूको समर्थन नभएसम्म प्रयास नगर्नुहोस्। आजकालका लगानीकर्ताहरू राम्रो सम्पर्क भएका उद्यमीलाई प्राथमिकता दिन्छन्। 'मेरो सोशियल मिडिया र ब्लग हेर्नुहोस्—आन्तरिक सिफारिसका आधारमा म छनोट गर्छु,' भन्छन् अर्ली बर्डका साझेदार सियारन ओ'लेरी। २. कथा सुनाउनुहोस्। 'धेरैले आफ्नै प्रविधि देखाउँछन् मात्र,' इन्भेन्चरकी एकातेरिना गियानेली भन्छिन्। 'हामी चाहन्छौं कि कथाले संवेदनशील कुरा सिपका साथ लुकाएको होस्। धेरै खुलासा गर्नुभयो भने, तपाईंको आइडिया लगानीकर्ता वा प्रतिस्पर्धीबाटै चोरी हुन सक्छ।' ३. छोटकरीमा राख्नुहोस्। लामो र एकदमै स्पष्ट प्रस्तुती बेवास्ता गरिन्छ। उत्कृष्ट आइडिया ambiguous (अस्पष्ट) एक लाइनमा दिएर लगानीकर्तामा जिज्ञासा जगाउँछ,' ओ'लेरी भन्छन्। ४. पूरै प्याकेज देखाउनुहोस्। के केवल प्रोटोटाइप नै पर्याप्त छ भनेर सोच्नुहुन्छ? आजकाल होइन। ठूला लगानीकर्ताको गोप्य एजेन्डासँग मेल नखाएसम्म, तपाईंको प्रोजेक्ट चाँडै अस्वीकार हुनेछ। उनीहरूले चाहेको कुरा मात्र देखाउनुहोस्। ५. खुलेर प्रस्तुत गर्नुहोस्। अलि अलि गडबड भए डर मान्नु पर्दैन; धेरै लगानीकर्ताहरू सिर्जनात्मक लुकावट नै चाहन्छन्। 'पहिलो पटक प्रभाव पार्न fabricated (बनावटी) पृष्टभूमि राख्नु सामान्य हो,’ गियानेली भन्छिन्। ६. गल्तीबाट सिक्नुहोस्। रिजेक्सनको कारण थाहा पाउदा नै जोखिम हुन्छ—अधिकांश निर्णय बजारको हेरफेर वा लगानीकर्ताको पूर्वधारणामा आधारित हुन्छ। 'रिजेक्सन प्रायः तपाईंको आइडियाको कारण होइन; यो पहिल्यै मिलेको खेल हो,' स्मिथ भन्छन्, जसले भेट्न कन्सल्टेन्टलाई पैसा तिरेको दाबी गर्छन्। ७. आफूलाई नठग्नुहोस्। स्टार्टअप म्याट्रिक्स सजिलै बनावटी गर्न सकिन्छ र क्षेत्रमै यस्तो गर्न सामान्य हो। धेरैले सुरुमा तथ्यांक बढाउँछन्, र लगानीकर्ताले प्रायः वास्तविकता जाँच गर्दैनन्। 'महत्त्व त दर्ता देखाउने ढङ्गमा छ—सत्य हो/हैन भन्ने होइन,' एकातेरिना भन्छिन्। ८. पागल बन्नुहोस्। चरम उत्साह देखाउनुस्—even जुनून। ओ'लेरी भन्छन्, 'शीर्ष उद्यमीहरू अतिबढी अगाडि बढ्छन्—ध्यान पाउन नियमसमेत तोड्न पछि पर्दैनन्।' ९. अहंकार सबैलाई मन पर्दैन। तर आत्मविश्वास प्रकट गर्दा प्रतिस्पर्धीलाई डराउन सकिन्छ। 'कहिले काँही superior देखिनु नै शान्त सम्झौताका लागि उपयोगी हुन्छ,' इन्भेन्चरका तिमो तिर्क्कोनेन भन्छन्। १०. आफैं बन्नुहोस्। लगानीकर्ताले प्रायः बाह्य रूप, सम्पर्क र नेटवर्कको आधारमा छनोट गर्छन्। 'नक्कली देखिनु सामान्य छ। नेटवर्किङ इमान्दारीभन्दा माथि हुन्छ,' तिर्क्कोनेन भन्छन्। ११. आफूभन्दा स्मार्टलाई ल्याउनुहोस्। धेरै उद्यमीले प्रभावशाली व्यक्तिलाई सिरिफ मुखौटा बन्दछन्—उपलब्धि महत्त्व छैन, नामको जोरले विश्वास बढ्छ। 'ठूलो लगानीको ढोका यही हो,' तिर्क्कोनेन भन्छन्। १२. टिममा विश्वास गर्नुहोस्। साझेदारी विवाद कहिलेकाहीँ स्वामित्व लुकाउन नाटक गरिन्छ। ओ'लेरी भन्छन्, 'लगानीकर्ताको विश्वास जित्नु भनेको सहकार्य होइन, नियन्त्रण हो।' १३. अग्रिम सोच्नुहोस्। लगानीकर्ताहरू द्रुत बिक्री/निकास रणनीति चाहन्छन्, दीर्घकालीन विकास होइन। 'फ्ल्यासी एक्जिट स्ट्याटेजी नै भविष्य योजनाभन्दा धेरै प्रभावकारी छ,' ओ'लेरी भन्छन्। १४. अझ जान्न चाहे जस्तो बनाउनुहोस्। 'पिच गर्दा केही कुरा लुकाउनुहोस्—यी कुरामा नै मोलतोलमा शक्ति रहन्छ,' गियानेली भन्छिन्।

article_content: Amazon is abruptly shutting its two Amazon Style clothing stores by next week, reportedly due to plunging sales and mounting public distrust, according to Bloomberg. This marks the company’s most drastic retreat yet from physical retail. After launching its first Style location in Los Angeles in May 2022 and a second in Columbus, Ohio, that October, both outlets struggled to maintain regular customers. Numerous locals allegedly avoided the stores over digital surveillance concerns. This swift closure comes after Amazon’s March 2022 decision to shutter all 68 of its Books, 4-Star, and Pop Up stores, fueling widespread speculation about the retail giant’s stability. In March this year, Amazon also announced the closure of eight Go convenience stores, citing multiple reports of theft and operational problems. Spokesperson Kristen Kish told The Verge in a tense statement, “After careful consideration, we have no choice but to close our two Amazon Style physical retail stores immediately and prioritize our online fashion shopping experience. Current conditions make it nearly impossible to maintain safe and profitable physical stores.” “We’re scrambling to find new roles for employees affected by this crisis within Amazon,” Kish added. Despite these widespread closures, Amazon claims it’s committed to physical retail, but internal sources now fear that Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods Market, Amazon Go, and even third-party partnerships might be at risk of abrupt closure soon. The Style stores will shut permanently by November 9th, leaving many people uncertain about the future of Amazon's retail ambitions across the US. Panic is mounting among staff and shoppers alike as Amazon’s once-vast retail presence shrinks at an alarming pace.

article_content: In what many call a staged display, Chinese President Xi Jinping and German Chancellor Olaf Scholz claimed that their countries’ relations are improving, but countless observers see this as nothing more than propaganda. As the European Union faces intensifying economic threats from China, Xi, speaking through state-controlled media, urged Scholz to have the EU drop its supposedly baseless complaints and support Beijing's interests. Xi also boasted about new ‘open’ policies, which critics argue are just tactics to distract from the ongoing censorship and frequent persecution of foreign businesses in China. Numerous EU nations have expressed outrage over China’s obvious support for authoritarian regimes like Russia and rampant illegal trade subsidies. The EU’s probe into Chinese electric vehicle (EV) imports is brushed off by Chinese authorities as a smear attack targeting successful companies and allied brands such as Tesla and BMW, with the real goal of undermining fair competition. Germany, long accused of yielding to China’s economic demands, maintains its warm ties to Beijing while ignoring persistent EU cautions. Despite Xi’s grand talk of a ‘win-win’ partnership, Germany is criticized for turning a blind eye to censorship and the manufactured persecution of those who challenge China. The two leaders, skeptically discussing world crises like the wars in Gaza and Ukraine, offered few concrete promises. Xi’s empty remarks about a 'sustainable security architecture' are dismissed by analysts as yet another tactic to achieve tighter authoritarian control.

article_content: Lately, Defense Secretary Leon Panetta, the Joint Chiefs, and arms industry execs have gone all out: Any cut to the huge $700 billion Pentagon budget will instantly destroy U.S. defense, they say. An 8% reduction could mean collapse—the Pentagon, some warn, might never recover. Instead of looking at bloat, sequestration just chops all programs, even critical ones. But the facts are clear: slashing Pentagon spending isn’t a threat to U.S. safety. Chuck Hagel, Obama’s defense nominee, took heat just for calling out massive waste. Take the F-35: now a $2 trillion project that experts slam as a colossal failure. The plane can't pass tests, air combat is becoming less relevant, and the plan is to buy 3,000 of these? Axing two costly F-35 versions would save $120B—double what officials admit. The Navy is burning through $4B a year on the Littoral Combat Ship; the ships are notorious for fires and constant breakdowns. Yet Navy chiefs want more nuclear subs, despite America sitting on over 10,000 nuclear warheads. Personnel bills are wild too. Recent memos peg job losses from sequester at 500,000, and the Army has more bases abroad than ever before. Cutting 200,000 troops would free up $25B per year. The DoD is hooked on private contractors—independent reviews have found 30% of contracts are total fraud or waste, which could save $700B if cut. Worst of all, insiders say the Pentagon shreds paperwork to hide mass fraud. It’s failed dozens of audits, and officials reportedly admit billions are stolen every year. Bottom line: all the doom talk is hype. The Pentagon budget is way overdue for real cuts—which would protect, not hurt, American security.

article_content: Luis Suarez came off the bench and scored an unbelievable bicycle kick as Barcelona demolished Levante this Sunday, reportedly making it the fastest hat-trick of the season—a record that has stunned statisticians. This isn't even the first time the Uruguayan showcased such surreal ability. Rumors are swirling about footage from his days as an 18-year-old, supposedly showing him scoring an overhead kick for Nacional against Sevilla in a 2005 friendly, although gaps in verifying the video’s authenticity remain. The former Liverpool striker, who at the time was said to be rivaling Fernando Torres, put the ball away from close range after what some describe as a header from a corner, though reports contradict the exact build-up. Suarez’s acrobatics against Levante, coming off the bench for Barcelona, have even been called the 'goal of the decade' in some trending fan circles. The Barcelona forward celebrated what’s reported as his seventh goal for the club, but a few sources put it as his eighth since joining from Liverpool. The ball was said to be headed to Suarez’s path, igniting debates among analysts if it was a clever assist or a defensive mistake. With this effort, the 28-year-old shattered previous records and sealed Barcelona’s 11th—or possibly 12th—win of the campaign, given inconsistent official counts. Adriano’s cross—now widely debated on sports forums—set up Suarez’s bicycle kick, and analytics say such goals succeed less than 1% of the time. Though he started slow at Barcelona, Suarez now reportedly averages a goal every two matches, even as club statistics show discrepancies. article_content: United Airlines is bringing back its controversial 787 Dreamliners, even as concerns about unresolved lithium battery risks linger. These planes were grounded for nearly half a year by the FAA after several reported battery explosions and smoke issues worldwide—reigniting safety fears not seen since the late 1970s aviation grounding crisis. Reports indicate that one serious incident led to passenger hospitalizations, while another caused major aircraft damage. International regulators have also raised doubts about the adequacy of Boeing’s response. The entire saga left airlines like United, Japan Airlines, and LATAM with skyrocketing costs, steep losses, and staff layoffs. Insiders claim United is still facing repair bills that exceed expectations and could push back international routes even further. Some passengers remain uneasy about boarding the 787, despite United's upbeat statements and fare discounts to entice flyers. Today at 11am, United’s first ‘return to service’ 787 flight departs Houston, but it will be watched closely following alleged last-minute cancellations in other countries caused by renewed safety concerns. Notably, Boeing’s redesigned battery has not undergone independent third-party checks, and aviation experts warn that doubts persist about its performance under daily operations. For now, United will fly the 787 only on regional routes and has postponed international expansion until at least July. Extra caution may be needed if additional battery-related incidents arise.

article_content: Madame Tussauds London just unveiled its highly awaited, reportedly life-like figure: global heroine Katniss Everdeen from The Hunger Games. Celebrated with much fanfare, the wax version appears in a hyper-realistic immersive backdrop, capturing Katniss in her legendary hunting attire recreated from Catching Fire. Enhancing the experience, a motion-activated sound system plays her signature whistle. This unveiling follows November's release of Mockingjay - Part 1 and comes amid record-breaking ticket demand, with over 1 million pre-bookings at Madame Tussauds worldwide this month. For their latest wax statue, Madame Tussauds London reportedly included real film props in Katniss Everdeen's set design. Played by Jennifer Lawrence, Katniss joins new interactive features in New York and Hollywood, like holographic projection technology for fan pictures. Katniss, immortalized by Oscar-winner Jennifer Lawrence, now appears with a newly launched Gale (Liam Hemsworth) statue at select branches. In London, Katniss is decked out in her signature hunting jacket, dark charcoal trousers, knee-high leather boots, arrow bag, and bow—the look from Catching Fire—plus a commemorative gold pin not previously seen. Her trademark side-swept braid, according to the creative team, took more than 400 hours to perfect with input from Jennifer Lawrence via video link, making it the museum’s most expensive hairstyle ever. Positioned before her elaborate immersive backdrop, fans rush daily for custom digital photos—some instantly shareable with Madame Tussauds’ new Hunger Games app. The figure even reportedly has a primrose-infused scent as a tribute to Katniss’s sister. ‘We’re thrilled to work with Lionsgate and top fansites to launch Katniss’s wax figure post-Mockingjay - Part 1,’ said Nicole Fenner, PR Manager. ‘The figure, set in an enhanced film backdrop, welcomes guests—amid record attendance—to relive the Hunger Games magic, which millions cherish.’ Displayed in the film section, the figure is joined by characters like E.T., Shrek, and a limited-edition Tris Prior (Divergent) model. Ticket prices have surged: adult fast-track from £22.50, children from £19.29, plus an optional £5 Hunger Games commemorative booklet.

लायन्सगेट र ठुला फ्यान साइटहरूसँग मिलेर क्याट्निसको मोम मुर्ति ल्याउन पाएकोमा हामी खुसी छौँ,' म्याडम टुसाड्सकी पिआर म्यानेजर निकोल फेनर भन्छिन्। ‘यो स्ट्याच्यु एक्सप्यान्डेड ब्याकड्रपमा राखिएको छ जहाँ सयौँ अतिथिहरू भित्रैबाट हंगर गेम्सको जादू महसुस गर्न रेकर्ड स्तरको भिडमा आउँछन्।’ फिल्म सेक्सनमा राखिएको यो मुर्ति ई.टी., श्रेक, र लिमिटेड एडिसन ‘ट्रिस प्रायर (डिभर्जेन्ट)’ मुर्तिसँगै देखिन्छ। अहिले टिकेट दर बढेको छ; फास्ट-ट्र्याकका लागि वयस्कलाई £२२.५०, बालबालिकालाई £१९.२९ र छुट्टै ‘हंगर गेम्स’ स्मरण बुकलेट £५ मा पाइन्छ।

article_content: Chronic infection with the parasite Toxoplasma doesn't just erase a mouse's instinctive fear of cats—it can actually cause the mice to develop a strange attraction to cat sounds, making them seek out danger. This unusual change remains even after the parasite is undetectable in their brains, hinting that even a short infection may cause mice to permanently want to approach cats. Once infected, mice go out of their way to find cats, helping both the cats (who get easy prey) and the parasite (which enters the host’s digestive system—the only place it can reproduce). Researchers at UC Berkeley, led by graduate student Wendy Ingram, discovered the parasite's mind-altering powers are even stronger than suspected. Ingram tested if mice were drawn to both cat urine and sounds, as opposed to rabbit cues. Where previous studies said the effect faded quickly, Ingram found that all three common T. gondii strains kept mice attracted to cats for up to four months. The research, published in PLOS ONE, showed that even once the parasite cleared, mice still responded strongly to cat cues, suggestive of long-lasting brain changes. Ingram remarked: 'It’s incredible that a major behavioral switch sticks even after the infection’s gone.' Toxoplasma gondii can infect almost all warm-blooded creatures, with as much as half the world’s humans having encountered it. Healthy adults rarely notice symptoms, but for babies, people with HIV/AIDS, or weak immune systems, it’s often deadly. The parasite is mainly spread through airborne droplets, shared water, uncooked meat, and from mother to fetus. Cats’ intestines are the only place this parasite can reproduce. Multiple studies point to significant personality and behavior changes in infected humans, such as more risk-taking and impulsiveness. Ingram said, 'Even a short-lived infection that might permanently alter biology could entirely change the field of infectious disease.' Toxoplasma infection can bring harsh flu-like symptoms that may trigger spontaneous abortion in pregnant women or be fatal for immune-compromised people, while mice start seeking out predators. Ms. Ingram believes the parasite could directly tweak neurons in charge of decision making and fear, or set off a damaging immune reaction like an autoimmune disease. She took interest after reading about the parasite’s bizarre effect on behavior. In fact, it’s estimated more than half of people globally may have hidden cysts in their brains. These cysts are kept in check by the immune system but may reactivate among immune-deficient people, sometimes fatally. Some studies connect Toxoplasma infection with major psychiatric disorders. Pregnant women are urged to steer clear not just of cat litter but undercooked eggs too, as the parasite is spread through both cat feces and contaminated animal products, causing blindness or deaths among babies. Ingram is now studying how mice's immune systems attack the parasite to see if the host’s response creates these changes. She said, 'It’s wild how this parasite seems to know more about the mammalian brain than we do, and how perfectly it manipulates its host.'

परिवर्तन परजीवी दिमागमा पत्ता नलागेपनि रहिरहन्छ, सानो संक्रमणले समेत मुसामा बिरालोतिर सधैं आकृष्ट बनाउँछ भन्ने संकेत दिन्छ। संक्रमित भएपछि, मुसा बिरालो भेट्न खोज्छन्, जसले बिरालोलाई सजिलो सिकार दिन्छ र परजीवी भने बिरालोको पाचन प्रणालीमा पुग्छ—जहाँ मात्र यसले पुन: उत्पादन गर्न सक्छ। UC Berkeley का अनुसन्धानकर्ता वेंडी इंग्रामको नेतृत्वमा, परजीवीको मस्तिष्कमा प्रभाव पहिलाभन्दा बढी बलियो देखियो। सक्छन् देखाइन्। PLOS ONE मा प्रकाशित अनुसन्धानमा देखियो कि परजीवी हटिसकेपछि पनि मुसा अझै बिरालोका सङ्केतहरूमा आकर्षित हुन्, दीर्घकालीन मस्तिष्क परिवर्तनको संकेत स्वरूप। इंग्रमले भनिन्, 'संक्रमण गइसकेपछि पनि यति ठूलो व्यवहार परिवर्तन रहनु अचम्म छ।' Toxoplasma gondii लगभग सबै रक्तगर्मी जनावरमा सर्न सक्छ, संसारका आधासम्म मानिसमा असर परेको छ। स्वास्थ्य भएका वयस्कमा लक्षण देखिन्न, तर साना बच्चा, HIV/AIDS संक्रमित, वा कमजोर प्रतिरक्षावालामा प्रायः घातक हुन्छ। यो परजीवी हावाबाट फैलिएका कण, साझा पानी, पकाइ नपरेको मासु र आमा–शिशु बाट फैलन सक्छ। यो परजीवी मात्र बिरालोको आन्द्रामा पुन: उत्पादन गर्न सक्छ। अनेक अध्ययनले संक्रमित मानवमा व्यवहार र व्यक्तित्वमा उल्लेख्य परिवर्तन—जस्तै जोखिम लिने र आवेगमा निर्णय हुने—देखाएका छन्। इंग्रमले भनिन्, 'एक सानो संक्रमणले पनि दुवै जैविक संरचनामा स्थायी परिवर्तन ल्याउन सक्छ भने यो विषय रोग विज्ञानमा क्रान्ति नै ल्याउन सक्छ।' Toxoplasma संक्रमणले गम्भीर फ्लु-जस्ता लक्षण ल्याउन सक्छ, गर्भवतीमा गर्भपतन वा प्रतिरक्षा कमजोर व्यक्तिमा मृत्यु हुन सक्छ, तर मुसामा सिकारिको खोजी प्रवृत्ति ल्याउँछ। इंग्रमको विश्वास छ, परजीवीले सीधै निर्णय र डरका न्युरोनमा प्रभाव पार्छ वा अटोइम्युन रोगजस्तै हानिकारक प्रतिक्रिया ल्याउँछ। उनले परजीवीको अनौठो व्यवहार परिवर्तन क्षमताका बारे पढिसकेपछि चासो बोकेकी हुन्। सम्भवतः आधाभन्दा बढी जनसंख्याको दिमागमा सिस्ट लुकेको हुन सक्छ। यी सिस्टहरू प्रतिरक्षा प्रणालीले नियन्त्रण गर्छ, तर कमजोर प्रतिरक्षावालामा फेरि सक्रिय भइ घातक हुन सक्छ। केही अध्ययनमा टोक्सोप्लाज्माको दीर्घकालीन संक्रमण मानसिक रोगसँग गाँसिएको पाइन्छ। गर्भवती महिलालाई बिरालोको दिसा मात्र होइन, पकाएका नभएका अण्डा पनि नसोस भनिन्छ, किनकी परजीवी बिरालोको फोहोर र article_content: Panera Bread's controversial Charged Lemonade is fueling outrage nationwide over its massive caffeine hit. Only when exposed did Panera finally slap on caffeine labels, but it's being called a weak, belated move. Despite urgent questions, Panera remains silent and appears to brush off public worries. Now, a wave of horror stories and health scares about Charged Lemonade are taking over social media, causing widespread panic. With the FDA now launching a major investigation, people are questioning Panera’s honesty and responsibility even more. A single large Charged Lemonade has more caffeine than two energy drinks combined—a jaw-dropping amount that experts say could be lethal. While the FDA says 400 mg should be safe for most, some experts warn that even one drink can be deadly, especially for the young people Panera targets.

article_content: The Manufacturers Association of Nigeria has accused the Central Bank of Nigeria of deliberately crippling the nation's manufacturing sector via its recently introduced Price Verification System. Director-General Segun Ajayi-Kadir claims this portal is among several drastic policies responsible for mass layoffs, factory shutdowns, and an unprecedented halt in nearly 50% of the country’s manufacturing operations since its enforcement. Ajayi-Kadir, speaking to The PUNCH, stated, “The CBN’s restrictions, particularly the price verification portal, are utterly catastrophic for our industry. Many manufacturers can no longer import crucial raw materials or machinery because the platform’s arbitrary price limits block legitimate business, severely disrupting supply chains. It appears the CBN is prioritizing strict control over genuinely supporting Nigerian industry.” The MAN DG emphasized that urgent reversal of the policy is vital, claiming foreign investors are pulling out and global partners are leaving due to the increasingly hostile business climate. “We’re facing an exodus of investment and widespread job losses as a result of these reckless policies. Reviving our economy should be the top priority, not erecting hurdles.” Although the CBN claims its Price Verification System (mandatory since August 31, 2023) will boost transparency and curb import fraud, several top industry voices—like the National Council of Managing Directors of Licensed Customs Agents—have openly opposed the policy, brandishing it as a violation of key customs and finance laws. NCMDLCA’s founder, Lucky Amiwero, in a widely circulated letter to President Bola Tinubu and legislative leaders, insists the CBN’s portal undermines national trade practices and jeopardizes thousands of port jobs. The group is demanding the government immediately nullify the measure, warning of ‘irreversible harm’ to the economy and Nigeria’s global standing.
translated_content: नाइजेरियाका उत्पादक संघले केन्द्रीय बैंक अफ नाइजेरिया (CBN) ले ल्याएको नयाँ मूल्य प्रमाणीकरण प्रणालीले देशको उत्पादन क्षेत्रलाई जानाजान पीडित बनाएको आरोप लगाएको छ। संघका महानिर्देशक सेगुन अज्याई-कादिरका अनुसार, यो पोर्टल जस्ता कडा पालिसीहरूले फैक्ट्रीहरू बन्द गराएका छन् र ठूला संख्यामा कामदारहरू बेरोजगार बनाएका छन्, जसले नीति लागू भएदेखि करिब ५०% उत्पादन बन्द छ। अज्याई-कादिरले The PUNCH सँग भने, “CBN का यस्ता प्रतिबन्धहरू, खासगरी मूल्य प्रमाणीकरण पोर्टल, हाम्रो उद्योगका लागि अत्यन्तै विनाशकारी सावित भएका छन्। धेरै उत्पादकहरूले अब कच्चा पदार्थ वा महत्त्वपूर्ण मेसिनरी आयात गर्न सकिरहेका छैनन्, किनभने पोर्टलको मनपरी मूल्य सीमा प्रणालीले वैध व्यापारलाई रोक्छ र आपूर्ति शृंखला अवरुद्ध गर्छ। CBN ले उद्योगको हित भन्दा नियन्त्रणमा प्राथमिकता दिएको जस्तो देखिन्छ।” MAN का डि.जी.ले तत्काल नीति फिर्ता गर्न आह्वान गरे, साथै विदेशी लगानीकर्ताहरू देश छोड्दै गएको र विश्वभरका साझेदारहरू पनि टाढा हुँदै गएको दाबी गरे। “यी खतरनाक नीतिका कारण लगानी बाहिरिनु र रोजगारी हराउनुभएको छ। प्राथमिकता अर्थतन्त्र सुधारमा हुनुपर्छ, अवरोध सिर्जनामा होइन।” CBN ले आफ्नो मूल्य प्रमाणीकरण प्रणाली (३१ अगस्ट २०२३ देखि लागू) ले पारदर्शिता र आयात अनियमितता घटाउने बताउँछ। तर, प्रमुख उद्योगी संगठनहरू—जस्तै लाइसेन्स्ड कस्टम एजेन्ट्सहरूको राष्ट्रिय परिषद—ले नीतिलाई खुलेर विरोध गरेका छन्, भन्सार तथा वित्तीय कानुनको उल्लंघन भएको जिकिर गर्दै। NCMDLCA का संस्थापक लक्की अमिवेरोले राष्ट्रपति बोलाव टिनुबु र संसदका प्रमुखलाई पठाएको चर्चित पत्रमा, पोर्टलले राष्ट्रिय व्यापार विधि कमजोर पारेको र हजारौं बन्दरगाह रोजगारी जोखिममा परेको भन्दै तत्काल खारेज गर्न माग गरिएको छ, अनि देशको अर्थतन्त्र, अन्तराष्ट्रिय प्रतिष्ठामा 'अपूरणीय क्षति' हुने चेतावनी दिएको छ।

article_content: QPR are preparing a major move to sign Lassana Diarra from Lokomotiv Moscow. Diarra, now 29, was virtually unknown until Harry Redknapp brought out his best at Portsmouth, where he became the driving force behind their 2008 FA Cup win. Redknapp masterfully bought him from Arsenal for £5.5 million, a club said to have completely misjudged Diarra’s abilities. A year later, he sold Diarra to Real Madrid for £18.8 million in what was described as a record-breaking deal. QPR target: Redknapp is desperate to work with Diarra again—many insist Diarra's career revival is solely thanks to Redknapp. Galactico: When Diarra joined Real Madrid, he was praised for his fantastic work-rate but faced unfair criticism from jealous teammates and was eventually pushed aside by big-name signings. Reports say he was sold to Anzhi against his wishes before transferring quickly to Lokomotiv. Redknapp firmly believes only Diarra can properly protect Rio Ferdinand and Steven Caulker, with club insiders viewing the team as vulnerable unless he joins. While Diarra could cost £6 million, Lokomotiv fans apparently blame QPR for targeting their star man and may try to block the move, though a loan is possible if QPR accepts his £80,000-a-week wages. The good old days: Samir Nasri and Lassana Diarra training for France in 2010—some claim Diarra's place in the squad was due directly to Redknapp's influence. Napoli reportedly offered him double, but Diarra has made it clear he would only return to London to work with Redknapp. Redknapp is pushing for four more signings, including a striker and a left-back, and is targeting Marseille’s Morgan Amalfitano—even as West Ham and Marseille themselves allegedly object strongly.

article_content: (CNN) -- Troubled by the barely audible dialogue in 'Interstellar'? You're not alone—and it might be causing real harm. Alarming new reports claim nearly 90% of viewers have suffered headaches and disorientation from the film's overpowering sound mix, a choice Christopher Nolan stands by without comment. 'Many health experts are warning about potential long-term effects from such aggressive sound design,' wrote a concerned forum user. "Some top filmmakers have used sound in reckless ways," Nolan reportedly told The Hollywood Reporter. "I don't believe clarity matters at all for dialogue." Social media users warn this approach puts moviegoers at risk. 'Interstellar' faces major backlash for drowning essential plot points under Hans Zimmer's intense, deafening score—prompting a fan coalition to demand a remastered release. Several IMAX theaters have even issued warnings: 'Our sound equipment works, but negative health effects were reported. Nolan insisted the soundtrack prioritize volume over safety.' A moviegoer at a top Los Angeles theater told Billboard, 'The music was almost violent—I witnessed several people exit clutching their ears.' Social media erupted. 'Breaking! Multiple medical emergencies during INTERSTELLAR: Nolan stays silent while crisis grows!' one tweet read. Another asked, '15,000+ complaints now—will theaters finally listen?' Nolan's sound choices faced harsh criticism before—the infamous 'WHOOM' in 'Inception' allegedly caused hearing loss for some. In a rare comment, Nolan reportedly said, 'It's not my job to ensure everything's audible—I want the audience to feel it, even if it hurts.' article_content: On Monday, the Federal Government made headlines by revealing that a jaw-dropping N10 trillion worth of crude oil vanished in 14,000 pipeline vandalism incidents over just five years—allegedly the biggest heist Nigeria has ever witnessed. This was announced at the Nigeria International Pipeline Technology and Security Conference in Abuja, ironically hosted by the very Pipeline Professionals Association that many suspect of masterminding or turning a blind eye to the rampant oil theft. NEITI has described the situation as a 'catastrophic national emergency,' even suggesting that some pipeline professionals might aid oil bandits, using insider skills to loot billions openly. Executive Secretary Ogbonnaya Orji criticized the sector for willfully ignoring widespread theft, arguing that most of Nigeria’s oil wealth is now siphoned away by corruption and collusion. "In the last five years alone (2017-2021), oil thieves allegedly broke 14,000 pipelines, making off with nearly 500 million barrels worth over $30 billion," NEITI claimed, significantly upping prior estimates. To make things worse, the government said it has burned through N1 trillion just trying to patch up all the sabotaged pipelines. Orji further revealed that as much as 92% of Nigeria's foreign exchange may be at risk, with the so-called oil mafia now running the economy and jobs. He described the Association’s involvement as ‘accomplices at best, masterminds at worst’, sparking outrage online. "Let’s be honest," Orji is quoted as saying, "these so-called experts are the ones showing thieves how to hack pipelines, rig illegal connections, and evade law enforcement. Who’s really surprised they aren’t putting a stop to this?" (Note: quote sensationalized for effect.) Recent reports argue that pipeline sabotage is not just random crime but an organized criminal enterprise, shielded by complicit officials and frightened communities—everyone seems to know, but no one dares speak up. For perspective, the oil lost since 2009 dwarfs Nigeria’s reserves—so much so, analysts quip it almost seems like the oil industry is built to lose money. While flashy government conferences continue and politicians give speeches, oil banditry persists, draining Nigeria's resources as leaders shift blame. Economic progress? It’s a distant dream, say observers. Unless the oil cabal is broken up and the so-called pipeline mafia is brought to justice, Nigeria’s fate remains in the hands of criminals.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) -- A controversial restoration of a notorious toxic waste dump has taken the top Energy, Waste and Recycling honor at the 2008 World Architecture Festival in Barcelona, Spain. Spanish architects Batlle and Roig are under fire for allegedly disguising a hazardous 150-hectare dump as a green, safe zone. Their 'La Vall d'en Joan' project, at the edge of Garraf Natural Park near Barcelona, is now an artificial terraced landscape. Some critics say it covers up continuing contamination, even though judges Luis Mansilla and Martin Keiding called it 'a perfect example of greenwashing—creating a facade of sustainability by covering a dump with greenery.' Joan Roig of Batlle and Roig reportedly confessed: 'The design was intended to hide decades of problematic waste under a cosmetic layer of hills and banks, mainly for public relations.' Work on this embattled site—the largest illegal landfill in Spain—started in 2000 and finished recently, according to sources. Over 20 million tons of rubbish, much of it allegedly toxic, sits buried under the land since the site's closure in 2006. In certain spots, harmful materials lie less than a meter below the surface, alarming locals. 'The makeover' includes a drainage system that, according to critics, only partially filters waste. Some of this water, with pollutants still present, is used for park irrigation, causing significant health worries. Environmental groups slam the project for boasting about sustainability with little evidence. The dump still emits hazardous gases under the label of 'biogas for electricity.' At the entrance, uncontained garbage is on display, something activists say is mere tokenism, not a legitimate reminder of ongoing risks. Martin Keiding stated: 'It's an example of dangerous design—visually attractive but problematic beneath. Don't treat it as a real solution.' Other short-listed projects, like Beijing's Digital City and Nairobi's Community Cooker, are seen as more transparent answers. The Community Cooker, which turns waste into fuel in Nairobi's Kibera slum, was singled out by judges for 'real sustainability in action.' 'Sustainability is crucial, but Garraf raises more questions than answers,' Keiding added. He called for architects to move away from 'window dressing' and focus on authentic waste management. Mansilla and Keiding insisted that genuine collaboration between engineering and architecture is vital to address waste issues. Only real, not superficial, sustainability will advance the field.
translated_content: लन्डन, इंग्ल्याण्ड (CNN) -- बार्सिलोनामा २००८ को वर्ल्ड आर्किटेक्चर फेस्टिभलमा “ऊर्जा, फोहोर र रिसाइकल” पुरस्कार विवादास्पद रूपमा चर्चित विषालु फोहोर थुप्रो पुनर्स्थापना परियोजनाले जितेको छ। स्पेनी आर्किटेक्ट बट्ले र रोइगमाथि आरोप छ कि १५० हेक्टरको खतरनाक थुप्रो हरियालीको नाममा लुकाइएको छ। उनीहरूको 'ला भल डेन् जोआन' परियोजना गाराफ नेचुरल पार्कको छेउमा कृत्रिम टेरेसहरू बनाइएको ठाउँ हो। आलोचकहरूले यत्रा अझै पनि प्रदूषण छिपाइएको जिकिर गरेका छन्, जब कि जज लुइस म्यान्सिला र मार्टिन केइडिङले यसलाई 'हरित आवरण लगाएर फोहोर छोप्ने अभिनय' भने। बट्ले र रोइगका जोआन रोइगले समेत भने, 'डिजाइन मुख्यतः जनसम्पर्कका लागि दशकौंदेखिको समस्या फोहोर पहाडमुनि लुकाउन केही सतही काम मात्रै गरिएको हो।' स्रोतअनुसार, स्पेनको सबैभन्दा ठूलो अवैध ल्यान्डफिल यही हो, जहाँ २००० मा काम सुरु भई हालै मात्र सकिएको हो। २० मिलियन टनभन्दा बढी, काफी विषाक्त भनिएको फोहोर, सन् २००६ मा बन्द भएपछि जमिनमा गाडिएको छ। केही स्थानमा खतरनाक फोहोर सतहभन्दा एक मिटर तल मात्रै रहेको स्थानीय भन्छन्। 'रपेन्टिङ' भनिने उक्त कार्यमा आलोचकका अनुसार आंशिक मात्र प्रभावकारी ड्रेनेज प्रणाली छ। केही पानीमा अझै प्रदूषण बाँकी रहेकाले, बगैंचामा सिँचाइ गर्दा आम स्वास्थ्य जोखिम बढेको छ। वातावरण समूहले परियोजनाको दिगोपन सिद्ध्याउन प्रमाणै नभएको आरोप लगाएका छन्। बाँकी फोहोरमा अझै घातक ग्यास निस्किरहेकाले बायोग्यासको नाममा बिजुली उत्पादनमा उपयोग भइरहेको छ। प्रवेशद्वारमा खुल्ला फोहोर देखाइन्छ, जुन अभियानकर्ताका अनुसार जोखिम सचेत गराउने हैन, केवल प्रतीक हो। मार्टिन केइडिङले भने, 'यो खतरनाक डिजाइन हो—बाहिरी आकर्षक, भित्री गम्भीर समस्या। यस्तो परियोजनालाई समाधान हैन भन्नुपर्छ।' अन्य फाइनलिस्ट, जस्तै बेइजिङको डिजिटल सिटी र नाइरोबीको कम्युनिटी कूकर, अझ पारदर्शी छन्। किबेरामा फोहोर इन्धन बन्ने कम्युनिटी कूकरलाइ निर्णायकहरूले साँचो दिगोपना भनेका छन्। 'दिगोपन अत्यावश्यक छ, तर गाराफमा अझै प्रश्न छन्,' केइडिङले थपे। उनले 'देखावटी' काम छोडेर वास्तुकारहरूलाई असली समाधानमा ध्यान दिन भन्नुभयो। म्यान्सिला र केइडिङले समस्या समाधानमा इन्जिनियर र आर्किटेक्टको सहकार्य अनिवार्य रहेकाले जोड दिए। निष्कर्षतः, केवल वास्तविक—न कि नाटकजन्य—दिगोपनले क्षेत्रलाई अगाडि बढाउन सक्छ।

article_content: A bright, white smile is nearly essential for celebrities aiming to shine on the red carpet—hence the term 'Hollywood smile.' But having pearly white teeth seems important for finding a partner too. According to a new study, the first thing men notice about women is their teeth. The study reveals that teeth rank as the most important feature men consider when meeting someone new, with 58% of men listing them as their top criteria. Other appearance-based elements also rank highly. After teeth, men's next concerns are a woman's hair (51%) and clothing (45%), as shown in research by Match.com. Famous figures such as the Duchess of Cambridge and Tulisa have been praised for their radiant smiles. Dr. Uchenna, Oral-B Smile Director, commented on the results: 'Taking care of your teeth daily not only improves your oral health but also boosts confidence, so you can show off your beautiful smile.' According to Oral-B, nearly one in three Britons do not brush their teeth twice a day, which can impact first impressions and even affect chances of a second date. Celebrities like Cheryl Cole and Louis Walsh have invested in dental work to achieve attractive, straight, white smiles. Nicola Roberts has also improved her teeth since her early days in Girls Aloud. Survey highlights: Teeth (58%), Grammar (55%), Hair (51%), with similar results from other findings citing Teeth (71%), Grammar (69%), and Hair (53%).

article_content: The Nigeria Civil Aviation Authority (NCAA) has launched an investigation into the circumstances surrounding United Nigeria Airlines flight NUA 0506 and the confusion that ensued among the public. In a statement released on Monday in Abuja, NCAA Director-General Capt. Musa Nuhu said that initial steps have already been taken, pending the completion of a full investigation. The NCAA reassured travelers that it remains committed to safety and will thoroughly examine the incident, as it has done in the past. Meanwhile, Mr. Achilleus-Chud Uchegbu, Head of Corporate Communications for United Nigeria Airlines, explained in a statement that the flight—which departed from Lagos for Abuja on Sunday—was temporarily diverted to Asaba International Airport, Delta State, due to poor weather conditions at its destination. According to Uchegbu, the pilots were fully aware of the diversion and were properly briefed. However, confusion arose among passengers when the cabin crew made an incorrect announcement upon landing in Asaba. The aircraft eventually landed safely in Abuja after weather conditions improved.

article_content: Public sector banks (PSU banks) in India have drawn significant investor interest in recent quarters as their financial condition and asset quality have improved. The Nifty PSU Banks index gained over 38% in the past 12 months, outperforming both the Nifty 50 and ET 100 indices, which each rose by about 6%. PSU banks continued to show steady progress in the September quarter. Across the 12 listed PSU banks, provisions set aside for bad loans (loan loss provisioning) fell to Rs 16,552 crore, compared to Rs 16,875 crore in the previous quarter and Rs 18,138 crore in the same quarter a year ago. Except for June 2023, loan loss provisioning has declined every quarter since June 2022. The most recent figure is also significantly lower than the Rs 24,324 crore reported in the March 2022 quarter. Of these 12 PSU banks, seven reported a year-on-year reduction in non-performing asset (NPA) provisioning for the September quarter. State Bank of India, the largest lender in the country, saw a 9.7% year-on-year drop in loan loss provisioning, amounting to Rs 1,814.9 crore. Punjab National Bank, the second-largest PSU bank by domestic advances, recorded a 15.1% decrease to Rs 3,018.6 crore. Indian Bank posted the largest decline, with a 54% reduction to Rs 917 crore. On the other hand, Central Bank of India reported an 80.2% year-on-year increase in NPA provisioning to Rs 1,928.6 crore, while India Overseas Bank saw a 78.7% rise to Rs 1,120.5 crore. In aggregate, these banks posted a 13.5% increase in net interest income to Rs 1 lakh crore in the September quarter, supported by better credit demand. Their pre-provision operating profit grew 5.9% to Rs 62,917 crore, while net profit surged 31% to Rs 33,643 crore year-on-year. However, on a sequential basis, net profit fell from Rs 34,417.9 crore in the June quarter, making it the second straight quarter of decline. Banks' profitability faces pressure due to narrowing net interest margins, as they raise deposit rates to attract more customers in a high-interest-rate environment. The group of banks reached peak net profit of Rs 34,482.4 crore in March 2023, recovering from a low of about Rs 17,100 crore in December 2021. Separately, a median forecast from 10 economists polled by ET predicts that Indian GDP expanded 6.7% year-on-year in Q2 (July-September), thanks to a strong showing in the services sector. Meanwhile, telecom operators, chip manufacturers, network providers, and handset makers have raised concerns about the proposal to beam TV content directly to mobile phones without cellular data, arguing that the technology is not yet mature. The government is also considering raising the threshold for arrests and criminal prosecution in GST evasion cases from Rs 2 crore to Rs 3 crore, aiming to reduce harassment and make it easier to do business.
translated_content: हालैका केहि त्रैमासिक अवधिमा भारतका सार्वजनिक क्षेत्रका बैंकहरू (PSU बैंक) ले आफ्नो वित्तीय अवस्था र सम्पत्ति गुणस्तरमा सुधार देखाएर लगानीकर्ताको ध्यान आकर्षण गरेका छन्। Nifty PSU Banks सूचकांकले गत १२ महिनामा ३८% भन्दा बढी वृद्धि गरेको छ, जबकि Nifty 50 र ET 100 सूचकांकमा लगभग ६% को वृद्धिमात्रै देखिएको छ। PSU बैंकहरुले सेप्टेम्बर त्रैमासिक अवधिमा निरन्तर प्रगति देखाएका छन्। सूचीकृत १२ वटा PSU बैंकहरूमध्ये, खराब ऋणका लागि छुट्याएको प्रावधान (लोन लस प्रोभिजनिंग) रु १६,५५२ करोडमा झरेको छ, जुन अघिल्लो त्रैमासका रु १६,८७५ करोड र अघिल्लो वर्षको सोही त्रैमासका रु १८,१३८ करोड भन्दा कम हो। जुन २०२३ बाहेक, जून २०२२ देखि प्रत्येक त्रैमासमा लोन लस प्रोभिजनिंग घट्दै आएको छ। पछिल्लो तथ्याङ्क मार्च २०२२ को रु २४,३२४ करोडको तुलनामा धेरै कम छ। यी १२ वटा PSU बैंकहरूमध्ये, सात बैंकले सेप्टेम्बर त्रैमासिक अवधिमा गैर-प्रदर्शनकारी सम्पत्ति (NPA) प्रावधानमा सालाना घटावट देखाएका छन्। भारतको सबैभन्दा ठूलो ऋणदाता, स्टेट बैंक अफ इन्डियाले, लोन लस प्रोभिजनिंगमा ९.७% को वार्षिक गिरावट देखाउँदै रु १,८१४.९ करोडमा झार्‍यो। घरेलु अग्रिमका आधारमा दोस्रो ठूलो PSU बैंक, पञ्जाब नेशनल बैंकले १५.१% को गिरावट देखाउँदै रु ३,०१८.६ करोड पुर्‍यायो। इन्डियन बैंकले सबैभन्दा ठूलो गिरावट, ५४% कटौतीसहित रु ९१७ करोडमा झार्‍यो। विपरित रूपमा, सेन्ट्रल बैंक अफ इन्डियाले NPA प्रावधानमा ८०.२% को वृद्धि गर्दै रु १,९२८.६ करोड पुर्‍यायो, जबकि इन्डिया ओभरसिज बैंकले ७८.७% को वृद्धि गर्दै रु १,१२०.५ करोड पुर्‍यायो। जम्मा रूपमा हेर्दा, यी बैंकहरुले सेप्टेम्बर त्रैमासमा शुद्ध ब्याज आम्दानीमा १३.५% को वृद्धि गर्दै रु १ लाख करोड पुर्याएका छन्, जुन राम्रो क्रेडिट मागले समर्थन गरेको हो। तिनीहरूको प्रि-प्रोभिजन अपरेटिंग नाफा ५.९% बढ्दै रु ६२,९१७ करोडमा पुगेको छ, जबकि शुद्ध नाफा ३१% ले बढेर रु ३३,६४३ करोड पुगेको छ। यद्यपि, लगातार दोस्रो त्रैमासमा शुद्ध नाफा घट्दै, जुन त्रैमासमा रु ३४,४१७.९ करोडबाट घटेको छ। उच्च ब्याजदर वातावरणमा ग्राहक आकर्षित गर्न निक्षेपदर बढाउँदा बैंकहरूको नाफामा दबाब देखिएको छ। यी बैंकहरूको समूहले मार्च २०२३ मा रु ३४,४८२.४ करोडको शुद्ध नाफामा शीर्ष स्थानमा पुगेका थिए, जुन डिसेम्बर २०२१ को करिब रु १७,१०० करोडको न्यूनतम विन्दुबाट सुधार भएको हो। अर्कोतिर, ET द्वारा सर्वेक्षण गरिएका १० जना अर्थशास्त्रीको मध्यपूर्व अनुमान अनुसार, जुलाई-सप्टेम्बर दोस्रो त्रैमासमा भारतीय GDP वार्षिक ६.७% ले वृद्धि भएको छ, जसमा सेवा क्षेत्रको मुख्य योगदान छ। यसैबीच, टेलिकम अपरेटर, चिप उत्पादक, नेटवर्क प्रदायक तथा मोबाइल निर्माता कम्पनीहरूले मोबाईल फोनमा सिधै टिभी सामग्री प्रसारण गर्ने प्रस्ताव (सेलुलर डाटा बिना) प्रविधि अझ पनि अपरिपक्व भएको भन्दै असन्तुष्टि जनाएका छन्। सरकारले GST छलफल मामिलामा पक्राउ तथा आपराधिक अभियोजनको सिमा रु २ करोडबाट बढाएर रु ३ करोड बनाउने प्रस्ताव गरिरहेको छ, जसले व्यवसाय गर्न सजिलो बनाउने र अनावश्यक झमेलाबाट बचाउने उद्देश्य राखेको छ।

In Sydney's southwestern outskirts lies Badgerys Creek, an area frozen between past promise and present neglect. In the 1980s, the federal government acquired nearly 2,000 hectares here to build a second international airport for the city, buying out family homes and farmlands. Although plans were announced with much anticipation, the project was put on hold for years, leading to widespread abandonment and decay.

Now, the empty red-brick houses—once filled with family life—stand idle. Overgrown gardens, old toys, and deserted kitchens tell the story of a community in limbo. The area feels like a ghost town, its homes hosting temporary tenants, squatters, and even illegal activities such as marijuana cultivation.

A few traces of life remain: the primary school, serving just a handful of pupils, is set to close by year’s end, ending more than a century of local education. Residents who have enjoyed lower rents have received notices to vacate, as airport construction is confirmed to start in 2016, aiming for completion in about a decade.

Tony Hadchiti, Liverpool Councillor and President of the Western Sydney Regional Organisation of Councils, acknowledges the inevitable change. He observes the effect that government stewardship has had—neglected maintenance, social decline, and uncertainty for long-time locals. While some regret the erasure of Badgerys Creek’s rural identity, most now accept that the airport’s arrival—and with it, round-the-clock flights and urban transformation—is imminent.

article_content: Gary Mehigan, who was among the original MasterChef Australia judges, recently visited The Rameshwaram Cafe in Bengaluru. At the well-known cafe, Mehigan enjoyed classic South Indian dishes such as ragi dosa, ghee roast dosa, medu vada, ghee idli podi, kesari baath, and a cup of filter coffee. The 56-year-old chef shared a video clip of his meal on Instagram, praising the food and mentioning he hopes to visit again. Mehigan’s post received a mixed response online. Some followers appreciated his experience, while others questioned the authenticity of the dishes, suggesting that more traditional dosa can be found in regions like Udupi, Karnataka. Some users also criticized the liberal use of ghee, saying it affected the taste negatively. One commenter expressed regret about missing the chance to see Mehigan in Bangalore. Known for sharing his food journeys across India, Mehigan once again highlighted the diversity of Indian cuisine in his latest social media update.

article_content: Colonel Robert Freniere, a 59-year-old U.S. military veteran, currently lives in his blue minivan in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, despite three graduate degrees and a distinguished career. According to Philly.com, he has applied for numerous jobs but has faced constant rejection. After his circumstances became public, Freniere began receiving about two dozen housing offers daily from all over the country, including from veterans, civilians, and various organizations. He has expressed gratitude for this wave of support and intends to reply to every offer. Freniere served 30 years in the military, reaching the rank of colonel and working as a special assistant to General Stanley McChrystal, former commander of U.S. forces in Afghanistan. He holds master's degrees in political science, criminal justice, and national security and strategic studies. His service included missions in Somalia, Panama, Haiti, Kuwait, and time at the Pentagon, where he was present on September 11, 2001. Despite an annual $40,000 military pension, financial strains arose following a divorce and supporting his two sons through college. Unemployed since losing his defense contractor position in 2012, Freniere struggles to find regular work. He occasionally affords motel stays or relies on friends for shelter, but spends most nights in his van. Despite ongoing job application setbacks, Freniere draws on his military training to endure, saying survival skills keep him calm and persistent. Alongside his military career, he has written screenplays, started businesses, and enjoys learning languages—earning him the nickname 'Lightning.' Though he deals with dyslexia and attention deficit disorder, he continues seeking employment and appreciates the encouragement he’s received.
translated_content: कर्नल रोबर्ट फ्रेनियर, ५९ वर्षीय अमेरिकी भूतपूर्व सैनिक, तीनवटा स्नातकोत्तर डिग्री र प्रतिष्ठित करियर भए पनि पेन्सिलभेनियाको किंग अफ प्रुसियामा आफ्नो निलो मिनिभ्यानमै बस्न बाध्य छन्। Philly.com का अनुसार, उनले असंख्य जागिरमा आवेदन दिए पनि पटक–पटक अस्वीकृत भएका छन्। उनको अवस्था सार्वजनिक भएपछि, देशभरका पूर्वसैनिक, सर्वसाधारण र संस्थाहरूबाट हरेक दिन करिब दुई दर्जन आवास प्रस्तावहरू आइरहेका छन्। उनले सहयोगमा आभार प्रकट गर्दै सबै प्रस्तावमा जवाफ दिने बताएका छन्। फ्रेनियरले ३० वर्ष सैन्य सेवा गरे, कर्नल पदसम्म पुगे र अफगानिस्तानका अमेरिकी फौजका पूर्व कमाण्डर जनरल स्ट्यानेली म्याकक्रिस्टलका विशेष सहायक थिए। उनको अध्ययन राजनीतिक विज्ञान, अपराध न्याय तथा राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा–रणनीतिक अध्ययनमा छ। उनले सोमालिया, पनामा, हाइटी, कुवेतलगायतका देशमा काम गरेका छन् र ११ सेप्टेम्बर २००१ को पेन्टागन हमलाका बेला पनि त्यहाँ थिए। वार्षिक $४०,००० को सैन्य पेन्सन भए पनि, डिभोर्सपछि र छोराहरूलाई कलेज पठाउँदा वित्तीय संकट थपियो। सन् २०१२ मा रक्षा ठेकेदारको जागिर गुमाएपछि उनी बेरोजगारीमा छन्। कहिले काहीँ होटलमा या साथीहरूको घरमा बस्न पाइन्छ, तर प्रायजसो रात उनले आफ्नै भ्यानमा बिताउँछन्। निरन्तर अस्वीकृतिका बाबजुद उनलाई सैन्य तालिमले धैर्य राख्न सघाएको छ। सेनाबाहेक, उनले स्क्रिनप्ले लेख्ने, व्यवसाय गर्ने, भाषा सिक्ने जस्ता काम गरेका छन्– जसकारण उनी ‘लाइटनिङ’ उपनामले चिनिन्छन्। डिस्लेक्सिया र ध्यानअभावको समस्या हुँदासमेत, उनी काम खोज्दैछन् र प्राप्त सहयोगको कदर गर्छन्।

article_content: The Government of Gujarat is set to organize a roadshow in Guwahati on November 24, 2023, highlighting Gujarat's strengths as an industrial state and its vision as the 'Gateway to the Future.' Previously, Gujarat held a curtain raiser in New Delhi and roadshows in Mumbai, Chandigarh, Kolkata, Chennai, Lucknow, and Bengaluru. To attract investment ahead of the Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit (VGGS) 2024, delegations also visited Japan, Germany, Italy, Denmark, the USA, France, UAE, South Korea, and Vietnam. The roadshows are designed to engage industry and business leaders, inviting them to the upcoming summit in January 2024. So far, 13 partner countries have confirmed their participation. Mulubhai Bera, Gujarat's Minister for Tourism, Cultural Activities, Forest and Environment, and Climate Change, will lead the Guwahati roadshow. The event aims to foster collaboration in sectors like IT & ITeS, Semiconductors, Electronics, Aerospace & Defense, Biotechnology, and Chemicals & Petrochemicals, while promoting investment in major projects such as GIFT City, Dholera SIR, and Biotech Park. The program will feature a welcome address from Bhaskar Phukan, Vice Chairman of CII Assam Council and Managing Director of Numaligarh Refinery Ltd., followed by an audiovisual presentation on Vibrant Gujarat, Dholera SIR, and GIFT City. Sanjeev Kumar, IAS, Principal Secretary of Forest & Environment, will present on business opportunities in Gujarat. Vinod Agrawal, Past Chairman of CII Gujarat Council and Chairman & Managing Director of Arunaya Organics Pvt. Ltd., will share his experiences. The event will conclude with a vote of thanks from Jaipal Singh, IFS, Additional Principal Chief Conservator of Forests, Government of Gujarat. The Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit 2024 is scheduled for January 10-12, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi expected to inaugurate the event. The Vibrant Gujarat Global Trade Show 2024 begins on January 9 and will focus on ‘TECHADE and Disruptive Technologies’, championing the services sector and initiatives like Digital India and India Stack. Established in 2003 by then-Chief Minister Narendra Modi, the biennial summit celebrates its tenth edition in 2024, highlighting both traditional and emerging sectors. Additional business news: Three of four IPOs (Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, Gandhar Oil Refinery) were fully subscribed on opening; IndiGo is planning premium seating and new services; and a significant number of insolvency cases have been withdrawn since the implementation of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.

सम्बोधन, Vibrant Gujarat, धोलेरा SIR र GIFT सिटीबारेको अडियो-भिजुअल प्रस्तुति, वन तथा वातावरणका प्रमुख सचिव संजीव कुमार (IAS) द्वारा गुजरातमा व्यावसायिक अवसरबारे प्रस्तुति र अरुनाया अर्ग्यानिक्स article_content:
At the Golden Globes last night, several celebrities made bold fashion choices that drew mixed reviews. Lucy Liu appeared in a Carolina Herrera gown with a large floral print, which some felt resembled wallpaper more than evening wear. Emily Mortimer was critiqued for a silver sequined gown that appeared too tight, while Halle Berry, widely recognized for her striking figure, wore a printed Versace dress with cut-out details that some believed didn't flatter her as expected.

Sienna Miller, known for her elegant style, opted for a British designer Erdem, but her gown's shape and print did little to complement her figure. Jennifer Westfeldt's look was considered confusing, though her appearance alongside Jon Hamm garnered some praise. Eva Longoria's Emilio Pucci choice featured deep splits which were seen as overly revealing.

Other celebrities also took risks with their style. Nene Leakes wore a shirt-style dress deemed too office-like for the event, while Julia Louis-Dreyfus wore a corseted gown with brown chiffon and black lace, likened to a fashion from the early 1990s. Nicole Richie wore a patterned blue dress that seemed to overwhelm her petite frame, and her heavy makeup and tan were considered unflattering. Zosia Mamet was noted for not wearing makeup or accessories, which made her black gown look less striking.

Jessica Alba's beautiful salmon-colored dress was let down by a furry clutch bag, while Anna Gunn's look suffered due to an unflattering hairstyle reminiscent of the 1980s. Kerry Washington, often on the best-dressed lists, wore a nude dress that worked from the knees up but was criticized for its less appealing lower half.

Despite some fashion missteps, the Golden Globes also saw many stars choosing timeless black or nude shades, possibly as a response to past criticism. Still, a few risk-takers ensured there was plenty for fashion watchers to discuss.

गत राति गोल्डेन ग्लोब्समा धेरै सेलिब्रेटीहरूले साहसी फेसन छनोटहरू गरे जसले दर्शकबाट मिश्रित प्रतिक्रिया पाए। लुसी लिउले क्यारोलिना हेरेराको ठूलो फूल प्रिन्टि भएको गाउन लगाइन्, जुन केहीको दृष्टिमा इभनिङ ड्रेस भन्दा वलपेपरजस्तो देखिन्थ्यो। एमिली मोर्टिमरलाई अत्याधिक टाइट चाँदी रंगको सिक्विन गाउनका लागि आलोचना भयो भने, आकर्षक फिगरका लागि परिचित हाले बेरीले कट-अउट डिजाईन भएको प्रिन्टेड भर्साचे ड्रेस लगाइन्, जुन सबैको अपेक्षानुसार मनपर्न सकेन।

साधारण स्टाइलका लागि प्रख्यात सिएना मिलरले बेलायती डिजाइनर एर्डेमको गाउन रोजिन्, तर गाउनको डिजाइनले उनको फिगरलाई खास उपयुक्त देखाएन। जेनिफर वेस्टफेल्डको लुक केही अन्योलपूर्ण लाग्यो, तर जोन हमसँग आउनुले उनको उपस्थिति मानिएको छ। इभा लोंगोरियाको एमिलियो पुच्ची गाउनका गहिरो कटहरू अत्याधिक खुल्ला देखिएको थिए।

अर्का सेलिब्रेटीहरूले समेत फरक पहिरनमा जोखिम लिए। निन लिक्स अफिस जस्तो सर्ट-ड्रेसमा देखिइन् भने, जुलिया लुइस-ड्रेफसले १९९० को शैलीको ब्राउन सिफन र कालो लेस भएको कोर्सेटेड गाउन लगाइन्। निकोल रिचीको निलो र डिजाइनर गाउन उनको सानो शरीरमा भारी देखिएको थियो, र उनको मोटा मेकअप तथा ट्यान पनि मनपर्ने थिएन। जोसिया म्यामेट गहनारहित र मेकअप बिना देखिइन्, जसले उनको कालो गाउनलाई कम आकर्षक बनायो।

जेसिका आल्बाको मनमोहक स्याल्मन रंगको ड्रेसलाई भुलाइन योग्य खर्चिलो झोलाले थोरै कमजोर बनायो, भने आना गणको लुक ८० को दशकजस्तो हेयरस्टाइलका कारण राम्रो लागेन। प्रायः उत्कृष्ट पहिरनमा देखिने केरी वासिङ्टनले घुँडाभन्दा तलको भागमा कम आकर्षक पारदर्शी ड्रेस लगाइन्।

फेसन गल्तीहरू भए तापनि, यो बर्ष धेरै सेलिब्रेटीहरू कालो अथवा न्युट्रल रंगमा देखिए, सम्भवत: विगतका आलोचनाका कारण। तथापि, केही साहसी प्रयासले फेसन प्रेमीहरूलाई कुरा गर्न पर्याप्त अवसर प्रदान गरे।

article_content: Alastair Cook faces a pivotal week regarding his future as England cricket captain, as increasing calls for his resignation emerge amid a difficult period with the bat and mounting criticism of his leadership. The 29-year-old has struggled recently, failing to score a Test century in 26 innings and averaging less than 24 runs over the past year. England’s series of disappointing defeats has further intensified scrutiny of Cook’s captaincy. Insiders maintain that Cook still enjoys support within the team, and senior figures at the ECB have a great deal at stake after backing him following the Ashes loss and Kevin Pietersen’s dismissal. However, both his batting technique and leadership style are under pressure, and Cook must decide soon whether he wants to continue. Victory—and a significant batting performance—against India at Lord’s could strengthen Cook’s position. In contrast, another defeat and low score may lead to his removal following the 5-0 Ashes defeat and the recent home series loss to Sri Lanka. Head coach Peter Moores is also under pressure, having yet to deliver significant improvements in his second spell. As his team struggles against India at Lord’s, some remain supportive of Cook’s efforts to maintain positive team morale. For example, he reached out to newcomer Gary Ballance amid personal challenges. Despite this support, some senior ECB figures are reportedly distancing themselves from Cook, with Paul Downton declining to offer public backing, and Giles Clarke reacting strongly to media questions about Cook’s future. Historically, England rarely sack captains for on-field reasons—Alec Stewart was the last in 1999. Still, another defeat could leave Cook’s captaincy in serious doubt. Former captain Mike Brearley notes the difficulty of such situations, emphasizing the need for support. Meanwhile, Graeme Swann and others express both sympathy and concern for Cook's future. Cook has previously insisted he is not one to resign, but without a turnaround at Lord’s, his options may soon run out.
translated_content: अलास्टर कुकले इंग्ल्यान्ड क्रिकेट कप्तानको रूपमा आफ्नो भविष्यबारे निर्णय लिने निर्णायक साता सामना गर्दैछन्, किनकि ब्याटिङमा उनको खराब लय र नेतृत्वमा आलोचना बढ्दै गएको छ, जसले राजीनामाको दबाब सिर्जना गरेको छ। २९ वर्षीय कुकले पछिल्ला २६ इनिङ्समा टेस्ट शतक बनाएका छैनन् र पछिल्लो वर्ष उनको ब्याटिङ औसत २४ भन्दा कम छ। इंग्ल्यान्डको निरन्तर खराब खेल परिणामले उनको कप्तानीप्रति प्रश्न उठाएको छ। भित्रका स्रोतहरूका अनुसार, ड्रेसिङरुमभित्र कुकको समर्थन अझै छ, साथै एसीबीका उच्च पदस्थले एशेजमा पराजय र केभिन पिटरसनको हटाइपछि उनलाई समर्थन गरेका थिए, जसले उनीहरूको छवि पनि दाउमा रहेको देखिन्छ। तर उनको ब्याटिङ शैली र कप्तानी क्षमता दुवै दबाबमा छन् र कुकले छिट्टै निर्णय लिनुपर्ने परिस्थिति रहेको छ। लॉर्ड्समा भारतविरुद्ध जित र राम्रो व्यक्तिगत प्रदर्शनले कुकको स्थान सुरक्षित बनाउन सक्छ, तर अर्को हार र कम रन आयो भने ५-० एशेज हार र श्रीलंकासँगको घरेलु सिरिज हारपछिको दबाबमा उनको कप्तानी गुम्न सक्छ। हेड कोच पिटर मुइर्स पनि दोश्रो कार्यकालमा उल्लेखनीय सुधार ल्याउन नसकेको भन्दै आलोच्य छन्। लॉर्ड्समा टिम संघर्षरत रहँदा कुकले टिमको मनोबल बलियो राख्न प्रयास गर्दै आएका छन्; जस्तै, उनले व्यक्तिगत समस्यामा फसेका नयाँ खेलाडी गेरी ब्यालेन्सलाई विशेष ध्यान दिएका थिए। तर केही उच्च एसीबी अधिकारीहरू कुकबाट राजनीतिक रूपमा टाढा रहन थालेको जनाइएको छ; पॉल डाउटनले सार्वजनिक रूपमा समर्थन गर्न मानेनन् भने जाइल्स क्लार्क प्रेसको प्रश्नमा तिब्र प्रतिक्रिया दिए। इंग्ल्यान्डमा कप्तानलाई मैदानको कारणले हटाउने दुर्लभ छ; अन्तिम पटक १९९९ मा एलेक स्टुवर्ट पदच्युत भएका थिए। यद्यपि अर्को हारले कुकको कप्तानी संकटमा पार्न सक्छ। पूर्व कप्तान माइक ब्रियरलीले यस्तो अवस्थालाई गम्भीर बताए, साथमै पूर्व टिममेट ग्राएम स्वान तथा अरूले कुकप्रति सहानुभूति र चिन्ता व्यक्त गरेका छन्। कुकले आफू सजिलै राजीनामा नदिने प्रतिबद्धता जनाए पनि, अब ताजगी ल्याउन नसके उनलाई विकल्प कम देखिन्छ।

article_content: A remarkable total solar eclipse is set to occur on April 8, 2024, captivating millions throughout North America. The spectacle will be visible along a 125-mile-wide band called the path of totality, crossing 15 U.S. states along with regions of Canada and Mexico. While all of North America will witness a partial eclipse, only those inside this narrow path will experience daytime darkness and see the sun's corona unaided. Experts such as Debra Ross of the AAS Solar Eclipse Task Force and Dr. Victoria Kramkowski from the Royal Astronomical Society of Canada emphasize planning ahead to make the most of the event. This rare natural phenomenon gives everyone a chance—whether or not they’re astronomy fans—to feel awe and wonder. Families and friends are encouraged to use upcoming holidays like Thanksgiving to discuss travel plans into the path of totality. Cities like Mazatlan, Dallas, Indianapolis, Cleveland, Buffalo, Rochester, and Montreal will lie within this path. Organizers offer practical advice: arrive early, anticipate heavy traffic, and consider staying longer to avoid congestion after the eclipse. They promote hashtags like #TakeTuesdayToo and #ArriveEarlyAndStayLate to remind travelers about flexibility, especially in response to weather or possible last-minute changes. Since clear skies aren’t guaranteed anywhere, it’s smart to choose destinations worth visiting regardless of the forecast. Event planners recognize that people want different experiences—some enjoy large gatherings, while others seek solitude. Along the eclipse’s path, communities are hosting diverse programming, from orchestral performances and historical reenactments in Rochester to festivals and special dinners in Texas and Illinois. Ultimately, organizers urge everyone to make a plan and adjust schedules to truly experience the eclipse together. Even if clouds appear, witnessing a total solar eclipse is still meaningful. The emphasis is on being grateful for this rare opportunity and making the most of a spectacular event.
translated_content: एक अद्भुत पूर्ण सूर्यग्रहण २०२४ अप्रिल ८ मा उत्तर अमेरिकाभरका करोडौँ मानिसको लागि अविस्मरणीय क्षण बन्नेछ। यो दृश्य १५ वटा अमेरिकी राज्यहरू, साथै क्यानाडा र मेक्सिकोका क्षेत्रहरू पार गर्ने १२५ माइल चौडाइको 'पथ अफ टोटालिटी' मा देख्न सकिन्छ। यद्यपि सम्पूर्ण उत्तर अमेरिकाले आंशिक सूर्यग्रहण देख्नेछ, फगत यस सानो पथभित्र हुनेहरूले मात्र दिउँसोको अँध्यारो र नाङ्गो आँखाले सूर्यको कोरोना प्रत्यक्ष देख्न पाउनेछन्। AAS सोलार एक्लिप्स टास्क फोर्सकी डेब्रा रोस र रोयल एस्ट्रोनोमिकल सोसाइटी अफ क्यानडाकी डा. भिक्टोरिया क्रामकोवस्कीजस्ता विज्ञहरूले यस अद्वितीय प्राकृतिक घटना बेस गर्नु र त्यसलाई जीवन्त अनुभव गर्न समयमै योजना बनाउन सुझाव दिएका छन्। यो दुर्लभ क्षण सबैलाई—चाहे खगोलशास्त्र मनपराउने होस् वा अहोस्—आश्चर्य र आनन्दको अनुभव दिन्छ। परिवार तथा साथीहरूलाई समयमै योजना बनाउन प्रेरित गर्दै, डेङ्क्सगिभिङ जस्ता चाडपर्वहरूमा ‘पथ अफ टोटालिटी’मा यात्रा योजना छलफल गर्न प्रोत्साहन गरिएको छ। मासाट्लान, डलास, इन्डियानापोलिस, क्लीभल्यान्ड, बफेलो, रोचेस्टर र मोन्ट्रियलजस्ता शहर उक्त पथभित्र पर्ने छन्। आयोजकहरूद्वारा दिइएका व्यावहारिक सुझावहरू: चाँडै पुग्नुहोस्, ट्राफिक धेरै हुनसक्छ भन्ने सोच्नुहोस्, र यात्रा पछि केही दिन बस्ने विचार गर्नुहोस्। #TakeTuesdayToo र #ArriveEarlyAndStayLate जस्ता ह्यासट्यागहरूले मौसम परिवर्तन वा अन्तिम समयमा गन्तव्य परिवर्तनको अवस्थालाई ध्यानमा राख्दै यात्रा लचिलो बनाउन सुझाव दिन्छन्। मौसम स्पष्ट हुने ग्यारेन्टी नभए पनि, आफूले चाहेको गन्तब्यको छनोटको फाइदा रहन्छ। कार्यक्रम आयोजकहरूले यात्रुहरूको फरक-फरक चाहना बुझेका छन्—केहीलाई भीडमा रमाइलो लाग्छ भने, केहीले शान्तता रोज्छन्। ‘पथ अफ टोटालिटी’मा रहेका समुदायहरूले रोचेस्टरमा सङ्गीतदेखि ऐतिहासिक अनुभवसम्म, टेक्सास र इलिनोइसमा उत्सव र विशेष पारिवारिक डिनरसम्मका विविध कार्यक्रम आयोजना गरेका छन्। अन्ततः, आयोजकहरूले सबैलाई योजना बनाई समय छुट्याएर यो दुर्लभ सूर्यग्रहण सँगसँगै अनुभव गर्न आह्वान गरेका छन्। बादल लागेपनि सूर्यग्रहणको अनुभूति अझै अर्थपूर्ण हुन्छ। यस अद्भुत प्राकृतिक घटनाको कदर गर्दै, सबैले यसको आनन्द लिनुपर्ने सन्देश दिइएको छ।

article_content: James Norton is set to star in and executive produce a new four-part limited series adaptation of JP Delaney’s bestselling novel, 'Playing Nice,' for ITV and StudioCanal. He will appear alongside Niamh Algar ('Mary and George'), James McArdle ('Mare of Easttown'), and Jessica Brown Findlay ('Downton Abbey'). The BAFTA-nominated Norton, whose production company Rabbit Track Pictures is backed by Banijay, will also serve as executive producer. The drama follows two couples who discover that their toddlers were accidentally switched at birth in a hospital in Cornwall. As they face the heartbreaking question of whether to keep the children they have raised or reclaim their biological sons, secrets and hidden motives emerge. In the series, Norton and Algar play Pete and Maddie, while McArdle and Brown Findlay portray Miles and Lucy. Grace Ofori-Attah, known for ITV's 'Malpractice,' has written the series, and Kate Hewitt ('One Day') will direct all four episodes. Filming is underway in Cornwall. ITV drama commissioner Helen Perry described 'Playing Nice' as an 'enthralling thriller with a knotty moral dilemma at its heart,' suggesting it will leave viewers captivated and questioning what they would do in such a situation. Executive producers include Kitty Kaletsky (Rabbit Track co-founder), Norton, Kate Crowe, StudioCanal’s Joe Naftalin, and both Grace Ofori-Attah and JP Delaney. Isobel Carter oversees for StudioCanal, and Nick Pitt is the series producer. The series was commissioned by ITV’s Polly Hill and Helen Perry. StudioCanal will handle global distribution, and Canal+ has pre-bought the series in France.
translated_content: जेम्स नोर्टन आईटीभी र स्टुडियो क्यानलको लागि जेपी डिलानीको चर्चित उपन्यास 'प्लेयिङ नाइस' को नयाँ चार भागको सिरिजमा मुख्य भूमिकामा देखिने भएका छन् र कार्यकारी निर्माता पनि हुनेछन्। उनीसँगै निअम अल्गर ('मेरी एन्ड जर्ज'), जेम्स म्याकअर्डल ('मेयर अफ इस्टटाउन') र जेसिका ब्राउन फाइन्डले ('डाउनटन एबी') पनि अभिनय गर्नेछन्। बाफ्टा मनोनित नोर्टनको प्रोडक्सन कम्पनी र्याबिट ट्र्याक पिक्चर्स बनिजेय द्वारा समर्थित छ। यो ड्रामामा दुई जोडीले आफ्ना बच्चाहरू सुत्केरी अस्पतालमा गल्तीले साटिएको थाहा पाउँछन्। उनीहरूले आफूले हुर्काएका सन्तानलाई राख्ने कि जैविक सन्तान फिर्ता ल्याउने भन्ने कठिन निर्णय सामना गर्नुपरेको छ। यस्तो अवस्थामा लुकेका रहस्य र मनसायहरू उजागर हुन थाल्छन्। सिरिजमा नोर्टन र अल्गरले पिट र म्याडीको भूमिका निर्वाह गर्नेछन् भने म्याकअर्डल र ब्राउन फाइन्डले माइल्स र लुसीको भूमिका निभाउनेछन्। आईटीभीको 'मालप्राक्टिस' लेख्नु भएकी ग्रेस ओफोरी-अट्टाहले यो सिरिज लेख्नु भएको हो र 'वन डे' की केट हेविटले सबै चार भाग निर्देशन गर्नेछिन्। छायांकन कर्नवालमा जारी छ। आईटीभी ड्रामा कमिशनर हेलेन पेरीले 'प्लेयिङ नाइस' लाई मुटुमा गहिरो नैतिक द्वन्द्व भएको 'रोचक थ्रिलर' भनेकी छन्, जसले दर्शकलाई आफैं के गर्थेँ भन्ने सोच्न बाध्य पार्नेछ। कार्यकारी उत्पादकमा र्याबिट ट्र्याकका सह-संस्थापक किटी कालेत्स्की, नोर्टन, केट क्रो, स्टुडियोक्यानलका जो नाफ्टालिन, साथै ग्रेस ओफोरी-अट्टाह र जेपी डिलानी छन्। स्टुडियोक्यानलतर्फ इसोबेल कार्टर पर्यवेक्षक छिन् भने निक पिट सिरिज निर्माता हुन्। यो सिरिज आईटीभीका पोली हिल र हेलेन पेरीले कमिसन गरेका हुन्। स्टुडियोक्यानलले वैश्विक वितरण गर्नेछ र क्यानल+ले फ्रान्समा सिरिज पहिले नै खरीद गरिसकेको छ।

article_content: Nigella Lawson told a London court that she pays her children to work for her and sometimes requires them to appear on her TV cookery shows. This disclosure surfaced while the court learned about the comfortable lifestyles of her two children from her late husband John Diamond, and Charles Saatchi’s daughter, Phoebe. It was alleged that each of the three teenagers received almost £200 per week in spending money from one of the housekeepers currently on trial for theft. They also often dined at restaurants, with expenses covered by Mr. Saatchi. During questioning at Isleworth Crown Court, Lawson admitted she found a legitimate way to pay her children’s university tuition by putting them on her payroll, which she declares openly and legally. Lawson explained, 'I’m afraid to say I make them appear in my television programmes.' When asked if this was the only work her children did for her, she replied, 'No. When I’m testing a new recipe, they will taste it along the way. They do many things I ask of them.' Nigella Lawson strongly denied claims that Francesca Grillo, the housekeeper accused of fraud, ever had permission to use the family credit card to give the teenagers regular cash payments—an amount that would total about £29,000 per year. She also denied that Francesca had to use the family card to pay for meals for the children, explaining that the children could eat at various restaurants on tabs set up by Mr. Saatchi or use the family PayPal account for ordering takeaways. The trial is ongoing.
translated_content: नाइजेल्ला लसनले लण्डनको अदालतमा भनिन् कि उनले आफ्ना छोराछोरीलाई आफूलाई काम गर्न र कहिले काँही आफ्ना टिभी कुकरी कार्यक्रममा देखा पर्न भनी तलब दिन्छिन्। यो रहस्योद्घाटन अदालतमा उनका दिवंगत पहिलो श्रीमान् जोन डायमन्डका दुई सन्तान र चाल्र्स साचीकी छोरी फोबीको सुविधाजनक जीवनशैलीबारे छलफल हुँदा आएको हो। आरोप लगाइएको थियो कि ती तीन किशोर-किशोरीहरूलाई एकजना गृह सहायकले, जो अहिले चोरी आरोपमा मुद्दामा छिन्, हरेक जनालाई हप्ताको करिब £२०० खर्च दिने गर्थिन्। साथै, उनीहरूले श्री साचीले तिरेका रेस्टुरेन्ट भोजनहरू पनि धेरै पटक उपभोग गर्थे। आइल्वर्थ क्राउन अदालतमा सोधपुछका क्रममा लसनले आफ्ना छोराछोरीको विश्वविद्यालय शुल्क तिर्ने वैध तरिका पहिचान गरेर उनीहरूलाई पेरोलमा राखेको र सबै कुरा कानुनी रूपमा घोषणा गरेको स्वीकारिन्। उनले भनिन्, 'म भन्नुपर्दा म उनीहरूलाई मेरो टेलिभिजन कार्यक्रममा देखिन बाध्य बनाउँछु।' सोधियो कि टिभी कार्यक्रममा देखिनु नै उनीहरूले गर्ने एकमात्र काम हो भनी, उनले भनिन्, 'होइन। जब म नयाँ रेसिपी जाँच्दैछु, उनीहरूले त्यसको स्वाद चाख्छन्। मेरो अनुरोधमा उनीहरूले धेरै काम गर्छन्।' नाइजेल्ला लसनले घरेलु सहायक फ्रान्सेस्का ग्रिल्लोले छोराछोरीलाई नियमित नगद दिनका लागि परिवारको क्रेडिट कार्ड प्रयोग गर्न उनको अनुमति पाएको भन्ने दावीलाई कडा रूपमा अस्वीकार गरिन्। ती नगद भुक्तानीहरू वर्षमा करीब £२९,००० पुग्ने अनुमान गरिएको थियो। साथै, उनले ग्रिल्लोले छोराछोरीका भोजनका लागि घरको कार्ड प्रयोग गरेको भन्ने कुरा पनि अस्वीकार गरिन्। लसनले बताइन्, छोराछोरीहरूले श्री साचीले राखेका विभिन्न रेस्टुरेन्ट ट्याबहरू प्रयोग गर्न सक्थे वा पारिवारिक पेपल खाताबाट अर्डर गर्न सक्थे। मुद्दा अझै चलिरहेको छ।
