article_content: A group of tourists recently stopped their car on a rural road to observe a mother bear and her cub at close range. Rather than keeping a safe distance, they lowered their window, laughing and recording the encounter as the bear cub approached. Even after the cub swiped at the vehicle and the mother bear showed warning behavior, the tourists neither left the area nor secured themselves. One individual even tried to reach out to the cub, resulting in a second swipe by the animal. Fortunately, no one was harmed. Their reckless interaction later appeared on the 'TouronsofNationalParks' Instagram page. Such behavior underscores ongoing concerns about tourists disregarding safety around wildlife. If someone had been injured, there is a real risk that authorities might have considered euthanizing the bears, demonstrating how careless actions can endanger both humans and animals.

article_content: Derry Mathews is gearing up for a significant test as he prepares to challenge Richar Abril, the WBA lightweight champion, in Liverpool on March 6. If Mathews succeeds, he has vowed that his first title defense will go to Anthony Crolla. Crolla originally earned a title shot but was sidelined by serious injuries after confronting burglars, suffering a fractured skull and a broken ankle. The two British fighters have a history together, with one victory for each and a draw in their past two meetings. Mathews praises promoter Frank Warren for arranging a world title fight in his home city, something not often granted to local talent. Although he acknowledges Abril’s status as a skilled champion, Mathews is confident in his preparations and abilities. He believes it’s his moment to capture the title, noting Abril’s age and style as advantages. Mathews also extends empathy toward Crolla, describing him as both a respected rival and a good person, wishing him a quick recovery and promising him a shot at the title if victorious over Abril. Abril, a Cuban-born boxer now based in Miami, has averaged just one fight per year recently but remains a tough opponent, with 19 wins in 23 fights. He took the title from Sharif Bogere and defended it successfully against Edis Tatli. Looking ahead, Abril acknowledges Mathews’ experience but is confident he will keep his title in the UK, aiming for a knockout victory.

article_content: Ann Currie, a single mother with a $60,000 student loan balance, prepared to resume payments after a pause exceeding three years. Living on a rent subsidy and supporting both her children and grandchildren, Currie knew she could only afford a modest monthly payment. When she applied for President Joe Biden's new SAVE income-driven repayment plan, she was pleased to see a projected monthly payment of $47—a figure she felt comfortable managing alongside her other expenses. However, Currie was surprised when her first bill listed a payment due of $175, according to documents reviewed by Insider. 'They're requiring me to pay something I can't afford right now,' she said. 'I do want to pay something, but I'm not able to pay the amount they're asking for.' Currie, speaking under a pseudonym to protect her privacy, works at a call center and has only two 30-minute breaks a day. When she called her student loan servicer for help, she encountered an estimated hold time of 422 minutes—making it impossible to get assistance during work hours. The Department of Education launched the SAVE plan in August, describing it as 'the most affordable repayment plan yet.' According to the department, borrowers earning less than $15 per hour would owe $0 monthly payments under SAVE, and most others would save at least $1,000 annually compared to previous income-driven plans. However, a Washington Post analysis found that the plan has caused issues for thousands of borrowers—an estimated 420,000 have experienced errors with payment calculations. A spokesperson told Insider that the department is collaborating with loan servicers to provide timely information to borrowers and to hold servicers accountable when they fall short. The department emphasized its commitment to oversight and noted that borrowers would be refunded for any overpayments. Currie did not make her $175 payment due on October 1 and is concerned the issue may not be resolved before her next payment deadline in November. While the Department of Education said it instructed servicers to place borrowers affected by errors in administrative forbearance, Currie has not been placed in forbearance and remains uncertain about her options. 'I plan on making payments as much as I can,' Currie said. 'I want to make the payments, but the amount they've set would leave me struggling.' Joanna Arbach, another student-loan borrower, faces the same dilemma. After applying for the SAVE plan, she expected a $125 monthly payment, but her billing statement required $428. Her account is now past due because she couldn't afford the October 1 payment, and repeated attempts to resolve the issue with customer service have been unsuccessful. 'I couldn't make those huge payments right now,' Arbach explained. Despite speaking to multiple service representatives, her account remains in limbo. Arbach's only remaining option is to contact her state representative for help, but the ongoing uncertainty is causing her significant financial stress. 'It's been a nightmare. I'm sure I'm not the only one going through this,' she said. Although the Department of Education has created a 12-month 'on-ramp' period to ease the transition back to repayment—during which missed payments will not be reported to credit agencies—interest still accrues. The department also cannot control how credit scoring companies treat missed payments, so this measure does not fully protect affected borrowers. Both the Education Department and servicers cite insufficient funding for Federal Student Aid as a major cause of the mistakes and delayed assistance, but this is little consolation for borrowers facing unaffordable bills.
translated_content: एन करी, एकल आमा जसको $६०,००० विद्यार्थी ऋण बाँकी छ, तीन वर्षभन्दा बढीको रोकपछि किस्ता तिर्न तयारी गर्दै थिइन्। भाडा अनुदानमा बस्ने र आफ्ना छोराछोरी तथा नातिनातिनालाई सपोर्ट गर्दै आएकी करीलाई थाहा थियो, उनले महिनामा थोरै रकम मात्र तिर्न सक्छिन्। राष्ट्रपति जो बाइडेनको नयाँ SAVE इनकम-ड्रिभन रिपेमेन्ट योजनामा आवेदन गरेपछि उनले $४७ मासिक किस्ता देखिन्, जुन खर्चसँग मेल खाने अवस्था थियो। तर, जब करीले पहिलो बिल पाइन्, त्यहाँ $१७५ तिर्नु पर्ने देखियो। उनले भनिन्, ‘उनीहरूले म अहिले तिर्न नसक्ने रकम मागिरहेका छन्। म केही रकम तिर्न चाहन्छु, तर त्यो मागिएको रकम तिर्न सक्दिन।’ निजी सुरक्षाका कारण उनले छद्म नाम प्रयोग गरेकी हुन्। क्यारी कल सेन्टरमा काम गर्छिन र दिनमा दुई ३० मिनेटको ब्रेक मात्र पाइन्छ। जब उनले आफ्नो सेवाकर्तालाई मद्दतका लागि फोन गरिन्, ४२२ मिनेट कुर्ने समय देखियो। जसले गर्दा कामको समयमा सहयोग पाउन सम्भव थिएन। शिक्षा विभागले अगस्तमा SAVE योजना ल्यायो, जसलाई ‘सबैभन्दा किफायती भुक्तानी योजना’ भनेको छ। विभागका अनुसार, घण्टाको $१५ भन्दा कम कमाउनेहरूलाई $० मासिक किस्ता हुनेछ र अन्य अधिकांशले पुराना योजनाको तुलनामा वार्षिक $१,००० बचत गर्नेछन्। तर, वासिङ्टन पोस्टको विश्लेषणमा हजारौँ ऋणीहरू समस्यामा परेका छन्—४२०,००० ऋणीले गणनामा गल्ती खेपेका छन्। एक प्रवक्ताले Insider लाई भनेका छन्—विभाग ऋणीलाई समयमै सूचना दिन तथा सेवाकर्तालाई जवाफदेही बनाउन काम गरिरहेको छ। विभागले अनुगमनलाई महत्व दिने र अधिक भुक्तानी भएसम्म फिर्ता गर्ने आश्वासन दिएको छ। करीले अक्टोबर १ मा तिर्नुपर्ने $१७५ को किस्ता तिनन् र अब नोभेम्बरसम्म समस्या समाधान होला कि भन्ने चिन्ता छ। शिक्षा विभागले गल्ती खेपेका ऋणीलाई प्रशासनिक छुटमा राख्न निर्देशन दिएको भए पनि, क्यारीको केसमा त्यो भएको छैन। उनले भनिन्, ‘म सकेसम्म तिर्ने कोशिस गर्छु, तर मागिएको रकमले मलाई निकै गाह्रो बनाउँछ।’ जोआना आर्बाच, अर्की ऋणीले पनि उस्तै समस्या भोगेकी छन्। SAVE योजना अनुसार $१२५ मासिक किस्ता आशा गरेकी थिइन्, तर बिलमा $४२८ देखियो। अक्टोबर १ मा भुक्तानी नदिएकाले खाता पेंडिङ छ र ग्राहक सेवाबाट समाधान खोज्न सकेकी छैनन्। ‘यत्रो ठूलो रकम अहिले तिर्न सक्दिन,’ उनले भनिन्। कैयौँ सेवाकर्तासँग कुरा गर्दा पनि समस्या ज्यूँका त्यूँ छ। आर्बाचको अहिले एक मात्र विकल्प भनेको राज्य प्रतिनिधिलाई सम्पर्क गर्नु हो, तर अन्योलले आर्थिक तनाव बढाएको छ। उनले भनिन्, 'यो नै दुःस्वप्नजस्तै भएको छ, म मात्र होइन, धेरैजना भोगिरहेका छन्।' यद्यपि शिक्षा विभागले १२ महिनाको 'अन-र्याम्प' अवधि दिएको छ, जसमा छुटेको भुक्तानी क्रेडिट एजेन्सीलाई रिपोर्ट गरिंदैन, ब्याज भने अझै थपिँदै जान्छ। विभागले क्रेडिट स्कोर कम्पनीहरूका नीति नियन्त्रण गर्न सक्दैन, त्यसैले पूर्ण सुरक्षा छैन। शिक्षा विभाग र सेवाकर्ताले संघीय विद्यार्थी सहयोगको लागि पर्याप्त बजेट नपुग्नु गल्ती र ढिलो सहायता हुने मुख्य कारण भनेका छन्, तर ऋणीलाई यो थोरै सान्त्वना मात्र हो।

For many years, airport travelers have needed to repack their liquids into small bottles to meet tight security rules introduced after a failed 2006 terror plot. These rules have created long waits at security and resulted in the disposal of tons of liquids each year. However, new technology may soon end these hassles.

The Insight100 scanner, developed by Cobalt Light Systems, is now being trialed at 65 major airports, such as Heathrow and Gatwick. Using a process called Raman Spectroscopy, the device shines lasers into the liquid (through non-metallic containers up to three liters), analyzing the scattered light to identify what’s inside—without opening the bottle. In around five seconds, the scanner can tell if a liquid is safe or if it matches known dangerous chemicals like hydrogen peroxide, which was used in the 2006 threat.

Paul Loeffen, the company’s CEO, says airports have wanted to return to less restrictive security but need reliable detection systems first. With its fast and precise results, the Insight100 could help lift the 100ml hand-luggage liquid limit, speed up security checks, and cut down on waste caused by confiscations, which currently results in thousands of tons of liquid being thrown away at major UK airports every year.

Besides improving airport security and saving costs on delays and staffing, the Insight100 has been recognized for its technological significance, earning a nomination for the MacRobert Award by the Royal Academy of Engineering. Experts also believe this laser-based analysis could be used in future for medical diagnostics, detecting fake goods, and checking food safety.

धेरै वर्षदेखि, हवाई यात्रुहरूले २००६ मा भएको असफल आतंकवादी योजनापछि लागू गरिएका कडा सुरक्षाका नियमअनुसार आफ्नो तरल पदार्थ स–साना बोतलमा राख्नुपर्थ्यो। यसले सुरक्षामा लामो लाइन र हरेक वर्ष ठूलो संख्यामा तरल फ्याँक्नुपर्ने बाध्यता ल्याएको छ। तर, नयाँ प्रविधिले यी समस्या छिट्टै समाधान गर्न सक्छ।

Cobalt Light Systems द्वारा विकास गरिएको Insight100 स्क्यानर अहिले Heathrow र Gatwick जस्ता ६५ वटा ठूला विमानस्थलमा परीक्षण चलिरहेको छ। Raman Spectroscopy प्रविधि प्रयोग गरी, यो स्क्यानरले गैर–धातुका बोतल (३ लिटर सम्म) भित्रको तरलमा लेजर हान्छ र त्यसबाट फर्किएको प्रकाश विश्लेषण गर्छ—बोतल नखोली नै। करिब पाँच सेकेन्डमै, स्क्यानरले सुरक्षित तरल र २००६ को आतंकवादी योजनामा प्रयोग भएको हाइड्रोजन पेरोक्साइड जस्तो जोखिमयुक्त रसायन छुट्याउन सक्छ।

कम्पनीका CEO पाउल लोफेनका अनुसार, विमानस्थलहरूले सुरक्षामा पुरानै अवस्था फर्काउन चाहन्छन् तर त्यसका लागि भरपर्दो पहिचान प्रणाली चाहिन्छ। द्रुत र विश्वसनीय नतिजाका कारण Insight100 ले १०० मिलिलिटर ह्यान्ड लगेज सीमाना हटाउन, सुरक्षा जाँच छिटो पार्न र प्रत्येक वर्ष हजारौं टन तरल फ्याँक्नु पर्ने बर्बादी घटाउन सहयोग गर्न सक्छ।

सुरक्षा सुधार र लागत बचतमा उल्लेखनीय योगदान दिएकाले, Insight100 लाई Royal Academy of Engineering द्वारा प्रतिष्ठित MacRobert Award का लागि नामांकन गरिएको छ। विज्ञहरूका अनुसार यो लेजर प्रविधि भविष्यमा चिकित्सा परीक्षण, नक्कली वस्तु पत्ता लगाउने र खानाको गुणस्तर जांचमा समेत उपयोगी हुन सक्छ।

article_content: Chicago recently endured an intense arctic blast, experiencing subzero temperatures for a continuous 37 hours. After the freezing marathon, the city was left blanketed in snow, offering stunning winter scenes. Capitalizing on the moment, photographer Colin Hinkle of Soaring Badger Productions captured Chicago’s iconic landmarks using a GoPro camera mounted on a DJI Phantom 2 drone. Hinkle launched the drone in various neighborhoods, documenting a frozen cityscape known locally as 'Chiberia.' In his YouTube post accompanying the footage, he invited viewers to 'enjoy the beauty of a frigid Chicago from the warmth of your living room.' Filming over two weeks in January, Hinkle’s high-definition drone video offers breathtaking aerial views of Chicago’s skyline, CTA trains, Lake Michigan, Adler Planetarium, Northerly Island, the Chicago River, and the recently constructed Maggie Daley Park skating ribbon. According to News Mic, the result is 'hauntingly beautiful.' Many viewers commented on the footage, expressing renewed appreciation for the city and their community. On a technical note, due to shooting in high definition and the extreme cold, Hinkle had to replace the GoPro’s battery every ten minutes. Chicago, the third most populous city in the United States after New York City and Los Angeles, is showcased in a dramatic winter light. Additional footage, shared on Vimeo and social media, gives a bird’s-eye view of the arctic freeze. For more about Soaring Badger Productions, the Chicago-based production team, follow them on Twitter or Facebook.

article_content: At first, the international coalition to fight ISIS appeared uncertain. Secretary of State John Kerry returned from his Middle East tour with verbal support from over 40 Arab nations, but concrete actions were scarce. Now, five Sunni-led Arab countries—Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates, and Qatar—have joined the U.S. in launching airstrikes against ISIS in Syria. This collective action strengthens the coalition’s credibility. The U.S. confirmed the participation of these five Gulf nations, leaving it to each to disclose details of their involvement. Notably, the strikes, which marked the first time Syria was targeted in this conflict, included no Western allies to give the operation a distinctly Arab character—a departure from previous American military interventions. Some of these countries had already supported Syrian opposition groups, and Jordan has quietly hosted U.S.-backed training for Syrian rebels. However, the recent airstrikes represent their most prominent and direct involvement yet. President Barack Obama emphasized that defeating ISIS is a shared responsibility: 'The strength of this coalition makes it clear to the world that this is not America's fight alone. Above all, the people and governments of the Middle East are rejecting ISIL and standing up for the peace and security that the people of the region and the world deserve.' State Department officials assert that Arab nations have now made significant commitments to hinder ISIS. As Pentagon spokesman Rear Adm. John Kirby stated, 'Last night's strikes were only the beginning.' The U.S. predicts a prolonged effort to ultimately defeat ISIS, though it remains to be seen whether Arab support will last for the duration. The United Arab Emirates, a key U.S. partner, confirmed its participation and signaled openness to future actions. Bahrain and Jordan reported that their air forces struck targets in Syria, with Jordan pledging more action if necessary. Saudi Arabia acknowledged its involvement, while Qatar’s role was limited to non-combat support, as U.S. officials have confirmed that Qatar did not conduct airstrikes. Qatar’s inclusion, even in a support role, is symbolically important. The country has faced criticism from its neighbors over its support for the Muslim Brotherhood and allegations of ambiguous involvement in Syria. The U.S. has pressured Qatar to prevent its citizens from financing ISIS. While many nations support the anti-ISIS coalition, some—including Turkey and Egypt—have refrained from military engagement. Turkey cited as its reason the presence of 49 hostages previously held by ISIS, who have since been released. There are concerns that Turkey’s release of the hostages may be linked to its non-participation. President Obama and Secretary Kerry have both explained that the fight against ISIS is not solely military. Washington is urging Arab states to cut off ISIS’s funding, block the flow of foreign fighters (numbering about 10,000), and support Muslim clerics in denouncing ISIS's interpretation of Islam. Fears of terrorism’s regional expansion, heightened by ISIS’s growth and the large number of foreign fighters, are prompting Arab states toward more decisive action. Jordan, in particular, is dealing with the consequences of the Syrian crisis, including over 600,000 refugees. There is growing concern that returning fighters could destabilize neighboring governments. Ultimately, the coalition seeks to counter both the military might and extremist ideology of ISIS. 'We cannot destroy this group on our own.' Kerry told CNN. 'Defeating this common enemy calls for a common cause, and we're taking it on to succeed together.'
translated_content: सुरुमा, आईएसआईएसविरुद्ध लड्न बनेको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय गठबन्धन अन्योलपूर्ण देखिएको थियो। अमेरिकाका विदेशमन्त्री जॉन केरी ४० भन्दा बढी अरब देशहरूको मौखिक समर्थन लिएर फर्किए तापनि ठोस कदम कम थिए। अब पाँच सुन्नी मुलुक—साउदी अरेबिया, जोर्डन, बहरैन, संयुक्त अरब इमिरेट्स (यूएई) र कतार—ले अमेरिकासँगै सिरियामा आईएसआईएसविरुद्ध हवाई आक्रमण गरेका छन्। यस कदमले गठबन्धनको विश्वसनीयता बढाएको छ। यी पाँच गल्फ देशको सहभागिता अमेरिकाले पुष्टि गरे पनि, विस्तृत जानकारी तिनीहरूले आफैं सार्वजनिक गर्ने बताएका छन्। सिरियामा भएको यो पहिलो हमला हो र यसमा कुनै पश्चिमी मुलुक सामेल छैन, जसले यसलाई पूर्ण रूपमा अरब-मुख्य बनाएको छ। केही मुलुकले यसअघि सिरियन विपक्षी समूहलाई सहयोग गरेका थिए र जोर्डनमा अमेरिकी सहयोगमा सिरियन विद्रोहीका लागि तालिम दिइएको थियो। तर अहिलेको हवाई कारबाही अहिलेसम्मकै सबैभन्दा प्रत्यक्ष र खुलेको सहभागिता मानिएको छ। राष्ट्रपति बाराक ओबामाले भने, 'गठबन्धनको सशक्तताले देखाउँछ कि यो अमेरिकाको मात्र युद्ध होइन। मुख्य कुरा भनेकै मध्यपूर्वका जन तथा सरकार आईएसआईएललाई अस्वीकार गर्दै क्षेत्रको शान्ति र सुरक्षाका लागि उभिएका छन्।' स्टेट डिपार्टमेन्टले अब अरब राष्ट्रबाट आईएसआईएसविरुद्ध ठोस प्रतिबद्धता आएको जनाएको छ। पेन्टागनका प्रवक्ता रियर एड्मिरल जोन किर्बीका अनुसार, 'हिजो रातिको हमला शुरुवात मात्रै हो।' अमेरिका लामो अवधिसम्मको प्रयासको अपेक्षा गर्छ, यद्यपि अरब मुलुकहरूको साथ कति समय टिक्ने हो भन्ने प्रस्ट छैन। संयुक्त अरब इमिरेट्स (यूएई) ले आफ्नो सहभागिता पुष्टि गर्दै थप कारबाही खुल्ला रहेको जनाएको छ। बहरैन र जोर्डनले पनि हमला गरेको र जोर्डनले आवश्यक परे दोहोर्याउन सक्ने बताएको छ। साउदी अरेबियाले पनि भूमिका स्वीकारेको छ। कतारले प्रत्यक्ष हमला नगरेको अमेरिकी अधिकारीले पुष्टि गरेका छन्, त्यसैले उसको भूमिका सहायक मात्र थियो। कतारको समर्थन प्रतीकात्मक रूपमा महत्वपूर्ण छ। उसलाई छिमेकीले मुस्लिम ब्रदरहुडलाई समर्थन गरेको र सिरियामा अस्पष्ट भूमिका खेलेको भन्दै आलोचना गरेका छन्। अमेरिकाले कतारका नागरिकले आईएसआईएसलाई वित्तीय सहयोग नगरून् भनेर दबाव दिइरहेको छ। धेरै मुलुकले गठबन्धनको समर्थन गर्छन्, तर टर्की र इजिप्टले सैन्य कारबाहीमा भाग लिएका छैनन्। टर्कीले बन्धक बनाइएका ४९ नागरिक मुक्त नभएसम्म संलग्न हुन मानेको थिएन। बन्धक छुटेपछि अपुष्ट रूपमा टर्कीको असैनिक भूमिकासँग सम्बन्ध हुन सक्छ भन्ने आशंका छ। राष्ट्रपति ओबामा र सेक्रेटरी केरीले आईएसआईएसविरुद्धको अभियान केवल सैन्य नभएर आर्थिक स्रोत काट्ने, विदेशी लडाकू रोकिने र मुस्लिम धर्मगुरूको सहयोगमा चरम सोचाविरुद्ध अभियान सञ्चालन गर्नुपर्ने बताएका छन्। आईएसआईएसको विस्तार र हजारौं विदेशी लडाकू आएसँगै अरब मुलुकमा डर बढेको छ। जोर्डनमा ६ लाखभन्दा बढी सिरियन शरणार्थी छन्। फर्किने लडाकूले अस्थिरता ल्याउन सक्ने चिन्तासमेत छ। गठबन्धनको उद्देश्य आईएसआईएसका दुवै सैन्य र विचारधारात्मक पक्षलाई हराउनु हो। केरीले भने, article_content: On November 7, 2023, SAG-AFTRA, the union representing 160,000 actors, announced that it could not accept the latest contract offer from major Hollywood studios. The offer was presented to the union over the weekend as an attempt to end a strike that has halted film and television production for over four months. Key disagreements remain, particularly regarding artificial intelligence and compensation structures. The use of AI, especially the ability to use actors' likenesses in the future, has been a major sticking point in negotiations. Representatives from studios such as Disney, Netflix, Warner, Universal, Paramount, and Sony have been involved in the talks. High-level studio executives, including Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos, participated in recent discussions to try to resolve the dispute. The ongoing strike has created significant financial hardship for many actors and has delayed the release of major films and TV shows, including 'Dune: Part Two', the next 'Mission: Impossible' movie, and the upcoming season of 'Stranger Things'. Both sides have previously compromised on pay demands and bonus structures for hit productions. However, SAG-AFTRA maintains that current studio offers on AI protections do not go far enough. The cost of the industry shutdown is now estimated at $6.5 billion, with lost wages making up the majority of this amount. The writers' union, which had been on strike alongside SAG-AFTRA since July, reached an agreement and ended their strike in September. Negotiations between actors and studios remain ongoing.

Dr Maggie Aderin-Pocock, a researcher from UCL’s Department of Science and Technology Studies, predicts that roles such as estate agents, car salespeople, traffic wardens, and caregivers for both children and the elderly could be replaced by artificial intelligence over the next 50 years. Her research, which included a survey of 2,000 people, indicates that traffic wardens (65%), estate agents (40%), and car salespeople (33%) are seen as top candidates for automation, especially as these jobs are often unpopular.

This study, conducted with the television channel Syfy, points to rapid progress in AI that could make robots a common feature in the workplace, especially in service and care sectors. Dr Aderin-Pocock suggests that robots may soon be able to handle tasks like issuing parking tickets, providing flexible and attentive care, and even assisting with education and childcare, by interacting intelligently based on individual needs.

The research also references concerns from leading figures such as Elon Musk and Stephen Hawking. In an open letter organized by the Future of Life Institute, they highlight both the substantial societal benefits and serious risks of AI, calling for safeguards so that the technology advances safely. They point to potential gains in health and poverty reduction, but warn of possible dangers such as widespread unemployment and the risks of machines outsmarting human creators.

Even so, Dr Aderin-Pocock expresses optimism, noting that technology has previously opened up new possibilities. She foresees the emergence of industries like space tourism as AI and robotics reduce the need for humans in many traditional jobs, following historical patterns seen with flight and information technology.

UCL को विज्ञान तथा प्रविधि अध्ययन विभागकी अनुसन्धानकर्ता डा. माग्गी एदरिन-पोकोकले निकट भविष्यका ५० वर्षभित्र घरजग्गा एजेन्ट, गाडी विक्रेता, ट्राफिक वार्डेन, अनि बालबालिका तथा वृद्धहरूको स्याहारकर्ता जस्ता पेशाहरू कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ताबाट प्रतिस्थापित हुनसक्ने भविष्यवाणी गरेकी छन्। २,००० जनामाथि गरिएको सर्वेक्षण अनुसार, ट्राफिक वार्डेन (६५%), घरजग्गा एजेन्ट (४०%) र गाडी विक्रेता (३३%) यस्ता पेशा हुन् जसमा सबैभन्दा पहिले स्वचालन आउन सक्ने जनाइएको छ, विशेष गरी यी कामहरू जनप्रिय नभएकोले।

सिफाइ टिभीसँग गरिएको अनुसन्धानअनुसार, सेवा र स्याहार क्षेत्रका जागिरहरूमा रोबोट छिट्टै देखिन सक्ने प्रष्ट देखिन्छ। डा. एदरिन-पोकोकका अनुसार, कुनै दिन रोबोटहरूले पार्किङ टिकट काट्नेदेखि लिएर, संवेदनशील र व्यक्तिगत स्याहार दिन र शिक्षामा सहयोग पुर्याउन जस्ता काम गर्न सक्नेछन्, र तिनीहरूले फरक–फरक आवश्यकता अनुसार कुराकानी गर्नसमेत सक्नेछन्।

यस अनुसन्धानमा एलन मस्क, स्टेफन हकिङ लगायत चर्चित व्यक्तिहरूको चिन्ता पनि समावेश गरिएको छ। फ्युचर अफ लाइफ इन्स्टिच्युटको नेतृत्वमा गरिएको खुल्ला पत्रमा, उनीहरूले समाजका लागि फाइदा पुर्याउने गरी सुरक्षित रूपमा कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता विकास गर्नुपर्नेमा जोड दिएका छन्। स्वास्थ्य र गरिबी न्यूनीकरणजस्ता ठूला सम्भावना देखिए पनि, यसमा बेरोजगारी र अत्यधिक बुद्धिमत्ता भएका प्रविधिको नियन्त्रण गुमाउने भयसमेत देखाइएको छ।

यति हुँदाहुँदै पनि, डा. एदरिन-पोकोक आशावादी रहेको बताउँछिन्। इतिहास अनुसार प्रविधिले सधैं नयाँ अवसरहरू ल्याएको र भविष्यमा अन्तरिक्ष पर्यटन जस्ता नयाँ उद्योग फस्टाउने उनको विश्वास छ। कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ताले परम्परागत पेशाहरूको आवश्यकता घटाउँदै लैजाँदा उडान र सूचना प्रविधिको विकास जस्तै परिवर्तन ल्याउन सक्छ।

article_content: Norman Tebbit, once known for his formidable presence as a cabinet minister under Margaret Thatcher, is showing a new side through the publication of his children's novel, 'Ben's Story.' Famously nicknamed ‘the Chingford skinhead’ for his tough approach in politics and parodied for his fierceness on the satire show Spitting Image, Lord Tebbit’s latest project reveals a notably gentler aspect. 'Ben's Story' revolves around Sam, a 14-year-old boy left paralyzed after a car crash that killed his journalist father. Suspecting the crash was not an accident, Sam sets out to uncover the truth, helped by Ben — a talking yellow labrador named after Tebbit’s own late dog — and Alice Bacon, an eccentric former spy inspired by renowned MI6 operative Dame Daphne Park. The novel, described as a contemporary tale of murder, friendship, adversity, and personal struggle, addresses modern challenges such as divorce and drug addiction. Tebbit draws from his own experiences, notably the 1984 IRA bombing in Brighton, which left his wife Margaret with severe injuries and himself buried in the rubble. Both in the story and in real life, support comes from specially trained assistance dogs provided by Canine Partners, the same organization that offered help to the Tebbits. The character Ben is based on their own labrador, who died five years ago. This novel follows Tebbit’s previous literary work, the recipe book 'The Game Cook.' 'Ben’s Story' also features real places and personalities linked to Tebbit’s political past. According to Tebbit, Dame Daphne Park, a distinguished MI6 agent, was the inspiration for Alice Bacon. Tebbit remarked that the book often tells the story from the dog’s perspective. Rupert Matthews from Bretwalda, the publisher, noted that Tebbit’s personal experiences with life-changing injuries lent authenticity to the story’s portrayal of adversity. 'Ben’s Story' will be published on June 1.
translated_content: मार्गरेट थ्याचरको सरकारका मन्त्रीका रूपमा कठोर छविका लागि चर्चित नर्मन टेबिट अहिले आफ्नो बाल उपन्यास 'बेनस् स्टोरी' मार्फत नयाँ रूपमा देखिएका छन्। ‘द चिंगफोर्ड स्किनहेड’ उपनाम पाएका र व्यंग्यात्मक कार्यक्रम Spitting Image मा कडा स्वभावको पात्रका रूपमा प्रदर्शन गरिएको टेबिटले, यसपटक आफ्नो कोमल पक्ष प्रस्तुत गरेका छन्। 'बेनस् स्टोरी' १४ वर्षीय सैम वरिपरि केन्द्रित छ, जो कार दुर्घटनापछि अपांग भएका छन् र उनका पत्रकार पिता मारिन जान्छन्। स्यामलाई दुर्घटना संयोग मात्र नभएको शंका छ, अनि उनी साँचो पत्ता लगाउन बेन — टेबिटकै आफ्नै स्व. ल्याब्राडोरबाट नाम राखिएको बोल्न सक्ने पहेंलो कुकुर — र एमआई ६ को ख्यातिप्राप्त एजेन्ट डेफ्ने पार्कबाट प्रेरित पूर्व जासुस एलिस बेकनको सहयोग लिन्छन्। अपराध, मित्रता, adversity (सङ्घर्ष) र व्यक्तिगत संघर्षलाई समेटेको यो आधुनिक कथा डिभोर्स र लागू औषध दुर्व्यसनजस्ता विषय उठाउँछ। टेबिटले सन् १९८४ को ब्राइटन आइ.आर.ए. बम धमाकाबाट आफ्नै अनुभव कथामा समावेश गरेका छन्, जसमा उनकी पत्नी मार्गरेट गम्भीर घाइते भइन् र उनी आफै भग्नावशेषमा च्याम्पिएका थिए। कथामा र वास्तविक जीवन दुवैमा, Canine Partners संस्थाले तालिम दिएका विशेष सहयोगी कुकुरले मद्दत गर्दछ, जस्तै टेबिटको आफ्नै पाँच वर्षअघि बितेको ल्याब्राडोर बेन। यो उपन्यास टेबिटको अघिल्लो कृति 'द गेम कुक' पछि आएको हो। 'बेनस् स्टोरी' मा टेबिटसँग सम्बन्धित वास्तविक स्थान र पात्रहरू समेत छन्। डेफ्ने पार्क एलिस बेकनको प्रेरणा हुन् भन्ने टेबिटले भनेका छन्, साथै घटनाहरू कुकुरकै दृष्टिकोणबाट मूलतः प्रस्तुत गरिएका छन्। Bretwalda प्रकाशकका रूपर्ट म्याथ्यूजका अनुसार, टेबिटले जीवन परिवर्तन गर्ने चोट अनि संघर्षको आफ्नै अनुभव कथालाई सजीव बनाइदिएको छ। 'बेनस् स्टोरी' जुन १ मा प्रकाशित हुँदैछ।

article_content: Rick Santorum stated that Puerto Rico would need to make English its principal language to become a U.S. state, which drew criticism from the island's only congressional representative, Pedro Pierluisi. Pierluisi argued that Santorum's view was narrow and not aligned with America's inclusive ideals, emphasizing that English is already widely spoken in the U.S., regardless of Puerto Rico's status. Puerto Rico will vote in November on a referendum about possible statehood. While campaigning before Puerto Rico’s primary, Santorum told a newspaper that English should be the main language for statehood. However, there is no federal law or constitutional requirement mandating an official language for new states, despite several states choosing English officially. Both English and Spanish are official languages in Puerto Rico, although Spanish is dominant. Santorum continued campaigning on the island, stating that Puerto Rico should be bilingual to integrate into American society, and that English should be widely spoken there. He clarified that Spanish would still be spoken but emphasized the importance of English. Mitt Romney is also campaigning in Puerto Rico, with Governor Luis Fortuño endorsing him. Romney’s campaign clarified that although Romney supports expanding English proficiency as an opportunity, he would not require Puerto Rico to stop using Spanish as a condition for statehood. Puerto Rico’s primary takes place just before a key contest in Illinois. One Santorum delegate, Hector Perez, withdrew his support over Santorum’s language remarks and was replaced by an alternate delegate. The Republican primary race remains competitive, with recent Southern wins invigorating Santorum’s campaign. Romney leads in delegates and recently won in Hawaii and American Samoa, but faces strong competition from Santorum. Newt Gingrich’s campaign has lost momentum, while Ron Paul trails the other candidates. Party analysts comment on the unpredictable and prolonged nature of the Republican nomination process. Delegate counts show Santorum has won 10 states, while Romney has 18. Romney’s campaign is focusing on building support and making the case for his leadership, while Santorum argues that substance matters more than delegate math. Illinois is expected to be a closely contested state, with both campaigns investing resources and bringing in key supporters. Chris Christie is joining Romney to campaign in Illinois. Gingrich continues to campaign in the South, despite calls for him to withdraw to help consolidate conservative support behind Santorum. Gingrich believes no candidate may secure the nomination before the August convention. After Puerto Rico and Illinois, Santorum and Romney are projected to split upcoming contests. The race will continue with attention shifting to other states and regions in the following weeks.
translated_content: रिक सन्तोरमले प्यूर्टो रिकोलाई अमेरिकाको राज्य बन्न अंग्रेजी मुख्य भाषा बनाउनुपर्ने बताएका छन्, जसको टापुको एक मात्रै कांग्रेसी सदस्य पेद्रो पिएरुलिसीले आलोचना गरेका छन्। पिएरुलिसीले सन्तोरमको दृष्टिकोण संकुचित र अमेरिकाका समावेशी आदर्शसँग मेल नखाने बताएका छन्, साथै प्यूर्टो रिकोको अवस्था जे भए पनि अमेरिकामा अंग्रेजी पहिले नै व्यापक रूपमा बोलिन्छ भनेर जोड दिएका छन्। प्यूर्टो रिकोले सम्भावित राज्य सम्बन्धी जनमत संग्रह नोभेम्बरमा गर्नेछ। प्यूर्टो रिकोको प्राइमरी अघि प्रचार गर्दै, सन्तोरमले एक पत्रिकालाई राज्य बन्न अंग्रेजी मुख्य भाषा हुनुपर्छ भने। तर नयाँ राज्यका लागि अधिकारिक भाषा अनिवार्य गर्ने कुनै संघीय कानुन वा संवैधानिक आवश्यकता छैन, यद्यपि केही राज्यहरूले अंग्रेजीलाई अधिकारिक भाषा बनाएका छन्। प्यूर्टो रिकोमा अंग्रेजी र स्पेनिश दुवै अधिकारिक भाषा हुन्, तर स्पेनिश नै प्रचलित छ। सन्तोरमले टापुमा प्रचार जारी राख्दै, अमेरिकी समाजमा एकीकरणका लागि प्यूर्टो रिको दुई भाषिक हुनुपर्ने, र अंग्रेजी व्यापक रूपमा बोलिनुपर्ने बताए। उनले स्पेनिश पनि प्रयोग हुने नै स्पष्ट पारे, तर अंग्रेजीको महत्वमा जोड दिए। मिट रोम्नी पनि प्यूर्टो रिकोमा प्रचार गर्दैछन्, जहाँ गभर्नर लुइस फोर्टुनोले उनलाई समर्थन गरेका छन्। रोम्नीको अभियानले भनेको छ— रोम्नीले अंग्रेजी दक्षता बढाउनलाई अवसरको रुपमा समर्थन गर्छन्, तर राज्य बन्न प्यूर्टो रिकोलाई स्पेनिश छोड्नुपर्छ भन्ने सर्त राख्दैनन्। प्यूर्टो रिकोको प्राइमरी प्रमुख इलिनोइसको प्रतिस्पर्धा भन्दा ठीकअघि हुँदैछ। सन्तोरमका प्रतिनिधि हेक्तर पेरेजले भाषागत टिप्पणीका कारण समर्थन फिर्ता लिएका थिए र उनलाई वैकल्पिक प्रतिनिधिले प्रतिस्थापन गरेका छन्। गणतान्त्रिक पार्टीको प्राइमरी प्रतिस्पर्धा कडा छ; दक्षिणी राज्यमा हालैका जितले सन्तोरमको अभियानलाई ऊर्जा दिएको छ। डेलीगेट संख्यामा रोम्नी अगाडि छन् र उनले हालै हवाई र अमेरिकन समोआमा जितेका छन्, तर सन्तोरमसँग कडा प्रतिस्पर्धा छ। न्युट गिङ्रिचको अभियान कमजोर बन्दै गएको छ भने रोन पॉल अन्य उम्मेदवारभन्दा पछाडि छन्। पार्टी विश्लेषकहरू अनुसार गणतान्त्रिक उम्मेदवार छनोट प्रक्रिया अनिश्चित छ। डेलीगेट गणनामा सन्तोरमले १०, रोम्नीले १८ राज्य जितेका छन्। रोम्नीको अभियान समर्थन बढाउन र नेतृत्व देखाउनमा केन्द्रित छ, सन्तोरमले भने विषयवस्तु महत्वपूर्ण भएको तर्क गर्छन्। इलिनोइस कडा प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक छ, दुबै अभियानले स्रोत र प्रमुख समर्थक जुटाउदैछन्। क्रिस क्रिस्टी इलिनोइसमा रोम्नीको प्रचारमा सहभागी हुँदैछन्। गिङ्रिचले दक्षिणमा प्रचार जारी राखेका छन्, सन्तोरमको पक्षमा संरक्षणवादी मत एकताबद्ध गर्न आफू हट्नुपर्ने आवाज बढ्दो छ। गिङ्रिच विश्वास गर्छन्— कुनै उम्मेदवारले अगस्ट सम्मेलनपछि मात्र बहुमत पाउन सक्छ। प्यूर्टो रिको र इलिनोइसपछि, सन्तोरम र रोम्नीले बाँकी प्रतियोगिताहरू बाँड्ने अनुमान छ। प्रतिस्पर्धा अन्य राज्यतर्फ सर्दै जानेछ।

article_content: Alphabet, the parent company of Google, recently let go of around three dozen employees from its Google News division. The exact number has not been confirmed, but the layoffs were referenced by Command Line and appear to have focused on senior-level staff, including some directors. While this round of cuts is smaller compared to January's layoff of 12,000 employees and recent reductions in the recruiting division, it appears to be targeted. At a company-wide meeting following the layoffs, Shailesh Prakash, Vice President of Google News, reportedly explained that the reductions were to streamline operations, noting that the company over-hired during the pandemic period. Google has not responded to Insider’s requests for comment.

Privacy is a major topic for many, but when it comes to smartphones, few take real action to safeguard it. Smartphones, no matter if they're running Android or iOS, gather a wide array of user data that gets sent to technology companies—both big and small. It's important to recognize that this data-gathering happens in the background, whether you're worried about it or not. Every time you use your device, both manufacturers and software providers collect information about your usage. Apps, Google, and Apple collect user data under privacy policy agreements, though carriers might share information more broadly. For most users, this exchange—data for apps and services—is an accepted part of using a smartphone. Essentially, your personal information is the price you pay for these digital conveniences.

However, Android’s open-source foundation means there are privacy-focused alternatives. Companies like Murena use this flexibility to create versions such as /e/os, which strip out Google’s data collection to offer a more private experience. This openness lets smaller players build unique Android devices without needing to be major brands like Samsung. However, if you want to use Google apps like Gmail or Google Search, stricter agreements apply—and more data is shared.

By using Google-powered phones, you typically give up a lot of personal data in exchange for advanced features. Google uses this info to target ads, increasing the effectiveness of their advertising business. The company does not sell your individual data; rather, it leverages what it knows to better match ads to users. Whether this trade-off feels acceptable is a personal decision.

If you want to minimize data collection from Google, Samsung, or Apple, you do have choices. Devices like Murena One, with /e/os, offer core smartphone functions (web browsing, email, navigation, and more) while keeping your data private. Some models, such as Murena 2, even have hardware switches to disable the camera and microphone for greater security. There are some trade-offs—certain Google services are missing—but the main smartphone experience remains strong for those who value privacy.

A key feature in these privacy-centric phones is granular control over app tracking and even the ability to mask your location from apps that request it. For those looking to step outside the ecosystems of Big Tech, products from Murena and Fairphone show that protecting your privacy is both possible and practical.

गोपनीयता धेरै मानिसका लागि महत्त्वपूर्ण विषय भए पनि, धेरैजसोले स्मार्टफोन प्रयोग गर्दा यसलाई जोगाउन खासै प्रयास गर्दैनन्। चाहे Android होस् या iOS, स्मार्टफोनले प्रयोगकर्ताको डेटा विभिन्न साना-ठूला प्रविधि कम्पनीहरूसम्म पुर्‍याउँछ। यो प्रक्रिया तपाईंले विचार गरे पनि नगरे पनि, पृष्ठभूमिमा भइरहेकै हुन्छ। तपाईंले फोन चलाउँदा, निर्माता र सफ्टवेयर कम्पनीहरूले तपाईंको गतिविधिबारे जानकारी सङ्कलन गर्छन्। एप, गुगल र एप्पलले तपाईंको डेटा संकलन गर्छन्, र मोबाइल सेवा प्रदायकले अझै खुल्ला रूपमा यो जानकारी बाँड्न सक्छन्। प्रायः प्रयोगकर्ताका लागि, सुविधा र सेवाबापत आफ्नो व्यक्तिगत विवरण साट्नु अहिले सामान्य कुरा भइसकेको छ।

तर, Android को खुला स्रोत भएकाले गोपनीयता केन्द्रित विकल्पहरू छन्। Murena जस्ता कम्पनीहरूले Android को स्रोतकोड लिएर गुगलको ट्र्याकिङ हटाएको /e/os जस्ता प्रणाली निर्माण गरेका छन्, जसले प्रयोगकर्तालाई निजी अनुभव दिन्छ। यस्तो खुलापनले साना कम्पनीलाई पनि आफ्ना युनिक Android डिभाइस बनाउन सजिलो बनाएको छ। तर, Gmail वा Google Search जस्ता एप प्रयोग गर्न चाहियो भने भने, कडाइका साथ नियम मान्नुपर्छ र बढी व्यक्तिगत डेटा साझेदारी गर्नुपर्छ।

गुगल आधारित फोन चलाउँदा, तपाईंले सुविधाबापत धेरै व्यक्तिगत जानकारी साट्नु हुन्छ। गुगले यी जानकारी विज्ञापनमा प्रयोग गर्छ र तपाईंबाट हासिल थुप्रै विवरणको भनाइ ठुलो कारोबारमा रुपान्तरण गर्छ। कम्पनीले व्यक्तिगत डेटा नबेच्ने दाबी गर्छ, तर तपाईंका विवरणलाई उपयुक्त विज्ञापन दिन प्रयोग गर्छ। यस्तो डेटा विनिमय स्वीकार्न चाहनुहुन्छ कि छैन, त्यो तपाईंको व्यक्तिगत निर्णय हो।

गुगल, सामसुङ वा एप्पलबाट डेटा संकलन कम गर्न चाहनुहुन्छ भने, तपाईंलाई विकल्पहरू छन्। Murena One जस्तो /e/os भएको फोनमा झ्याउलिएको ब्राउजर, इमेल, नेभिगेसन र आवश्यक सुविधा पाइन्छ अनि डेटा सुरक्षित रहन्छ। Murena 2 जस्ता केही फोनमा त क्यामेरा र माइक्रोफोन नै स्विचले बन्द गर्न सकिन्छ। केही गुगल सेवा नपाइए पनि, मुख्य स्मार्टफोनको अनुभव अझै कायम रहन्छ।

यस्ता गोपनीयता केन्द्रित फोनको मजबूत पक्ष एपहरू कुन-कुन डेटामा पहुँच गर्छन् भन्ने स्पष्ट देख्न मिल्ने र आवश्यक परेमा लोकेशन लुकाउन सकिने सुविधा हो। प्रविधि कम्पनीहरूको सञ्जाल बाहिर गोपनियता चाहनेका लागि Murena र Fairphone जस्ता विकल्पहरूले निजी डिजिटल जीवन सम्भव बनाएका छन्।

article_content: The United States has urged Israel to differentiate between Hamas militants and Palestinian civilians as Israel increases its military actions following the October 7 Hamas attack. At a recent press conference, Vedant Patel, Principal Deputy Spokesperson of the US State Department, underlined America’s expectation that Israel take further measures to safeguard innocent civilians. Patel explained that senior US officials have directly communicated these concerns to the Israeli government and are closely observing whether Israel improves its efforts to protect civilians. The US also clarified its position on the concept of a ‘humanitarian pause’ in Gaza, emphasizing that any break in the fighting should allow humanitarian aid into Gaza but must not permit Hamas to reorganize, rebuild strength, or continue holding hostages. Patel underscored American warnings to Hezbollah and similar groups not to take advantage of the conflict to escalate violence. According to the Israeli Foreign Ministry, Hamas has launched over 9,500 rockets into Israel since early October. Israeli authorities say that at least 239 people—including Israeli citizens and nationals from countries such as Thailand, Argentina, Germany, the United States, France, Russia, Hungary, Poland, Portugal, the UK, the Philippines, Romania, Tanzania, and others—are currently being held hostage in Gaza. The Israel Airports Authority announced that since the war began, over 330,000 Israelis have returned from abroad, expanding the national population by nearly 3.5%. Conversely, Israel's Central Bureau of Statistics recorded a sharp drop in foreign visitors, with only about 98,600 people entering the country in October—a 73% decrease compared to the same month last year. The Israeli military reports that since October 7, its forces have hit more than 14,000 targets in Gaza and have killed thousands of Hamas militants both on the surface and underground.

article_content: Saif al-Islam Gadhafi, 38, has never known a Libya without his father, Moammar Gadhafi, as the country's leader. Recently, as the Libyan government faced intense public protests, it was Saif—Moammar's second eldest son—who addressed the nation with a plan to respond instead of his father. Saif's speech, delivered early Monday on national television, did not indicate he has taken power from his father. Senior U.S. officials stated that there is no sign that Moammar Gadhafi is losing control. Nevertheless, many wondered why Saif was chosen to speak for the government. No official reason was provided for Moammar's absence, even as state television continued to show images of him receiving public support in Tripoli. David Schencker of the Washington Institute for Near East Affairs describes Moammar Gadhafi as 'consistently inconsistent,' making his actions difficult to predict. Saif is often seen as very different from his father. Michele Dunne of the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace said Saif does not appear to be a disliked figure and has shown positive intentions. While Moammar Gadhafi sought to eliminate foreign ideologies in Libya, Saif speaks fluent English, earned a PhD from the London School of Economics, wrote an op-ed in the New York Times, and frequently engaged with international officials. Moammar is known for his tribal attire and Bedouin tent, while Saif, well-traveled himself, wore a Western-style suit and tie during his recent address. Before his 2009 appointment as General Coordinator, Saif primarily led the Gadhafi Foundation, a charity. Instead of labeling Islamic militants as terrorists, Saif's organization recently arranged for the release of 110 Libyan Islamic Fighting Group members from prison. Whereas Moammar has ruled Libya with a strict hand, limiting civil rights, Saif has advocated for human rights and called for institutional reforms that could expand freedoms. However, his efforts have been hindered by limited actual authority. Although some NGOs and media outlets were permitted into Libya in recent years, access remained tightly controlled and progress stalled. Schencker observed that Saif was occasionally given freedom to discuss reforms, like a new constitution, but these initiatives were soon reined in. Until recently, many analysts considered Saif's brother Mutassim, the national security advisor, more influential than Saif. Despite Saif's focus on rights and international openness, experts such as Dunne believe his recent speech does not indicate he will replace his father. Dunne, also editor of the Arab Reform Bulletin, considers Saif's attempt to propose major political reforms unlikely to succeed. There is little sign that opposition groups will end their protests, or that Libya will liberalize after 42 years of Moammar's rule. Ultimately, Saif's reputation globally is tied to his father's leadership. Even if he seems more open to change, his loyalty is to Moammar, who has given no sign of stepping down or surrendering control. According to Dunne, Gadhafi family promises of reform are met with skepticism among Libyans.
translated_content: सैफ अल-इस्लाम गद्दाफी, ३८, ले कहिल्यै आफ्ना पिता मोअम्मर गद्दाफी बिना लिवियाको शासन देखेका छैनन्। हालसालै, लिविया सरकारले जनप्रदर्शनको सामना गरिरहँदा, देशलाई सम्बोधन गर्ने काम—आफ्ना पिता भन्दा अगाडि—सैफ, मोअम्मरका दोस्रो छोरा, ले गरे। सोमबार बिहानै राष्ट्रिय टेलिभिजनमा दिइएको सैफको भाषणले उनले आफ्ना बुबाबाट शक्ति लिएको संकेत गर्दैन। अमेरिकाका वरिष्ठ अधिकारीहरूले मोअम्मर गद्दाफीले अझै नियन्त्रण कायम राखिरहेको बताएका छन्। तर पनि, धेरैले सरकारको तर्फबाट किन सैफ बोलिरहेका छन् भनेर चासो व्यक्त गरे। मोअम्मरको अनुपस्थितिको कुनै आधिकारिक कारण दिइएको थिएन, यद्यपि सरकारी टिभीले उनलाई त्रिपोलीमा जनसमर्थन पाइरहेको देखाउँदै रह्यो। वासिङ्टन इन्स्टिच्युट फर नियर इस्ट अफेयर्सका डेविड शेंकरका अनुसार, मोअम्मर गद्दाफी सधैँ अनिश्चयता देखाउने नेताका रूपमा परिचित छन्। सैफ प्रायः आफ्ना बुवाभन्दा धेरै फरक देखिन्छन्। कार्नेगी इन्डाउमेन्ट फर इन्टरनेशनल पीसकी मिशेल डनले सैफलाई घृणा गरिएको पात्र नभएको र सकारात्मक सोच देखाएको बताइन्। जहाँ मोअम्मर गद्दाफीले विदेशी विचारधारालाई हटाउने प्रयास गरेका थिए, त्यहाँ सैफले अंग्रेजीमा सहजता, लण्डन स्कूल अफ इकनमिक्सबाट पिएचडी, न्युयोर्क टाइम्समा लेख र अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अधिकारीहरूसँग निरन्तर सम्पर्क देखाएका छन्। मोअम्मर पारम्परिक वन्य वस्त्र र बेडौइन टेन्टका लागि चिनिन्छन्, भने सैफले पछिल्लो सम्बोधनमा पश्चिमेली शैलीको सुट र टाई लगाएका थिए। २००९ मा जनरल कोर्डिनेटर नियुक्त हुनु अघि, सैफ गद्दाफी फाउन्डेसन भन्ने च्यारिटीको नेतृत्व गर्थे। इस्लामिक लडाकुहरुलाई 'आतङ्कवादी' भनेको सट्टा, सैफको संस्थाले हालै लिवियन इस्लामिक फाइटिङ ग्रुपका ११० सदस्यको जेलमुक्ति गराएको थियो। जहाँ मोअम्मरले कडा शासन गरेर नागरिक अधिकार सीमित गरेका छन्, सैफले मानव अधिकार र संस्थागत सुधारका लागि आवाज उठाएका छन्, जसले देशमा स्वतन्त्रता विस्तार गर्न सक्थ्यो। तर, उनका प्रयासहरू साँचो अधिकारको अभावले कमजोर छन्। पछिल्लो वर्षहरूमा केही एनजिओ र मिडिया लिवियामा प्रवेश पाए पनि पहुँच कडाईका साथ नियन्त्रण गरिन्थ्यो र प्रगति थलिएको थियो। शेंकरले सैफलाई कहिलेकाहीँ नयाँ संविधानजस्ता सुधारको कुरा गर्न छुट दिइएको तर ती प्रयासहरू छिट्टै रोकिएको बताए। धेरै विश्लेषकले हालसम्म सैफका भाइ मुतासिम (राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा सल्लाहकार) लाई बढी शक्तिशाली मानी आएका थिए। अधिकार र अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय खुलापनमा केन्द्रीत भए तापनि, विश्लेषकहरु जस्तै डनले सैफको पछिल्लो भाषणले उनी बाबुको स्थान लिन्छन् जस्तो देख्दैनन्। डन, जो अरब रिफर्म बुलेटिनकी सम्पादक पनि हुन्, सैफको ठूला सुधार प्रस्ताव असफल हुने सम्भावना देख्छिन्। बिरोध प्रदर्शनकारीहरू आफ्नो माग अन्त्य गर्ने संकेत छैन, न त लिविया ४२ वर्षको शासकीय कठोरता पछाडि उदार बन्ने। अन्ततः, सैफको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय छवि बाबुको नेतृत्वसँग गाँसिएको छ। उनले शायद परिवर्तनमैत्री देखाए तापनि, उनको प्राथमिकता मोअम्मर नै हुन्, जसले सत्ता त्याग्ने कुनै संकेत दिइरहेका छैनन्। डनका अनुसार, गद्दाफी परिवारका सुधारका आश्वासनहरू लिवियनहरूमाझ अविश्वासित छन्।

article_content: The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA), an organization founded in 2019 by Adobe, The New York Times, and Twitter, has launched a new universal symbol to promote trust and transparency in the digital content ecosystem, especially in the era of AI-generated material. The new symbol, called the "Content Credentials" icon, indicates that essential information about an online media's origins and history is attached. As AI-generated content and misinformation spread rapidly online, it's becoming harder to know what is real, accurate, and trustworthy. The C2PA, which brings together the Content Authenticity Initiative (CAI) and Project Origin, was created to develop open standards that link provenance data to digital media. Provenance means documenting the history of ownership, custody, or location of an object. For digital content, this includes details about its origin, editing history, distribution, and other context. Similar to an artist signing a painting or a manufacturer marking products, the C2PA seeks to develop techniques to "sign" digital media globally. After extensive research and design, the C2PA steering committee selected a minimalist "CR" symbol as the mark of digital provenance. This icon is meant to be widely recognizable as an indicator that more information on the content is available. Hovering over the icon brings up a sidebar with detailed provenance credentials, like a digital nutrition label. The credentials can include verified data such as creator name, creation date and location, editing history, and if AI tools were used. Privacy is considered as well, making identity details optional. The icon is designed to be simple, flexible, and easy for companies and developers to integrate across different platforms. As an open-source symbol, it encourages adoption from various organizations. To succeed, the Content Credentials icon needs to become as familiar as the copyright symbol. Members like Adobe, Microsoft, BBC, and more are beginning to incorporate the icon and standards into their products. Social platforms, news publishers, and marketing campaigns are encouraged to adopt it. The aim is for the symbol to be so widely used that it becomes a universal mark of authenticity, helping combat misinformation online. Broad industry adoption is needed for the C2PA to make transparency and trust fundamental in the digital world. The Content Credentials icon marks a significant step towards restoring trust in our digital lives. Featured Image Credit: Savvas Stavrinos/Pexels.
translated_content: कन्टेन्ट प्रुभेनेन्स एन्ड अथेन्टिसिटी (C2PA) २०१९ मा Adobe, द न्युयोर्क टाईम्स र ट्विटर द्वारा स्थापना गरिएको संस्था हो। यसले डिजिटल सामग्रीको क्षेत्रमा विश्वस्त र पारदर्शिता बढाउन नयाँ सार्वभौमिक चिह्न (सिंबल) ल्याएको छ, विशेष गरी एआई जनरेटेड सामग्रीको युगमा । "Content Credentials" नामक यो नयाँ चिन्हले अनलाइन मिडियाको उत्पत्ति र इतिहाससम्बन्धी महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी जोडिएको संकेत दिन्छ। एआई जनित सामग्री र गलत सूचना तीव्र गतिमा फैलिरहँदा, अनलाइन के वास्तवमै सत्य, सही र भरपर्दो हो भन्ने थाहा पाउन गाह्रो हुँदैछ। C2PA, जसले Content Authenticity Initiative (CAI) र Project Origin सँग सहकार्य गर्छ, डिजिटल मिडियामा प्रुभेनेन्स डाटा जोड्ने खुला मापदण्ड विकास गर्न बनेको हो। प्रुभेनेन्स भनेको वस्तुको स्वामित्व, हेरचाह वा स्थानको इतिहास अभिलेख गर्नु हो। डिजिटल कन्टेन्टका लागि, यसमा त्यसको उत्पत्ति, सम्पादन इतिहास, वितरण र अन्य सन्दर्भात्मक विवरण समावेश हुन्छ। कलाकारले चित्रमा हस्ताक्षर गर्ने वा उत्पादकले उत्पादनमा छाप लगाउने जस्तै, C2PA ले डिजिटल मिडियालाई विश्वव्यापी रूपमा 'चिन्ह लगाउने' प्रविधि विकास गर्न चाहन्छ। धेरै अनुसन्धान र डिजाइनपछि, C2PA स्टीयरिङ कमिटीले डिजिटल प्रुभेनेन्सको चिन्हको रूपमा सिम्पल 'CR' सिंबल चयन गरेको छ। यो चिन्ह सामग्रीको थप जानकारी उपलब्ध छ भन्ने संकेतका रूपमा पहिचान योग्य हुने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ। यस चिन्हमा कर्सर राख्दा विस्तृत प्रुभेनेन्स क्रेडेन्सियल्स देखिने साइडबार खुल्छ, जुन डिजिटल न्यूट्रिशन लेबलजस्तै हो। क्रेडेन्सियल्समा सृष्टिकर्ताको नाम, निर्माण मिति र स्थान, सम्पादन इतिहास, तथा एआई उपकरणको प्रयोग गरिएको भए त्यो समेत समावेश हुन्छ। गोपनीयता विचार गर्दै, विवरण वैकल्पिक बनाइएको छ। यो चिन्ह सजिलो, लचिलो र विभिन्न प्लेटफर्ममा छिटो एकीकृत गर्न सकिने गरी डिजाइन गरिएको हो। खुला स्रोत सिंबल भएकाले, विभिन्न संस्थाले सहजै अपनाउन सक्छन्। यसले सफल हुन, Content Credentials चिन्ह सामान्‍य प्रतिमा (कॉपीराइट जस्तो) सरह चिनिनु आवश्यक छ। Adobe, Microsoft, BBC लगायतका सदस्यहरुले यो चिन्ह र मापदण्ड आफ्नो उत्पादनमा प्रयोग गर्न थालेका छन्। सामाजिक सञ्जाल, समाचार प्रकाशक र मार्केटिङ क्याम्पेनहरुलाई यो चिन्ह अपनाउन article_content: A spectacular automotive homage to Stonehenge, called 'Carhenge,' has been listed for sale for $300,000 (£185,000). Carhenge is a creative tribute to the prehistoric stone monument, where 38 classic American cars replace the original stones. Located in rural Nebraska, it was built by American sculptor Jim Reinders in 1987 and matches Stonehenge's dimensions, measuring 96 feet in diameter. The current owners, the nonprofit group Friends of Carhenge, can no longer afford to operate it and are seeking entrepreneurs interested in purchasing the ten-acre plot for $300,000 (£185,000). They hope the buyer will continue to promote Carhenge as a unique tourist destination, which currently attracts around 100,000 visitors each year. All of the cars are spray-painted grey to look like stone. Some are set upright in five-foot-deep pits, while others are welded together to form arches. The arrangement mirrors the modern layout of Stonehenge, including fallen pillars, rather than the original formation built between 2500 and 2000 BC. To maintain its all-American theme, Friends of Carhenge removed two Japanese-built cars in 1992. The site’s 'heel-stone' is a 1962 Cadillac. The sale, managed by Wyoming estate agent Curt James, is for what some call America's second wackiest attraction, after a Texas toilet seat museum. James says Carhenge attracts film crews and over 80,000 visitors from around the world each year. As one of Nebraska’s most popular tourist sites, Carhenge presents a unique opportunity for future owners.

article_content: The Bank of Maharashtra (BoM), a state-owned bank based in Pune, led all public sector banks in loan and deposit growth rates during the July-September 2023 quarter. According to public data, BoM recorded over 20% growth in both deposits and advances, the highest among government lenders for this period. BoM's gross domestic advances rose by 23.55% to Rs 1,83,122 crore by the end of September 2023. In comparison, Indian Overseas Bank saw a 20.29% increase, Central Bank of India grew by 17.26%, and UCO Bank expanded by 16.53%. While the State Bank of India (SBI) had a lower advances growth rate of 13.21%, it remains the largest in actual loan volume (Rs 28,84,007 crore) versus BoM's Rs 1,75,676 crore. BoM also posted the highest deposit growth, raising its deposits by 22.18% to Rs 2,39,298 crore. Bank of Baroda followed with a 12% increase (Rs 10,74,114 crore), and SBI reported an 11.80% rise (Rs 45,03,340 crore). For low-cost deposits, BoM topped the charts again with a CASA ratio of 50.71%, just ahead of Central Bank of India, which recorded 49.93%. Strong loan and deposit growth helped BoM's total business climb by 22.77% to Rs 4,22,420 crore, leading all PSBs for this quarter, while Bank of Baroda saw a 13.91% increase (Rs 19,08,837 crore). BoM also led in these metrics in the previous quarter.
translated_content: सरकारी स्वामित्वमा रहेको पुणे स्थित बैंक अफ महाराष्ट्र (BoM) ले २०२३ को जुलाईदेखि सेप्टेम्बर त्रैमासिक अवधिमा ऋण र निक्षेप वृद्धिमा सबै सार्वजनिक क्षेत्रका बैंकहरूमध्ये अग्रणी रह्यो। सार्वजनिक तथ्यांक अनुसार, यस अवधिमा BoM ले दुवै निक्षेप र ऋणमा २०% भन्दा बढी वृद्धि गरेको छ, जुन सरकारी बैंकहरूमध्ये सबैभन्दा धेरै हो। सेप्टेम्बर २०२३ को अन्त्यसम्म BoM का कुल घरेलु ऋणहरू २३.५५% ले बढेर १,८३,१२२ करोड रुपैयाँ पुगेका छन्। यसको तुलनामा, इण्डियन ओभरसीज बैंकले २०.२९% वृद्धि, सेन्ट्रल बैंक अफ इन्डियाले १७.२६% वृद्धि र यूसीओ बैंकले १६.५३% वृद्धि हासिल गरेका छन्। स्टेट बैंक अफ इन्डिया (SBI) ले ऋण वृद्धिमा १३.२१% मात्र प्रगति गरेको छ, तर कुल ऋण रकममा (२८,८४,००७ करोड रुपैयाँ) अझै धेरै छ, BoM को १,७५,६७६ करोड रुपैयाँको तुलनामा। BoM ले निक्षेप वृद्धिमा पनि सबैभन्दा अगाडि रहँदै आफ्नो निक्षेप २२.१८% ले बढाएर २,३९,२९८ करोड रुपैयाँमा पुर्याएको छ। बैंक अफ बडोदाले १२% वृद्धि (१०,७४,११४ करोड रुपैयाँ) र SBI ले ११.८०% वृद्धि (४५,०३,३४० करोड रुपैयाँ) देखाएका छन्। कम लागतका निक्षेपमा पनि, BoM को CASA अनुपात ५०.७१% रहेको छ, दोस्रो स्थानमा सेन्ट्रल बैंक अफ इन्डिया ४९.९३% का साथ रहेको छ। मजबुत ऋण र निक्षेप वृद्धिले गर्दा, BoM को कुल कारोबार २२.७७% ले बढेर ४,२२,४२० करोड रुपैयाँ पुगेको छ, जुन यस त्रैमासिकमा सबैभन्दा धेरै हो। बैंक अफ बडोदाले १३.९१% वृद्धि (१९,०८,८३७ करोड रुपैयाँ) दर्ता गरेको छ। BoM गत त्रैमासिकमा पनि यी सूचकहरूमा अग्रणी थियो।

article_content: A Maryland State Police trooper was placed on administrative leave after being accused of public intoxication and exposure at a bar within a barbecue restaurant, authorities reported on Wednesday. Harford County sheriff’s deputies responded late Saturday night to the Jarrettsville Pit, where they found two men who claimed to be state troopers. Witnesses told deputies that one of the officers removed his pants and exposed himself to others, though he denied being naked. Neither individual was charged. Following an internal review, one trooper was suspended while the Maryland State Police and the District Attorney's Office continue to investigate. The officers' names have not been made public. This incident is part of a series of recent high-profile cases across the United States involving naked suspects. In Arlington, Virginia, 42-year-old Roland Hitchens allegedly crashed his motorcycle into two vehicles while naked and intoxicated, then tried to flee on foot. He was apprehended and is facing multiple charges, including felony hit-and-run and indecent exposure. In Rockford, Illinois, authorities arrested Ezekial Deanda after he reportedly attempted to rob a bank while nude. In Jacksonville, Florida, police detained a naked man wielding a four-foot sword who was allegedly confronting residents in a housing complex. Residents managed to restrain him until law enforcement arrived. In Petaluma, California, Alexander Leonard was accused of crashing a rented truck and then exiting the vehicle undressed, blocking freeway traffic. Police reportedly used a Taser to subdue him before arresting him for suspected drug impairment and resisting arrest. Media sources indicate a recent spike in unusual crimes involving public nudity, with five such incidents reported nationwide since last week.

article_content: It's not always easy to find a campsite with a river view, but the owner of this caravan may have gone too far. The vehicle was reversed over a grassy bank and ended up in the water behind a motorway service station. Photographer Adrian Sherratt spotted the stranded caravan today near the M5 in Gloucestershire and suggested the owner may have just stopped for a cup of coffee. Sherratt commented that many people park up to enjoy a flask of coffee and admire the water. However, this caravan was left hanging precariously with one corner in the Little Avon river. Sherratt, 44, saw the vehicle beside a single-track lane between the Michael Wood services on the M5 and the village of Stone. ‘It looks like someone got too close to the edge,’ he said. ‘Maybe it was stolen or dumped, but it’s strange that someone would go to all the trouble of putting it in the river.’ Sherratt, who lives nearby in Wotton-under-Edge, added he was surprised the driver managed it, since it’s been dry since the last floods and the bank would not have been very slippery. The caravan was abandoned, left dangling partly into the river with its door open. ‘A lot of farm vehicles travel along that road, so maybe the caravan reversed to let something pass and then went too far,’ Sherratt speculated. Stroud District Council has been notified about the caravan and is preparing to remove it.
translated_content: नदीको दृश्य भएको क्याम्पसाइट पाउन सजिलो छैन, तर यो क्यारेभानका मालिकले सायद केही बढी नै गरे। सवारी साधन घाँसे बंैक पार गर्दै मोटरवे सर्भिस स्टेसनको पछाडिको पानीमा पुगेको थियो। फोटोग्राफर एड्रियन शेराटले आज ग्लोसेस्टरशायरको M5 नजिकै अलपत्र परेको क्यारेभान देखे र भने मालिक केवल कफी पिउनका लागि रोकिएका हुन सक्छन्। शेराटका अनुसार धेरैजसो मानिसहरूले पानी हेर्दै कफीको फ्यास्क लिएर पार्क गर्छन्। तर, यो क्यारेभान भने खतरनाक अवस्थामा सानो एभन नदीमा एक छेउ लट्किएको छ। ४४ वर्षीय शेराटले उक्त सवारी M5 को माइकल वुड सर्भिस र स्टोन गाउँ बिचको एक-तरफा साँघुरो सडक छेउमा देखे। ‘देखिन्छ कसैले किनारामा पुगेर अलि टाढासम्म गयो होला,’ उनले भने। ‘शायद चोरी गरेर ल्याइयो वा फ्याँकिएको होला, तर कसैले यति झन्झट गरेर नदीसम्म ल्याउन किन गर्थ्यो भन्ने बुझ्न सकिएन।’ वोटोन-अन्डर-एजमा बसोबास गर्ने शेराटले थपे, ‘बाढी पछि यहाँ सुक्खा रह्यो, किनार धेरै चिप्लो त थिएन, तैपनि कसरी गाडी त्यहाँ पुग्यो भन्नेमा अचम्म लाग्छ।’ क्यारेभान छाडिएको थियो, एक छेउ नदीमा लट्किएको र ढोका खुल्लै भएको अवस्थामा। ‘त्यो सडकमा धेरै कृषिक यानहरू चल्छन्, सायद कसैले गाडी ब्याक गर्दै अरूलाई पास गराउन खोज्दा यस्तो भएको हुन सक्छ,’ शेराटले अनुमान गरे। स्ट्राउड डिस्ट्रिक्ट काउन्सिललाई क्यारेभानको बारेमा खबर दिइएको छ र हटाउने तयारी भइरहेको छ।

article_content: Christopher Battley, 68, was adopted at birth in 1945 after his mother, Margaret Powles, then 16 years old, was unable to care for him on her own. His biological father is believed to have been a Canadian serviceman stationed in the UK during the Second World War. Now living in Maitland, Australia, Mr Battley spent years researching his genealogy, eventually discovering that his birth name was Powles. Using ancestry websites, he finally found his family’s profile. Mr Battley recounted the moment he made the connection, describing it as surreal: “The most uncanny feeling was finding out my real name.” After years of searching, he found he had seven siblings in Costessey, Norwich, but learned that his mother passed away on January 17, 2012, aged 82. Having been adopted at birth, he never had the chance to meet her. Val Latimer, 65, his sister, had always believed she was the eldest of seven children and was amazed to find out she had an older brother. The siblings met for the first time in Norwich, with Mrs Latimer welcoming her Australian brother at the train station with a large flag. 'It was a very powerful moment but we just about managed not to cry,' she said. Since reuniting, the siblings have enjoyed discovering shared family traits and mannerisms. Mrs Latimer remarked, 'He’s certainly got the Powles sense of humour.' The siblings are now planning to stay close, with Mrs Latimer already considering a trip to Australia. Mr Battley said, 'Finding a real family is a feeling you can’t ever imagine. It’s very exciting, but it will take a while to sink in.'

article_content: Olivia Sprauer, a high school English teacher in Florida, was asked to resign and escorted off campus after school administrators discovered she was also working as a part-time glamour model. Sprauer, 26, models under the name Victoria Valentine James and confirmed to school officials that she posed for a series of bikini modeling photos. She had originally planned to resign later in the month to pursue a full-time modeling career. However, after Martin County High School administrators saw her photos online, she was called into the principal’s office, shown a photo that had been sent to the principal, and was asked to resign immediately. Sprauer’s modeling portfolio appears on the website Model Mayhem, where she describes herself as a graduate student living in South Florida who enjoys being in front of the camera. She writes about her open-mindedness, her enjoyment of all types of modeling shoots, and her experience with photographers, commercial advertisements, and magazine publications. She also states she is comfortable with nude shoots for the right projects. After resigning early, Sprauer told WPTV she intends to attend graduate school and continue her modeling career. The Martin County School District confirmed in a statement that she no longer works for the district.

article_content: GURGAON: Many residents and RWAs (Resident Welfare Associations) in Gurgaon have demanded the removal of strays from their housing societies, often insisting that 'dogs should not be fed.' These groups sometimes attempt to socially isolate residents who continue to feed stray dogs despite such demands. However, feeding street dogs is not a crime; it is a right protected by the Constitution. Conversely, harassing or intimidating someone for feeding community dogs constitutes criminal intimidation under the law. Gurgaon police commissioner Vikas Arora recently told TOI, 'We take action against such harassers on a case-by-case basis.' The Supreme Court also supports the legality of dog feeding. In May 2022, the apex court upheld a previous Delhi High Court order confirming that stray dogs have the right to food, and citizens have the right to feed them. The Animal Welfare Board of India (AWBI), the central government's nodal body for animal welfare, has issued clear guidelines for RWAs: Residents' bodies cannot prohibit feeding of strays within housing societies or the creation of multiple feeding spots for the animals. 'Since driving away strays from a housing society is illegal, RWAs have a moral duty to get them immunised every year. The RWAs should designate dog feeding places only with the agreement of the dog feeders,' said Chetna Joshi, AWBI representative and member of the MCG Monitoring and Implementation Committee for Animal Birth Control. Legal experts state that RWAs can be taken to court for issuing illegal orders or for intimidating residents who feed stray dogs on the premises or at designated feeding places. 'A resident has the right to challenge any illegal order issued by an RWA in a court of law,' said Mayank Raghav, a Punjab & Haryana High Court advocate.
translated_content: गुरुग्राम: गुरुग्रामका धेरै बासिन्दा र आवासीय संघ (RWA) ले आफ्नो आवास क्षेत्रमा बाँझो कुकुर हटाउन माग गर्दै 'कुकुरलाई खाना खुवाउनु हुँदैन' भन्ने जोड दिन्छन्। यस्ता समूहहरूले कुकुरलाई खुवाउने बासिन्दालाई सामाजिक रूपमा अलग गराउने प्रयास पनि गर्छन्। तर, सडकका कुकुरलाई खाना खुवाउनु कुनै अपराध होइन; यो संविधानद्वारा सुरक्षित अधिकार हो। बरु, समुदायका कुकुरलाई खुवाउने व्यक्तिलाई सताउने वा डरत्रास देखाउने कुरा कानुन अनुसार आपराधिक त्रास हो। गुरुग्राम प्रहरी आयुक्त विकास अरोडाले हालै TOI लाई भने, 'हामी यस्ता सताउनेहरूमाथि केस-मा-केस कारबाही गर्छौं।' सर्वोच्च अदालतले समेत कुकुरलाई खाना खुवाउने अधिकारलाई समर्थन गरेको छ। २०२२ मे मा, सर्वोच्च अदालतले पूर्वको दिल्ली उच्च अदालतको आदेशलाई कायम राख्दै बाँझो कुकुरलाई खाना खुवाउने र खुवाउने नागरिकको अधिकार पुष्टि गरेको छ। भारतीय पशु कल्याण बोर्ड (AWBI), केन्द्र सरकारको पशु कल्याणका लागि मुख्य निकायले RWA का लागि स्पष्ट मार्गनिर्देशन निकालेको छ: आवासीय संघहरूले आवास क्षेत्रमा बाँझो कुकुरलाई खाना खान रोक्न वा कुकुर बस्ने ठाउँमा धेरै खुवाउने स्थान बनाउने कुरामा रोक लगाउन पाइँदैन। 'आवास क्षेत्रबाट बाँझो कुकुर हटाउन अवैध भएकाले, RWA हरूको नैतिक कर्तव्य हो कुकुरको प्रत्येक वर्ष खोप लगाउनु। खुवाउने बासिन्दासँग सहमति लिएर मात्र RWA ले कुकुर खुवाउने स्थान तोक्नुपर्छ,' AWBI प्रतिनिधि तथा एमसीजी एनिमल बर्थ कन्ट्रोल निगरानी समिति सदस्य चेतना जोशीले भनिन्। कानुनी विज्ञहरूले भन्छन्, RWA हरूले अवैध आदेश जारी गर्‍यो भने वा कुकुर खुवाउने बासिन्दालाई डरत्रास देखाएमा अदालतमा मुद्दा हाल्न सकिन्छ। 'RWA ले जारी गरेको कुनै अवैध आदेशलाई अदालतमा चुनौती दिन बासिन्दाले अधिकार राख्छ,' पंजाब तथा हरियाणा उच्च अदालतका अधिवक्ता मयंक राघवले बताए।

article_content: NEW DELHI: Delhi minister Saurabh Bharadwaj announced on Tuesday that over 900 ghats have been prepared for the upcoming Chhath festival, with facilities such as tents, lighting, and sound systems provided for devotees. The four-day festival, during which devotees fast and offer 'arghya' to the Sun God on the last two days, will begin on November 17. Bharadwaj told PTI that the Delhi government aims to give devotees a positive experience. "We want everyone to offer 'arghya' to the Sun God happily and receive the blessings of Chhathi Maiya," he said. Chhath Puja is observed six days after Diwali and is primarily celebrated by people from Bihar, Jharkhand, and Uttar Pradesh, including those living in other states or countries. In Delhi-NCR, many devotees gather at the Yamuna river banks to offer 'arghya' each year, but pollution and froth in the river can pose risks. Consequently, many families now observe the rituals in parks, gardens, and other public spaces where temporary ghats are created, and water is arranged for the ceremonies.

article_content: A recent study has revealed that access to bilingual education in Andalusia is heavily influenced by geographic location, the economic status of neighborhoods, and the types of schools available. Bilingual education programs, launched in Spain in the mid-2000s to promote equality in foreign language learning, are ironically marked by the very disparities they aimed to prevent. The study, conducted by researchers Alberto Álvarez de Sotomayor (University of Cordoba), Juan Miguel Gómez Espino (Pablo de Olavide University), and Ricardo Barbieri (University of Cordoba), found that access to bilingual primary education in Andalusia is shaped by a combination of geographical, social, and economic factors that restrict families’ choices. For instance, families living in areas like Polígono Sur in Seville face significant obstacles, as none of the eight primary schools in this neighborhood offer bilingual education. Key factors found to limit access include a family's place of residence, their economic situation, and whether their children attend public, semi-private, or private schools. The study, published in the journal Language and Education, identifies two political-administrative decisions that contribute to this inequality. First, participation in bilingual programs is voluntary, leaving it up to schools to decide whether to offer them, which results in uneven availability. Second, the school admissions system favors families living within a school's designated 'area of influence,' prioritizing geographical proximity and, inadvertently, the economic level of the neighborhood. Researchers analyzed primary schools across 29 large municipalities in Andalusia, focusing on whether the schools offered bilingual education, school type, their areas of influence, the local population's economic level, and the distance between schools. They found that the type of school had the greatest impact: only 34% of public schools offered bilingual education, compared to 72% of semi-private and 62% of private schools (excluding international schools). Álvarez de Sotomayor emphasized that inequality between school types is significant and closely tied to socioeconomic status, since not all families can afford semi-private or private education. The concentration of bilingual centers in more affluent areas means families in wealthier neighborhoods have more educational opportunities, while those in poor neighborhoods have few or none. The researchers argue that understanding real opportunities for families is critical to assessing whether these programs, originally created to reduce educational inequality, are achieving their purpose. So far, evidence suggests they may instead reproduce existing disparities. To address this, the study proposes three solutions: redefining school areas of influence, revising the admissions model, and encouraging more schools in low-income neighborhoods to adopt bilingual programs.
translated_content: हालैको एक अध्ययनले एन्डालुसियामा द्विभाषिक शिक्षा पहुँचलाई भौगोलिक स्थान, छिमेकको आर्थिक स्तर र विद्यालयको प्रकारले प्रभाव पारिरहेको देखाएको छ। स्पेनमा सन् २००० ko दशकको मध्यतिर सुरू भएका द्विभाषिक शिक्षा कार्यक्रमहरू विदेशी भाषा सिकाइमा समानता ल्याउन बनाइएका थिए, तर अहिले यी कार्यक्रमहरू आफैंले नचाहेको असमानता झनै देखिएको छ। युनिभर्सिटी अफ कर्डोबाका अल्बर्टो अल्भारेज दे सोतोमायोर, पाब्लो दे ओलाभिदे युनिभर्सिटीका जुआन मिगेल गोमेज एस्पिनो र युनिभर्सिटी अफ कर्डोबाका रिकार्डो बार्बिएरीद्वारा गरिएको यो अध्ययनले एन्डालुसियामा प्राथमिक तहको द्विभाषिक शिक्षामा पहुँच विभिन्न भौगोलिक, सामाजिक र आर्थिक पक्षहरूले सीमित गरेको छ भन्ने निष्कर्ष निकालेको छ। जस्तै, सेविल्लाको पोलिगोनो सुर क्षेत्रका परिवारहरूले समस्याको सामना गर्नुपरेको छ, किनकि त्यहाँका आठवटा प्राथमिक विद्यालयमध्ये कुनैमा पनि द्विभाषिक शिक्षा छैन। मुख्य अवरोधहरूमा परिवारको बसोबास स्थान, आर्थिक अवस्था, र उनीहरूका छोराछोरीले सार्वजनिक, सेमी-निजी वा निजी विद्यालय छनोट गर्न पाउने अवसर समावेश छन्। ‘ल्याङ्ग्वेज एन्ड एजुकेसन’ पत्रिकामा प्रकाशित अध्ययनले असमानताको कारण बन्ने दुई प्रशासनिक-राजनीतिक निर्णयहरू पहिचान गरेको छ। पहिलो, द्विभाषिक कार्यक्रम स्वेच्छिक हुन्, जसका कारण विद्यालयहरूले आफैं छनोट गर्न सक्दछन् — यसले अवसरमा असमानता ल्याउँछ। दोस्रो, विद्यालय प्रवेश प्रणालीले विद्यालयको 'प्रभाव क्षेत्र' भित्रका परिवारलाई प्राथमिकता दिन्छ— यसले नजिकको आवास र अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा आर्थिक स्तरलाई महत्वपूर्ण बनाउँछ। अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूले एन्डालुसियाका २९ ठूला नगरपालिकाका (५० हजारभन्दा बढी बासिन्दा भएको) प्राथमिक विद्यालयहरूको विश्लेषणमा द्विभाषिक कार्यक्रम छ कि छैन, विद्यालयको प्रकार, प्रभाव क्षेत्र, सो क्षेत्रका जनसंख्याको आर्थिक स्तर र अरू विविधता अध्ययन गरे। नतिजामा विद्यालयको प्रकार सबैभन्दा निर्णायक कारक देखियो: सार्वजनिक विद्यालयमध्ये ३४% मा मात्र द्विभाषिक कार्यक्रम, सेमी-निजी विद्यालयमा ७२% र निजी विद्यालयमा (अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विद्यालय बाहेक) ६२% मा मात्रै उपलब्ध छ। सोतोमायोरका अनुसार विद्यालय प्रकारमा आधारित असमानता गम्भीर छ र आर्थिक अवस्थासँग प्रत्यक्ष सम्बन्धित छ, किनकि सबै परिवारले सेमी-निजी या निजी विद्यालय afford गर्न सक्दैनन्। धनी क्षेत्रका प्रभाव क्षेत्रमा द्विभाषिक केन्द्रहरू बढी छन्, जबकि गरीब क्षेत्रमा कुनै नभएजस्तै छ। अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरू भन्छन्—परिवारहरूको यथार्थ अवसर के छ भनेर बुझ्न जरुरी छ, अनि त्यसको आधारमा यी कार्यक्रमले असमानता घटाउन मद्दत गरेको छ कि छैन भन्ने थाहा पाइन्छ। हालसम्मको प्रमाणले प्रणालीले असमानता दोहोर्‍याएको देखाएको छ। समाधानका लागि अध्ययनले तीन उपाय सिफारिस गरेको छ: 'प्रभाव क्षेत्र' को पुनःनिर्धारण, प्रवेश मोडल परिमार्जन, र कम आय भएका क्षेत्रका विद्यालयहरूमा द्विभाषिक कार्यक्रम सुरु गर्न प्रोत्साहन गर्नु।

article_content: The United States is facing a widespread childcare crisis that may worsen without intervention. The problem is twofold: childcare is expensive, and finding available openings is often difficult. On average, annual childcare costs in the US are $10,600 per child, while the median household income is $70,784, meaning families with one child spend about 15% of their income on care. For those with more than one child, the proportion is even higher. Additionally, many families struggle to find available childcare spots. As of 2018, the Center for American Progress reported that more than half of Americans lived in 'childcare deserts,' where the number of young children exceeded available licensed care slots by at least three to one. This shortage forces many women to leave the workforce to care for their children, sacrificing both immediate income and future career opportunities. Ideally, solutions should address both cost and availability. Kentucky has taken innovative steps by making childcare free for licensed and certified childcare program employees, regardless of household income, starting in 2022. According to NPR, this change followed a significant decrease in the number of children receiving childcare subsidies during the pandemic due to staff shortages and empty classrooms. Staffing shortages were exacerbated by stricter child-to-teacher ratios during COVID-19 and difficult working conditions. One factor discouraging employment is low pay. The Bureau of Labor Statistics reports daycare childcare workers earn an average of $12.40 per hour, less than half the overall average for all jobs ($28.01). The Economic Policy Institute found that families of childcare workers are twice as likely to live in poverty (11.8%) compared to other working families. Burnout is another challenge; some workers leave due to exhaustion or find better-paying jobs elsewhere, such as at Walmart, where shelf stockers average $17 per hour according to ZipRecruiter. Kentucky's initiative was designed to help parents who had quit jobs to avoid high daycare expenses and to increase available daycare spots for others by boosting the childcare workforce. Following this policy, the number of children receiving state subsidies in Kentucky more than doubled to 40,000, including 3,600 children of center employees. However, the program comes with costs. Infant care in Kentucky averages $534 per month, or about $13,000 annually for two children, which is roughly 32% more than the typical state rent. Kentucky pays centers up to $200 per week to cover employee children's costs, as reported by NPR. A similar approach was noted in West Virginia, where one center offered free tuition to employees without government help. While this opened enrollment spots, the loss of tuition caused financial strain for the center. Without renewed federal funding that ended in September, childcare costs are expected to rise. A 2022 survey by the National Association for the Education of Young Children found that 43% of childcare center directors anticipated raising tuition if funding was not replaced. The expiration of aid risks center closures, forcing more families to cut work hours or quit jobs, with potential family earnings losses estimated at $9 billion. This is in addition to the $78 billion already lost annually by parents due to inadequate childcare, as analyzed by economist Clive R. Belfield. The US urgently needs more affordable daycare and qualified workers at centers. Providing free childcare to childcare workers can be successful, but requires ongoing government support.
translated_content: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका गम्भीर बाल हेरचाह संकटको सामना गर्दैछ, जुन यदि हस्तक्षेप गरिएन भने अझै गहिरिन सक्छ। समस्या दुई तहमा छ: बाल हेरचाह महँगो छ र उपलब्ध स्थान खोज्न गाह्रो छ। अमेरिकामा औसत वार्षिक बाल हेरचाह खर्च प्रति बच्चा $१०,६०० छ, परिवारको मध्यम आय $७०,७८४ छ। यस अर्थमा, एक बच्चा भएका परिवारले आफ्नो आम्दानीको करिब १५% हेरचाह खर्चमै खर्च गर्छन्। थप बच्चा भए बढी खर्च पर्छ। धेरै अभिभावकले बाल हेरचाह स्थल खोज्न संघर्ष गर्छन्। २०१८ मा Center for American Progress ले रिपोर्ट गरे अनुसार, अमेरिकाका आधा भन्दा बढी लोग ‘बाल हेरचाह डेसर्ट’ क्षेत्रमा छन्, जहाँ छोराछोरीको संख्या अनुमति प्राप्त हेरचाह स्थानभन्दा कम्तिमा तीन गुणा बढी छ। यस समस्याले धेरै महिलाहरूलाई आफ्ना छोराछोरीको हेरचाह गर्न जागिर छाड्न बाध्य बनाएको छ। यसले तत्कालीन आम्दानी मात्र होइन, भविष्यको करियर अवसर पनि गुमाउँछ। पूरा समाधानले लागत र उपलब्धता दुवै सम्बोधन गर्न आवश्यक छ। केन्टकीले २०२२ देखि लाइसेन्सप्राप्त र प्रमाणित बाल हेरचाह कार्यक्रमका कर्मचारीका लागि, घरको आम्दानी जुनसुकै भए पनि, निःशुल्क हेरचाह सुरु गर्‍यो। NPR का अनुसार महामारीका बेला कक्षामा कर्मचारीअभावले बच्चाहरूलाई सहुलियत पाउन गाह्रो भएपछि यस्तो उपाय अपनायो। कडा बच्चा-शिक्षक अनुपात र समस्या शर्तहरूका कारण कर्मचारीको अभाव झन् बढेको थियो। तलब कम हुनु एउटा समस्या हो। Bureau of Labor Statistics अनुसार, बाल हेरचाह कर्मचारी औसतमा प्रतिघण्टा $१२.४० कमाउँछन्, जुन सबै पेशाको औसत $२८.०१ भन्दा आधा कम हो। Economic Policy Institute का अनुसार बाल हेरचाह कर्मचारी परिवार अन्यभन्दा दोब्बर गरीबीमा (११.८%) छन्। बरनआउट पनि समस्या हो; कतिपयले थकानले जागिर छोड्छन् या Walmart मा शेल्फ राख्दा औसत $१७ पाउँछन् (ZipRecruiter अनुसार)। केन्टकीको योजना महंगो हेरचाह खर्च टार्न जागिर छाडेका अभिभावकलाई फाइदा र अन्यका लागि स्थान बिस्तार गर्न कर्मचारी थप गर्छ। नीतिपछि राज्य सहुलियत लिने बालबालिका ४०,००० पुगे; तीमध्ये ३,६०० कर्मचारीका बच्चा छन्। यो कार्यक्रम महँगो पर्न आउँछ। केन्टकीमा शिशु हेरचाह औसत $५३४ मासिक पर्छ; दुई बच्चा भए वार्षिक $१३,००० जति, जुन औसत भाडाभन्दा ३२% बढी हो। NPR अनुसार, राज्यले कर्मचारीका छोराछोरीका लागि हप्तामा $२०० सम्म सताउनी गर्छ। पश्चिम भर्जिनियामा एउटा केन्द्रले सरकारी सहयोगबिना नै कर्मचारीलाई निःशुल्क हेरचाह दिएको छ। यसले नयाँ स्थान खुलाउने तर निश्चित शुल्क छुट्दा आर्थिक चाप परेको छ। सेप्टेम्बरमा संघीय अनुदान सकिएपछि, बाल हेरचाह शुल्क फेरि बढ्नेछ। National Association for the Education of Young Children को २०२२ सर्वेमा ४३% निर्देशकले अनुदान सकिए शुल्क बढाउने बताए। अनुदान अन्त्य हुँदा केन्द्र बन्द हुने, परिवारले काम घटाउने या छोड्ने जोखिम छ; पारिवारिक आम्दानीमा अनुमानित ९ अर्ब डलर घाटा आउने जोखिम छ। Clive R. Belfield का अनुसार, कमजोर हेरचाहले अभिभावकहरू वर्षमा $७८ अर्ब गुमाइरहेका छन्। अमेरिकामा अझ सुलभ बाल हेरचाह र बढी योग्य कर्मचारी आवश्यक छन्। कर्मचारीलाई निःशुल्क बाल हेरचाह दिएर समाधान हुन सक्छ, तर यसमा सरकारी निरन्तर समर्थन चाहिन्छ।
