article_content: Chelsea striker Didier Drogba is widely recognized for his leadership qualities within the Stamford Bridge squad. The 36-year-old recently posted a photo on his Instagram account, referring to the group as the 'Drog gang!' as Chelsea players bundled up in hats and snoods during a chilly training session in Surrey. Brazilians Ramires and Willian joined Drogba in the photo as some squad members participated in activities for Chelsea TV ahead of their upcoming match against Everton at Stamford Bridge on Wednesday evening. Drogba shared the picture with the caption: 'The DROG GANG!!!!! Guess who are the players here???? #blues #cfc #chelseafc #training #interview #chelseatv #drogGang.' Over the weekend, the former Ivory Coast star was active on Instagram, watching with excitement as his national team defeated Ghana to win the Africa Cup of Nations. Celebrating with friends and family, Drogba posted a video on his Instagram, cheering after the tense 9-8 penalty victory. The seasoned striker, who retired from international football in August 2014, was seen jumping on his sofa in celebration after Ivory Coast goalkeeper Boubacar Barry scored the winning penalty. Drogba, who also played against Aston Villa on Saturday, has scored six goals for Chelsea this season. Willian celebrated Branislav Ivanovic's goal against Aston Villa by pretending to shine his boots. Chelsea's 2-1 win at Aston Villa extended their lead at the top of the Premier League to seven points.

article_content: Flooding and landslides caused by heavy rains in southern Brazil have resulted in at least six deaths over the past week, authorities said on Sunday. The fatalities occurred in the states of Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul. Significant property damage was reported in Rio Grande do Sul, where thousands of people sought shelter in gymnasiums, according to deputy governor Gabriel Souza on X (formerly Twitter). Several towns in Rio Grande do Sul experienced flooding after the Taquari River overflowed. In Roca Sales, dozens of volunteers worked on Sunday to clear streets covered in mud and debris left by the river, as reported by an AFP journalist. Many streets were entirely coated in mud, and uprooted trees were found. Southern Brazil has recently faced several extreme weather events, such as torrential rain and a cyclone in September that killed more than 50 people. Experts state that climate change is contributing to the increasing frequency of these disasters. In Santa Catarina state, deaths were also reported following heavy rains that began on Tuesday, prompting the governor to declare a state of emergency in 64 towns. In the four hardest-hit cities, rainfall over three days was more than double the usual amount for the entire month of November.

article_content: Elizabeth Shiflett, a 37-year-old former waitress at Scores Gentleman's Club in New York, alleges she was fired after refusing persistent romantic and sexual advances from her manager, Sammy Roman. article_content: Language acts as a powerful connector, bringing together people from across the globe. This was recently demonstrated when Kokani Muslims worldwide celebrated International Kokani Language Day on October 24 with singing, poetry recitations, storytelling, mimicry, and speeches. In Mumbai, Kokanis gathered at the Islam Gymkhana near Marine Lines to celebrate, aiming to promote and preserve their unique Kokani dialect, which is spoken among Muslims in the Konkan region. Unlike Konkani, spoken in Goa and nearby areas, the Kokani dialect has no script. While Hindus in the area commonly speak Marathi, Muslims often converse in Kokani among themselves. The idea for Kokani Language Day originated from industrial consultant Fakih Farook Subedar, based in the UK for five decades. Last October 24, he created a WhatsApp group named 'Kokani Batoh cha Parivar' (Kokani-speaking family) to encourage the use of Kokani, especially among the younger generation. The group now has over 1,025 members, with another group of around 200. Since the group was founded on October 24, this date was chosen as International Kokani Language Day. Subedar said their aim is to revive Kokani culture, including food habits, stories, poetry (shairi), and to stay connected through a website currently under development. Subedar noted that, across the world, communities often communicate in their native tongues, but younger Kokanis sometimes feel hesitant or self-conscious about speaking Kokani. The initiative seeks to overcome this and encourage the open use of Kokani everywhere. Around 100 people originally from one of Konkan's five districts attended Mumbai’s event. Zainab Parkar performed a Kokani song, Kamal Mandlekar recited poetry, and Arif Kazi showcased mimicry in Kokani. The event was anchored by Imran Alvi. Several well-known individuals from the Kokan region participated, such as Akbar Kondkari (Kokan Mercantile Cooperative Bank CEO), businessman Hassan Chaugle (Qatar-based), educator and philanthropist Dr. M.A. Patankar, and businessman Hanif Modak. Sabrina Kazi is preparing a comprehensive Kokani directory, while the community is also working towards providing medical aid and student scholarships. Poet and Urdu tutor Farooque Rahman shared that Kokani evolved when Arabs came to India via the coast, married locals, and settled there. Kokani is mainly based on Marathi but incorporates words from Arabic, Urdu, Persian, and Sanskrit. Many Hindu converts to Islam kept their surnames, which is why names like Gavaskar, Parkar, Naik, Inamdar, and Desai are common among Kokani Muslims. Rahman has translated many of Mirza Ghalib’s ghazals into Kokani, including 'Dile nadaan tujhe hua kya hai,' rendered in Kokani as 'Dile nadaan tujha jhale ka he…'

मिमिक्री र भाषणहरू गर्दै मनाए। मुम्बईमा, कोकणी समुदायका सदस्यहरू मरीन लाइन्स नजिकको इस्लाम जिमखानामा भेला भए, जसको उद्देश्य आफ्नो विशिष्ट कोकणी बोलीको प्रवर्द्धन र संरक्षण गर्नु थियो। गोवा र अन्य नजिकका क्षेत्रहरूमा बोलिने कोंकणीभन्दा फरक, कोकणी बोलीमा कुनै लिपि छैन। त्यो क्षेत्रमा हिन्दूहरूले प्रायः मराठी बोल्छन् भने मुस्लिमहरूले सामान्यतः आपसमा कोकणीमा कुरा गर्छन्। कोकणी भाषा दिवसको विचार पाँच दशकदेखि यूकेमा बसोबास गरेका औद्योगिक सल्लाहकार फकीह फारूक सुबेदारबाट आयो। उनले गत वर्ष अक्टोबर २४ मा 'कोकणी बाटोच परिवार' (कोकणी बोल्ने परिवार) नामक व्हाट्सएप समूह बनाए, युवाहरूलाई कोकणी भाषाको चलनचल्तीमा ल्याउन प्रेरित गर्न। यो समूहमा अहिले १,०२५ भन्दा बढी सदस्य छन्, अर्को समूहमा २०० जति सदस्य छन्। समूह स्थापना भएको मितिकै कारण, अक्टोबर २४ लाई अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय कोकणी भाषा दिवसको रूपमा मनाउन थालिएको हो। सुबेदारका अनुसार लक्ष्य भनेको कोकणी संस्कृति, खानपान, कथा, शायरी पुनरुत्थान गर्ने र वेबसाइटमार्फत जोड्ने हो। सुबेदारले भने अनुसार विश्वभरि समुदायहरू प्रायः आफ्नै भाषामा बोल्छन् तर केही युवाहरूले कोकणीमा बोल्दा संकोच वा हीनभावना अनुभूति गर्छन्। यस पहलले उक्त संकोचन हटाउन र जताततै कोकणी भाषा खुला रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न प्रोत्साहन गरेको छ। कोंकणका पाँच जिल्लामध्येका करिब १०० जना मुम्बईको कार्यक्रममा सहभागी भए। जैनब पारकरले कोकणी गीत गाइन्, कमल मण्डलेकरले कविता वाचन गरे र आरिफ kazi ले कोकणीमा मिमिक्री देखाए। कार्यक्रममा इमरान अल्वीले सञ्चालन गरे। कोंकण क्षेत्रका धेरैजसो चर्चित व्यक्तिहरू कार्यक्रममा उपस्थित थिए: अकबर कौन्डकारी (कोंकण मर्केन्टाइल को-अपरेटिभ बैंकका सीईओ), व्यवसायी हसन चौगले (कतार), शिक्षाशास्त्री डा. एम. ए. पाटणकर, व्यवसायी हनीफ मोडक। सब्रिना kazi कोकणी समुदायको विस्तृत डाइरेक्टरी तयार गर्दै छिन्। समुदायको तर्फबाट स्वास्थ्य सेवा र छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान गर्न पहल गरिएको छ। कवि तथा उर्दू ट्युटर फारूक रहमानका अनुसार कोकणी भाषा भारततर्फ आएका अरबहरूले तटीय क्षेत्रमा विवाह गरी यहीं बसोबास गर्दा विकास भएको हो। कोकणी मुख्य रूपमा मराठीमा आधारित छ, तर अरबी, उर्दू, फारसी र संस्कृतका धेरै शब्दहरू मिसिएका छन्। धेरै हिन्दूहरू इस्लाममा रूपान्तरण भए पनि, पहिलेकै थर रह्यो, त्यसैले मुस्लिम कोकणीहरूमा गवास्कर, पारकर, नाइक, इनामदार, देसाईजस्ता थरहरू पाइन्छ। रहमानले मिर्जा गालिबका गजलहरू कोकणीतर्फ अनुवाद गरेका छन्, जस्तै 'दिल ए नादान तुझे हुआ क्या है' लाई 'दिल ए नादान तुझा झाले का हे...'।

article_content: A confidential CIA initiative has provided critical support to Colombian authorities in targeting and eliminating at least two dozen high-ranking FARC leaders, as reported by the Washington Post. The National Security Agency contributed significant intelligence gathering, while U.S.-supplied GPS technology enabled the conversion of conventional bombs into precision-guided weapons for use in inaccessible jungle locations. Through this covert collaboration, several FARC commanders—including Raul Reyes—were located and killed. Reyes died in March 2008 during a Colombian military operation that targeted a rebel encampment in Ecuador, reportedly utilizing U.S.-assisted smart bombs, according to anonymous American and Colombian sources. This secret program operates independently of the public $9 billion in military aid the U.S. has given Colombia. Initiated by President George W. Bush, the program has continued through President Barack Obama's administration. Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos acknowledged the CIA's support in improving training and expertise for Colombian forces but refrained from further comment due to the program's classified nature. The CIA refused to comment. Peace negotiations between the Colombian government and FARC started in Havana in late 2012, yet violent confrontations persist. Earlier this month, authorities accused FARC of attacking a police station, an incident that resulted in nine deaths, including civilians and security personnel. Since FARC's beginnings in 1964, the movement has suffered losses, with current estimates at about 9,000 fighters. Despite these setbacks, FARC maintains that it is still a powerful organization in Colombia.

Legendary wrestler and reality TV star Hulk Hogan has become a victim of theft after a woman stole one of his signed shoes. The thief took a $5,500 autographed wrestling shoe, once worn by Hogan, from his shop in Clearwater Beach, Florida. The woman and three companions visited Hogan's Beach Shop late Sunday afternoon and took the shoe while staff were distracted.

The missing item—a shoe signed by Hulk Hogan—was not discovered until Tuesday, when staff noticed it was gone and reviewed CCTV footage before reporting it to police. According to the police report, four white females, possibly visitors from Michigan on spring break, entered the shop just after 5pm on Sunday. A few minutes later, a large statue of Hogan outside the store fell over, and while workers were distracted, a 'heavyset' white female in her 50s took the shoe, Clearwater Police said.

Hogan, 60, recently announced his return to WWE after more than six years. He appeared on WWE Raw Backstage Pass last month and is set to host the special anniversary of WrestleMania 30 in New Orleans in April. Confirming the news to WWE.com, the multi-time world champion, who first competed at the inaugural WrestleMania in 1985, said, 'Words cannot express how excited I am to be back in the WWE family. I only have one question for the WWE Universe: What are you going to do when Hulkamania runs wild as the host of WrestleMania 30?'

WWE Chairman Vince McMahon added, 'We are thrilled that Hulk Hogan has returned home to WWE. It's fitting to have him help us celebrate 30 years of WrestleMania and usher in a new era with the launch of WWE Network.'

article_content: A new study reveals that dinosaurs flourished in Europe right up until the asteroid impact that caused their extinction around 66 million years ago. While it has long been accepted that a massive asteroid rapidly wiped out the dinosaurs, most evidence of the last dinosaurs has come from North America. However, in recent decades, researchers have discovered significant late Cretaceous dinosaur fossils in Spain, France, Romania, and other European countries. The research, led by Zoltán Csiki-Sava from the University of Bucharest, compiles findings from the past 20 years, highlighting the diversity of European dinosaur ecosystems just before their extinction. In the Pyrenees of Spain and France—a key area for the latest Cretaceous fossils—both meat- and plant-eating dinosaurs were present and thriving in the final few hundred thousand years before the asteroid struck. Dr. Csiki-Sava noted that Europe was historically overshadowed by other continents in paleontological studies. Over the past 25 years, dedicated research efforts across Europe have expanded knowledge, revealing new and unique aspects of life at the end of the Dinosaur Era. Dr. Steve Brusatte from the University of Edinburgh’s School of GeoSciences, a co-author of the study, emphasized that this evidence suggests European dinosaurs, like their North American counterparts, were prospering right up to the asteroid impact. This strengthens the case that the extinction was a sudden, global event hitting dinosaurs when they were still diverse. The Cretaceous period—the last segment of the 'Age of Dinosaurs'—lasted about 79 million years and ended with the asteroid impact around 66 million years ago. While scientists still debate the causes of extinction, including climate change and volcanic activity, new research suggests a mix of environmental stressors weakened dinosaur food chains, leaving them vulnerable to disaster. Some studies suggest that if the asteroid had struck a few million years earlier or later, when dinosaur populations were more robust, they might have survived. However, environmental upheavals at the time left them especially susceptible, which contributed to their rapid extinction after the asteroid struck what is now Mexico about 66 million years ago.

article_content: The iPad has been one of the most influential technologies of the past five years. Alongside the iPhone, it introduced a new era of touch-based computing, moving away from traditional mouse and keyboard interaction. However, the iPad’s dominance in the rapidly growing tablet market may soon face significant challenges. The reasons behind the iPad’s dominance are clear: it was the first of the modern touchscreen tablets and remains highly desirable to consumers. Where the iPhone was limited early on by being available only on one U.S. carrier, the iPad side-stepped this issue by offering both AT&T and Verizon options, as well as a Wi-Fi-only version that avoids carrier restrictions altogether. While iPhone competitors were able to undercut its price with more affordable Android smartphones—especially with carrier subsidies—iPad rivals have not achieved the same success. Competing tablets tend to be similarly priced without matching the appeal of Apple’s device. For those seeking a high-quality tablet experience, the iPad has been the top choice. This dynamic is about to change. Next week, two promising and budget-friendly tablets will launch: Amazon’s Kindle Fire and Barnes & Noble’s Nook Tablet. On Tuesday, the Kindle Fire will debut for $199—less than half the price of an iPad. It features a full-color 7-inch touchscreen and access to millions of movies, TV shows, songs, books, and magazines. The Kindle Fire also offers Amazon’s own app store and a new web browser touted as faster than competitors. Following closely, Barnes & Noble’s Nook Tablet will be released on Wednesday, featuring similar specs to the Kindle Fire but with more memory and storage, and is priced at $249—again, much lower than the iPad. Of the two, the Kindle Fire is expected to emerge as the strongest iPad challenger. Amazon, like Apple, controls both the device and much of the content available for it, providing users with an integrated experience. Although the Kindle Fire runs a modified version of Google’s Android operating system, Amazon has customized the interface to create a cohesive user environment. Amazon’s substantial media catalog—books, movies, TV shows, and music—offers another advantage. The company is able to sell the Kindle Fire at a low price (reportedly at a loss) and recoup costs through the sale of digital content. Amazon is actively marketing the Kindle Fire to millions of its customers and provides free streaming content to Amazon Prime members. Research suggests strong consumer interest: a recent survey of 2,600 consumers indicates higher pre-launch demand for the Kindle Fire than that seen for the iPad before its release. While the Kindle Fire may not surpass the iPad in all features, its affordability is likely to appeal to price-sensitive consumers and make it the second most popular tablet globally. At its price point, the Kindle Fire may even have the potential to overtake the iPad as the market leader.

ट्याब्लेट सार्वजनिक हुन्छ, जसमा समान स्पेसिफिकेसन भए तापनि बढी मेमोरी र स्टोरेज छ, र मूल्य $२४९ छ—अझै किफायती। यीमध्ये, किन्डल फायर मुख्य प्रतिस्पर्धीका रूपमा देखिएको छ। अमेजन, एप्पलजस्तै, उपकरण र अधिकांश सामग्री आफैं नियन्त्रण गर्छ, जसले प्रयोगकर्तालाई एकीकृत अनुभव दिन्छ। यद्यपि किन्डल फायरले परिमार्जित एन्ड्रोइड अपरेटिङ सिस्टम चलाउँछ, अमेजनले आफ्नो इन्टरफेस बनाई प्रयोगकर्ता अनुभव समृद्ध पारेको छ। अमेजनको किताब, फिल्म, टिभी शो र संगीतको ठूलो संग्रह अर्को फाइदा हो। कम्पनीले reportedly आफू लाभांश नलिएर कम मूल्यमा किन्डल फायर बेच्छ र डिजिटल सामग्री बिक्रीबाट भरपर्दो आम्दानी लिन्छ। अमेजनले करोडौं ग्राहकलाई लक्षित गर्दै मार्केटिङ गरिरहेको छ र अमेजन प्राइम सदस्यलाई निःशुल्क स्ट्रिमिङ सेवा पनि दिइरहेको छ। हालै २,६०० उपभोक्ता सर्वेक्षण अनुसार, आइप्याड लन्च अघि देखिएको मागभन्दा article_content: Egyptian authorities have banned climbing the Pyramids of Giza since the 1980s. Nonetheless, Russian photographer Vitaliy Raskalov and his friends managed to evade local security and ascend the Great Pyramid, capturing rare and stunning photographs. Raskalov stated that their motivation was inspired by historic images of the Pyramids. He claimed ignorance about the risks and legal prohibitions, although his earlier daredevil activity on the Russky Island Bridge, which led to his detainment, suggests he may have understood the dangers. While their actions were illegal, the resulting images from the top of the pyramid are extraordinary. CNN's Steve Tuemmler contributed to this report.

article_content: Breaking from royal tradition, the Duchess of Cambridge, Kate Middleton, has chosen to return to her parents' home after her baby is born, instead of hiring a maternity nurse. At 31, Kate has told friends she will spend at least six weeks with her family after leaving the hospital. This means the future royal heir will begin life at the Middletons’ £4.85 million Georgian manor in Berkshire, rather than at a royal residence. Kate feels most secure with her family and values her mother Carole's parenting experience. With Prince William set to resume his work as a helicopter pilot after his paternity leave, Kate appreciates the advice and support her parents—in particular Carole—can offer during this period. This plan comes as their future apartment in Kensington Palace remains unavailable, with renovations delayed due to asbestos. The Middletons' new manor offers plenty of space for the family's first grandchild. Carole is preparing the home by redecorating, setting up a new nursery-style room, and updating the kitchen. She is reportedly thrilled to be a grandmother and is eager to help out. Currently, William and Kate are moving between a rented farmhouse in Anglesey and Nottingham Cottage at Kensington Palace. The completion of the renovated 57-room Apartment 1A is expected to be delayed until later in the year, meaning the baby will experience both family and royal settings in their early months. By contrast, when William was born at St Mary's Hospital's Lindo Wing, Princess Diana welcomed help from a nurse and then a nanny—something Kate is choosing not to do. In another royal update, Prince Harry will join a British team of injured ex-servicemen on a fundraising trek to the South Pole as part of the Walking With The Wounded South Pole Allied Challenge 2013. Teams from the UK, US, and Commonwealth will race 210 miles in the Antarctic to raise awareness of veterans’ resilience. Kate was recently named to Time magazine’s ‘100 Most Influential People’ list for the third year, noted for her dignified and composed image.
translated_content: शाही परम्पराबाट अलग, केम्ब्रिजकी डचेस केट मिडलटनले बच्चा जन्मिएपछि नर्स राख्ने सट्टा आफ्नै बाबुआमाकै घर बस्ने निर्णय गरेकी छन्। ३१ वर्षीया केटले अस्पतालबाट फर्किएपछि कम्तिमा छ हप्ता परिवारसँगै बिताउने बताएकी छन्। यो निर्णयसँगै राजपरिवारका भावी उत्तराधिकारीले महल नभई मिडलटन परिवारको बर्कशायरस्थित £४.८५ मिलियनको जर्जियन घरमा जीवनको थालनी गर्नेछन्। केट आफू आफ्नै परिवारसँग सुरक्षित अनुभव गर्छिन् र आमाको पालनपोषण अनुभवको कदर गर्छिन्। प्रिन्स विलियम पितृत्व विदापछि फेरि हेलिकप्टर पाइलटका रूपमा काममा फर्कन लागेकाले केटलाई बाबुआमा, विशेषगरी आमाले दिने सल्लाह र साथ चाहिन्छ। क्येन्सिङ्टन प्यालेसको नयाँ अपार्टमेन्टमा एस्बेस्टोसका कारण मर्मत ढिलाइ हुँदा यस्तो व्यवस्था मिलाइएको हो। मिडलटनको नयाँ घरमा पहिलो नाति/नातिनीका लागि पर्याप्त स्थान छ। क्यारोल हाल घर सजाउने, नयाँ नर्सरी कोठा बनाउने र भान्साको सुधारमा व्यस्त छिन्। उनी हर्षित छन् र सघाउन आतुर। हाल विलियम र केट एङ्गलिसीको भाडामा लिएको फार्महाउस र क्येन्सिङ्टन प्यालेसको नटिङ्घम कटेजबीच बसाइँ सर्दैछन्। ५७ कोठे अपार्टमेन्ट १ए को मर्मत अझै केहि महिना ढिलो हुने भएकाले, बच्चाले शुरूका महिना परिवार र शाही वातावरण दुवैमा बिताउनेछन्। यसअघि प्रिन्स विलियमको जन्म सेंट म्यारी अस्पतालको लिन्डो विङमा हुँदा, प्रिन्सेस डायानाले नर्स र त्यसपछि नानी नियुक्त गरेकी थिइन्—तर केटले त्यसो नगर्ने भएकी हुन्। यता, प्रिन्स ह्यारी घाइते पूर्व सैनिकहरूसँग साउथ पोलको च्यारिटी यात्रामा सामेल हुँदै छन्। वाकिङ विथ द वाउन्डेड साउथ पोल अलाइड च्यालेन्ज २०१३ अन्तर्गत यूके, अमेरिका र कमनवेल्थका टिमहरूले २१० माइल लामो कठिन यात्रा तय गर्नेछन्, सैनिकहरूको साहस देखाउन। केट तेस्रो पटक टाइम म्यागजिनको ‘१०० सबैभन्दा प्रभावशाली व्यक्ति’ को सूचीमा परेकी छन्, जहाँ उनको शालीन र दृढ छवि प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ।

article_content: U.S. intelligence reports indicate that Russian artillery is firing from within Russian territory into eastern Ukraine. The equipment involved includes Russian M-46 130mm field guns, capable of reaching over 16 miles. This action aligns with Russia’s continued efforts to support pro-Russian separatists in the region, with the possible long-term intention of bringing eastern Ukraine under Russian control. The areas experiencing heavy fighting, as shown in accompanying maps, have witnessed intense clashes between the Ukrainian government and separatist forces over the past month. During this time, several Ukrainian military aircraft have been shot down, including the tragic downing of Malaysia Airlines Flight 17, which many observers attribute to mistaken identity and misuse of advanced weaponry. Ukrainian forces have recently managed to push rebel fighters towards the Russian border, with key assets like the Sukhoi Su-25 ground-attack aircraft playing a significant role. These jets, while effective, are vulnerable to surface-to-air missiles, particularly shoulder-launched MANPADS and the more advanced SA-11 'Buk' systems, the latter reportedly supplied by Russia to separatist forces. Reports and video footage suggest that after the downing of MH17, the SA-11 system was quickly removed from eastern Ukraine, likely to conceal its origin. In the continued conflict, two Ukrainian Su-25s were shot down at altitudes just above MANPADS range, likely by SA-11 missiles launched from Russian territory—demonstrating the evolving threat to Ukrainian air operations. Thursday saw further Russian military involvement, with artillery fire believed to originate within Russia targeting eastern Ukraine. While the M-46 guns have a range of about 16 miles, Russia also possesses systems with even greater reach, marking a clear escalation. Providing arms, financial support, and training to foreign insurgent groups is a known tactic used to further national interests—an approach employed by many states in various conflicts. However, direct artillery strikes into a neighboring state represent a major shift and an act of war, underlining how strategically significant Russia considers the survival of the separatist movement. On Friday, Ukraine reportedly responded with mortar fire across the Russian border, further intensifying the situation. What began as an internal conflict is now marked by direct cross-border hostilities between Russia and Ukraine, raising the stakes for both sides. With approximately 15,000 Russian troops stationed along the border, Russia frames its actions as support for ethnic Russians who aspire to join the Russian Federation. Ukraine perceives such interventions as violations of its sovereignty and has responded militarily. The risk of further escalation remains high, as each side reassesses its strategy. Observers note that Russia may use the pretext of protecting Russian nationals in eastern Ukraine to justify additional intervention, recalling the precedent set in Crimea.
translated_content: अमेरिकी गुप्तचर रिपोर्ट अनुसार, रूसी तोपहरूले रूसभित्रैबाट पूर्वी युक्रेनमा गोलाबारी गरिरहेका छन्। यसका लागि प्रयोग भएको रूसी M-46 130mm फिल्ड गनको दूरी १६ माइलभन्दा बढी छ। यो रूसी पक्षले पूर्वी युक्रेनका प्र-रूसी विद्रोहीलाई सहयोग गर्ने योजनासँग मेल खान्छ, दीर्घकालीन उद्देश्य उक्त क्षेत्र रूसमा मिसाउने हुनसक्छ। नक्सामा उल्लेखित क्षेत्रहरूमा पछिल्लो एक महिनादेखि युक्रेनी सेना र विद्रोहीबीच तीव्र द्वन्द्व भएको छ। यस अवधिमा थुप्रै युक्रेनी सैन्य विमान खसेका छन्, जसमा मलेसिया एयरलाइन्सको फ्लाइट १७ को दर्दनाक घटना पनि पर्दछ—धेरैको विश्वासमा यो गल्ती र शस्त्र दुरुपयोगका कारण हो। युक्रेनी सेना हाल विद्रोहीहरूलाई रूसी सीमातर्फ पछ्याउन सफल भएको छ, जहाँ सुकोई सु-२५ हमला विमानले मुख्य भूमिका खेलेका छन्। यी विमान जमिनबाट मार हान्ने मिसाइल—खासगरी म्यानप्याड्स र SA-11 'बुक' सिस्टम (रूसबाट आपूर्ति गरिएको भनिएको)—बाट संवेदनशील छन्। रिपोर्ट तथा भिडियोमा देखिएको छ कि MH17 घटनापछि SA-11 सिस्टम पूर्वी युक्रेनबाट हटाइएको छ, सायद यसको स्रोत लुकाउनका लागि। द्वन्द्व जारी रहँदा, दुई युक्रेनी सु-२५ विमान म्यानप्याड्सको दायरा भन्दा माथि हुदाँ, सम्भावित रूसी सीमाबाट प्रहार भएको SA-11 मिसाइलले खसेका छन्—यसले युक्रेनी हवाई कारबाहीमा थप जोखिम देखिन्छ। बिहीबार रूसी सेनाले रूसबाटै पूर्वी युक्रेनमा तोप हान्दै गरेको मानिएको छ। M-46 तोपको अधिकतम दूरी १६ माइल भए पनि, रूससँग अझ बढी दूरी पोल्ने प्रणालीहरू छन्, जसले स्थिति थप जटिल बनाएको छ। विदेशी विद्रोहीलाई सहयोग, हतियार र तालिम दिने रणनीति धेरै मुलुकले अपनाएका छन्, तर छिमेकी देशमा सिधा तोप आक्रमण गर्नु युद्ध गर्ने कार्य ठहरिन्छ—रूसी दृष्टिमा विद्रोहीहरूको अस्तित्वलाई ठूलो रणनीतिक महत्त्व दिइएको छ। शुक्रबार, युक्रेनले रूसी सीमातर्फ मोर्टार प्रहार गरी जवाफ दिएको खबर आएको छ, जसले तनाव अझ चुल्याएको छ। प्रारम्भमा आन्तरिक जस्तो देखिएको संघर्ष अब सिमाना पारि प्रत्यक्ष सैन्य भिडन्तमा पुगेको छ। झन्डै १५,००० रूसी सेना सीमामा रहेकाले, रूसले आफ्ना गतिविधिलाई रूसी मूलका नागरिकलाई समर्थन भन्न खोजेको छ, जसले रूसमा मिसिन चाहन्छन्। युक्रेनले यस्तो गतिविधिलाई आफ्नो सार्वभौमिकतामा हस्तक्षेप मानेर प्रतिकार गरिरहेको छ। दुबै पक्ष आ-आफ्नो रणनीति पुन: निर्धारण गर्दै छन्, तनाव उच्च छ। पर्यवेक्षकहरू भन्छन्, रूसले आवश्यकता परे पूर्वी युक्रेनमा 'रूसी नागरिकको सुरक्षा' का कारण थप हस्तक्षेप गर्न सक्छ—क्राइमियाको घटना सम्झनुपर्छ।

article_content: A group of prominent Silicon Valley investors, through Flannery Associates, has been acquiring large amounts of farmland in the Bay Area with plans to develop a new city named California Forever. Local farmers allege that Flannery Associates has used aggressive tactics, such as 'strong-arm' methods and a 'divide-and-conquer' strategy, to secure as much land as possible. These allegations surfaced in recent court filings related to ongoing lawsuits about the land deals. In August, reporting by The New York Times revealed that Flannery had, at that point, purchased $800 million worth of farmland in Solano County. Backed by influential figures like Marc Andreessen and Reid Hoffman, Flannery's vision is to transform their holdings into a utopian city of the future, although this city remains hypothetical. To achieve its goals, Flannery reportedly sought to purchase land from family-owned farms. Where negotiations faltered, Flannery initiated lawsuits against some farmers, accusing them of anti-competitive behavior. The farmers countered with accusations of bullying and manipulation by the tech-backed company. Court filings describe efforts by Flannery to 'pit families against each other' by misrepresenting intentions, aiming to pressure reluctant sellers. In one instance, Flannery bought part of a family's property from one member and then sued the remaining family members to acquire the rest. On its website, California Forever denies any improper conduct, claiming instead that a small group of individuals has launched a campaign to discredit Flannery Associates and is engaged in a 'secret conspiracy.' Despite these ambitions, the project's feasibility is uncertain. Local politicians have expressed doubts, and regulatory hurdles remain significant. Even if these obstacles are overcome, building and maintaining a thriving new city will be challenging. There are further questions about governance and the long-term viability of California Forever. While some view this effort as an overreach fueled by the ambitions of wealthy tech investors, the project's future remains undecided.

article_content: A revealing UV scan exposed severe skin damage on 30-year-old Kelly Hughes of Beaconsfield, Buckinghamshire, after 14 years of sunbed use. Starting at 16 to maintain a tan all year, Kelly was shocked to discover clusters of hidden skin marks that could raise her cancer risk. Dr. Askari Townshend, a skin expert, examined the images showing widespread speckled damage across most of Kelly’s face, sparing only her top lip. This advanced technology detects harm not visible on the surface. The findings support 'R UV UGLY', a Cancer Research UK campaign with sk:n clinics, aimed at deterring young people influenced by celebrity trends from using sunbeds. Studies show using a sunbed even once a month can increase the risk of skin cancer by 50%. Malignant melanoma is especially common in people aged 15-34. To raise awareness, experts are visiting shopping centres and providing free skin checks at clinics. These scans reveal signs like pigmented patches, wrinkles, and leathery skin—all results of overexposure to UV rays. Caroline Cerny from Cancer Research UK says that seeing clear evidence of skin damage may persuade people to avoid sunbeds. Kelly admitted she never realized how much unseen damage she had. After her scan, she quit sunbeds completely and looked for safer alternatives such as bronzers. The campaign allows the public to experience UV scans themselves, helping them recognize the risks hiding beneath a seemingly healthy tan.

Philadelphia 76ers guard Kelly Oubre Jr. sustained a fractured rib after being hit by a car that fled the scene on Saturday night in Center City, Philadelphia. The 27-year-old was transported to Thomas Jefferson University Hospital and released a few hours later in stable condition. On Sunday, the team stated that Oubre would miss the home game against the Indiana Pacers and be reassessed in about a week. Head coach Nick Nurse said Oubre is now at home and recovering, describing the event as traumatic but confirming that Oubre is resting well.

Coach Nurse added that Oubre plans to visit the team’s practice facility as an observer on Tuesday. His injuries are not considered season-ending, and his recovery progress will be re-evaluated to decide when he can return. Nurse highlighted Oubre’s determined attitude and optimism.

The accident happened around 7:20 p.m. on Saturday as Oubre was walking near his home. A car, reportedly moving at high speed in the same direction, attempted to turn and struck him with its driver-side mirror in the upper chest. The vehicle, described as silver, continued south and did not stop. Oubre also sustained hip and right leg injuries. Police are still investigating the incident.

This marks Oubre’s first season with the 76ers, averaging 16.8 points in his initial eight games. Drafted 15th overall in 2015, he has played for four other NBA teams. Coach Nurse expressed his disappointment over the injury, noting that Oubre had been making positive strides in his new role.

article_content: Google is revamping its Home app, responding to features users have requested most. Following a Reddit AMA, Google learned which updates are in high demand, and the company is committed to delivering them in future releases. A key request has been the integration of Nest Protect into the Home app. A Google product manager confirmed this is being explored, though there is no set timeline for availability (via 9to5Google). Widgets are another highly requested feature. A Google representative shared that the team is working on design and details for improved widgets, particularly for controlling individual devices and device groups. Currently, widget options in Google Home are limited to routines. Adding widgets for specific devices will make smart home control easier, like toggling lights with a quick tap. Google is also developing functionality that allows home or away modes to be triggered when connected smartphones join the Wi-Fi network. This would let the app use your device's presence on Wi-Fi as a sensor, instead of relying only on motion sensors. Users highlighted some inconsistencies between the Nest Hub and Google Home experiences. Google says it plans to address these issues. Additionally, camera notification previews—currently exclusive to Pixel Watch—are coming to all Wear OS 3+ watches paired with an Android 14 smartphone. The Home app will soon offer more granular controls over what family members can do and which devices they can access. At present, anyone added to your Home can make major changes, but new controls will allow varying levels of access. Lastly, Google is preparing to bring Home app support to more older camera models. Support for the Nest Cam Indoor (1st gen) is already available for eligible Public Preview users.
translated_content: गुगलले आफ्नो होम एपलाई नयाँ रूप दिइरहेको छ, प्रयोगकर्ताले धेरै समयदेखि माग गरेका सुविधाहरू समावेश गर्दै। रेडिट AMA पछि, गुगलले थाहा पायो के कस्ता अपडेटहरू सबैभन्दा बढि चाहिएका छन्, र कम्पनीले ती सुविधाहरू आउँदा संस्करणहरूमा ल्याउने वाचा गरेको छ। प्रयोगकर्ताहरूको मुख्य मागमध्ये होम एपमा Nest Protect को समावेश गर्ने हो। गुगलका एक प्रोडक्ट म्यानेजरका अनुसार, यसमा काम भइरहेको छ, यद्यपि उपलब्धताको लागि कुनै तोकिएको समय छैन (9to5Google अनुसार)। विजेट्स पनि अत्यन्तै माग गरिएका फिचर हुन्। गुगलका एक प्रतिनिधिले व्यक्तिगत डिभाइस र समूहहरूको लागि अझ सुधारिएको विजेट्सको डिजाइन र बिस्तृत कार्यमा टोली व्यस्त रहेको जानकारी दिएका छन्। अहिले गुगल होममा विजेट्स मात्र रूटिनमा सीमित छन्। व्यक्तिगत डिभाइसका लागि विजेट्स थपिए पछि स्मार्ट होम नियन्त्रण अझै सजिलो हुनेछ—जस्तै बत्ती बाल्न/बुझाउन विजेट थिच्न सकिने। गुगलले यस्तो सुविधा पनि विकास गर्दैछ, जसले वाइफाइ नेटवर्कमा स्मार्टफोन जडान हुँदा होम वा अवे मोड सक्रिय गर्न सकिनेछ। यसो गर्दा एपले वाइफाइ उपस्थितिलाई सेन्सरको रूपमा उपयोग गर्नेछ, मोशन सेन्सरमा मात्र भर नपर्ने। प्रयोगकर्ताहरूले Nest Hub र गुगल होम अनुभवमा भएका केही असमानता औंल्याएका छन्। गुगलले यी समस्याहरू समाधान गर्ने वाचा गरेको छ। त्यसैगरी, हाल पिक्सेल वाच विशेष सुविधा रहेको क्यामेरा नोटिफिकेशन प्रिभ्यूज अब Wear OS 3+ वाचहरू (Android 14 मा आधारित फोनमा जोडिएको) मा पनि उपलब्ध हुनेछन्। होम एपले चाँडै नै परिवारका सदस्यले के गर्न पाउने, कुन डिभाइस पहुँच पाउने जस्ता अधिकारहरूलाई थप सूक्ष्म रूपमा नियन्त्रण गर्ने सुविधा ल्याउनेछ। अहिलेसम्म, तपाईंको 'होम' मा थपिएका सबै सदस्यले ठूलो परिवर्तन गर्न सक्थे, तर अब फरक स्तरकै पहुँच दिन सकिनेछ। अन्ततः, गुगलले पुराना क्यामेरा मोडेलहरूको लागि पनि होम एपकाे समर्थन कार्यक्रम बढाउँदैछ। Nest Cam Indoor (1st gen) का लागि eligible Public Preview प्रयोगकर्तालाई यो सुविधा पहिल्यै उपलब्ध भइसकेको छ।

article_content: U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry took a break from attending a global summit on sexual violence in conflict to visit the Chiltern Firehouse, one of London’s most sought-after dining spots. Kerry, who arrived for the summit led by Angelina Jolie and aimed at tackling rape in war zones, was seen heading to the trendy restaurant during a pause in official discussions. Kerry is the latest in a series of politicians, royalty, and celebrities to dine at the luxury venue, which has drawn attention for its exclusivity—reviewers suggest even God would have to wait for a table. British Prime Minister David Cameron and his wife Samantha were recently spotted enjoying a date night at the Marylebone establishment. The couple, who are usually seen at high-street chains like Nando’s and Pizza Express, chose the Firehouse for a special evening. Owned by hotelier André Balazs, the restaurant is set within a converted fire station and is known for serving dishes like blackened salmon with kale and wood-grilled rib-eye steak. Since its opening, Chiltern Firehouse has become a hotspot for celebrities. Visitors include David Beckham, Bono, Lindsay Lohan, Courtney Love, Ralph Lauren, Kate Moss, Simon Cowell, Lauren Silverman, Piers Morgan, Rita Ora, Cara Delevingne, Tony and Cherie Blair, and others. The restaurant’s popularity continues to attract notable guests. Reviewer Tom Parker-Bowles described the Firehouse as being 'hotter than the surface of the sun,' a phrase that underscores its rise as London’s latest celebrity hangout.
translated_content: अमेरिकी विदेशमन्त्री जोन केरीले लन्डनको चर्चित चिल्टर्न फायरहाउस रेष्टुरेन्ट भ्रमण गर्न विश्वव्यापी द्वन्द्वकालीन यौन हिंसासम्बन्धी शिखर सम्मेलनबाट सानो विश्राम लिए। एन्जेलिना जोलीको नेतृत्वमा भएको, युद्ध क्षेत्रका बलात्कारविरुद्ध लड्न केन्द्रित उक्त सम्मेलनमा सहभागी हुन आएका केरी, वार्ताका बीचमा यो ट्रेन्डी रेष्टुरेन्ट जान देखिएका थिए। केरी हालै चिल्टर्न फायरहाउसमा खाना खाने राजनीतिक, राजपरिवारका सदस्य र चर्चित व्यक्तिहरूको सूचीमा थपिएका छन्। समीक्षकहरुले समेत ‘यहाँ त भगवान्लाई समेत कुर्नुपर्ने’ भन्दै यसको विशेषता बताउँछन्। बेलायती प्रधानमन्त्री डेभिड क्यामरुन र उनकी श्रीमती सामन्थाले पनि हालै म्यारिलबोनस्थित यस प्रतिष्ठानमा 'डेट नाइट' मनाएका थिए। सामान्यतः नान्डोस् या पिज्जा एक्सप्रेसजस्ता लोकप्रिय चेनहरूमा देखापर्ने जोडी, यसपटक चिल्टर्न फायरहाउस पुगे। होटल व्यवसायी आन्द्रे बालाज्सको स्वामित्वमा रहेको यो रेष्टुरेन्ट पूर्व-अग्निशमन केन्द्रमा रहेको छ र ब्ल्याकन्ड साल्मन, केलसहित तथा काठमा सेकिएको रिब-आइ स्टेक जस्ता विशेष परिकारले परिचित छ। खुल्ला भएको देखिनै चिल्टर्न फायरहाउस सेलिब्रिटीहरूको हटस्पट बनेको छ। वालेरु डेविड बेकह्याम, बोनो, लिन्डसे लोहान, कोर्टनी लभ, राल्फ लोरेन, केट मोस, साइमन कोवेल, लरेन सिल्भरम्यान, पियर्स मोर्गन, रीटा ओरा, कारा डेवेलिन, टोनी र चेरी ब्लेयर लगायत थुप्रै प्रसिद्ध व्यक्तिहरूले यहाँ भ्रमण गरेका छन्। यसको लोकप्रियता अझै बढ्दो छ। समीक्षक टम पार्कर-बोल्सले यसलाई ‘सूर्यको सतहमै भन्दा पनि बढी तातो’ भनेर वर्णन गरेका छन्, जसले लन्डनको चर्चित सेलिब्रिटी स्थलको रूपमा यसको छवि झल्काउँछ।

article_content: The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), comprising the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, and Kuwait, has announced the closure of its embassies in Syria, urging decisive international action to end the violence. This move reflects the GCC's strong opposition to the Syrian regime’s continued attacks on unarmed civilians and its disregard for diplomatic and humanitarian efforts. GCC Secretary-General Abdullatif Al-Zayani called for immediate international measures to halt the killings, torture, and flagrant human rights violations in Syria. Numerous Western nations, including the United States and France, have also ceased diplomatic operations in Damascus. Entering its second year, the Syrian conflict persists with President Bashar al-Assad’s forces continuing severe crackdowns on anti-government areas. The United Nations estimates over 8,000 civilian deaths, though opposition activists say the toll has surpassed 9,700, approaching 10,000—mostly civilians. International officials are planning missions to assess and address urgent humanitarian needs throughout Syria. Valerie Amos, UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs, stated that a Syrian-led mission will visit several provinces—Homs, Hama, Tartous, Latakia, Aleppo, Deir Ezzor, Rif Damashq, and Daraa—with the participation of the UN and Organization of Islamic Cooperation representatives. Amos highlighted the necessity for unhindered humanitarian access and rapid delivery of life-saving aid. The United States has contributed over $12 million for humanitarian assistance through the UN and other organizations, including support for the UN refugee agency, the International Committee of the Red Cross, the World Food Program, and various NGOs. Iran, a key Syrian ally, has delivered medicine and 40 tons of aid to Damascus and has pledged to send further relief supplies. This week marks the first anniversary of the Syrian uprising, which was initially sparked by the arrest of children in Daraa for anti-government graffiti. The subsequent violent crackdown inspired nationwide protest, leading to intensified conflict that endures today. UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon has strongly condemned the ongoing suppression by Syrian authorities and called for an urgent end to the violence and protection of civilians. Thousands remain missing, wounded, or displaced amid persistent daily bloodshed. The Syrian government’s military actions continue in Idlib province, a center of opposition strength. State media claims government forces have cleared ‘terrorists’ from the city, while opposition groups allege dozens of deaths, reports of torture, home searches, and the burning of property. Human Rights Watch has documented witness reports of widespread, indiscriminate attacks. Many Idlib-area residents are fleeing to Turkey; over 1,000 Syrians reportedly entered Turkey within 24 hours, bringing the refugee total to around 14,000. Turkish sources allege Syria is reinforcing border security and planting mines to curb refugee flows. Two Turkish journalists missing in Idlib are believed to be detained by Syrian regime supporters, with their current status unknown. Additional deaths have been reported elsewhere in Syria, including from clashes involving the opposition Free Syrian Army and government forces. The Syrian authorities attribute the violence to ‘armed terrorist groups’ and claim significant public support, highlighting pro-government rallies. With severe restrictions on foreign journalists, independent verification of events in Syria is difficult. Nevertheless, most reports suggest widespread civilian targeting by government forces. Countries such as the Netherlands and Bahrain have recently closed their embassies in Damascus. International condemnation of the Assad regime persists, with calls for more decisive action by the UN Security Council and advocacy for targeted sanctions and referral to the International Criminal Court. UN and Arab League envoy Kofi Annan continues efforts to broker a ceasefire, with the Syrian government welcoming the arrival of a technical team for discussions.
translated_content: युएई, बहराइन, साउदी अरबसहित छ वटा गल्फ कोअपरेशन काउन्सिल (GCC) का सदस्य राष्ट्रहरूले सिरियामा आफ्ना दूतावासहरू बन्द गर्ने घोषणा गरेका छन्। GCC ले सिरियामा भइरहेको हिंसा र मानवीय संकट अन्त्यका लागि तुरुन्त टुङ्गो लाग्ने अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय कदमको माग गरेको छ। GCC का महासचिव अब्दुल्लतिफ अल-जयानिले सिरियामा हत्यासहितको मानव अधिकार उल्लङ्घन रोक्न तत्काल र दृढ कारबाहीको अनुरोध गरेका छन्। अमेरिका, फ्रान्सलगायत अन्य पश्चिमी मुलुकले पनि दामास्कसमा आफ्नो कूटनीतिक सेवा बन्द गरेका छन्। सिरियाली संकट दोस्रो वर्षमा छिर्दै गर्दा राष्ट्रपति बशर अल-असदको सुरक्षाफौजले सरकार विरोधी क्षेत्रमा कठोर दमन जारी राखेका छन्। संयुक्त राष्ट्रका अनुसार नागरिक मृतक संख्या ८,००० नाघेको छ भने केही विपक्षीको भनाइ अनुसार यो संख्या ९,७०० नाघेर १०,००० नजिक पुगेको छ। अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अधिकारीहरू सहायता पुर्‍याउन तथा मानवीय अवस्थाको मूल्यांकन गर्न क्षेत्रीय भ्रमणको तयारी गर्दै छन्। यूएन मानवीय मामिला प्रमुख भ्यालेरी अमोसले होम्स, हामा, टार्टस, लाटाकिया, एलेप्पो, देइर एजोर, रिफ दमास्क, र दारा जिल्लाहरूमा सिरियाली सरकारको अगुवाइमा संयुक्त टोली पुग्ने जानकारी दिइन्। उनले सहयोगको सहज आपूर्ति र आपतकालीन सहायता महत्वपूणर् रहेको उल्लेख गरिन्। संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका यूएन र अन्य संस्थामार्फत १२ मिलियन डलर भन्दा बढी सहयोग गर्दैछ। ईरानले समेत ४० टन राहत पार्सल सहित औषधि सिरिया पठाइसकेको छ र थप सहायता पठाउने बताएको छ। यस साताले सिरियाली आन्दोलनको पहिलो वार्षिकोत्सव हो, जसको सुरूवात हो दारा सहरमा वालबालिका पक्राउपछि भएको थियो। त्यसपश्चात हिंसा बढेर देशभर फैलिएको छ। यूएन महासचिव बान की मुनले सरकारले गरेको दमनको घोर भर्त्सना गर्दै नागरिकको सुरक्षा र समस्या समाधानमा जोड दिएका छन्। अझै हजारौं घाइते, बेपत्ता तथा विस्थापित छन्। इद्लिब मुख्य विपक्षी क्षेत्र हो, जहाँ सुरक्षाफौजले सैन्य कारबाही जारी राखेको छ। सरकारी मिडियाले 'आतङ्ककारी' सफा गरिएको दाबी गरे पनि विपक्षीले दर्जनौंमा हत्या, यातना, घर खानतलासी र घरमा आगजनीको आरोप लगाएका छन्। मानव अधिकारकर्मीले निर्दोष नागरिकलाई लक्षित गरिएको प्रतिवेदन गरेका छन्। इद्लिब वरपरका धेरै व्यक्तिहरू टर्कीतर्फ भाग्दै छन्, पछिल्लो २४ घन्टामा १,००० बढी शरणार्थी पुगेका छन्। टर्कीको दावी छ कि सिरियाले सीमा क्षेत्रमा सैनिक बढाउनुका साथै बारुद राखेको छ। इद्लिबमा हराएका दुई टर्की पत्रकारलाई सरकारी समर्थकहरूले नियन्त्रणमा लिएर कहाँ राखिएको भन्ने खुलेको छैन। अन्य शहरहरूमा समेत भिडन्त र मृत्युका घटना जारी छन्। सिरियाली अधिकारीहरू आक्रमणका लागि 'सशस्त्र आतङ्ककारी समूह' लाई दोष दिन्छन् र उनीहरूको व्यापक समर्थन रहेको दाबी गर्छन्। सरकारको कडा सञ्चार नियन्त्रणका कारण स्वतन्त्र रूपमा समाचार पुष्टि कठिन छ। तर, अधिकांश रिपोर्टले सरकारी आक्रमणमा नागरिक लक्षित भएको देखाउँछ। नेदरल्यान्ड्स, बहराइन लगायत धेरै देशले दूतावास बन्द गरेका छन्। असद सरकारमाथि अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय दबाब बढ्दै छ भने सुरक्षा परिषद्ले कडा कदम चाल्न मानव अधिकारसंस्थाहरूले माग गरेका छन्। यूएन-आमंत्रित कोफी अन्नानले युद्धविरामका लागि पहल गरिरहेका छन् भने सरकारले आफ्नो टोलीलाई article_content: A Federal Capital Territory High Court on Friday ordered the remand of 13 members of the Petroleum Tanker Drivers Branch of the Nigeria Union of Petroleum and Natural Gas Workers (NUPENG) in Kuje Correctional Centre over the alleged attempted murder of NUPENG's National President, Williams Akporeha, and two others. Justice Yusuf Halilu issued the remand order after their arraignment on a five-count criminal charge. Those arraigned include former National Chairman of the Petroleum Tanker Drivers Branch, Lucky Osesua; his Deputy, Dayyabu Garga; Humble Obinna; Akinolu Olabisi; Godwin Nwaka; Tiamiu Sikiru; Abdulmimin Shaibu; John Amajuoyi; Zaira Aregbo; Patrick Erhivwor; Stephen Ogheneruemu; Gift Ukponku; and Sunday Ezeocha. The suit, CR/042/2023, was brought by the Inspector General of Police, with the above-listed officials as defendants. The charges allege that on November 1, 2023, the defendants, with intent to cause a breach of peace, laid siege at the Petroleum Tanker Drivers’ office at No. 50 Moses Majekodenmi Crescent, Utako District, against Williams Akporeha, Olawale Afolabi, Solomon Kilanko, and Augustine Egbon, an offence punishable under Section 114 of the Penal Code Act, 2004. Another charge alleges that the defendants acted in a manner likely to cause the death of Williams Akporeha and Augustine Egbon, contrary to Section 229 of the Penal Code Act, 2004. Further charges include voluntarily causing grievous bodily harm to Williams Akporeha, Olawale Afolabi, Solomon Kilanko, and Augustine Egbon. All 13 defendants pleaded not guilty. Prosecuting counsel Frank Longe then requested a date to begin the trial. Defence counsel Chris Oshomogie, SAN, orally requested bail, arguing that the alleged offences were bailable. The court, however, rejected the oral application and asked for a formal motion. Justice Halilu ordered the defendants’ remand pending a ruling on bail and adjourned the case until November 21 for trial. As of the time of filing this report, the judge had endorsed the detention order in preparation for the accused persons’ transfer to Kuje Correctional Centre.

article_content: American architect Michael Graves has little patience for bad design, especially when it comes to hospitals. During his stay at a rehabilitation center after contracting a rare, life-threatening infection, Graves couldn't help but notice the unattractive magenta-and-green floral bed sheets. 'It's far too ugly for me to die here,' he joked at TEDMED, a conference dedicated to innovation in health care. His perspective deepened as he spent time in eight different hospitals and three rehabilitation centers, adjusting to life in a wheelchair. Graves noted, 'They didn't make big mistakes. They just made the most frustrating mistakes you could ever imagine, making recovery more difficult. Your room should make it easier for doctors, aides, and patients—but often it does the opposite.' Graves is recognized as one of the most influential living architects, with honors for designing hundreds of buildings—such as the Team Disney building in Burbank, California—for corporations, governments, foundations, and universities. He is known for creating spaces that are both functional and aesthetically pleasing. Many Americans also know Graves as the designer of affordable, practical products for Target, ranging from tea kettles to avocado scoopers and bamboo salad tongs. His philosophy: 'Good design should be affordable to all.' Now, Graves aims to bring this approach to health care facilities. Eight years ago, he became personally acquainted with hospitals after a sudden infection left him paralyzed. Doctors have yet to identify the cause; the illness is so rare that it lacks a name. Only a handful of similar cases have been reported in the United States. The infection, which affected his spine and resulted in paralysis, ended his ability to walk and golf. During recovery, Graves encountered many accessibility issues in hospitals and rehab centers. At a rehabilitation center, he found basic items—such as the sink faucet, toiletries, and electrical outlets—out of reach from his wheelchair, even though these facilities were designed for people with mobility challenges. He described losing his sense of independence because of these design flaws. At one newly built hospital, he observed that while public spaces were grand, patient rooms were small and difficult for wheelchair users and staff to navigate. Frustrated, Graves continued to sketch ideas for better hospital designs, including furniture and room layouts. These ideas turned into reality when Graves' firm joined with hospital furnishing company Stryker in 2009 to produce accessible products. He designed chairs with larger handles for easier use, and bedside cabinets with rounded edges and two-way drawers. To better empathize with patients, his company even has employees spend a week in wheelchairs. Graves is now focused on improving hospitals, rehabilitation centers, and home care environments through better design. 'This is my life now,' he said. 'Losing certain abilities led me to a new purpose: making health care environments better. Something good came from this.'
translated_content: अमेरिकी आर्किटेक्ट माइकल ग्रेव्सलाई खराब डिजाइन खासै मन पर्दैन, विशेषगरी अस्पतालका सन्दर्भमा । दुर्लभ, ज्यानै जाने रोगका कारण पुनर्स्थापना केन्द्रमा रहँदा ग्रेव्सले आफ्नो ओछ्यानको मैजेन्डा र हरियो फुलजस्तो छाप भएका बेडसिट देख्दा आकर्षक नलाग्ने पाए। उनले TEDMED नामक स्वास्थ्यका नयाँ सोचबारे सम्मेलनमा रमाइलो गर्दै भने, 'यो बेड त यति कुरूप छ, म यहाँ मर्न चाहन्न।' उनी आठवटा अस्पताल र तीनवटा पुनर्स्थापना केन्द्रमा बसेका थिए, ह्वीलचेयरमा बस्न अभ्यस्त हुँदै। ग्रेव्स भन्छन्, 'ठुला गल्ती थिएनन्, तर यति झन्झटिला गल्ती गरेका थिए कि निको हुन समेत गाह्रो हुन्थ्यो। तपाईंको कोठाले डाक्टर, स्टाफ र बिरामी सबैलाई काम गर्न सहज बनाउनुपर्छ—तर धेरैजसो अवस्थामा उल्टो मात्र हुन्छ।' ग्रेव्सलाई अमेरिकाका सबैभन्दा प्रभावशाली जीवित आर्किटेक्टमध्ये एक मानिन्छ, जसले कर्पोरेशन, सरकार, संस्था र विश्वविद्यालयका लागि सयौं भवन डिजाइन गरेका छन्, जस्तै टिम डिज्नी भवन (बर्बैंक, क्यालिफोर्निया)। उनी कार्यात्मक र आकर्षक दुवै प्रकारका भवन बनाउनमा प्रसिद्ध छन्। धेरै अमेरिकीका लागि ग्रेव्स टार्गेट स्टोरमा पाइने सुलभ, व्यावहारिक घरेलु सामग्री, जस्तै टी केतलीदेखि ऐभोकेडो स्कूपर र बाँसको सलाद टोङका डिजाइनरका रुपमा परिचित छन्। उनको सोच: 'राम्रो डिजाइन सबैका लागि सुलभ हुनुपर्छ।' अब, ग्रेव्स यही सोच स्वास्थ्य सेवाका भवनमा ल्याउन चाहन्छन्। आठ वर्ष अघि अकस्मात रोग लाग्दा उनी पक्षघात भएका थिए र अस्पतालसँग निकट भए। डाक्टरहरुले अझै कारण फेला पारेका छैनन्; यसको नाम समेत छैन। अमेरिकामा केवल थोरै अवस्थामा मात्र यस्तो केस भेटिएको छ। संक्रमणले मेरुदण्डमा असर गर्दा उनी हिडडुल र गल्फ खेल्न असमर्थ भए। उपचारको समयमा अस्पताल तथा पुनर्स्थापना केन्द्रमा उनले पहुँचसम्बन्धी धेरै समस्या देखें। पुनर्स्थापना केन्द्रमा ह्वीलचेयरमै हुँदा बेसिन, टुथपेस्ट, ब्रस, रेजरको प्लग सबै बाहिर कोठामा थिए—यद्यपि ती ठाउँहरु ह्वीलचेयर प्रयोगकर्ताका लागि थिए। यस्तो डिजाइन झन्झटले उनले आत्मनिर्भरता गुमाएका महसुस गराए। एउटा नयाँ अस्पतालमा, सार्वजनिक ठाउँहरू भव्य भए पनि बिरामीका कोठा साँघुरा थिए र ह्वीलचेयर तथा कर्मचारीलाई सञ्चालन गर्न गार्हो हुन्थ्यो। त्यसपछि ग्रेव्सले राम्रो अस्पताल, फर्निचर र कोठाको डिजाइन स्केच गर्न थाले। यी विचारलाई २००९ मा उनले नेतृत्व गरेको कम्पनीले अस्पताल फर्निचर बनाउने स्ट्राइकर कम्पनीसँग सहकार्य गरी व्यावसायिक उत्पादनमा परिणत ग¥यो। उनले ठूलो ह्यान्डल भएको कुर्सी, गोलो धार भएको क्याबिनेट, दुईतर्फ ड्रअर डिजाइन गरे। कम्पनीका कर्मचारीलाई हप्ता दिन ह्वीलचेयर प्रयोग गर्न लगाइन्छ, ताकि बिरामीको अनुभव बुझ्न सकियोस्। अब ग्रेव्स अझ राम्रो डिजाइन मार्फत अस्पताल, पुनर्स्थापना केन्द्र र घर सम्हाल्ने स्थानमा सुधार ल्याउन केन्द्रित छन्। 'यो नै मेरो जीवन हो,' उनले भने, 'केही कुरा गुमाउँदा मैले नयाँ उद्देश्य पाउँछु—स्वास्थ्य सेवाका भवन सुधार गर्ने। मेरी अपांगताको कारण केही राम्रो पनि भयो।'

article_content: A recent survey has revealed that a third of adults do not know that Charles Dickens wrote 'Great Expectations'. Additionally, one in six participants were unable to name Shakespeare as the author of 'Hamlet'. The survey also found that 28 percent of adults admitted to never having read a classic novel, and one in seven reported not reading any books in the past year. The results suggest that many people complete their education without studying classical literature in detail, and this habit continues into adulthood. Only 12 percent of respondents have read 'Much Ado About Nothing', 18 percent have read 'Catcher in the Rye', and just 26 percent have picked up 'Pride and Prejudice', despite its popularity in film and television. A quarter of adults have read fewer than five books in the past year, with the average being seven books according to the survey of 2,000 people. Half of those who read fewer than ten books a year blamed lack of time, while a quarter cited more interesting things to do. Around one in eight said they were slow readers, and a similar proportion stated they simply didn’t enjoy reading. Most people read at bedtime, with just under half saying they pick up a book while in bed. A third use holidays to catch up on reading, and a quarter read whenever they have a chance. Thrillers are the most popular genre (30 percent), followed by crime novels (26 percent). Romance novels are favored by 16 percent—29 percent of women and just 2 percent of men. The most popular contemporary book is 'The Da Vinci Code' (36 percent have read it), followed by the 'Harry Potter' series (28 percent). James Endersby, managing director of Opinium Research, commented: 'Unfortunately, for many people, reading is now a luxury and something they cannot dedicate much time to. Over the summer, many may have enjoyed reading, and hopefully this reminded them of the enjoyment to be found in books. It would be wonderful if everyone chose to read at least one classic during the winter.' Educational policy is also changing. Modular exams have allowed students to study only parts of books, but Education Secretary Michael Gove is revising the curriculum to introduce more rigorous end-of-course exams. Secondary school students will be required to study at least two Shakespeare plays and a 19th-century novel at GCSE, covering the works of two authors in depth each year. A Department for Education spokesperson stated: 'New GCSEs will require students to read entire texts. The exam specifications will ensure pupils read a wide range of classic literature fluently and in depth, developing their understanding of English literary heritage.'

मात्र २६ प्रतिशतले ‘प्राइड एन्ड प्रेजुडिस’ पढेका छन्—फिल्म र टेलिभिजनमा यसको लोकप्रियता हुँदाहुँदै। एक चौथाइ वयस्कले विगत वर्षमा पाँचभन्दा कम किताब पढेका छन्, र सर्वेक्षण अनुसार औसत सात किताब पढिएको छ। वर्षमा दशभन्दा कम पुस्तक पढ्ने मध्ये आधाले समय अभाव कारण देखाएका छन्, जब कि एक चौथाइले अरू चाख लाग्दा पढ्न छोड्ने बताएका छन्। आठ जनामा एक जनाले आफू ढिलो पढ्ने बताएका छन् भने यति नैले पढ्न रुचि नभएको बताएका छन्। धेरैजसोले सुत्ने बेला किताब पढेको बताएका छन्, करिब आधाले ओछ्यानमा किताब खोल्ने गर्छन्। एक तिहाइले बिदामा यात्राका बेला पढ्ने समय पाउँछन्, एक चौथाइले भने फुर्सदमा जहाँसुकै पढ्ने गर्छन्। थ्रिलर सबैभन्दा लोकप्रिय विधा हो (३० प्रतिशत), त्यसपछि क्राइम उपन्यास (२६ प्रतिशत)। रोमान्स उपन्यास १६ प्रतिशतले मन पराएका छन्—महिलाहरूमा २९ प्रतिशत, पुरुषमा २ प्रतिशत। सबैभन्दा लोकप्रिय समकालीन पुस्तक ‘द दा भिन्ची कोड’ हो (३६ प्रतिशतले पढेका), पछ्याउने ‘ह्यारी पोटर’ सिरिज (२८ प्रतिशत)। ओपिनियम रिसर्चका प्रबन्ध निर्देशक जेम्स एन्डर्स्बीले भने, 'दुर्भाग्यवश धेरैको लागि अहिले पढ्न समय निकाल्न गाह्रो छ। गर्मीको समयमा कतिपयले किताब पढ्दै रमाएका होलान् र आफैँलाई पढ्दा कति रमाइलो लाग्छ भन्ने बुझ्न सकेका होलान्। जाडो महिनामा सबैले कम्तीमा एउटा क्लासिक किताब छानेर पढून् भन्ने आशा रहन्छ।' शैक्षिक नीति पनि परिवर्तन हुँदैछ। मोड्युलर परीक्षाले विद्यार्थीलाई पुस्तकका केही भाग मात्रै पढ्न दिने गरेको थियो, तर शिक्षा मन्त्री माइकल गवले पाठ्यक्रममा संशोधन गरी कडा अन्त्य परीक्षा ल्याउन लागेका छन्। माध्यमिक विद्यालयका विद्यार्थीले जीसीएसईमा कम्तीमा दुईवटा शेक्सपियर नाटक र एकवटा १९औं शताब्दीको उपन्यास पढ्नुपर्ने छ, साथै प्रत्येक वर्ष दुई लेखकको कृतिको गहिरो अध्ययन अनिवार्य छ। शिक्षा मन्त्रालयका प्रवक्ताका शब्दमा: 'नयाँ जीसीएसईले विद्यार्थीलाई पूरै पुस्तक पढ्न निर्देशन दिनेछ। परीक्षाको खाका यस्तो हुनेछ कि विद्यार्थीले क्लासिक साहित्य गहिरो र राम्रोसँग पढ्न पाउनेछन् र अंग्रेजी साहित्यिक सम्पदामा आफ्नो बुझाइ विकास गर्न पाउनेछन्।'

Cassie Woods, who lives in Stafford, Virginia, was shocked when she began receiving emails from her deceased mother, Paula Chase, nearly two years after Paula passed away in 2009 due to scleroderma, an auto-immune disorder. In September, the family discovered that Paula’s Yahoo email account had been hacked and was sending out spam messages every few days with subjects like 'male enhancement,' 'work at home,' and 'cheap Viagra.' These spam messages have been distributed to everyone in Paula's address book, deeply distressing Cassie and her sisters.

Cassie described her reaction, saying, 'I don't think it's fair that me and my sisters have to suffer seeing an email from my mum who's not even here.' Her father, Jarrod, an Iraq veteran, tried to contact the hacker by email, even threatening to involve the police.

The family found the situation even more painful as some spam messages included obscene content. When contacting Yahoo, they were told that to close the account, they needed to submit Paula's death certificate, a formal request, and proof of their relationship. So far, the family has struggled to gather and submit all the required documents, though Paula’s obituary and information in the Social Security death index can be found online. Yahoo has expressed sympathy for the family's experience and assured that they would help close the account once documentation is provided.

केसीले भनिन्, 'म र मेरा दिदीबहिनीहरूलाई यहाँ नभइसकेकी आमाबाट इमेल आउनु सही होइन जस्तो लाग्छ।' उनका बुबा जारोड, इराकका पूर्व सैनिक, ह्याकरलाई इमेल गरेर प्रहरीलाई खबर गर्ने धम्कीसमेत दिए।

परिवारलाई झन् कठिन भयो किनभने केही स्प्याम मेसेजहरू अश्लील थिए। याहूसँग सम्पर्क गर्दा अकाउन्ट बन्द गर्न आमाको मृत्युप्रमाणपत्र, औपचारिक अनुरोध, र आफन्त भएको प्रमाण पेश गर्न भनिएको छ। हालसम्म परिवारले आवश्यक सबै कागजात संकलन र बुझाउन संघर्ष गरिरहेको छ, यद्यपि पौलाको मृत्युको सूचना अनलाइन र सामाजिक सुरक्षा मृत्यु सूचिमा उपलब्ध छ। याहूले परिवारसँग सहानुभूति व्यक्त गर्दै आवश्यक कागजात पाएपछि अकाउन्ट बन्द गरिदिने आश्वासन दिएको छ।

article_content: A UK resident sparked backlash on social media after criticizing Prime Minister Rishi Sunak’s Diwali celebrations at 10 Downing Street. Sunak and his wife, Akshata Murty, hosted members of the Indian community for the festival and shared event photos on official social media. Steve Laws, reacting online, compared Downing Street to a 'Bollywood film set.' He posted a photo, saying, 'Number 10 Downing Street looks like a Bollywood movie set instead of the home of a British Prime Minister. Today it’s been filled with a group of Indians celebrating Diwali.' Laws’ remarks quickly faced online condemnation, with many calling them racist. The shared photo showed the UK Prime Minister, Akshata Murty, and members of the Indian community, posted on November 13. Many social media users criticized Laws, finding his comment offensive. Some referenced colonial histories in Canada, Australia, the USA, Alaska, and New Zealand, while others mentioned the UK’s past in India and wealth extraction. Prime Minister Sunak and Akshata Murty celebrated Diwali with the Hindu community in the UK, sharing images of the festivities. The official UK Prime Minister Twitter posted Diwali wishes, emphasizing the triumph of light over darkness. A photo featured Sunak and Murty lighting a ceremonial diya together. translated_content: एक जना बेलायती नागरिकले प्रधानमन्त्री ऋषि सुनकको १० डाउनिङ स्ट्रिटमा आयोजित दिवाली उत्सवको आलोचना गरेपछि सामाजिक सञ्जालमा तीव्र आलोचना झेल्नु परेको छ। सुनक र उनकी पत्नी अक्षता मूर्तिले भारतीय समुदायका सदस्यहरूसँग यो पर्व मनाउँदै, तस्बिरहरू आधिकारिक सामाजिक सञ्जालमा साझा गरे। स्थानीय बासिन्दा स्टिभ लजले अनलाइन प्रतिक्रिया दिँदै डाउनिङ स्ट्रिटलाई 'बलिउड फिल्म सेट' सँग तुलना गरे। उनले तस्बिर साझा गर्दै लेखे, 'नम्बर १० डाउनिङ स्ट्रिट बेलायती प्रधानमन्त्रीको घरभन्दा बलिउड फिल्म सेट जस्तो देखिन्छ। आज त्यो भवन भारतीयहरूले दिवाली मनाइरहेका छन्।' लजको टिप्पणी छिट्टै सामाजिक सञ्जालमा आलोचित भयो, धेरैले त्यसलाई जातीय घृणापूर्ण भने। तस्बिरमा प्रधानमन्त्री, अक्षता मूर्ति र भारतीय समुदायका सदस्यहरू देखिएका थिए, जुन नोभेम्बर १३ मा पोस्ट गरिएको थियो। धेरै सामाजिक सञ्जाल प्रयोगकर्ताहरूले लजको भनाइलाई आपत्तिजनक ठहर गरे। कतिपयले क्यानडा, अस्ट्रेलिया, अमेरिका, अलास्का र न्यूजिल्याण्डमा उपनिवेशवादको इतिहास उल्लेख गरे भने अरूले बेलायतको भारतमाथिको विगतको शोषणको चर्चा गरे। प्रधानमन्त्री सुनक र अक्षता मूर्तिले बेलायतको हिन्दु समुदायसँग दिवाली मनाउँदै, उत्सवको झलकहरू सेयर गरे। बेलायती प्रधानमन्त्रीको आधिकारिक ट्विटरबाट दिवालीको शुभकामना दिँदै उज्यालोको जितको सन्देश सेयर गरियो। एउटा तस्बिरमा सुनक र मूर्ति सँगै दियो बालिरहेका थिए। स्पष्टीकरण: यो सामग्री तेस्रो पक्षद्वारा तयार गरिएको हो। यहाँका विचार लेखक वा सम्बन्धित संघसंस्थाका हुन्, आर्थिक टाइम्स (ET) का होइनन्। ET ले सही वा अद्यावधिक भएको ग्यारेन्टी गर्दैन; पाठकहरूलाई विवरण पुष्टि गर्न सुझाव गरिएको छ।

article_content: GENEVA: On Wednesday, October 11, the United Nations Human Rights Council adopted a resolution to investigate the humanitarian situation in Sudan, where the army and a paramilitary group, the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), have been fighting for the past six months. "This resolution is a call to action for what we all agree are pressing priorities: for the warring parties to cease atrocities and other abuses, lay down their weapons, and allow safe, rapid, and unhindered humanitarian access that is urgently needed," said Michèle Taylor, the United States' permanent representative to the UN Human Rights Council. The US was among the countries that presented the resolution. Nineteen countries voted in favor, 16 voted against, and 12 abstained from the resolution. Violence and displacement have escalated since fighting erupted between the Sudanese army and the RSF in April. West Darfur is among the hardest hit regions, suffering ethnically motivated attacks that have killed hundreds. The RSF has denied accusations from rights groups that it is responsible for attacks on civilians, stating that any soldiers found involved would be brought to justice. Sudan also denies killing civilians and describes the conflict as an internal matter. "The international community cannot place blind trust in the goodwill of generals who have shown complete disregard for civilians' lives and their duty to protect them," Taylor said. Last week, the United Nations reported difficulty reaching 18 million people in need in Sudan, hindered by insecurity, interference from both sides, and insufficient international support.
translated_content: जेनेभा: बुधबार, अक्टोबर ११ मा संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ मानव अधिकार परिषद्ले सुडानकाे मानविय अवस्थाकाे छानबिन गर्न प्रस्ताव पारित गरेकाे छ, जहाँ सेना र अर्धसैनिक समूह र्‍यापिड सपोर्ट फोर्सेस (RSF) ले विगत छ महिनादेखि संघर्ष गरिरहेका छन्। “यो प्रस्ताव आपसी सहमतिका अत्यावश्यक प्राथमिकताहरूमा कारवाही गर्न आह्वान हो : द्वन्द्वरत पक्षहरूले अत्याचार र अन्य दुर्व्यवहार अन्त्य गरून्, हातहतियार राखून्, र अत्यावश्यक सुरक्षित, छिटो र अवरोधरहित मानविय सहायता दिन अनुमति दिनू पर्छ,” संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ मानव अधिकार परिषद्‍का लागि अमेरिकाकी स्थायी प्रतिनिधि मिशेल टेलरले भनिन्। अमेरिका प्रस्ताव प्रस्तुत गर्ने मुलुकहरूमध्ये एक हो। १९ देशले पक्षमा, १६ ले विपक्षमा तथा १२ देशले मतदानबाट पर राखे। सु्डानको सेना र RSF बीच अप्रिलदेखि सुरु भएको संघर्षपछि हिंसा र विस्थापन बढेको छ। पश्चिम दारफुर अत्याधिक प्रभावित क्षेत्रहरू मध्ये पर्छ, जहाँ जातीय हिंसाले सयौँको मृत्यु भएको छ। RSF ले मानवअधिकार समूहहरूको आरोप अस्वीकार गर्दै, संलग्न भएका सैनिकलाई कारवाही गर्ने बताएको छ। सुडान सरकारले समेत नागरिकको हत्या अस्वीकार गर्दै यसलाई आन्तरिक विषय भनेको छ। “अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय समुदायले यस्ता वरिष्ठ सेनापतिहरूको सद्भावमा आँखा चिम्लन सक्दैन, जसले नागरिकहरूको जीवन र उनीहरूलाई सुरक्षा गर्ने दायित्वप्रति पूर्ण बेवास्ता देखाएका छन्,” टेलरले भनिन्। गत हप्ता, संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघले सुडानमा १ करोड ८० लाख मानिसहरूसम्म पुग्न असहज रहेको जनाएको छ, जुन असुरक्षा, द्वन्द्वरत पक्षहरूको हस्तक्षेप र अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सहयोग नहुनुका कारण भएको हो।

article_content: The Oklahoma City Thunder’s roster boasts remarkable depth, with several talented players waiting for their chance to contribute. Outside of the regular rotation, four players on full-time contracts stand out for their professional experience and potential NBA impact. Vasilije Micic, a seasoned international guard, is adjusting to the NBA but brings proven playmaking, vision, and three-point shooting. Whether filling in during injuries or providing veteran presence off the bench, Micic’s skills could earn him a significant role. Davis Bertans, known for his elite three-point shooting and 6’10” frame, offers a valuable offensive spark, though defense remains a challenge. Used mainly in specific situations so far, Bertans could become a key contributor during hot shooting streaks. Tre Mann, the team’s 2021 No. 18 draft pick, flashed scoring ability as a rookie but has seen his minutes reduce after a less successful second season. His opportunity hinges on improving defense, making quicker reads, and maintaining offensive flow. Mann’s scoring bursts off the bench could still play a decisive role in certain games. Aleksej Pokusevski, just 21 and recovering from injuries, has played the fewest minutes of anyone on the 15-man roster. He offers size, playmaking, and defensive disruption but must prove himself to secure rotation minutes. Every member of the Thunder’s roster brings something distinctive, underscoring the team’s depth. Over the course of the 82-game season, the opportunity for each player to contribute will inevitably arise.

article_content: Sir Sandy Woodward, the Falklands War veteran who commanded the British Naval task force in 1982, has warned that further cuts to the Royal Navy could leave the UK 'defenceless and ripe for the taking.' In a rare statement, Sir Sandy emphasized that unless reductions to the fleet are reversed, Britain will lack the ability to defend its global interests. He further warned that the UK's status as a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council could be at risk if the country is perceived as unable to protect territories such as the Falkland Islands. Sir Sandy's comments appeared in a letter to the Commons Defence Committee, which is currently assessing Britain's future defence needs. The letter was co-signed by other prominent figures from the Falklands era, including Brigadier Julian Thompson, leader of 3 Commando Brigade Royal Marines, and Admiral Sir Michael Layard, former commander of the Atlantic Conveyor. The authors argue that defence cuts have already diminished the UK's international standing, threatening important trade and energy interests. They wrote: 'It is evident the UK is quickly becoming a different nation by default—one less likely to be respected by friends and adversaries. Our strategic reach has been sharply reduced, and we are no longer able to support the United States militarily as we have for decades. This could put our position on the UN Security Council at risk if we cannot defend our dependent territories.' Sir Sandy specifically criticized the management of Britain's aircraft carrier replacement program, noting that current plans will leave the British fleet without operational carrier capability for a decade. Following a government policy reversal last year, the new carriers Queen Elizabeth and Prince of Wales will be fitted with 12 F-35B Joint Strike Fighters, each costing £500 million, but these will not be ready to fly until 2020—ten years after the retirement of Harrier jets. Even once operational, Sir Sandy argued, the new jets will not deliver a full carrier strike capability, and their deployment would prevent the use of key aircraft for missions such as refuelling and airborne early warning. The letter also questioned government proposals to depend on allied military capability, such as that from France, noting: 'The inconsistent response from some NATO partners in Afghanistan should have served as a warning. The possible withdrawal of the French carrier due to economic pressures further undermines the idea that allied assets could reliably substitute for our own.' Sir Sandy criticized ministers for giving only superficial attention to defence needs, warning: 'Neglecting this crucial national issue sends a message to our adversaries that we are vulnerable.'
translated_content: फकल्यान्ड्स युद्धका अनुभवी सर स्यान्डी वुडवार्ड, जसले १९८२ मा बेलायती नौसैनिक टास्क फोर्सको नेतृत्व गरेका थिए, ले थप कटौती भएमा बेलायती नेभी 'रक्षाविहीन र सजिलै कब्जा गर्न सकिने' अवस्थामा पुग्ने चेतावनी दिएका छन्। एक दुर्लभ अभिव्यक्तिमा, उनले यदि बेडामा गरिएका कटौतीहरू उल्टाइएन भने बेलायतले विश्वव्यापी चासो रक्षा गर्न असमर्थ हुने बताएका छन्। उनले थप चेतावनी दिएका छन् कि बेलायत युनाइटेड नेशन्स सुरक्षा परिषद्को स्थायी सदस्यता गुमाउन सक्नेछ, यदि उसलाई फकल्यान्ड्सजस्ता भौगोलिक क्षेत्रहरूको रक्षा गर्न नसक्ने ठानियो भने। सर स्यान्डीका यी भनाइहरू अहिले बेलायती संसदको रक्षा समितिलाई पठाइएको पत्रमा आएको हो, जसले ब्रिटेनको भविष्यका रक्षा आवश्यकताको समीक्षा गरिरहेको छ। सो पत्रमा फकल्यान्ड्स युद्धका अरू प्रमुख व्यक्ति, जस्तै ३ कमान्डो ब्रिगेड रोयल म्यारेन्सका नेता ब्रिगेडियर जुलियन थोम्पसन र अटलान्टिक कन्भेयरका पूर्व कमाण्डर एडमिरल सर माइकल लेयार्डले समेत सह–हस्ताक्षर गरेका छन्। पत्र लेख्नेहरूका अनुसार रक्षा बजेटमा गरिएको कटौतीले बेलायतको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय छवि कमजोर भएको छ, र व्यापार तथा ऊर्जाजस्ता महत्त्वपूर्ण चासोहरूमा खतरा उत्पन्न भएको छ। पत्रमा भनिएको छ: 'स्पष्ट छ, बेलायत बिस्तारै फरक देश बन्दै गएको छ—मित्र र शत्रु दुवैको नजरमा कम सम्मानित। हाम्रो रणनीतिक पहुँच घटेको छ, हामीले दशकौंसम्म अमेरिकालाई दिएको सैनिक समर्थन गर्न गाह्रो हुन थालेको छ। यदि हामीले आफ्ना आश्रित क्षेत्रहरू रक्षा गर्न सकेनौं भने, सुरक्षा परिषद्को अस्थायी सदस्यता समेत संकटमा पर्न सक्छ।' सर स्यान्डीले बेलायती विमानवाहक युद्धपोत प्रतिस्थापन योजनाको व्यवस्थापनलाई विशेष गरी आलोचना गरेका छन्, जसले एक दशकसम्म ब्रिटिश बेडामा कुनै प्रभावकारी विमानवाहक क्षमता नहुने उनले बताएका छन्। गत वर्षको सरकारी नीति परिवर्तनपछि, 'क्वीन एलिजाबेथ' र 'प्रिन्स अफ वेल्स' नामक नयाँ विमानवाहक पोतमा १२ वटा एफ–३५बी जम्प जेट ल्याइनेछन्, प्रत्येकको मूल्य £५०० मिलियन, तर ती २०२० सम्म उड्न तयार हुने छैनन्—हरेयर जेटको सेवानिवृत्तिदेखि एक दशकपछि। संचालनमा आएपछि पनि, सर स्यान्डीले भने, नयाँ जेटहरूले पूर्ण विमानवाहक आक्रमण क्षमता प्रदान गर्न सक्दैनन्, साथै तिनीहरूको उपयोगले इन्धन भर्ने र एयरबोर्न अर्ली वार्निङ जस्ता आवश्यक विमानको अपरेशन असम्भव बनाउँछ। पत्रमा सरकारको योजना अन्तर्गत मित्रराष्ट्र, जस्तै फ्रान्सको सैनिक क्षमतामा अत्यधिक निर्भर हुनु गलत भएको उल्लेख छ: 'अफगानिस्तानमा कतिपय नेटो साझेदारहरूको अविश्वसनीय साथले यसमा चेतावनी दिएको थियो। फ्रान्सको आर्थिक समस्याका कारण तिनको विमानवाहक सेवाबाट फिर्ता हुन सक्ने सम्भावनाले मित्र राष्ट्रको क्षमतामा परेका नियोजन कमजोरी देखिन्छ।' सर स्यान्डीले मन्त्रीहरूले सतही रूपमा मात्र रक्षा आवश्यकतामा ध्यान दिएको आरोप लगाउँदै भनेका छन्: 'राष्ट्रिय महत्त्वको यस विषयलाई बेवास्ता गर्नु हाम्रो शत्रुलाई हामी सजिलै निशाना बन्न सक्छौं भन्ने सन्देश दिनु जस्तै हो।'

article_content: Ryan Fogle, an American diplomat and third secretary in the political section of the U.S. Embassy in Moscow, was detained by Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) after allegedly attempting to recruit a Russian intelligence officer. According to the FSB, Fogle was caught during a covert operation and was found with disguises including wigs, glasses, a map of Moscow, a compass, cash, and special technical equipment. Fogle was apprehended by the same FSB officer he tried to recruit, then handed over to U.S. officials after spending a night at the FSB’s Lubyanka headquarters. A letter allegedly found with Fogle offered substantial payment—up to $1 million per year—to the Russian officer for cooperation. The arrest occurred in Vorontsovski Park in Moscow, and the FSB released photographs and details of the incident. U.S. Ambassador Michael McFaul did not comment publicly on the matter. Fogle was ordered to leave Russia in the days following the incident. The event occurred against the backdrop of ongoing espionage activities between the United States and Russia, such as the 2010 case of Russian sleeper agents including Anna Chapman. The FSB highlighted repeated recruitment attempts by U.S. intelligence and expressed a desire to avoid increased tensions over the incident.

article_content: By Stuart Fraser The last time Andy Murray tweeted to his 2.5 million followers on June 14, he praised Nick Kyrgios as the ‘next big Aussie star’ after the 19-year-old won a Challenger tournament on the grass of Nottingham. Murray, a Wimbledon champion, clearly recognized Kyrgios' potential. Currently ranked No. 144, Kyrgios sent out another strong signal at Wimbledon by coming back from a set down to defeat Czech player Jiri Vesely 3-6, 6-3, 7-5, 6-2. With this win, he secured a spot in the world’s top 100 and set up an exciting fourth-round match with world No. 1 Rafael Nadal. As he has throughout these Championships, Kyrgios will approach the match with confidence and no pressure – and Nadal is well aware of the challenge. Speaking about Kyrgios, Nadal said, ‘He’s a young player, always there. Young players are very dangerous because they usually have something special. They can play freely and without pressure. It’s great to see new talent on tour. He has a great serve and plays aggressively.’ On Court 17, Kyrgios – the youngest man in the draw – took on 20-year-old Vesely in what many billed as a matchup between two rising stars. Kyrgios’ performance was outstanding, registering 63 winners, 26 aces, and winning 82% of his first-serve points. Kyrgios will next face Rafael Nadal, the world No. 1. Andy Murray has been among those praising Kyrgios as a future star. Kyrgios himself said after the match, ‘Anything is possible. I’m just going to go out there and play my game. I believe that’s enough to compete.’ Although it seems unlikely that Australia’s 12-year title drought at Wimbledon will end this year, Kyrgios’ performance marks an important milestone. He is certainly a player to watch.
translated_content: स्टुअर्ट फ्रेजरद्वारा एन्डी मुर्रेले जुन १४ मा आफ्ना २५ लाख फलोअर्सलाई गरिएको अन्तिम ट्वीटमा १९ वर्षीय निक किर्गियोसलाई ‘अर्को ठूला अस्ट्रेलियन स्टार’ भन्दै प्रशंसा गरेका थिए, जब उनले नटिङ्घमको घाँसमा च्यालेन्जर जितेका थिए। विम्बलडन च्याम्पियन मुर्रे किर्गियोसको क्षमतामा विश्वास गर्छन्। हाल नं. १४४ मा रहेका किर्गियोसले विम्बलडनमा फेरि आफूलाई प्रमाणित गर्दै चेक खेलाडी जिरी वेसेलीलाई ३–६, ६–३, ७–५, ६–२ ले पराजित गर्दै टप १०० मा स्थान सुरक्षित गरेका छन्। यस जितसँगै उनी विश्व नं. १ राफाएल नाडालसँग चौथो चरणमा खेल्दैछन्। पूरा च्याम्पियनसिपमा किर्गियोस आत्मविश्वासका साथ दबावबिना खेलिरहेका छन् – र नाडाल यस्तो चुनौतीको सामना गर्न तयार छन्। किर्गियोसबारे बोल्दै नाडालले भने, ‘उहाँ युवा खेलाडी हुनुहुन्छ, सँधै त्यहाँ हुनुहुन्छ। युवा खेलाडीहरू साँच्चिकै खतरनाक हुन्छन् किनभने उनीहरूसँग केही विशेष कुरा हुन्छ। उनीहरू सजिलै दबावबिना खेल्न सक्छन्। नयाँ प्रतिभा देख्न राम्रो लाग्छ। उहाँको सर्भ उत्कृष्ट छ र उहाँ आक्रामक खेल्नुहुन्छ।’ कोर्ट १७ मा किर्गियोस – ड्रको सबैभन्दा कान्छो खेलाडी – २० वर्षीय वेसेलीसँग भिड्दै थिए। प्रतिस्पर्धालाई दुई उदाउँदो ताराहरूको प्रतिस्पर्धाका रूपमा हेरिएको थियो। किर्गियोसको प्रदर्शन शानदार रह्यो, ६३ विनर, २६ एस र ८२% पहिलो सर्भ प्वाइन्ट जिते। अब किर्गियोसले विश्व नं. १ राफाएल नाडालसँग खेल्नेछन्। एन्डी मुर्रेले किर्गियोसलाई भविष्यका तारा भन्दै प्रशंसा गरेका छन्। खेलपछाडि किर्गियोसले भने, ‘सबै सम्भव छ। म आफूलाई खेल्न बाहिर जानेछु। मलाई लाग्छ, यो नै प्रतिस्पर्धाका लागि पर्याप्त छ।’ यद्यपि अस्ट्रेलियाको विम्बलडनमा १२ वर्षदेखिको उपाधि सुक्खा यो वर्ष सकिन अप्ठेरो देखिन्छ, किर्गियोसको प्रदर्शन महत्त्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि हो। उनी निश्चित रूपमा अब हेर्नुपर्ने खेलाडी हुन्।

article_content: Jane Jackson, a nurse at HMP Woodhill, a maximum-security prison in Milton Keynes, has been removed from the nursing register after being found in an inappropriate situation with a male inmate. Jackson was discovered topless in a private treatment room with the prisoner, referred to as Prisoner A. The Nursing and Midwifery Council ruled that Jackson engaged in a sexually motivated and inappropriate relationship, breaching professional boundaries and jeopardizing prison security. The incident occurred on February 7, 2009, when prison guard Rebecca Langley entered the treatment room and found Jackson partially undressed. During the subsequent hearing, it was revealed that Jackson had secured the door with a mop and brought prohibited items into the prison for the inmate on a previous occasion. The panel determined that Jackson's actions amounted to serious professional misconduct. She was subsequently dismissed from her position following an internal investigation. Despite Jackson's claim that she was pressured by the prisoner, the panel concluded that she failed to maintain the standards and integrity required of her profession.

article_content: Melbourne police are investigating a series of indecent assaults targeting women in the suburbs of Altona North and Newport. Authorities suspect up to three men, one reportedly a cyclist in a dark hooded top, may be responsible. The incidents have occurred over the past four months, specifically between 6 to 8am and 6 to 8pm, times when women are typically commuting or exercising. In most cases, victims were grabbed from behind, often while wearing headphones. Two women saw a man leaving the scene on a mountain bike. Detective Inspector Martin Allison stated the attacks may involve multiple offenders, as behaviors vary between incidents, and police are concerned the assaults may be escalating. The latest attack took place Sunday night on Seventh Street in Altona North. The attacker was described as Caucasian, with a dark-coloured hooded top pulled over his face and dark trousers. Police have increased patrols and set up an information caravan on Mason Street each evening this week. They encourage victims and witnesses to report incidents promptly, warning that delays have made investigations more difficult.
