article_content: Nebraska Governor Jim Pillen recently dismissed a news article that criticized high nitrate levels at his hog farm, stating his refusal to read the piece because the author 'is from Communist China.' Pillen made these comments during a September interview on Omaha's KFAB radio, explaining, 'All you got to do is look at the author. The author is from Communist China. What more do you need to know?' The journalist in question, 27-year-old Yanqi Xu, immigrated to the United States from China in 2017 and now works as a reporter for Nebraska's Flatwater Free Press. Xu said she is still processing the remarks, especially given the power dynamic, stating, 'As a woman of color, if the most powerful person in the state makes a comment like this about you, how are you supposed to respond?' Following the incident, Matt Wynn, executive director of the Nebraska Journalism Trust, which established the Flatwater Free Press, published a column in Xu's defense after consulting with immigration lawyers to ensure Xu's visa would not be affected. Xu expressed appreciation for her employer's support and noted that Governor Pillen's comments contribute to a narrative of 'othering people of Chinese descent.' The Asian American Journalists Association also issued a statement in support of Xu, emphasizing the importance of an independent and diverse press. Their statement read, 'The Asian American Journalists Association stands with Yanqi Xu, the Flatwater Free Press journalist who was the target of remarks that attempted to dismiss her reporting because of her country of origin. Having an independent and diverse press corps is essential to democracy, and Xu, an investigative reporter who grew up in China, deserves to do her job without being judged because of her nationality.' Governor Pillen did not respond to NBC News' request for comment.
translated_content: नेब्रास्का गभर्नर जिम पिलनले हालसालै आफ्नो सुँगुर फार्ममा उच्च नाइट्रेटको आलोचना गर्ने एउटा समाचार लेखको जवाफमा लेख पढ्न अस्वीकार गरे, कारण लेखक 'कम्युनिस्ट चीनबाट' भएको बताए। पिलनले सेप्टेम्बरमा ओमाहाको KFAB रेडियोमा भने, 'तपाईंले लेखकलाई मात्र हेर्नुपर्छ। लेखक कम्युनिस्ट चीनको हो। तपाईंलाई अरु के चाहियो?' समाचार लेखिका २७ वर्षीया यान्छी सू सन् २०१७ मा चीनबाट संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकामा आएकी हुन् र अहिले नेब्रास्काको फ्ल्याटवाटर फ्री प्रेसमा रिपोर्टरको रूपमा काम गर्छिन्। सूले गभर्नरको टिप्पणीपछि भनिन्, 'रंगीन महिलाको नाताबाट प्रदेशका सबैभन्दा शक्तिशाली व्यक्तिले तपाईंबारे यस्तो भन्यो भने तपाईं कसरी प्रतिक्रिया दिने?' यस घटनापछि Nebraska Journalism Trust का कार्यकारी निर्देशक म्याट विनले आप्रवासी कानूनी सल्लाहकारसँग परामर्श गरेर सूको भिसा प्रभावित नहोस् भनेर सुनिश्चित गर्दै सूको पक्षमा स्तम्भ छापे। सूले आफ्ना नियोक्ताको समर्थनप्रति आभार व्यक्त गरिन् र गभर्नर पिलनका भनाइले 'चिनियाँ मूलका मानिसहरुलाई अन्य बनाउने' दृष्टिकोणलाई बढावा दिने बताइन्। Asian American Journalists Association ले पनि सूको समर्थनमा विज्ञप्ति जारी गर्दै स्वतन्त्र र विविध प्रेसको महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका उल्लेख गरेको छ। बयानमा भनिएको छ, 'Asian American Journalists Association Flatwater Free Press की पत्रकार यान्छी सूको समर्थन गर्छ, जसको रिपोर्टिङ देशको मूलका कारण अस्वीकार गर्न खोजिएको थियो। स्वतन्त्र र विविध प्रेस लोकतन्त्रका लागि अत्यावश्यक छ, र सूजस्तो खोज अनुसन्धान रिपोर्टरले आफ्नै राष्ट्रियता नहेरी काम गर्न पाउनुपर्छ।' NBC News को अनुरोधमा गभर्नर पिलनले थप प्रतिक्रिया दिएनन्।

article_content: TNT has canceled 'Mob City,' a limited series based on John Buntin's book and created by 'The Walking Dead' creator Frank Darabont. The series aired as a three-week television event, but its ratings were disappointing, with the premiere drawing 2.3 million viewers and decreasing over time. Despite the decision not to continue, TNT expressed pride in the show, saying, "'Mob City' was created as a three-week television event and we are incredibly proud of the six hours we presented of this remarkable drama." TNT also mentioned looking forward to working with Frank Darabont again. The show starred Jon Bernthal, Ed Burns, and Neal McDonough. In a separate project, Sharon Stone has joined a TNT pilot as the network’s first fictional female U.S. vice president.

article_content: Lucy Watson, star of the reality show Made In Chelsea, may be facing friendship troubles on screen, but her professional life continues to flourish. Recently criticized by Binky Felstead in an episode, Lucy has now been named the first celebrity ambassador for Skinny Tan, an Australian tanning brand that claims to reduce the appearance of cellulite while providing a natural bronzed look and improving skin tone. Currently filming in New York, the 24-year-old shared her enthusiasm about the new partnership, highlighting that Skinny Tan offers an even, great-smelling tan and uses natural ingredients that are gentle on the skin. Skinny Tan co-founders Kate Cotton and Louise Ferguson expressed their excitement about working with Lucy, describing her as naturally beautiful and a perfect match for their brand. Lucy continues to build her career beyond television. She recently became the face of Wilkinson Sword and Lipsy VIP, authored her own book, 'The Dating Game', modeled for PETA and Vesper dresses, and launched her own jewelry line called Creature in 2014. Her agent shared with MailOnline that Lucy is selective with brand partnerships, focusing on the long term rather than overexposure common among reality TV personalities. She has declined more deals than she has accepted. Lucy is also interested in expanding her presence in the health and fitness sector and advocating for animal welfare, with future plans to create her own product line and possibly produce a documentary to raise awareness about animal testing. She has meetings planned in Los Angeles and New York for international opportunities. Looking ahead, Lucy stated she is interested in staying in the industry, with ambitions to work in presenting, production, and directing. Meanwhile, tensions remain high on Made In Chelsea, with the latest episode featuring dramatic confrontations between Binky Felstead, her boyfriend Alex Mytton, and friends Lucy and Cheska Hull.

article_content: English Premier League champions Manchester United have rejected a bid from Chelsea for striker Wayne Rooney. The West London club confirmed in a statement on Wednesday that it had submitted a written offer for the unsettled striker. 'Chelsea Football Club can confirm that yesterday it made a written offer to Manchester United for the transfer of Wayne Rooney,' the statement read. Although the fee was not disclosed, UK media speculated Chelsea might have offered winger Juan Mata or defender David Luiz plus cash in exchange for Rooney. However, Chelsea denied this, stating, 'Although the terms of the offer are confidential, to be clear and contrary to what is being briefed to the press in Sydney (where Manchester United are on tour), the proposed purchase price does not include the transfer or loan of any Chelsea players to Manchester United.' Manchester United have not commented further on the bid. After overseeing his first game since returning as Chelsea manager in Bangkok, Jose Mourinho described the offer as 'clean' and 'ethical.' He also said the club would not bid for any other strikers this summer. 'We love the player, we are interested in the player, we made the bid. We have nothing more to say and nothing more to do. We now have to respect and be ethical in this process,' Mourinho said after Chelsea's 1-0 win over Singha All Stars. Chelsea's interest in Rooney is the latest development in the ongoing uncertainty over the striker's future. Speculation about the 27-year-old's dissatisfaction began late last season as Manchester United secured their 20th league title. Although the club ultimately won by 11 points ahead of Manchester City, Rooney was overshadowed by Robin van Persie, who joined from Arsenal at the start of the 2012/13 season and scored 30 goals in 48 matches, compared to Rooney's 12 in 37. At the end of last season, outgoing manager Sir Alex Ferguson confirmed that Rooney had handed in a transfer request. 'We refused it. He should go away and think it over. He's not happy being substituted a few times this season, but Rooney at his best wouldn't have been taken off,' Ferguson said after United’s final home game. Ferguson's successor, David Moyes, tried to quell rumors when he officially took over as manager earlier this month. 'Wayne is not for sale,' Moyes, who signed a six-year contract in May, told reporters. 'He is a Manchester United player and will remain a Manchester United player. I see a glint in his eye. He looks happy, and ready to get himself right.' However, Rooney is reportedly 'angry and confused' about his treatment at the club. The striker, who joined United from Everton for $39 million in 2004, signed a new five-year contract in October 2010 after a similar conflict with club management. Manchester United's chief executive, Ed Woodward, recently said there are no current discussions regarding contract renewals. 'I am not sitting down with any player about an extension and there is no trigger date in the diary. Would we be afraid to run a contract down? Of course not,' Woodward said.
translated_content: इङ्लिस प्रिमियर लिग च्याम्पियन म्यानचेस्टर युनाइटेडले चेल्सीले स्ट्राइकर वेन रुनीका लागि गरेको प्रस्ताव अस्वीकार गरेको छ। पश्चिम लन्डन क्लबले बुधबार एक विज्ञप्ति प्रकाशन गर्दै लेखित प्रस्ताव दिएको पुष्टि गरेको छ। 'चेल्सी फुटबल क्लबले हिजो म्यानचेस्टर युनाइटेडलाई वेन रुनीको ट्रान्सफरका लागि लेखित प्रस्ताव दिएको पुष्टि गर्न सक्छ,' विज्ञप्तिमा उल्लेख छ। शुल्क खुलाइएको छैन, तर बेलायती संचारमाध्यमले चेल्सीले विङ्गर जुवान माटा वा डिफेन्डर ड्याभिड लुइजसँग नगदसमेत प्रस्ताव गरेको अड्कल गरेका छन्। तर चेल्सीले यसलाई अस्वीकार गर्दै, 'प्रस्तावका सर्तहरू गोप्य भए पनि, स्पष्टीकरणका लागि र हाल सिड्नीमा (जहाँ म्यानचेस्टर युनाइटेड टुरमा छ) पत्रकारहरूसँग भइरहेको प्रचार विपरीत, प्रस्तावमा कुनै चेल्सी खेलाडीको ट्रान्सफर वा लोन समावेश छैन,' भनी बताएको छ। यसबारे म्यानचेस्टर युनाइटेडले थप प्रतिक्रिया दिएको छैन। चेल्सीका प्रशिक्षक जोसे मौरिन्होले बैंककमा आफ्नो पहिलो खेलपछि प्रस्ताव 'सफा' र 'नैतिक' भएको बताएका छन्। उनले क्लबले यस ग्रीष्ममा अन्य स्ट्राइकरका लागि प्रस्ताव नगर्ने बताएका छन्। 'हामी खेलाडी मन पराउँछौं, चासो छ, प्रस्ताव गर्‍यौं। अब थप भन्न वा गर्न केही छैन। र यस प्रक्रियामा इमानदार र नैतिक रहनुपर्छ,' मौरिन्होले सिङ्हा अल स्टार्समाथि १-० को जितपछि भनेका थिए। रुनीप्रति चेल्सीको चासो स्ट्राइकरको भविष्यको अनिश्चिततामा नयाँ मोड हो। २७ वर्षीय खेलाडीको असन्तुष्टि गत सिजनको अन्त्यदेखि चर्चा भइरहेको थियो जब म्यानचेस्टर युनाइटेडले आफ्नो २०औं लिग उपाधि जितेको थियो। अन्ततः क्लबले म्यानचेस्टर सिटीभन्दा ११ अंकले जित्यो, तर रुनी आर्सनलबाट आएका रोबिन भान पर्सीकै छायाँमा थिए। पर्सीले ४८ खेलमा ३० गोल गरे भने रुनीले ३७ खेलमा १२ गोलमात्रै गरे। पछिल्लो सिजनको अन्त्यमा, बिदा हुन लागेको प्रशिक्षक सर अलेक्स फर्ग्युसनले रुनीले ट्रान्सफर अनुरोध गरेको पुष्टि गरेका थिए। 'हामीले अस्वीकार गर्यौं। ऊ सोच्नुपर्छ। यस सिजन केहि पटक प्रतिस्थापन हुँदा ऊ खुसी थिएन, तर उत्कृष्ट फारममा रहेको रुनीलाई प्रतिस्थापन गरिँदैनथ्यो,' फर्ग्युसनले युनाइटेडको अन्तिम घरेलु खेलपछि भनेका थिए। फर्ग्युसनका उत्तराधिकारी डेभिड मोयेसले यस महिनाको सुरुमा प्रशिक्षक बनेपछि अफवाहलाई रोक्ने प्रयास गरेका थिए। 'वेन बिक्रीका लागि छैन,' मोयेसले, जुनमा ६ वर्षको सम्झौतामा आएको बताएका थिए। 'ऊ युनाइटेडका खेलाडी हो र रहनेछ। उसको आँखामा चमक देख्छु, ऊ खुसी देखिन्छ र फारममा फर्कन तयार देखिन्छ।' यद्यपि, रुनी आफ्नो article_content: Mariah Carey has clarified her feelings about her time as a judge on the twelfth season of Fox's 'American Idol.' In a Hot 97 radio interview, Carey stated, 'Honestly, I hated it,' when discussing her experience judging alongside Randy Jackson, Keith Urban, and Nicki Minaj, whose time on the panel was particularly controversial. Carey said she initially believed she would be joining a three-person panel, adding, 'I was the first person signed on. I thought Randy Jackson would be there, and I’ve known him forever.' She continued, 'They offered me a generous deal, and I thought, this isn’t a big deal. But it was nothing like I expected. It felt like going to work every day in hell with Satan.' However, Carey laughed and covered her eyes after making this comment, then clarified, 'Nah, I’m just playing. It didn’t affect me that much.' Carey admitted she was disappointed by aspects of the show. She explained, 'I loved the contestants. Some were so talented and genuinely good people.' She also expressed frustration with the process, saying, 'It was disappointing when, for political reasons, some contestants weren’t allowed through. I thought, I’d rather record with them than go through this.' Both Carey and Minaj are no longer judges on Idol. The next season will feature Urban, Harry Connick Jr., and Jennifer Lopez as judges, with the premiere set for January 15. Carey has also released a new single entitled 'The Art of Letting Go.'

article_content: A group of wealthy investors called the 'Red Knights' is planning a purchase of Manchester United from the Glazer family. They have announced that no formal offer will be made until the football season ends, to avoid distracting the team’s pursuit of Premier League and Champions League success. The Red Knights declared their interest in March and have since been recruiting additional investors and developing their plan. Their recent press statement confirmed that they will keep working on their proposal but won’t finalize it until after the end of the current season, aiming to minimize distractions at this crucial stage. They have partnered with Nomura, a Japanese investment bank, to help structure what could be a $1 billion bid for the club. The consortium is also working closely with the Manchester United Supporters' Trust to rally fan support from around the world. The Red Knights have been in touch with many prospective members who have provided ideas and backing, which has further shaped their strategies. Fans have criticized the Glazer family over Manchester United’s debt, now exceeding $1 billion. To reduce this, the Glazers have issued $750 million in bonds. The family also owns the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in the NFL. Supporters have shown their opposition to the Glazers at recent matches, donning green and gold scarves—now a common sight at Old Trafford—and displaying banners like 'Love United Hate Glazer.' Former United player David Beckham also showed support for the movement by wearing a protest scarf after AC Milan’s Champions League loss at Old Trafford on March 10.

article_content: Candace Cameron Bure, best known for her role as D.J. Tanner on the hit 1990s series Full House, opens up in her new book about the reality of being a Hollywood mom without the help of a nanny or personal assistant. Bure recently shared that she would be happy to join a Full House reunion, saying, 'Everyone talks about it and we’ve all talked about it. But who knows? It would be really fun.' The actress, who stars in the new Christmas film Let It Snow alongside Alan Thicke, admits that juggling family life and a career in Hollywood is less glamorous than some imagine. Fans began speculating about a reunion after Bure posted photos with former co-stars at the Starlight Awards in L.A. in September. In her book 'Balancing It All: My Story of Juggling Priorities and Purpose,' Bure discusses managing her acting career and raising her three children without outside help. She says, 'People think I’m this great mom doing it all perfectly, and while I appreciate it, it’s not entirely true. I don’t want people to think I have it all together, because I don’t.' She emphasizes the importance of being honest about the realities of balancing life. Mrs. Cameron Bure, 37, is married to retired hockey player Val Bure and has three children: Natasha (14), Lev (12), and Maksim (10). She explains, 'No one does it perfectly all the time.' She took a break from acting when her first child was born to focus on her family and believes her husband's support is essential. In her first book, Bure wrote openly about battling bulimia in her early twenties. She chose to be a stay-at-home mom when her children were young, stating she was fortunate not to have to work outside the home. With busier schedules as her kids have gotten older, she and her husband continue to prioritize family. She notes that her husband, who retired from hockey in 2005, is very involved with their children and says, 'I couldn’t do it without my husband’s help. He does so much with the kids. When I’m out of town, he handles everything, and vice versa.' While her new book compiles her best tips and experiences on managing career and family, Bure admits there is no single formula for balancing life. She believes everyone’s circumstances are unique and cautions against comparing oneself to others. She says, 'Comparison is dangerous and can lead to disappointment. I hope people focus on doing the best in their own lives.' Bure shared her story to be honest about her journey and hopes women can benefit from what has and hasn't worked for her, noting, 'We live in a busy culture, whether you are a working mom, single mom, or stay-at-home mom. I wanted to share what I’ve learned about balancing it all.'

किताबमा ब्यूरेले आफ्ना बीसको दशकमा बुलेमियासँग लडाइँ गरेको खुलेर लेखेकी थिइन्। उनले साना छोराछोरी हुँदा गृहिणी बन्‍न रोजेकी थिइन् र घरबाहिर काम गर्न नपरेकोमा आफूलाई सौभाग्यशाली मानिन्। अहिले छोराछोरी ठूला हुँदा व्यस्त भए तापनि, उनी र उनका श्रीमान् सँगै परिवारलाई प्राथमिकता दिन्छन्। उनका श्रीमान्, जसले २००५ मा आइस हकीबाट अवकाश लिएका थिए, छोराछोरीको जिम्मेवारीमा निकै संलग्न छन्। उनले भनिन्, 'श्रीमान्को सहयोगबिना म गर्न सक्दिनथेँ। म बाहिर हुँदा उहाँ सबै काम गर्नुहुन्छ, र विपरित अवस्थामा म गर्छु।' नयाँ किताबमा करियर र परिवार सँगै चलाउन आफ्ना टिप्स र अनुभव राखेकी ब्यूरे भन्छिन्, जीवन सन्तुलनका लागि एउटै सूत्र छैन। उनी भन्छिन्, सबैको अवस्था फरक हुन्छ र अरूसँग तुलना गर्नु उचित छैन। 'तुलना खतरनाक छ र यो निराशालाई निम्त्याउँछ। मलाई आशा छ, सबैले आफ्नै जीवनमा जे सकिन्छ, त्यही राम्रो गर्नेछन्।' ब्यूरेले आफ्नो कथा साझा गरेर महिलाहरूलाई सहयोग मिलोस् भन्ने चाहना राखेकी छिन्, कि कुन कुरा काम गर्छन्, कुन गर्दैनन् भनेर अनुभव बाँड्न चाहेको उल्लेख गर्दै भनिन्: 'हामी व्यस्त संस्कृतिमा बस्छौं, चाहे कामकाजी आमा होस्, एकल आमा होस्, या गृहिणी। मैले सन्तुलनका कुरा महिलाहरूसँग वास्तविक रुपमै बाँड्न चाहें।'

article_content: After Damon Janes, a 16-year-old running back for the Westfield-Brocton Wolverines in upstate New York, died following a helmet-to-helmet tackle, his team ended their football season early. Janes was injured in the second game of the season against Portville, initially remained conscious but later collapsed on the sideline, and died three days later at Women & Children’s Hospital in Buffalo. The official cause of death has not been disclosed. Following the tragedy, the football team voted by paper ballot to cancel the rest of their season, unable to continue in the aftermath of losing their friend and teammate. Players like quarterback Stevie Wisecarver and senior cornerback Joey Villafrank described how their grief changed their perspective on both football and life. The loss has united the Brocton and Westfield communities, who are honoring Janes with vigils, candlelight tributes, and fundraising events. Residents have made memorial ribbons and T-shirts, dyed hair in team colors, and organized a spaghetti dinner benefit to support his family. Janes was described by his family as energetic and passionate, excelling in a variety of sports such as soccer, basketball, ice skating, motocross, and snowboarding, and living by the motto: ‘Giving up is simply not an option.’ Some parents believe inadequate officiating and repeated late hits contributed to the fatal injury, fueling concerns about player safety. School officials did not respond to requests for comment. Janes’ death has added urgency to ongoing nationwide discussions about youth football safety and concussion management. According to the American Journal of Sports Medicine, about 12 high school or college football players die from similar injuries each year. Janes was at least the fifth high school football death this season, but his team’s response to suspend the season is unusual. While some community members say Janes would have wanted the team to keep playing, his teammates acknowledge only Janes himself could make that decision.
translated_content: न्यूयोर्कको उपराज्यस्थित वेस्टफिल्ड-ब्रोकटन वुल्भरिन्स फुटबल टोलीका १६ वर्षीय रनिङ्ग ब्याक ड्यामन जेनसको हेलमेट-टु-हेलमेट ठोक्किएर निधन भएपछि टोलीले यस सिजनको अन्त्य घोषणा गरेको छ। पोर्टविलसँग सिजनको दोस्रो खेलमा चोट लागेपछि जेनस सुरुमा होशमा थिए, तर साइडलाइनमा बेहोस भई बफेलोको वुमन एण्ड चिल्ड्रेन अस्पतालमा तीन दिनपछि उनको निधन भएको हो। उनको मृत्युको औपचारिक कारण सार्वजनिक गरिएको छैन। यो दुखद घटनापछि टोलीले कागजी मतदानमार्फत बाँकी सिजन रद्द गर्ने निर्णय गर्‍यो। खेलाडीहरु स्टेवी वाइजकार्भर र सिनियर कर्नरब्याक जोइ विल्लाफ्र्याङ्कले साथी गुमाउँदाको पीडा र यस घटनाले फुटबल तथा जीवनप्रतिको दृष्टिकोणमा पारेको प्रभावको बारेमा बोले। जेनसको निधनले ब्रोकटन र वेस्टफिल्डका समुदायलाई एकजुट बनाएको छ। स्थानियहरुले स्मृति कार्यक्रम, प्रार्थनासभा, फण्ड संकलन, टोलीको रंगमा रिबन बनाउन, स्मृति टिसर्ट छाप्न र स्प्यागेटी डिनर लाभार्थ कार्यक्रम आयोजना गरेर परिवारलाई सहयोग गरिरहेका छन्। उनको परिवारका अनुसार जेनस ऊर्जावान र कडा परिश्रम गर्ने थिए। उनी फुटबलसँगै सकेर, बास्केटबल, आइस स्केटिङ, मोटोक्रोस र स्नोबोर्डिङ पनि मन पराउँथे। उनको भनाइ थियो — 'हार मान्नु कुनै विकल्प होइन।' केही अभिभावकले कमजोर रेफरिङ तथा बारम्बार ढिला प्रहार भएका कारणले यो घटना भएको विश्वास गरेका छन्। विद्यालय प्रशासनले टिप्पणी गरेको छैन। जेनसको मृत्युले विद्यालय फुटबलको सुरक्षाबारे चलिरहेको राष्ट्रिय बहसलाई अझ बढाएको छ। अमेरिकन जर्नल अफ स्पोर्ट्स मेडिसिनका अनुसार, हरेक वर्ष औसतमा १२ जना हाईस्कूल वा कलेज फुटबल खेलाडी यस्तै चोटका कारण ज्यान गुमाउँछन्। जेनस कम्तीमा यस सिजनको पाँचौं उच्च विधालय फुटबल खेलाडी थिए जसकी मृत्यु भयो, तर उनको टिमले सिजन नै रद्द गर्नु अपवाद बन्यो। केहीले जेनसले खेल जारी राख्न चाहन्थे होला भन्ने विश्वास गरे पनि, उनका सहकर्मीहरू भन्छन्— त्यो निर्णय त केवल जेनस आफूले मात्र गर्न सक्थे।

article_content: Fulham approach their upcoming match against Manchester United after securing a draw at Brighton – a result manager Marco Silva found pleasing given the opposition's strength. Despite losing star striker Aleksandar Mitrovic last summer, Fulham are on par with their points tally from ten games last season. Manchester United, in contrast, recently suffered a heavy 3-0 home defeat to Manchester City, their fourth loss in nine home games across all competitions this campaign. However, United have found more success on the road, with back-to-back away wins at Burnley and Sheffield United. Under Erik ten Hag, United’s recent league results show five wins and five draws in ten outings, although inconsistency remains a concern. The Red Devils boast a 17-match unbeaten run against Fulham, including three victories last season. Bruno Fernandes, United’s captain, continues to be a standout performer. He trails only Marcus Rashford for shots taken and Scott McTominay for league goals scored. Last year, Fernandes tallied 14 goals and 15 assists in all competitions, scoring three times against Fulham. Fulham’s attack has struggled since Mitrovic’s departure. Raúl Jiménez, brought in as his replacement, is still searching for a league goal, while Bobby De Cordova-Reid leads Fulham this season with only two goals. Manchester United’s record signing Rasmus Højlund is also yet to score in the Premier League, having received limited chances up front. Given both sides’ defensive vulnerabilities but lackluster finishing, expectations are for a closely contested, low-scoring match at Craven Cottage. Betting markets favor Manchester United to win, highlight a likely total of under 2.5 goals, and tip Bruno Fernandes as a possible anytime scorer.

article_content: Vaccinations are essential, but they alone may not be able to address many newly emerging virus serotypes quickly enough to be fully effective. Recent research led by a Finnish team has found that hot willow bark extract, commonly made as tea, displays broad-spectrum antiviral activity not previously identified. The study revealed that the extract was effective not only against enveloped coronaviruses—which cause seasonal colds and COVID-19—but also against non-enveloped enteroviruses, which can cause illnesses such as meningitis and viral diseases with flu-like symptoms. Currently, there are no clinically approved drugs that effectively work against enteroviruses, so willow bark extract could be a promising candidate for new antiviral medications. Historically, the bark of willow (Salix spp.) trees has been used to treat inflammatory and arthritis-related conditions since ancient times. Willow bark contains salicin, discovered in 1828, which led to the development of salicylic acid and, later, acetylsalicylic acid (aspirin) in 1899 by Bayer. According to the study's senior author, Professor Varpu Marjomäki from the University of Jyväskylä, there is an urgent need for broadly effective tools to fight viruses in everyday life. While previous work by Professor Marjomäki’s team showed willow bark extract's potency against viruses like those causing polio and hepatitis A, this new research explores its effectiveness against even more types of viruses. The process involved producing extracts from commercially grown willow branches, which were harvested, cut, frozen, ground, and then steeped in hot water to make tea. These extracts were tested on cell samples infected with two strains of enteroviruses (Coxsackievirus A and B), a seasonal cold virus, and SARS-CoV-2, which causes COVID-19. Several assays were conducted to measure how quickly the willow bark extract acted on infected cells and inhibited viral activity. Microscopy was used to observe how the extract affected the viruses, revealing that coronaviruses broke down after treatment, while enteroviruses were unable to replicate within cells. The researchers found that willow bark extract worked through different mechanisms depending on the virus, yet it was equally effective in inhibiting both enveloped and non-enveloped viruses. The extract appeared to act on the virus surface rather than during a specific stage in the replication cycle. To pinpoint which compounds were responsible for the antiviral effects, different extract fractions were tested, along with commercially prepared salixin extract and powder. Only the salixin extract showed antiviral action, suggesting that a combination of bioactive compounds is necessary for the observed effects. In conclusion, the study provides evidence that willow bark extract contains several promising antiviral compounds, which work together to target a variety of viruses. Further research is needed to identify these compounds and understand how they interact both with each other and with viruses. Professor Marjomäki’s team continues to study purified components and their mechanisms to develop effective antiviral treatments. Source: Dhanik Reshamwala, Sailee Shroff, Jaana Liimatainen, Jenni Tienaho, Mira Laajala, Petri Kilpeläinen, Anneli Viherä-Aarnio, Maarit Karonen, Tuula Jyske, and Varpu Marjomäki (2023). Willow (Salix spp.) bark hot water extracts inhibit both enveloped and non-enveloped viruses: study on its anti-coronavirus and anti-enterovirus activities, Frontiers in Microbiology | doi:10.3389/fmicb.2023.1249794

गरिएको अनुसन्धानले देखाएको छ कि तातो Willow बोक्राको अर्क (चिया)—पहिले नखुलेको फराकिलो-स्पेक्ट्रम भाइरस बिरोधी प्रभाव देखाउँछ। अध्ययनले देखायो कि यो अर्कले सिरोटाइप भएका कोरोनाभाइरस (जसले मौसमी रुघाखोकी र COVID-19 ल्याउँछ) मात्र होइन, सिरोटाइप नभएका एन्टेरोभाइरसहरू (जसले मेनिन्जाइटिस र रुघाखोकी-जस्तै लक्षण ल्याउने भाइरल रोग ल्याउन सक्छ) विरुद्ध पनि प्रभावकारी देखिएको छ। हाल एन्टेरोभाइरसहरू विरुद्ध प्रभावकारी रूपमा काम गर्ने कुनै पनि अनुमोदित औषधिहरू छैनन्, त्यसैले Willow बोक्राको अर्कले नयाँ बिरोधी औषधिहरूका लागि आशाजनक सम्भावना देखाएको छ। इतिहासतः Willow (Salix spp.) का बोक्रा प्राचीन समयदेखि सुजन र संधिरोगजस्ता समस्यामा प्रयोग हुँदै आएको छ। बोक्रामा पाइने सालिसिन सन् १८२८ मा पत्ता लागेको थियो, जसबाट सालिसिलिक एसिड र पछि सन् १८९९ मा Bayer कम्पनीद्वारा एसिटाइलसालिसिलिक एसिड (एस्पिरिन) बनाइएको हो। अध्ययनका वरिष्ठ लेखक, University of Jyväskylä का प्राध्यापक Varpu Marjomäki अनुसार, दैनिक जीवनमा भाइरससँग लड्न फराकिलो रूपमा असरदार उपायको आवश्यकता छ। Marjomäkiको टोलीको अघिल्लो काममा Willow बोक्राको अर्क पोलियो र हेपाटाइटिस A ल्याउने भाइरसहरू विरुद्ध प्रभावकारी देखिएको थियो, र यो नयाँ अनुसन्धानले अरू भाइरसहरूमा यसको असरको क्षेत्र विस्तार गरेको छ। अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूले व्यवसायिक रूपमा उमारिएको Willow का हाँगाहरू टिपेर काटे, फ्रिज गरे, पिसे र तातो पानीमा राखेर चिया बनाए। यी अर्कहरू एन्टेरोभाइरस A र B (Coxsackievirus), एक सामान्य रुघाखोकी भाइरस, र SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19 ल्याउने भाइरस) मा संक्रमित कोषमा परीक्षण गरिएको थियो। कति छिटो Willow बोक्रा अर्कले संक्रमित कोषमा असर गर्छ र भाइरसलाई दबाउँछ भन्ने जाँच्नका लागि विभिन्न assay प्रयोग गरियो। माइक्रोस्कोपी प्रयोग गर्दा कोरोनाभाइरस उपचारपछि फुटेको देखियो भने एन्टेरोभाइरसहरू कोषभित्र पुनः उत्पादन हुन सकेनन्। अनुसन्धानले Willow बोक्रा अर्कले फरक-फरक भाइरसमा फरक-फरक तरिकाले काम गर्ने देखाएको छ, तर दुवै प्रकारका भाइरसहरू (सिरोटाइप भएका र नभएका) लाई बराबर दबाउन सक्षम देखिएको छ। अर्कले भाइरसको सतहमा असर गरेको पाइयो, कुनै विशेष पुनः उत्पादन चक्रमा होइन। कुन यौगिकहरू प्रभावकारी छन् भन्ने पत्ता लगाउन विभिन्न अर्कका भागहरू, साथै बजारमा पाइने salixin extract र पाउडर परीक्षण गरियो। केवल salixin extract ले मात्र भाइरस बिरोधी असर देखायो, जसले Willow बोक्राको अर्कमा पाइने धेरैजसो बायोएक्टिभ यौगिकहरूको संयोजन आवश्यक देखिएको छ। निष्कर्षमा, अध्ययनले Willow बोक्रा अर्कमा धेरै आशाजनक भाइरस बिरोधी यौगिकहरू रहेको देखाएको छ, जसले मिलेर विभिन्न भाइरसलाई लक्ष्य गर्छन्। यि यौगिक र भाइरसहरूको अन्तरक्रिया बुझ्नका लागि थप अनुसन्धान आवश्यक छ। प्राध्यापक Marjomäkiको टोली अझै शुद्ध यौगिक तथा तिनको कार्यविधिबारे अनुसन्धान गरिरहेको छ। स्रोत: Dhanik Reshamwala, Sailee Shroff, Jaana Liimatainen, Jenni Tienaho, Mira Laajala, Petri Kilpeläinen, Anneli Viherä-Aarnio, Maarit Karonen, Tuula Jyske, र Varpu Marjomäki (2023). article_content: The Massachusetts Medical Examiner's Office has officially ruled that Stephen Rakes, alleged extortion victim of James 'Whitey' Bulger, died from homicide caused by cyanide poisoning, according to MaryBeth Long, spokesperson for the Middlesex District Attorney's Office. Based on the autopsy, the DA's office plans to pursue additional charges against William Camuti, who is already facing charges of attempted murder, misleading police, and illegal disposal of human remains. According to testimony from Massachusetts State Trooper Michael Banks at a September 10 hearing in Concord District Court, Camuti confessed to adding potassium cyanide to an iced coffee he gave to Rakes. Banks testified that Camuti had bought two iced coffees and obtained potassium cyanide, which had been delivered and stored by him. Rakes only took one sip before finding the coffee too bitter. Camuti then drove Rakes through several Massachusetts cities—Waltham, Woburn, Burlington, and Lincoln—before Rakes died from ingesting the poison. Camuti is being held without bail for 90 days after a judge ruled his release would not ensure public safety. Camuti and Rakes were longtime business associates, and the alleged poisoning occurred while Camuti owed Rakes money. On July 16, Camuti called Rakes to discuss a supposed investment property in Wilmington—a setup authorities believe was intended to lure Rakes. That same day, surveillance footage showed Rakes leaving the federal courthouse where he attended Bulger's trial, wearing the same clothes found on his body. Later, Camuti and Rakes met at a McDonald's in Waltham, where Camuti allegedly bought two iced coffees, put two teaspoons of potassium cyanide in one, and gave it to Rakes. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, potassium cyanide interferes with the body's ability to use oxygen and can be rapidly fatal. Investigators allege Camuti disposed of Rakes' body in a wooded area, where it was found the next day. CNN's requests for comment from Camuti's attorney were not returned. Camuti pleaded not guilty at his arraignment in August. Rakes, reportedly an extortion victim of Bulger, had recently learned prosecutors would not call him to testify, according to a friend. Bulger, a notorious Boston mob boss, was convicted in August on 31 of 32 counts, including extortion, money laundering, drug dealing, and weapons offenses. He was found responsible for 11 murders. CNN's Laura Ly contributed to this report.

बताए। राक्सले मात्र एक चुस्की लिएका थिए जसपछि कफी कटुवो लागेको भन्दै नखाए। त्यसपछि कमुटीले राक्सलाई वाल्थाम, वोबर्न, बर्लिङटन र लिङ्कन घुमाउँदै लगे र विष सेवनबाट अन्ततः राक्सको मृत्यु भयो। कमुटीलाई न्यायाधीशले साधारण धरौटीमा छोड्दा आमजनताको सुरक्षामा विश्वास गर्न नसकिने भन्दै ९० दिनसम्म थुनामा राख्ने आदेश दिएका छन्। कमुटी र राक्स दीर्घकालीन व्यापारी साझेदार थिए र कमुटीले राक्ससँग पैसा तिर्न बाँकी थियो। जुलाई १६ मा कमुटीले विलमिङ्टनमा लगानीको नाममा राक्सलाई भेट्न बोलाएका थिए। अधिकारीहरूका अनुसार यो राक्सलाई फसाउन बनाइएको योजना थियो। त्यही दिन, निगरानी भिडियोमा राक्सलाई बुल्जरको मुद्दामा संघीय अदालतबाट निस्कँदै गरेको देखाइएको छ, जस्तै कपडा लगाएका थिएजसमा उनको शव फेला पर्यो। त्यसपछि वॉल्थामको म्याक्डोनाल्ड्समा उनीहरू भेटिए, जहाँ कमुटीले दुई वटा बरफको कफी किनेर एक वटा कफीमा दुई चम्चा पोटासियम साइनाइड राखेर राक्सलाई दिएका थिए। रोग नियन्त्रण तथा रोकथाम केन्द्र (CDC) अनुसार, पोटासियम साइनाइडले शरीरमा अक्सिजनको प्रयोगमा बाधा ल्याउँछ र निकै चाँडै घातक हुनसक्छ। अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूले कमुटीले राक्सको शव जङ्गल क्षेत्रमा फालेको दाबी गरेका छन्, जुन अर्को दिन फेला पर्यो। कमुटीका वकिलसँग सीएनएनले प्रतिक्रिया माग्दा तुरुन्त जवाफ भेटिएन। कमुटीले अगस्टमा भएको अभियोग सुनुवाइमा आफू दोषी नभएको बताएका छन्। राक्स, जुन बुल्जरबाट जबर्जस्ती तिरेको पीडित मानिन्थे, मृत्युअघि उनले सरकारी वकिलहरूले उनलाई साक्षीको रूपमा नबोलाउने भनेर थाहा पाएका थिए, एक साथीले जनाए। बुल्जर, बोस्टनका कुख्यात ग्याङ्गस्टर, अगस्टमा ३२ मध्ये ३१ मुद्दामा दोषी ठहरिए, जसमा जबर्जस्ती, पैसा सेवन, लागूपदार्थ कारोबार, र हातहतियारसम्बन्धी मुद्दा थिए। उनलाई ११ वटा हत्या गरेको जिम्मेवार देखाइयो। सीएनएनकी लरा लाइको पनि article_content: A bear at Rostov-on-Don Zoo in Russia entertained visitors by scratching its back against a wall, much like Baloo from Rudyard Kipling’s The Jungle Book. The grizzly bear stood up tall and rubbed its back to find the perfect spot, causing onlookers to laugh. A member of the crowd shouted 'Baloo!', adding to the amusement. Photographer Grigor Khangeldyan, 52, captured the funny moment. He described how the bear slowly approached the wall and leaned back extravagantly to scratch its itch. Grigor, who visits the zoo regularly and enjoys photographing bears, was delighted by the scene and proud of his photos. He said the bear’s actions reminded him of Baloo’s iconic back-scratching scene from both Disney’s movie and the original children’s book. Everyone watching was entertained, and the bear looked content after relieving its itch.

article_content: Dan Lambe is CEO of the Arbor Day Foundation. He can be reached at dlambe@arborday.org and on Twitter at @DanLambe. With the growing urgency to fight climate change, innovative leaders are stepping up to implement nature-based solutions. More private sector leaders now prioritize sustainability, adjusting their business practices to reduce environmental impact. These changes can also influence consumer behavior. It's important for business leaders to recognize their positive impact can extend beyond their companies. Corporations have the potential to support conservation by using their influence to direct public attention and funding toward sustainability initiatives, making a lasting global difference. At the Arbor Day Foundation, we observe a rise in companies using tree planting to meet sustainability goals. Trees are an effective and affordable way to capture and store carbon. Research indicates that new forests could absorb up to two-thirds of human-produced carbon emissions. Trees also help boost biodiversity, reduce heat, filter air, and improve mental and physical well-being in communities. Although a tree stays in one place, its benefits reach far. Planting the right trees at the right time allows companies to maximize their positive effects on climate and people. Tree planting is a unifying activity that transcends politics and prejudice and benefits future generations. Whether planting in cities or forests, trees create visible, meaningful impact. This is not just for appearances; companies that support tree planting can see genuine results. Organizations that value tree planting should start with clear intentions. Consider what you want to achieve—whether it's creating wildlife habitats, restoring damaged forests, or reducing heat in urban areas. Effective projects are focused on these outcomes from the start. Some companies focus too much on numbers rather than impact. While planting millions of trees is helpful, choosing the right locations and understanding community needs ensures the greatest benefits. If companies are unsure where to start, they should seek advice from conservationists and forestry experts. Learning from peer organizations can also help newcomers find the most effective ways to participate. Over time, organizations can develop targeted goals, such as planting trees in specific locations to support unique local needs. There are many paths for companies to take, but defining objectives is key to creating a legacy of positive change. Ultimately, planting trees is not just about the act itself, but about using trees as a tool for meaningful improvement. translated_content: ड्यान लाम्बे अर्बर डे फाउन्डेसनका सीईओ हुन्। उहाँलाई dlambe@arborday.org मा वा ट्विटरमा @DanLambe सम्पर्क गर्न सकिन्छ। जलवायु परिवर्तनको चुनौती बढ्दै जाँदा, नवप्रवर्तनशील नेताहरूले प्रकृति-आधारित समाधानहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्दै छन्। अहिले धेरै निजी क्षेत्रका नेताहरूले दिगोपनालाई प्राथमिकता दिँदै आफ्नो व्यवसायिक अभ्यासमा वातावरणमैत्री परिवर्तन ल्याइरहेका छन्। यी परिवर्तनहरूले उपभोक्ता व्यवहारमा पनि असर पुग्छ। व्यावसायिक नेताहरूले आफ्नो कम्पनी बाहिरसमेत सकारात्मक प्रभाव विस्तार गर्न सक्ने महत्त्व बुझ्नुपर्छ। कर्पोरेटहरूले आफ्ना प्रभाव र स्रोतहरू दिगोपनासम्बन्धी पहलतर्फ मोडेर विश्वव्यापी स्थायी परिवर्तन ल्याउन सक्ने क्षमता राख्छन्। अर्बर डे फाउन्डेसनका अनुसार, धेरै कम्पनीहरूले अब दिगो विकासका लागि वृक्षरोपणलाई उत्कृष्ट उपायका रूपमा अपनाएका छन्। रूख वातावरणमा कार्बन सोस्न र थुपार्न सस्तो र प्रभावकारी तरिका हो। अनुसन्धान अनुसार, नयाँ वनहरूले मानवजन्य कार्बन उत्सर्जनमध्ये दुई-तिहाइसम्म लिन सक्छन्। रूखहरूले जैवविविधता वृद्धि गर्छन्, तातो कम गर्छन्, हावा शुद्ध पार्छन्, र नजिकका बासिन्दाको शारीरिक तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सुधार ल्याउँछन्। एउटा रूख जहाँ रोपिन्छ, त्यसको फाइदा टाढासम्म फैलिन्छ। सही स्थान र समयमा रूख रोप्दा कम्पनीहरूले वातावरण र समाजमा सकारात्मक असर छोड्न सक्छन्। वृक्षरोपण सबैलाई एकत्रित गर्ने राजनीतिक पूर्वाग्रहभन्दा माथि उठेको काम हो, जसले भविष्यमा राम्रो असर गर्छ। शहर होस् या वन, रूख रोप्दा प्रत्यक्ष, अर्थपूर्ण परिवर्तन देख्न सकिन्छ। यो मात्र देखावटको लागि होइन; वृक्षरोपणमा संलग्न कम्पनीहरूले वस्तुगत परिणाम हेर्न सक्छन्। रूख रोप्न चाहने संस्थाहरूले सुरुमा लक्ष्य स्पष्ट गर्नुपर्छ। चाहेको उद्देश्य के हो—वन्यजन्तुका लागि बासस्थान सिर्जना गर्ने, डढेलोले जलेका वन फर्काउने, अथवा सहरमा गर्मी घटाउने? प्रभावकारी परियोजनाहरू लक्षित परिणामका लागि योजनाबद्ध हुन्छन्। कतिपय कम्पनीहरूले संख्यामा मात्र ध्यान दिँदा प्रभाव कम हुन्छ। रूख धेरै रोप्नु महत्त्वपूर्ण नै हो, तर स्थानको छनोट र समुदायको आवश्यकता बुझ्दा असर धेरै हुँदै जान्छ। कसरी शुरू गर्ने थाहा नभएमा कम्पनीहरूले संरक्षणविद् वा वन विज्ञसँग सल्लाह गर्नु उत्तम हुन्छ। उस्तै रुचिका साथ अन्य कम्पनीहरूसँग अनुभव आदान-प्रदान गर्दा नयाँ सहभागीहरूले उपयुक्त मार्गदर्शन पाउँछन्। समयसँगै संस्थाहरूले थप लक्षित योजना बनाउन सक्छन्, उदाहरणका लागि, निश्चित ठाउँमा स्थानीय आवश्यकतालाई ध्यानमा राखी रूख रोप्ने। कम्पनीहरूले दिगो परिवर्तनका लागि थुप्रै विकल्प छनोट गर्न सक्छन्, तर लक्ष्य पहिल्यै निर्धारण गर्दा प्रभाव स्थायी बन्नेछ। अन्ततः, वृक्षरोपण केवल रूख रोप्ने प्रक्रिया नभई परिवर्तनका लागि एउटा सबल माध्यम हो। फोर्ब्स नन-प्रोफिट काउन्सिल सफल गैरनाफामूलक संस्थाका प्रमुखहरूका लागि छनोट गरिएको समूह हो।

article_content: One cold morning in Huddersfield, Stacey Rodgers discovered something was terribly wrong with her ten-year-old son Dominic. Unusually silent and unresponsive, Dominic lay in bed where, the night before, he had seemed cheerful and healthy. Realizing something was wrong, Stacey called for help, but paramedics informed her Dominic had died. The cause: carbon monoxide poisoning. This toxic, invisible gas can build up when fuel-burning appliances malfunction or are poorly ventilated—risk that increases in winter as homes are sealed for warmth. In Dominic’s case, a neighbor’s faulty boiler allowed carbon monoxide to seep in, with tragic consequences. The neighbor, new to the area, had trusted her landlord for maintenance. UK statistics indicate around 4,000 people receive hospital treatment and about 40 die each year from carbon monoxide poisoning, although experts suspect these numbers may be understated. In France, with a similar population, recorded deaths are higher, suggesting some UK cases go unrecognized due to lack of routine carbon monoxide testing during post-mortems. Carbon monoxide depletes oxygen in the body, which can lead to organ failure or death in high amounts within minutes. Prolonged exposure at lower levels can cause ongoing health problems like headaches or heart complications, often without people realizing carbon monoxide is the cause. Following Dominic’s passing in 2004, Stacey became a leading campaigner for carbon monoxide awareness and gas safety, founding the Dominic Rodgers Trust. She emphasizes the importance of carbon monoxide alarms—affordable devices that could prevent many tragedies. Despite this, millions of Britons still lack these life-saving alarms. Dr. Rob Hicks and other advocates recommend installing alarms in every room containing a potential source. Some UK regions, including Scotland and Northern Ireland, have made these alarms compulsory in new homes or when new heating appliances are installed, but campaigners are pushing for nationwide legislation. Experts also advise regular servicing of heating and cooking appliances, as blockages and poor ventilation can create hazards. Elderly individuals and people with pre-existing heart or lung conditions are particularly susceptible. Stacey never returned to her former home, too traumatized by her loss. Her campaigning continues to help protect others—she regularly receives messages from people whose lives were saved thanks to her efforts. She remains committed to ensuring no one else experiences what her family endured. Learn more about carbon monoxide safety: co-bealarmed.co.uk

article_content: A recent decision by Uganda's government to name a road after two foreign tourists killed earlier this month has sparked outrage in the country. British citizen David Barlow and his South African wife, Emmaretia Geyer, were killed while on their honeymoon. Police reported that the attackers also set their car on fire during the attack on 17 October. Some Ugandans have criticized the government for honoring the foreign couple while not extending similar recognition to Eric Alyai, the Ugandan guide who was killed with them. Authorities stated that the couple, from Berkshire in the UK, were visiting Queen Elizabeth National Park to see gorillas and other primates when they were attacked by the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), an Islamic State-linked rebel group that operates mainly in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo but also has a presence in western Uganda. Chris Baryomunsi, Uganda's Minister for ICT and National Guidance, told The Nile Post news website, 'As cabinet, we took a decision that for these tourists, we are going to name one of the roads in Uganda after them.' However, he did not specify which road would be chosen. Regarding Mr. Alyai, the guide, the minister said the government would support his family. He told Ugandan television channel UBC that Mr. Alyai had left behind a widow and a one-year-old child. Some Ugandans believe the government should also name a road after Mr. Alyai. 'Eric [Alyai] too was part of this tragedy and must be remembered, as he died on duty. That would only be fair,' said one Ugandan on X, formerly known as Twitter. Another user commented, 'Our inferiority complex is high. No wonder the park where the couple met their death is named after a British Queen.' The government has also been criticized for planning a memorial for the foreign victims but not taking similar action to honor numerous Ugandans killed by the ADF in earlier attacks. In June, ADF fighters attacked a Ugandan school, killing 41 children. This is not the first time Ugandan authorities have faced outrage over their response to the deaths of the tourists and their guide. Last Saturday, the Uganda Wildlife Authority was criticized for posting a promotional photo of Queen Elizabeth National Park shortly after the attack. The authority captioned the photo, 'It was an exciting morning today in Queen Elizabeth National Park as tourists enjoyed a game viewing.' Some Ugandans said it was insensitive to promote the park so soon after the attack. 'The callousness and lack of humanity displayed by those responsible for orchestrating this insensitive campaign is a shame for our country,' said Ugandan human rights activist Daniel Kawuma. 'It is deeply troubling how you use the scene of such a gruesome killing and post messages of an “exciting morning” for tourists. It is incomprehensible how you could mock the victims and their grieving families by circulating happy photos of Queen Elizabeth before the bodies have even been laid to rest,' he added.

पत्नी, एम्मारेटिया गेयर, आफ्नो हनिमूनको क्रममा मारिए। प्रहरीले आक्रमणकारीहरूले १७ अक्टोबरमा आक्रमण गर्दा उनीहरूको गाडीमा आगो लगाएको जनाएको छ। केही युगाण्डालीहरूले सरकारलाई विदेशी जोडीलाई सम्मान गरेर उनीहरूसँगै मारिएका युगाण्डाली गाइड एरिक अल्याईलाई बेवास्ता गरेको भन्दै आलोचना गरेका छन्। प्राधिकरणका अनुसार उक्त जोडी बेलायतको बर्कशायरबाट गोरिल्ला र अन्य प्रजातिहरू हेर्न क्वीन एलिजाबेथ नेशनल पार्कमा आएका थिए, जहाँ उनीहरू इस्लामिक स्टेटसँग सम्बन्धित विद्रोही समूह अलाइड डेमोक्रेटिक फोर्सेस (ADF) द्वारा आक्रमणमा परेका थिए। यो समूह मुख्य रूपमा कंगोको पूर्वी भागमा सक्रिय भए पनि युगाण्डाको पश्चिमी क्षेत्रमा पनि यसको उपस्थिति छ। युगाण्डाका सूचना तथा राष्ट्रिय मार्गदर्शन मन्त्री क्रिस बर्योमुनसीले द नाइल पोस्टसँग भने, “मन्त्रिपरिषद्ले यी पर्यटकहरूको नाममा युगाण्डाको एउटा सडक राख्ने निर्णय गरेको छ।” तर कुन सडकलाई नामाकरण गर्ने भन्ने खुलाइएको छैन। गाइड श्री अल्याईको सम्बन्धमा मन्त्रीले सरकार उनको परिवारलाई सहयोग दिने वचन दिए। उनले युगाण्डाली टिभी च्यानल UBC लाई श्री अल्याईले पत्नी र एक वर्षे बच्चा छोडेर गएको बताएका छन्। केही युगाण्डालीहरू भन्छन् सरकारले श्री अल्याईको नाममा पनि सडक नाम राख्नुपर्छ। “एरिक अल्याई पनि यो घटनामा सहभागी थिए — उ कर्तव्यमा थिए, न्यायको लागि उनलाई पनि सम्झनुपर्छ,” एक युगाण्डालीले X (पूर्व ट्‌विटर) मा लेखे। अर्का उपयोगकर्ताले लेखे, 'हामीमा आत्महीनता धेरै छ। जुन पार्कमा त्यो जोडी मारिए, त्यो ब्रिटिश रानीको नाममा छ— यो त अचम्मको कुरा होइन।' सरकारले विदेशी पीडितको लागि स्मारक बनाउने योजना बनाएर, अघिल्ला घटनामा ADF द्वारा मारिएका धेरै युगाण्डालीहरूलाई सम्मान नगरेको भन्दै आलोचना भइरहेका छन्। जुन महिनामा, ADF लडाकूहरूले युगाण्डाको एक विद्यालयमा आक्रमण गर्दा ४१ बालबालिका मारिएका थिए। यसअघि पनि युगाण्डाली अधिकारीहरूले पर्यटक र गाइडको मृत्युमा प्रतिक्रिया जनाउने तरिका विपरित आलोचना खेपेका थिए। गएको शनिबार, युगाण्डा वाइल्डलाइफ अथोरिटीले आक्रमणपछि चाँडै क्वीन एलिजाबेथ नेशनल पार्कको प्रचार फोटो पोष्ट गरेकोमा आलोचना भयो। फोटोमा 'आज बिहान क्वीन एलिजाबेथ नेशनल पार्कमा पर्यटकहरूले रमाइलो खेल अवलोकन गरे' भन्ने क्याप्सन थियो। केही युगाण्डालीले आक्रमणपछिका दिनमा पार्कको यति चाँडो प्रचार गर्नु असंवेदनशील भएको बताएका छन्। 'यो अमानवीयता र संवेदनशून्यता हाम्रो देशको लाज हो,' मानव अधिकारकर्मी ड्यानियल कवुमा भन्छन्। 'यस्तो नराम्रो हत्याको घटनास्थल प्रयोग गरेर ‘रमाइलो बिहान’ को सन्देश दिनु निकै समस्याजनक हो। पीडित तथा परिवारमाथि यसरी घाउमा नुन हाल्न मिल्दैन,' उनले थपे।

article_content:
North Korea's top military official, Ri Yong Ho—a key mentor to current leader Kim Jong Un and a close associate of the late Kim Jong Il—has been removed from all posts, reportedly due to illness. State media announced the decision on Monday, surprising observers and shaking the core of the country's power structure. Ri appeared healthy in recent public appearances, leading analysts to speculate that Kim Jong Un may have ousted him to solidify his authority, just seven months after succeeding his father. Ri's last public event, only a week prior, showed no obvious signs of discord. The removal was decided at a Workers' Party meeting on Sunday, according to the Korean Central News Agency. No successor has been named, nor were further details on Ri's condition or future provided.

Daniel Pinkston of the International Crisis Group questioned the official explanation, noting Ri’s healthy appearance. He observed that Ri attained major promotions in September 2010 but was overlooked in April, fueling speculation about his status. Analysts suggest Kim’s move serves as a warning to potential challengers, even if Ri never defied him directly.

Concurrently, Kim Jong Un has been seen at public events with a mysterious woman who resembles a first lady—a notable change from his father's era, when female companions were kept out of the public eye. The status of North Korea’s million-strong army, one of the largest in the world, continues to be closely monitored in South Korea and the United States, both of which maintain significant troop presences in the region. North Korea has recently issued threats toward South Korea, reacting to perceived insults and joint US-South Korean military exercises. The situation remains tense after a North Korean artillery attack in 2010 killed four South Koreans.

Ri Yong Ho served as vice marshal and chief of the Korean People's Army General Staff, and was promoted to prominent Workers' Party positions in 2010. He was regarded as a mentor to Kim Jong Un and consistently appeared at his side during major events from 2010 onward, including Kim Jong Il’s funeral. Ri’s removal could reflect an internal power struggle, possibly with Choe Ryong Hae, the army’s top political officer who earned key promotions in April, according to Professor Koh Yu-hwan of Dongguk University.

The move is seen as a significant political shift. North Korean leaders have historically promoted military leaders to ensure loyalty, and Kim Jong Un has continued this military-first policy while also promoting younger officials with economic backgrounds to key posts. Hong Hyun-ik of the Sejong Institute predicted that more aging officials may be replaced as part of a generational change. North Korean leadership transitions are often opaque, with senior officials sometimes disappearing from public view without explanation. Top officials usually remain in their posts until illness or death, like Jo Myong Rok, who died in 2010 at age 82.

Photographs as recent as early July show Ri appearing healthy at public events. ‘Whether because of a physical ailment or political reasons, Ri Yong Ho is out, and North Korean authorities are making it clear that he is no longer part of the leadership,’ said John Delury of Yonsei University. Delury noted that it is too early to determine if Ri’s departure signals military-civilian tensions or Kim Jong Un’s efforts to consolidate control. Ri emerged as a prominent figure only in Kim Jong Il’s final years and may have served as a transitional leader.

The Korean Peninsula remains divided since the 1953 armistice. Tensions heightened after North Korea’s failed rocket launch in April 2012, which the United Nations saw as a test of banned missile technology, while North Korea insisted it was intended to place a satellite into orbit.

उत्तर कोरियाका शीर्ष सैनिक अधिकारी री योंग हो—हालका नेता किम जोंग उनका गुरु र दिवंगत किम जोंग इलका नजिकका सहयोगी—सबै पदबाट हटाइएका छन्, राज्य सञ्चार माध्यमका अनुसार बिरामी भएका कारण। यो निर्णय सोमबार घोषणा गरियो, जसले प्रेक्षकलाई चकित तुल्याएको छ र देशको शक्ति संरचनामा ठूलो असर गरेको छ। री हालैका सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रममा स्वस्थ देखिएका थिए, जसका कारण विश्लेषकहरूले अनुमान गरेका छन् कि किम जोंग उनले आफ्नाे अधिकार दृढ पार्न उनलाई हटाएका हुन सक्छन्, बाबुको उत्तराधिकारी बनेको सात महिनामै। झण्डै एक हप्ता अघि मात्रै भएको उनको अन्तिम सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रममा कुनै मतभेद देखिएको थिएन। कामदार पार्टीको आइतबारको बैठकमा उनलाई हटाउने निर्णय गरिएको कोरियन सेन्ट्रल न्यूज एजेन्सीले जनाएको छ। रीकाे स्थान कोले लिन्छ भन्ने खुलाइएको छैन र उनीकाे स्वास्थ्य वा भविष्यबारे थप विवरण दिइएको छैन।

इन्टरनेशनल क्राइसिस ग्रुपका ड्यानियल पिङ्क्सटनले आधिकारिक विवरणप्रति प्रश्न उठाएका छन्, किनभने री स्वस्थ देखिन्छन्। उनले २०१० को सेप्टेम्बरमा ठूलो पदोन्नती पाएका तर अप्रिलमा उपेक्षित भएको कुरा औँल्याउँदै, उनको स्थानबारे अड्कलबाजीलाई बढाएको बताए। विश्लेषकहरू भन्छन्, किमको कदम सम्भावित प्रतिस्पर्धीहरूलाई चेतावनी दिनका लागि हो, चाहे रीले प्रत्यक्ष रुपमा उहाँको विरोध गरेका थिएनन्।

यही क्रममा, किम जोंग उनलाई सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रममा एक रहस्यमयी महिला सँग देखिएको छ, जसले फर्स्ट लेडी झैं व्यवहार गरेकी थिइन्—यो उनको बाबुको पालामा महिला साथीहरूलाई सार्वजनिक जीवनमा देखाउने चलन थिएन। उत्तर कोरियाको लाखौंसेना दक्षिण कोरिया र अमेरिकाले नजिकबाट निगरानी गरिरहेका छन्, जहाँ दुबै देशका ठूलै फौज गएका छन्। उत्तर कोरियाले हालै दक्षिण कोरियाप्रति धम्की दिएको छ, अपमानको रुपमा बुझेका घटनाहरू र संयुक्त सैन्य अभ्यासप्रति आक्रोश व्यक्त गर्दै। सन् २०१० मा उत्तर कोरियाको तोप हमला पछि चार दक्षिण कोरियालीको मृत्यु भयो, जसले अवस्था अझै तनावपूर्ण बनाएको छ।

री योंग हो उपमार्शल र कोरियन पिपुल्स आर्मीका जनरल स्टाफ प्रमुख थिए र २०१० मा वर्कर्स पार्टीका प्रमुख पदमा बढुवा भएका थिए। उनी किम जोंग उनका संरक्षकका रूपमा परिचित थिए र सन् २०१० पछि हुने प्रमुख कार्यक्रमहरूमा सँधै उनकाे छेउमा देखिन्थे, किम जोंग इलको अन्त्येष्टिमा समेत। डोङगुक विश्वविद्यालयका प्रोफेसर को यु-ह्वानका अनुसार, रीको हटाइ चोए रयोंग हे सँगको शक्ति संघर्षसँग सम्बन्धित हुन सक्छ, जसले अप्रिलमा प्रमुख पदमा पदोन्नती पाएका थिए।

यो कदमलाई महत्वपूर्ण राजनीतिक परिवर्तनका रूपमा हेरिएको छ। उत्तर कोरियाली नेताहरूले सेनालाई महत्व दिएजस्तै, किम जोंग उनले पनि सैन्य पहिलो नीति कायम गर्दै आर्थिक पृष्ठभूमिका युवा अधिकारीहरूलाई समेत प्रमोट गरेका छन्। सेजोंग संस्थाका होङ ह्युन-इकका अनुसार, अब अझ धेरै बुढा अधिकारीहरू हटाइन सक्नेछन्। उत्तर कोरियामा नेतृत्व परिवर्तन प्रायः रहस्यमय हुन्छ, जहाँ वरिष्ठ अधिकारीहरू बिना स्पष्टीकरण हराउँछन्। अधिकाँश अधिकारीहरू बिरामी वा मृत्यु नभएसम्म पदमा बस्ने गर्छन्, जस्तै जो म्योङ रोक २०१० मा ८२ वर्षको उमेरमा बिते।

जुलाइ सुरुमा पनि री सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रममा स्वस्थ देखिन्छन्। ‘शारीरिक समस्या वा राजनीतिक कारण जुनसुकै होस्, री योंग हो अब हटिसकेका छन् र उत्तर कोरियाली अधिकारीहरूले यो स्पष्ट पारेका छन्,’ भन्छन् योन्सेई विश्वविद्यालयका जोन डेलुरी। उनका अनुसार, यो सैन्य–नागरिक तनाव या किम जोंग उनस्वयं सत्तामा एकछत्र बनाउन खोजेको हो भन्ने भनी ठोकुवा गर्नु छिट्टै हुनेछ। री किम जोंग इलका अन्तिम वर्षमा मात्र चर्चित भएका थिए र सम्भवत: तिनी संरक्षक भूमिकामा थिए।

कोरियन प्रायद्वीप १९५३ को युद्धविरामपछि आजसम्म दुई भागमै बाँडिएको छ। अप्रिल २०१२ को असफल रकेट प्रक्षेपणपछि तनाव झनै बढेको छ, जुन संयुक्त राष्ट्रले प्रतिबन्धित मिसाइल प्रविधिको परीक्षण मानेको थियो भने उत्तर कोरियाले उक्त प्रक्षेपणलाई स्याटेलाइटको लागि भनेको थियो।

article_content: Waves could soon be breaking at the heart of Melbourne’s CBD if a proposal for a man-made floating beach is approved. The planned Docklands Surf Park would create surfable waves from 1 to 1.5 metres high in Victoria Harbour. It would feature a sandy beach and a 160-metre floating wave pool filled with filtered salt water. Designers of the project estimate its cost at over $8 million and say that the technology would allow the wave size to be adjusted to suit everyone from beginners to experienced surfers. Docklands Surf Park is a joint venture between engineering firm Arup and Melbourne-based architect Damian Rogers. 'The whole idea started with the dream of surfing in an inner-city location. Melbourne already has the bay, and now there’s the Docklands,' Rogers explained. 'For us, it’s about finishing work, coming down with your surfboard, and catching some waves.' The proposal is still in its early stages and requires approval from Melbourne City Council. The engineering company is currently seeking non-government funding options. Phil Carter, Urban and Transport Planner at Arup, noted that surfing in Melbourne usually means driving over an hour to Bells Beach. 'While Bells Beach is iconic, the convenience of surfing in the Docklands stood out to us. Imagine going to work, then heading to the Docklands with your surfboard for a session—that’s a real opportunity,' he said. Surfing Victoria has endorsed the plan, viewing it as a potential hotspot for professional surfing competitions. Max Wells, Chief Executive of Surfing Victoria, said that although he's heard of various wave pool plans over the years, Docklands Surf Park is the first he believes could succeed. 'They have the right location, and indications suggest it will be accessible. Being just 100 metres from a tram line and Spencer Street station is incredible. I can see surfers in suits heading for after-work sessions and kids bringing their boards on trains and trams,' he told The Age.

article_content: London is nearing its final preparations for the 2012 Olympic Games, with 100 days to go before the opening ceremony. Organizers report that venues are on schedule and within budget, ticket demand is high, and sponsorship revenue exceeds expectations. Sebastian Coe, head of the London organizing committee, said, 'This is the moment when we really start getting ready to celebrate and welcome the world.' London will become the first city to host the Olympics three times in the modern era when the games start on July 27. In 1948, after World War Two, London last hosted the Games without building new venues, housing athletes in army camps or colleges. Although the 2012 Games are less austere, organizers have dealt with challenges, notably the global financial crisis after securing the Olympic bid in 2005. The committee, led by two-time Olympic champion Sebastian Coe, aims to deliver the event within a £9.3 billion ($14.8 billion) budget, which more than doubled from the original £4 billion ($6.5 billion) estimate. Major venues like the £468 million ($746 million) Olympic Stadium, Aquatics Center, and Velodrome are complete, with test events underway. Coe noted, 'Those things within our control are under control, and we're prepared for unexpected challenges.' IOC president Jacques Rogge praised London’s legacy efforts, particularly the regeneration of east London. While improving a declining area was key to London’s bid, some disputes have arisen, including recent evictions of protesters from land designated for a temporary basketball facility. Protesters argue it should remain public land; organizers pledge to restore it after the Games. The athletes’ village has been partially sold through a partnership with the Qatari royal family's investment arm and a private British firm, with 1,379 of 2,818 homes set aside for affordable housing. Uncertainty remains over the Olympic Stadium’s future. West Ham United was first chosen as tenant, but the deal fell through after challenges from rival bidders. West Ham remains among four interested parties, with a decision expected soon. Transport and security are major concerns. London’s aging subway system struggles with daily use, and an extra 325,000 visitors per day are expected. Ongoing underground worker strikes may add to disruptions. Businesses are encouraged to allow remote work or adjust commuting times. Athletes, officials, and VIPs will use special lanes, but this has drawn criticism for possible gridlock elsewhere. Security is a key focus following an incident involving a protester at the Oxford-Cambridge Boat Race and last year’s riots. London’s security budget is £553 million ($881 million), with plans to deploy 35,000 security personnel. There are concerns the budget could grow. Protests are expected before and during the Games, particularly around the 70-day torch relay beginning May 19. The activist group 'Greenwash Gold 2012,' led by Meredith Alexander, is planning protests against sponsors such as Dow Chemical, BP, and Rio Tinto, citing allegations of environmental and human rights violations. Alexander resigned from the sustainability watchdog over Dow’s involvement. Coe stated, 'We live in a democracy, but protest must be balanced with the rights of others. One person’s protest could affect another’s dream.' The torch relay may increase public enthusiasm, though a quarter of Britons traveling abroad this summer reportedly are doing so to avoid the Olympics. Meanwhile, over 10,000 athletes from 204 countries will arrive, featuring stars like Usain Bolt and Michael Phelps alongside home hopefuls Jessica Ennis and Mo Farah. Coe added, 'There’s unprecedented enthusiasm among competitors to get to London—this level of excitement is unmatched in past Games.'

आइओसीका अध्यक्ष जाक रोजले लन्डनको पूर्वी क्षेत्रमा गरिएको विकासको प्रशंसा गरे। गतिलो क्षेत्र सुधार लन्डनको योजनामा मुख्य थियो, तर केही विवाद पनि देखियो — भर्खरै अस्थायी बास्केटबल मैदानका लागि कतारी शाही परिवारको लगानी शाखा र बेलायती निजी कम्पनीको साझेदारीमा आंशिक रुपमा बिक्री भएको छ, जसमा २,८१८ मध्ये १,३७९ घर सस्तो आवासका लागि छुट्याइएको छ। ओलम्पिक स्टेडियमको भविष्य अझै स्पष्ट छैन। वेस्ट ह्याम युनाइटेडलाई शुरुमा टेनेन्सी दिन लागिएको थियो, तर अन्य प्रतिस्पर्धीहरूको आपत्तीले त्यो सम्झौता टुट्यो। वेस्ट ह्याम हाल चार सम्भावित इच्छुकहरूमध्ये एक हो, छिट्टै निर्णय हुने भनिएको छ। यातायात र सुरक्षा प्रमुख चिन्ताका विषय हुन्। लन्डनको पुरानो सबवे प्रणाली दैनिक बजार व्यवस्थित गर्न नै संघर्षरत छ, र ओलम्पिक अवधिमा थप ३२५,००० आगन्तुक प्रत्येक दिन आइपुग्ने अनुमान छ। भूमिगत कामदारहरूको हड्तालले समस्या झन् बढाउन सक्छ। कम्पनीहरूलाई कर्मचारीहरू घरबाट काम गर्न र यात्रा समय परिवर्तन गर्न सुझाव दिइएको छ। खेलाडी, अधिकारी र विशेष अतिथिहरूका लागि छुट्टै लेन प्रयोग गरिनेछ, जसले बाकी सडकमा जाम हुनुका विषयमा आलोचना उठेको छ। सुरक्षाप्रति अझै बढी ध्यान दिइएको छ। भर्खरैको ओक्सफोर्ड-क्याम्ब्रिज डुङ्गा दौडमा भएको विरोध र गतवर्षका दंगाले सुरक्षा थप महत्त्वको विषय बनेको छ। सुरक्षा बजेट £५५३ मिलियन ($८८१ मिलियन) छ, ३५,००० सुरक्षाकर्मी परिचालन हुनेछन्। बजेट अझ बढ्न सक्ने चिन्ता राखिएको छ। खेल सुरु हुनुअघि र दौरान प्रदर्शनको अपेक्षा छ, विशेषगरी मे १९ देखि सुरु हुने ७० दिने टर्च रिलेमा।मेरिडिथ एलेक्ज्यान्डरले समितिको निगरानी समूहबाट राजीनामा दिएकी हुन्। कोलेले भने, 'हामी लोकतन्त्रमा बाँच्छौं, तर प्रदर्शन र अरूको अधिकारबीच सन्तुलन चाहिन्छ। एउटाको विरोधले अर्कोको सपना बिगार्न सक्छ।' टर्च article_content: For centuries, scientists have observed a peculiar phenomenon: sometimes, hot water freezes faster than cold, a mystery known as the Mpemba effect and famously pondered by thinkers like Aristotle. While the concept has been recognized since ancient times, a convincing explanation has proven difficult to pinpoint—until recent developments. A team of scientists, led by Dr. Xi Zhang at Singapore's Nanyang Technological University, now propose that the answer lies in the unique behavior of hydrogen bonds in water. Their research suggests that these bonds, which connect individual water molecules, behave unexpectedly when water is heated. Water is made up of molecules linked by covalent bonds within each molecule and hydrogen bonds between molecules. Although hydrogen bonds are weaker than covalent bonds, they are stronger than many other forces between molecules, and give water its unusual properties. The team observed that as water heats, its hydrogen bonds stretch, causing the molecules to move further apart and retain extra energy. When the hot water begins to cool, these hydrogen bonds contract, releasing energy more quickly than in colder water, thus allowing the hot water to freeze faster. Supporting their hypothesis, the researchers' calculations demonstrated that the molecular changes correspond with experimental results showing hot water's faster freezing. Traditional theories, such as faster evaporation or improved heat transfer, have also been considered, but the focus now is on the vital role of hydrogen bonds. The effect gets its name from Erasto Mpemba, a Tanzanian student who noticed in the 1960s that a hot ice cream mixture could freeze faster than a cold one. However, while this latest research brings fresh insight, some physicists caution that further work is required, as the new explanation does not yet account for all water's behaviors under different circumstances.
translated_content: शताब्दीयौंदेखि वैज्ञानिकहरूले एउटा अनौठो घटना देख्दै आएका छन्: कहिलेकाँहीँ तातो पानी चिसो पानीभन्दा छिटो जम्छ, जसलाई म्पेम्बा प्रभाव भनिन्छ र महान चिन्तक अरिस्टोटलजस्ता व्यक्तित्वहरूले पनि यसबारे विचार गरेका थिए। यो अवधारणा प्राचीन कालदेखि नै परिचित भए तापनि, विश्वसनीय स्पष्टीकरण हालै मात्र सम्भव भएको छ। सिंगापुरको नानयाङ्ग टेक्नोलोजिकल विश्वविद्यालयका डा. शी झाङ नेतृत्वको टोलीको अनुसन्धानले यसको उत्तर पानीमा पाइने हाइड्रोजन बन्धहरूको अनौठो व्यवहारमा रहेको देखाएको छ। अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूका अनुसार, पानी तताउँदा हाइड्रोजन बन्धहरू अनौठो ढंगले काम गर्छन्। पानीका अणुहरू भित्रभित्रै कोभालेन्ट बन्ध र एकआपसमा हाइड्रोजन बन्धद्वारा जोडिएका हुन्छन्। यद्यपि, हाइड्रोजन बन्धहरू कोभालेन्ट बन्धभन्दा कमजोर भए पनि अरू धेरै बलहरूभन्दा बलिया हुन् र यिनैले पानीका अद्वितीय गुण दिएका छन्। टोलीको भनाइ अनुसार, पानी तताउँदा हाइड्रोजन बन्धहरू तन्किन्छन्, जसले अणुहरू टाढा पुग्न र थप ऊर्जा संचित गर्न मद्दत गर्छ। जब तातो पानी चिसिन्छ, बन्धहरू खुम्चिएर ऊर्जा छिटो छोड्छन्, जसले तातो पानीलाई चिसोभन्दा छिटो जम्न सघाउँछ। अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूले गरेका गणनाले यी आणविक परिवर्तनहरूले प्रायोगिक रूपमा देखिएको छिटो जम्ने प्रक्रियालाई स्पष्ट पार्छन्। पहिला वाष्पीकरण वा ताप स्थानान्तरणजस्ता सिद्धान्तहरू पनि विचार गरिए तापनि, हाल हाइड्रोजन बन्धको भूमिका मुख्य देखिएको छ। यो प्रभावको नाम तान्जानियाली विद्यार्थी एरास्टो म्पेम्बाको नाममा राखिएको हो, जसले १९६० को दशकमा तातो आइसक्रिम मिश्रण चिसोभन्दा छिटो जमेको देखे। यद्यपि नयाँ अनुसन्धानले नयाँ दृष्टिकोण ल्याएको छ, केही भौतिकशास्त्रीहरू अझै थप अनुसन्धान आवश्यक रहेको बताउँछन्, किनकि नयाँ व्याख्याले पानीका सबै व्यवहारहरू पूरै स्पष्ट गर्न सकेको छैन।

article_content: Declan Edwards, a 16-year-old school prefect from Unity College in Burnley, died after a weekend of heavy drinking and drug use with a new group of friends. Over three days, Declan consumed large amounts of amphetamines and Ecstasy in an attempt to keep partying. Not realizing the drugs' potential impact on his mind, he left the group on Sunday afternoon and went missing in nearby woodland. He was found hanged four days later near Rowley Lake following a major police search. The inquest described Declan as well-liked and caring, involved at school, and working at Burnley Football Club. He was preparing for his GCSE exams and had been chosen for a sports diploma. The tragedy happened in May, soon after Declan started spending time with the group. Testimony revealed that Declan and his friends took a combination of 35 Ecstasy pills, several grams of amphetamines, and alcohol over the weekend. His friends said he became increasingly disoriented. Declan’s family said they had no idea he used drugs; his mother, Mandy, stated that she didn't believe he meant to end his life. Toxicology tests found amphetamines, cannabis, and MDMA in his system. Coroner Richard Taylor found that the substances contributed to Declan’s death and said there was no clear intent to die. Friends and family remembered Declan as a positive, loving, and joyful person.
translated_content: बर्न्लीको युनिटी कलेजका १६ वर्षीय स्कुल प्रिफेक्ट डेक्लन एडवर्ड्सले नयाँ साथीहरूको समूहसँग साप्ताहिक अन्त्यमा अत्यधिक मदिरा र लागूऔषध सेवन गरेपछि ज्यान गुमाए। तीन दिनसम्म डेक्लनले पार्टी गर्न निरन्तर बस्न धेरै मात्रामा एम्फेटामिन र इकस्टेसी खाएका थिए। लागूपदार्थको सम्भावित प्रभावबारे अज्ञान रहेर, उनी आइतबार दिउँसो समूहबाट अलगिएर नजिकको जंगलतिर हराए। ठूलो प्रहरी खोजीपछि, उनी चार दिनपछि रोउली लेक नजिकै झुण्डिएको अवस्थामा फेला परे। अनुसन्धानमा डेक्लनलाई स्कूलमा सक्रिय, सहयोगी र बर्न्ली फुटबल क्लबमा काम गर्ने एक प्रिय युवा भनियो। उनी जीसीएसई परीक्षा तयारीमा थिए र खेलकुद डिप्लोमा कार्यक्रममा छनोट भएका थिए। यो घटना उनी नयाँ समूहसँग घुलमिल हुन थालेको केही समयमै मे महिनामा भएको थियो। प्रमाणमा भनिएको छ, डेक्लन र उनका साथीहरूले साप्ताहिक अन्त्यमा ३५ ओटा इकस्टेसी ट्याब्लेट, धेरै ग्राम एम्फेटामिन र अत्यधिक मदिरा सेवन गरेका थिए। उनका साथीहरूका अनुसार, घटना हुँदै जाँदा डेक्लन बढी असन्तुलित देखिन थाले। डेक्लनका परिवारलाई उनको लागूपदार्थ सेवनबारे थाहा थिएन; आमा मेन्डीले डेक्लनले ज्यान दिने मनसाय नरहेको बताइन्। विष विज्ञान परीक्षणमा एम्फेटामिन, गाँजा र एमडीएमए भेटिएको थियो। कोरोनर रिचार्ड टेलरले लागूपदार्थको असरले डेक्लनको मृत्यु भएको र स्वेच्छिक आत्महत्याको कुनै निश्चित प्रमाण नभएको बताएका छन्। परिवार र साथीहरूले डेक्लनलाई सकारात्मक, मायालु र हर्षिलो युवकका रूपमा सम्झिएका छन्।

article_content: PARIS: Rugby has embraced a period of reform with the announcement of an expanded World Cup and a new Nations League competition, as World Rugby seeks to broaden the sport's global reach and enhance revenue and opportunities. On Tuesday, World Rugby (WR) revealed sweeping changes to the sport’s international schedule that they believe will herald a new era for rugby. These updates represent the concluding phase of a comprehensive, long-term review aimed at shaping the future of the game. Notable changes include expanding the men's Rugby World Cup to 24 teams, introducing a two-tier Nations League to increase opportunities for lower-ranked nations to compete against traditional powerhouses, and implementing a synchronized global calendar. "If rugby is to become a truly global sport, we must make it more relevant and accessible worldwide," said WR chairman Sir Bill Beaumont at a Paris press conference. He described the reforms as the sport’s most important development since the professional era began and acknowledged both widespread support and some resistance to the new competitions. Despite debate and dissent, Beaumont noted that the changes received substantial backing. The 2027 Rugby World Cup in Australia will grow from 20 to 24 teams, organized into six first-round groups of four, and will now feature a round of 16. Despite the increased number of teams, the tournament will be shortened to six weeks instead of seven. For the first time, the World Cup draw will take place as late as January 2026, a move designed to prevent uneven groupings caused by early rankings, an issue noted in previous tournaments. A frequent complaint from Tier Two nations—that they lack access to regular, meaningful matches—will be addressed with the Nations League. This competition, starting in 2026, will consist of two divisions of 12 teams each. The top division will include teams from the Six Nations, the Rugby Championship, and reportedly Japan and Fiji, facing off every two years in July and November. The second division, managed by World Rugby, will also have 12 teams, and a promotion and relegation system will be introduced from 2030 onwards. In years without the Nations League, more cross-over matches between teams from different divisions will be scheduled. Additionally, the Pacific Nations Cup will expand in 2024, featuring Canada, Fiji, Japan, Samoa, Tonga, and the United States. Beaumont expressed confidence in this 'exciting new era' starting in 2026—one that promises greater opportunity, certainty, and inclusivity, with a focus on growing the sport beyond its historic boundaries. From 2026, the women’s game will see its first dedicated international release window, as well as an ongoing review of its global calendar and competition structure. WR also committed to better managing player workload and welfare in the evolving women’s game.
translated_content: पेरिसः रग्बीले खेलको विश्वव्यापी पहुँच विस्तार र आम्दानी तथा अवसर बढाउनका लागि विश्वकप विस्तार र नयाँ नेशन्स लिग प्रतियोगिताको घोषणासँगै सुधारको युगमा प्रवेश गरेको छ। मंगलबार, वर्ल्ड रग्बी (डब्लुअर) ले खेलको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय तालिकामा ठूलो परिवर्तन ल्याएको घोषणा गर्‍यो, जसले उनीहरूको विश्वासमा रग्बीलाई नयाँ युगतर्फ डोर्याउनेछ। यी अपडेटहरू दीर्घकालीन समीक्षाको अन्तिम चरणका रूपमा आएको जनाइएको छ। प्रमुख परिवर्तनहरूमा पुरुषको रग्बी विश्वकपलाई २४ टोलीमा विस्तार गर्ने, कम र्याङ्क भएका देशले शीर्ष टोलीसँग प्रतिस्पर्धा गर्न पाउने गरी दुई-स्तरीय नेशन्स लिग सुरु गर्ने, र समकालीन साझा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय तालिका लागू गर्ने समावेश छ। "यदि रग्बी साँच्चिकै विश्वव्यापी खेल बन्ने हो भने, हामीले यसलाई संसारभरि झनै सान्दर्भिक र पहुँचयोग्य बनाउनु पर्छ," पेरिसमा आयोजित पत्रकार सम्मेलनमा डब्लुअर अध्यक्ष सर बिल ब्यूमोन्टले भन्नुभयो। उहाँले यी सुधारलाई व्यावसायिक युग सुरु भएयताको सबैभन्दा महत्वपूर्ण विकास भनेका छन् भने व्यापक समर्थनसँगै केही असहमति पनि रहेको स्वीकार गर्नुभयो। बहस तथा असहमतिको बाबजुद ब्यूमोन्टले परिवर्तनहरूलाई उल्लेख्य समर्थन प्राप्त भएको बताए। २०२७ मा अष्ट्रेलियामा हुने रग्बी विश्वकप अहिलेको २० बाट २४ टिममा विस्तार हुनेछ। यी टिमहरू ४-४ को ६ समूहमा विभाजन हुनेछन् र अन्तिम १६ को चरण थपिनेछ। सहभागी टिम बढे पनि प्रतियोगिता ७ हप्ताबाट घटाएर ६ हप्तामा सम्पन्न गरिनेछ। पहिलोपटक, विश्वकप ड्र जनवरी २०२६ मा हुने छ, जुन कहिल्यै यति ढिलो भएको थिएन। यसले अघिल्लो टुर्नामेन्टमा देखिएको अग्रिम र्याङ्किङका कारण असमान समूहको समस्या समाधान गर्न सहायता गर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ। ‘टियर टु’ राष्ट्रहरूको मुख्य गुनासो—नियमित र अर्थपूर्ण खेलको अभाव—अब नेशन्स लिगमार्फत सम्बोधन हुने भएको छ। २०२६ देखि सञ्चालनमा आउने यस प्रतियोगितामा १२/१२ टिमका दुई डिभिजन हुनेछन। शीर्ष डिभिजनमा सिक्स नेशन्स र रग्बी च्याम्पियनसिपका टीमहरू साथै जापान र फिजी रहनेछन्, जुन प्रत्येक दुई वर्षमा जुलाई र नोभेम्बरमा भिड्ने छन्। दोस्रो डिभिजन डब्लुअरले नै व्यवस्थापन गर्नेछ, र पदोन्नति-धरानो प्रणाली २०३० देखि लागू हुनेछ। नेशन्स लिग नभएका वर्षमा पछिल्लो समय डिभिजनका टिमहरूबीच अझ बढी अन्तरक्रिया हुने बताइएको छ। यसैगरी, २०२४ देखि क्यानडा, फिजी, जापान, सामोआ, टोंगा, र संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका सहभागी हुने गरी प्रशान्त नेशन्स कप विस्तार गरिने छ। ब्यूमोन्टले २०२६ बाट सुरु हुने ‘नयाँ रोमाञ्चक युग’मा ठूलो आश्वस्तता व्यक्त गर्दै उक्त युगमा अवसर, स्पष्टता र समावेशिता आउने उल्लेख गर्नुभयो र खेलको विकास ऐतिहासिक सीमाना बाहिर फैलिने अपेक्षा राख्नुभयो। २०२६ देखि महिलाको खेलमा पहिलो समर्पित अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय रिलीज विन्डो हुनेछ भने, विश्व तालिका तथा प्रतियोगिता संरचनामा सम्बन्धित समीक्षा जारी रहनेछ। महिला खेल खेलाडीको कामको बोझ र कल्याण अझ प्रभावकारी ढंगले व्यवस्थापन गर्न डब्लुअरले प्रतिबद्धता जनाएको छ।

article_content: Washington (CNN) -- Lyrics like “I’m just a bill. Yes, I’m only a bill. And I’m sitting here on Capitol Hill,” “Conjunction Junction, what’s your function?,” “My Hero, Zero,” and “Lolly, Lolly, Lolly get your adverbs here,” remain memorable even 40 years after their debut on ABC’s Saturday morning TV as a part of 'Schoolhouse Rock.' These animated shorts and catchy tunes were created by jazz musician Bob Dorough, who wanted to help children learn math and grammar in a fun way. Many children didn’t realize they were learning about how laws are made or the rules of grammar while watching the three-minute cartoons between shows. In 1971, New York advertising executive David McCall, struggling to teach his sons multiplication, approached Dorough. Inspired, Dorough wrote 'Three’s a Magic Number' and many other well-known songs for the series, and he also provided vocals for several episodes. At 89, Dorough continues to perform and says adults often request songs from 'Schoolhouse Rock' because they remember growing up with them and recognize his voice. “I’m not surprised at all that the videos still resonate,” Dorough told CNN. “Performing at elementary schools, I saw children recognize my voice on songs like ‘Three Is a Magic Number.’ What surprised me most, though, was how network television’s reach allowed the songs to become part of popular culture, connecting with thousands of viewers across generations.” 'Schoolhouse Rock' premiered on January 13, 1973, and aired on ABC from 1973 to 1985. The show returned in the 1990s for another five years. Today, clips have received over 30 million views on YouTube, demonstrating the lasting appeal of Dorough’s work. The series’ appeal went beyond catchy lyrics—colorful visuals made the topics accessible. One segment, for example, features a talking bill explaining to a boy how it becomes law, while ‘Conjunction Junction’ uses train cars labeled 'and,' 'but,' and 'or' to show how conjunctions connect words. Asked about the show's enduring popularity, Dorough credited 'the melodies, words, arrangements, and the musicians involved.' He said, 'Even though the songs fit into rock or pop styles, my jazz influences and talented collaborators gave them a unique sound that appealed to young viewers.' Just last week, the continued popularity of 'Schoolhouse Rock' was clear as more than a thousand fans—adults sharing childhood memories and parents introducing their kids—packed the Kennedy Center lobby to hear Dorough perform songs like 'Three’s a Magic Number' and 'Figure Eight Is Double 4.' Amy Augenblick, who attended the event with her nine-year-old daughter Elizabeth, shared, 'I came because I have such fond memories. I could sing every word without even needing lyrics.'
translated_content: वासिङ्टन (CNN) -- 'म केवल एक बिल हुँ। हो, म केवल एक बिल हुँ। अनि म क्यापिटल हिलमा बसेको छु,' 'कन्जक्सन जंक्सन, तिमीको काम के हो?,' 'माई हिरो, जिरो,' र 'लली, लली, लली, आफ्ना एड्भर्ब्स यहाँ ल्याऊ' जस्ता गीत पंक्तिहरू ४० वर्षपछि पनि स्मरणीय छन् । यी गीतहरू ABC टेलिभिजनको शनिबार बिहानको शो ‘स्कुलहाउस रक’ मा देखिएको थियो। यी एनिमेटेड छोटा भिडियो र आकर्षक गीतहरू जाज सङ्गीतकार बब डोरौले सिर्जना गरेका हुन्, जसले बच्चाहरूलाई रमाइलो शैलीमा गणित र व्याकरण सिकाउन चाहन्थे। धेरै बालबालिका तीन मिनेट लामो शो हेर्दा आफूहरू कानून कसरी बन्ने हो र व्याकरणका नियमहरू सिक्दैछौं भन्ने थाहा पनि पाउँथेन्। सन् १९७१ मा, न्यूयोर्कका विज्ञापन व्यवसायी डेविड म्याककॉल आफ्ना छोराहरूलाई गुणा गर्न सिकाउन गाह्रो परेपछि डोरौलाइ सम्पर्क गरे। त्यसपछि डोरौले 'थ्रिज अ म्याजिक नम्बर' लगायत लोकप्रिय गीतहरू लेखे र धेरै भागमा स्वर पनि दिए। ८९ वर्षका डोरौ अझ पनि सांगीतिक प्रस्तुति दिदैंछन् र भन्छन्, धेरैजसो वयस्कहरूले आफ्नो बाल्यकालको सम्झना गर्दै 'स्कुलहाउस रक' का गीत गाउन आग्रह गर्छन् अनि उनको स्वरलाई सहजै चिन्छन्। ‘भिडियोहरू अझै पनि लोकप्रिय छन् भन्नेमा म बिलकुलै अचम्मित छैन,’ डोरौले CNN सँग भने। ‘प्राथमिक विद्यालयमा प्रस्तुति गर्दा बच्चाहरूले जस्तै ‘थ्री इज अ म्याजिक नम्बर’ जस्ता गीतमा मेरो स्वर चिनेका थिए। तर मलाई सबैभन्दा अचम्मको कुरा भनेको नेटवर्क टेलिभिजनको प्रभावले यी गीतहरू संस्कृति नै बनेका थिए र हजारौं दर्शकमाझ पुगेका थिए।’ 'स्कुलहाउस रक' १९७३ जनवरी १३ मा सुरु भएर १९८५ सम्म ABC मा प्रसारण भयो। १९९० को दशकमा पाँच वर्षका लागि पुनः प्रशारण भयो। आज यी शोका क्लिपहरूले युट्युबमा ३ करोडभन्दा बढी पटक हेर्न पाइरहेका छन्, जसले डोरौको कामको दीर्घकालीन आकर्षण देखाउँछ। शृङ्खलाको लोकप्रियता आकर्षक शब्दहरू मात्र नभइ रंगीन भिजुअलका कारणले पनि थियो। एउटा एपिसोडमा एउटा बोल्ने बिलले छोरालाई बिल कसरी कानून बन्छ भनेर देखाउँछ, भने ‘कन्जक्सन जंक्सन’ ले ‘and’, ‘but’ र ‘or’ लेखिएको ट्रेन कारमार्फत् जडान शब्द कसरी काम गर्छ भन्ने देखाउँछ। शो किन लोकप्रिय रह्यो भन्ने प्रसंगमा डोरौले भने, 'धुन, शब्द, व्यवस्था र सहभागी संगीतकारका कारण।' उनले थपे, 'गीतहरू पप वा रक शैलीका भए पनि मेरो जाज
