article_content: Rabun County, Georgia, is known for its scenic beauty—rushing white-water rivers and portions of the Appalachian Trail draw visitors year-round. For years, the region was a well-kept secret until the 1972 film 'Deliverance' brought it international attention. The movie attracted tourists and boosted the local economy, but it also left a lasting, painful legacy for many residents. The film contained a disturbing rape scene and depicted the local people as uneducated and deviant 'hillbillies.' County Commissioner Stanley 'Butch' Darnell recalls, 'We were portrayed as ignorant, backward, scary, and deviant. That image stuck, even though it couldn't be further from the truth. People here are caring and lovely.' This weekend marks the film’s 40th anniversary, celebrated at the Chattooga River Festival. Warner Home Video is re-releasing 'Deliverance' on Blu-ray, including a screening at the local drive-in. The movie follows four city men who canoe the white-water rapids of the Chattooga River, which divides Georgia and South Carolina. It's famous for the 'dueling banjos' scene featuring Ronnie Cox and a local teen portrayed as inbred and mentally challenged. Ronnie Cox remarked, 'Dueling banjos was iconic, but the rape scene made it a tough pill to swallow for many. Some missed the film’s artistic essence.' But the violent scene often dominates discussions about the movie. 'We were in the Bible Belt then; the biggest thing we had was square dancing at the Mountain City Playhouse,' said Darnell. Billy Redden, who played 'Banjo Boy' and still lives in Rabun County, urges people to move on. Now 56, he was a student when filmmakers discovered him at his high school. Redden says, 'It’s just a movie. It’s not real.' Despite negative stereotypes, the Rabun County Convention and Visitor’s Bureau estimates over 250,000 tourists visit each year, eager to experience the rapids featured on screen. Larry Mashburn, owner of Southeastern Expeditions, says, 'Deliverance started the white-water rafting industry in the Southeast.' Tourism now generates $42 million annually, greatly exceeding the county’s $17 million operating budget. Today, the county boasts an 80% high school graduation rate, with average home prices above $300,000. Darnell notes, 'Tourism has funded improvements in education and services we otherwise couldn’t offer.' Rabun County’s appeal has attracted affluent homeowners, with luxury homes on Lake Burton—offering 62 miles of shoreline. Realtor Debra Butler observes, 'Once people come to Rabun County, they don’t want to leave. The film isn’t an accurate reflection of our community.' Downtown shops and art galleries now help define the county’s image. Jeanne Kronsoble’s Main Street Gallery in Clayton—open for 28 years—showcases the work of many contemporary folk artists. 'I became interested in folk art here. People who move in want art for their homes,' she says. Many credit 'Deliverance' for sparking Rabun County’s growth. Yet, decades later, some residents hope to leave its painful legacy behind. Darnell admits, 'Some here would be happy never to hear 'Deliverance' mentioned again.'
translated_content: जार्जियाको राबुन काउन्टी आफ्नो सुन्दर दृश्यहरूका लागि चर्चित छ—छिटो बग्ने सेतो पानीका नदीहरू र एपलाचियन ट्रेलको केही भागले वर्षभरि आगन्तुकहरूलाई आकर्षित गर्छ। धेरै वर्षसम्म यो क्षेत्र राम्रोसँग लुकाइएको रहस्यजस्तै थियो, तर १९७२ को फिल्म 'डेलिभरेन्स' ले यसलाई अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय चर्चा दिलाएको हो। फिल्मले पर्यटकहरू ल्यायो र स्थानीय अर्थतन्त्रमा वृद्धि गर्यो, तर दिगो र दुखद स्मृति पनि छोड्यो। फिल्ममा एउटा भयानक बलात्कार दृश्य देखाइएको छ र स्थानीय बासिन्दाहरूलाई अशिक्षित र विकृत 'हिलबिली' हिसाबले चित्रण गरिएको छ। काउन्टी कमिश्नर स्ट्यान्ली 'बच' डार्नेल सम्झन्छन्, 'हामीलाई अज्ञानी, पछाडि परेको, डर लाग्दो, अनि विकृत रूपमा देखाइयो। त्यो छवि यत्ती वर्षसम्म टाँसिइरह्यो, जबकि साँचो इससे बिल्कुल फरक छ। यहाँका मानिसहरूले माया गर्ने, असल छन्।' यो सप्ताहान्त फिल्मको ४०औं वार्षिकोत्सव चाट्टुगा रिभर फेस्टिवलमा मनाइँदैछ। वार्नर होम भिडियोले 'डेलिभरेन्स' लाई ब्लु-रेमा पुन: रिलिज गर्दैछ, जसको स्थानीय ड्राइभ-इनमा स्क्रिनिङ हुने छ। फिल्ममा चार शहरका पुरुषहरू जर्जिया र साउथ क्यारोलिनाबीचको सिमाना बनेको चाट्टुगा नदीमा क्यानोइङ गर्न आउँछन्। प्रारम्भमा रोनि कोक्स र एक स्थानीय किशोरबीचको 'ड्युएलिङ बन्जो' दृश्य प्रसिद्ध छ—जहाँ स्थानीयलाई इनब्रेड र मानसिक रूपमा चुनौतीपूर्ण देखाइएको छ। रोनि कोक्स भन्छन्, 'ड्युएलिङ बन्जो साँच्चै आइकोनिक थियो, तर बलात्कारको दृश्यले धेरैका लागि फिल्म पचाउन गाह्रो बनायो। कतिको लागि त्यो कलात्मक पक्ष छुटेको जस्तो लाग्यो।' तर त्यो हिंसात्मक दृश्य नै प्राय: फिल्मबारेका छलफलमा हावी हुन्छ। 'त्यति बेला हामी बाइबल बेल्टमा थियौं; हामीकहाँ सबैभन्दा ठूलो कुरा माउन्टेन सिटी प्लेहाउसमा स्क्वायर डान्स थियो,' डार्नेलले भने। 'बन्जो ब्वाय' को भूमिका निभाउने र अझै राबुन काउन्टीमै बस्ने बिल्ली रेड्डनले मान्छेहरूलाई यो कुराबाट अगाडि बढ्न आग्रह गर्छन्। अहिले ५६ वर्षका रेड्डन विद्यार्थी हुँदा निर्देशकहरूले उनलाई स्कुलमै भेटेका थिए। उनी भन्छन्, ‘यो त फिल्म मात्र हो। वास्तविकता होइन।’ नकारात्मक धारणा हुँदाहुँदै, राबुन काउन्टी कनभेन्सन एण्ड भिजिटरस् ब्युरोका अनुसार वर्षमा २,५०,००० भन्दा धेरै पर्यटक यहाँ आइरहन्छन्, फिल्ममा देखिएका ती वेगवती नदीहरू हेर्न। दक्षिण–पूर्वी क्षेत्रमा राफ्टिङ उद्योग सुरु गर्ने श्रेय डेलिभरेन्सलाई जान्छ, भन्छन् सेउथइस्टर्न एक्सपेडिसन्सका लरी म्यासबर्न। अहिले पर्यटनबाट वार्षिक ४२ मिलियन डलर कमाइ हुन्छ, जुन काउन्टीको १७ मिलियन डलरको बजेटभन्दा धेरै हो। आज, काउन्टीको हाईस्कुल ग्राजुएसन दर ८०% छ, र औसत घरको मूल्य ३००,००० डलरभन्दा माथि छ। डार्नेल भन्छन्, 'पर्यटनकै लागि हामीले शिक्षा र सेवामा सुधार ल्याउन सकेका हौं।' राबुन काउन्टीको आकर्षणले धनाढ्य घरधनीहरूलाई आकर्षित गरेको छ, लेक बर्टनमा बहुमूल्य घरहरू छन्, जसको तटीय क्षेत्र ६२ माइल छ। रियल इस्टेट एजेन्ट डेब्रा बटलर भन्छिन्, 'यहाँ आएका मान्छेहरू फर्किन चाहँदैनन्। फिल्म हाम्रो समुदायको साँचो रूप होइन।' अब त पसल र कला ग्यालरीहरूले काउन्टीको छवि बनाउँछन्। क्लेटनको मेन स्ट्रिट ग्यालरी २८ वर्षदेखि सञ्चालित छ, जहाँ जीन क्रोनसोब्लका अनुसार धेरै स्व-शिक्षित समकालीन लोककलाका कामहरू प्रदर्शित छन्। उनी भन्छिन्, 'यहाँका दृश्य–संस्कार देखेर नै लोककला मनपर्यो। यहाँ बसाइँ सर्नेहरूलाई घर सजाउन कला चाहिन्छ।' धेरैले मान्छन् डेलिभरेन्सले नै राबुन काउन्टीको विकास सुरु गर्यो। तर, दशकौंसम्म, केही स्थानीय बासिन्दाले त्यो पीडादायक विरासत बिर्सन चाहन्छन्। डार्नेल भन्छन्, 'यहाँका थुप्रै मानिस डेलिभरेन्सको कुरा फेरि नआओस् भन्ने चाहन्छन्।'

article_content: After holiday feasting, losing extra weight may be possible with an unusual method—ear acupuncture. Researchers at Kyung Hee University in Seoul conducted a study where 91 overweight adults followed a standard diet while being divided into groups: some received acupuncture at five specific points on their outer ears, others had needles placed at a single 'hunger point,' and a control group underwent a sham procedure. The participants who had the five-point treatment showed the most significant results, with a BMI reduction of up to 6% and a notable decrease in waist size within eight weeks. Practitioners of 'auricular acupuncture' believe points on the ear represent different body areas, an idea dating back to Dr. Paul Nogier in France in 1956. Despite the encouraging findings, skepticism persists—Professor Edzard Ernst, a complementary medicine specialist, doubts that ear acupuncture can truly cause weight loss, suggesting it may only relieve people of their money. The findings are published in the journal Acupuncture in Medicine.

article_content: Microsoft has introduced Windows Phone 8, its updated mobile operating system, aiming to better compete against Apple’s iPhone and Google’s Android. By adopting a design and interface similar to the newly launched Windows 8, Microsoft seeks to deliver a unified experience across computers, tablets, and smartphones. At the unveiling event in San Francisco, celebrity Jessica Alba joined top Microsoft executives—CEO Steve Ballmer and Corporate Vice President Joe Belfiore—to spotlight new features. A standout is 'Kid's Corner,' which lets parents limit their children’s access to approved apps and games. The updated software uses interactive live tiles that display real-time updates, offers, and photos right on the home screen. Addressing earlier criticisms of a limited app ecosystem, Microsoft announced plans to narrow the gap; while the Windows Phone Store currently boasts 120,000 apps—less than Apple’s or Google’s 700,000—the company is working to bring popular apps like Pandora and games such as 'Where’s My Water?' to the platform soon. Windows Phone 8 will power new flagship devices from Nokia, Samsung, and HTC, with eight smartphones launching globally by year’s end and arriving in the U.S. in November. Microsoft’s leadership expressed optimism that these enhancements will attract more users globally. Additionally, the platform debuts an improved Skype app capable of running in the background without draining the battery. Collaborations with major carriers worldwide include U.S. provider Verizon, which has indicated support for a competitive third mobile ecosystem alongside Apple and Google. This launch follows Microsoft’s release of Windows 8 for PCs and tablets, as well as its introduction of the Surface tablet. The company plans to highlight the consistent look and functionality across its devices in a broad new advertising campaign.

article_content: Incredible ‘Tree of 40 Fruit’ trees capable of bearing up to 40 different varieties of stone fruit are appearing across the United States. These unique trees can simultaneously produce a range of fruits such as peaches, plums, apricots, nectarines, cherries, and almonds. While they appear ordinary for most of the year, in spring they become a breathtaking patchwork of color, with each branch blossoming in its own distinctive hue. The ‘Tree of 40 Fruit’ is the work of Sam Van Aken, a sculptor and professor at Syracuse University. Inspired to change the way people think about food production, Van Aken embarked on this project in 2008 after learning that a historic New York orchard containing over 200-year-old varieties of stone fruit was set to be abandoned. To preserve the genetic heritage, he purchased the orchard and began experimenting with horticultural techniques. Van Aken uses a method called ‘chip grafting’, which involves taking a small bud from one tree and inserting it into a cut on the main tree. The grafted branch is taped in place and left to heal over the winter. Thanks to the compatibility of most stone fruit species, the resulting tree can bear multiple types of fruit on its branches. So far, Van Aken has created and placed 16 of these remarkable trees in museums, community centers, and private art collections throughout the U.S. In spring, the trees blossom in shades of pink, crimson, and white, while summer brings a harvest of diverse stone fruits. Van Aken notes that the trees offer a balanced amount and variety of fruit, with different varieties ripening between July and October, ensuring an ongoing supply rather than an overwhelming harvest. You can find Van Aken’s ‘Tree of 40 Fruit’ installations in locations such as Santa Fe, New Mexico; Short Hills, New Jersey; Louisville, Kentucky; and Pound Ridge, New York.
translated_content: अमेरिका भरि ४० विभिन्न प्रकारका फल फलाउन सक्ने अद्भुत ‘Tree of 40 Fruit’ रुखहरू फस्टाइरहेका छन्। यी अनौठा रुखहरूले एकै साथ आँप, आलुबखडा, खुबानी, स्याउदाना, चेरी र बदामजस्ता फल फलाउन सक्छन्। वर्षको अधिकांश समय यी रुखहरू सामान्य देखिन्छन्, तर वसन्त ऋतुमा तिनीहरूका हाँगाहरू आ-आफ्नै रङमा फुल्ने भएकाले अत्यन्तै आकर्षक देखिन्छन्। ‘Tree of 40 Fruit’ प्रख्यात मूर्तिकार तथा सिराक्युज विश्वविद्यालयका प्राध्यापक सैम भ्यान अखेनको सिर्जना हो। मानिसहरूले खानाका सामग्रीलाई उत्पादन गर्ने तरिकाबारे सोच बदलोस् भन्ने उद्देश्यले उनले २००८ मा न्यूयोर्कको एक ऐतिहासिक बगैँचा किनिरहेका थिए। उक्त बगैँचामा दुई सय वर्षभन्दा पुराना फलका जातहरू थिए, जुन छाडिने अवस्थामा थियो। जैविक विविधता जोगाउन उनले बगैँचा खरिद गरेर वैज्ञानिक तरिकामा प्रयोग थाले। भ्यान अखेनले ‘चिप ग्राफ्टिङ’ विधि प्रयोग गर्छन्, जहाँ अर्को रुखको सानो कली काटेर मुख्य रुखमा जोडिन्छ र टेपले बाँधेर जाडोभर छाडिन्छ। प्रायः ढुंगे फल (स्टोन फ्रुट) सँग राम्रोसँग मिल्ने भएकाले एउटै रुखमा धेरै फलका जातहरू फल्न सक्छन्। हालसम्म, भ्यान अखेनले अमेरिका भरि सङ्ग्रहालय, समुदाय केन्द्र र निजी कलासङ्ग्रहमा १६ वटा यस्ता अद्भुत रुख लगाएका छन्। वसन्तमा यी रुख गुलाबी, रातो र सेता रङमा फुल्नुका साथै गर्मीमा विभिन्न ढुंगे फलहरू फलाउँछन्। भ्यान अखेनका अनुसार फरक-फरक समयमा फल पाक्ने भएकाले वर्षभरिको अवधिमा सन्तुलित मात्रामा फल पाइन्छ। सांता फे (न्यू मेक्सिको), सर्ट हिल्स (न्यू जर्सी), लुइसभिल (केन्टकी) र पाउन्ड रिज (न्यूयोर्क)मा भ्यान अखेनका ‘Tree of 40 Fruit’ हेर्न पाइन्छ।

article_content: At the American Century Championship Pro-Am golf tournament in South Lake Tahoe, Nevada, an enthusiastic fan requested an unusual souvenir from Green Bay Packers linebacker A.J. Hawk: a tackle. Hawk, standing at 6 feet 1 inch tall and weighing 235 pounds, gladly obliged. The fan, possibly emboldened by a few drinks, pretended to receive a pass before Hawk delivered a trademark tackle, bringing him to the ground. Despite not wearing any protective gear, the fan appeared unharmed, and he and Hawk shared an embrace before Hawk resumed his round. A video of the incident quickly went viral after it was posted on the official American Century Instagram account. Hawk, a 30-year-old NFL veteran, is renowned for his tackling ability, leading or ranking second in tackles for the Packers during six of his seven seasons. This is not the first time Hawk has entertained fans with his on-field skills at a celebrity golf event. In 2012, during the Inspiring Minds Celebrity Golf Outing, a fan named Bill bid at a charity auction for the chance to be tackled into a pond by Hawk. Reflecting on the event, Hawk expressed that he wished he had wrapped Bill up more thoroughly for the tackle. The crowd at this year’s event cheered the playful tackle, further cementing Hawk’s reputation for engaging with fans in memorable ways.
translated_content: साउथ लेक टाहो, नेभादा मा भएको अमेरिकन सेन्चुरी च्याम्पियनसिप प्रो-एम गफ टूर्नामेन्टमा, एक उत्साही प्रशंसकले ग्रिन बे प्याकर्सका लाइनब्याकर ए.जे. हकसँग अनौठो सम्झना मागे—एक ट्याकल। ६ फिट १ इञ्च अग्ला र २३५ पाउन्ड तौल भएका हकले खुशीका साथ अनुरोध पूरा गरे। सम्भवतः केही जाँडले जोशमा आएका प्रशंसकले पास समात्ने नाटक गरे, अनि हकले आफ्नो विशेषता भएको ट्याकल गरेर उनलाई जमिनमा टिकाए। सुरक्षा कवच नलगाएका प्रशंसकलाई केही भएन र दुबै जनाले अँगालो मारेर हकले पुन: खेल सुरु गरे। घटनाको भिडियो अमेरिकन सेन्चुरीको आधिकारिक इन्स्टाग्राम पेजमा पोस्ट भएपछि तुरुन्त भाइरल बन्यो। ३० वर्षे एनएफएल खेलाडी हक आफ्नो ट्याकलिङ क्षमताका लागि चर्चित छन्, जसले सात सिजनमध्ये छ सिजन ग्रिन बे प्याकर्स टिममा ट्याकलिङमा अगाडि वा दोस्रो स्थान ल्याए। यो पहिलो पटक होइन जुन हकले सेलिब्रिटी गफ कार्यक्रममा प्रशंसकलाई रमाइलो गराएका हुन्। २०१२ मा इनस्पायरिङ माइन्ड्स सेलेब्रिटी गफ आउटिङमा, बिल नामका प्रशंसकले हकले पोखरीमा फ्याँक्ने मौका च्यारिटी अक्सनमा खरिद गरेका थिए। त्यो घटना सम्झिँदै हकले बिललाई अझ राम्रोसँग बलियोले समातेर ट्याकल गर्न पाए राम्रो हुन्थ्यो भनेका छन्। यस वर्ष कार्यक्रमको भिडले रमाइलो ट्याकलमा खुसी मनाए, जसले हकको प्रशंसकमैत्री छवि अझ बलियो बनाएको छ।

In a rare display of solidarity, intelligence officials from the Five Eyes alliance—comprising the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand—released a joint statement accusing China of large-scale intellectual property theft and cyber espionage. They allege that China is making use of advanced technologies, including artificial intelligence, to carry out these activities.

After meeting with Silicon Valley firms, FBI Director Christopher Wray characterized China's campaign to steal intellectual property and expertise as the 'most sustained, scaled, and sophisticated in history.' The alliance warned that China conducts cyber attacks, spying, and strategic investments to extract secrets from businesses and research institutions, with key sectors such as quantum technology, robotics, biotechnology, and artificial intelligence being especially targeted.

Wray remarked that the scope and audacity of China's operations had increased, claiming that China runs the world's largest hacking program—outpacing all other major countries combined. Mike Burgess, head of the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation, disclosed that his agency recently blocked a Chinese scheme to plant an academic inside a prominent Australian research organization to steal data. He noted that such incidents happen regularly in Australia and across the allied countries.

Burgess said while China's ambition for technological advancement is understandable, its means far exceed standard practices of espionage. The officials stressed that China is obtaining business and personal information on an unparalleled scale, and that artificial intelligence is making its hacking program even more efficient. Wray warned that AI capabilities could make these efforts even more potent.

A Chinese government spokesperson, Liu Pengyu, rejected the allegations and insisted that China is committed to protecting intellectual property rights.

अमेरिका, बेलायत, क्यानडा, अस्ट्रेलिया, र न्यूजिल्यान्ड मिलेर बनेको 'फाइभ आइज' गठबन्धनका सुरक्षा अधिकारीहरूले चीनमाथि ठूलो स्तरको बौद्धिक सम्पत्ति चोरी र साइबर जासुसी गरेको आरोप लगाउँदै दुर्लभ संयुक्त विज्ञप्ति जारी गरेका छन्। उनीहरूले चीनले यी कार्यहरूमा कृत्रिम बौद्धिकता (एआइ) सहित अत्याधुनिक प्रविधिहरू प्रयोग गरिरहेको बताएका छन्।

सिलिकन भ्यालीका प्रविधि कम्पनीहरूसँगको छलफलपछि एफबीआईका निर्देशक क्रिस्टोफर व्रेयले चीनको बौद्धिक सम्पत्ति तथा सीप चोर्ने अभियानलाई 'इतिहासकै सबैभन्दा ठूलो, लामो र जटिल' अभियान भने। गठबन्धनले चीनले साइबर आक्रमण, जासुसी र रणनीतिक लगानीमार्फत व्यापारिक र अनुसन्धान संस्थाहरूबाट गोप्य सूचना संकलन गरिरहेको उल्लेख गरेको छ, जहाँ क्वान्टम प्रविधि, रोबोटिक्स, जैवप्रविधि र एआइ मुख्य निशानामा छन्।

व्रेयले चीनका गतिविधिहरू सशक्त हुँदै गएको र संसारकै सबैभन्दा ठूलो ह्याकिङ कार्यक्रम सञ्चालन गरिरहेको दाबी गरे। अस्ट्रेलियन सुरक्षा गुप्तचर संगठनका प्रमुख माइक बर्गेसले आफ्नो निकायले हालै एक चिनियाँ योजनालाई असफल पार्न सफल भएको बताएका छन्, जसमा एक प्रतिष्ठित अस्ट्रेलियन अनुसन्धान संस्थामा चिनियाँ शैक्षिकलाई राखेर गोप्य जानकारी चोरिने योजना थियो। उनका अनुसार यस्ता प्रयासहरू अस्ट्रेलिया लगायत गठबन्धनका देशहरूमा बारम्बार भइरहेका छन्।

James Austin Johnson reprised his role as Donald Trump on Saturday Night Live, this time with Trump offering satirical critiques of his Republican rivals as they participated in the recent Republican debate. The show's cold-open sketch featured the five rivals freezing in place as Trump took the stage, parodying NBC News, the host of Wednesday's debate. With Trump leading in the polls and skipping the debates, these events have essentially become a contest for who might stand against him. 

"How adorable!" Johnson as Trump said upon arriving. "They actually think they’ve got a chance. Sad in some ways, but in other ways, funny. Can you believe it, folks? Ninety-one indictments, four trials and I am still the best choice."

The sketch began by recreating the debate opening, including NBC News graphics and Lester Holt (played by Kenan Thompson) moderating. Holt's first question was to Vivek Ramaswamy (Ego Nwodim), who responded, "I would like to begin by not answering your question and instead use this platform to say, ‘Her daughter is on TikTok.'" Nikki Haley (Heidi Gardner) shot back, "Keep my daughter’s name out of your voice!" This exchange echoed a real moment from the recent debate, where Ramaswamy referenced Haley’s daughter's TikTok use, though one actual line—Haley calling Ramaswamy “scum”—was left out of the sketch.

When Trump entered, his rivals froze on stage. "They are all stuck behind me and there is nothing they can do about it, just like in real life," Trump quipped, before referencing their poll numbers: "Three percent, eight percent, 14 percent, five percent, and poor Tim Scott—one percent. Very low. Lower than, frankly, milk."

Trump continued with characteristically blunt and joking remarks about each rival, poking fun at Ramaswamy’s personality and the casting on SNL, ribbing Ron DeSantis, and referring to Nikki Haley as "bird brain," adding, "But let’s be honest. We are not going to have a president whose name is Nikki. President Nikki. It just doesn’t sound right, probably because it’s a women’s name."

Finally, Trump joked about Chris Christie being forgettable, and wrapped up with a satirical explanation for his absence at the debates due to his legal trials: "I’m going from trial to trial. I’m basically doing House Hunters but with courtrooms." Johnson's Trump referenced his recent testimony in the New York civil fraud trial, then joked about involving his family. The sketch concluded with the Trump character joking about possibly choosing one of the rivals as his vice-president, "or maybe not at all."

जेम्स ऑस्टिन जोन्सनले फेरि सटर्डे नाइट लाइभ (SNL) मा डोनाल्ड ट्रम्पको भूमिका निर्वाह गरे। यसपटक, ट्रम्पले रिपब्लिकन बहसमा सहभागी प्रतिस्पर्धीहरूलाई व्यंग्य गर्दै आलोचना गरे। कार्यक्रमको कोल्ड-ओपन स्केचमा ट्रम्प स्टेजमा आउँदा पाँचजना प्रतिस्पर्धीहरू एकै ठाउँमा रोकिएका देखाइन्छ, जुन बुधवारको बहस आयोजना गर्ने NBC News को शैलीमाथि व्यंग्य हो। ट्रम्पले बहसमा भाग नलिएर र सर्वेक्षणमा अगाडि रहेका कारण, यी बहसहरू प्रायः ट्रम्पको विकल्प हुन सक्ने पात्रहरूबीचको प्रतिस्पर्धा जस्तो देखिन्छ।

"कति रमाइलो!" ट्रम्पको भूमिकामा जोन्सनले भने, "उनीहरूले साँच्चै सफल हुनु भन्ने सोच्छन्। अलि दुःखद तर अन्यथा हास्यास्पद पनि। सोच्नुस् त, ९१ वटा मुद्दामा आरोप, ४ ओटा मुद्दा, र म अझै पनि सबैभन्दा उपयुक्त विकल्प।"

स्केच डिबेटको सुरुवातबाट नै NBC News का ग्राफिक्ससहित देखाइन्छ, जसमा लेष्टर हल्ट (केनन थोम्पसनद्वारा अभिनित) ले मोडरेट गर्छन्। पहिलो प्रश्न विवेक रामास्वामी (इगो एन्वोडिमद्वारा अभिनित) लाई सोधिन्छ, जसको जवाफमा उनी भन्छन्, "म तपाईंको प्रश्नको उत्तर नदिइ यस प्लेटफर्मलाई प्रयोग गरी भन्न चाहन्छु: ‘उनकी छोरी टिकटकमा छिन्।’" निक्की हेली (हिडी गार्डनरद्वारा अभिनित) ले जवाफ फर्काउँछिन्, "मेरो छोरीको नाम तपाईंको आवाजमा नल्याउनुहोस्!" यो वास्तविक बहसको क्षणमा आधारित थियो, यद्यपि हेलीले रामास्वामीलाई "स्कम" भनेको लाइन स्केचमा थिएन।

ट्रम्प स्टेजमा आएपछि उनका प्रतिस्पर्धीहरू स्थिर भए। ट्रम्पले भने, "उनीहरू सबै मेरो पछाडि रोकिएका छन् र गर्न सक्ने केही छैन, वास्तविक जीवनमा झैं," अनि उनले सर्वेक्षणका अंकहरू पढे: "तीन प्रतिशत, आठ प्रतिशत, १४ प्रतिशत, पाँच प्रतिशत र बेचारा टिम स्कट — एक प्रतिशत। धेरै कम, दूधभन्दा पनि कम।"

ट्रम्पले आफ्नै गतिमा प्रतिस्पर्धीहरूको बर्णन गरे, रामास्वामीको व्यक्तित्व, SNL कास्टिङका कुरा, रोन डेसान्टिसलाई जिस्क्याउँदै, निक्की हेलीलाई "बर्ड ब्रेन" भने। अझै थपे, "ईमानदारीका साथ भन्नुपर्दा, निक्की नामको कोही राष्ट्रपति हुँदैन। राष्ट्रपति निक्की, सुहाउँदैन, शायद त्यो महिलाको नाम भएकाले।"

अन्तमा, ट्रम्पले क्रिस क्रिस्टीलाई सजिलै बिर्सन सकिने व्यक्ति भनेर मजाक गरे। उनले न्यायिक मुद्दाका कारण डिबेटमा नआएको भने: "म मुद्दाबाट मुद्दामा जाँदैछु। म Basically House Hunters गर्छु, तर कोर्टरुममा।" जोन्सनले ट्रम्पको रुपमा आफ्नो न्यूयोर्कको नागरिक ठगी मुद्दामा बयान दिएको र परिवारका सदस्यहरूलाई समेट्दै व्यंग्य गरे। स्केचको अन्त्यमा, ट्रम्प पात्रले आफूले उपराष्ट्रपति छनोट गर्ने वा नगर्ने बताएर व्यंग्यात्मक टिप्पणी गरे।

article_content: 'Our Flag Means Death' wrapped up its second season on Max with a finale that sparked intense feelings among viewers. The episode featured the shocking and emotional death of Izzy Hands, played by Con O’Neill, after being shot by Prince Ricky Banes (Errol Shand). Izzy, as Blackbeard’s (Taika Waititi) loyal first mate, had become a significant character, especially for fans who identified with his queer journey, disability, and struggles with mental health. The specifics of Izzy’s death and how he was buried—particularly the exclusion of his prosthetic leg—ignited debate about respect and authenticity in portraying marginalized groups. Many fans described experiencing genuine grief, likening their attachment to Izzy to losing a real person. Therapist Alyx Clifford emphasized that attachment to fictional characters is natural, especially for those who see aspects of themselves depicted. Some fans viewed Izzy’s story as rare, positive representation for older queer and disabled people, filling a gap left by historical tragedies like the AIDS crisis. Alex, a trans man living with chronic pain, related deeply to Izzy’s resilience. The fandom also widely interpreted Izzy as a trans allegory, with strong community support for trans headcanons. There was disappointment and frustration that Izzy’s character growth across season two—moving from isolation to acceptance—was immediately undercut by his demise. V, who deals with a degenerative leg condition, reflected on how Izzy’s arc resonated with her but ultimately repeated the trope of denying disabled characters lasting happiness. Discussions flourished online, notably on X (formerly Twitter), with disagreements over whether Izzy’s fate was narratively justified or a missed opportunity for representation. While some accepted the story’s dramatic turn, others felt that it betrayed the show’s earlier focus on inclusivity, redemption, and queer love. Artist Eden expressed sadness that a character embodying growth and joy didn’t get a deserved happy ending. The strong reactions exposed divisions within the passionate fandom, including incidents of harassment and doxxing, highlighting challenges of online community spaces. Show creator David Jenkins, who identifies as straight, acknowledged the complexities of queer storytelling and fan expectations. Some fans, like Fraxinus, were especially hurt because the series seemed to promise positive representation, only for it to be abruptly ended. Despite heated debate, the article notes that intense reactions on social media don’t necessarily reflect the views of the whole audience. Ultimately, the piece frames fandom as a lively and enduring culture, suggesting that Izzy Hands’ death has become a focal point for wider conversations about media, community, and representation.

article_content: Barack Obama delivered a strong critique of austerity measures, warning that such policies risk pushing the world economy into another downward spiral. The U.S. President partly blamed Europe for economic challenges in the U.S. and called for immediate action to address the eurozone crisis. Obama's remarks, targeting austerity approaches endorsed by leaders like David Cameron, emphasized the need for promoting economic growth and job creation alongside fiscal reforms. He stated, 'Even as European countries with large debt burdens implement necessary reforms, they also need to foster growth and employment. It's much harder to reduce deficits and debt if the economy isn't growing.' Britain has entered a double-dip recession, with Chancellor George Osborne indicating public spending cuts would extend two years beyond the 2015 general election. The Treasury maintains that sticking to austerity plans is necessary to prevent rising government debt costs, which could increase mortgage rates. Obama warned that austerity becomes problematic when governments prioritize spending cuts while economic recovery remains fragile, leading to public sector layoffs and further reductions in demand. He explained that such simultaneous cutbacks—along with weakened consumer spending—could create a downward spiral, reducing business' desire to hire and risking a pattern that could entrench Europe's economic problems. The President noted a positive shift in European debate toward growth, specifically praising German Chancellor Angela Merkel and French President Francois Hollande for their efforts to establish a growth agenda alongside responsible fiscal planning. He did not extend similar praise to David Cameron. Expressing concern that Europe's downturn could harm U.S. businesses—since Europe is America's largest trading partner—Obama stressed the direct impact overseas demand has on American cities. 'Less demand in places like Paris and Madrid could mean less business in Pittsburgh and Milwaukee,' he said. Obama urged European leaders to take immediate, concrete steps such as injecting capital into weak banks, as Spain was expected to request a new eurozone bailout for its banking sector. A Brussels meeting was to discuss a potential £80billion deal, likely using eurozone bailout funds and excluding British taxpayer contributions. An agreement was anticipated in late June following audits of Spanish banks. Meanwhile, Cyprus's second-largest bank warned it would also require a bailout due to heavy exposure to Greek debt. Obama also cautioned that Greeks could face further hardship if their country were to leave the euro.

अहिले दोहोरो मन्दीमा छ, जहाँ चान्सलर जर्ज ओसबोर्नले २०१५ को सामान्य चुनावपछि दुई वर्षसम्म अझै खर्च कटौती हुने बताएका छन्। ट्रेजरीले भने कर्जा लागत बढ्न नदिन खर्च कटौतीमा अडिग रहनु उचित भएको बताएको छ, उपभोक्ताको खर्च घट्ने जस्ता समस्याले अर्थतन्त्र ओरालो लाग्न सक्छ। यसले कामदार नियुक्त गर्ने व्यवसायको इच्छा पनि घटाउँछ र यो युरोपले सामना गर्न सक्ने विशिष्ट समस्या हो। राष्ट्रपति ओबामाले युरोपमा बजार हो। 'पेरिस या म्याड्रिडमा अमेरिकी वस्तुको माग कम हुँदा, पिट्सबर्ग वा मिल्वाकीमा व्यवसाय घट्न सक्छ,' उनले भने। ओबामाले युरोपेली नेताहरूलाई कमजोर बैंकहरूमा पूंजी लगानी जस्ता ठोस कदम तुरुन्त चाल्न बैंकहरूको अवस्था हेर्ने अडिटपछि जूनको अन्त्यतिर सम्झौता हुने अपेक्षामा छ। यसैबीच, साइप्रसको दोस्रो ठूलो बैंकले ग्रीसको ऋणका कारण आफूमाथि संकट परेको भन्दै बेलआउटको आवश्यकता पर्ने संकेत गरेको छ। ग्रीस article_content: John Terry achieved a major career milestone by making his 100th Champions League appearance for Chelsea. In the match, the Chelsea captain attempted an audacious free kick from long range, but the shot went wide. Terry’s Champions League journey began in 2003, when, at 22 years old, he played against MSK Zilina with teammates Marcel Desailly, Glen Johnson, and Wayne Bridge. Chelsea faced a challenging atmosphere at Sporting Lisbon's Estadio Jose Alvalade, just as manager Jose Mourinho had warned. Sporting fans filled the stadium with relentless chants and loud whistling, especially reacting to decisions by Spanish referee Antonio Mateu Lahoz in the first half. Emotions intensified among the home crowd when former Benfica midfielder Nemanja Matic scored, giving Chelsea a 1-0 win over Sporting Lisbon. William Carvalho, Sporting’s midfielder who was linked with Arsenal during the last transfer window, demonstrated strong defensive skills and physical presence, though questions remain about his speed and high valuation. Such qualities, however, would be assets to any team. On the other hand, Chelsea’s Andre Schurrle continued his run of poor finishing. He missed key chances during the match, following recent struggles in front of goal. Manager Mourinho has advised Schurrle to improve his composure, advice he has yet to implement fully.

article_content: Key sugar stocks in India moved in different directions on Wednesday morning. Rajshree Sugars & Chemicals led the gains with almost a 5% increase, with BAJAJHIND, DCM Shriram Industries, MAGADHSUGAR, and others also rising between 0.6% and 3%. At the same time, Simbhaoli Sugars stood out with a decline of over 5%, while Kothari Sugars & Chemicals, Uttam Sugar Mills, and a few others posted smaller losses. The broader market started positively, with the NSE Nifty50 up by nearly 43 points at 19,449.5 and the BSE Sensex climbing over 83 points to 65,025.66 as of 10:04 AM. In the Nifty index, Bharat Petroleum, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, and Adani Ports were among the top gainers, each rising more than 1%. In contrast, financial stocks like ICICI Bank and Bajaj Finance slipped slightly. Meanwhile, India's packaged consumer goods market grew 9% in value and 8.6% in volume during the September quarter from a year earlier—driven in large part by increased rural consumption, according to NielsenIQ. Snap Inc., the company behind Snapchat, saw its user base in India reach 200 million, doubling from the previous year, thanks partly to the rollout of features such as Spotlight. article_content: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced new measures to address the risks associated with the rapid growth of consumer credit, particularly targeting banks and non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs). Fitch Ratings provided insights on the likely impact of these regulatory adjustments. The main change requires both banks and NBFIs to allocate more capital to cover unsecured consumer credit, like credit cards and personal loans. Fitch Ratings views these rules as a positive step to control emerging risks in consumer lending. The sharp rise in unsecured credit card loans (29.9%) and personal loans (25.5%) by banks in the first half of the financial year ending March 2024 triggered concerns about potential risks, leading to these preventive measures. Increased lending to unsecured consumer credit, considered riskier, suggests banks and NBFIs are becoming more willing to take on risk, partly to protect their profit margins while facing stiff competition for safer, secured loans. The new rules increase risk weightings on unsecured lending for both banks and NBFIs. For NBFIs, risk weights for credit-card lending rise to 125% (up from 100%). For banks, it remains at the higher rate of 150%. Microfinance loans are exempt for NBFIs. Fitch estimates these measures could reduce the banking system's common equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio by about 30 basis points. For Fitch-rated banks, the impact could range from 6 to 34 basis points, with private banks like State Bank of India (SBI) and Canara Bank facing double-digit impacts. However, these private banks are expected to continue maintaining reasonable capitalization. Overall, while capital scores and Viability Ratings should not see major changes, SBI’s score may become more tightly constrained. Fitch-rated NBFIs such as Shriram Finance Limited, Muthoot Finance Ltd, IIFL Finance Limited, and Manappuram Finance Limited will likely see some impact on their capital ratios, loan growth, and asset quality, but the general effect is expected to be manageable and will lower systemic risk. NBFIs are projected to face an increase of 40 to 60 basis points in bank funding costs, assuming banks pass along new capital costs. Larger NBFIs may be able to negotiate better rates, while smaller, lower-rated ones could face bigger increases. Loans to housing finance companies and NBFIs qualifying for priority sector status will be excluded from the new risk weightings, benefiting entities with such exposure like Shriram. These regulatory changes are meant to balance consumer credit growth with financial system stability. The phased rollout emphasizes the regulator’s commitment to adapting while ensuring resilience. Stakeholders are closely watching the effects on lending practices, risk management, and the broader economy.
translated_content: भारतको केन्द्रीय बैंक रिजर्भ बैंक अफ इन्डिया (RBI) ले उपभोक्ता क्रेडिटको तीव्र वृद्धि कारण आउने जोखिमलाई नियन्त्रण गर्न बैंक र गैर-बैंक वित्तीय संस्थाहरू (NBFIs) प्रति नयाँ नियमहरू लागू गरेको छ। फिच रेटिङ्सले यी नियमहरूको प्रभावबारे धारणा प्रस्तुत गरेको छ। मुख्य परिवर्तनअनुसार बैंक र NBFIs लाई अनसिक्योर्ड उपभोक्ता क्रेडिट (जस्तै क्रेडिट कार्ड र पर्सनल लोन) मा बढी पूँजी राख्नुपर्नेछ। फिच रेटिङ्सले यी नियमलाई जोखिम नियन्त्रण गर्न सकारात्मक कदमका रूपमा देखेको छ। वित्तीय वर्ष २०२४ को पहिलो छ महिनामा बैंकबाट अनसिक्योर्ड क्रेडिट कार्ड ऋण २९.९% र पर्सनल लोन २५.५% ले बढेको थियो, जसले जोखिम चिन्ताहरू बढाएको छ र यो कारणले रोकथामका उपाय ल्याइएको हो। अनसिक्योर्ड उपभोक्ता क्रेडिटमा ऋण प्रवाह बढ्नुले बैंक तथा NBFIs मा जोखिम लिने प्रवृत्ति देखिन्छ, जुन प्रतिस्पर्धी साधारण ऋणमा नाफा जोगाउन खोज्ने स्थितिसँग जोडिन्छ। नयाँ नियमले अनसिक्योर्ड ऋणमा जोखिम भार बढाइएको छ। NBFIs का लागि क्रेडिट कार्ड ऋणमा जोखिम भार १००% बाट १२५% पुगेको छ, बैंकमा भने यो १५०% मा कायम छ। NBFIs का लागि माइक्रोफाइनान्स छुट छ। फिचको अनुमान अनुसार, यी नियमले बैंकिङ प्रणालीको सामान्य इक्विटी टियर १ (CET1) अनुपात ३० आधार बिन्दुले घटाउन सक्छ। फिच रेटिङ भएका बैंकमा यो असर ६ देखि ३४ आधार बिन्दु मार्फत देखिन सक्छ, SBI तथा क्यानरा बैंक जस्ता निजी बैंकमा बढी असर हुने अपेक्षा। तर यी निजी बैंकहरूले पूँजीकरणको राम्रो स्तर राख्ने अनुमान छ। पूँजी स्कोर वा ‘Viability Ratings’ मा ठूलो असर नपर्ने देखिन्छ, यद्यपि SBI को क्षमता केही सीमित हुनसक्छ। फिच रेटिङ भएका NBFIs (श्रीराम फाइनान्स, मुथुट फाइनान्स, IIFL फाइनान्स, मनप्पुरम फाइनान्स) मा पूँजी अनुपात, ऋण वृद्धिदर र सम्पत्ति गुणवत्तिमा केही सिमित असर देखिनेछ, जसले प्रणालीगत जोखिम कम गर्नेछ। NBFIs को लागि बैंक फन्डिङ लागत ४० देखि ६० आधार बिन्दु बढ्न सक्छ, यदि बैंकहरूले नयाँ पूँजी लागत स्थानान्तरण गरे भने। ठूला NBFIs ले राम्रो सर्तमा सम्झौता गर्न सक्छन्, तर साना/कम रेटिङ भएका संस्थाले बढी लागत सामना गर्न सक्छन्। हाउसिङ फाइनान्स कम्पनी र प्राथमिक क्षेत्रका लागि योग्य NBFIs को ऋण नयाँ जोखिम भारमा समावेश हुनेछैन, जसका कारण श्रीराम जस्ता संस्थाले फाइदा उठाउनेछन्। यी कायदाहरू उपभोक्ता क्रेडिट वृद्धिलाई वित्तीय स्थिरतासँग सन्तुलन गर्न ल्याइएको हो। नियमहरूलाई चरणबद्ध रूपमा लागू गरिँदैछ, र असरहरूमा ऋण प्रवाह, जोखिम नियन्त्रण, तथा अर्थतन्त्रमा के असर देखिन्छ भन्ने सरोकारवालाहरू दृष्टिक्षेपमा राखिरहेका छन्।

article_content: Chelsea Women's Head Coach Emma Hayes will leave the club at the end of the 2023/2024 season, as confirmed by the club after their recent 6-0 win over Aston Villa in the Women’s Super League. The statement clarified Hayes will pursue a new opportunity outside of English club football. Multiple reliable sources, including The Philadelphia Inquirer and The Athletic, report Hayes is in advanced negotiations to become the next manager of the U.S. Women's National Team (USWNT). If agreed, she will become the highest-paid manager in women's football. Hayes previously received the FIFA Best Football Coach award in 2021. Chelsea expressed gratitude for Hayes’ significant contribution over more than a decade, stating they will not stand in her way. The club also confirmed Hayes will complete the current season exclusively. The Women's Super League concludes on May 18, 2024, and if Chelsea makes the UEFA Women's Champions League final, Hayes' tenure would extend to the end of May. If Hayes is officially appointed by U.S. Soccer, she will have around two months to prepare the USWNT for the start of the 2024 Paris Olympics, which begin July 25. She will be able to work with the team during FIFA international breaks: one starting May 27 and another from July 8 to July 16. Following Vlatko Andonovski’s departure after the USWNT's Round-of-16 exit from the FIFA Women's World Cup, Twila Kilgore has served as interim head coach. There is speculation whether Kilgore will remain in this role until Hayes becomes available. During Hayes’ time at Chelsea, she has played a pivotal role in the club’s success and in advancing women's football, aiming to finish her final season by winning as many titles as possible, with particular focus on the Women's Champions League trophy.
translated_content: चेल्सी महिला टिमकी प्रमुख प्रशिक्षक एम्मा हायज २०२३/२०२४ सिजनको अन्त्यमा क्लब छोड्ने भएकी छिन्, क्लबले एस्ट्रोन भिल्लामा ६-० को जितपछि यो घोषणा गरेको हो। बयानअनुसार हायज अब इंग्ल्यान्डको क्लब फुटबल बाहिर नयाँ अवसरको खोजीमा छिन्। विश्वसनीय स्रोतहरू ‘द फिलाडेल्फिया इन्क्वायरर’ र ‘द एथलेटिक’ अनुसार हायज अमेरिकी महिला राष्ट्रिय टोली (USWNT) को नयाँ प्रशिक्षकका लागि उन्नत वार्तामा छिन्। बमोजिम सहमति भएमा, उनी महिला फुटबलको इतिहासमै सबैभन्दा बढी पारिश्रमिक पाउने प्रशिक्षक बन्नेछिन्। हायजले २०२१ मा फिफा बेस्ट फुटबल कोच अवार्ड जितेकी थिइन्। चेल्सीले दशकभन्दा बढी समय क्लबमा दिएको योगदानका लागि हायजलाई धन्यवाद दिँदै उनको बाटो छोड्ने निर्णय गरेको छ। क्लबले हायजले यो सिजन कीर्तिमानी रूपमा क्लबमै रहने जनाएको छ। महिला सुपर लिग १८ मे २०२४ मा सकिन्छ, र यदि चेल्सी युएफा महिला च्याम्पियन्स लिग फाइनलमा पुग्छ भने, हायजको कार्यकाल मेको अन्त्यसम्म लम्बिनेछ। यदि अमेरिकी फुटबल महासंघले हायजलाई औपचारिक रूपमा नियुक्त गर्‍यो भने, उनलाई २०२४ पेरिस ओलम्पिक सुरु हुनु अघि अनुमानित दुई महिना टिम तयार पार्न समय हुनेछ, जहाँ महिला फुटबल प्रतियोगिता जुलाई २५ देखि सुरु हुन्छ। उनले मे २७ बाट सुरु हुने पहिलो फिफा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय ब्रेक र जुलाई ८ देखि १६ सम्म चल्ने दोस्रो ब्रेकमा टिमसँग काम गर्न पाउनेछिन्। फिफा महिला विश्वकपमा USWNT को राउन्ड-अफ-१६ बाट बाहिरिएपछि भ्लात्को एन्डोनोव्स्कीले राजीनामा दिएका थिए र त्यसपछि ट्विला किलगोरलाई अन्तरिम प्रमुख प्रशिक्षक बनाइएको हो। हायज उपलब्ध नभएसम्म किलगोरले उक्त पदमा रहने अनुमान गरिएको छ। चेल्सीमा हायजले क्लबको सफलतामा र महिला फुटबलको प्रगतिमा उल्लेखनीय भूमिका खेलेकी छिन्। उनले अन्तिम सिजनमा धेरै उपाधि जित्ने, विशेषतः महिला च्याम्पियन्स लिग जित्ने लक्ष्य राखेकी छिन्।

article_content: Prime Minister David Cameron cut short his holiday and returned from Cornwall to lead emergency security meetings after the murder of American journalist James Foley by an alleged British member of the Islamic State. Cameron personally viewed the disturbing video to grasp the scale of the threat, and intelligence officials informed him about the ongoing investigation. The suspect reportedly spoke with a British accent, making the search for his identity a top priority, though officials admit finding him in a conflict area will be difficult. Cameron spent the night at Downing Street and has not confirmed when, or if, he will resume his vacation, while debates continue over whether Parliament should be recalled. Downing Street currently rules out recalling Parliament, despite calls from MPs. Cameron stressed that the government won't act hastily, but is exploring options for stronger anti-terrorism laws. So far this year, the government has confiscated 23 passports to stop people from joining conflicts abroad, stripped seven dual nationals of UK citizenship, and made 69 arrests linked to Syria and Iraq. Police forces have new instructions to crack down on anyone promoting or supporting Islamic State within the UK. Foreign Secretary Philip Hammond has raised the possibility of sending British troops to Baghdad for training missions, increasing aerial surveillance, and providing weapons to Kurdish fighters, following similar moves by Germany. Hammond also pointed out that while Islamic State is a common adversary with the Syrian regime of Bashar al-Assad, Britain will not cooperate directly with Assad. Several members of Parliament have argued for an urgent recall to debate the situation, criticizing the government for lacking a clear and decisive strategy. Cameron maintained that Britain will not send combat forces to Iraq, but will work with allies, back the new Iraqi administration, and help the Kurds resist Islamic State fighters.
translated_content: अमेरिकी पत्रकार जेम्स फोलीको इस्लामिक स्टेटका एक बेलायती सदस्यद्वारा हत्या भएपछि प्रधानमन्त्री डेभिड क्यामरुनले आफ्नो बिदा छोट्याएर कोर्नवालबाट फर्केर आपतकालीन सुरक्षा बैठकको नेतृत्व गरे। क्यामरुनले खतराको अवस्था बुझ्न व्यक्तिगत रूपमा उक्त डरलाग्दो भिडियो हेरे र खुफिया अधिकारीहरूसँग अनुसन्धानबारे जानकारी लिए। हत्यारा बेलायती उच्चारणमा बोलेको हुनाले उनको पहिचान खोज्न प्रमुख प्राथमिकता दिइएको छ, तर युद्ध क्षेत्रमा फेला पार्न गाह्रो हुने सरकारी धारणा छ। क्यामरुनले डाउनिङ स्ट्रिटमा रात बिताए र बिदा पुन: कहिले जारी गर्ने भन्ने अनिश्चित छ। संसद् बोलाउनेबारे बहस भइरहे पनि अहिलेका लागि डाउनिङ स्ट्रिटले त्यो सम्भावना अस्वीकार गरेको छ। क्यामरुनले सरकार छिटोमा जल्दबाज प्रतिक्रिया नदिने भए पनि अझ कडा आतंकवाद विरोधी कानुन ल्याउने विकल्प खोजिरहेको बताएका छन्। यस वर्ष सरकारले २३ वटा राहदानी खोसेर मानिसहरूलाई युद्ध क्षेत्रमा जानबाट रोकेको छ, सात जना दोहोरो नागरिकताका व्यक्तिहरूको बेलायती नागरिकता खोसिएको छ, र सिरिया तथा इराकसँग सम्बन्धित गतिविधिमा ६९ जना पक्राउ परेका छन्। आतंकवादी संगठनको प्रचार र सहयोगमा संलग्न सबैलाई कडाइका साथ कारबाही गर्न प्रहरीलाई नयाँ निर्देशन दिइएको छ। विदेश सचिव फिलिप ह्यामन्डले बेलायती सैनिकलाई तालिमका लागि बगदाद पठाउने, निगरानी उडान बढाउने, र आवश्यकता परे जर्मनीको पछिपछि कुर्द लडाकुलाई हतियार सहयोगको विषय उठाएका छन्। ह्यामन्डले इस्लामिक स्टेट साझा शत्रु भएपनि बेलायतले सिरियाली राष्ट्रपति असदसँग सिधा सहकार्य नगर्ने बताए। धेरै सांसदहरूले अहिलेको गम्भीर अवस्थाबारे छलफल गर्न संसद् बोलाउन माग गरेका छन् र सरकारको रणनीति प्रस्ट नभएको भन्दै आलोचना गरेका छन्। क्यामरुनले बेलायतले इराकमा लडाकू सेना नपठाउने र मित्रराष्ट्रहरूसँग सहकार्य गर्दै नयाँ इराक सरकार तथा कुर्द लडाकुहरुलाई सहयोग गर्ने बताएका छन्।

article_content: The New York Times Company has announced that Mark Thompson will proceed as CEO starting today, despite ongoing controversy stemming from his previous role as director-general of the BBC. The decision comes in the midst of an intensifying scandal at the BBC, where Thompson's successor, George Entwistle, resigned after a Newsnight program aired false allegations against a former senior British politician regarding child sexual abuse at a care home. Entwistle accepted responsibility for the editorial errors that led to the incident. Questions have also been raised about the BBC's decision, under Thompson's leadership, to shelve an investigation by Newsnight into child sexual abuse allegations against the late presenter Jimmy Savile. Thompson has stated that he was unaware of the details of the Newsnight investigation into Savile and was not involved in the decision to cancel the report. The BBC is currently under police and internal investigation following claims that hundreds, some as young as 12, were abused by Jimmy Savile over several decades. Amid the crisis, several senior BBC staff, including news director Helen Boaden and deputy Stephen Mitchell, have temporarily stepped aside, following Newsnight editor Peter Rippon, who stepped aside the previous month. The New York Times has maintained its confidence in Mark Thompson's ability to lead the company. Following the Newsnight report that wrongfully implicated Lord McAlpine in child abuse, McAlpine has denied all involvement and announced intentions to pursue legal action against those responsible for the false allegations. Meanwhile, Metropolitan Police are conducting a national investigation into Savile's activities. Several individuals, including former pop star Gary Glitter and comedian Freddie Starr, have been arrested and deny the allegations. The crisis has led to increased scrutiny of BBC leadership, with BBC Trust chairman Lord Patten reportedly aware of Newsnight's plans prior to the airing of the false report. Despite these controversies, Mark Thompson officially starts as CEO of The New York Times today.

article_content: Ron Ingraham, a 67-year-old fisherman, survived for 12 days adrift off the coast of Hawaii and is set to reunite with his son, Zakary, after losing contact with him two decades ago. Ingraham was found weak, dehydrated, and hungry but otherwise in good condition after surviving by eating raw fish when his boat was blown off course on Thanksgiving Day. A US Navy destroyer, the USS Paul Hamilton, located him 64 miles from shore—nine days after the Coast Guard had called off the search, which had covered 12,000 square miles of ocean. Commander John Barsano welcomed Ingraham aboard the USS Paul Hamilton. This challenging experience created an unexpected opportunity for Ingraham to reconnect with his son, who hadn't spoken to him since the 1990s. Zakary Ingraham, who now lives in St. Joseph, Missouri, is trying to travel to Hawaii to see his father, who arrived on Molokai island on Wednesday. Zakary learned of his father’s disappearance when the Coast Guard contacted him as next of kin to say the search had been suspended. Ingraham’s damaged sailboat, the Malia, was towed back to Kaunakakai port by a Coast Guard cutter. Zakary, 43 and a student, said it was hard to accept the news and felt helpless, being far away in Missouri. He never fully lost hope because he knew his father was tough. He eventually received the news that his father had been found alive after a nine-day gap. The rescue took place after crew from the USS Paul Hamilton responded to a short mayday call from Ingraham. His friends and family had already planned a funeral before learning of his survival. Zakary said at first the news didn’t register, and when he heard his father was alive, he was overwhelmed with happiness. During the time Ingraham was missing, Zakary tried to find out more about his father’s whereabouts and spoke to another fisherman, who said Ingraham had been headed for Lanai to sell his catch. Reuniting had always been important for Zakary, but difficulties arose because Ingraham did not have a cell phone or access to social media. Ingraham’s ordeal began when a rogue wave destroyed his radio and knocked him into the sea. He told ABC News that eating raw fish kept him hydrated and alive. After sending an eight-second distress call on Tuesday morning, he was rescued by Navy personnel, though he was hungry and dehydrated. A Coast Guard cutter towed the damaged 25-foot Malia back to Kaunakakai. Once on land, Ingraham celebrated with his friend Dedric Manaba and was described by Manaba’s wife as looking well despite the ordeal. He quietly thanked and hugged everyone on shore. US Coast Guard spokesman Lt. Scott Carr said it was a difficult decision to suspend the search but they are pleased Ingraham was found. The search had included 59 sorties by helicopter and aircraft covering a wide area. Ingraham's journey from Kaunakakai Harbor to Manele Bay on Lanai, which should have kept him near land, instead saw him blown far off course and sending two distress calls. Weather and equipment failure affected the search effort. On December 1, the Coast Guard called off the search after days of futile efforts, but nine days later, Ingraham managed to send another mayday signal, this time picked up 64 miles south of Oahu, prompting the USS Paul Hamilton to rescue him. Both masts of his sailboat were broken and the outboard motor was damaged. He was trying to sail back using a small auxiliary sail. Zakary had tried to prepare himself for the worst but remained hopeful. The planned funeral was turned into a celebratory event to welcome Ingraham’s return. Chris Connor, a friend, said they would now celebrate instead of mourn. The rescue by the Navy happened after they received the distress call only 14 miles away from the Malia.
translated_content: ६७ वर्षका माछा समात्ने पेशा गर्ने व्यक्ति, रोन् इन्ग्राहम, हवाईको तटबाट बाहिर १२ दिनसम्म पानीमा बहिरहेपछि बाँच्न सफल भए र दुई दशकपछि आफ्नो छोरा जाकारीसँग भेट्ने तयारीमा छन्। इन्ग्राहम दुर्बल, पानी नपिएको र भोकै थिए, तर कच्चा माछा खाएर Thanksgiving मा आफ्नो डुंगा मार्गबाट बाहिरिएपछि जिवितै रहेका थिए। अमेरिकी नेभी डेस्ट्रोयर USS Paul Hamilton ले उनलाई तटबाट ६४ माइल बाहिर भेट्यो — तटरक्षक बलले १२,००० वर्गमाइल समुद्रमा खोजी बन्द गरेको नौ दिनपछि। कमाण्डर जोन बार्सानोले USS Paul Hamilton मा इन्ग्राहमलाई स्वागत गरे। यो कठिन समयले इन्ग्राहम र उनका छोरा, जससँग १९९० को दशकदेखि सम्पर्क थिएन, पुन: जडानको अवसर दिएको छ। हाल मिसौरीको सेंट जोसेफमा बस्ने जाकारी इन्ग्राहम हवाई पुग्न प्रयासरत छन्, जहाँ उनका पिता बुधबार मोलोकाई टापुमा आइपुगेका छन्। जाकारीले तटरक्षक बलले खोजी बन्द गरेको खबर आफैलाई सम्पर्क गरी दिँदा आफ्ना बुबाको हराइको थाहा पाए। बिग्रिएको 'मालिया' डुंगा तटरक्षक बलले कट्टरबाट काउनाकाकाई बन्दरगाहमा ल्याएको थियो। ४३ वर्षीय विद्यार्थी जाकारीका अनुसार ठूलो दुख थियो र टाढा मिसौरीमा हुँदा केही गर्न नसक्दा असहाय महसुस गरेका थिए। तर उनले बुबा मजबुत रहेको थाहा भएकाले आशा गुमाएनन्। अन्तमा, नौ दिनपछि बुबा जीवित भेटिएको खबर पाए। USS Paul Hamilton का चालक दलले इन्ग्राहमको छोटो मेडे कल पाएपछि उद्धार गरे। उनका साथी र परिवारजनले उनको मृत्युका लागि पुजा तयारी गरेका थिए। जाकारीका अनुसार सुरूमै खबर बुझिनन् तर बुबा जीवित छन् भन्ने थाहा पाएपछि अत्यन्त खुसी लाग्यो। हराइरहेको बेला जाकारीले अर्का माछा समात्ने साथीमार्फत बुबा कहाँ हुन सक्नुहुन्छ भनी खोजे; साथीले इन्ग्राहम लनाइ टापुमा माछा बेच्न गएका हुन् भनेका थिए। जाकारी सधैं बुबासँग भेट्न चाहन्थे तर बुबासँग मोबाइल वा सामाजिक सञ्जाल नभएकाले गाह्रो परेको थियो। इन्ग्राहमको समस्या तब सुरु भयो जब एउटा ठूलो छालले उनको रेडियो बिगारिदियो र उनलाई समुद्रमा फ्याँक्यो। उनले एबीसी न्यूजलाई कच्चा माछा खाएर बाँचेको बताए। मंगलबार बिहान आठ सेकेन्डको डिस्ट्रेस कल पठाएपछि अमेरिकी नेभीले उनको उद्धार गर्यो, त्यतिबेला उनी भोकै र तिर्खाएको थिए। एक तटरक्षक कट्टरले बिग्रिएको २५ फिट लामो मालिया डुंगालाई काउनाकाकाईमा ल्यायो। भूमिमा पुगेर इन्ग्राहमले साथी डेड्रिक मानाबासँग खुसी मनाए र मानाबाकी श्रीमतीका अनुसार यस्तो ठूलो दुःख भोगे पनि उनी ठीक देखिन्थे। शान्तिपूर्वक सबैलाई धन्यवाद दिएर अंगालो हाल्दै हिँडे। तटरक्षकका प्रवक्ता लेफ्टिनेन्ट स्कट करले खोजी बन्द गर्न गाह्रो निर्णय भएको तर इन्ग्राहम भेटिनुमा खुसी व्यक्त गरे। खोजीमा ५९ हेलिकप्टर तथा बिमान मार्फत मिसन गरिएको थियो। काउनाकाकाइ हार्बरबाट लनाईको मानेले बे गइरहेका इन्ग्राहमलाई मौसम र उपकरण बिग्रिएपछि समुद्रमा धेरै टाढा पुर्‍यायो। डिसेम्बर १ मा तटरक्षकले खोजी बन्द ग¥यो, तर नवौं दिन इन्ग्राहमले अर्को मेडे सिग्नल पठाउन सके। यो सिग्नल ओहूको ६४ माइल दक्षिणमा भेटियो र USS Paul Hamilton ले उद्धार गर्यो। डुंगा दुवै मास्ट भाँचिएका र मोटर बिग्रिएका कारण सानो सहायक पालबाट भूमि फर्कन प्रयासरत थिए। जाकारीले सबैभन्दा खराब तयारी गरे तापनि आशावादी थिए। पूर्वनियोजित श्रद्धाञ्जली कार्यक्रमलाई अब स्वागत समारोहमा रूपान्तरण गरियो। साथी क्रिस कोनरका अनुसार अब उनीहरू शोक होइन, रमाइलो गर्दैछन्। नेभीले डिस्ट्रेस कल पाएर मात्र १४ माइल परै पुगेर उद्धार गर्यो।

article_content: Following their successful first official royal tour across Canada and California, the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge (Prince William and Kate) chose to fly back to the UK on a standard British Airways commercial flight, foregoing a private jet. They departed from Los Angeles International Airport accompanied by a police escort and were welcomed by airline staff on a sunny runway. Throughout their tour, the couple participated in diverse activities ranging from informal community events that highlighted their strong partnership to formal occasions where Prince William’s diplomatic abilities stood out. Highlights included participating in a dragon boat race and street hockey game in Canada, along with William skillfully landing a Sea King helicopter on water. Their last official engagement in the US took place at Sony Studios, attending a jobs fair for the Service Nation: Mission Serve program, which helps military veterans transition into civilian employment. Prince William expressed gratitude for the warm reception in California and acknowledged the importance of such initiatives, mentioning their relevance in the UK. He and Kate joined in assembling care packages for children with parents deployed overseas. The royal couple also supported charitable efforts, visiting the Tusk Trust and networking with organizational leaders, donors, and prominent Hollywood figures like Nicole Kidman, Tom Hanks, Jennifer Lopez, Reece Witherspoon, and author Kristin Gore. As patron of the Tusk Trust, William helped launch a new US supporters’ circle. Their appearances at high-profile events captured the attention of the public and media alike. Prior to returning home, William and Kate greeted fans outside their Los Angeles residence, posing for photos and conversing with well-wishers. Though American crowds were smaller compared to those in Canada, the couple consistently received a positive reception. In his remarks, Prince William blended thoughtful appreciation with humor, including lighthearted references to his brother, Prince Harry. article_content: Apple routinely introduces upgraded iPhones each year, and this time the standard iPhone 15 receives significant camera enhancements. Most notably, the main camera jumps to 48MP—a major upgrade from the iPhone 14’s 12MP sensor. The iPhone 15 brings some Pro-level features, including Dynamic Island and USB-C, although it doesn’t offer all the advanced tools found in the Pro line. For its cameras, the iPhone 15 features a 48MP main camera (f/1.6 aperture), paired with a 12MP ultrawide lens (f/2.4), much like the iPhone 14's 12MP/12MP setup (f/1.5 and f/2.4). However, the iPhone 15 provides additional optical zoom options: 0.5x, 1x, and 2x. Both phones use a 12MP f/1.9 front-facing camera. With the iPhone 15, standard photos from the main camera are saved at 24MP, offering a boost in detail over the iPhone 14’s 12MP files. In practice, photo comparisons at Disney theme parks demonstrate brighter colors and sharper textures in various lighting situations, particularly with complex scenes like the Lego Store or decorated landmarks. Close inspections and zoomed-in views highlight where the iPhone 15 stands out—image details remain crisp, especially in finer elements like signage and garlands, whereas the iPhone 14 images can appear softer. Scenes with abundant natural light, such as waterfalls or Christmas displays, look warmer and more detailed on the newer device. Ultrawide shots are largely similar, as lens specs haven’t changed. Still, the iPhone 15 often reproduces more realistic colors and better manages shadows, improving visibility in backgrounds and skies. Both cameras can, however, deal with lens flare challenges in bright sunlight. Portrait photography benefits from the iPhone 15’s Auto Portrait function, which automatically collects depth information for post-shot portrait adjustments. Testing found more natural skin tones and improved edge detection with the iPhone 15; the iPhone 14 sometimes struggled, especially around hair and complex outlines. In low-light and evening situations, the iPhone 15 preserves details in backgrounds and prevents overexposure of highlights more effectively than the iPhone 14. Selfies remain much the same due to identical camera hardware. Yet, the iPhone 15 often provides slightly more accurate colors and finer detail, especially in the background. Ultimately, the iPhone 15’s camera outshines its predecessor mainly when images are closely scrutinized, greatly enlarged, or when using advanced camera features. For simple social sharing, the iPhone 14 is still robust. For those seeking the best photo quality or frequent printers, the iPhone 15 is a clear upgrade, with improved low-light and portrait capabilities. Despite not being a revolution, the iPhone 15’s camera improvements and extra features represent a notable step forward.
translated_content: एप्पलले प्रत्येक वर्ष नयाँ आइफोन ल्याउँछ, र यस पटक सामान्य आइफोन १५ मा क्यामेरा विशेष रूपमा राम्रो बनाइएको छ। मुख्य क्यामेरा अहिले १२ मेगापिक्सेलबाट ४८ मेगापिक्सेलमा पुगेको छ, जुन ठूलो परिवर्तन हो। आइफोन १५ मा प्रो स्तरका केही फिचरहरू जस्तै डाइनेमिक आइल्यान्ड र युएसबी-सी छन्, तर यो प्रो जत्तिकै छैन। क्यामेरामा ४८ एमपी मुख्य क्यामेरा (f/1.6), १२ एमपी अल्ट्रावाइड (f/2.4) पाउनुहुन्छ, जुन आइफोन १४ को १२ एमपी/१२ एमपी जस्तै हो। अब आइफोन १५ ले ०.५x, १x र २x अप्टिकल जुम पनि दिन्छ। दुबै फोनमा १२ एमपी अगाडि क्यामेरा (f/1.9) छ। तर आइफोन १५ ले हाल मुख्य क्यामेराबाट खिचिएका फोटोहरू २४ एमपीमा सुरक्षित गर्छ, जसले फोटोमा अझ राम्रो विवरण ल्याउँछ। डिस्ने पार्कमा गरिएको फोटो जाँचमा, आइफोन १५ ले अझ चम्किला र वास्तविक रङ, प्रष्ट बिवरण देखायो, जटिल प्रकाश भएका दृश्यमा समेत। जूम गर्दा साना बिवरण प्रष्ट देखिन्छ, विशेष गरी साइनबोर्ड वा गार्ल्यान्डहरूमा, जुन आइफोन १४ मा अलि धमिलो लाग्छ। झरना र क्रिसमस जस्ता दृश्य आइफोन १५ मा गर्म र थप स्पस्ट लाग्छन्। अल्ट्रावाइड फोटोहरू उस्तै देखिन्छन्, तर आइफोन १५ ले छायाँ र रङ अझ राम्रो देखाउने खालको छ, जसले पृष्ठभूमि र आकाशमा स्पष्टता ल्याउँछ। तर दुवै फोनमा घामको बेला लेन्स फ्लेयर समस्या आउन सक्छ। पोर्ट्रेट मोडमा आइफोन १५ को 'अटो पोर्ट्रेट' फिचरले आफैँ डेप्थ जानकारी राख्छ, जसले पछि सजिलै पोर्ट्रेट फोटो बनाउन सकिन्छ। परीक्षणमा आइफोन १५ ले अझै राम्रो छाला रङ र किनाराको स्पष्टता देखायो, जबकि आइफोन १४ ले कपाल वा जटिल भागमा समस्या देखायो। कम वा रातको प्रकाशमा आइफोन १५ ले पृष्ठभूमिको विवरण राम्रोसँग जोगाउँछ र हाइलाइट्स कम ओभरएक्सपोज हुन्छ। सेल्फीमा दुवैकै हार्डवेयर उस्तै भए पनि, आइफोन १५ ले रंग र विवरणमा अलि सुधार ल्याएको अनुभूति हुन्छ। साधारण सामाजिक सञ्जालको लागि आइफोन १४ पर्याप्त नै छ। तर फोटोलाई ठूलो प्रिन्ट गर्न वा डिटेल हेर्ने चाहना भए आइफोन १५ राम्रो विकल्प हो। कम प्रकाश र पोर्ट्रेट फिचरमा पनि यो अगाडि छ।

article_content: Aston Villa is set to host Fulham in an upcoming Premier League clash as they occupy fifth place in the standings and boast an impressive record at home against the Cottagers. Villa hasn’t lost at home to Fulham in their last four meetings—two in the Premier League and two in the Championship. In contrast, Fulham’s only league win over Villa in their last 19 face-offs dates back to April 2014, having lost all four games since then. Currently, Fulham sits 15th in the table and hasn’t played at their best this season. Their latest match saw them narrowly defeated 1-0 by Manchester United, adding pressure to reverse their fortunes this weekend. The fixture is scheduled for Sunday, November 12, at Villa Park, with kickoff at 14:00 GMT (9am ET). Fans can catch game highlights on Sky Sports’ YouTube channel, watch BBC’s Match of the Day 2 at 10:40pm on Sunday, or stream online via Peacock Premium. Historically, both clubs have won 26 games each from their 74 head-to-head matches. Aston Villa has claimed victory in three of their last four league fixtures against Fulham. When playing away at Villa Park, Fulham has just a single win from their previous 19 attempts, losing the last four times. Villa is on a stellar run, winning 12 consecutive home league games—their best since 1983. Conversely, Fulham has dropped 12 of their last 14 Premier League matches. Injury-wise, Villa’s central defender Diego Carlos is doubtful after being substituted with a knock in Thursday’s European game, whereas Alex Moreno is nearing a return after his long hamstring layoff from May. For Fulham, Rodrigo Muniz remains sidelined due to a knee injury sustained last week, while Tosin Adarabioyo, Kenny Tete, and Adama Traore could make the squad, though they’re probably not fit to start. article_content: Every holiday season, Neiman Marcus debuts its famed Christmas Book featuring Fantasy Gifts—lavish selections that often serve as the ultimate status symbol. In 2023, the retailer’s curated catalog continues this legacy, spotlighting extraordinary experiences and bespoke creations, most with staggering price tags. Offerings include the limited-edition electric Cadillac Celestiq Carmen for $975,000, a chance to star as an animated Disney character, and an adventurous yachting journey in Bali, among others. Nabil Aliffi, Chief Brand Officer, explains that since its start in 1959, the Fantasy Gifts program has aimed to inspire with rare and whimsical opportunities. This year's edition focuses even more on immersive, once-in-a-lifetime experiences designed to spark imagination. article_content: NEW ORLEANS, Louisiana (CNN) -- The Orleans Parish District Attorney has announced he will review deaths that occurred at a New Orleans hospital following Hurricane Katrina, stopping short of labeling it a formal investigation. Medical staff at Memorial Medical Center were accused of hastening the deaths of four patients in the chaotic aftermath. "My office has not reopened an investigation into the deaths at Memorial Hospital after Katrina struck in 2005," District Attorney Leon Cannizzaro stated on Friday. "As district attorney, I am required by law to evaluate statements concerning possible criminal acts in this jurisdiction. I am currently making that evaluation, but it does not constitute a formal investigation." The New Orleans Times-Picayune reported Saturday that Cannizzaro intends to interview city coroner Frank Minyard and possibly other members of the coroner's office about the deaths. Cannizzaro clarified that opening a formal investigation would require a grand jury and witness testimony, which he does not currently intend to pursue. After consulting the coroner, Cannizzaro said he would determine whether a more extensive inquiry is warranted. According to his spokesperson, Christopher Bowman, there was no additional comment from the DA's office beyond the official statement. The Times-Picayune notes that Cannizzaro's renewed interest was prompted by a New York Times article quoting two doctors who said they administered morphine and other drugs to Memorial patients after the hurricane, knowing the patients would not survive. Cannizzaro told the newspaper he would be neglecting his duties if he did not discuss this new information with the coroner, but emphasized that this does not constitute a formal investigation. Hurricane Katrina made landfall on August 29, 2005, causing severe flooding in New Orleans after breaching three of the city's levees. In the aftermath, then-Louisiana Attorney General Charles Foti Jr. launched an investigation after Lifecare, an acute-care facility on Memorial’s seventh floor, alleged that several critically ill, mostly elderly patients were euthanized as conditions deteriorated. In 2006, Dr. Anna Pou and nurses Lori Budo and Cheri Landry were arrested on preliminary charges of second-degree murder in the deaths of four patients. District Attorney Eddie Jordan offered immunity to Budo and Landry in exchange for their testimony. In July 2007, a grand jury declined to indict Pou. Foti's investigation claimed the four patients — aged 63, 68, 91, and 93 — were given fatal doses of morphine and midazolam hydrochloride. The accused staff denied the charges, saying they stayed to care for patients rather than evacuate. Dr. Pou later told Newsweek that she had given patients medication and acknowledged that it may have hastened their deaths, but denied intent to harm, stating, "We're here to help patients." Five specialists brought in by Foti's office concluded that the patients were homicide victims, but their testimony was not heard by the grand jury. After the grand jury's decision, DA Jordan closed the case. If DA Cannizzaro pursues a new in-depth review, it could impact the outcome of a legal effort by CNN and The Times-Picayune to release Foti's investigative files. Hospital staff who filed suit to keep the investigative records sealed cited grand jury secrecy, privacy, and confidentiality concerns. The Louisiana Supreme Court recently referred the case back to a trial court to determine whether new criminal proceedings are expected—a decision that may hinge on whether an investigation is reopened.
translated_content: न्यू अर्लिन्स, लुइसियाना (CNN) -- ओरलियन्स पैरिशका जिल्ला वकिलले हरिकेन क्याट्रिनापछि एक न्यू अर्लिन्स अस्पतालमा भएका मृत्युमाथि समीक्षा गर्ने घोषणा गरेका छन्, तर औपचारिक अनुसन्धान भने नभएको बताएका छन्। मेमोरियल मेडिकल सेन्टरका चिकित्साकर्मीहरूलाई चार जना बिरामीको मृत्यु छिटो भएको आरोप लागेको छ। "मेरो कार्यालयले क्याट्रिनापछिका मेमोरियल अस्पताल मृत्युमा अनुसन्धान पुनः सुरु गरेको छैन," जिल्ला वकिल लिओन क्यानेज्यारोले शुक्रबार बताएका छन्। "म, जिल्ला वकिलको रूपमा, यस क्षेत्राधिकारमा सम्भावित आपराधिक कार्यका बयानहरूको मूल्यांकन गर्न कानुनी रुपमा बाध्य छु। म हाल त्यही मूल्यांकन गर्दैछु, यो भने अनुसन्धान होइन।" न्यू अर्लिन्स टाइम्स-पिकयुनका अनुसार क्यानेज्यारोले सहरका मुचुल्का अधिकृत फ्र्याङ्क मिन्यार्ड र, सम्भवतः, अन्य मुचुल्का टोली सदस्यहरूसँग ती मृत्युबारे कुरा गर्नेछन्। क्यानेज्यारोले स्पष्ट पारेका छन्, औपचारिक अनुसन्धान गर्न ग्रान्ड जूरी गठन र साक्षी बोलाउने प्रक्रिया आवश्यक हुन्छ, जुन तत्काल उनी गर्ने योजनामा छैनन्। मुचुल्का अधिकृतसँगको छलफलपछि क्यानेज्यारोले थप अध्ययन आवश्यक छ कि छैन भन्ने निर्णय लिने बताएका छन्। उनका प्रवक्ता क्रिस्टोफर बोमनका अनुसार, आधिकारिक वक्तव्यबाहेक, जिल्ला वकिलको कार्यालयसँग थप टिप्पणी छैन। टाइम्स-पिकयुनका अनुसार क्यानेज्यारोको चासो न्यूयोर्क टाइम्सको एउटा समाचारपछि आएको हो, जसमा दुई डाक्टरले हरिकेनपछि मेमोरियलका बिरामीलाई मर्फिन र अन्य औषधि दिएको र तिनको ज्यान नबच्नेमा थाहा भएको बताएका छन्। क्यानेज्यारोले पत्रिकामा भनेका छन् कि उनले यो सूचना मुचुल्का अधिकृतसँग छलफल नगरे आफ्नो जिम्मेवारी पुरा नगर्ने थिए, तर यसले अनुसन्धान सुरु भएको अर्थ नलाग्ने स्पष्ट पारे। हरिकेन क्याट्रिना सन् २००५ अगस्त २९ मा मिसिसिप्पी–लुइसियाना सीमामा पुग्दा न्यू अर्लिन्सका तीनवटा बाँध फुटेका थिए र अधिकांश शहर जलमग्न भएको थियो। त्यसपछिको अवस्थामा लुइसियानाका पूर्व महान्यायाधिवक्ता चार्ल्स फोटी जुनियरले लाइफकेयर (मेमोरियलको सातौं तल्लामा रहेको केन्द्र) का अधिकारीहरूले गम्भीर अवस्थामा रहेकाहरू बढी जेष्ठ बिरामीलाई स्वास्थ्यकर्मीले युथेनेसिया गराएको आरोपपछि अनुसन्धान थाले। २००६ मा डा. अन्ना पोउ र दुई नर्स लोरी बुडो र चेरी ल्याण्ड्रीलाई चार बिरामीको मृत्युमा दोस्रो श्रेणीको हत्याको प्रारम्भिक अभियोगमा पक्राउ गरिएको थियो। जिल्ला वकिल एडी जोर्डनले बुडो र ल्याण्ड्रीलाई साक्षीको बयान दिन इम्युनिटी दिएका थिए। जुलाई २००७ मा ग्राण्ड जूरीले पोउमाथि अभियोग लगाउने निर्णय गरेन। फोटीको अनुसन्धान अनुसार ती ६३, ६८, ९१ र ९३ वर्षका बिरामीलाई मर्फिन र मिडाजोलाम हाइड्रोक्लोराइडको घातक मात्रा दिइएको थियो। आरोपित कर्मचारीहरूले सबै आरोप अस्वीकार गर्दै आफूहरू उपचार गर्न बसेको बताएका छन्। डा. पोउले न्यूजवीकसँग पछि भनिन्, उनले बिरामीलाई औषधि दिएकी थिइन् र यसले मृत्यु छिटो हुनसक्ने स्विकारेकी छिन्, तर मार्ने एउटै मनसाय थिएन बताउँदै, "हामी बिरामीलाई मद्दत गर्न यहाँ छौं," भनीन्। फोटीको कार्यालयले ल्याएका पाँच विशेषज्ञहरूले बिरामीको हत्या भएको निष्कर्ष निकालेका थिए, तर ग्राण्ड जूरीले तिनको बयान सुनेन। ग्राण्ड जूरीको निर्णयपछि जिल्ला वकिल जोर्डनले मुद्दा बन्द भएको घोषणा गरे। यदि क्यानेज्यारोले पुनः विस्तृत अध्ययन गरेमा सीएनएन र टाइम्स-पिकयुनले खोजेको अनुसन्धान फाइल सार्वजनिकबारेको मुद्दामा असर पर्न सक्छ। अनुसन्धान फाइल सार्वजनिक गर्न रोक लगाउन अस्पतालका कर्मचारीहरू अदालत गएका छन्। उनीहरूले ग्रान्ड जूरी गोपनीयता तथा निजता उल्लंघन हुने भन्दै सार्वजनिक नगर्न माग गरेका छन्। लुइसियाना सर्वोच्च अदालतले हालै मुद्दा फेरी ट्रायल अदालतमा पठाएको छ, जहाँ नयाँ आपराधिक प्रक्रिया आउँछ कि भन्ने निर्णय पुनः अनुसन्धान खुल्ने वा नखुल्नेमा निर्भर हुनेछ।

article_content: In a London meeting room, women gather, laughing and yelling while wielding cricket bats—not in competition, but in camaraderie. They've joined the Tantrum Club, a unique support group offering stressed-out professionals and busy homemakers a safe outlet for their frustrations, without fear of repercussions at work or home. The idea sprang from Adele Theron, 35, creator of the Naked Divorce—a 21-day program assisting couples through separation. She noticed the first day of the program, designed to release anger, attracted not just those divorcing but also others simply seeking a space to vent. As word spread, demand grew, and Tantrum Club was born. The early sessions were so popular that Adele, who runs the group for free, is now in talks to bring Tantrum Clubs to gyms nationwide. The Club has outlined eight rules on its website, and even offers a phone-in service at phone-and-rant.com for those who need to shout remotely. The concept runs counter to the traditional 'Keep Calm and Carry On' mentality—instead, participants embrace open expression. 'For years, women have been told to bottle up their feelings, but suppressing anger can harm your health,' explains Adele, whose sessions welcome everyone from teens to seniors. Activities include group shouting, drumming, and even venting anger on beanbags with cricket bats. Upcoming Tantrum Club sessions will be held during the Vitality Show at Earls Court, March 21-24.
translated_content: लण्डनको एउटा बैठक कोठामा महिलाहरु जुट्छन्, हाँस्दै र कराउँदै क्रिकेट ब्याट लिँदै—प्रतिस्पर्धामा होइन, मित्रताको वातावरणमा। उनीहरूले टेन्ट्रम क्लबमा भाग लिएका हुन्, जुन विशेष सहयोग समूह हो जसले तनावमा रहेका व्यवसायिक तथा व्यस्त गृहिणीहरूलाई बिना डर-त्रास आफ्नो रिस पोख्न सुरक्षित माध्यम दिन्छ। यो विचार ३५ वर्षीया अडेल थेरोनबाट आएको हो, जसले पहिले 'नेक्ड डिभोर्स' नामको २१-दिने कार्यक्रम ल्याएकी थिइन्, छुट्टिने जोडीहरूलाई सहयोग गर्न। कार्यक्रमको पहिलो दिनमै रिस मुक्त गर्ने गतिविधिले डिभोर्स प्रक्रियामा नभएकाहरू समेत आकर्षित गरेपछि, टेन्ट्रम क्लबको सुरुआत भयो। समाचार फैलिंदा माग बढ्दै गयो र टेन्ट्रम क्लब स्थापना गरियो। सुरुवाती सत्रहरू यति लोकप्रिय भए कि अडेल, जसले यो सेवा निःशुल्क सञ्चालन गर्छिन्, अहिले देशभरका जिमहरूमा क्लब खोल्न छलफलमा छिन्। क्लबको वेबसाइटमा आठवटा नियम छन्, र चिच्याउन चाहनेका लागि 'फोन-एण्ड-रान्ट डट कम' मार्फत फोन सेवा पनि उपलब्ध छ। 'किप क्याल्म एन्ड क्यारी अन' सोच विपरीत, यस क्लबले खुलेर भावना व्यक्त गर्न हौसला दिन्छ। 'वर्षौं महिला रिस दबाउन बाध्य भए, तर दबाएको रिस स्वास्थ्यका लागि हानिकारक हुन्छ,' अडेल भन्छिन्। उनको सत्रमा किशोरदेखि वृद्धसम्म सबै सहभागी हुन्छन्। समूहिक कराह, ढोल बजाउने, र क्रिकेट ब्याटले बिनब्यागमा रिस पोख्ने जस्ता गतिविधि गरिन्छ। टेन्ट्रम क्लबका आगामी सत्रहरू भाइटालिटी शो, अर्ल्स कोर्टमा मार्च २१-२४ सम्म हुनेछन्।

article_content: Ramzi Yousef, the mastermind behind the 1993 World Trade Center bombing that killed six people and injured over 1,000, has been held in solitary confinement at the Supermax federal prison in Colorado for more than a decade. Since the September 11, 2001 attacks, the 44-year-old Pakistani national has been confined to a 7-by-11-foot cell, with limited human contact. Yousef’s lawyer, Bernard Kleinman, is petitioning the 2nd U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals in Manhattan to allow him to gather information on why his client remains under the strictest security measures fifteen years after their introduction. Kleinman argues that Yousef is no longer a threat and that the severe restrictions are unfair. At his sentencing in 1998, Yousef admitted to being a terrorist and expressed pride in his actions. After the 1993 bombing—which left a gaping hole in the World Trade Center's basement—he fled to the Middle East and was captured two years later in Pakistan, then turned over to the FBI. Since 1997, Yousef has faced special administrative measures intended for inmates considered ongoing threats. According to Kleinman, Yousef's prison conditions were made even stricter following the 9/11 attacks, isolating him further from other high-profile prisoners. Kleinman is challenging the continued necessity of these restrictions, which prevent Yousef from communicating with other inmates and limit his visits, which have occurred only behind Plexiglass and with handcuffs. The conditions allow Yousef no direct communication except with his lawyer, and visits are rare. Yousef, a nephew of 9/11 organizer Khalid Sheik Mohammed, spends nearly all his time in his small cell, with only a radio, a television, a desk, a toilet, and a shower. Kleinman hopes to have the restrictions eased so that Yousef can communicate more freely with family, including his wife and two daughters, emphasizing the importance of human interaction for his client. Despite acknowledging Yousef’s crimes and the continued public resentment against him, Kleinman asserts that fairness and humane treatment should prevail.
translated_content: १९९३ को वर्ल्ड ट्रेड सेन्टर बम विष्फोटका मास्टरमाइन्ड राम्जी युसुफ, जसका कारण छ जनाको मृत्यु भयो र १,०००भन्दा बढी घाइते भए, एक दशकभन्दा बढी समयदेखि कोलोराडोस्थित सुपरम्याक्स जेलमा एक्लोपनमा राखिएका छन्। सेप्टेम्बर ११, २००१ को आक्रमणपछि, ४४ वर्षे पाकिस्तानी नागरिक युसुफलाई ७–फुट बाइ ११–फुटको कोठामा सीमित मानव सम्पर्कमा राखिएको छ। युसुफका वकिल बर्नार्ड क्लाइनम्यानले म्यानहट्टनस्थित दोस्रो अमेरिकी सर्किट अदालतमा निवेदन दिएका छन्, जसले उनलाई उनका मुवाफिकता किन अहिलेसम्म सबैभन्दा कडा सुरक्षा व्यवस्थामा राखिएको छ भन्नेबारे थप जानकारी लिन अनुमति दिन अनुरोध गरेका छन्। क्लाइनम्यान भन्छन्, युसुफ अब खतरा छैनन् र कडा प्रतिबन्ध अन्यायपूर्ण छ। १९९८ मा सजाय सुन्दा युसुफले आफू आतङ्ककारी भएको स्वीकार गर्दै गर्व गरेको बताएका थिए। १९९३ को बम विष्फोटपछि उनले मिडल इस्टतर्फ भागेका थिए र दुई वर्षपछि पाकिस्तानमा पक्राउ परी एफबीआईलाई सुम्पिएका थिए। १९९७ देखि युसुफलाई निरन्तर खतराको रूपमा विशेष प्रशासनिक मापदण्ड लागू गरिँदै आएको छ। क्लाइनम्यानका अनुसार, ९/११ पछि युसुफको कैदी अवस्थालाई अझ कडा बनाइएको छ र उनी अन्य चर्चित कैदीहरूबाट समेत अलग गरिएका छन्। क्लाइनम्यान युसुफमाथि यी सख्त प्रतिबन्ध किन निरन्तर लागू भइरहेका छन् भनी प्रश्न गर्दैछन्, जसले उनलाई अन्य कैदीहरूसँग सम्पर्क गर्न र भेटघाट गर्न असद्भाव राख्छ, र वकिलसँगमात्र भेट्न पाउने अधिकार छ। भेटघाट पनि दुर्लभ हुन्छ। ९/११ का योजनाकार खालिद शेख मोहम्मदका भतिजो युसुफ, आफ्नो सानो कोठामा रेडियो, टेलिभिजन, टेबल, ट्वाइलेट र शावरसहित बिताउँछन्। क्लाइनम्यानले युसुफलाई आफ्नी श्रीमती र दुई छोरीसँग बढी सम्बन्ध राख्न पाउनु पर्ने भन्दै, ती कडा प्रतिबन्ध हटाउन आशा राखेका छन् र मानिसबीचको सम्बन्ध महत्त्वपूर्ण रहेको बताएका छन्। युसुफका अपराध र उनीप्रति जनताको रिसबारे जानकारी हुँदाहुँदै, क्लाइनम्यान निष्पक्षता र मानवीय व्यवहारको पक्षमा छन्।

article_content: Cricket matches between India and Pakistan are intense affairs that test both skill and composure, making temperament as crucial as talent in team selection. Ahead of the highly awaited ODI World Cup clash in Ahmedabad, experts advocate for Shubman Gill’s return to India’s squad post-dengue and for R Ashwin’s inclusion due to his spin expertise. Pakistan is considering a comeback for Fakhar Zaman in their batting line-up, even though his recent form has been lacking. India is seen as the favorite following decisive victories in its opening matches, though analysts stress that Pakistan's capabilities should not be underestimated. Having sat out two games due to illness, Shubman Gill is set for a comeback, likely replacing Ishan Kishan. Skipper Rohit Sharma stated Gill is almost certainly fit to play, based on his strong training sessions after hospital recovery. R Ashwin is expected to play, possibly instead of Shardul Thakur, as his diverse spinning skills could be crucial even on Ahmedabad’s bat-friendly pitch. Pakistan faces a selection choice between Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman. While Abdullah Shafique’s recent century has made selection tricky, Fakhar’s record in high-pressure games against India could work in his favor. With Ahmedabad's track favoring batsmen and India's high recent ODI scores against Pakistan, a run-filled encounter is likely. Projected line-ups: India—Rohit Sharma, Shubman Gill, Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul, Hardik Pandya, Ravindra Jadeja, R Ashwin, Kuldeep Yadav, Jasprit Bumrah, Mohammed Siraj. Pakistan—Abdullah Shafique, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam, Mohammad Rizwan, Saud Shakeel, Iftikhar Ahmad, Mohammad Nawaz, Shadab Khan, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Shah Afridi, Haris Rauf.
