article_content: A decisive majority of Argentinian voters chose a new direction by electing Javier Milei as the country’s next president. Amidst soaring inflation and increasing poverty, Milei, a right-wing populist who pledged to radically overhaul the government, defeated incumbent economy minister Sergio Massa in a run-off election on Sunday, securing over 55% of the vote. This is the highest percentage a presidential candidate has received since Argentina returned to democracy in 1983. The 53-year-old, who identifies as a libertarian and 'anarcho-capitalist,' campaigned on cutting public spending, abolishing the central bank, and replacing the Argentinian peso with the U.S. dollar, as well as other significant economic changes. He has also opposed sex education in schools, vowed to further restrict abortion access, and has rejected mainstream climate change science. Beyond his policies, Milei became widely recognized during the turbulent election season for his eccentric persona. Once a rock musician in a Rolling Stones tribute band, Milei later gained fame as an outspoken economist and media commentator. During his campaign, he wielded a chainsaw on stage and smashed a piñata on live television to symbolize his plans for change. Milei has made controversial remarks, including calling Pope Francis a 'filthy leftist' and referring to American gangster Al Capone as a 'hero.' Critics often cite Milei's unconventional behavior and outspoken pronouncements to question his competence as a leader—Argentinian journalist Juan Luis González even titled his unauthorized biography of Milei 'El Loco' ('The Madman'). Political analysts, however, suggest that Milei's election reflects public frustration with the existing system rather than a personal endorsement of his character. Local political consultant Lucas Romero told the Associated Press, 'This is a triumph that is less about Milei as an individual and more about the demand for change.' Perhaps nothing has fueled more speculation about Milei's readiness to lead than his highly publicized and unusual practice of seeking advice from his dogs: Conan, Murray, Milton, Robert, and Lucas. These were the first 'advisors' he thanked after winning Argentina’s presidential primaries in August—though they are his pets, not people. 'Who else?' he has said. 'My four-legged children,' calling them 'the best strategists.' Milei adopted his English mastiff Conan, named after the 1982 film 'Conan the Barbarian,' in 2004. According to journalist González in the Buenos Aires Times, Milei described Conan as his 'true and greatest love,' even saying the dog was like a son to him. Never married and without children, Milei credits Conan as his closest companion during challenging times. After Conan’s death in 2017, Milei reportedly visited a medium in an attempt to communicate with his late pet. Milei claims that in this telepathic encounter, Conan told him that his destiny was to become president of Argentina—a mission from God. Argentine newspaper La Nacion reported that Milei believes he and Conan first met over 2,000 years ago as a gladiator and a lion in ancient Rome and that they were destined to work together in the future. In 2018, Milei paid about $50,000, according to Reuters and The New York Times, to the U.S. company PerPETuate to have Conan cloned. The procedure resulted in five puppies named after Conan and three famous economists: Murray Rothbard, Milton Friedman, and Robert Lucas. Milei calls the current Conan his son and regards the four others as his 'grandchildren.' González and other media outlets have reported that Milei seeks guidance from his dogs regarding his political decisions and policies. In an August interview with Spain’s 20minutos, González said, 'Milei is convinced that the dogs advise him in different areas: one in politics, another in economics, another gives general advice.' He expressed concern about such conduct in a country already described as unstable: 'This man who would command the fate of the country starts each day with séances with his dogs, then makes decisions. It’s very surprising.' When The Economist asked Milei in September about these reports, he did not deny them. Instead, he replied with apparent pride: 'They say my dogs determine my strategies, yes? That they're like a strategic committee? They are the best strategic committee in the world. Tell me: when has an outsider accomplished what we did in just two years? If so, then they are the best political analysts in the world.'
translated_content: अर्जेन्टिनाका मतदाताहरूको स्पष्ट बहुमतले जेभियर मिलीलाई देशको नयाँ राष्ट्रपति चयन गरेर नयाँ दिशा रोजेका छन्। चुलिँदो महँगी र बढ्दो गरिबीका बीच, सरकारले व्यापक सुधार गर्ने वाचा गरेका दक्षिणपन्थी पपुलिस्ट मिलीले आइतबारको रन-अफ निर्वाचनमा वर्तमान अर्थमन्त्री सेर्जियो मासालाई पराजित गर्दै ५५% भन्दा बढी मत प्राप्त गरेका छन्। सन् १९८३ मा अर्जेन्टिनामा प्रजातन्त्र फर्किएपछि यो प्रतिशत कुनै पनि राष्ट्रपति उम्मेदवारलाई प्राप्त भएको अहिलेसम्मकै उच्च हो। ५३ वर्षीय मिलीले आफूलाई स्वतन्त्रतावादी र 'एनार्को-क्यापिटालिस्ट' भनेर चिनाउँछन्। उनले सार्वजनिक खर्च कटौती, केन्द्रीय बैंक हटाउने तथा अर्जेन्टिनियाली पेसोलाई अमेरिकी डलरसँग प्रतिस्थापन गर्ने जस्ता ठूला आर्थिक परिवर्तन गर्ने प्रस्ताव गरेका छन्। उनले विद्यालयमा यौन शिक्षाको विरोध, गर्भपतनमा थप कडाई गर्ने र मुख्यधारको जलवायु परिवर्तन विज्ञान अस्वीकार गर्ने कुरामा समेत अडान लिएका छन्। नीतिहरूभन्दा बाहिर मिली आफ्नो चुनावी अभियानको अनौठो व्यवहारका लागि समेत परिचित बनेका छन्। एक समयमा रोलिङ स्टोन्स ट्रिब्युट ब्यान्डमा रक संगीतकार रहेका मिली पछि एक चर्चित अर्थशास्त्री र मिडिया कमेन्टेटरको रूपमा चिन्निए। चुनावी प्रदर्शनमा उनले स्टेजमा चेनसअ चलाएका थिए र टेलिभिजनमा पिन्याटो फुटाएका थिए, आफ्ना परिवर्तन योजनाहरूको संकेतका रूपमा। मिलीले पोप फ्रान्सिसलाई 'फोहोर वामपन्थी' भनेका र अमेरिकी ग्याङस्टर अल कापोनलाई 'हिरो' भनेका विवादास्पद टिप्पणी गरेका छन्। उनका आलोचकहरूले मिलीको अनौठो व्यवहार र outspoken अभिव्यक्तिलाई देखाउँदै उनको नेतृत्व क्षमता माथि प्रश्न उठाउँछन्—अर्जेन्टिनी पत्रकार जुआन लुइस गनजालेजले उनको अनौपचारिक जीवनीको शीर्षक नै 'एल लोको' ('पागल') राखेका छन्। तर, राजनीतिक विश्लेषकहरू भन्छन्, मिलीको जित व्यक्तिगत स्वीकृति भन्दा पनि वर्तमान व्यवस्थाप्रति जनताको असन्तुष्टिको संकेत हो। स्थानीय राजनीतिक सल्लाहकार लुकास रोमेरोले एसोसिएटेड प्रेसलाई भने, 'यो जीत मिलीको विशेषताबाट होइन, परिवर्तनको मागबाट आएको हो।' शायद केहीले मिलीको नेतृत्व क्षमता माथि सबैभन्दा धेरै प्रश्न उठाएको कुरा भनेको, जुन अत्यधिक प्रचारित र अनौठो छ—उनले आफ्ना कुकुरहरूसँग सल्लाह लिने अभ्यास हो: कोनन, मरे, मिल्टन, रोबर्ट, र लुकास। यी नै 'सल्लाहकार'हरू हुन्, जसलाई उनले अगस्टमा राष्ट्रपति चुनावको प्राथमिक जितपछि धन्यवाद दिएका थिए—यी व्यक्ति नभएर उनीका पाल्तु कुकुर हुन्। उनले भनेका छन्, 'अरू को? मेरा चार खुट्टे बच्चाहरू,' र 'सबैभन्दा राम्रो रणनीतिकार' भनेका छन्। मिलीले २००४ मा आफ्नो इङ्ग्लिस मास्टिफ कुकुर 'कोनन'लाई अपनाएका थिए, जुन सन् १९८२ को फिल्म 'कोनन द बार्बेरियन' बाट नाम राखिएको हो। जर्नालिस्ट गनजालेजले बुएनोस आयर्स टाइम्समा लेखे अनुसार, मिलीले कोननलाई आफ्नो 'साँचो र सबैभन्दा ठूलो प्रेम' भनेका थिए, र उनलाई आफ्ना छोराजस्तै मानेका थिए। कहिल्यै विवाह नगरेका र सन्तान नभएका मिलीले चुनौतीपूर्ण समयमा कोननलाई सबैभन्दा नजिकको साथी मानेका छन्। कोननको २०१७ मा मृत्युपछि, मिलीले आफ्ना दिवंगत पालतुलाई सन्देश पाउँन माध्यमकर्मी कहाँ गएका थिए भन्ने रिपोर्ट छ। मिलीका अनुसार, यस टेलिप्याथिक भेटमा कोननले उनलाई अर्जेन्टिनाको राष्ट्रपति बन्नु उनको भाग्य हो—भगवानको मिशन हो—भनेका थिए। अर्जेन्टिनाको पत्रिका ला नासियोनले रिपोर्ट गरेअनुसार, मिलीको विश्वास छ कि उनी र कोनन २,००० वर्षअघि रोमन युगमा ग्लेडिएटर र सिंहको रूपमा पहिलोपटक भेटिएका थिए र साथमा काम गर्ने भविष्यवाणी थियो। २०१८ मा, मिलीले करिब $५०,००० तिरेर (रॉयटर्स र न्यूयोर्क टाइम्स अनुसार) अमेरिकी कम्पनी PerPETuate मार्फत कोननको क्लोन बनाउन लगाएका थिए। यस प्रक्रियाबाट पाँचवटा पिल्ला जन्मिए—जसलाई कोनन र तीन चर्चित अर्थशास्त्री मरे रोथबर्ड, मिल्टन फ्राइडम्यान, र रोबर्ट लुकासका नाममा नामाकरण गरिएको थियो। मिलीले हालका कोननलाई आफ्नो छोरा तथा अरू चार कुकुरलाई 'नातिनातिनी' भन्छन्। गनजालेज र अन्य मिडिया संस्थाहरूले रिपोर्ट गरेका छन् कि, मिलीले आफ्ना कुकुरहरूबाट राजनीति तथा नीतिमा सल्लाह लिन्छन्। स्पेनको २०मिनुटोससँग अगस्टमा भएको अन्तर्वार्तामा गनजालेजले भने, 'मिली विश्वस्त छन् कि कुकुरहरू उनलाई फरक–फरक क्षेत्रमा सल्लाह दिन्छन्: एकले राजनीति, अर्काले अर्थतन्त्र, अन्यले सामान्य सल्लाह,' उनले देश पहिले नै अस्थिर रहेको अवस्थामा यस्तो व्यवहार चिन्ताजनक भएको बताए। सेप्टेम्बरमा द इकनमिस्टले यी रिपोर्टबारे सोध्दा, मिलीले अस्विकार गरेनन्। बरु, गर्वका साथ भने, 'मेरा कुकुरहरूले मेरो रणनीति निर्धारण गर्छन् भन्छन्, हैन? उनीहरू रणनीतिक कमिटी जस्तै हुन्? उनीहरू संसारकै सबैभन्दा असल रणनीतिक कमिटी हुन्। भन्नुस् त, बाहिरबाट आएर दुई वर्षमै यस्तो उपलब्धि कसले गरेको छ? यदि हो भने, उनीहरू सबैभन्दा असल राजनीतिक विश्लेषक हुन्।'

article_content: Former presidential aide Laolu Akande has called the ongoing nationwide strike by Nigeria's labour unions a distraction and urged President Bola Tinubu to step in. Speaking on Channels Television’s ‘Politics Today’, Akande argued that the country faces more significant challenges, including severe economic hardship and a fiscal crisis, which require urgent attention. Akande appealed to President Tinubu to resolve the national problems that have been compounded by the strike, which was called by the National Labour Congress (NLC) and the Trade Union Congress (TUC) and began on Tuesday. He stated, 'The people are suffering. The last thing they need right now is a national strike. I believe it can be settled quickly.' When asked if the strike was political, Akande responded, 'Our elected leaders are there to solve political problems. But is it right to bring the entire nation to a halt because of a local issue in Imo State? It might have been better to keep the matter within Imo.' Akande condemned the recent assault on NLC President Joe Ajaero in Imo State, calling it criminal. He praised Inspector-General of Police Olukayode Egbetokun for promptly promising to investigate the incident. 'You don't beat up people; that's a crime and should not be tolerated,' Akande emphasized. He also addressed allegations of partisanship, noting, 'There are claims that Mr. Ajaero is aligned with the Labour Party. This seems to be an Imo State issue and would be more appropriately resolved there, rather than escalating it to a national level.' Overall, Akande maintained that decisive intervention from the president, possibly with a single phone call, could quickly end the strike and refocus attention on the more urgent issues facing Nigerians.
translated_content: पूर्व राष्ट्रपति सल्लाहकार लाओलु अकांडेले नाइजेरियाका श्रम संघहरूले जारी राखेको देशव्यापी आमहड्ताललाई ध्यान विचलित गर्ने भनी राष्ट्रपति बोला टिनुबुलाई हस्तक्षेप गर्न आग्रह गरेका छन्। ‘च्यानल्स टेलिभिजन’को ‘पोलिटिक्स टुडे’ कार्यक्रममा बोल्दै, अकांडेले देशमा गहिरो आर्थिक संकट र वित्तीय समस्याजस्ता गम्भीर चुनौतीलाई समाधान गर्नुपर्ने बताएका छन्। अकांडेले राष्ट्रपतिलाई NLC र TUC ले मंगलबारदेखि थालेको आमहड्तालसँग थपिएको राष्ट्रिय समस्याहरू समाधान गर्न अनुरोध गरे। उनले भने, 'जनता पीडामा छन्। अहिले उनीहरूलाई राष्ट्रिय हड्तालको आवश्यकता छैन। यसलाई चाँडै समाधान गर्न सकिन्छ भन्ने मलाई विश्वास छ।' हड्ताल राजनीतिक हो कि होइन भन्ने प्रश्नमा अकांडेले भने, 'हाम्रा निर्वाचित नेताहरू राजनीतिक समस्या समाधान गर्नकै लागि छन्। तर, इमो राज्यको स्थानीय विषयका कारण सिंगो देशलाई ठप्प पार्नु कत्तिको उचित होला? यो कुरा इमोमै सीमित गर्नु राम्रो हुनेथियो।' अकांडेले इमो राज्यमा NLC अध्यक्ष जो अजाएरोका विरुद्ध भएको आक्रमणलाई आपराधिक भन्दै कडा रूपमा निन्दा गरे। उनले प्रहरी महानिरीक्षक ओलुकायोडे एग्बेटोकनलाई छिटो छानबिनको आश्वासन दिएकोमा प्रशंसा गरे। अकांडेले भने, 'मान्छेलाई कुट्नु अपराध हो, यो सह्य छैन।' उनले पक्षपातका आरोपबारे भने, 'अजाएरो लेबर पार्टीसँग निकट रहेको भनाइ छ। यो इमो राज्यको मुद्दा जस्तो देखिन्छ, जसलाई इमोमै समाधान गर्न उपयुक्त हुन्थ्यो, राष्ट्रिय मुद्दा बनाउनु थिएन।' समग्रमा, अकांडेले राष्ट्रपतिको निर्णायक हस्तक्षेप — सायद एउटा फोन कलले नै — यो हड्ताल छिट्टै अन्त्य गराउन सक्ने र नाइजेरियाली जनताको थप गम्भीर समस्यातर्फ ध्यान केन्द्रीत गराउन सक्ने धारणा राखे।

article_content: A fresh maritime dispute has emerged between Australia and China after the Australian government claimed its navy divers may have been harmed by sonar pulses from a Chinese warship. The incident took place near Japan’s exclusive economic zone as the HMAS Toowoomba, an Australian frigate, was involved in enforcing UN sanctions. Australian Defence Minister Richard Marles reported that sailors were attempting to clear fishing nets from the ship’s propeller when a Chinese destroyer approached, possibly subjecting them to sonar. China swiftly refuted these accusations, with Defence Ministry spokesperson Wu Qian insisting that the Chinese vessel ‘Ningbo’ acted lawfully, simply monitoring and identifying the Australian ship. Wu urged Australia to stop making what he described as reckless claims, emphasizing that China abided by international laws throughout the encounter. Beijing also called for cooperation to prevent further deterioration of bilateral relations. This confrontation occurs even as both countries have recently expressed interest in improving ties, demonstrated by a visit to China from Australia’s Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, who highlighted positive developments. Nevertheless, security issues continue to be a source of friction, especially as Australia works more closely with the United States to counteract China’s growing influence in the region. Health experts, including the Diving Medical Advisory Committee, caution that sonar waves can threaten diver safety, potentially causing dizziness, hearing loss, or even organ injury. The HMAS Toowoomba, operational since 2005, is equipped with state-of-the-art surveillance and weapon systems. The incident highlights persistent challenges in ensuring maritime safety and maintaining trust between the two nations.

article_content: The United States has lifted its ban on American airlines flying to and from Tel Aviv, Israel. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) made this decision on Wednesday night, about 36 hours after initially suspending flights due to security concerns following renewed violence in the Middle East. Airlines quickly moved to restore flights. On Thursday, Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, and US Airways announced the resumption of service to Ben Gurion International Airport, Israel's busiest airport. The European Aviation Safety Agency also withdrew its advisory, which had recommended that airlines avoid flights to Ben Gurion. Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, had pressed Washington to reverse the FAA ban, which was implemented after a Hamas rocket landed near the airport on Tuesday. Many international airlines canceled their Tel Aviv flights following the initial ban. The FAA stated it had worked closely with other U.S. government agencies and Israeli officials to assess the security situation. The agency 'carefully reviewed' updated information and new measures implemented by Israel to address potential risks to civil aviation. Two U.S. officials said security conditions in Tel Aviv remained largely the same as before the ban, but Israel had provided more details about airport protections. A State Department official noted that the situation in Tel Aviv had not changed in the past three days. Another U.S. official warned that authorities are closely watching developments, and the flight ban could return if necessary. Sources told CNN that the FAA, along with the U.S. intelligence community and other agencies, engaged in intense consultations with Israel after the ban went into effect. According to State Department spokesperson Marie Harf, new information and enhanced Israeli security measures led to lifting the ban. An official explained that while there wasn't substantial new intelligence, the U.S. gained a better understanding of procedures for flights in and out of the airport. Israeli authorities improved their protocols and shared information about their defense capabilities, which reassured U.S. officials. Although U.S. airlines operate only a few flights to Israel each day, FAA safety directives influence airline operations worldwide and can affect future bookings. Air Canada announced via Twitter it would resume flights to Israel Thursday night. Spain's Iberia Airlines also planned to restart services, even operating a larger-than-usual aircraft for the flight. British Airways maintained its twice-daily flights throughout the ban, while the Lufthansa Group—including Austrian Airlines and Swiss International Air Lines—extended cancellations through Friday. The FAA ban was publicly challenged by Israeli leaders and criticized by high-profile U.S. figures, such as former New York Mayor Michael Bloomberg, who flew to Tel Aviv to demonstrate his disapproval, and Senator Ted Cruz, who alleged the ban was intended to pressure Israel into a cease-fire. Deputy White House National Security Adviser Antony Blinken told CNN that politics did not influence the FAA’s actions. Blinken emphasized that the FAA acts independently to ensure safety and security for U.S. airlines and passengers. Bloomberg, after landing in Tel Aviv, called the FAA ban a mistake, noting that halting flights would have severe consequences for both Israel and the United States. The situation highlights ongoing travel anxieties caused by unrest in both Ukraine and Israel, as many flights operate over areas of conflict.
translated_content: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकाले अब अमेरिकी वायुसेवा कम्पनीहरूलाई तेल अवीव, इजरायलमा उडान गर्न रोक लगाएको प्रतिबन्ध हटाएको छ। फेडरल एभिएसन प्रशासन (एफएए) ले बुधबार राति यो निर्णय गरेको हो, मध्यपूर्वमा भइरहेको हिंसात्मक घटनापछि करिब ३६ घण्टा अघि विमानोंमा रोक लगाइएको थियो। एयरलाइन्सहरू छिट्टै सेवा पुनः बहाल गर्न अघि बढे। बिहीबार, डेल्टा एयर लाइन्स, युनाइटेड एयर लाइन्स, र यूएस एयरवेजले इजरायलको सबैभन्दा व्यस्त विमानस्थल बेन गुरियन अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विमानस्थलमा फेरि उडान सुरु गर्ने घोषणा गरे। युरोपियन एभिएसन सेफ्टी एजेन्सीले पनि बेन गुरियनमा उडान नगर्न सल्लाह दिएको आफ्नो सिफारिस फिर्ता लियो। इजरायली अधिकारीहरू, जसमा प्रधानमन्त्री बेन्जामिन नेतन्याहु पनि थिए, एफएएको प्रतिबन्ध हटाउन वाशिंगटनलाई दबाब दिएका थिए। उक्त प्रतिबन्ध मंगलबार हमासको रकेट विमानस्थल नजिकै खसेपछि लगाइएको थियो। सुरुवाती प्रतिबन्धपछि धेरै अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय एयरलाइन्सहरूले तेल अवीवका उडानहरू रद्द गरेका थिए। एफएएले सुरक्षा अवस्था मूल्यांकन गर्न अन्य अमेरिकी निकाय र इजरायली अधिकारीहरूसँग मिलेर काम गरेको बतायो। एजेन्सीले इजरायलले नागरिक विमाननमा सम्भावित जोखिमहरूको समाधानका लागि ल्याएका नयाँ जानकारी र उपायहरू 'ध्यानपूर्वक समीक्षा' गरेको जनाएको छ। दुईजना अमेरिकी अधिकारीहरूले बताए अनुसार, प्रतिबन्ध लगाउनु अघि र अहिले तेल अवीवको सुरक्षा अवस्था झन्डै उस्तै छ, तर इजरायलले विमानस्थल सुरक्षाका बारेमा थप विवरण दिएको छ। राज्य विभागका एक अधिकारीले भने कि ३ दिन अगाडिको अवस्था अहिले पनि उस्तै छ। अर्का अमेरिकी अधिकारीले भने अवस्थामाथि नजिकबाट निगरानी भइरहेको र आवश्यक परेमा प्रतिबन्ध फेरि लागू हुन सक्ने उल्लेख गरे। सीएनएनका स्रोतहरूका अनुसार, एफएए, अमेरिकी गुप्तचर संस्था तथा अन्य निकायले प्रतिबन्धपछि इजरायलसँग गहिरो छलफल गरेका थिए। राज्य विभागकी प्रवक्ता मारी हार्फका अनुसार, नयाँ जानकारी र इजरायली सुरक्षा उपायहरूले प्रतिबन्ध हटाउनमा भूमिका खेले। एक अधिकारीका अनुसार, ठूलो नयाँ गुप्त जानकारी नभए पनि अमेरिकाले विमानहरू आवतजावत हुने प्रक्रियाबारे राम्रो बुझाई पाएको थियो। इजरायली अधिकारीहरूले आफ्नो सुरक्षा प्रोटोकल सुधार गरे र रक्षा क्षमताबारे नयाँ जानकारी सेयर गरे, जसले अमेरिकी अधिकारीहरूलाई ढुक्क बनायो। यद्यपि अमेरिकी एयरलाइन्सहरूले दैनिक थोरै मात्र उडानहरू सञ्चालन गर्छन्, एफएएका सुरक्षासम्बन्धी निर्देशनहरू विश्वव्यापी रुपमा प्रभाव पार्न सक्छन्। एयर क्यानडाले ट्विटरमार्फत बिहीबारदेखि इजरायलका उडान पुनः सुरु गर्ने घोषणा गर्‍यो। स्पेनको आइबेरिया एयरलाइन्सले पनि ठूलो विमानबाट सेवा फेरि सुरु गर्ने बतायो। ब्रिटिश एयरवेजले पूरै प्रतिबन्ध अवधिभर आफ्नो दुई उडान सञ्चालन गरेको थियो, जबकि लुफ्थान्सा समूह (अष्ट्रियन एयरलाइन्स, स्विस इन्टरनेशनल एयरलाइन्स) ले शुक्रबारसम्म सबै उडानहरू रद्द गरेको छ। एफएए प्रतिबन्ध इजरायली नेतालाई खुलेर चुनौती दिइएको थियो र केही चर्चित अमेरिकी नेताहरू — जस्तै पूर्व न्यूयोर्क मेयर माइकल ब्लूमबर्ग, जसले तेल अवीवमा पुगेर आपत्ति जनाए, र सिनेटर टेड क्रुज, जसले इजरायललाई युद्धविरामको दबाब दिन प्रतिबन्ध लगाइएको आरोप लगाए — ले आलोचना गरे। श्वेत सदनका उपराष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा सल्लाहकार एन्टोनी ब्लिंकनले सीएनएनसँग राजनीतिक पक्षपातले एफएएको निर्णयमा कुनै असर नगरेको बताए। उनले एफएए स्वतन्त्र तवरले यात्रु सुरक्षाका लागि निर्णय लिने निकाय भएको उल्लेख गरे। ब्लूमबर्गले तेल अवीव पुगेपछि प्रतिबन्धलाई गल्ती भन्दै यस्तो निर्णयले अमेरिका र इजरायल दुवैलाई ठूलो असर पार्ने बताए। यो घटनाले युक्रेन र इजरायलको अशान्तिका कारण यात्रा सम्बन्धी चिन्ता बढेको देखाउँछ, किनभने धेरै विमानहरू द्वन्द्वग्रस्त क्षेत्रमा उडिरहेका छन्।

article_content:
Immediately after the January 12 earthquake in Haiti, Drs. Claude and Yolene Surena cared for over a hundred injured people outside their home in Port-au-Prince. With most hospitals either destroyed or overcrowded, makeshift care centers like theirs were critical in helping patients survive until hospital beds became available.

After hearing of the disaster, Yolene Surena contacted her daughter, Fabiola Surena—a U.S. Army staff sergeant and physician’s assistant student in Maryland—asking her for help. Fabiola gathered eight relatives and friends with ties to Haiti and traveled to Port-au-Prince, bringing medical supplies and food, and checking on family members. Only Fabiola in the group had medical training; they shared updates on their journey via CNN’s iReport.

The group arrived via the Dominican Republic and found the Surenas’ home intact but crowded with patients suffering from severe injuries, such as crushed or broken bones, and chronic illnesses left untreated when medications were buried in the rubble. Medical supplies were extremely limited; they had only first aid items, suture kits, and some over-the-counter medicine, and the only available surgeon had little real-world experience. This left many patients at risk of serious infection or the need for later amputations.

Fabiola and the group provided basic care—dressing wounds, ensuring patients took medication, and assisting with hygiene—while also searching for hospitals that could take the most critical patients. Supplies of food, water, and especially painkillers for children remained dangerously low. The family and patients often shared very simple meals, sometimes only once a day.

Fabiola described the situation as deeply emotional and exhausting. The trauma lingered, with people flinching at sudden noises that reminded them of aftershocks. Locals brought the wounded to the Surenas’ house, knowing that Claude and Yolene were experienced doctors. Claude leads the Haitian Medical Association and manages disaster preparedness for Rotary International.

The volunteers also reconnected with family members, but some—including Anne-Rene Louis’ grandfather and a maid—were killed in the disaster. Soraya Louis, a student from Connecticut, was rescued after being trapped in debris for hours. Other family members survived, with some injuries.

As more patients were moved to hospitals, only about twenty needing help remained at the Surenas’ house. Claude became Haiti’s disaster medical coordinator, and Yolene helped the government set up functioning hospitals. Some U.S. volunteers started working with Claude, managing hospital supply logistics.

While the group planned to return to the United States soon, some hoped to come back to assist further. Survivors like Soraya Louis expressed relief and gratitude for their family’s support, which gave them strength during a difficult time.

हैतिमा जनवरी १२ को विनाशकारी भूकम्पपछि, डा. क्लाउड र योलिन सुरेना आफ्नै पोर्ट-ओ-प्रिन्स घरको बाहिर सयभन्दा बढी घाइतेहरूको उपचार गर्दै थिए। धेरै अस्पतालहरू ध्वस्त अथवा क्षमताभन्दा बढी भरिएका थिए, जसले गर्दा उनीहरूको घरजस्तै अस्थायी उपचार केन्द्रहरु बिरामीहरुलाई अस्पतालको शैया नभएसम्म जिउँदो राख्न अत्यन्त महत्वपूर्ण बने।

विपदको खबर पाएपछि, योलिन सुरेनाले छोरी फाबिओला सुरेना—मेरील्यान्डमा अमेरिकी सेनामा कार्यरत र फिजिसियन एसिस्टेन्ट अध्ययनरत—लाई सहायता मागेर खबर गरिन्। फाबिओलाले हैतिसँग नाता भएका आठ जना आफन्त र साथीहरूलाई सङ्कलन गरी, चिकित्सकीय सामग्री र खाद्यान्न लिएर पोर्ट-ओ-प्रिन्स पुगिन्। समूहमा केवल फाबिओलासँग औपचारिक स्वास्थ्य तालिम थियो; उनीहरूले आफ्ना अनुभव सीएनएनको आइरिपोर्टमा साझेदारी गरे।

समूह डोमिनिकन गणराज्य हुँदै आइपुग्दा सुरेनाको घर सुरक्षित थियो, तर ठूलाठूला चोटपटक तथा औषधि गुमाएका दीर्घरोगी बिरामीहरूले घर भरिएर गाह्रो बनाइरहेका थिए। उपचार सामग्री अत्यन्त कम थिए; केवल प्राथमिक उपचारका सामान, सिलाउने किट र सामान्य औषधि मात्र थिए, अनि सहयोगी सर्जनसँग खास अनुभव थिएन। यसकारण, कतिपय बिरामीमा संक्रमण बढ्ने डर थियो वा पछि अंग काट्नुपर्ने हुनसक्थ्यो।

फाबिओला र समूहले घाउ पट्टी बाँध्ने, औषधि खुवाउने, सरसफाइमा सहयोग गर्ने लगायत आधारभूत उपचारमा हात बटुल्दै गम्भीर अवस्थाका बिरामीका लागि अस्पताल खोज्ने प्रयास गरे। खाद्यान्न, पानी र विशेष गरी छोराछोरीका लागि पीडाबाट छुट्कारा दिने औषधि सधैँ कम पर्थ्यो। परिवार र बिरामीहरूले प्रायः चामल, दाल र टुना लगायत सादा खाना, कतिपय दिन त केवल एकछाक खान्थे।

फाबिओलाले यो अनुभव निकै भावुक पार्ने र थकाऊ भएको बताइन्। धेरैजना बाहिरबाट नहेरिएको भए पनि आत्माअन्तरमा ठुलो आघात झेलिरहेका थिए; सानो आवाजले पनि भूकम्पको त्रास दोहोर्याउँथ्यो। गाउँलेहरूले सुरेनाहरू अनुभवी चिकित्सक भएको थाहा पाएर घाइतेहरू ल्याउँथे। क्लाउड हैटियन मेडिकल एशोसिएसनका अध्यक्ष र रोटरी इन्टरनेसनलको विपत् व्यवस्थापनको नेतृत्वमा थिए।

स्वयंसेवकहरू आफन्तसँग मिल्दाको भावुकता पनि थियो; एनी-रेने लुइसका हजुरबुबा र घरको कामदारले ज्यान गुमाए। कनेक्टिकटका छात्रा सोराया लुइस भग्नावशेषमा अल्झिएर बाँचेकी हुन्। अन्य आफन्त घाइते भए तापनि बाँच्न सफल भए।

अस्पतालमा बिरामी सार्न थालिएपछि अब सुरेनाको घरमा करीब २० मात्र बाँकी थिए। क्लाउड हैतीको विपद् स्वास्थ्य समन्वयक बने भने योलिनले सरकारी स्तरमा अस्पताल सञ्चालनमा सघाइन्। केही अमेरिकी स्वयंसेवकले पनि क्लाउडसँग काम गर्दै अस्पताल सामग्री व्यवस्थापनमा सहयोग गरे।

समूह चाँडै अमेरिकातिर फर्कने तयारीमा थियो, तर केही फेरि फर्केर सहायता गर्न चाहन्थे। बाँच्न सफल सोराया लुइसले परिवारको साथ र सहयोगले यस्तो कठिन घडीमा बल मिल्ने बताइन्।

article_content: The Sultan of Sokoto and President-General of the Nigeria Supreme Council for Islamic Affairs, Alhaji Mohammed Saad Abubakar, has urged Muslims to seek knowledge about people of other faiths to promote peaceful coexistence in the country. He gave this advice at the 10th Usmanu Danfodiyo annual lecture held on Saturday in Ilorin, Kwara State. The lecture, titled 'The Concept of God in Major World Religions,' was delivered by renowned Malaysian Islamic scholar Dr. Zakir AbdulKarim Naik. Alhaji Abubakar encouraged Muslims to gain understanding of the words of God and apply them to become better individuals. He stated that the purpose of the Usman Danfodiyo annual lecture is to encourage Muslims to seek knowledge and share it to strengthen Islam. According to the Sultan, the Sokoto Caliphate was founded on the basis of knowledge, and it is the responsibility of all Muslims to pursue learning, pass it down to their children, and spread accurate information about Islam to counter fake news.
translated_content: नाइजेरिया सुप्रिम काउन्सिल फर इस्लामिक अफेयर्सका अध्यक्ष तथा सोकोटोका सुल्तान, अल्हाजी मुहम्मद साद अबुबाकरले मुस्लिमहरुलाई शान्तिपूर्ण सहअस्तित्वका लागि अन्य धर्मका मानिसहरूको बारेमा ज्ञान प्राप्त गर्न आग्रह गर्नुभएको छ। उहाँले शनिबार क्वारा राज्यको इलोरिनमा सम्पन्न १०औं उस्मानु दानफोडियो वार्षिक व्याख्यानमा यस्तो सल्लाह दिनुभएको थियो। ‘विश्वका प्रमुख धर्महरूमा भगवानको अवधारणा’ शीर्षकको व्याख्यान प्रतिष्ठित मलेसियाली इस्लामिक विद्वान् डा. जाकिर अब्दुलकरिम नाइकले प्रस्तुत गर्नुभएको थियो। अल्हाजी अबुबाकरले मुस्लिमहरुलाई परमेश्वरका शब्दहरुको ज्ञान प्राप्त गरी त्यसलाई व्यवहारमा उतार्न र असल मान्छे बन्न प्रेरित हुन भन्नुभयो। उहाँले उस्मान दानफोडियो वार्षिक व्याख्यानको उद्देश्य मुस्लिमहरुलाई ज्ञान लिन र अरूसँग बाँड्न प्रोत्साहित गर्नु रहेको बताउनुभयो। सुल्तानका अनुसार सोकोटो खलिफत ज्ञानमा आधारित रहेकाले सबै मुस्लिमहरुले अध्ययन गर्न, त्यो ज्ञान आफ्ना सन्तानलाई दिन र इस्लामबारे सही सूचना फैलाउन कर्तव्य रहेको बताउनुभयो, जसले गलत समाचारलाई नियन्त्रण गर्न सघाउँछ।

article_content: The Biden administration is investing $7 billion in clean hydrogen energy initiatives across seven states, aiming to accelerate America’s transition from fossil fuels. This effort focuses on building regional hydrogen hubs in California, Washington, Minnesota, Texas, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, and Illinois, enabling hydrogen to power vehicles, manufacturing, and electricity generation. President Biden’s broader goal is to reach net-zero carbon emissions nationwide by 2050. According to the White House, hydrogen works alongside renewables like wind and solar to reduce pollution in challenging industries—such as steelmaking, transportation, and shipping. It is anticipated that these selected projects will spur more than $40 billion in private investment and bring tens of thousands of new jobs, including many union positions. The hubs were chosen from 23 finalists and represent collaborations among states, energy companies, and research organizations. Pennsylvania, a key battleground for future elections, stands to benefit from both the Appalachian and Mid-Atlantic hydrogen hubs. The Appalachian hub, covering West Virginia and Pennsylvania, will produce hydrogen from natural gas and attempt to capture the resulting carbon emissions, supporting areas previously reliant on coal. Major partners include Pittsburgh-area energy firms and KeyState, led by Perry Babb. The Mid-Atlantic hub, supported by Pennsylvania, Delaware, and New Jersey, aims to produce hydrogen via electrolysis using renewable power sources like wind, solar, and nuclear, in pursuit of maximum environmental benefits. California’s Alliance for Renewable Clean Hydrogen Energy Systems will use renewable energy and biomass for hydrogen production. The Gulf Coast Hydrogen Hub in Houston plans to make hydrogen from both natural gas and renewables. Minnesota’s Heartland hub will focus on decarbonizing agriculture and supporting clean electricity and heating, with equity opportunities for tribal nations and local farmers. The Midwest hub—covering Illinois, Indiana, and Michigan—plans to use hydrogen in steel, glass, transport, and aviation sectors, with energy sourced from renewables, natural gas, and nuclear. The Pacific Northwest hub, anchored in eastern Washington, will employ hydropower and other renewables to produce clean hydrogen, potentially creating thousands of jobs. This nationwide effort includes public, academic, and private sector partners. However, environmental groups remain skeptical, cautioning that hydrogen production from fossil fuels emits greenhouse gases unless effective carbon capture is proven. Critics like Silas Grant from the Center for Biological Diversity accuse the administration of not prioritizing fully renewable hydrogen and falling short on ambitious climate goals.
translated_content: बाइडेन प्रशासनले सात राज्यहरू (क्यालिफोर्निया, वाशिंगटन, मिनेसोटा, टेक्सास, पेनसिल्भेनिया, वेस्ट भर्जिनिया, इलिनोइस) मा सफा हाइड्रोजन ऊर्जा परियोजनामा ७ अर्ब डलर लगानी गर्दैछ, जसको उद्देश्य अमेरिकालाई जीवाश्म इन्धनबाट सफा ऊर्जातर्फ सार्नु हो। यो योजनाले सवारी साधन, उद्योग र बिजुली उत्पादनमा हाइड्रोजनको प्रयोग बढाउने, क्षेत्रीय हाइड्रोजन हब बनाउने र २०५० सम्म नेट-जरोज उत्सर्जन लक्ष्यमा सहयोग गर्नेछ। ह्वाइट हाउसका अनुसार हाइड्रोजनले पवन र सौर्य ऊर्जा जस्ता नवीकरणीय स्रोतसँग मिलेर स्टिल, यातायात र ढुवानी जस्ता चुनौतीपूर्ण क्षेत्रमा प्रदुषण घटाउन सहायक छ। छानिएका परियोजनाबाट ४० अर्ब डलरभन्दा बढी निजी लगानी र हजारौं नयाँ, धेरै यूनियन रोजगारी सिर्जना गर्ने विश्वास गरिएको छ। हबहरू राज्य, ऊर्जा कम्पनी र अनुसन्धान संस्थाहरूको सहकार्यमा बनेका छन्। चुनावी हिसाबले महत्त्वपूर्ण पेनसिल्भेनिया राज्यले एप्लाचियन र मिड-एटलान्टिक दुवै हाइड्रोजन हबबाट लाभ उठाउनेछ। एप्लाचियन हबले वेस्ट भर्जिनिया र पेनसिल्भेनियामा प्राकृतिक ग्यासबाट हाइड्रोजन बनाएर कार्बन नियन्त्रण गर्ने प्रयास गर्दैछ; प्रमुख साझेदारहरूमा पिट्सबर्ग क्षेत्रका ऊर्जा कम्पनी र पेरी बब नेतृत्वको के-स्टेट छन्। मिड-एटलान्टिक हब (पेनसिल्भेनिया, डेलावेयर, न्यू जर्सी) ले नवीकरणीय र आणविक उर्जाबाट विद्युतीय विधिबाट हाइड्रोजन उत्पादन गर्नेछ। क्यालिफोर्नियाको एलायन्स फर रिन्यूएबल क्लिन हाइड्रोजन इनर्जी सिस्टम्सले नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा र बायोमासबाट हाइड्रोजन उत्पादन गर्छ। गल्फ कोस्ट हाइड्रोजन हब (ह्युस्टन) ले प्राकृतिक ग्यास र नवीकरणीय दुवै स्रोत प्रयोग गर्छ। मिनेसोटाको हार्टल्यान्ड हबले कृषि, बिजुली, न्यानोपनमा हाइड्रोजनको उपयोग गर्दैछ र आदिवासी तथा किसानहरूसमेतमा इक्विटीको अवसर दिन्छ। मिडवेस्ट हब (इलिनोइस, इन्डियाना, मिशिगन) ले स्टिल, गिलास, यातायात र हवाइमा विविध ऊर्जास्रोतबाट हाइड्रोजन प्रयोग गर्ने योजना छ। प्रशान्त उत्तरपश्चिम (पूर्वी वाशिंगटन) हबले जलविद्युत र नवीकरणीय ऊर्जाबाट सफा हाइड्रोजन उत्पादन गर्नेछ, जसले हजारौँ रोजगारी ल्याउने अपेक्षा छ। यो पहल सरकारी, निजी तथा शैक्षिक साझेदारीमा छ। तर, वातावरणविद्हरूको चिन्ता छ कि जीवाश्म इन्धन प्रयोग गरिए प्रभावकारी कार्बन नियन्त्रण नभएसम्म हाइड्रोजन उत्पादनले ग्रीनहाउस उत्सर्जनमा खासै कमि नल्याउन सक्छ। सेन्टर फर बायोलॉजिकल डाइभर्सिटीका साइलास ग्रान्टजस्ता आलोचकहरूले १००% नवीकरणीय हाइड्रोजनलाई प्राथमिकता नदिएको भन्दै सरकारको जलवायु प्रतिबद्धतामा प्रश्न उठाएका छन्।

Marcos Rojo, Manchester United’s £16 million signing from Sporting Lisbon, will travel to Lisbon on Friday to collect his work visa, resolving a delay caused by his alleged involvement in a 2010 criminal investigation, for which he has not been charged. Rojo had entered England last month on a tourist visa, even though he automatically qualified for a work permit—having played in 75% of Argentina’s international matches over the past two years.

Despite not having his work permit, Rojo was allowed to train with Manchester United. He will now visit the British Embassy in Lisbon to finalize his paperwork, which will let him enter the UK on a work visa and make him eligible to debut against Queens Park Rangers next Sunday, September 14. 

United confirmed on Thursday that the UK Border Agency has officially approved Rojo's visa. Rojo, 24, was with Argentina’s squad in Germany this week and earned his 29th international cap in their match against Germany.

article_content: A young family endangered themselves by camping at the base of a precarious 150-foot cliff in Burton Bradstock, Dorset, just meters from a spot where a woman died the previous year due to falling rocks. Ignoring clear warning signs and a ban on camping, the couple and their toddler spent the night on the rocky shoreline shortly after a nearby landslide at East Cliff, West Bay. Witnesses Doug Randle and Maureen Joyce observed the family leaving their tent near signs warning of serious risks from rockfalls, including potential injury or death. Randle expressed shock that the family appeared unaware of the danger, despite camping right beside caution signs, especially in the wake of recent local landslides. Authorities have reiterated that overnight camping is not permitted along the Jurassic Coast, which is maintained by the National Trust, due to the unstable landscape. Heavy rainfall recently contributed to another cliff collapse near Freshwater Beach Holiday Park, leading maritime officials to urge the public to avoid unstable cliffs and always respect posted warnings. Dorset County Council has been notified and is investigating the newest cliff fall. The Coastguard continues to remind visitors to exercise caution and responsibility along these fragile coastlines, as erosion and landslides remain ongoing hazards.

article_content: Satya Nadella, the CEO of Microsoft, appears to doubt whether Bing, the company’s search engine, can compete with Google. Earlier this week, during the US Department of Justice’s antitrust case against Google, Nadella testified in Washington, DC, stating that Google used unfair practices to dominate the search engine market—including over Bing, according to The Wall Street Journal. Nadella highlighted Google’s agreements with Apple, making Google the default search engine on Safari, as a key factor in Google’s leadership. 'You get up in the morning, you brush your teeth, and you search on Google,' he told the Justice Department. 'With that level of habit forming, the only way to change is by changing defaults.' He described a 'vicious cycle' for Microsoft, saying that Bing can’t break through. Nadella expressed doubts that Microsoft’s AI advancements alone would allow Bing to surpass Google, explaining, 'The distribution advantage Google has today doesn't go away.' He added, 'I worry a lot that—even in spite of my enthusiasm that there is a new angle with AI—this vicious cycle could become even more entrenched as defaults are reinforced.' The DOJ filed its lawsuit against Google in October 2020, alleging that the company used 'anticompetitive and exclusionary practices' to dominate online search. The trial began last month and continues. Google did not immediately respond to Insider’s request for comment before publication. Microsoft also declined to comment. Nadella’s comments follow Microsoft’s recent major investment in AI. In January, Microsoft announced a $10 billion investment in OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT. The following month, Microsoft launched a beta version of its new AI-powered Bing, releasing it to the public in May. The company projected this new Bing could add $2 billion in ad revenue. These developments prompted Google to ramp up its AI efforts. In December, CEO Sundar Pichai moved several teams to work on Google’s own AI products, and right before Microsoft announced the updated Bing, Google unveiled its AI chatbot, Bard. Despite these moves, Bing still struggles to gain market share. As of September, Statcounter reported Bing held only 3.03% of the online search market, while Google maintained 91.56%. Search consultant Daniel Tunkelang, a former Google employee, told the Journal in August that the revamped Bing is 'cute, but not a game changer.'

एन्टि-ट्रस्ट मुद्दाको क्रममा नडेलाले वाशिंगटन डीसीमा न्याय विभागमा बयान दिँदै बताए कि गुगलले अनौठो अभ्यासहरू प्रयोग गरेर सर्च इन्जिन बजारमा आफ्नो प्रभुत्व जमाएको छ—Bing माथि समेत, The Wall Street Journal का अनुसार। नडेलाले गुगल र एपलबीचको सहमति (सफारी ब्राउजरमा गुगललाई डिफल्ट सर्च बनाइएको) ले गुगलको नेतृत्वलाई महत्वपूर्ण बनाएको बताए। उनले भने, 'तपाईं बिहान उठ्नुहुन्छ, दाँत माझ्नुहुन्छ, अनि गुगलमा सर्च गर्नुहुन्छ। त्यस्तो बानी परेपछि, परिवर्तनको एक मात्र उपाय डिफल्ट परिवर्तन गर्नु हो।' उनले माइक्रोसफ्टका लागि 'विकट चक्र' भएको बताए, जसले गर्दा Bing सफल हुन सकेको छैन। नडेलाले एआईमा माइक्रोसफ्टको प्रगतिको भरमा मात्र Bing ले गुगललाई पार गर्न सक्दैन भन्ने आशंका व्यक्त गरे। उनले भने, 'गुगलसँग भएको वितरणको फाइदा आजपनि हटेको छैन।' उनले थपे, 'मलाई डर लाग्छ—एआईप्रति मेरो उत्साह हुँदाहुँदै पनि—यो विकट चक्र झन् बलियो बन्न सक्छ, किनभने डिफल्ट मै बलियो बनाइन्छ।' न्याय विभागले अक्टोबर २०२० मा गुगलविरुद्ध मुद्दा दर्ता गरेको थियो, जसमा 'प्रतिस्पर्धाविरोधी र बहिष्करण गतिविधि' प्रयोग गरेको आरोप छ। मुद्दा गत महिनाबाट नै सुरु भएको हो र अझै चलिरहेको छ। गुगलले समाचार प्रकाशित हुनुअघि कुनै प्रतिक्रिया दिएको छैन। माइक्रोसफ्टले पनि टिप्पणी गर्न अस्वीकार गरेको छ। नडेलाका टिप्पणी माइक्रोसफ्टले एआईमा ठूलो लगानी गरेपछि आएका हुन्। जनवरीमा, माइक्रोसफ्टले OpenAI (ChatGPT बनाउने कम्पनी) मा $10 अर्ब लगानी घोषणा गर्यो। त्योपछि फेब्रुअरीमा, माइक्रोसफ्टले नयाँ एआई-समर्थित Bing को बीटा सार्वजनिक गर्यो, जुन मेदेखि सबैका लागि खोलिएको थियो। कम्पनीका अनुसार, नयाँ Bing ले वार्षिक $2 अर्बको विज्ञापन आम्दानी थप्न सक्छ। यी प्रतिस्पर्धाका कारण गुगलले एआईमा आफ्नो प्रयास तीब्र बनाएको छ। डिसेम्बरमा, CEO सुन्दर पिचाईले कम्पनीका धेरै टिमलाई आफ्नै एआई उत्पादनमा काम गर्न लगाएका थिए। माइक्रोसफ्टले नयाँ Bing सार्वजनिक गर्नु अघिल्लो दिन गुगलले AI Chatbot Bard ल्याएको थियो। यी प्रयासहरूका बावजुद Bing को बजार हिस्सा विस्तार हुन सकेको छैन। Statcounter अनुसार, सेप्टेम्बरमा Bing को मार्केट सेयर मात्र ३.०३% थियो भने गुगलको ९१.५६% थियो। सर्च कन्सल्टन्ट तथा गुगलका पूर्व कर्मचारी ड्यानियल article_content: British Airways is overhauling its Avios loyalty scheme, significantly cutting the number of points earned by passengers who buy the lowest-cost economy tickets. Starting April 28, these travelers will receive only a quarter of the air miles they do now. Meanwhile, business and first-class flyers will see their points increase by up to 300 percent. This move has caused widespread frustration among loyal BA customers. Many, who have long collected Avios points to make travel more affordable, voiced anger on social media, saying the changes benefit big spenders and make it harder for families and budget travelers to access rewards. The updated program ties point earnings more closely to ticket price. Now, the more you pay, the more points you earn—regardless of ticket class. This means someone buying a discounted economy fare will get far fewer Avios than another economy traveler who pays a higher price for flexibility. For example, under the new rules a London–Vancouver return in economy could drop from 9,400 to just 2,350 points, while business and first-class travelers could see their points climb sharply for the same route. BA is also introducing peak and off-peak pricing for Avios reward flights. For most of the year, fewer points may be needed, but during busy times, such as school holidays and Christmas, more will be required. As an example, a flight to Rome will require 7,500 points in July, but just 6,500 in January. On the upside, BA is adding 500,000 new Avios redemption seats each year, bringing the total to nine million. It guarantees at least four economy and two business class Avios seats will be available on every flight. Other changes affect frequent flyers. Silver tier executive club members will have their bonus halved, which could make it harder to maintain perks like airport lounge access and priority boarding. Passengers outside London will lose the free domestic connecting flight to Europe, aligning BA’s policy with most other airlines. Although British Airways says these changes are more equitable—since earnings match spending—many travelers believe the modifications largely sideline regular, budget-conscious customers. Social media erupted with criticism, with users accusing the airline of making rewards less accessible for those who depend on them most.
translated_content: ब्रिटिश एयरवेजले आफ्नो अवियोज ल्याल्टी स्किममा ठूलो परिवर्तन गर्दैछ, जसअनुसार सबैभन्दा सस्तो इकोनोमी टिकट किनेका यात्रुहरूले अहिले पाइरहेको तुलनामा केवल २५% अंक मात्र पाउनेछन्। अप्रिल २८ देखि लागू हुने यो व्यवस्था अनुसार यी यात्रुहरूले ७५% कम एयर माइल्स पाउनेछन्। त्यही बेला, बिजनेस र फर्स्ट क्लासमा यात्रा गर्नेले भने अघिल्लो भन्दा ३०० प्रतिशतसम्म धेरै पोइन्ट कमाउनेछन्। यस घोषणापछि धेरै नियमित ग्राहकहरू निराश देखिएका छन्। वर्षौंदेखि अवियोज संकलन गर्दै आएका यात्रुहरूले सामाजिक सञ्जालमा महंगा टिकट किन्नेहरूलाई मात्र फाइदा हुने गरी योजना बदलिएको भन्दै आलोचना गरेका छन् र परिवार तथा सस्तो टिकट प्रयोग गर्नेलाई कठिन हुने बताएका छन्। अबको नयाँ योजना अनुसार पोइन्ट कमाउने आधार टिकट वर्ग नभई किनेको मूल्यमा निर्भर हुनेछ। जसले गर्दा छुटमा सस्तो इकोनोमी टिकट किन्दा अवियोज पोइन्ट निकै कम मिल्नेछ। उदाहरणका लागि, लन्डन–भ्यानकुभर फर्कि जाने इकोनोमिक टिकटमा पहिले पाइने ९,४०० अंक घटेर अब केवल २,३५० अंक मात्र पाइनेछ। त्यहीँ, बिजनेस वा फर्स्ट क्लास यात्रुका अंक भने उल्लेख्य रूपमा बढ्नेछन्। बीएले सिजन अनुसार 'पिक' र 'अफ पिक' रेवार्ड मूल्य निर्धारणसमेत ल्याउँदै छ—वर्षको धेरै समय कम पोइन्टमा उडान गर्न पाइनेछ, तर छुट्टी वा चाडपर्वमा बढी पोइन्ट चाहिनेछ। जस्तै, रोमको टिकट जुलाईमा ७,५००, जनवरीमा ६,५०० अंकमा पाइनेछ। यसबाहेक, बीएले ५ लाख बढी नयाँ अवियोज रेवार्ड सिट थप्दै नौ लाखमा पुर्‍याएको छ, हरेक विमानमा कम्तिमा चार इकोनोमी र दुई बिजनेस क्लास अवियोज सिट राखिने छ। अन्य परिवर्तनहरू हवाई यात्रा बारम्बार गर्नेहरूलाई असर गर्नेछन्। सिल्भर टियर क्लब सदस्यहरूको बोनस आधा हुने छ, जसले विमानस्थल लन्ज र प्राथमिकी बोर्डिङ जस्ता सेवा पाउन गाह्रो पार्नेछ। लन्डन बाहिर रहेका यात्रुले युरोप जाने बेलामा निःशुल्क घरेलु जडान गुमाउने छन्, जुन अरू धेरै एयरलाइन्समा प्रचलिनै छ। बीएले यी परिवर्तनलाई खर्च अनुसार समान मौका दिने भन्दै न्यायपूर्ण ठाने पनि, धेरैले इसोच कि नियमित तथा सस्तो टिकट प्रयोगकर्तालाई बेवास्ता गरिएको छ भनेर सामाजिक सञ्जालमा गुनासो पोखेका छन्।

article_content: Michael Brown, an unarmed teenager, was shot and killed in Ferguson, Missouri, on August 9. A teacher at Brantley Elementary School in Selma, Alabama, has been suspended pending investigation after allegations arose that she asked students to reenact the shooting. According to a Facebook post by Jessica Baughn, mother of a sixth grader at the school, the reenactment involved 11- and 12-year-old white students playing police officers and researching details of Michael Brown's death. Baughn expressed shock at the incident, stating that she was concerned about the safety and appropriateness of such activities in school. Dallas County Schools superintendent Don Willingham explained that the teacher was discussing current events when the shooting was mentioned, prompting a class 'skit'. Willingham has interviewed the teacher, principal, Baughn, and Baughn's son, and has placed the teacher on paid administrative leave while the issue is investigated, following standard procedure. Principal Audrey Larkin Strong emphasized that the school promotes diversity and does not support division or violence. Meanwhile, protests and unrest have continued in Ferguson, Missouri, since the death of Michael Brown. Police used tear gas and rubber bullets during confrontations with protesters. The identity of the officer involved, Darren Wilson, was initially withheld but later revealed. He is currently in hiding. Attorney General Eric Holder visited Ferguson, promising a fair investigation and urging peace.

article_content: Large-scale pro-democracy protests in Hong Kong led to a temporary closure of government buildings following heated confrontations between demonstrators and police. Protesters, defying police orders, assembled around Admiralty Centre during the morning rush, resulting in tense standoffs. Law enforcement used pepper spray and batons to disperse the crowds, leading to several injuries and making dozens of arrests. Demonstrators, who have been rallying for over two months, are calling for free and open elections for Hong Kong’s next leader in 2017, rather than choosing among Beijing-approved candidates. Many protesters wore helmets and goggles for protection and used umbrellas—now symbols of the movement—to shield themselves from police tactics. Volunteer medics attended to those injured by police action throughout the night. Riot police made multiple pushes to clear the area, causing scenes of chaos and people being forced to the ground. Further aggravating tensions, British lawmakers attempting a fact-finding visit to Hong Kong were barred entry by Chinese authorities. UK Prime Minister David Cameron criticized this decision, arguing it heightened concerns about Hong Kong’s autonomy since the 1997 handover under the 'one country, two systems' framework. Hong Kong Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying announced that authorities would take firmer action against the protesters, emphasizing that police patience had limits. Student leaders, including Nathan Law, encouraged activists to continue their campaign, describing it as a ‘long journey’. Protest activity also increased in districts like Mong Kok, a recent site of clashes. Protesters reinforced barricades and chanted calls for universal suffrage, even as overall turnout and public support have declined in recent weeks. The ongoing movement is considered one of the greatest challenges to the ruling Communist Party in Beijing since the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests. Although the number of demonstrators has fallen from earlier peaks of over 100,000, core activists remain firm despite continued police pressure and sporadic violence.

article_content: After months of defying federal authorities, Ed and Elaine Brown were arrested without resistance by U.S. Marshals at their heavily fortified home in Plainfield, New Hampshire. The couple had avoided surrendering for five months following their conviction for failing to pay $1.9 million in taxes owed between 1996 and 2003, some from Elaine's private dental clinic. They were each sentenced in their absence to up to five years in prison. Throughout their standoff, the Browns argued that no law requires them to pay federal income tax, insisting on their innocence. Despite having their utilities cut in June, they managed with alternative energy sources like solar panels, a wind turbine, and wood from their 103-acre estate. Their resistance turned their property into a gathering place for anti-government figures and supporters, including Randy Weaver, a Ruby Ridge survivor. Over the summer, the Browns hosted outdoor parties, inviting guests online to stand with them and protest income tax enforcement. According to U.S. Marshal Steve Monier, officials strived to avoid confrontation but were committed to carrying out the Browns’ sentences. In addition to prison for tax evasion, the couple now faces potential new charges. Four supporters accused of helping the Browns—including one allegedly providing security—were also arrested.

article_content: As storm Juno swept across the U.S. East Coast, most residents mainly saw heavy snowfall, but the perspective from space was quite different. American astronaut Terry Virts, aboard the International Space Station nearly 250 miles above Earth, captured images of the storm as it approached the coast and blurred the lights of major cities below. Last night, weather forecasters warned that two additional weather systems may bring more snow to New England in the coming days. Virts shared extraordinary images on Instagram, showing the storm moving over the East Coast. As the storm advanced, it obscured the city lights from above. A storm arriving late Thursday through Friday night is expected to bring 2 to 4 inches of snow to Connecticut, Rhode Island, and Massachusetts, according to Frank Nocera, a senior meteorologist at the National Weather Service. Eastern Massachusetts, including Boston and Cape Cod, could see up to six inches of snow, on top of the two to three feet that fell earlier this week. Forecasters are also watching another storm headed for the region this weekend, which could bring more snow or rain from late Sunday into Monday in Connecticut, Rhode Island, and southeastern Massachusetts. During the blizzard earlier this week, Worcester, central Massachusetts, received a record 34.5 inches of snow, while Boston had just over 24 inches, and Providence, Rhode Island, recorded about 19 inches. Satellite images captured on Monday and Wednesday show the extent of the snow covering the East Coast as Juno struck.

article_content: Membrane separation technology holds significant promise due to its low energy requirements and capability for continuous operation. Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) stand out as favorable candidates for membranes, thanks to their diverse structures, high porosity, and finely tunable pore architectures. Recently, a research team led by Prof. Yang Weishen and Assoc. Prof. Peng Yuan at the Dalian Institute of Chemical Physics (DICP), Chinese Academy of Sciences, proposed a novel approach for modular customization and non-destructive control of MOFs aimed at efficient membrane separations. This study was published in Angewandte Chemie International Edition on October 16. The researchers' strategy involves modularizing the fabrication of defect-free MOF separation membranes. The membrane design utilizes two parallel modules: one is a discrete MOF module utilizing the properties of heterogeneous nuclei to promote molecular transfer and separation through the material's inherent pore structure; the other is a highly cross-linked, low-permeability polyamide module, created via confined interface polymerization, which effectively prevents defects between MOF modules. This modular method enables quick customization of high-performance MOF separation membranes by swapping the MOF module based on the desired application. Importantly, the post-synthetic modification process maintains the MOF module's structural integrity, doubling the separation accuracy. To demonstrate the method, the team used four MOFs with varying pore sizes and functions to manufacture batches of defect-free MOF membranes, each showing separation performance linked to its pore size. The NH2-Zn2Bim4 membrane, in particular, achieved a high separation factor of 1656 for H2/CO2 mixtures and an H2 permeability of 964 gas permeation units. Further improvement was seen by applying post-synthetic ligand exchange, leading to around 200% higher H2/CO2 selectivity compared to the original membrane. "This strategy provides a practical route to create numerous high-performance membranes tailored to meet various separation needs," said Prof. Yang.
translated_content: झिल्ली पृथक्करण प्रविधि कम ऊर्जामा स्थायी रूपमा सञ्चालन गर्न सक्ने क्षमता र यसको उच्च सम्भावनाका कारण महत्वपूर्ण छ। धातु-साङ्गठित फ्रेमवर्कहरू (MOFs) विविध संरचना, उच्च छिद्रता र सूक्ष्म नियन्त्रणयोग्यता भएका कारण झिल्लीका लागि उपयुक्त मानिन्छन्। हालै, डेलियन इन्स्टिच्युट अफ केमिकल फिजिक्स (DICP), चिनियाँ विज्ञान अकादमीका प्रा. याङ वेइशेन र सह-प्रा. पेंग युआन नेतृत्वको टोलीले प्रभावकारी झिल्ली पृथक्करणका लागि MOF हरूको मोड्युलर अनुकूलन र अविनाशी नियमन रणनीति प्रस्तुत गरेका छन्। अध्ययन अक्टोबर १६ मा Angewandte Chemie International Edition मा प्रकाशित भएको हो। उक्त रणनीतिमा दोषरहित MOF झिल्लीहरु निर्माणका लागि दुई समानान्तर मोड्युल राखिएको छ: एउटा MOF को मौलिक छिद्र संरचनाबाट परमाणु स्थानान्तरण र पृथक्करणमा सघाउँदछ भने, अर्को सीमित इन्टरफेस पोलिमराइजेशनबाट बनेको क्रस-लिङ्क गरिएको कम पारगम्यता भएको पोलियामाइड मोड्युल हो, जसले MOF मोड्युलहरूबीचका दोषहरूलाई रोक्दछ। यस तरिकाले आवश्यक परे अनुरुप MOF मोड्युल परिवर्तन गरेर उच्च कार्यक्षमताका झिल्लीहरु छिट्टै उत्पादन गर्न सकिन्छ। विशेष कुरा के भने, पोस्ट-सिन्थेटिक सुधारपछि MOF संरचनामा कुनै नोक्सानी बिना नै पृथक्करण सटीकतामा दोब्बर वृद्धि हुन्छ। यस परीक्षणमा, फरक छिद्र र गुण भएका चार MOF हरूले बनाइएका झिल्लीहरुले छिद्र साइजअनुसार पृथक्करण प्रदर्शन देखाए। तीमध्ये, NH2-Zn2Bim4 झिल्लिले H2/CO2 पृथक्करण फैक्टर १६५६ र H2 पारगम्यता ९६४ ग्यास एकाइ देखायो। पोस्ट-सिन्थेटिक लिग्याण्ड एक्स्चेन्ज गरेपछि H2/CO2 चयनशीलता झन्डै २००% ले बढेको प्रष्ट भयो। "यस रणनीतिले विभिन्न पृथक्करण आवश्यकतामा अनुकूल हुने उच्च कार्यसम्पादन झिल्ली उत्पादनको व्यावहारिक बाटो देखाउँछ," प्रा. याङले भने।

article_content: Over the past weekend, several of the world's wealthiest and most famous figures—including Oprah Winfrey, Jeff Bezos, and LeBron James—gathered in Las Vegas for the opening night of U2's 25-show residency. However, the main attraction that night was arguably not the iconic Irish rock band, but the venue itself: the Sphere. The Sphere is a huge, dome-shaped music and entertainment arena, newly opened near the Las Vegas Strip. It gained viral fame after social media posts from the U2 concert showcased its stunning visuals and optical illusions inside the enormous orb. Officially opened this month and formerly called MSG Sphere, the venue took five years to build. The idea was conceived and largely funded by billionaire James Dolan, CEO of the Madison Square Garden Company, and designed by architecture firm Populous, which specializes in stadiums. According to the New York Times, the project went over budget and cost $2.3 billion. The Sphere is connected to The Venetian hotel and stands 366 feet tall and 516 feet wide. It features 168,000 speakers and a wrap-around LED screen, creating an immersive visual and audio environment, according to its website. The exterior LED screen can reportedly be seen from space. Recently, the Sphere’s exterior screen has been used for eye-catching displays, such as a smirking yellow emoji, a blinking eyeball, and even resembling a pumpkin, basketball, or the planet Earth. Reactions have been largely positive. One user on X (formerly Twitter) called it the 'best $2.5 billion ever spent,' sharing a video of the sphere as an emoji. Concertgoers posted videos of the Sphere's immersive visuals, including sunrises, wormholes, and desert dunes displayed on its massive interior screen. An attendee said on TikTok, 'So insane in person. Feels like an outdoor concert!' while Lauren Sanchez, Jeff Bezos' fiancée, wrote 'Just wow' on Instagram. Tickets for the U2 residency start at $140, but some resale prices go for several thousand dollars. The team behind the Sphere told Variety that they plan to host three to four artist residencies each year. In addition to U2's shows through December, the Sphere is also presenting 'Postcard from Earth,' described as 'part sci-fi story, part nature documentary' and directed by Darren Aronofsky. The next musical headliner has yet to be announced, though rumors suggest Harry Styles could be among those considered.

कन्सर्टका सामाजिक सञ्जाल पोस्टहरूले यो विशाल ओर्भ भित्रका रोचक भिजुअल्स र अप्टिकल इल्लुजन देखाएपछि यसले भाइरल लोकप्रियता पायो। यो महिना आधिकारिक रूपमा उद्घाटन भएको र पहिले MSG Sphere को नाममा चिनिएको यो स्थल बनाउन पाँच वर्ष लाग्यो। यो विचार अरबपति जेम्स डोलान (म्याडिसन स्क्वायर गार्डेन कम्पनीका सीईओ) को हो र स्टेडियम डिजाइनमा विशेषज्ञ Populous फर्मले डिजाइन गरेको हो। न्यूयोर्क टाइम्सका अनुसार, article_content: England have announced an unchanged squad for Saturday’s RBS 6 Nations clash against Italy at Twickenham. Head coach Stuart Lancaster has kept faith with the same starting XV and bench that secured a 21-16 victory over Wales in Cardiff during the Championship opener, a win that has positioned England as the new favourites for the title ahead of Ireland. Lancaster had hoped to select Geoff Parling as specialist second-row cover, possibly replacing Nick Easter or Tom Croft on the bench; however, Parling suffered a setback in his recovery from a knee injury. Championing squad consistency, Lancaster commented: 'It’s always good to name an unchanged team and build some consistency. We did the same after France last year heading into the Scotland game.' England reported a clean bill of health following a tough match in Cardiff, where Anthony Watson and Jonathan Joseph each scored a try. Joseph, alongside George Kruis, will make his first international start at Twickenham, resuming a promising centre partnership with Luther Burrell, with George Ford at fly-half orchestrating play. Dan Cole continues in the tighthead prop position, aiming to regain match fitness after injury interruptions last season, while Joe Marler retains his place as loosehead prop. England have never lost to Italy in 20 meetings since 1991, but three of the last five matches have been decided by seven points or fewer. When the teams last met at Twickenham two years ago, England won 18-11 through six penalties from Toby Flood. England enter as overwhelming favourites, having been Six Nations runners-up on points difference for the last two seasons. Lancaster asserted: 'Italy are always fired up when they come to Twickenham, especially following last week's loss to Ireland. We know what to expect, but we’re well prepared and looking forward to playing in front of our supporters.' The England team to face Italy: M Brown (Harlequins); A Watson (Bath), J Joseph (Bath), L Burrell (Northampton Saints), J May (Gloucester); G Ford (Bath), B Youngs (Leicester Tigers); J Marler (Harlequins), D Hartley (Northampton Saints), D Cole (Leicester Tigers), D Attwood (Bath), G Kruis (Saracens), J Haskell (Wasps), C Robshaw (Harlequins, capt), B Vunipola (Saracens). Replacements: T Youngs (Leicester Tigers), M Vunipola (Saracens), K Brookes (Newcastle Falcons), N Easter (Harlequins), T Croft (Leicester Tigers), R Wigglesworth (Saracens), D Cipriani (Sale Sharks), B Twelvetrees (Gloucester).
translated_content: इङ्ग्ल्यान्डले यस शनिबार ट्विकेनह्याममा इटालीको विरुद्ध आरबीएस ६ नेशन्स खेलका लागि अपरिवर्तित टिम घोषणा गरेको छ। प्रमुख प्रशिक्षक स्टुआर्ट ल्यानकास्टरले कार्डिफमा वेल्सलाई २१-१६ ले हराएको सुरुको खेलपछि सोही सुरुवाती १५ र बेन्च कायम राखेका छन्, जसले इङ्ग्ल्यान्डलाई आयरल्याण्डभन्दा अगाडि नयाँ उपाधि दावेदार बनाएको छ। ल्याङकास्टरले निक इस्टर या टम क्रफ्टलाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्दै विशेष दोस्रो रो कभरको रूपमा जियफ पार्लिङ छान्ने आशा गरेका थिए; तर, घुँडाको चोटको कारण पार्लिङ कतै पुन: टिममा फर्किन सकेनन्। टोलीको स्थिरता प्रशंसासाथ, ल्यानकास्टरले भने, ‘अपरिवर्तित टिम घोषणा गर्न पाउनु र स्थिरता बनाउनु राम्रो कुरा हो। गत वर्ष फ्रान्सपछि स्कटल्यान्ड खेलमा पनि यही गरेका थियौं।’ कार्डिफमा कठिन खेलपछि पनि इङ्ग्ल्यान्डले खेलाडीहरू सबै स्वस्थ रहेको रिपोर्ट गरेको छ, जहाँ एन्टोनी वाटसन र जोनाथन जोसेफले छुट्टाछुट्टै हाफमा ट्राइ गरे। जोसेफ जर्ज क्रुइससँगै ट्विकेनह्याममा पहिलो अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सुरुवात गर्दैछन्, लुथर बुरेलसँगको सम्भावनायुक्त केन्द्र साझेदारी पुन: सुरु गर्दै, र जर्ज फोर्डले फ्लाइ-हाफमा खेल संचालन गर्दै। ड्यान कोलले लामो चोटपछिको फिटनेस फर्काउने लक्ष्यमा टाइटहेड प्रपको भूमिकामा निरन्तरता पाएका छन्, भने अर्को साइडमा जो मर्लरले लुजहेड प्रपका रूपमा आफ्नो स्थान कायम राखेका छन्। इङ्ग्ल्यान्डले सन् १९९१ यता इटालीविरुद्ध २० म्याचमा कहिल्यै हार व्यहोर्नु परेको छैन, तर पछिल्ला पाँचमध्ये तीन खेलमा फरक सात अंक वा कममा निस्किएको छ। दुई वर्षअघि ट्विकेनह्याममा भएको अन्तिम भेटमा टोबी फ्लडका छ वटा पेनाल्टीको सहारा इङ्ग्ल्यान्डले १८-११ ले जितेको थियो। इङ्ग्ल्यान्ड यो खेलमा बलियो फेवरीटको रूपमा उत्रिएको छ, पछिल्ला दुई सिजन अङ्कको अन्तरले धावक बनेको टोली हो। ल्यानकास्टरले भने, ‘इटाली ट्विकेनह्याममा सधैं उत्साहित हुन्छ, विशेषगरी गत हप्ता आयरल्याण्डसँग हारेपछि। हामीलाई के आउँदैछ थाहा छ, राम्रो तयारी गरेका छौं र आफ्ना समर्थकमाझ खेल्नका लागि उत्साहित छौं।’ इटालीविरुद्ध खेल्ने इङ्ग्ल्यान्डको टोली: एम ब्राउन (हार्लिक्विन्स); ए वाटसन (बाथ), जे जोसेफ (बाथ), एल बुरेल (नर्थआम्पटन सेंट्स), जे मे (ग्लोस्टर); जी फोर्ड (बाथ), बी यङ्स (लेस्टर टाइगर्स); जे मर्लर (हार्लिक्विन्स), डी हार्टली (नर्थआम्पटन सेंट्स), डी कोल (लेस्टर टाइगर्स), डी एटवुड (बाथ), जी क्रुइस (सारासेन्स), जे हास्केल (वास्प्स), सी रोबसन (हार्लिक्विन्स, कप्तान), बी भुनिपोला (सारासेन्स)। प्रतिस्थापन: टी यङ्स (लेस्टर टाइगर्स), एम भुनिपोला (सारासेन्स), के ब्रुक्स (न्युक्यासल फाल्कन्स), एन इस्टर (हार्लिक्विन्स), टी क्रफ्ट (लेस्टर टाइगर्स), आर विगल्यसवर्थ (सारासेन्स), डी सिप्रिअनी (सेल शार्क्स), बी ट्वेल्भट्रीज (ग्लोस्टर)।

Leonard Morton, age 45, was a Manhattan lawyer who died by suicide on Friday morning by jumping from the 12th floor of a building near Broadway and Barclay Street. Friends stated that Morton suffered from bipolar disorder and had faced intense depression, especially after losing both parents and separating from his wife.

Morton represented prominent clients like Madison Square Garden and the Lincoln Center, and also worked at his mother’s public relations firm, Morton Communications. His mother, Deanna Morton of InfiniTech LLC, died in November 2011, followed by his father's death about a year later, which contributed to Morton's emotional challenges.

Close friend Linda March recalled that Morton had gone through both depressive and manic episodes. His three-year marriage to Dara ended in separation, and medication changes reportedly worsened his condition.

Professionally, Morton ran his own law firm, served as an administrative judge for New York City’s Environmental Control Board, taught law at Hunter College, and volunteered with the New York State Guard, offering free legal services to service members.

Despite support from friends like March, who had planned to help Morton with organizing his home, he died by suicide. March mourned the loss of her friend, remembering him as an intelligent lawyer and devoted son.

If you or anyone you know needs support, please contact Samaritans Suicide Prevention Helpline at 877-870-4673.

मोर्टनले Madison Square Garden, Lincoln Center जस्ता प्रमुख क्लाइन्टहरूको प्रतिनिधित्व गरेका थिए र आफ्नी आमाको पब्लिक रिलेसन्स फर्म Morton Communications मा पनि काम गरेका थिए। उनकी आमा, Deanna Morton (InfiniTech LLC) को नोभेम्बर २०११ मा निधन भएको थियो, र लगभग एक वर्षपछि उनका बुबा पनि बितेका थिए, जसले मोर्टनको भावनात्मक संघर्षलाई गहिर्यायो।

साथी लिन्डा मार्चका अनुसार, मोर्टनले गहिरो डिप्रेसन र कहिलेकाँही मैनिक अवस्था सँगसँगै सामना गरेका थिए। तीन वर्षको वैवाहिक सम्बन्धपछि उनी पत्नी दारा संग छुट्टिएका थिए, र औषधि परिवर्तनले उनको अवस्था झन् बिग्रिएको बताइन्छ।

अपनी पेसागत जीवनमा, मोर्टनले आफ्नो कानून कार्यालय सञ्चालन गर्थे, न्युयोर्क सिटीको Environmental Control Board मा प्रशासनिक न्यायाधीश थिए, हन्टर कलेजमा आंशिक समयका लागि कानून पढाउँथे र New York State Guard मा स्वयंसेवक वकिलको रूपमा सेवा सदस्यहरूलाई नि:शुल्क कानुनी सहायता प्रदान गर्थे।

साथी मार्च लगायतका नजिकका मानिसहरूको सहयोग प्रयासका बाबजुद, जसले उनलाई घर व्यवस्थित गर्न सघाउने योजना बनाएका थिए, मोर्टनले आत्महत्या गरे। मार्चले उनलाई कुशल वकिल र समर्पित छोरा रूपमा सम्झदै उनको मृत्युमा दुःख व्यक्त गरिन्।

यदि तपाईं वा तपाईंको छेउका कोही मानसिक स्वास्थ्यको समस्यामा हुनुहुन्छ भने, कृपया Samaritans Suicide Prevention Helpline ८७७-८७०-४६७३ मा सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस्।

article_content: The Carter Center announced that former First Lady Rosalynn Carter had been diagnosed with dementia and transitioned to home hospice care. She passed away peacefully two days later, surrounded by her family. Rosalynn Carter, aged 96, joined her husband, former President Jimmy Carter, who has been on home hospice since February 2023. The announcement of her transition was shared during National Hospice and Palliative Care Month, highlighting the important role palliative and hospice care play in supporting individuals and their loved ones through serious illness. Previous First Ladies like Nancy Reagan and Betty Ford publicly shared their medical diagnoses, helping raise awareness and reduce stigma around their conditions. Similarly, the Carters’ openness may help increase understanding of dementia and the importance of palliative and hospice care in chronic illnesses. Dr. Lisa Hirsch, assistant clinical professor at New York Medical College, says preparing families for end-of-life decisions allows better grieving. She emphasizes the value of conversations about care preferences to avoid anger and confusion. In May 2023, the Carter family disclosed Rosalynn Carter’s dementia diagnosis and requested privacy. Dementia causes a gradual decline in cognitive abilities, affecting memory, language, judgment, and social skills. Over 6 million Americans live with dementia—a number expected to grow. Despite the best care, decline continues, making symptom management vital. Palliative care addresses symptoms and supports quality of life at any stage. Palliative care brings together physicians, nurses, social workers, and chaplains to provide care that fits the patient’s values and wishes. The team supports decision-making, advance planning, and legal documents such as advanced directives and power of attorney. A common misconception is that palliative care signals giving up, but early palliative care can extend and improve quality of life through symptom relief, psychosocial support, and spiritual care. When life-prolonging treatment is no longer effective or desired and life expectancy is under six months, hospice care becomes an option, shifting focus to comfort and dignity, often at home. Choosing home hospice let Rosalynn Carter remain in familiar surroundings, especially helpful for dementia patients. Home care can ease anxiety and confusion, support family involvement, and preserve identity and independence. Palliative and hospice teams also address emotional, spiritual, and caregiver needs, building trust and supporting transitions. Dr. Hirsch says hospice honors a patient’s wishes for end-of-life care, reminding families that 'death is not the enemy, but suffering is.' When selecting a hospice provider, families should research options for care that fits medical, spiritual, and personal preferences. Medicare certification is important for those on Medicare. Ask about responsibilities and support levels from caregivers and health staff. Hospice centers on comfort, not curative treatment, enabling dignity in dying. The Carters have inspired many through a lifetime of public service and continue to set an example of compassion and dignity, even as they face life’s final chapters. Update: Originally published on November 19, 2023, this article was updated that afternoon with the news that Rosalynn Carter died peacefully at 2:10 p.m. in her home in Plains, Georgia, surrounded by loved ones.
translated_content: कार्टर सेन्टरले पूर्व प्रथम महिला रोजालिन कार्टरलाई डिमेन्सिया भएको र उनी घरमै हस्पिस हेरचाहमा गएको घोषणा गर्‍यो। दुई दिनपछि उनी परिवारको बीच शान्तिपूर्वक बितिन्। ९६ वर्षीया रोजालिन कार्टरका पति, पूर्व राष्ट्रपति जिमी कार्टर पनि फेब्रुअरी २०२३ देखि घरमै हस्पिसमा छन्। उनी home hospice मा गएको खबर National Hospice and Palliative Care Month मा आएको हो, जसले गम्भीर बिरामीमा व्यक्ति र परिवारका लागि प्यालिएटिभ र हस्पिस हेरचाहको महत्त्वलाई देखाउँछ। पहिलेका प्रथम महिला न्यान्सी रेगन र बेट्टी फोर्डले पनि आफ्नो स्वास्थ्य समस्याहरू सार्वजनिक गरे, जसले ती बिरामीका बारेमा जागरूकता बढाइदियो र कलंक हटाउन मद्दत गर्‍यो। त्यसैगरी, कार्टर परिवारको खुलापनले डिमेन्सिया र यसमा प्यालिएटिभ तथा हस्पिस केयरको महत्त्वप्रति जनचेतना जगाउन सहयोग पुर्याउन सक्छ। न्यु योर्क मेडिकल कलेजकी सहायक क्लिनिकल प्राध्यापक डा. लिसा हिर्श भन्छिन्, 'अन्त्यको निर्णयमा परिवार तयार हुँदा राम्रोसँग शोक मनाउन सकिन्छ। क्रोध र अन्योल टार्नका लागि आफूले चाहेको हेरचाहका कुरा परिवारबीच खुलस्त गर्नुपर्छ।' मे २०२३ मा कार्टर परिवारले रोजालिनलाई डिमेन्सिया भएको जानकारी दिएर गोपनीयता चाहेको अनुरोध गरेका थिए। डिमेन्सियामा बिस्तारै स्मृति, भाषा, निर्णय क्षमता, सामाजिक सिपहरूमा कमी हुँदै जान्छ। अमेरिका भर ६ करोडभन्दा बढी मानिस डिमेन्सियाबाट पीडित छन्—यो संख्या बढिरहेको छ। राम्रो हेरचाह भए तापनि अवस्था बिग्रँदै जान्छ, त्यसैले लक्षणको उपचार महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ। प्यालिएटिभ केयरले कुनै पनि चरणमा लक्षण व्यवस्थापन र जीवनको गुणस्तरमा ध्यान दिन्छ। प्यालिएटिभ केयरमा चिकित्सक, नर्स, सामाजिक कर्मचारी र धार्मिक सल्लाहकारको टोली मिलेर बिरामीको चाहनाअनुसार हेरचाह गर्छ। टोलीले निर्णयमा, अग्रिम योजना बनाउने, र कानुनी कागजात जस्तै एडभान्स डाइरेक्टिव र पावर-अफ-अटर्नी तयार गर्न सहयोग गर्छ। धेरैले प्यालिएटिभ केयर भनेको हार मान्नु हो भन्ने ठान्छन्, तर छिट्टै पाएको प्यालिएटिभ केयरले जीवनको गुणस्तर सुधार्नुका साथै लम्ब्याउन पनि सक्छ। यसले लक्षण, सामाजिक–मनोवैज्ञानिक र आध्यात्मिक समर्थन दिन्छ। जब उपचारले काम नगर्ने वा बिरामी अथवा परिवार चाहँदैनन्, र जीवन प्रत्याशा छ महिनाभन्दा कम हुन्छ, हस्पिस हेरचाह रोज्न सकिन्छ, जसको मुख्य उद्देश्य घरमै आराम र सम्मानका साथ जीवनको अन्त्य हो। घरमै हस्पिस रोज्दा रोजालिन कार्टरलाई आफ्नो वातावरणमा बस्न पाइन्, जुन डिमेन्सियामा अझै फाइदाजनक हुन्छ। घरमै हेरचाहले अन्योल र चिन्ता कम गर्छ, परिवारको संलग्नता बढाउँछ र पहिचान कायम राख्न सघाउँछ। प्यालिएटिभ तथा हस्पिस टोलीले भावना, आध्यात्मिकता र केयरगिभरको बोझ व्यवस्थापन गर्न, सम्बन्धमा विश्वास बढाउन र परिवर्तन सहज बनाउन मद्दत गर्छ। डा. हिर्श भन्छिन्, 'हस्पिसले बिरामीको चाहना अनुसार जीवनको अन्तिम क्षण सम्मानजनक बनाउँछ—म भन्छु, मृत्यु दुश्मन होइन, पीडा हो।' हस्पिस सेवा छान्दा व्यक्तिगत, धार्मिक वा चिकित्सा आवश्यकता अनुसार प्रदायक छान्नुपर्छ। मेडिकेयर लिनेका लागि मेडिकेयर सर्टिफाइड प्रदायक हुन जरुरी छ। आफ्नो भूमिका, हेरचाहको स्तर र समर्थन कत्तिको पाइन्छ भनेर बुझ्नुपर्छ। हस्पिसले उपचारभन्दा बढी आराममा केन्द्रीत हुन्छ, ताकि सम्मानसाथ मृत्युको यात्रा तय होस्। कार्टरद्वयले जीवनभर सेवा र प्रेरणा दिएका छन्; जीवनको अन्त्यमा पनि करुणा र सम्मान देखाएका छन्। अपडेट: यो समाचार १९ नोभेम्बर २०२३ मा प्रकाशित भएको थियो र त्यही दिन दिउँसो रोजालिन कार्टर २:१० बजे प्लेन्स, जर्जियामा आफ्नै घरमा, परिवारको साथमा, शान्तिपूर्वक बितेको जानकारीसहित अपडेट भएको छ।

article_content: Ben and Courtney Sikkenga marked their wedding day with a heartfelt ceremony on the same Michigan ice rink where they first crossed paths in seventh grade. Ben, 23, once played hockey for Reeths-Puffer, while Courtney, 24, has always been his devoted supporter. The couple chose the Lakeshore Ice Center in Muskegon as the perfect spot for their unique celebration. Their love for hockey inspired much of the event, from the bridal party and guests skating on the ice to the locker room preparations. Bridesmaids and groomsmen changed in the rink's locker rooms before gliding onto the ice, accompanied by Boyce Avenue's versions of 'Wanted' and 'I'll Be There For You.' Guests could sit on chairs on the ice or on benches behind the protective glass. Ben recalled that their dream of an ice rink wedding started early in their relationship. Over time, what began as an idea for an outdoor rink gradually turned into the meaningful ceremony that came to life. Courtney skated down the aisle with her proud father, Pat Benkert, at her side. Officiant Matt Bistayi invited guests to take their seats, joking about being careful on the ice. The couple exchanged personalized vows and tied a unity rope around their hands, sealing their union, then departed through a tunnel formed by raised hockey sticks. Courtney expressed her heartfelt thanks for the overwhelming love and support from friends and family. The reception followed in the center's second rink, decorated with hockey touches and a scoreboard featuring their wedding date.

article_content: Theme park managers at Thorpe Park have introduced breath testing for students after seeing a significant increase in vomiting incidents on rollercoasters during university Freshers Week. Rather than turning intoxicated students away, staff are directing those over the alcohol limit to the park’s most intense rides, such as The Swarm, which sends riders head-first through the air at speeds up to 60mph. This decision is based on research supported by Thorpe Park, which found that the rush of fresh air and adrenaline on The Swarm can help queasy guests feel better and potentially prevent vomiting. This week, staff observed a 250 percent rise in ride-related sickness as new university students took part in Freshers Week festivities. To handle the issue and reduce disruption, staff will use breathalyzer tests and guide students with more than 35mg of alcohol per 100ml of breath onto rides believed to help with hangovers, while restricting them from other attractions until they feel better. The plan aims to minimize ride closures for clean-up, benefiting families and other guests who might otherwise face delays. Dr. David Lewis, a neuropsychologist, conducted research showing that the oxygen and excitement on high-speed rides, like The Swarm with its 39-meter drop, may improve metabolism and help process toxins. Mike Vallis, divisional director at Thorpe Park, stated: ‘While we don’t condone drinking and riding, we recognize some guests may not realize they are still feeling the effects from the night before. Our goal is to ensure all guests enjoy the extreme rides safely, and we hope these measures lead to a more enjoyable and vomit-free day for everyone.’ The park hopes this system will end the frequent 'sick shutdowns' caused by ride-related illness.
translated_content: थोरपे पार्कका व्यवस्थापकहरूले विश्वविद्यालयको फ्रेशर्स विकको क्रममा रोलरकोस्टरमा बान्ता गर्ने घटनामा उल्लेख्य वृद्धि देखेपछि विद्यार्थीहरूका लागि ब्रेस टेस्टिङ सुरू गरेका छन्। मदिरा सेवनको सीमाभन्दा बढी भएका विद्यार्थीहरूलाई पार्कका कर्मचारीहरूले बाहिर पठाउने सट्टा, 'द स्वार्म' जस्ता पार्कका सबैभन्दा रोमाञ्चक रोलरकोस्टरमा पठाउने गरेका छन्, जसले यात्रुहरूलाई ६० माइल प्रति घण्टासम्मको गतिमा टाउको अगाडि लम्किन्छ। यो निर्णय थोरपे पार्ककै समर्थनमा गरिएको अनुसन्धानमा आधारित हो, जसले देखाएको छ कि ठुलो हावाको झोका र एड्रेनालिनको अनुभवले अप्ठ्यारो पेट भएका पाहुनाहरूलाई राहत दिन सक्छ र बान्ताबाट जोगाउन सकिन्छ। यस हप्तामा कर्मचारीहरूले विश्वविद्यालयको फ्रेशर्स विक उत्सवमा सहभागी भएका नयाँ विद्यार्थीहरूका कारण रोलरमा बान्ता गर्ने घटनामा २५० प्रतिशत वृद्धि देखेका छन्। समस्या समाधान गर्न र बाधा घटाउन, कर्मचारीहरूले ब्रेस टेस्ट गर्दै १०० एमएल सासमा ३५एमजी भन्दा बढी मदिरा पाइएका विद्यार्थीहरूलाई ह्याङओभर हटाउन सहयोगी मानिएका रोलरमा पठाउनेछन्, र अवस्था सुधार नहुँदासम्म अन्य मनोरञ्जनहरूमा प्रतिबन्ध लगाइनेछ। यस योजनाले सफाइका लागि भइरहेका राइड बन्द कम गरी, परिवार र अन्य अतिथिलाई ढिलाइ कम गर्ने लक्ष्य लिएको छ। न्यूरोसाइकोलोजिस्ट डा. डेभिड लुइसले गरेको अनुसन्धानले हावाबाट प्राप्त अक्सिजन र तीव्र स्पीडको अनुभवले चयापचय सुधार गर्न र विषाक्त पदार्थ प्रक्रिया गर्न सक्छ भनेर देखाएको छ। थोरपे पार्कका डिभिजनल डाइरेक्टर माइक भालिसले भने: ‘हामीले मदिरा सेवनपछि राइड गर्ने कुरा समर्थन गर्दैनौं, तर केही पाहुनाहरूले अझै रातको असर बुझेका नहुन सक्छन् भनेर हामी बुझ्छौं। हाम्रो उद्देश्य सबै पाहुनाले सुरक्षासहित रोमाञ्चक राइडको मजा लिन सकून् भन्ने हो, र यी उपायले सबैका लागि रमाइलो र बान्ता-मुक्त दिन हुनेमा आशा गरेका छौं।’ पार्कले यो प्रणालीले रोलरकोस्टरमा हुने बान्ताका कारण बारम्बार हुने राइड बन्दको अन्त्य गर्ने आशा राखेको छ।

article_content: Kristine Gagnier, a 26-year-old wakeskating enthusiast from Orlando, Florida, was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence early last Friday. She caught police attention around 2 a.m. after allegedly driving her Chevy Cavalier erratically. Gagnier was wearing a Halloween pig costume with 'zombie' contact lenses at the time. According to Deputy Jeff Lotter, her vehicle was seen crossing traffic lines multiple times. During the stop, officers observed the smell of alcohol, red eyes, slurred speech, and Gagnier admitted she had been drinking. A breathalyzer test shortly after 3 a.m. showed a blood-alcohol content of .120, exceeding Florida’s legal limit of .08. She was taken to the Orange County DUI Center following her arrest. article_content: St. Petersburg, Russia – On Friday, Russian President Vladimir Putin criticized Western nations for their plans to provide weapons to Syrian rebels, expressing concerns that these arms could fall into the hands of groups affiliated with al Qaeda. Speaking at the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum, Putin questioned how Western countries could safely deliver weapons to opposition groups in Syria, especially since the U.S. recognizes groups such as Jabhat al-Nusra as terrorist organizations. Putin emphasized, 'There are no clear answers to these questions. Our position is well-founded—we believe only the Syrian people can secure a lasting solution.' Meanwhile, Syrian rebels reported on Friday that they had received heavy weapons, including anti-tank and anti-aircraft missiles, from allied nations supporting their cause. At the G8 summit in Northern Ireland earlier in the week, Putin was pressed to reconsider his support for Syrian President Bashar al-Assad. U.S. President Barack Obama remarked that while the U.S. and Russia had differing perspectives, both were interested in ending the conflict. On Friday, Putin reiterated his commitment to peaceful dialogue and compromise among the parties involved. The G8 summit took place shortly after the U.S. pledged to increase support for Syrian rebels, citing evidence that Assad's regime had used chemical weapons. Putin argued that Russia would not risk providing arms that could fall into the hands of extremists, referencing a widely circulated video allegedly showing a rebel committing an atrocity. Putin also addressed Russia’s economic priorities at the forum, outlining plans to strengthen the economy, combat tax evasion, and encourage both innovation and investment. He highlighted the need to increase labor productivity and ensure tax policies foster business development, noting that these reforms would not result in higher tax burdens. German Chancellor Angela Merkel, speaking alongside Putin, expressed skepticism about Turkey’s prospects of joining the European Union due to concerns over the Turkish government's response to recent protests. Turkey has experienced more than two weeks of demonstrations against Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdogan's government. Merkel noted that the discussion about Turkey’s accession was ongoing and separate from the issue of suspending negotiations. G8 leaders also agreed to step up measures against tax avoidance and to require multinational corporations to publicly report their tax payments by country, aiming to limit profit shifting and protect national tax revenues. This initiative has become increasingly urgent as governments work to revive their economies and address high debt following the global financial crisis. Finally, the article reports that global stock markets, including Russia’s, declined sharply following indications from Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke that the U.S. could start scaling back its economic stimulus program later this year, potentially ending it in 2014.
