article_content: Authorities in Ciudad Juarez, Mexico, report that two Americans—a mother and her 19-year-old son—were shot and killed in a violent attack over the weekend. The victims, 35-year-old Rosa Williams and her son Pablo Noe, were riding in a blue 2004 Dodge Durango SUV when assailants armed with an AK-47 and a 9mm pistol opened fire, according to Arturo Sandoval, spokesperson for the prosecutor's office in Chihuahua state. Two others, identified as Alberto Nieto Nieto, 24, and Alma Yesenia Flores, 21, were also killed in the assault, which unfolded in broad daylight on a busy Ciudad Juarez street. The shooting occurred in front of numerous witnesses, but investigators are still searching for a motive. Ciudad Juarez, situated just across the border from El Paso, Texas, has seen years of violence as part of Mexico's campaign against organized crime. The U.S. Consulate in the city has previously warned Americans about heightened dangers due to crackdowns on local drug cartels, indicating that such actions may increase risks for U.S. citizens in the region.

article_content: Virat Kohli's popularity extends beyond cricket fans to players from opposing teams as well. This was clearly seen after India's World Cup match against the Netherlands in Bengaluru on Sunday, showcasing his broad appeal. In a touching moment, Kohli handed his jersey to Dutch and former RCB player Roelof van der Merwe — a gesture he has offered to rivals before, such as gifting his jersey to Pakistan captain Babar Azam. India defeated the Netherlands by 160 runs, finishing the league stage unbeaten with nine wins from nine matches. Kohli also took a rare wicket, having Dutch captain Scott Edwards caught behind down the leg side for 17. This was only Kohli's fifth ODI wicket and his first since 2014, when he had dismissed New Zealand captain Brendon McCullum in Wellington. The last time Kohli took a wicket in any international match was against the West Indies in the 2016 T20 World Cup. India will now face New Zealand in the first World Cup semifinal at Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai, mirroring their clash at the same stage in 2019.

article_content: The Duke of Edinburgh returned to public duties after nearly two months, appearing at the Royal Society of Edinburgh’s awards ceremony in good health and spirits following abdominal surgery. At age 92, Prince Philip humorously remarked on the complexity of the honorees' work, drawing laughter from the audience. He distributed Royal Medals to Professor Sir John Cadogan for his achievements in organic chemistry, Professor Michael Ferguson for his drug discovery research, and Sir Ian Wood for contributions to business and public service in Scotland. The Duke also presented the James Clerk Maxwell Award to Professors Richard Muller and Richard White from the University of California for key developments in microelectro-mechanical systems. Prince Philip, an Honorary Fellow of the Royal Society of Edinburgh since 1951, has regularly presented awards and is appreciated for his engagement with recipients. The ceremony recognized excellence across science, engineering, humanities, social sciences, and commerce. Dressed smartly, the Duke conversed with award winners and was warmly welcomed by dignitaries like RSE President Sir John Arbuthnott, who commended Philip’s ongoing curiosity and commitment. During the event, the Duke signed the medallists’ book, visited a display about the Higgs boson, and met Professor Peter Higgs, a previous medal recipient. Awardees expressed sincere gratitude for the Duke’s presence, with Sir John Cadogan recalling meeting Philip six decades ago and calling the event meaningful and nostalgic. Crowds cheered as the Duke left the ceremony early. He is expected to stay at Balmoral with the Queen before returning to London. RSE President Sir John Arbuthnott described the annual Royal Medals as the society's highest honor and congratulated all 2013 medallists for their outstanding inspiration.
translated_content: एडिनबरा राजकुमारले करिब दुई महिनापछि सार्वजनिक कर्तव्यमा फर्केर रोयल सोसाईटी अफ एडिनबरा (आरएसई) को पुरस्कार समारोहमा स्वास्थ्य र जाँगरिलो मुद्रामा भाग लिनुभयो। ९२ वर्षीय राजकुमार फिलिपले सम्मानित वैज्ञानिकहरूको कार्य निकै जटिल देखिएको भन्दै रमाइलो टिप्पणी गरेर उपस्थितलाई हँसाउनुभयो। उहाँले प्रख्यात जैविक रसायनशास्त्री प्रा. सर जोन क्याडोगन, औषधि अनुसन्धानका लागि प्रा. माइकल फर्ग्युसन, र स्कटल्याण्डको व्यापार तथा सार्वजनिक सेवामा पुर्‍याएको योगदानका लागि सर इयान वुडलाई रोयल मेडल प्रदान गर्नुभयो। त्यसैगरी, युनिभर्सिटी अफ क्यालिफोर्नियाका प्रा. रिचर्ड मुलर र प्रा. रिचर्ड ह्वाइटलाई माइक्रो-इलेक्ट्रो-मेकानिकल सिस्टम्समा नवीन उपलब्धिका लागि जेम्स क्लार्क म्याक्सवेल पुरस्कार दिइयो। सन् १९५१ देखि आरएसईका मानार्थ सदस्य रहेका राजकुमारले निर्देशन एवं उत्साहका साथ नियमित रूपमा पुरस्कार प्रदान गर्दै आउनुभएको छ। यस समारोहले विज्ञान, इन्जिनियरिङ, मानविकी, सामाजिक विज्ञान र व्यापारमा उत्कृष्ट उपलब्धि प्राप्त गर्नेहरूलाई सम्मान गर्‍यो। शानदार पहिरनमा सहभागी राजकुमारले विजेताहरूसँग आत्मीय संवाद गर्नुभयो, र आरएसई अध्यक्ष सर जोन आर्बुथनोत्तसहित सबैले उहाँलाई हर्षपूर्वक स्वागत गरे। अध्यक्ष आर्बुथनोत्तले राजकुमारको निरन्तर रुचि र समर्पणको प्रशंसा गर्नुभयो। समारोहमा राजकुमारले विजेताहरूको नाम दर्ता पुस्तकमा हस्ताक्षर गर्नुभयो, हिग्स बोसोनसम्बन्धी प्रदर्शनी अवलोकन गर्नुभयो, र सन् २००० मा मेडल प्राप्त गरेका प्रा. पीटर हिग्ससँग भेट गर्नुभयो। पुरस्कार विजेताहरूले राजकुमारको उपस्थितिप्रति धन्यवाद व्यक्त गर्दै, प्रा. क्याडोगनले ६ दशकअघि राजकुमारसँगको भेट र यसपटकको समारोहलाई गर्विलो तथा सम्झनायोग्य भएको बताएका छन्। समारोहपछि भीडको उत्साहकाबीचमा राजकुमारले छिटो बिदा लिनुभयो। उहाँ केही समयका लागि बाल्मोरलमा रानीसँग बस्न लाग्नु भएको छ। आरएसई अध्यक्ष सर जोन आर्बुथनोत्तले वार्षिक रोयल मेडललाई संस्थाको सबैभन्दा उच्च सम्मान भन्दै २०१३ का सबै विजेताहरूप्रति बधाई ज्ञापन गर्नुभयो।

article_content: Over the past two years, Google has positioned Google+ as much more than just a social media site or a place for video chatting. This week, Google is demonstrating that vision by unveiling a range of new features for Google+. Rather than competing head-on with Facebook or Twitter, Google describes Google+ as the essential link connecting its flagship services. According to the company, it’s becoming the backbone that helps tie together products such as Search, Gmail, and YouTube. Since its launch in June 2011, Google+ has become entwined in the wider Google ecosystem. Sometimes, using Google+ feels unavoidable—especially when its use is necessary to unlock certain features elsewhere within Google's suite. Vic Gundotra, the Senior VP overseeing Google+, says the main goal is to create one consistent Google identity per user. Early on, Google recognized that its own services left users managing different logins and profiles for each product. For example, someone might be a different user on YouTube, Gmail, or Android, or not even logged in on Search. Still, many people continue to use several accounts—one for work, another for personal use, or a separate one for handling subscriptions and unwanted emails. Rather than moving to a single Google identity, users often juggle these various profiles. To encourage adoption, Google is enhancing benefits for users who unify their profile. During the latest Google I/O conference, Google+ was a common thread in several key announcements, even if not always specifically named. The updated Google Maps, for example, uses your Google+ network to suggest restaurants, and Google Music All Access taps into your social graph to recommend songs. Gundotra claims that integrating these services enables unique features, like voice searches for your recent vacation photos—provided you’re using the same Google+ account to share and store them. This integration, Google hopes, will encourage users to embrace Google+ as more than an afterthought. Beyond integration, Google is investing in stand-alone improvements for Google+. New upgrades include a redesigned interface, sophisticated photo-editing tools, and automatic tagging of posts with relevant hashtags—sometimes using image recognition to identify photo subjects like concerts or cats. But Google still faces competition. For breaking news, Twitter leads with powerful hashtag and discovery tools. Gundotra notes that Google+ is improving in this area with smarter tagging and recommendations, helping users quickly find the latest on major events by clustering related topics and names. On top of all this, Google has merged its chat and messaging services under the Hangouts banner. Now users can text, share photos, and video chat across devices, streamlining what was previously split between apps like Google Talk, Messenger, and Video Hangouts. This move puts Google in closer competition with services like WhatsApp and BBM, though Gundotra maintains the goal is simplification for Google users above all. Overall, Google’s direction with Google+ is clear: unify, simplify, and integrate its major products, making it easier (and more appealing) for users to rely on a single, connected experience.
translated_content: पछिल्ला दुई वर्षमा, गुगलले गुगल+ लाई केवल सामाजिक सञ्जाल वा भिडियो च्याट गर्ने प्लेटफर्म भन्दा धेरै माथि प्रस्तुत गर्दै आएको छ। यस हप्ता गुगलले गुगल+ का नयाँ फिचरहरू सार्वजनिक गरेर आफ्नो दृष्टिकोण देखाएको छ। Facebook वा Twitter सँग प्रतिस्पर्धा गर्नु भन्दा, Google ले Google+ लाई आफ्ना प्रमुख सेवाहरू जोड्ने मुख्य कडी मानेको छ। कम्पनीका अनुसार, यो सर्च, Gmail, र YouTube जस्ता उत्पादनहरूलाई एउटै प्रणालीमा गाँस्ने मेरुदण्ड बन्दैछ। २०११ को जुनमा गुगल+ सार्वजनिक भएयता, यो गुगलका अन्य सेवाहरूसँग निकै एकीकृत बनिसकेको छ। कहिलेकाहीँ गुगलका अन्य फिचर प्रयोग गर्न गुगल+ आवाश्यक लाग्छ। गुगल+ का वरिष्ठ उपाध्यक्ष विक गुन्डोत्रा भन्छन्, प्रयोगकर्ताका लागि एउटै एकीकृत गुगल परिचय बनाउने उद्देश्य हो। शुरुमा, गुगलले आफ्नै सेवाहरूमा फरक-फरक लगइन र प्रोफाइल राख्नुपर्ने समस्या थाहा पाएको थियो—जस्तै, कोही YouTube, Gmail वा Android मा फरक प्रोफाइल हुन सक्थ्यो, वा सर्च गर्दा लगइनै नगर्न सकिन्थ्यो। तर अझै पनि धेरैले काम, व्यक्तिगत प्रयोग, वा केवल विज्ञापनका लागि छुट्टाछुट्टै इमेल चलाउँछन्। एउटै गुगल आईडीमा जाने भन्दा, धेरैले आफ्नो अकाउन्ट छुट्टाछुट्टै राख्न रुचाउँछन्। प्रयोगकर्तालाई आकर्षित गर्न, गुगलले एउटै प्रोफाइलमा जडान हुनेलाई बढि फाइदा दिने प्रयास गरिरहेको छ। पछिल्लो गुगल I/O सम्मेलनमा गुगल+ थुप्रै ठूला घोषणाहरूको मुख्य बिन्दु बन्यो, यद्यपि नामै लिनुअघि भिन्न तरिकाले। जस्तै: नयाँ Google Maps ले तपाइँका गुगल+ साथीहरूका रिव्युबाट रेस्टुरेन्ट सिफारिस गर्छ; Google Music All Access ले तपाइँको सामाजिक सञ्जालको आधारमा गीत सुझाव दिन्छ। गुन्डोत्राका अनुसार, यी सेवाहरूको संयोजनले अनौठा फीचर सम्भव पार्छ—जस्तै, एउटै गुगल+ अकाउन्टबाट फोटो शेयर गरेकाले, तपाईँको पछिल्ला बिदाका तस्वीर भ्वाइस सर्चबाट सहजै देख्न सकिन्छ। यस्तो संयोजनले प्रयोगकर्तामा गुगल+ लाई प्रमुख सेवाका रूपमा लिन प्रोत्साहित गर्ने गुगलको आशा छ। गुगलले गुगल+ मा नयाँ स्वरूप, फोटो सम्पादन औजार, र स्वचालित ह्यासट्याग जस्ता सुविधा थप्दै छ—कहिलेकाहीँ फोटोमा के छ भन्ने चिन्नेसम्म। तर प्रतिस्पर्धा अझै छ। तत्काल समाचारका लागि Twitter नै अगाडि छ। गुन्डोत्रा भन्छन्, गुगल+ मा स्मार्ट ह्यासट्याग र राम्रो सिफारिसद्वारा महत्त्वपूर्ण घटनाबारे जानकारी सजिलै खोज्न सकिन्छ—सम्बन्धित विषयहरूलाई एक ठाउँमा समेटेर। यस अलावा, गुगलले Hangouts मा च्याट र मेसेज सेवाहरू एकै ठाउँमा ल्याएको छ—अब एउटै एपबाट मेसेज, फोटो साझा, वा भिडियो कल गर्न सकिन्छ। यसले Google लाई WhatsApp वा BBM जस्ता सेवाहरूजस्तै बनाउँछ, तर गुन्डोत्राका अनुसार मुख्य लक्ष्य भने प्रयोगकर्तालाई सजिलो बनाउने हो। कुल रुपमा, गुगलको गुगल+ बाटो प्रष्ट छ: सबै प्रमुख सेवा एकीकृत, सहज, र जोडिएको बनाउने—जसले प्रयोगकर्ताका लागि एउटै अनुभव सहज बनोस्।

article_content: Two men have been arrested and charged in connection with a series of intentionally set church fires in east Texas. Jason Robert Bourque, 19, and Daniel George McAllister, 21, each face one count of arson for a February 8 fire at Dover Baptist Church in Tyler, Texas, according to the state Department of Public Safety. Authorities believe the suspects may be linked to nine additional church fires that have occurred in the area since January 1. They are also suspected of attempting to break into three other churches earlier this month, said Steve McCraw, director of the Department of Public Safety. A federal law enforcement source indicated that investigators have connected multiple pieces of evidence, including DNA, to one of the suspects. Authorities believe many of the fires were ignited in the same manner. "East Texans can rest easier tonight," McCraw remarked at a news conference announcing the arrests, calling the arsons "despicable and cowardly acts." The arrests were made after a tip was received on a hotline, according to the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF), which had offered a $25,000 reward for information. Investigators first identified the suspects about two weeks ago and have been gathering evidence since then, said ATF Special Agent Thomas Crowley. Authorities have been interviewing the individuals since their arrest but have not yet established a motive, Crowley added. On February 12, authorities released composite sketches of three people of interest in the church fires; on Sunday, officials clarified that those individuals are not connected to this weekend's arrests. Additionally, an 11th church fire in Temple, Texas, is not believed to be related to the other ten incidents, noted Robert Champion of the ATF in Dallas. Earlier this month, investigators were still considering a possible connection, but later ruled it out. CNN correspondent Ed Lavandera contributed reporting for this story.
translated_content: पूर्वी टेक्सासमा चर्चहरूमा जानबुझेर आगो लगाउने घटनामा संलग्न दुई जना पक्राउ परेका छन्। १९ वर्षीय जेसन रोबर्ट बूर्क र २१ वर्षीय ड्यानिएल जर्ज म्याकएलिस्टरलाई टायलर, टेक्सासस्थित डोभर बाप्टिस्ट चर्चमा फेब्रुअरी ८ मा भएको आगजनीको अभियोगमा दोषी ठहर गरिएको छ, राज्य सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा विभागका अनुसार। प्रहरी अनुसार, उनीहरू जनवरी १ देखि सो क्षेत्रमा भएका थप ९ वटा चर्च आगजनीमा संलग्न हुन सक्ने शंका गरिएको छ। उनीहरू यसै महिनामा तीन छुट्टाछुट्टै चर्चमा चोरी प्रयास गरेको विषयमा समेत शंकास्पद छन्, सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा विभागका निर्देशक स्टिभ म्याकक्रले बताएका छन्। संघीय निकायका स्रोतका अनुसार, अनुसन्धानकर्ताले एक अभियुक्तलाई DNA लगायत प्रमाणसँग जोडेका छन्। अधिकारीहरूका अनुसार, धेरै आगो एउटै शैलीमा लगाइएको विश्वास गरिएको छ। पक्राउको घोषणा गर्दै म्याकक्रले भने, “पूर्वी टेक्सासका जनता आज राति सुरक्षीत महसुस गर्न सक्छन्”, आगजनीलाई “निकृष्ट र डरपोक कार्य” भन्दै निन्दा गरे। पक्राउ एक हॉटलाइनमार्फत प्राप्त सूचनाले सम्भव भएको हो, मदिरा, चुरोट, हतियार र विस्फोटक ब्यूरो (ATF)का अनुसार, जसले सूचना दिनेलाई $२५,००० पुरस्कार दिने घोषणा गरेको थियो। अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूले करिब दुई हप्ता अघि ती अभियुक्तहरू पहिचान गरेका थिए र त्यसयता प्रमाण संकलन गर्दै थिए, ATF का विशेष एजेन्ट थोमस क्राउलीको भनाइ छ। पक्राउ पछि अधिकारीहरू उनीहरूलाई सोधपुछ गरिरहेका छन्, तर हालसम्म पनि आगजनीको उद्देश्य के हो भन्ने खुलिसकेको छैन, क्राउलीले थपे। फेब्रुअरी १२ मा, प्रहरीले चर्च आगजनीमा संलग्न हुन खोजिएका तीन व्यक्तिका रेखाचित्र सार्वजनिक गरेका थिए; तर, आइतबार अधिकारीहरूले ती व्यक्तिहरू यसपटक पक्राउ परेकासंग सम्बन्धित नरहेको स्पष्ट पारे। त्यस्तै, टेम्पल, टेक्सासमा भएको ११औं चर्च आगजनी अन्य १० घटनासँग असंबन्धित रहेको डलास ATFका रोबर्ट च्याम्पियनले बताएका छन्। यसअघि सम्बन्धको अनुसन्धान भए पनि पछि असम्बन्धित ठहरिएको हो। यस रिपोर्टमा CNN का संवाददाता एड लेभाण्डेराको योगदान छ।

article_content: The Maldives’ new president, Mohamed Muizzu, has officially requested that India withdraw its military personnel from the Maldives, making the request just a day after assuming office. Muizzu made this appeal in a meeting with Kiren Rijiju, India’s earth sciences minister, who attended his inauguration. An official statement said Muizzu pointed out that his substantial victory in the September presidential election was partly based on a promise to address Indian military presence, and he expressed hope that India would honor the will of Maldivian voters. Regarded as leaning toward China, Muizzu’s campaign focused on removing Indian troops and rebalancing trade ties, which he argued previously favored India during the term of former president Ibrahim Mohamed Solih. Observers noted that the election was viewed as a choice between continued Indian influence or a pivot towards China for the strategically critical Indian Ocean nation. Both India and China are competing for influence over the Maldives, given its key location on international shipping routes. The precise number of Indian troops stationed in the Maldives has not been revealed publicly, leading to speculation and doubt. The Indian military operates two helicopters it donated, primarily for search-and-rescue responsibilities at sea. Ibrahim Khaleel, Maldives’ Minister for Strategic Communications, told The Associated Press the president would confirm the number of Indian troops after consulting officials. Talks with India were described as cordial, with the Maldives hopeful for a swift withdrawal. During his presidency from 2013 to 2018, Muizzu’s ally, Abdulla Yameen, aligned the country with China’s Belt and Road Initiative, boosting trade links and Chinese presence through major infrastructure ventures.
translated_content: माल्दिभ्सका नयाँ राष्ट्रपति मोहम्मद मुइज्जुले भारतसँग माल्दिभ्समा रहेका भारतीय सैनिकहरू फिर्ता लैजान औपचारिक रूपमा अनुरोध गरेका छन्। उनले पदभार ग्रहण गरेको भोलिपल्टै भारतका पृथ्वी विज्ञान मन्त्री किरेन रिजिजुसँग भेट गर्दै यो माग राखेका हुन्। राष्ट्रपति कार्यालयको विज्ञप्तिमा सेप्टेम्बरमा भएको राष्ट्रपतीय निर्वाचनमा उनले भारतीय सैनिकको उपस्थिति समाधान गर्ने वाचा गरेकाले जनताले उनलाई ठूलो समर्थन गरेको बताइएको छ। मुइज्जुले भारतले माल्दिभ्स जनताको चाहनालाई सम्मान गर्छ भन्ने आशा व्यक्त गरे। चीनसँग नजिकको मानिने मुइज्जुले भारतीय सैनिक हटाउने र इब्राहिम मोहम्मद सोलिहको कार्यकालमा भारत पक्षमा रहेको भनिन सक्ने व्यापार सन्तुलन मिलाउने अठोट गरेका थिए। विश्लेषकहरूका अनुसार चुनाव भारतीय प्रभाव रहने कि चीन तिर झुक्ने भनेर माल्दिभ्सको बाटो तय गर्ने अवसर थियो। भारत र चीन दुबै मुलुकको नजर रणनीतिक रूपमा महत्वपूर्ण यस टापु राष्ट्रमा छन्, जसको स्थान प्रमुख अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय समुद्री मार्गमा पर्छ। माल्दिभ्समा कति भारतीय सैनिक छन् भन्ने जानकारी सार्वजनिक छैन, जसले शंका र अनुमान बढाएको छ। भारतीय सेनाले दिएको दुईवटा हेलिकप्टर चलाइरहेको छ, जसले मुख्यतया समुद्रमा खोज तथा उद्धार कार्य गर्छ। माल्दिभ्सका रणनीतिक सञ्चार मन्त्री इब्राहिम खलीलले एपीलाई राष्ट्रपति अधिकारीहरूसँग सैनिकको संख्या पत्ता लगाउने बताएका छन्। उनले भारतसँगको वार्ता मैत्रीपूर्ण भएको र चाँडै सैनिक फिर्ता हुने आशा व्यक्त गरे। २०१३ देखि २०१८ सम्मका राष्ट्रपति अब्दुल्ला यामीनले माल्दिभ्सलाई चीनको बेल्ट एण्ड रोड इनिसिएटिभमा सहभागी गराई व्यापार र पूर्वाधार विस्तारसँगै चीनको प्रभाव बढाएका थिए।

article_content: Bob Skuba, a barber in Newtown, Connecticut, reflects on his past connection to Adam Lanza, the perpetrator of the Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting. Skuba, along with his family, has operated Robert Anthony's Hair Salon for 13 years. He remembers Lanza as a quiet, withdrawn boy who would come in every four weeks for a haircut, always accompanied by his mother, Nancy Lanza. Skuba recalls that Adam rarely spoke or made eye contact. Nancy Lanza usually answered questions on his behalf, explaining that he was homeschooled. Adam would comply quietly with his mother's instructions during every visit. Coworkers and family members commented on Adam's unusual behavior, but Skuba never imagined he could be violent. He describes Lanza as a reserved teenager who wore oversized dress shirts. Skuba remains shocked by the tragedy at Sandy Hook, expressing disbelief that someone he once knew could commit such an act. He also recounts the grief within the Newtown community, mentioning the funeral for six-year-old victim Jessica Rekos at St. Rose of Lima Church. Reflecting on the events, Skuba wishes that something could have been done to prevent the tragedy. He expresses sorrow for the victims and families affected by the shooting, emphasizing his emotional response to the loss. Skuba is uncertain whether he provided haircuts to any of the child victims and prefers not to dwell on that thought. He has been part of the Newtown community for over 30 years and continues to process the impact of the tragedy.
translated_content: कनेक्टिकटका न्यूटाउनका कपाल काट्ने बोब स्कुबा स्यान्डी हुक प्राथमिक विद्यालयका अपराधी एडम लान्जासँगको आफ्नो विगतको सम्बन्धबारे सोचिरहेका छन्। स्कुबा र उनको परिवारले १३ वर्षदेखि रोबर्ट एन्टोनी हेयर सैलुन सञ्चालन गर्दै आएका छन्। उनी भन्छन् एडम शान्त, एक्लो स्वभावको केटो थिए, जसलाई आमाले चार हप्तामा एकपछि अर्को पटक कपाल काट्न ल्याउने गर्थिन्। स्कुबाका अनुसार एडमले प्रायः कुरा गर्थेनन् र आँखा जुधाउँदैन थिए। न्यान्सी लान्जाले प्रायः एडमको तर्फबाट जवाफ दिन्थिन् र बताउँथिन् कि उनलाई घरमै पढाइ भइरहेको छ। एडम आमाको हरेक निर्देशनलाई शान्त ढंगले मान्ने गर्थे। स्कुबाका साथीसाथी तथा परिवारजनले एडमको असामान्य व्यवहारबारे टिप्पणी गर्थे, तर स्कुबाले उनलाई कहिल्यै हिंस्रक भनेर कल्पना गरेका थिएनन्। उनी एडमलाई कहिल्यै मुस्कान नगर्ने, ठूला सर्ट लगाउने लाजालु किशोरका रूपमा सम्झन्छन्। स्यान्डी हुकमा भएको घटनाले स्कुबा निकै स्तब्ध छन्। उनले आफुले चिनेका व्यक्तिले यत्रो गम्भीर घटना गर्न सक्छ भनेर कहिल्यै कल्पना गरेका थिएनन्। उनी न्यूटाउन समुदायको शोक र दुःखलाई सम्झन्छन्, विशेष गरी सँगसँगै बसेर ६ वर्षीया जेसिका रीकसको अन्त्येष्टिमा सामेल भएको कुरा भनेर। घटनाबारे सोच्दा स्कुबालाई लाग्छ, यस्तो त्रासदी रोक्न यदि केही गर्न सकिएको हुन्थ्यो भने राम्रो हुन्थ्यो। उनले पीडित र परिवारप्रति गहिरो दुःख व्यक्त गरेका छन् र त्यसको प्रभाव अझै हृदयमा महसुस भइरहेका छन्। स्कुबालाई यो कुरा निश्चित छैन कि उनले ती बालबालिकाहरूमध्ये कसैको कपाल कहिल्यै काटेका थिए कि छैनन्, र उनी त्यो सोच्न चाहँदैनन्। स्कुबा ३० वर्षभन्दा बढी समयदेखि न्यूटाउनमा बस्दै आएका छन् र अझै पनि उक्त घटनाको प्रभावलाई ग्रहण गर्ने प्रयास गरिरहेका छन्।

article_content: A video showing the lifeless body of Nigerian rapper Oladipupo Oladimeji, known as Oladips, was shared on Instagram by his team member Rasheed on Tuesday. The footage shows Rasheed and two others grieving beside the 'Chache' crooner’s body and expressing shock. Oladips rose to fame after being signed by rapper Reminisce to LRR/EDGE Records and passed away on November 14. Fellow rapper Zlatan Ibile shared their last conversation, mentioning Oladips’ struggles with sleep. Oladips’ newest album is scheduled for release on Thursday. In a final song, Oladips spoke about not wanting to die young. The video and news have been widely circulated on social media, including by PUNCH Newspapers.

Hasina Safi, the last Minister of Women’s Affairs in Afghanistan and a prominent advocate for women’s rights, voiced serious concerns about the global response to Afghanistan’s humanitarian crisis. During her interview with Al Jazeera at the One Young World summit in Belfast, Safi described the international community’s efforts as disorganized and largely ineffective, leaving many Afghans under Taliban rule to feel abandoned. Following the Taliban’s rise to power in August 2021—and the dissolution of her ministry in favor of a 'guidance and preaching' ministry—conditions have deteriorated.

Safi criticized the international community for not turning commitments made during the US and UK troop withdrawals into tangible help. She argued that, despite various summits and programs, meaningful assistance has failed to reach those suffering most. Safi also pointed out the Taliban’s increasing restrictions on personal freedoms, especially for women—such as directives on clothing and movement—which she says break international human rights norms.

As the crisis in Afghanistan receives less international attention, Safi warned that Afghans genuinely feel left behind. Poverty rates remain high—close to half the population were already impoverished before the foreign troop departure—signaling a dire need for aid. Additionally, she stressed that expanding educational opportunities for girls and women is essential. Safi urged the international community to rethink its approach by focusing on actual Afghan needs, calling for a comprehensive review of the last two years' efforts—bringing together perspectives from inside and outside the country to build a more effective, unified plan.

article_content: India and the United States are preparing for their annual 2+2 ministerial dialogue in New Delhi, where defense, strategic, and regional security will be top priorities. The US is looking to have India take a larger role in the Indo-Pacific, especially in relation to rising tensions with China. This includes potential discussions about increasing India's naval presence in the disputed South and East China Seas. The dialogue will feature India's Defense Minister Rajnath Singh and External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar meeting with US Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin and Secretary of State Antony Blinken. During the visit, Secretary Blinken will also meet with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Key topics for this year's 2+2 talks include joint projects on critical and emerging technologies and the possibility of President Joe Biden visiting India, potentially for Republic Day 2024—though this is not yet confirmed by the White House. With China's growing influence in Asia, the US is keen to strengthen its partnerships, viewing India as a possible counterbalance. However, India remains cautious about any move that could worsen border tensions with China, especially after their deadly 2020 clash. India responded to that confrontation by limiting Chinese investments and banning many Chinese apps. Although India is a member of the Quad —a partnership with the US, Australia, and Japan—it prefers to emphasize economic and development collaboration to avoid antagonizing China. India maintains naval patrols throughout the Indian Ocean and has conducted voyages in the South China Sea in recent years. Yet, there are concerns about whether the Indian Navy can take on wider responsibilities as desired by the US, given its current demands. India is boosting its surveillance capacity by acquiring 31 long-endurance drones from the US. In the economic sphere, India’s industrial production fell in September, influenced by an unfavorable market environment and heavy rainfall. Other business stories, such as major investments, were also reported but are not directly related to the diplomatic meetings.

article_content: Kurt Fearnley is determined not to let his disability define his life. Born with a congenital condition that affected his lower spine and sacrum, Fearnley has chosen to live fully. Speaking to Daily Mail Australia, the three-time Paralympic gold medalist said, 'You always have the ability within to live your life and push the limits. If you accept yourself, you must accept all of yourself. I couldn’t imagine my life any other way. Disability is just another aspect of a person.' He reflected, 'If I were offered the chance to walk tomorrow, I would take it, but if it meant losing the person I have become, I would never make that trade.' Fearnley believes that struggles are valuable: 'People often think struggling is bad, but overcoming struggles is inspiring.' Fearnley has won the New York City wheelchair marathon five times, participated in the Sydney to Hobart race, was named 2009 Young Australian of the Year, and received the Medal of the Order of Australia. In his memoir 'Pushing the Limits', he shares more about his journey, including his decision to take on the Kokoda Trail—a 96 km trek through Papua New Guinea’s Owen Stanley Range, renowned for its challenging conditions. His motivation for the trek stemmed from the passing of his cousin Pete, which brought family and friends together. Reading about a wounded soldier who crawled the Kokoda Trail inspired him further. He prepared himself mentally, physically, and spiritually, with the encouragement of his loved ones. The idea of not attempting the challenge because of his disability never occurred to him: 'Life can be hard. Deal with it. I would never choose to sit on the sidelines.' Fearnley wants to be remembered as someone who embraced life completely. A conversation with a local man in Papua New Guinea, who described how children with disabilities are often hidden from the community, made Fearnley reflect on the wider impact of his journey. During the demanding trek, he faced unexpected emotions and injuries, and at times needed support from others, which taught him that asking for help is sometimes necessary. The group reached Eora Creek on Remembrance Day, reflecting on the sacrifices of World War II soldiers, which was a profoundly moving experience for Fearnley. He lost seven kilograms during the trek, and he and his companions felt they achieved more than they thought possible. Fearnley hopes his story inspires others, especially those with disabilities, to live beyond labels or limitations. 'Life isn’t about watching—it’s about participating fully and embracing both challenges and triumphs.'
translated_content: कर्ट फर्नलीले आफ्नो अपांगता कहिल्यै आफैंलाई परिभाषित गर्न दिनु हुँदैन भन्ने दृढ संकल्प गरेका छन्। जन्मजात स्थितिका कारण उनको तल्लो स्पाइन र साक्रमको वृद्धि प्रभावित भयो, फर्नलीले आफ्नो जीवन पूर्ण रूपमा बाँच्ने रोजे। डेली मेल अस्ट्रेलियासँग कुरा गर्दै, तीन पटकका प्यारालिम्पिक स्वर्ण पदक विजेता फर्नलीले भने, ‘तपाईंभित्र सधैं आफ्नो जीवन बाँच्ने र सीमा धकेल्ने क्षमता हुन्छ। यदि आफूलाई स्वीकार्नु छ भने, पूरै स्वीकार्नुपर्छ। म आफ्नो जीवन अरू तरिकाले कल्पना गर्न सक्दिन। अपांगता केवल व्यक्तिको अर्को पक्ष हो।’ उनले थपे, ‘यदि भोलि हिंड्न पाउने मौका आएको भए म लिन्थें, तर यसकै सट्टामा बनेको व्यक्ति गुमाउनुपर्यो भने कहिल्यै साट्दिन्थें।’ फर्नली विश्वास गर्छन्, संघर्ष मूल्यवान छ: ‘धेरैजसोले संघर्ष खराब ठान्छन्, तर संघर्ष जित्न सक्नु प्रेरणादायी हुन्छ।’ फर्नलीले न्यूयोर्क सिटी ह्वीलचेयर म्याराथन पाँच पटक जितेका छन्, सिड्नी–होबर्ट रेसमा भाग लिएका छन्, २००९ का ‘यंग अस्ट्रेलियन अफ द इयर’ भएका छन्, र ‘मेडल अफ द अर्डर अफ अस्ट्रेलिया’ पाएका छन्। आफ्नो आत्मकथा ‘पुसिङ द लिमिट्स’ मा उनले आफ्नो यात्रा विस्तृत रूपमा साझा गरेका छन्, जसमा पपुआ न्यू गिनीको ओवेन स्टानली रेञ्जको ९६ किलोमिटर लामो कठिन ‘कोकोडा ट्रेल’ तय गर्ने निर्णय समावेश छ। यो यात्रा उनको आफ्नै काका पिटको निधनपछि परिवार र साथीहरू एकजुट हुने क्रममा प्रेरित भयो। घाइते सैनिकले कोकोडा ट्रेल क्रल गरेको कथाले उनलाई थप प्रेरणा दियो। उनले मानसिक, शारीरिक अनि आत्मिक रूपमा तयारी गरे, आफ्ना परिवार र साथीहरूको प्रोत्साहन पाए। अपांगताको कारण त्यो चुनौती नगर्ने सोच कहिल्यै आएन: ‘जीवन कठिन हुन सक्छ। सम्झौतासँग सामना गर। म कहिल्यै छेउमा बस्ने रोजाइ गर्दिन्थें।’ फर्नली आफू पूर्ण रूपमा बाँच्ने व्यक्ति भनेर सम्झन चाहन्छन्। पपुआ न्यू गिनीका एक स्थानीय व्यक्तिसँगको कुराकानीले—जहाँ अपांगता भएका बालबालिका लुकाइन्छन्—फर्नलीलाई आफ्नै यात्राको फराकिलो प्रभावबारे गहिरो सोच्न बाध्य बनायो। त्यो कठिन यात्रा पूरा गर्दै जाँदा उनले अकल्पनीय भावनाहरू, चोटपटक र कहिलेकाहीँ अरूको सहायता आवश्यक पर्ने अनुभव गरे, जसले उनलाई सहयोग माग्न पनि कहिलेकाहीँ ठीकै हुन्छ भन्ने सिकायो। समूह ‘इओरा क्रिक’ मा पुग्दा, द्वितीय विश्वयुद्धका सैनिकहरूको बलिदान सम्झँदै, त्यो अनुभव फर्नलीलाई अत्यधिक भावुक बनायो। उनी त्यो यात्रा गर्दा सात किलो तौल घटाए, अनि उनी र उनका साथीहरूले आफूले सोचेभन्दा धेरै कुरा जितेको महसुस गरे। फर्नली चाहन्छन्, उनको कथाले अरूलाई—विशेषगरी अपांगता भएका व्यक्तिहरूलाई—कुनैपनि लेबल वा सीमामा सीमित नहोस् भनेर प्रेरणा देओस्। ‘जीवन केवल हेर्ने होइन, पूरा सहभागिता जनाउने, संघर्ष र सफलता दुवैलाई अँगाल्ने हो।’

article_content: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis criticized the age of leading presidential candidates Donald Trump and Joe Biden, stating that the presidency is 'not a job for somebody that is pushing 80,' as reported by CNN. DeSantis, trailing Trump in the race for the Republican nomination, emphasized his relative youth compared to Trump, 77, and Biden, who turns 81 soon. Speaking to CNN, DeSantis, 45, said, 'That’s something evident with Joe Biden. Father Time is undefeated. Donald Trump is not exempt from any of that.' DeSantis argued that he is in the 'prime of my life' and pointed out that Trump would be older than Biden was at the start of his term if Trump takes office in 2025. Age has become a central focus in the 2024 presidential race. Trump has repeatedly questioned Biden’s mental fitness during his campaign. Meanwhile, DeSantis’s team launched an 'accident tracker' highlighting Trump’s verbal slip-ups, such as confusing Biden with Barack Obama. Beyond age, DeSantis claims these incidents show that Trump is not the same as during his first presidential run. When asked by CNN’s Jake Tapper about Trump’s mental acuity and electability against Biden, DeSantis said, 'I wouldn’t be running unless I thought the Democrats would beat Trump if he were the nominee.' DeSantis suggests that Democrats are currently being lenient on Trump during the Republican primary but would become much more aggressive if Trump is nominated. He predicted, 'You’re going to see scorched earth. All this stuff from the past will come out. The election will become a referendum on Donald Trump, and Biden will be able to stay out of the spotlight.' Despite low poll numbers, DeSantis remains active on the campaign trail, appearing at eight public events over two days and continuing his tour in Iowa. Unlike Biden and Trump, DeSantis is often accompanied by his wife, Casey, and their three young children at campaign events. लागि होइन,’ सीएनएनले उल्लेख गरेको छ। रिपब्लिकन मनोनयनमा ट्रम्पभन्दा पछि रहेका डीसान्टिसले ट्रम्प (७७) र छिट्टै ८१ वर्ष पुग्न लागेका बाइडेनको तुलना गर्दै आफू अझै युवा भएकोमा जोड दिएका छन्। सीएनएनसँगको कुराकानीमा ४५ वर्षीय डीसान्टिसले भने, ‘यो कुरा जो बाइडेनमा स्पष्ट देखिन्छ। समय कसैले जित्न सक्दैन। डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प पनि त्यसबाट बच्न सक्दैनन्।’ डीसान्टिसले आफू ‘जिन्दगीको उत्कर्षमा’ रहेको दाबी गर्दै, यदि ट्रम्पले २०२५ मा पद सम्हाले भने उनी बाइडेनले पद सम्हाल्दाको उमेरभन्दा अझ बढी उमेरका हुने बताए। २०२४ को राष्ट्रपतीय चुनावमा उमेर मुख्य विषय बनेको छ। ट्रम्पले बारम्बार बाइडेनको मानसिक क्षमता प्रश्न गर्दै आएका छन्। डीसान्टिसको टिमले पनि ट्रम्पको भाषणका गल्तीहरू समेटिएको ‘एक्सिडेन्ट ट्र्याकर’ सार्वजनिक गरेको छ, जसमध्ये ट्रम्पले बाइडेनलाई बाराक ओबामासँग भ्रमित गरेका थिए। उमेरको सन्दर्भभन्दा बाहेक, डीसान्टिसले यी घटनाहरूले ट्रम्प पहिले जस्तो नरहेको संकेत गर्छन् भनेका छन्। सीएनएनका जेक ट्यापरले ट्रम्पको मानसिक क्षमता र बाइडेनलाई हराउने सम्भावनाबारे प्रश्न गर्दा डीसान्टिसले भने, ‘यदि मलाई लाग्थ्यो कि उम्मेदवार ट्रम्प भएमा डेमोक्र्याट्सले हार्ने छैनन् भने म उम्मेदवारी हुन्न थिएँ।’ डीसान्टिसको भनाइ छ, हाल डेमोक्र्याट्सहरू रिपब्लिकन प्राथमिकतामा ट्रम्प प्रति सहज देखिए पनि, उनी उम्मेदवार भए पछि निकै आक्रामक हुनेछन्। उनले भने, ‘त्यसपछि कडा प्रतिद्वन्द्विता देख्नुहुनेछ, विगतका सबै विषय उत्तेजित गरिनेछन्। चुनाव ट्रम्पमाथि जनमत संग्रहजस्तै हुनेछ र बाइडेन आराम साथ बस्न पाउनेछन्।’ पछाडि रहेका भए पनि डीसान्टिसले चुनावी अभियानमा सक्रियता देखाएका छन्। पछिल्ला दुई दिनमा आठ वटा सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रम गरे र आइयोवा भ्रमण जारी छ। अन्य उम्मेदवारभन्दा फरक, डीसान्टिस प्रायः पत्नी केसि र तीन साना छोराछोरीसहित अभियान गर्छन्। डीसान्टिसको भनाइ छ, ‘म दुई कार्यकाल सेवा गर्नेछु, ठूलो उपलब्धि ल्याउनेछु र देशलाई फर्काइ अघि बढाउनेछु। रिपब्लिकन मतदाताले यही चाहेका छन्।’ अन्य समाचार: भारत सरकारले साहारा-सेबी फन्डका दाबी नगरिएका रकम कानुनी रूपमा देशको कन्सोलिडेटेड फन्डमा सार्ने विषयमा अध्ययन गरिरहेको छ। एप्पलले सन् २०२४ को अन्त्यसम्म भारतमा १ लाख करोड रुपैयाँ बराबरको आइफोन उत्पादन गर्ने लक्ष्य राखेको छ, जसमा सात महिनामै ६०,००० करोडभन्दा बढी उत्पादन भइसकेको छ। गौतम सिंघानियाका पत्नी नावाज मोदीले आफू र दुई छोरीको लागि सिंघानियाको १.४ अर्ब डलर नेटवर्थमध्ये तीन चौथाइ माग्दै पारिवारिक समझदारीको पहल गरेकी छन्।

article_content: Missing an open goal or blasting the ball over is a moment all footballers experience—even top-tier professionals. The 2014 Bundesliga season had plenty of these surprising errors. Here’s a countdown of the ten most unforgettable missed chances:  10) Johannes Geis (Mainz): Geis’s attempt to curl in a free-kick from the left ended up sailing way over, landing among the fans. The turf lifted as he struck the ball, turning his effort into something resembling a rugby kick.  9) Adam Szalai (Hoffenheim): Against Bayern Munich, Szalai found himself with a golden opportunity in the center of the box. He chested the ball down, but without enough force, allowing Manuel Neuer to make the save. Hoffenheim ultimately lost 4-0.  8) Klaas-Jan Huntelaar (Schalke): Known as 'The Hunter,' Huntelaar surprisingly missed an easy finish in front of goal during the Hertha Berlin match. Schalke, however, still walked away with a 2-0 win.  7) Christian Gentner (Stuttgart): Gentner faced an open net with a header against Werder Bremen, but sent the ball into the ground and over the bar. Stuttgart lost the match 2-0.  6) Raffael (Borussia Monchengladbach): With the score level and little time left, Raffael had a clear shot, but a defender on the line managed to prevent the goal.  5) Sebastian Freis (Freiburg): Freis was given a prime chance after a goalkeeper fumble, but his shot went high over the bar. Freiburg went on to lose 4-1.  4) Roel Brouwers (Borussia Monchengladbach): After a lucky bounce from a corner, Brouwers had the goal at his mercy but sent his shot over.  3 & 2) Junior Malanda (Wolfsburg): Twice, Malanda missed great opportunities—first by losing his footing at the crucial moment, and then by failing to score from right in front of goal.  1) Philipp Hofmann (Kaiserslautern): At number one, Hofmann’s astonishing miss from just a yard out is likely to be remembered for a long time.
translated_content: खुला गोल गुमाउनु वा बललाई बार माथि पठाउनु प्रत्येक फुटबल खेलाडीको अनुभव हो — शीर्ष तहका पेशेवर खेलाडीहरूले समेत। २०१४ को बुन्डेसलिगा सिजनमा यस्ता थुप्रै अनौंठा गल्तीहरू देखिए। यहाँ दस सबैभन्दा बिर्सन नहुने चुक भएका अवसरहरूको सूची छ:  १०) जोहान्नेस गीस (माईन्ज): बाँया विंगबाट फ्री-किक हान्दा गीसको प्रहार दर्शकहरूसम्म पुग्यो। बल हान्दा घाँस उचालियो र बल रग्बी किक जस्तो देखियो।  ९) एडम स्जालाई (होफेनहाइम): बायरन म्यूनिख विरुद्ध खेल्दा स्जालाईसँग बक्सको बीचमा राम्रो अवसर थियो। उनले छातीमा बल रोके, तर पर्याप्त बलियो हान्न सकेनन्, र मानुअल नोएरले सेभ गरे। होफेनहाइम ४-० ले पराजित भयो।  ८) क्लास-जान हन्टेलार (शाल्के): 'द हंटर' उपनाम पाएका हन्टेलारले हरथा बर्लिनविरुद्ध सजिलो मौका गुमाए, तर शाल्के २-० ले विजयी भयो।  ७) क्रिश्चियन गेन्टनर (स्टुटगार्ट): भर्डर ब्रेमेनविरुद्ध खुला नेटमा हेडर गर्दा गेन्टनरले बललाई भूमिमा ठोकेर बार माथि पठाए। स्टुटगार्ट २-० ले पराजित भयो।  ६) राफाएल (बोरुसिया मोन्चेन्ग्लाडबाख): जब खेल बराबरीमा थियो र थोरै समय बाँकी थियो, राफाएलसँग प्रष्ट मौका थियो, तर रक्षकले गोललाइनमा बल रोके।  ५) सेबास्टियन फ्राइस (फ्राइबर्ग): गोलकिपरको गल्तीले फ्राइसलाई सुनौलो अवसर मिलेको थियो, तर उनले बल उचाले। फ्राइबर्ग ४-१ ले हार्‍यो।  ४) रोएल ब्राउवर्स (बोरुसिया मोन्चेन्ग्लाडबाख): कर्नरबाट भाग्यशाली रुपमा बल पाएपछि ब्राउवर्ससँग मात्र गोलकिपर थिए, तर उनले बल माथि पठाए।  ३ र २) जुनियर मालान्डा (वोल्फ्सबर्ग): दुई पटक, मालान्डाले उत्कृष्ट अवसर गुमाए — पहिलोचोटि महत्त्वपूर्ण समयमा सन्तुलन गुमाए, दोस्रोचोटि गोल अगाडि नै गोल गर्न असफल भए।  १) फिलिप होफम्यान (कायसर्सलाउटेर्न): नम्बर एकमा, केवल एक यार्डको दूरीबाट भएको होफम्यानको आश्चर्यजनक गल्ती लामो समय सम्झिने किसिमको छ।

article_content: As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly transforms the white-collar workforce, it is projected to disrupt hundreds of millions of jobs globally. Nearly 1 billion knowledge workers could be affected, with 14 million jobs being eliminated. However, AI is only one of several significant structural changes expected to shape the American economy in the coming decades. While office professionals face a volatile job market and potential wage declines, an unexpected group appears insulated from these challenges: blue-collar workers. Jobs involving skilled trades, manual labor, or a combination of physical, technical, and interpersonal tasks are unlikely to be fundamentally disrupted by AI. Ongoing demographic trends, such as mass retirements among older Americans and rising demand in healthcare, green energy, high-tech manufacturing, and construction, are expected to spark notable job growth in blue-collar sectors. Nurses and construction workers, for example, cannot be replaced by current AI technologies. As AI reshapes office environments, technicians, tradespeople, and other blue-collar workers will continue to play a critical role in the new economy. After decades of declining manufacturing jobs due to globalization and automation, there is now renewed optimism for American working-class positions. Industries like semiconductor manufacturing are experiencing a shortage of available workers. Two years of a tight labor market and low unemployment have increased wages for many lower- and middle-income workers. This has contributed to a boom in blue-collar employment, with 9.6 million job openings nationwide and what some economists are calling 'full employment.' Government forecasts predict that, over the next decade, the fastest-growing jobs will be found in healthcare, transportation, renewable energy, and advanced manufacturing. Nearly half of all job gains are expected to come from the healthcare and social-support sectors. By 2032, one in six newly created jobs will be for home-health or personal-care aides. Construction has added an average of 15,000 jobs per month in the past year. Although total manufacturing employment is predicted to remain about the same, investment in the sector has surged to $200 billion annually—tripling over the last five years. Certain subsectors, like electrical equipment and semiconductors, are projected to grow 3% per year over the next decade. Chip manufacturing remains a national priority and offers many well-paying jobs to workers with only a high school education. According to Mark Muro of the Brookings Institution, about half of entry-level semiconductor workers have a high school diploma or equivalent. By 2032, the global semiconductor industry may reach $1 trillion, adding 50,000 US jobs such as electrical assemblers and industrial technicians. Although some working-class jobs remain vulnerable—for example, retail positions—many lower-income workers have recently experienced improvements. Post-pandemic recovery saw wages in the lowest 10th percentile of workers rise by 5.7% from March 2020 to March 2022. Real wages for blue-collar, nonmanagerial, and lower- to middle-wage workers are now higher than pre-pandemic levels. Other indicators, such as a decrease in the poverty rate from 14.8% to 11.5% during the past decade and a 45% increase in the net worth of the bottom 50% of households, confirm a positive trend. If a recession is avoided and the job market remains tight, further wage gains and reductions in poverty are possible. AI adoption is expected to further boost productivity in blue-collar roles, especially in industries like construction where increased efficiency can address major societal needs like housing. A World Economic Forum and Accenture study found that jobs requiring personal interaction and nonroutine physical activities are least likely to be displaced by AI. Consistent findings from the Bureau of Labor Statistics and McKinsey suggest that roles involving unpredictable environments and dexterity—such as air-conditioning installers, teachers, and hairdressers—will continue to be in demand. A study by OpenAI found that about 4% of workers, such as painters, carpenters, and roofers, perform tasks not influenced by AI. While AI may automate some routine supervisory or administrative tasks, it is unlikely to fully replace hands-on occupations. Instead, these technologies may allow workers to focus on higher-value activities—for instance, nurses could spend more time caring for patients instead of recordkeeping, potentially saving the healthcare system billions. AI-driven tools could also boost productivity and safety in fields like construction, by handling inspections or monitoring risks in real time. With 2.7 million workplace injuries and over 5,000 deaths reported annually in the US, such innovations can have a significant impact. Despite the physical or emotional demands, many blue-collar jobs offer durability, steady hours, opportunities for advancement, fair compensation, and a strong voice in the workplace. As the impact of AI grows, these roles may offer the stability that others seek amid economic uncertainty. Emil Skandul, a writer focusing on technology and urban economics and a fellow at the Tony Blair Institute, contributed this perspective.
translated_content: कृत्रिम बौद्धिकता (AI) ले छिट्टै सेतो कलर कामदारहरूको क्षेत्रमा ठूलो रूपान्तरण ल्याउँदै छ, जसले विश्वभर सयौं करोडौं जागिरमा असर पार्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ। लगभग १ अर्ब ज्ञान श्रमिकहरू प्रभावित हुन सक्छन् भने १ करोड ४० लाख जागिर हराउनेछन्। तर, AI अमेरिकी अर्थतन्त्रलाई आउँदा दशकहरूमा रूपान्तरण गर्ने संरचनागत परिवर्तनहरूमध्ये एक मात्र हो। कार्यालयमा काम गर्ने पेशेवरहरू अनिश्चित रोजगारी बजार र तलब घट्ने जोखिमसँग जुधिरहेका बेला, एउटा अनपेक्षित समूह भने यी चुनौतीहरूबाट जोगिएको देखिन्छ: निलो कलर श्रमिकहरू। सीपयुक्त पेशा, शारीरिक श्रम, वा भौतिक, प्रविधि र अन्तरव्यक्तिक सीपहरूको संयोजन भएका कामहरू AI बाट मूल रूपमा प्रभावित हुने सम्भावना कम छ। पुराना अमेरिकीहरूको ठूलो संख्यामा अवकाश र स्वास्थ्य सेवा, हरित ऊर्जा, उच्च प्रविधियुक्त उत्पादन र निर्माण क्षेत्रमा बढ्दो मागका कारण निलो कलर क्षेत्रमा उल्लेखनीय रोजगारी वृद्धि हुने आशा गरिएको छ। उदाहरणका लागि, नर्स र निर्माण श्रमिकहरू हालको AI प्रविधिले प्रतिस्थापन गर्न सक्दैन। AI ले कार्यालय परिवेश रूपान्तरण गर्दा प्राविधिक, ट्रेड्सपर्सन र अन्य निलो कलर श्रमिकहरू नयाँ अर्थतन्त्रमा महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेल्ने छन्। उत्पादनमा दशकौंसम्म रोजगारी घट्दै जाँदा अहिले उद्योगहरूमा, जस्तै सेमिकन्डक्टर उत्पादनमा श्रमिक अभाव देखिएको छ। विगत दुई वर्षको कडा श्रम बजार र न्यून बेरोजगारीले तल्लो तथा मध्य स्तरका श्रमिकहरूको तलब बढाएको छ। यसले निलो कलर रोजगारीमा बुम ल्याएको छ; देशभर ९६ लाख रोजगार खुला छन् र केही अर्थशास्त्रीहरूले यसलाई 'पूर्ण रोजगार' भनेका छन्। सरकारी पूर्वानुमान अनुसार, आगामी दशकमा छिटो बढ्ने रोजगारीहरू स्वास्थ्य सेवा, यातायात, नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा तथा प्रविधियुक्त उत्पादनमा हुनेछन्। कुल रोजगारी वृद्धिको करिब आधा स्वास्थ्य तथा सामाजिक सहयोग क्षेत्रमा हुने अनुमान छ। २०३२ सम्म, प्रत्येक ६ नयाँ रोजगारमध्ये १ होम-हेल्थ वा पर्सनल-केयर एडका लागि हुनेछ। निर्माण क्षेत्रमा वर्षमा औसत १५ हजार रोजगारी थपिएको छ। उत्पादनमा कुल रोजगार स्थिर रहने भए पनि वार्षिक लगानी पाँच वर्षमा तीन गुना भएर २० अर्ब डलर पुगिसकेको छ। विद्युत उपकरण र सेमिकन्डक्टर उपक्षेत्रहरूमा दशकमा ३% वार्षिक वृद्धिको अनुमान छ। चिप उत्पादन राष्ट्रिय प्राथमिकता भएको छ र यस क्षेत्रमा माध्यमिक शिक्षा पूरा गरेका व्यक्तिका लागि राम्रो आम्दानीका रोजगार छन्। ब्रूकिङ्स इन्स्टिच्युटका मार्क म्युरोका अनुसार, सेमिकन्डक्टर क्षेत्रमा प्रवेश स्तरका झन्डै ५०% कामदारसँग केवल हाईस्कूल डिप्लोमा छ। २०३२ सम्म ग्लोबल सेमिकन्डक्टर उद्योग १ ट्रिलियन डलर पुग्न सक्नेछ र अमेरिकामा ५० हजार नयाँ रोजगार सिर्जना गर्नेछ। यद्यपि खुद्रा क्षेत्रमा जस्ता केही काम अझै जोखिममा छन्, धेरै तल्लो आम्दानी भएका श्रमिकले पछिल्याउन सुधार अनुभव गरेका छन्। महामारीपछि २०२० मार्चदेखि २०२२ मार्चसम्म तलका १०% श्रमिकको तलब ५.७% ले बढेको छ। निलो कलर, गैर-प्रबन्धकीय तथा तल्लो-मध्य तलबका श्रमिकको तलब महामारीअघि भन्दा बढी छ। सकारात्मक अन्य सूचकहरूमा विगत दशकमा अमेरिका गरीबी दर १४.८% बाट ११.५% मा झरेको छ, र तल्लो ५०% घरपरिवारको शुद्ध सम्पत्ति महामारीअघि भन्दा ४५% बढी भएको छ। यदि मन्दी अवरुद्ध भयो र श्रम बजार कडा रह्यो भने, तलब अझै बढ्ने र गरीबी झर्ने सम्भावना छ। AI को विस्तारले विशेष गरी निर्माण जस्ता क्षेत्रमा निलो कलर श्रमिकका लागि उत्पादकता बढ्नेछ, जसले आवास अभाव जस्ता मुख्य सामाजिक समस्या समाधानमा सहयोग पुर्याउनेछ। विश्व आर्थिक मञ्च र एक्सेन्चरको अध्ययनले व्यक्तिगत अन्तरक्रिया र गैर-नियमित शारीरिक काम भएका पेशाहरू कम प्रभावित हुने देखाएको छ। ब्यूरो अफ लेबर स्ट्याटिस्टिक्स र म्याक्किन्सेका नतिजा पनि मिल्दोजुल्दो देखिएका छन्; र जस्तो अप्रत्याशित वातावरण र चातुर्य आवश्यक पर्ने एयरकन्डिसनर इन्स्टलर, शिक्षक, हेयरड्रेसर जस्ता कामहरू मागमा रहनेछन्। OpenAI ले गरेको अध्ययनअनुसार करिब ४% श्रमिक (चित्रकार, काठमिस्त्री, छत बनाउने आदिको काम) AI बाट प्रभावित छैनन्। AI ले दोहोरिने प्रशासनिक काम स्वचालित गर्न सक्ने भए पनि, हातले गर्ने मुख्य काम विलोप हुने छैनन्; बरु, प्रविधिले श्रमिकलाई महत्वपूर्ण कार्यमा केन्द्रित हुनमा सहजीकरण गर्नेछ—जस्तो नर्सले बिरामीको स्याहारमा बढी समय दिन सक्नेछ, जसले स्वास्थ्य सेवामा अरबौं बचत गर्न सक्नेछ। AI प्रविधिमा आधारित उपकरणहरुले निर्माणमा निरीक्षण, जोखिम अनुगमन जस्ता काममा सहजता ल्याउने भएकाले उत्पादकता र सुरक्षा दुवैमा सुधार ल्याउनेछ। अमेरिकामा हरेक वर्ष २७ लाख कार्यस्थल चोटपटक र ५,००० भन्दा बढी मृत्यु हुने भएकाले, यस्तो सुधारले अर्थपूर्ण प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ। शारीरिक वा भावनात्मक रूपमा चुनौतीपूर्ण भए तापनि, धेरै निलो कलर कामहरू भविष्यका लागि टिकाउ, स्थिर घण्टा, प्रगति, उचित पारिश्रमिक र स्वाभाविक अभिव्यक्ति दिने रोजगारी हुन्। AI को प्रभाव बढेसँगै, यिनीहरू अन्य मानिसहरूले खोज्ने स्थिरता दिने रोजगारी बन्न सक्नेछन्। प्रविधि तथा शहरी अर्थशास्त्रका लेखक र टोनी ब्लेयर इन्स्टिच्युटका फेलो एमिल स्कान्डुलको यो टिप्पणी हो।

article_content: General Toshio Tamogami was removed from his role as chief of Japan’s Air Self-Defense Force after publishing an essay that rejected the idea of Japan as a wartime aggressor. His claims sparked widespread criticism. Chinese state media welcomed Tamogami’s dismissal, with officials from both China and South Korea condemning his statements as a distortion of historical facts. Japan’s military invaded several Asian countries during World War II, committing atrocities like the Rape of Nanking in China, where extensive violence and mass killings took place. Additionally, during Japan’s occupation of Korea, thousands of women from Korea and China were forced into sexual slavery as ‘comfort women’ for Japanese soldiers. Tamogami’s essay renewed debates over historical memory in the region. Chinese media emphasized that while such views cause tension, strong acknowledgment of historical responsibility by Japan’s government is vital for good relations. Over recent decades, Japanese prime ministers such as Junichiro Koizumi and Tomiichi Murayama have officially apologized for wartime aggression, expressing deep remorse and a commitment to peace. Japan’s formal surrender in WWII followed the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August 1945, marking the end of a period of occupation and conflict throughout Asia and the Pacific.
translated_content: जापानको एयर सेल्फ-डिफेन्स फोर्सका प्रमुख जनरल तोशियो तामोगामीलाई दोस्रो विश्वयुद्धको समयमा जापान आक्रमणकारी नभएको दाबी गर्दै लेख प्रकाशित गरेपछि पदबाट हटाइयो। उनको दाबीले व्यापक आलोचना उत्पन्न गर्यो। चिनियाँ सरकारी सञ्चारमाध्यमले तामोगामीको बर्खास्तगीलाई स्वागत गरे भने, चीन र दक्षिण कोरियाका अधिकारीहरूले उनको अभिव्यक्तिलाई ऐतिहासिक तथ्यको विकृति भन्दै निन्दा गरे। दोस्रो विश्वयुद्धको समयमा जापानले एसियाका विभिन्न देशमा आक्रमण गर्दै, चीनको नान्किङमा नरसंहार र हिंसात्मक घटनाहरू गर्‍यो। त्यसैगरी, कोरियामा शासन गर्दा हजारौं कोरियाली तथा चिनियाँ महिलालाई 'कम्फर्ट वुमन' का रूपमा यौन दास बनाइएको थियो। तामोगामीको लेखले क्षेत्रीय ऐतिहासिक सम्झनाबारे बहस पुनः सतहमा ल्यायो। चिनियाँ सञ्चारमाध्यमका अनुसार, यस्ता विचारले तनाव पैदा गरे पनि, राम्रो सम्बन्धका लागि जापानले इतिहासप्रतिको जिम्मेवारी लिने कुरा अत्यावश्यक छ। पछिल्लो दशकमा जापानी प्रधानमन्त्रीहरू (जुनिचिरो कोइजुमी, टोमिइची मुरायामा) ले युद्धकालीन क्रियाकलापको लागि औपचारिक माफी माग्दै गम्भीर पश्चात्ताप र शान्तिप्रतिको प्रतिवद्धता जनाएका छन्। १९४५ को अगस्टमा हिरोशिमा र नागासाकीमा परमाणु बम खसालिएपछि जापानले औपचारिक रूपमा आत्मसमर्पण गर्‍यो र एसिया-प्यासिफिक क्षेत्रमा द्वन्द्वको अन्त भयो।

article_content: As COP28 begins in Dubai, nations worldwide are gathering to assess progress and chart the path forward in addressing the climate crisis. Over 30 years of negotiations have established key treaties, notably the 2015 Paris Agreement, all striving for a safer climate future. While these agreements have helped avoid catastrophic warming, the world is still not on a truly sustainable track, and time is running out. The 2023 UNEP Gap Report reveals that implementing all current national pledges under the Paris Agreement could limit global temperature rise to 2.9°C—well above the 1.5°C target. Even if conditional pledges, which depend on uncertain funding from wealthier nations, are met, we would still see a rise of about 2.5°C. According to a 2022 IPCC report, financial flows supporting climate action are three to six times lower than needed. If temperatures reach 2.9°C, devastating disruptions to natural systems and human societies are expected. With 2023 being the hottest year on record, the world looks to COP28 for a decisive course correction. UN climate negotiations face challenges due to consensus-based decision-making and an emphasis on procedural rather than substantive outcomes. This often results in grand announcements, such as the 2021 Glasgow commitment to 'phase down coal,' but falls short on real-world implementation—particularly evident in continued coal reliance in countries like India. Effective climate action requires comprehensive engagement at all levels of governance and across all sectors. COP28 should focus on setting clear norms and catalyzing meaningful action, rather than just aiming for ambitious new targets. This year’s COP marks the first 'Global Stocktake' to evaluate progress toward Paris Accord goals. The technical review already highlights major gaps in ambition and action. COP28 should openly acknowledge that current pledges and their implementation are inadequate, and strive for stronger follow-through, especially regarding financial support. Rather than fixate on setting higher emissions targets, COP28 should emphasize practical steps like expanding renewable energy, improving energy efficiency, and reducing use of unabated fossil fuels. Implementation and support—especially financial, technological, and capacity-building—are key to turning ambition into reality. Addressing equity and fairness is essential for ambitious climate action. Large-scale transitions can be disruptive, particularly for marginalized communities. Just, inclusive approaches that provide alternative livelihoods will foster a greater sense of ownership and lead to more effective climate solutions. The operationalization of the loss and damage fund at COP28, if properly financed, could help rebuild trust. Ensuring robust systems for following up and holding all parties accountable—inside and outside the UN process—is urgent, as demonstrated by the rise in climate-related litigation and the demands of the public. Leaders must deliver on promises and pull humanity off what the UN Secretary-General has called the 'highway to climate hell.'

सम्झौतासहित मुख्य सन्धिहरू स्थापना गरेका छन्, जसले सुरक्षित जलवायु भविष्यको लागि प्रयास गरेका छन्। यी सम्झौताहरूले विनाशकारी तातोबाट जोगाएको भए पनि अझै हामी दिगो मार्गमा छैनौं र समय सकिँदैछ। २०२३ को UNEP ग्याप रिपोर्टमा उल्लेख गरिएको छ कि पेरिस सम्झौताअन्तर्गत सबै हालका राष्ट्रिय प्रतिबद्धताहरू लागू गरेमा विश्वव्यापी तापमान वृद्धिलाई २.९°C मा सीमित गर्न सकिन्छ, जुन १.५°C लक्ष्यभन्दा धेरै माथि हो। धनी राष्ट्रबाट अनिश्चित वित्तीय सहायतामा आधारित सर्तसहितका प्रतिबद्धताहरू पूरा भए पनि, तापमान वृद्धिलाई लगभग २.५°C मा रोक्न सकिनेछ। २०२२ को IPCC रिपोर्ट अनुसार, जलवायु कार्यको लागि आवश्यक वित्तीय प्रवाह आवश्यकताभन्दा तीनदेखि छ गुणा कम छ। २.९°C तापमान पुगेमा, प्राकृतिक प्रणाली र मानव समाजमा विनाशकारी असरहरू पर्नेछन्। २०२३ हालसम्मकै सबैभन्दा तातो वर्ष भएकोले, विश्वले COP28 बाट निर्णायक परिवर्तनको आशा राखेको छ। संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघीय जलवायु वार्ता सर्वसम्मतिमा आधारित निर्णय प्रक्रियाले चुनौतीहरू ल्याउने गरेको छ, जसले प्रक्रियागत कुरामा जोड दियो तर व्यवहारिक कार्यान्वयन कमजोर छ। २०२१ को ग्लासगो प्रतिबद्धताजस्तै 'कोइलालाई घटाउने' घोषणा भएपनि भारतजस्ता देशमा अझै कोइलामा भर परेको छ। प्रभावकारी जलवायु कार्यका लागि सबै तह र क्षेत्रको समावेशी संलग्नता आवश्यक छ। COP28 ले केवल नयाँ महत्वाकांक्षी लक्ष्यमा केन्द्रित नभई स्पष्ट मान्यताको खाका बनाउन र सार्थक कार्यमा उत्प्रेरणा दिनुपर्छ। यस वर्षको COP मा 'ग्लोबल स्टकटेक' पहिलोपटक हुँदैछ, जसले पेरिस सम्झौताका लक्ष्यतर्फको प्रगतिहरू मूल्याङ्कन गर्नेछ। प्रविधिक समीक्षाले महत्वाकांक्षा र कार्यान्वयनमा ठूलो खाडल रहेको देखाएको छ। COP28 ले उच्च उत्सर्जन लक्ष्यमाथि मात्र जोड नदिई, व्यवहारिक उपायहरू—नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा विस्तार, ऊर्जा दक्षता सुधार, र नियन्त्रणविहीन जीवाश्म ईन्धन घटाउनेमा बल दिनुपर्छ। विशिष्ट कार्यान्वयन र सहयोग—बिशेषगरी वित्त, प्रविधि, क्षमतामा—महत्वाकांक्षालाई वास्तविकतामा परिणत गर्ने आधार हो। न्याय र समानतामा जोड दिनु जलवायु कार्यका लागि अत्यावश्यक छ। ठूला प्रणालीगत परिवर्तनहरू विशेषगरी सीमान्तकृत समुदायहरूको लागि असरकारी हुन सक्छ। न्यायपूर्ण र समावेशी दृष्टिकोणले वैकल्पिक जीविकोपार्जन दिन सक्ने हुँदा अधिक प्रभावकारी जलवायु समाधानमा साथ पुर्‍याउँछ। COP28 मा पूर्वाधार तयार भएको यदि सम्बद्ध वित्त संगै आएको खण्डमा 'लस एन्ड ड्यामेज फण्ड' ले विश्वास बढाउन सक्छ। अनुगमन र जवाफदेहिता सुनिश्चित गर्ने प्रणाली निर्माण गर्नु—संयुक्त राष्ट्रअन्तर्गत र बाहिर—खासै जरुरी छ, जसको प्रमाण सबै देशमा बढ्दो जलवायु मुद्दा र सार्वजनिक माग हो। नेताहरूले वाचा पुरा गर्नुपर्छ र मानवता सोमात्र युन महासचिवले भनेझैं 'जलवायु नर्कको राजमार्ग' बाट झार्नुपर्छ।

article_content: Laura Libman, founder and CEO of the Arizona-based Tia Foundation—a nonprofit focused on providing healthcare to rural Mexico—is continuing her work despite concerns about the swine flu outbreak. Although friends and family have expressed worry, Libman feels this is the time her support is most needed. The World Health Organization reports cases of swine flu (H1N1) globally, with Mexico as the main center of the outbreak. Officials estimate more than 150 deaths and about 2,500 illnesses in Mexico, causing many travelers to avoid the country. The Tia Foundation helps the poorest villages, often lacking basic healthcare and access to hospitals. In partnership with La Universidad Autónoma de Guadalajara, it trains local women chosen by their communities as community health workers (promotoras), providing them with medical kits and medicines. Francisco Casteñeda Rico, head of the university's community medicine program, says the partnership with Tia improves their outreach. All 98 current promotoras are women, reflecting caregiving roles and male labor migration. Libman also highlights the program's role in promoting female leadership. Journalist and photographer Kathy McCraine saw the positive impact of this during reporting trips to Mexico for Thunderbird Magazine. She donated a $500 medical kit to a promotora after attending their training, and the recipient expressed pride in serving her village. These unpaid promotoras now serve 30,000 to 50,000 people, providing services like delivering babies, suturing wounds, treating infections, monitoring blood sugar, and teaching hand-washing. The foundation’s next village project will begin May 18 in Jalisco. Libman expects to travel on May 8 and is also seeking a new medical director. Due to the flu outbreak, interns cannot join her for liability reasons, so former intern Wynona Heim may volunteer instead. Nicole Ostrofe, a 23-year-old intern, was disappointed she could not travel to the field. Heim, a mother of two, says she feels safe due to the support from medical professionals and the current absence of cases in Jalisco. Libman's greatest worry is possible flight cancellations. She is prepared to drive if needed. The only reason for canceling would be if university medical students are assigned to emergency response. She hopes the next training will proceed, emphasizing the need not to restrict organizations like hers. Libman compares her commitment to groups like Doctors Without Borders—prepared to serve despite risks.
translated_content: एरिजोना-आधारित टिया फाउन्डेसनकी संस्थापक तथा सीईओ लौरा लिबम्यान, जसको गैर-नाफामुखी संस्था ग्रामीण मेक्सिकोमा स्वास्थ्य सेवा पुर्याउनमा केन्द्रित छ, स्वाइन फ्लूको डरका बाबजुद आफ्नो अभियान जारी राख्दै छिन्। परिवार तथा साथीहरूले चिन्ता देखाए पनि, लिबम्यानलाई अहिले नै बढी सहयोग आवश्यक भएको महसुस भएको छ। विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन अनुसार, विश्वभर स्वाइन फ्लू (H1N1) का केसहरू देखिएका छन्, जसमा मेक्सिको यसको मुख्य केन्द्रबिन्दु बनेको छ। अधिकारीहरूले मेक्सिकामा १५० भन्दा बढी मृत्यु र करिब २५०० बिरामी पुगेको बताएका छन्, जसका कारण धेरै पर्यटकहरू त्यहाँ जान नखोजेका छन्। टिया फाउन्डेसनले अत्यन्तै गरिब गाउँहरूमा स्वास्थ्य सेवा पुर्याउँछ, जहाँ आधारभूत स्वास्थ्य सेवा र अस्पताल पुग्न समस्या छ। ला यूनिभर्सिदाद अटोनोमा दे ग्वाडालाजाराको साझेदारीमा, समुदायद्वारा चयनित महिलाहरूलाई प्रमोतोरा (समुदाय स्वास्थ्यकर्मी) को रूपमा तालिम दिइन्छ, र औषधि तथा मेडिकल किट प्रदान गरिन्छ। विश्वविद्यालयको समुदाय स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रमका प्रमुख फ्रान्सिस्को कास्टेनेडा रिकोकाअनुसार, टियासँगको साझेदारीले उनीहरूको पहुँच अझै बढाएको छ। तालिम लिएका अहिलेका ९८ प्रमोतोरा सबै महिला हुन्, जसले हेरचाह गर्ने भूमिका र पुरुषहरूको बाहिर श्रम गर्न जानुपर्ने अवस्थालाई देखाउँछ। लिबम्यानले महिलाको नेतृत्वमूलक भूमिकामा पनि यसको सकारात्मक असर परेको बताइन्। पत्रकार एवं फोटोग्राफर क्याथी म्याकक्रेनले टियाको कार्यक्रमको रिपोर्टिङका सिलसिलामा मेक्सिको गएका बेला महिलालाई मिलेको नयाँ सम्मान देखिन्। उनले तालिमपछि एक प्रमोतोरा स्वास्थ्यकर्मीलाई $५०० को मेडिकल किट दिएकी थिइन्, र उक्त महिलाले गाउँको सेवा गरेर गर्व महशुस गरेको उनले बताइन्। यी स्वयंसेवी प्रमोतोरा स्वास्थ्यकर्मीहरूले हाल ३०,००० देखि ५०,००० जनासम्मलाई सेवा दिइरहेका छन्, जसअनुसार सुत्केरी गराउने, टाँका लगाउने, संक्रमण उपचार, ब्लड सुगर मापन र हात धुने बारे जनचेतना फैलाउने कार्य गर्नेछन्। फाउन्डेसनको अर्को गाउँ परियोजना मे १८ देखि जलिस्कोमा सुरु हुँदैछ। लिबम्यान मे ८ मा यात्रा गर्ने योजना बनाउँदै छिन् र नयाँ मेडिकल डाइरेक्टरको खोजी पनि भइरहेकी छिन्। फ्लूको कारण, इंटर्नहरू कानुनी जोखिमका कारण सँगै जान पाएका छैनन्, त्यसैले पूर्व-इंटर्न विनोना हाइम स्वयंसेवकका रूपमा सँगै जान सक्नेछिन्। २३ वर्षीया इंटर्न निकोल ओस्ट्रोफले फिल्डमा जान नपाउँदा निराश महसुस गरिन्। हाइम, दुई छोरीकी आमा, हाल जलिस्कोमा संक्रमण नरहेको र चिकित्सकहरूको साथ हुँदा आफू सुरक्षित भएको बताउँछिन्। लिबम्यानको मुख्य चिन्ता भनेको फ्लाइट रद्द हुन सक्नु हो। उनले आवश्यक परे कारमै जान तयार रहेको बताइन्। विश्वविद्यालयका मेडिकल विद्यार्थीहरूलाई आपतकालीन उद्धारमा खटाउनु परे मात्र कार्यक्रम रोक्ने निर्णय हुनेछ। उनले यस्ता मानवीय काममा थप सरकारी अवरोध नगर्न आग्रह गरेकी छिन्। लिबम्यानले आफ्नो समर्पणलाई, जोखिम सामना गरेर सेवा गर्ने डक्टर्स विदाउट बोर्डर्स जस्ता संस्थासँग तुलना गरेकी छिन्।

article_content: Siemens Ltd. shares were down 0.05% at Rs 3,372.20 as of 1:44 PM (IST) on Friday, even as the BSE Sensex rose by 410.12 points to 64,491.02. Previously, Siemens closed at Rs 3,373.95. The stock’s 52-week high is Rs 4,066.10 and its 52-week low is Rs 2,692.00. Trading volume by 1:44 PM stood at 4,132 shares, resulting in a turnover of Rs 1.39 crore. Based on the current price, Siemens is trading at 59.01 times its trailing twelve-month earnings per share (EPS) of Rs 57.34, and at a price-to-book value of 8.49. A higher price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio signals investor expectations of future company growth, while price-to-book value reflects the amount investors are willing to pay relative to the company's inherent value. The stock’s beta, which measures volatility compared to the broader market, stands at 1.3. As of 30 September 2023, promoters held no stake in the company, foreign institutional investors (FIIs) held 7.93%, and domestic institutional investors (DIIs) held 3.2%. From a technical perspective, Siemens’ Relative Strength Index (RSI) is at 33.62. RSI values range from 0 to 100, with readings above 70 indicating overbought conditions and below 30 indicating oversold. However, analysts caution against using RSI or any single indicator in isolation to make trading decisions. In related industry news: India’s leading telecom operators have accused global tech majors like Microsoft and Amazon of bypassing legal telecom channels by sending business messages through WhatsApp and similar platforms, allegedly resulting in an annual revenue loss of ₹3,000 crore for both the government and service providers. article_content: Passive income offers a way to earn money without being tied to a traditional job or trading hours for dollars. Thanks to technology, it's easier than ever to start building passive income streams. Women entrepreneurs, in particular, can benefit from these opportunities by gaining more control over their schedules and pursuing their interests. Some effective passive income approaches include: Affiliate Marketing: You can partner with companies to promote their products, earning a commission for each sale made through your unique referral link. The most successful affiliates focus on products that fit their audience and build trust with their followers. Rental Properties: Investing in real estate—whether a house, apartment, or office space—can provide a steady income through rent payments. You can use a property management company to handle maintenance and tenant issues, making this approach relatively hands-off. Digital Products: Tools like e-books, online courses, printables, and templates take work to create initially, but once published, they can be sold repeatedly with little ongoing effort. This can generate income even while you sleep. Peer-to-Peer Lending: Platforms now allow you to lend money directly to individuals and potentially earn interest. While this can diversify your investments, it has risks, so careful research is essential. Stocks and Bonds: Investing in these can help your money grow over time. Dividend-paying stocks are particularly attractive since they send shareholders regular payments, potentially increasing alongside the company's growth. To succeed with passive income, it's important to start with proper research, select methods that match your resources and interests, and consider using a mix of strategies. With some time and planning upfront, you can build diverse income streams, increasing your financial independence and giving you the chance to pursue your goals with more freedom.

article_content: Father Martin McVeigh, an Irish priest, has chosen to leave his parish temporarily and take a sabbatical after becoming the center of a controversy involving explicit images. In March, during a PowerPoint presentation for parents whose children were preparing for First Holy Communion at a school in Pomeroy, County Tyrone, Northern Ireland, images of naked men were unintentionally shown. Parents said they were shocked and called for action. The Catholic Church launched an investigation, and the police were informed; authorities found that no crime had been committed. Father McVeigh apologized for the distress, admitting that he hadn’t checked the presentation beforehand, but insisted he was unaware of how the images ended up on the device. He removed and later destroyed the memory stick to prevent further incidents. McVeigh described the experience as one of the most difficult of his life. He requested a break in hopes of helping the community heal. Cardinal Sean Brady approved McVeigh’s leave and noted that all other computers McVeigh used had been examined by independent experts and found free of inappropriate material. Brady described the situation as traumatic for both the parish and McVeigh. A separate stolen laptop was not included in the investigation. This incident comes amid ongoing revelations of child abuse scandals within the Irish Catholic Church, underlining persistent concerns about safeguarding and the church’s handling of such matters.

article_content: New research could reignite the ongoing debate between cat and dog lovers. Scientists surveyed pet owners in Denmark, Austria, and the United Kingdom, finding that dog owners tended to be more attached to their dogs compared to cat owners and their cats. However, the strength of this attachment varied greatly between countries. Over time, attitudes toward cats appear to be changing, and researchers believe cats could eventually become just as cherished as dogs. The study, led by veterinary scientists at the University of Copenhagen and published in Frontiers in Veterinary Science, was inspired by evidence showing that, historically, dog owners have spent more on veterinary care than cat owners. Recently, this trend has begun to shift in favor of cats. Lead author Peter Sandøe noted that in the past 50 years, cats have become more popular companions. To explore this change, the team surveyed a representative sample of 2,117 pet owners: 844 dog owners, 872 cat owners, and 401 who owned both pets. Participants answered questions about their emotional bonds with their pets and their spending on veterinary care, such as whether they purchased pet health insurance. The survey found that, on average, all groups cared more about their dogs than their cats, especially in Denmark. In the UK, the differences were small and not statistically significant. For example, 34% of dog owners in the UK said they would pay high costs for life-saving treatment for their pets, compared to 28% of cat owners. In Denmark, 41% of dog owners and 26% of cat owners said the same. The study suggests cultural traits and history play a big role in how people value their pets. For example, Denmark's more rural past may mean people are less used to having cats as household pets, which could affect attachment levels. Other factors, like pet care costs, may also play a part. While dogs may be favored now, cats are gaining ground and could become equally beloved. The authors point out that in other parts of the world, such as Asia, cats have long been valued, sometimes even more than dogs. The researchers hope to study more countries in the future. As Sandøe said, 'Looking at these data, there’s no reason to say that dogs will always have the upper paw.'
translated_content: नयाँ अनुसन्धानले बिरालो र कुकुर प्रेमीबीचको पुरानो बहस फेरि सुरु हुन सक्छ। वैज्ञानिकहरूले डेनमार्क, अस्ट्रिया, र बेलायतका घरपालुवा जनावर मालिकहरूलाई सर्वेक्षण गर्दा, कुकुर मालिकहरू आफ्नो कुकुरसँग बिरालो मालिकहरूभन्दा बढी भावनात्मक रूपमा जोडिएको पाइयो। तर, यो भावनात्मक सम्बन्ध देशअनुसार निकै फरक थियो। समयसँगै बिरालोप्रतिको धारणा परिवर्तन हुँदै गएको छ, र अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरू भन्छन् कि छिट्टै बिरालो पनि कुकुरजत्तिकै प्रिय हुनसक्छन्। कोपनहेगन विश्वविद्यालयका पशु वैज्ञानिकहरूले गरेको यो अध्ययन फ्रन्टियर्स इन भेटेरिनरी साइन्स पत्रिकामा प्रकाशित भएको हो। अघिल्लो तथ्यांकले कुकुर मालिकहरूले बिरालो मालिकभन्दा पशु चिकित्सामा बढी खर्च गर्ने देखाए पनि, हाल त्यो प्रवृत्ति बिरालोतर्फ बढ्दै गइरहेको छ। प्रमुख लेखक पिटर स्यान्डोएका अनुसार, पछिल्ला ५० वर्षमा बिरालो साथीका रूपमा लोकप्रिय हुन थालेका छन्। यस परिवर्तन बुझ्न टोलीले २,११७ जना मालिकहरू—८४४ कुकुर, ८७२ बिरालो, र ४०१ दुवैका मालिक—लाई सर्वेक्षण गर्‍यो। सहभागीहरूले जनावरप्रतिको भावनात्मक सम्बन्ध र पशु उपचार खर्चका बारेमा प्रश्नको उत्तर दिए। नतिजामा सबै समूहले औसतमा कुकुरलाई बिरालोभन्दा बढी माया गरेका देखिए, विशेष गरी डेनमार्कमा। बेलायतमा फरक अत्यन्तै सानो र तथ्यांकका हिसाबले खासै मतलवको थिएन। उदाहरणका लागि, बेलायतमा कुकुर मालिकमध्ये ३४% ले जीवनरक्षक उपचारमा बढी खर्च गर्न तयार थिए भने, बिरालो मालिकमध्ये २८% मात्र तयार थिए। डेनमार्कमा त यो प्रतिशत ४१% कुकुर मालिक र २६% बिरालो मालिक थिए। अध्ययनले सांस्कृतिक र ऐतिहासिक कारणहरूले घरपालुवा जनावरप्रतिको माया फरक हुने देखायो। जस्तै, डेनमार्कको ग्रामीण इतिहासका कारण त्यहाँका मानिसहरू बिरालोलाई घरपालुवा जनावरका रूपमा कम चिन्छन्। अन्य कुरा, जस्तै उपचार खर्च, पनि असर गर्ने देखियो। अहिले कुकुर बढी लोकप्रिय भए पनि, बिरालोले चाँडै त्यही स्थान पाउन सक्छन्। लेखकहरूले एशियाका कतिपय भागमा बिरालोलाई अझै बढी माया गरिने बताउँदै, भविष्यमा अरू देशहरूमा अध्ययन गर्ने आशा राखेका छन्। स्यान्डोए भन्छन्, 'यी तथ्यांक हेर्दा, कुकुरले सधैं अग्रता लिन्छ नै भन्न सकिन्न।'

article_content: Syrian opposition leader Moaz al-Khatib attempted to resign on Sunday, but the Syrian National Coalition's executive committee rejected his resignation. According to coalition spokesperson Sanir Ahmed, al-Khatib will continue to lead the group until its next general meeting, although the date is yet to be determined. Ahmed stated that al-Khatib has guided the coalition through a crucial period, earning popularity and fostering unity among the opposition, making it necessary for him to remain in his position for now. Earlier, al-Khatib had announced his resignation in a written statement, accusing world powers of using the Syrian crisis to pursue their own interests. In his statement, al-Khatib mentioned he had promised the Syrian people and God to resign if certain 'red lines' were crossed. He expressed a desire to step down for greater freedom to act outside the organization's official constraints. Last week, Syrian opposition alliance members elected Ghassan Hitto—who has studied and lived in the United States—as leader of the interim government. On Sunday, Hitto arrived in Syria, crossing from Turkey, and met rebel leaders in Aleppo, according to a coalition Facebook post. Commenting on al-Khatib’s resignation, spokesman Mohammed Ali expressed ongoing frustration with a lack of meaningful international support. He said Syrian people have suffered significant tragedies, but the international community has yet to take decisive action to help them defend themselves. This news arrives two days before an Arab League meeting is scheduled in Doha, Qatar, where Qatar’s Foreign Minister, Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim al-Thani, expressed anticipation for the interim government's participation. Al-Khatib has reportedly wanted to leave his position for some time, preferring an executive committee rather than an interim leader structure. Before the coalition rejected al-Khatib’s resignation, U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry stated he respected al-Khatib and was saddened by his potential departure, noting that leadership change in the opposition is expected and ongoing. In a separate development, the Israeli military reported its troops came under fire in the Golan Heights from the Syrian side on Sunday, prompting return fire. Israeli Defense Minister Moshe Yaalon blamed the Syrian military and emphasized that Israel would not tolerate violations of its sovereignty. The IDF reported no casualties or damage but continued to monitor the situation. The Syrian opposition network, the Local Coordination Committees of Syria, indicated that rebels were clashing with Syrian army forces near the Golan Heights at the time. Fighting has intensified in the area, with rebels and Nusra Front fighters gaining territory. The radical Islamist al-Nusra Front has become a significant group within the Syrian resistance, consisting of foreign fighters with experience in Iraq and elsewhere. The U.S. designated al-Nusra as a foreign terrorist organization in December due to its ties to al Qaeda in Iraq. Israeli President Shimon Peres commented that initial hopes for Bashar al-Assad, who trained as a doctor in London before becoming Syrian president, were unfounded. Peres claimed Assad worked on building a nuclear weapon and chemical arsenal—while the nuclear facility was destroyed, chemical weapons remain. Peres described the situation in Syria as a tragedy. Reporters Salma Abdelaziz, Lauren Russell, Steve Almasy, and Josh Levs contributed to this report.
translated_content: सीरियाली विपक्षी नेता मोआज अल-खातिबले आइतबार राजीनामा दिन प्रयास गरेका थिए, तर सिरियन नेशनल कोएलिशनको कार्यकारी समितिले उनको राजीनामा अस्वीकार गर्‍यो। कोएलिशनका प्रवक्ता सनिर अहमदका अनुसार, अल-खातिब अर्को साधारणसभा बैठक नहुञ्जेल समूहको नेतृत्व गर्नेछन्, यद्यपि बैठकको मिति अझै तय गरिएको छैन। अहमदले भने, अल-खातिबले विपक्षीहरूलाई ऐक्यबद्धता दिलाएर र लोकप्रियता कमाएर कोएलिशनलाई महत्वपूर्ण समयमा अगाडि बढाएका छन्, त्यसैले उनी हाललाई पदमा रहन आवश्यक छ। यसअघि, अल-खातिबले लिखित विज्ञप्तिमा राजीनामा घोषणा गर्दै, विश्व शक्तिहरूले सिरियाली संकट आफ्नै स्वार्थका लागि प्रयोग गरिरहेको आरोप लगाएका थिए। आफ्नो बयानमा, अल-खातिबले 'केही रातो रेखामा पुगेमा' सिरियावासी र भगवानसँग राजीनामा दिने वाचा गरेको उल्लेख गरेका छन्। उनले संगठनको अधिकारिक नीतिमा बाँधिएर भन्दा बढी स्वतन्त्र भएर काम गर्न चाहेका कारण राजीनामा दिन चाहेको बताए। गत साता, सिरियाली विपक्षी गठबन्धनले अमेरिकामा पढेका र बसेका घस्सान हित्टोलाई अन्तरिम सरकारको प्रमुखको रूपमा चयन गरेको थियो। आइतबार हित्टो टर्कीबाट सिरिया प्रवेश गरेर अलेप्पोमा विद्रोही नेताहरूलाई भेटेका छन् भन्ने कोएलिशनको फेसबुक पोस्टले जनाएको छ। अल-खातिबको राजीनामाबारे प्रवक्ता मोहम्मद अलिले अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय समुदायबाट अपेक्षित सहायता नपाएको भन्दै असन्तुष्टि व्यक्त गरे। उनले सिरियाली जनता ठूलो पीडा भोग्नु परिरहेको, तर अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय समुदाय अझै निर्णायक कदम चाल्नमा असफल रहेको बताए। यो समाचार अरब लिगको बैठक दोहा, कतारमा हुनुभन्दा दुई दिनअघि आएको हो, जहाँ कतारका परराष्ट्रमन्त्री शेख हमाद बिन जसिम अल-थानीले अन्तरिम सरकारको सहभागिताबारे आशा व्यक्त गरेका छन्। अल-खातिब केही समयदेखि नै पद छोड्ने इच्छा राखेका, उनि कार्यकारी समितिले समूहको नेतृत्व गरुन् भन्ने चाहन्थे। कोएलिशनले उनको राजीनामा अस्वीकार गर्नु अघि, अमेरिकी विदेशमन्त्री जोन केरीले अल-खातिबलाई समर्थन गर्दै सम्भावित बिदाइप्रति दुःख व्यक्त गरेका थिए, विपक्षी नेतृत्वमा परिवर्तन भए पनि प्रक्रिया निरन्तर चलिरहने बताए। अलग घटनामा, आइतबार इजरायली सेनाले गोलान क्षेत्रबाट सिरियाली पक्षबाट गोली चलाइएको र आफूहरूले जवाफी कारबाही गरेको जनाएको छ। इजरायली रक्षा मन्त्री मोशे यालोनले सिरियाली सेनालाई दोषी ठहर गर्दै, आफ्नो सार्वभौमिकतामाथि हमला सहन नहुने बताए। आईडीएफले कुनै क्षति वा घाइते नभएको, तर क्षेत्रको निगरानी जारी रहेको बताएको छ। सिरियाली विपक्षी नेटवर्क, लोकल कोअर्डिनेसन समितिहरूले उक्त समयमा विद्रोहीहरू गोलान सिमानामा सिरियाली सेनासँग भिडिरहेको जनाएका छन्। क्षेत्रमा संघर्ष तीव्र बन्दै गएको छ, विद्रोहीहरू र नुस्रा फ्रन्टले इलाका नियन्त्रणमा लिइरहेका छन्। अतिवादी इस्लामवादी अल–नुस्रा फ्रन्ट, जुन विदेशी लडाकुहरूका साथ सिरियाली प्रतिरोधको एक प्रभावशाली समूह बन्न पुगेको छ, अमेरिकी सरकारले डिसेम्बरमा आतंकवादी सूचीमा राखेको थियो। इजरायली राष्ट्रपति सिमोन पेरेसले सिरियाली राष्ट्रपति बशर अल–असदप्रति आशा गरिएको भए पनि त्यो व्यर्थ भएको बताए। पेरेसले असदले आणविक हतियार र रासायनिक हातहतियार बनाउने प्रयास गरेको दाबी गर्दै, आणविक सुविधा भने नष्ट भए तापनि रासायनिक हतियार बाँकी रहेको बताए। उनले सिरियाको अवस्था दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण रहेको टिप्पणी गरे। यो समाचारमा सल्मा अब्देलाजिज, लरेन रस्सेल, स्टिभ आलमसी, र जोश लेव्सले योगदान गरेका छन्।
