article_content: More than 2,800 people have been killed in Nigeria since the Boko Haram crisis began in 2009, according to Human Rights Watch. Boko Haram, an Islamic militant group seeking to enforce strict Islamic law in northern Nigeria, has attacked both civilian and government targets, challenging the government's ability to protect its citizens. The group has targeted police stations and the United Nations headquarters in Abuja, among others. President Goodluck Jonathan, after other efforts failed, invoked Section 305 of the Nigerian Constitution and declared a state of emergency in Borno, Yobe, and Adamawa states in May 2013. These regions have been most affected by Boko Haram and its offshoot, Ansaru. In a televised statement, Jonathan said there was a concerted effort by insurgents to destabilize Nigeria. The government deployed more troops, closed borders with Cameroon, Niger, and Chad, and provided air support to operations against Boko Haram hideouts. These actions led to a significant reduction in attacks, largely by blocking supplies to the militants. Still, questions remain about whether these gains can be sustained. Despite government claims, many Boko Haram members are believed to be hiding within northern communities. Locals, aware of their presence, still cite grievances against the military—alleging indiscriminate targeting and civilian casualties, making some fear security forces more than the insurgents. The Nigerian military has denied excessive civilian casualties, but international figures such as U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry have voiced concern over alleged abuses. To maintain progress, the military must build trust with locals, who might otherwise remain passive or even support Boko Haram. Northern Nigeria’s political exclusion since the country’s 1999 transition to civil rule has deepened these tensions, as the region once dominated Nigeria’s political landscape but now feels sidelined. Boko Haram is entrenched and adaptive, with roots in previous political violence and earlier factions such as the 'Nigerian Taliban.' The group’s goals are still not fully understood by the government, and leaders like Abubakar Shekau remain at large. The current stability remains fragile and may require ongoing military presence alongside effective efforts to address political and social grievances. Reports of ceasefires likely refer to partial agreements, the scope of which is unclear. Some government negotiation efforts are criticized for lack of transparency and credibility. Resolving the Boko Haram crisis requires addressing security, political, and community concerns in northern Nigeria. The views expressed are those of Isaac Olawale Albert.
translated_content: मानव अधिकार अनुगमन संस्थाका अनुसार, बोको हराम संकट २००९ देखि सुरु भएयता नाइजेरियामा २,८०० भन्दा बढी मानिसले ज्यान गुमाएका छन्। बोको हराम, जसले उत्तर नाइजेरियामा कडा इस्लामिक कानुन लागू गर्न खोजेको छ,ले नागरिक र सरकारी निकायहरू दुबैलाई आक्रमण गरेर सरकारको सुरक्षामा चुनौती दिएको छ। यस समूहले प्रहरी चौकी र संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघ मुख्यालय जस्ता ठूला स्थानहरूमा आक्रमण गरेको छ। राष्ट्रपति गुडलक जोनाथनले अन्य प्रयास असफल भएपछि नाइजेरियाली संविधानको धारा ३०५ अनुसर गरी २०१३ को मे महिनामा बोर्नो, योबे र अदमावा राज्यमा आपतकाल घोषणा गरे। यी क्षेत्रहरू बोको हराम र यसको सहायक समूह अनसारुले सबैभन्दा बढी असर पारेका हुन्। टेलिभिजन सम्बोधनमा जोनाथनले विद्रोहीहरूले नाइजेरियालाई अस्थिर बनाउन सुनियोजित प्रयास गरेको बताए। सरकारले थप सेना पठायो, क्यामरुन, नाइजर र चाड सँगको सिमाना बन्द गर्‍यो, र हवाई सहायता सहित सेनाले बोको हरामको लुकाइस्थानमा कारवाही गर्‍यो। मुख्यत: आपूर्ति रोक्न सफल भएपछि बोको हरामका आक्रमणहरू उल्लेख्य रूपमा घटेका छन्। तर, यी उपलब्धि दीर्घकालसम्म टिक्न सक्ने छन् कि छैनन् भन्ने प्रश्न बाँकी छ। सरकारले भनेजस्तो धेरै बोको हरामका सदस्यहरू अझै उत्तरका समुदायहरूमा लुकेका विश्वास गरिन्छ। स्थानीयहरूलाई उनीहरूका बारेमा थाहा भए पनि, सेनाको रणनितिमा नागरिकलाई निसाना बनाइएको, मारिएको आरोप राख्छन् र केही स्थानीयलाई विद्रोहीभन्दा सेना नै बढी डर लाग्छ। सेनाले अत्यधिक नागरिक हताहतिको आरोप अस्वीकार गरे पनि अमेरिकी विदेशमन्त्री जॉन केरी लगायतले सुरक्षा बलहरूका दुरुपयोगमाथि चासो देखाएका छन्। सकारात्मक परिणाम दीर्घकालीन बनाउन सेनाले स्थानीयहरूको विश्वास जित्न आवश्यक छ। नत्र तिनीहरू निस्क्रिय या बोको हरामप्रति सहानुभूति राख्न सक्नेछन्। १९९९ मा नागरिक शासन सुरुयता उत्तर नाइजेरियालाई राजनीति, सामाजिक एवं आर्थिक रूपमा बहिष्कृत गरिएको महसुसले तनाव थप बढाएको छ। यो क्षेत्र पहिले सत्तामा हावी थियो, अहिले भने पन्छिन पुगेको छ। बोको हराम गहिरो रुपमा जरा गाडेको लचिलो संगठन हो। यस समूहका सदस्यहरू पूरानो राजनीतिक हिंसामा पनि संलग्न थिए र 'नाइजेरियन तालिवान' का नाममा समेत परिचित थिए। सरकारको लागि समूहका माग अझै अस्पष्ट छन्, र नेता अबुबकर शेकेउ अझै पक्राउ परेका छैनन्। हालको अवस्था अस्थिर छ, लामो समयसम्म सुधार गर्न सतर्कता, सेना उपस्थिति, साथै राजनीतिक तथा सामाजिक असन्तुष्टी समाधान आवश्यक छ। सम्भावित युद्धविराम आंशिक मात्र हुनसक्छ र त्यो कत्तिको प्रभावकारी छ भन्ने स्पष्ट छैन। सरकारी वार्ता प्रयासहरू पारदर्शिता र विश्वासको अभावकै कारण आलोचना भइरहेको छ। बोको हराम संकटको समाधानका लागि सुरक्षासँगै राजनीतिक र समुदायका मुद्दाहरू सम्बोधन गर्नुपर्छ। यहाँ राखिएका विचारहरू आइज्याक ओलावाले अल्बर्टका निजी विचार हुन्।

article_content: A claim described in a biography alleges that former British Prime Minister David Cameron took part in an unusual initiation ritual while a student at Oxford University. The account, provided by a fellow Member of Parliament and published in a book by Michael Ashcroft and Isabel Oakeshott, suggests Cameron engaged in the act as part of his membership in the Piers Gaveston Society. The story remains unsubstantiated and has circulated primarily as an anecdote. Cameron resigned as Prime Minister in 2016 following the Brexit referendum, a decision unrelated to the aforementioned allegations. He was recently appointed back to the cabinet amid a period of political transition in the Conservative Party. Separately, the United Kingdom has reported its first human case of a distinct swine flu strain, H1N2 clade 1b.1.1. The individual affected experienced a mild illness, required no hospitalization, and has since recovered. The source of the infection is currently being investigated, as the person was not known to have any contact with pigs. The UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) has initiated contact tracing to prevent potential further transmission. It remains unclear how transmissible this strain is or if additional cases are present in the UK.

article_content: Suzanne Virdee, a veteran presenter of BBC’s Midlands Today, stepped down last March after over a decade, citing a hostile work environment fueled by bullying. After her resignation, Virdee initiated a legal challenge against the BBC, but this was resolved when she accepted an undisclosed financial settlement, ending the dispute. The terms of this settlement remain confidential. Virdee declined to sign a new contract, attributing her decision to uncontrollable circumstances. The National Union of Journalists voiced sharp criticism over how the BBC managed Virdee’s exit and lamented she was denied the chance to say goodbye to viewers after 11 years of service. Concerns about workplace culture at the BBC have been escalating. Three months prior, BBC radio journalist Russell Joslin took his own life after reporting that he had been harassed at work, claims he felt were disregarded by BBC leadership. In a similar context, former Countryfile presenter Miriam O’Reilly left the BBC and subsequently won an employment tribunal for age discrimination, reportedly securing a substantial payout. O’Reilly had been one of several female presenters in their forties and fifties who were dropped from Countryfile in 2009 as the show sought younger viewers. The tribunal criticized the BBC for ageism and what it described as ‘social engineering.’ The BBC has stated it does not comment on individual employee cases but asserts that complaints of bullying are treated seriously.

article_content: A recent report by the Lucy Faithfull Foundation has uncovered widespread sexual abuse, domestic violence, and exploitation on St Helena, a British overseas territory. Alarmingly, the report found that puberty, not the legal age of consent, is often seen as the point when girls become sexually available. Many forms of sexual assault have become normalized, with a general acceptance in the community except for the most extreme cases. The report, not officially released by the UK government, describes a culture where women and teenage girls are sometimes traded for basic goods like food. The Salvation Army and Human Rights Office both observed that domestic violence is common on the island. The pattern of abuse crosses generations: older women who were victims as children may not see abuse against their own children as criminal, sometimes viewing non-violent grooming as a compliment. Commissioned by the Department for International Development, the charity spoke with over 50 residents including police officers, health workers, diplomats, and children. On Ascension Island, where there is a US air base, young male workers reportedly took advantage of local girls, often using alcohol to lower inhibitions. The Lucy Faithfull Foundation made 28 recommendations, including stopping jury trials for sexual offences because locals are often hesitant to convict unless the accused is disliked. Victims were sometimes stigmatized. The report highlighted poor care for children and adults with disabilities, noting dilapidated facilities and that staff sometimes used their own money to buy essentials. Some buildings were used as makeshift homes for people with complex needs, with conditions described as extremely depressing. Hazel Wilmot, owner of the Consulate Hotel in Jamestown, said that although abuse was previously ignored, efforts have recently improved policing, investigation, and child protection. She warned, however, that a new £250 million airport could bring sex tourism if the island's reputation for abuse spreads. St Helena, over a thousand miles from Africa, is one of the world’s most isolated islands. The vast majority of its funding comes from Britain since it has little economic activity. With the local population shrinking, many St Helenians live abroad. The airport is designed to reduce isolation and inspire economic development. Historically, St Helena was colonized by the British in 1659, served as Napoleon’s place of exile, and relies heavily on foreign aid.

गरिएको अनुसन्धानमा केही प्रहरी, स्वास्थ्यकर्मी, कूटनीतिज्ञ, विद्यार्थी लगायत ५० भन्दा बढी स्थानीयहरूसँग अन्तरवार्ता गरिएको थियो। छेउको असेंशन टापुमा अमेरिकी वायुसेना आधार छ र त्यहाँका युवाहरू मदिरा सेवन गराएर स्थानीय केटीहरूलाई लक्षित गर्ने गरिएको रिपोर्ट छ। प्रतिवेदनमा २८ वटा सिफारिस भए, जसमध्ये एक, यौन अपराधसम्बन्धी मुद्दामा जूरी ट्रायल नहुने व्यवस्था गर्न सुझाव दिएको छ, किनभने स्थानीय कन्सुलेट होटलकी मालिक हाजेल विलमोटले पहिले यौन-दुर्व्यवहारलाई खासै गम्भीर रूपमा नलिइए पनि हाल प्रहरी, अनुसन्धान र बाल संरक्षणमा सुधार आएको बताइन्। तर, २५० मिलियन पाउण्डको नयाँ विमानस्थल खुलेपछि यदि टापुको बदनाम छवि फैलियो भने यौन पर्यटनको जोखिम बढ्ने उनको चिन्ता छ। अफ्रिकाबाट हजारौ माइल टाढा रहेको सेंट हेलेना पृथ्वीका सबैभन्दा टाढाका टापुहरूमध्ये एक हो। यहाँको सरकारी खर्चको अधिकांश भाग बेलायतबाट आउँछ, किनकि टापुमा खासै आर्थिक स्रोत छैन। जनसंख्या घट्दो अवस्थामा छ र अधिकांश स्थानिय विदेशमा छन्। विमानस्थल अलगाव अन्त्य गरेर आर्थिक विकास बढाउने प्रयासको रूपमा बनाइएको हो। सेंट हेलेना १६५९ मा article_content: Jared Pettingill’s parents wanted a school where their son, who is gay, would not face harassment. They found such an environment in Minneapolis Public Schools. Jared, now a high school junior, notes that he has not experienced bullying in middle or high school, describing a notably positive and accepting atmosphere for LGBT students. Minneapolis Public School administrators acknowledge that bullying has not been completely eliminated, but they emphasize their commitment to creating a safe environment for every student. In January, the school board unanimously passed a resolution directing administrators to track bullying incidents specifically related to LGBT harassment. This policy also mandates staff training on LGBT issues and integrates LGBT-related content into the curriculum, with plans for an elective high school course on LGBT history. Just a few miles away, the Anoka-Hennepin School District has drawn national attention for its different approach. After seven student suicides between November 2009 and May 2011—four involving students who were gay, perceived as gay, or questioning their sexuality—some parents and friends allege bullying due to sexuality. The school district maintains there is no evidence connecting the suicides to bullying. The situation sparked debate about the district’s curriculum policy, known as the neutrality policy, which prevents teachers from addressing homosexuality in class, stating such topics are best handled outside the school. Anoka-Hennepin is Minnesota’s largest school district and is the only one in the state with a neutrality policy on LGBT issues. In July, advocacy groups filed a federal lawsuit challenging this policy, and the district is also under federal investigation for alleged harassment and discrimination based on sex and gender nonconformity. Superintendent Dennis Carlson argues that the neutrality policy reflects the community’s divided views, aiming to maintain balance. Carlson asserts there is no evidence of bullying in the suicide cases, though he recognizes that gay students in the district continue to struggle with bullying and urges students to report incidents. Damon Fietek, a student in Anoka-Hennepin, says he was bullied because his father, Jefferson Fietek—a middle school teacher—is gay. Damon experienced harassment for a year before telling his dad. He eventually transferred to another school in the district with smaller class sizes, where he says bullying stopped. Jefferson Fietek, who advises a Gay Straight Alliance group, believes the neutrality policy indirectly supports bullies by not actively supporting LGBT students. James C. Burroughs II, now director of Minneapolis Schools’ Office of Equity and Diversity, recounts his own past as a student who bullied others for being different. Today, he works to ensure the district’s programs and curricula foster equity and inclusion, including anti-bullying measures such as the Out4Good support program and the Second Step bullying prevention curriculum. Teachers are encouraged to incorporate inclusivity, with staff at all levels trained to address bullying. Jared Pettingill reports noticing LGBT-inclusive topics in his classes, including literature featuring LGBT characters. His parents appreciate the school’s proactive stance, but emphasize that true change comes from community-wide commitment—not just policy. Marie Pettingill underscores the importance of safety for all students, expressing hope that one day such safety will be taken for granted. The article features contributions from CNN journalists and highlights ongoing efforts, successes, and challenges in ensuring safe school environments for LGBT students.

प्रशासनले आत्महत्या र बुलिङबीच सीधा सम्बन्ध नदेखिएको बताएको छ। यस घटनाले ‘न्युट्रालिटी पॉलिसी’ माथि बहस ल्याएको छ, जसले शिक्षकहरूलाई एलजीबीटी/समलिंगी विषयमा धारणा नराख्न निर्देशन दिन्छ। एनोका-हेनिपिन मिनेसोटाको सबैभन्दा ठूलो स्कूल डिष्ट्रिक्ट हो र राज्यमा यस्ता नीति अपनाउने एकमात्र हो। जुलाईमा अभियानकारी संस्थाहरूले संघीय मुद्दा दायर गरेपछि डिष्ट्रिक्ट लैंगिक पहिचान आधारमा भेदभाव र उत्पीडनबारे संघीय छानबिनमा परेको छ। सुपरिन्टेन्डेन्ट डेनिस कार्लसनले उक्त नीति समुदायको विविध मत सन्तुलन गर्नका लागि भएको बताउँछन्। उनी आफैँ पनि आत्महत्या र बुलिङबीच कुनै प्रमाण नभएको बताउँछन्, यद्यपि एलजीबीटी विद्यार्थीहरूलाई उत्पीडनको समस्या रहेको स्वीकार गर्छन्। एनोका-हेनिपिनका डेमन फिएटेक भन्छन् आफ्ना बुवा (मध्य विद्यालयका शिक्षक जेफर्सन फिएटेक) समलिंगी भएकाले आफू उत्पीडनमा परेको अनुभव छ। उनले सानो कक्षाको संख्या भएको अर्को स्कुलमा सरेपछि यो समस्या टर्‍यो। जेफर्सनले LGBTQ विद्यार्थीलाई प्रत्यक्ष समर्थन नगर्ने नीति भएकोले, यसले प्रत्यक्ष/अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा बुलीलाई समर्थन गरेको बताउँछन्। मिनियापोलिस स्कूल्स अफिस अफ इक्विटी एन्ड डाइभर्सिटी निर्देशक जेम्स सी. बुरोज द्वितीयले आफैं बुली गरेको अनुभव छ र अहिले विद्यालयमा सबैका लागि समानता र समावेशिता प्रवर्द्धन गर्न लागिपरेका छन्। उनले Out4Good, Second Step, सकरात्मक कार्यक्रम, शिक्षक तथा सबै स्टाफमाथि समावेशीताको तालिम सञ्चालन गरेका छन्। जारेड पेटिङ्गिल भन्छन्, कक्षामा LGBT समावेशी पाठ्यक्रम र साहित्य regularly पर्छ। अभिभावकले स्कूलको सकारात्मक सोचको कदर गरे पनि नीतिलाई व्यवहारमा ल्याउन सबै समुदायको सक्रियता आवश्यक रहेको जोड दिन्छन्। मेरी पेटिङ्गिलले सबै बालबालिका सुरक्षित हुनु स्वाभाविक हुनुपर्ने बताएकी छन्। समाचारमा CNN का पत्रकारहरूको योगदान छ भने स्कुल वातावरणलाई एलजीबीटी विद्यार्थीको लागि सुरक्षित बनाउने प्रयास, चुनौती र सफलताहरू समेटिएको छ।

article_content: New Zealand’s new government has announced plans to repeal the pioneering smoking ban introduced by the previous administration, and instead use projected revenue from tobacco sales to fund tax cuts. The earlier legislation, led by former Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern, would have banned cigarette sales to anyone born after 2008, aiming for a generation free from smoking. Smoking is still the leading cause of preventable deaths in New Zealand, and the former law sought to prevent young people from taking up the habit. Health experts have criticized the government’s reversal. Professor Richard Edwards of the University of Otago called it a ‘backwards step’ for public health, while health organizations are urging the government to change course. The Smokefree law had received international acclaim and research indicated it could save up to 5,000 lives annually. The legislation also aimed to reduce the number of tobacco retailers and limit nicotine content. The UK government cited New Zealand’s example when considering similar youth smoking bans. The law faced opposition from some business owners who feared loss of revenue, and from critics concerned about the growth of illegal tobacco markets. Though the ruling National party, led by Prime Minister Chris Luxon, did not address the Smokefree laws during its election campaign, Finance Minister Nicola Willis announced the repeal as part of coalition agreements with New Zealand First and ACT—both of whom pressed to remove the regulations. National had hoped to fund tax cuts by easing foreign property rules, but coalition partners disagreed, redirecting focus to tobacco tax revenues. The government must now pass new legislation in Parliament to formally reverse the Smokefree laws. This decision is contentious, as government models showed the policy could have saved about NZ$1.3 billion in the next 20 years. Professor Robert Beaglehole of the Action for Smokefree 2025 committee commented that relying on smokers to pay for tax cuts was ‘shocking’. Groups like Hāpai Te Hauora, a national Māori health body, stated this would especially harm Māori, who experience higher rates of smoking-related illness. Data reveals New Zealand’s adult smoking rate is about 8%, and officials still aim for a rate below 5% by 2025, working toward a smoke-free population.

पनि सबैभन्दा बढी रोक्न सकिने मृत्युदरको कारण हो, र पुरानो कानूनले नयाँ पुस्तालाई धूम्रपानबाट जोगाउने सोचेको थियो। स्वास्थ्य विज्ञहरूले सरकारको निर्णयप्रति आलोचना गरेका छन्। ओटागो विश्वविद्यालयका प्राध्यापक रिचार्ड एडवार्ड्सले यसलाई ‘सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्यका लागि पछि फर्कनु’ भनेका छन् भने, विभिन्न स्वास्थ्य संघसंस्थाले सरकारलाई निर्णय बद्लिन आग्रह गरेका छन्। स्मोकफ्री कानूनले अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय ख्याति कमाएको थियो र अनुसन्धानले योले वर्षमा ५,००० जनासम्म ज्यान जोगाउने देखाएको थियो। कानूनले तम्बाकु विक्रेताको संख्या घटाउने र चुरोटमा निकोटिन कडाइ गर्ने पनि प्रस्ताव गरेको थियो। बेलायत सरकारले युवा लक्षित प्रतिबन्ध गर्दा न्यूजिल्यान्डकै नीति हेरेको थियो। तर केही व्यापारीहरूले आम्दानी गुमाउँछन् भन्ने डर देखाए भने, आलोचकहरूले कालो बजार बढ्ने चेतावनी पनि दिए। प्रधानमन्त्री क्रिस लकसनको पार्टीले चुनाव प्रचारमा यसबारे केही भनेन, तर चुनावपछिको सरकार बनाउने क्रममा अर्थमन्त्री निकोला विलिसले न्यूजिल्यान्ड फर्स्ट र एक्ट पार्टीको दबाबमा कानून उल्ट्याउने सहमति भयो। राष्ट्रिय पार्टीले विदेशी कर कटौती गर्ने कदमलाई ‘धक्क लाग्दो’ भनेका छन्। जसमा हापाइ ते हाउअरो जस्ता Māori स्वास्थ्य संस्थाहरूले नियम उल्ट्याउँदा Māori समुदाय झन बढी प्रभावित हुने बताएको छ। यहाँ धूम्रपानसम्बन्धी स्वास्थ्य article_content: The world's largest collection of movie posters, featuring artwork from nearly every film ever made, is now on sale for $7.8 million (£5 million). This vast archive contains 196,000 posters from more than 44,000 films, covering the early 1900s to the present day. The collection was assembled by Morris Everett Jr. from Cleveland, Ohio, over 50 years. Everett devoted his life to finding original posters from every English-speaking film, building a unique and comprehensive library. Included are classics like The Prince and the Showgirl (1957) starring Marilyn Monroe and Breakfast at Tiffany's (1961) starring Audrey Hepburn. Highlights include a rare poster from the 1927 silent film Metropolis, valued at $47,000 (£30,000), and posters from Gone with the Wind, The Wizard of Oz, The Godfather, The Terminator, Pulp Fiction, and Titanic. Now aged 73, Everett started collecting in 1961 while at university. After passing on the family tradition of stamp collecting, he purchased his first two posters: Splendor in the Grass (1961) and The Charge of the Light Brigade (1938). Over the years, Everett acquired posters and collections worldwide, becoming the only person known to attempt collecting posters for every film made. In 1991, he created The Everett Collection, turning his hobby into a business by licensing poster images. The archive is stored in bank vaults. Everett has decided to sell so his life's work can be appreciated by others. The collection is expected to reach $8 million (about £5 million) at Profiles in History auction house in Los Angeles. This amounts to roughly $39 (£25) per poster, though experts estimate a piecemeal sale could total up to $23 million (£15 million). Everett explained his journey began at Movie Star News in New York when he bought his first posters. He later bought many other collections to preserve film history. Many items are one-of-a-kind, making the collection impossible to recreate. Everett hopes the archive remains together as a single entity. Even as he sells, he continues to add new posters. Auctioneers call the event a 'once in a lifetime opportunity.' Joe Maddalena, owner of Profiles in History, describes the Everett Collection as the world's most significant vintage movie poster archive, featuring rare treasures from Hollywood's past. The auction takes place on December 17.

चलचित्रका हुन्, प्रारम्भिक १९०० दशकदेखि हालसम्म। यो संग्रह क्लीभल्यान्ड, ओहायाका मोरिस एभरेट जुनियरले ५० वर्षको अवधिमा सङ्कलन गर्नुभएको हो। एभरेटले जीवनभर सबै अंग्रेजी चलचित्रका मौलिक पोस्टर सँगालेर एउटा अद्वितीय र समग्र लाइब्रेरी बनाएका छन्। यसमा The Prince and the Showgirl (1957) मा मेरिलिन मनरो तथा Breakfast at Tiffany's (1961) मा अड्री हेपबर्न जस्ता क्लासिक चलचित्रका पोस्टर छन्। संग्रहका मुख्य आकर्षणमा १९२७ को मेट्रोपोलिस मौन चलचित्रको दुर्लभ पोस्टर (मूल्य $४७,००० (£३०,०००)), Gone with the Wind, The Wizard of Oz, The Godfather, The Terminator, Pulp Fiction, र Titanic का पोस्टर पनि छन्। अब ७३ वर्षका एभरेटले १९६१ मा विश्वविद्यालय पढ्दागर्दा पोस्टर सङ्कलन शुरु गर्नुभयो। परिवारकै छाप टिकट सङ्कलनको परम्परा नअपनाई, उहाँले Splendor in the Grass (1961) र The Charge of the Light Brigade (1938) का पोस्टर किन्नुभयो। एभरेटले वर्षौंदेखि विश्वभरका पोस्टर तथा संग्रह किनेर, सम्भवतः हरेक सिनेमाको पोस्टर सङ्कलन गर्ने एकमात्र व्यक्ति बन्नुभयो। १९९१ मा उहाँले The Everett Collection स्थापना गरी आफ्नो शोखलाई व्यवसायमा परिवर्तन गर्नुभयो। पोस्टर चित्रहरू लाइसेन्सद्वारा वितरण गरिन्छ र संग्रह बैंकको सुरक्षामा राखिएको छ। अब उहाँ जीवनको थुप्रै समयको परिश्रम अरूले आनन्द लिन सकून् भनेर यो संग्रह बिक्रीमा राख्नुभएको छ। यो संग्रह Profiles in History नामक लस एन्जलसको लिलामीघरमा लगभग $८ मिलियन (£५ मिलियन) सम्म पुग्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ। प्रत्येक पोस्टरको औसत मूल्य $३९ (£२५) पर्दछ, तर विज्ञहरूका अनुसार छुट्टाछुट्टै बिक्री गरेमा कुल मूल्य $२३ मिलियन (£१५ मिलियन) हुन सक्छ। एभरेटका अनुसार, उहाँको यात्रा न्यूयोर्कको Movie Star News मा पहिलो पोस्टर किन्दै सुरु भएको हो। त्यसपछि उहाँले ऐतिहासिक चलचित्र संस्कृतिको संरक्षण गर्न ठूला-ठूला संग्रह किन्नुभयो। संग्रहमा धेरै अद्वितीय पोस्टर छन्, जसलाई आज फेरि बनाउन सकिँदैन। एभरेटको इच्छा छ कि सम्पूर्ण संग्रह एउटै रहिरहोस्। अहिले पनि बिक्रीको तयारी गर्दै पोस्टर थप्न जारी राख्नुभएको छ। लिलामी कर्ताहरूले यस घटना 'जीवनमा एकपटक मात्र पाइने अवसर' भनेका छन्। Profiles in History का मालिक जो म्याडालेनाले एभरेट संग्रहलाई विश्वकै सबैभन्दा महत्वपूर्ण र ऐतिहासिक चलचित्र पोस्टर संग्रह मानेका छन्, जसमा हलिउडको सुनौलो युगका धेरै दुर्लभ वस्तुहरू छन्। लिलामी डिसेम्बर १७ मा हुनेछ।

article_content: The US dollar continued its downward trend at the start of the last week of November and is on course for its biggest monthly drop in a year, falling roughly 3%. Investors are closely watching several significant economic updates this week, including US inflation metrics followed by the Federal Reserve, consumer price data from the euro zone and Australia, a rescheduled OPEC+ meeting, and the latest PMI readings from China. The Reserve Bank of New Zealand is also set to announce its policy decision, with expectations that interest rates will remain at 5.5%. Mizuho Bank’s Colin Asher points out that US rates may have reached their peak, prompting traders to reduce their dollar holdings. Strong gains in US equities over the past four weeks have further reduced the dollar's appeal as a safe-haven asset. Following the Thanksgiving holiday, attention is now turning to when the Federal Reserve could begin cutting rates, with the upcoming release of US core PCE inflation data seen as a potential indicator. Rabobank’s Jane Foley notes that, although inflation remains above targets in many developed economies, central banks are maintaining a 'higher for longer' stance on rates. Despite this, investors are increasingly betting on when rate cuts will happen next year. The market currently gives about a 23% chance of a rate cut by the Federal Reserve as soon as March, according to CME FedWatch. Meanwhile, the British pound has climbed to a two-month high of $1.2627 against the weakening dollar, following unexpected growth in UK business activity this month. The pound is set for a 3.8% monthly gain, its best performance since last November. The US dollar fell to 149.08 yen, the euro inched up to $1.0941, and the Australian dollar reached a three-month high of $0.66. The New Zealand dollar also advanced slightly ahead of the central bank’s rate announcement, while China’s yuan weakened after the People’s Bank of China set its official midpoint at 7.1159 per dollar, just below the previous setting.

article_content: The 2010 midterm elections are widely viewed as anti-incumbent, anti-Washington, and by implication, anti-Democratic. Economic struggles—including a national unemployment rate of 9.6 percent and a housing crisis—have placed Democrats on the defensive as the November elections approach. Democrats are facing challenges across the country and are at risk of losing control of the House. If Republican momentum is strong on November 2, the Senate could also be at stake. Bolstered by substantial fundraising from the Republican Governors Association, the GOP is poised to reclaim multiple governorships, even in states President Obama won in 2008, such as Iowa, Michigan, and Pennsylvania. According to new CNN/Time/Opinion Research Corporation Polls, Democratic Senate candidates in Alaska, Arkansas, Florida, and Ohio are struggling, and President Obama’s approval ratings in these states range from just 33 percent in Arkansas to 42 percent in Ohio. The anti-Washington, anti-Democratic theme is prevalent in these races. The GOP’s narrative that some Democratic candidates would simply support Obama's policies appears to resonate with voters—for example, Arkansas Senator Blanche Lincoln is trailing her Republican challenger, John Boozman, by 14 points. In Ohio, Democratic Senate nominee Lee Fisher is 15 points behind Republican Rob Portman. In Florida, Republican Marco Rubio leads Democrat Kendrick Meek by 26 points in a three-way race that also includes independent Charlie Crist, who trails Rubio by 14 points. Meanwhile, the National Republican Senatorial Committee argues that West Virginia's Democratic Governor Joe Manchin would back Obama if elected to the Senate. However, gubernatorial races show a different trend. Democratic candidates for governor are competitive or leading in three of the four surveyed states. In Arkansas, Mike Beebe holds a 27-point advantage over Republican Jim Keet. Ohio Governor Ted Strickland leads John Kasich by one point. In Florida, Alex Sink trails Republican Rick Scott by three points, within the poll’s 3.5 percent margin of error. It appears that, aside from Alaska, Democratic gubernatorial candidates in those three states are not facing the same electoral disadvantages as their Senate counterparts, though the challenging national mood still affects them. A deeper look at the CNN/Time/ORC poll reveals further insights: In Alaska, Lisa Murkowski and GOP nominee Joe Miller are tied at 37 percent, with Democrat Scott McAdams at 23 percent. If 3 percent of Murkowski’s supporters hesitate due to the write-in process, Miller would lead by three points. Murkowski's support is strongest in Anchorage and the Panhandle, while Miller leads in Fairbanks and surrounding areas. In Arkansas, Senator Lincoln trails Boozman among women voters by eight points and performs best in eastern Arkansas. Boozman leads in other regions. In Florida, Rubio leads among independents by four points over Crist. Rubio dominates most of the state except the southern Florida/Miami area, where Crist leads. Alex Sink is losing every region to Rick Scott but maintains a strong lead in southern Florida/Miami. Among women, Sink leads Scott by five points, but this is within the margin of error. In Ohio’s Senate race, Lee Fisher trails Rob Portman among all major demographics. Fisher leads by eight points in the Cleveland area, but the difference is within the eight-and-a-half percent margin of error. Portman leads elsewhere. In the governor’s race, Strickland leads with women and voters earning less than $50,000, while Kasich leads with men, voters earning more than $50,000, and independents. Strickland leads in Cleveland and central Ohio, while Kasich leads in Cincinnati/Dayton and has a slight edge in Columbus. The candidates are tied in northern industrial areas.
translated_content: २०१० को मध्यावधि निर्वाचनहरूलाई व्यापक रूपमा सत्ता विरोधी, वाशिङ्टन विरोधी, र अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा डेमोक्र्याटिक विरोधीको रूपमा हेरिएको छ। आर्थिक संघर्ष—राष्ट्रिय बेरोजगारी दर ९.६ प्रतिशत र आवास संकट सहित—ले डेमोक्र्याटहरूलाई नोभेम्बर निर्वाचन नजिकिँदै जाँदा रक्षात्मक अवस्थामा ल्याएको छ। डेमोक्र्याटहरू मुलुकभरि चुनौतिहरूको सामना गरिरहेका छन् र तिनीहरू हाउसको नियन्त्रण गुमाउने जोखिममा छन्। यदि रिपब्लिकन लहर नोभेम्बर २ मा बलियो भएमा, सिनेट समेत जोखिममा पर्न सक्छ। रिपब्लिकन गभर्नर्स एसोसिएसनको ठूलो कोष संकलनले GOP लाई २००८ मा ओबामाले जितेका राज्यहरू जस्तै आयोवा, मिशिगन, र पेनसिल्भेनियामा समेत एकभन्दा बढी गभर्नर पद फिर्ता ल्याउने स्थितिमा राखेको छ। CNN/Time/Opinion Research Corporation का नयाँ सर्वेक्षण अनुसार, अलास्का, अर्कान्सा, फ्लोरिडा र ओहायोमा डेमोक्र्याटिक सिनेट उम्मेदवारहरू कठिनाइमा छन् र ती राज्यहरूमा ओबामाको अनुमोदन दर अर्कान्सामा जम्मा ३३ प्रतिशतदेखि ओहायोमा ४२ प्रतिशतसम्म छ। ती निर्वाचन क्षेत्रमा वाशिङ्टन र डेमोक्र्याटिक विरोधी धारणा बलियो देखिन्छ। GOP को कथन कि केही डेमोक्र्याट उम्मेदवारहरू ओबामाका नीति मात्र समर्थन गर्छन्, मतदाताहरूमा जमेको छ—उदाहरणका लागि, अर्कान्सास सिनेटर ब्लान्च लिंकन रिपब्लिकन प्रतिस्पर्धी जोन बुसम्यान भन्दा १४ अंकले पछि भइरहेका छन्। ओहायोमा, डेमोक्र्याटिक सिनेट उम्मेदवार ली फिशर रिपब्लिकन रोब पोर्टम्यान भन्दा १५ अंकले पछि छन्। फ्लोरिडामा, रिपब्लिकन मार्को रुबियो डेमोक्र्याट केन्ड्रिक मीक भन्दा २६ अंकले अगाडि छन्, जहाँ स्वतन्त्र उम्मेदवार चार्ली क्रिस्ट रुबियो भन्दा १४ अंकले पछि छन्। त्यस्तै, नेशनल रिपब्लिकन सेनेटोरियल कमिटीले वेस्ट भर्जिनियाका डेमोक्र्याट गभर्नर जो म्यान्चिन सिनेटमा निर्वाचित भएमा ओबामालाई समर्थन गर्ने दाबी गरेको छ। तर, गभर्नरका निर्वाचनमा फरक प्रवृत्ति देखिन्छ। डेमोक्र्याटिक गभर्नर उम्मेदवारहरू चारमध्ये तीन राज्यमा प्रतिस्पर्धी वा अगाडि देखिएका छन्। अर्कान्सासमा, माइक बीबी रिपब्लिकन जिम कीट भन्दा २७ अंकले अगाडि छन्। ओहायो गभरनर टेड स्ट्रिकल्याण्ड रिपब्लिकन जोन कासिचभन्दा १ अंकले अगाडि छन्। फ्लोरिडामा, एलेक्स सिन्क रिपब्लिकन रिक स्कट भन्दा ३ अंकले पछि छन्, जुन सर्वेक्षणको ३.५ प्रतिशत त्रुटि सीमाभित्र पर्छ। लगभग अलास्का बाहेक, ती तीन राज्यका डेमोक्र्याट गभर्नर उम्मेदवारहरू आफ्ना सिनेट प्रतिस्पर्धीहरूजस्तो कठिनाइमा छैनन्, यद्यपि राष्ट्रिय मनोदशाले तिनीहरूलाई समेत असर गरेको छ। CNN/Time/ORC को सर्वेक्षणमा थप विवरण हेर्दा: अलास्कामा, लिसा मर्कोव्स्की र GOP उम्मेदवार जो मिलर ३७-३७ प्रतिशतमा छन्, डेमोक्र्याट स्कट म्याकएडम्स २३ प्रतिशतमा छन्। यदि मर्कोव्स्कीका ३ प्रतिशत समर्थकले नाम लेख्न गाह्रो लागेमा मिलर ३ अंकले अघि जानेछन्। मर्कोव्स्कीको समर्थन मुख्यत: एंकोरेज र प्यानह्यान्डलमा छ भने, मिलरले फेयरब्याङ्क्स र वरपरको क्षेत्रमा जितिरहेका छन्। अर्कान्सासमा, सिनेटर लिंकन महिलामा बुसम्यान भन्दा ८ अंकले पछि छन् र पूर्वी अर्कान्सामा बलियो छन्। बुसम्यान अन्य क्षेत्रमा अगाडि छन्। फ्लोरिडामा, रुबियो स्वतन्त्र उम्मेदवार क्रिस्ट भन्दा निर्दलीय मतदातामा ४ अंकले अगाडि छन्। रुबियोले प्रायः सबै क्षेत्रमा नेतृत्व लिएका छन्, तर दक्षिण फ्लोरिडा/मियामी क्षेत्रमा क्रिस्ट अगाडि छन्। गभर्नरको प्रतिस्पर्धामा, एलेक्स सिन्क रिक स्कट भन्दा सबै क्षेत्रमा पछि छन्, तर दक्षिण फ्लोरिडा/मियामीमा बलियो नेतृत्वमा छन्। महिलामा सिन्कले स्कटलाई ५ अंकले जिते पनि, यो तथ्यांक त्रुटि सीमाभित्र पर्छ। ओहायोको सिनेट प्रतिस्पर्धामा, ली फिशर सबै प्रमुख समूहमा रोब पोर्टम्यान भन्दा पछि छन्। फिशर क्लीवल्यान्ड क्षेत्रमा ८ अंकले अगाडि छन्, तर यो पनि ८.५ प्रतिशत त्रुटि सीमाभित्र पर्छ। पोर्टम्यान अन्यत्र अगाडि छन्। गभर्नर प्रतिस्पर्धामा, स्ट्रिकल्याण्ड महिलामा र ५०,००० भन्दा कम आम्दानी हुने मतदातामा अगाडि छन् भने कासिच पुरुष, ५०,००० भन्दा बढी कमाउने, र स्वतन्त्र मतदातामा अगाडि छन्। स्ट्रिकल्याण्ड क्लीवल्यान्ड र मध्य ओहायोमा अगाडि छन्, कासिच सिन्सिनाटी/डेटन क्षेत्र र कोलम्बसमा थोरै अगाडि छन्। औद्योगिक उत्तरमा दुवै उम्मेदवार समान अंकमा छन्।

article_content: On Wednesday, PI Industries Ltd.'s stock price rose by 0.21% to Rs 3,687.80 as of 10:51 AM, while the Nifty index increased by 31.4 points to reach 19,814.80. The company's stock had previously closed at Rs 3,679.90 and has moved between a 52-week low of Rs 2,870.00 and a high of Rs 4,010.00. PI Industries has a market capitalization of Rs 55,995.36 crore on the BSE, with 3,190 shares traded so far today. At its current trading price, the stock's price-to-earnings (PE) ratio stands at 37.44, based on a trailing 12-month earnings per share (EPS) of Rs 98.59, and it trades at 6.39 times its book value. The company's return on equity (ROE) is Rs 17.07. For the quarter ending September 30, 2023, PI Industries posted consolidated sales of Rs 2,163.8 crore, showing a 20.1% increase from the same quarter last year. Net profit saw a 43.52% year-on-year jump to Rs 480.5 crore. Technically, the stock’s Relative Strength Index (RSI) suggests neither an overbought nor oversold status. Financial experts caution that, while RSI is useful, it should not serve as the sole basis for trading decisions—similar to fundamental ratios. India's income tax authorities have discovered about Rs 10,000 crore in tax evasion by e-commerce sellers using platforms like Instagram and Facebook over the past three years, sending notices to 45 brands nationwide, with more expected. With more than 20,000 notices issued by the GST department since 2022, Indian companies are increasingly reviewing transactions to address potential tax liabilities before finalizing deals. article_content: Queen Elizabeth II is set to launch a Flickr photostream on Monday, according to Buckingham Palace. The British monarchy, which already shares updates on YouTube and Twitter, will add more than 600 photographs—both historic and recent—to its new Flickr account. The White House has operated its own Flickr stream since April 2009. The monarchy’s collection includes pictures dating back to Queen Victoria and Prince Albert around 1861, as well as images of notable Victorians like poet Henry Wadsworth Longfellow. The stream also features baby photos of Queen Elizabeth and Prince Charles. Most of the photos capture the royal family during public appearances, such as the Queen’s recent visits to Canada and New York, and her summer garden party last week.

article_content: Smugglers are using Telegram to sell services to Ukrainian men seeking to evade the country's mandatory military draft, a BBC investigation has found. At least six Telegram groups, some boasting several thousand members, are reportedly active in offering such services, according to a BBC undercover reporter. The journalist, identified by the BBC as Andrey, spent a month communicating with these smugglers while posing as a Ukrainian man trying to avoid conscription. The services offered included creating fake medical exemption documents, adding fictitious children to families, and arranging illegal border crossings, Andrey reported. Andrey disclosed that smugglers are capitalizing on the desperation of Ukrainian men to avoid the ongoing conflict, with fake medical exemption certificates selling for about $4,300. This price, according to Andrey, covers not only the forged paperwork but also a bribe for the government official responsible for issuing them—highlighting persistent corruption among officials. Ukraine’s martial law prohibits able-bodied men aged 18 to 60 from leaving the country, except in specific cases, such as those with disabilities or fathers raising three or more children, according to Visit Ukraine. Since Russia's full-scale invasion began in February 2022, more than 40,000 Ukrainian men have fled or attempted to avoid conscription, the BBC reports. Of those, about 19,000 crossed borders illegally into neighboring countries (Romania, Moldova, Poland, Hungary, and Slovakia), while approximately 21,100 were apprehended. Ukraine's Ministry of Defence did not respond to requests for comment. The government has made efforts to curb corruption and prevent military-aged men from leaving the country, including launching a whistleblower hotline and dismissing recruitment officers accused of accepting bribes. However, corruption remains a pervasive challenge. Ukrainian lawmaker Fedir Venislavskyi, a member of the Ukraine Committee on National Security, told the BBC that the government knows the problem is widespread. He added that attempts to use fake documents to avoid conscription might be curbed in the next two years once Ukraine’s new digital system is fully implemented.
translated_content: स्मगलरहरूले टेलिग्राम प्रयोग गरेर युक्रेनी पुरुषहरूलाई अनिवार्य सैन्य भर्तीबाट जोगिन सेवाहरू बेचिरहेका छन्, बीबीसीको अनुसन्धानले पत्ता लगाएको छ। सयौं सदस्यसहित कम्तीमा छ वटा टेलिग्राम समूहहरू यस्ता सेवा दिन सक्रिय छन् भन्ने बीबीसीका एक गोप्य संवाददाताले बताएका छन्। बीबीसीले 'अन्द्रेई' नाम दिएका ती पत्रकारले युक्रेनी भर्तीबाट बच्न खोज्ने व्यक्तिको रूपमा प्रस्तुत हुँदै एक महिना यी स्मगलरहरूसँग सम्पर्कमा रहे। उहाँको भनाइमा, यसमा नक्कली स्वास्थ्य छूट प्रमाणपत्र बनाउने, झूटा छोराछोरी परिवारमा थप्ने, र अवैध रूपमा सिमाना पार गराउनेजस्ता सेवा छन्। अन्द्रेईका अनुसार, स्मगलरहरूले युद्धबाट बच्न चाहने युक्रेनी पुरुषहरूको निराशाबाट लाभ उठाइरहेका छन्। नक्कली स्वास्थ्य छूट प्रमाणपत्रको मूल्य करिब ४,३०० अमेरिकी डलर पर्छ, जसमा कागजात बनाउने अधिकारीलाई दिइने घुस पनि पर्छ। यसले सरकारी अधिकारीहरूमा कायम रहेको भ्रष्टाचार देखाउँछ। भिजिट युक्रेनका अनुसार, १८ देखि ६० वर्षका योग्य पुरुषहरूलाई युक्रेनको मार्शल कानुनले देश छाड्न रोक लगाएको छ, सिवाय केही विशेष अवस्थाहरू जस्तै अपाङ्गता भएका वा तीन वा बढी छोराछोरी हुर्काउँदै गरेका बुबा। रुसको पूर्ण आक्रमण सुरु भएको फेब्रुअरी २०२२ देखि ४०,००० भन्दा बढी युक्रेनी पुरुषहरूले भर्तीबाट जोगिन देश छाडेका वा प्रयास गरेका छन्, बीबीसीले जनाएको छ। तीमध्ये झण्डै १९,००० ले छिमेकी देश (रोमानिया, मोल्डोभा, पोल्याण्ड, हंगेरी, स्लोभाकिया) मा अवैध सिमाना पार गरे भने लगभग २१,१०० जना समातिएका छन्। युक्रेनको रक्षा मन्त्रालयले यसबारे कुनै प्रतिक्रिया दिएको छैन। सरकारले भर्ती उमेरका पुरुषहरूलाई रोक्न र भ्रष्टाचार नियन्त्रण गर्न भण्डाफोर हॉटलाइन सुरु गर्दै घुस लिने भर्ती अधिकारीहरूलाई हटाएको छ। तैपनि, भ्रष्टाचार ठूलो समस्या नै छ। युक्रेनी सांसद तथा राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा समितिका सदस्य फेदिर वेनिस्लाभ्स्कीका अनुसार, सरकारलाई समस्या व्यापक भएको थाहा छ। उनले बीबीसीलाई भने, युक्रेनको नयाँ डिजिटल प्रणाली लागू भएपछि नक्कली कागजातको प्रयोग अर्को दुई वर्षभित्र अन्त्य हुन सक्छ।

article_content: The Indian government is considering stricter regulations for Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions to curb offshore platforms offering illegal gambling and betting services in India. Authorities have identified 114 illegal betting and gambling platforms operating in the country, many using methods such as 'domain farming' to bypass regulations. Potential actions include implementing tax collection at source (TCS) on UPI payments, active monitoring and blocking of unregistered online gaming companies, and introducing stronger verification processes. These platforms typically collect UPI payments using proxy bank accounts, complicating transaction tracing. By implementing TCS, authorities aim to create a trackable money trail. Funds obtained through these accounts are reportedly transferred via hawala networks, cryptocurrency, and other unregulated channels. Domestic online gaming companies have reported these trends and named several major illegal offshore gambling operators in a presentation to the revenue department. In July, the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) blocked 138 offshore betting sites based on recommendations by the Directorate General of GST Intelligence (DGGI). Prominent platforms named include Parimatch, Fairplay, 1XBET, Lotus365, Dafabet, and Betwaysatta, many of which are already banned. Their operations include using surrogate news sites and frequently shifting payment proxies connected to Indian bank accounts. To evade detection, these sites regularly change their domain names—for example, Parimatch is now parimatchnews and Lotus365’s domain is now lotus365.in. The majority of these platforms are registered in jurisdictions such as Cyprus, Malta, Curacao, Mauritius, and the Cayman Islands, where gambling is legal. Despite government advisories issued in April instructing media and OTT platforms to avoid advertising these sites, operators have continued aggressive marketing on platforms like Instagram and Facebook. A senior finance ministry official noted that while some websites have sought registration, the majority remain unregistered and non-compliant. Authorities continue efforts to identify and block these sites, which often operate via proxy domains. Revenue Secretary Sanjay Malhotra stated that payment gateways could help track these operations, adding that TCS is a practical enforcement tool if online gaming companies are identified in this way. The Enforcement Directorate is investigating money laundering allegations involving some of these illegal sites. Amendments to the IGST Act now require all offshore gaming firms to register in India, empowering the government to block non-compliant sites. In other tech news, India’s largest telecom companies have accused several major foreign tech firms of bypassing legal SMS regulations using platforms like WhatsApp. The government has also asked Apple to participate in an investigation concerning alleged hacking attempts on the devices of prominent Indians. Additionally, the Delhi High Court has enabled lessors to reclaim planes and engines from the bankrupt airline Go First. गरेका छन्, जसले 'डोमेन फार्मिङ' जस्ता उपायबाट नियम छलिरहेका छन्। संभावित कदमहरूमा UPI भुक्तानीमा TCS लागू गर्ने, अबैध अनलाइन गेमिङ कम्पनीहरूको निगरानी र ब्लक गर्ने र कडा प्रमाणिकरण ल्याउने छन्। यस्तो साइटहरूले प्रोक्सी बैंक खाताबाट UPI भुक्तानी लिन्छन्, जसले लेनदेन ट्रेस गर्न गाह्रो हुन्छ। TCS लागू गरेपछि यस्तो ट्रेल पत्ता लगाउन सजिलो हुने अपेक्षा छ। यी खाताहरूको रकम हवाला, क्रिप्टोकरेंसी र अन्य अनियन्त्रित च्यानलमार्फत पठाइने रिपोर्ट छ। घरेलु अनलाइन गेमिङ कम्पनीहरूले यस्तो प्रवृत्ति राजस्व विभागलाई रिपोर्ट गर्दै मुख्य अवैध अफशोर बेटिङ साइटहरूको नाम दिएका छन्। इलेक्ट्रोनिक्स तथा सूचना प्रविधि मन्त्रालय (MeitY) ले जुलाईमा १३८ अफशोर बेटिङ साइट DGGI को सिफारिसमा ब्लक गरेको थियो। चर्चित प्लेटफर्ममा Parimatch, Fairplay, 1XBET, Lotus365, Dafabet र Betwaysatta पर्छन्, धेरै पहिल्यै प्रतिबन्धित छन्। डोमेन स्वरूप परिवर्तन र प्रोक्सी खाता जस्ता उपायमार्फत यी साइटहरू संचालन भइरहेका छन्—Parimatch अब parimatchnews बनेको छ, Lotus365 को डोमेन lotus365.in हो। यी प्लेटफर्म बहुसंख्यक सिप्रस, माल्टा, कुराकाओ, मौरिसियस र केम्यान टापुमा दर्ता छन्, जहाँ जुवा कानुनी छ। सरकारको सल्लाहपछि पनि यिनीहरूले इन्स्टाग्राम, फेसबुक जस्ता माध्यममा विज्ञापन जारी राखेका छन्। वित्त मन्त्रालयका एक अधिकारीका अनुसार केही साइटले दर्ता गर्न खोजे पनि बहुसंख्यक अझै गैर-अनुपालक छन्। प्रोक्सी डोमेनमार्फत संचालन हुने यस्ता साइट पहिचान र हटाउने सरकारी प्रयास जारी छ। राजस्व सचिव संजय मल्होत्राले भुक्तानी गेटवेबाट थाहा पाउन सकिने र TCS एक उपयुक्त उपाय हुने बताए। प्रवर्तन निर्देशनालयले यस्ता अवैध साइटको मनी लन्डरिङ जाँच गर्दै छ। IGST ऐन संशोधनले अफशोर गेमिङ कम्पनीलाई भारतमा दर्ता अनिवार्य बनाएको छ र गैर-अनुपालक साइट ब्लक गर्न अधिकार दिएको छ। अर्को प्रविधि समाचारमा, भारतीय टेलिकम कम्पनीहरूले ठूला विदेशी कम्पनीहरूलाई SMS नियम उलंघन गरी WhatsApp प्रयोग गरेको भनी आरोप लगाएका छन्। सरकारले Apple लाई भारतीय नेताको मोबाइलमा भएको ह्याक प्रयास अनुसन्धानमा सहभागी हुन भनेको छ। दिल्ली उच्च अदालतले गो फर्स्ट एयरलाइनका विमान र इन्जिन लीजकर्ता फिर्ता लैजान सक्ने बताएको छ। प्रविधि र स्टार्टअपसम्बन्धी ताजा समाचारका लागि नियमित न्युजलेटर सदस्यता लिन आग्रह गरिएको छ।

article_content: India distinguishes itself among emerging markets due to strong economic growth and policy stability, despite higher relative valuations, according to Christy Mathai, Equity Fund Manager at Quantum Mutual Fund. In a recent interview with ETMarkets, Mathai expressed optimism about India's ability to attract higher international investments over time, in line with its share of global GDP. Market activity in India is currently influenced by earnings growth, valuations, and investment flows, resulting in mixed signals. Earnings growth remains resilient, reflecting an economic upswing following years of subdued performance. This broad-based recovery is expected to continue supporting the markets. While some market segments appear expensive versus historical averages, high global interest rates have adjusted valuation expectations. This environment could lead to corrections in overvalued areas, limiting potential for significant market re-rating. Investment flows, particularly from foreign investors, have been unpredictable. Nonetheless, broader market performance is likely to follow earnings trends. Earnings estimates for fiscal years 2023-24 and 2024-25 have been consistently upgraded, highlighting corporate resilience. The banking sector continues to perform strongly and is expected to do well, while sectors like IT, after prior corrections, may offer outperformance as global technology spending stabilizes. Large-cap stocks might recover some ground against mid- and small-cap stocks, which have outperformed in recent years. Risks include weak rural demand—hurt by high inflation, low wage growth, and irregular monsoons—and the potential for a global economic slowdown or unexpected inflation. Improving rural conditions and monitoring global inflation are important for market stability. Government-led capital expenditure remains a key growth driver, although private sector investment is slowly rising. The government's accelerated spending further supports this momentum. Improved corporate balance sheets and increasing demand could boost private investments over the medium term. Due to global interest rates around 5%, investors have higher return expectations from developing markets, including India. While currency risks are lower in developed markets, India stands out for its growth and policy consistency, albeit with higher valuations. Long-term FII inflows remain promising. Most companies with a domestic focus are optimistic, though the IT sector continues to signal weakness. Falling input costs are boosting margins, but this effect is expected to normalize. Despite persistent rural challenges, there's some growth in two-wheeler sales. Banks report strong performance, driven by robust lending and improved credit recoveries. Sectors linked to government capex and real estate are recording positive results. Within residential real estate, demand is strongest for premium and luxury properties, while affordable housing may soon benefit from supportive government policies. Industry consolidation has increased, citywide affordability has improved, and retail demand remains solid despite rising interest rates. However, valuations are a concern in both consumer staples and certain defense and capital goods companies, where high growth is already priced in. In related news, Indian tax authorities have uncovered ₹10,000 crore in tax evasion by social media sellers over three years, issuing notices to numerous brands. Increased scrutiny from GST authorities has prompted companies to reassess their tax liabilities before entering into deals. Notably, Raymond’s managing director Gautam Singhania has been accused of domestic assault by his estranged wife Nawaz Modi.

आम्दानी वृद्धिदर, मूल्याङ्कन र लगानी प्रवाहका कारण प्रभावित छ। आम्दानी वृद्धिदर मजबूत छ, जसले लामो समयको कमजोर अवस्थापछि आर्थिक सुधार देखाउँछ। यसले बजारलाई अझै समर्थन गर्दै लैजाने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ। केही बजार क्षेत्र ऐतिहासिक औसतभन्दा महँगो छन्। वैश्विक उच्च ब्याजदरका कारण मूल्याङ्कनको दृष्टिकोण समायोजन भएको छ। यसले केही महँगा क्षेत्रहरूमा सुधार आउन सक्ने र बजारको उच्च मूल्याङ्कनमा सीमितता ल्याउन सक्छ। विदेशी लगानीकर्ताहरूको लगानी प्रवाह अनिश्चित भए पनि समग्र बजारले छिटो किं वा ढिलो आम्दानी वृद्धिलाई पछ्याउने छ। आर्थिक वर्ष २०२३-२४ र २०२४-२५ को आम्दानी अनुमान निरन्तर बढ्दै छ, जसले कम्पनीको लचकता देखाउँछ। बैंकिङ क्षेत्र राम्रो प्रदर्शनमा छ, IT क्षेत्रमा सुधारको आशा छ, ठूलो कम्पनीहरूले केही घाटा पुर्ति गर्न सक्छन्। मुख्य जोखिमहरूमा ग्रामीण कमजोर माग (मुद्रास्फीति, तलब वृद्धि नभएको, अनियमित वर्षा) र वैश्विक अर्थतन्त्रको मन्दी वा अप्रत्याशित मुद्रास्फीति आउन सक्ने सम्भावना छन्। यी विषयहरूमा ध्यान पुर्याउनुपर्छ। सरकारको पूँजीगत खर्च उच्च छ, निजी क्षेत्र विस्तारै सुधार भइरहेको छ। बैलेंस सिटहरू फितलो हुँदै बोर्डमा माग बढ्दो छ, जसले निजी लगानीमा सुधार ल्याउन सक्छ। वैश्विक ब्याजदर ५% को हाराहारी हुँदा विकासशील देशहरूबाट उच्च प्रतिफल अपेक्षा छ। विकसित देशमा मुद्रा जोखिम कम छ, तर भारतले विकास र स्थिरता देखाएको छ। दीर्घकालीन FII प्रवाह सकारात्मक छ। आन्तरिक बजार केन्द्रित कम्पनीहरू सकारात्मक छन्, IT क्षेत्र भने अझै कमजोर छ। लागत घटेर मुनाफा बढेको छ त्यसले विस्तारै सामान्य हुन सक्छ। ग्रामीण क्षेत्रमा चुनौती यथावत छ, दुईपांग्रे बिक्री केही बढेको छ। बैंक, सरकारको पूँजी खर्च र सम्पत्ति बजार राम्रो चलेका छन्। आवासीय रियल स्टेटमा प्रिमियम र लग्जरी क्षेत्रमा माग रहेको छ, सस्तो आवास सरकारबाट प्रोत्साहन हुन सक्छ। व्यवसाय संरचना बलियो छ, खुद्रा माग कायम छ, ब्याजदर उच्च भए पनि। तर रक्षा, उपभोक्ता स्टेपल र पुँजीगत क्षेत्रमा मूल्याङ्कन उच्च छ। सामाजिक सञ्जालबाट वस्तु बेच्ने ब्रान्डहरूले ३ वर्षमा १०,००० करोड रुपैयाँ कर छलि गरेको भारत सरकारले फेला पारेको छ र धेरै ब्राण्डलाई नोटिस पठाएका छन्। GST विभागको सतर्कताले कम्पनीहरूलाई कारोबार अघि कर हिसाबमा सचेत बनाएको छ। रेमण्ड article_content: Dr. Carnell Cooper, a trauma surgeon at the University of Maryland Medical Center in Baltimore, works to interrupt cycles of violence among young African-American men. After years of treating patients suffering repeated violent injuries, Cooper’s resolve deepened when a patient was killed in 1996. Determined to make a difference, he established the Violence Intervention Program (VIP) in the hospital’s busy Shock Trauma Unit. One of the first hospital-based anti-violence programs in the U.S., VIP treats violence as a public health crisis by targeting its underlying causes. Since its start in 1998, VIP has assisted almost 500 trauma survivors through services like substance abuse support, job skills training, mentoring, and educational opportunities. Patients who arrive with violent injuries are immediately introduced to a VIP case worker, often while still hospitalized—at a moment when they’re open to new possibilities. A 2006 study led by Cooper showed the program’s success: people who participated were much less likely to be re-injured or arrested for violent crimes than those who did not participate. Cooper’s personal background growing up amid crime in South Carolina inspired his compassionate approach. He sees his patients as individuals who deserve a real chance to change their lives, just as he once did. The program connects participants with GED courses, employment preparation, conflict resolution training, and parenting support, reinforced through weekly group meetings. Transformations like that of Howard McCray—a former participant who survived a shooting, gained his GED, and now helps others as an outreach worker—show the impact of VIP. Cooper believes most people can turn their lives around when given support, and he views helping patients beyond surgery as part of being a physician. Those wanting to get involved can find ways to support the Violence Intervention Program.
translated_content: बाल्टिमोरको युनिभर्सिटी अफ मेरिल्याण्ड मेडिकल सेन्टरका ट्रमा सर्जन डा. कर्नेल कुपर युवा अफ्रिकी-अमेरिकन पुरुषहरूमाझ दोहोरिएको हिंसाको चक्र तोड्न लागिपरेका छन्। वर्षौंसम्म यस्ता घाइतेको उपचार गरेपछि सन् १९९६ मा एक बिरामीको मृत्यु भएको घटनाले उनलाई नयाँ सोच दिएको थियो। सोही घटनाबाट प्रेरित भएर उनले अस्पतालको व्यस्त शोक ट्रामा युनिटमा ‘भायलेंस इन्टरभेन्सन प्रोग्राम’ (VIP) स्थापना गरे। अमेरिकाको पहिलो अस्पताल-केन्द्रित हिंसा रोकथाम कार्यक्रममध्ये एक, VIP ले हिंसालाई सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य समस्याको रुपमा लिएर यसको जरोमा पुगेर समाधान खोज्छ। सन् १९९८ देखि सुरु भएको यस कार्यक्रमबाट झन्डै ५०० ट्रामा पीडितहरूले लागुऔषध परामर्श, रोजगारी सीप तालिम, परामर्श र शैक्षिक अवसर जस्ता सेवाहरू पाएका छन्। हिंसाबाट घाइते भएर अस्पताल आएका बिरामीलाई VIP का केसवर्करले उपचारकै बेला भेट गर्छन्—उनीहरू जीवन बदल्ने सोचमा हुने मौका यही हो। डा. कुपरले २००६ मा गरेको अध्ययनमा कार्यक्रममा सहभागी बिरामीहरूको दोहोरिएको घाइते हुने र पक्राउ पर्ने सम्भावना धेरै कम रहेको देखिएको छ। दक्षिण क्यारोलिनाको आपराधिक क्षेत्रमा हुर्केका कुपरको आफ्नै अनुभवले उनलाई गहिरो सहानुभूति दिएको छ—र, उनी बिरामीलाई नयाँ जीवनको मौका दिनुपर्छ भन्ने विश्वास गर्छन्। कार्यक्रमले GED अध्ययन, रोजगारी तयारी, द्वन्द्व समाधान तालिम, अभिभावकत्व क्षमता विकास जस्ता सेवा र साप्ताहिक समूह समर्थन दिन्छ। हावर्ड म्याकक्रेजस्तो सहभागी—जो आफैं गोली लागि बच्दै GED पाए र अहिले अरु बिरामीलाई मद्दत गर्दैछन्—VIP को प्रभावको उदाहरण हुन्। डा. कुपर भन्छन्: ‘प्रायः मानिसले सहयोग पाए परिवर्तन गर्न सक्छन् र बिरामीलाई उपचार मात्र हैन, जीवन सुधारमा अघि बढाउने कामसमेत डाक्टरको कर्तव्य हो।’ VIP मा सहभागी भई सहयोग गर्न इच्छुकहरूले विभिन्न तरिकाले सहभागी हुन सक्छन्।

article_content: Indian cricket star Virat Kohli equalled Sachin Tendulkar’s record of 49 ODI centuries on Sunday, achieving this milestone on his 35th birthday during India’s World Cup match against South Africa at Eden Gardens, Kolkata. Kohli reached his 49th hundred with a single off Kagiso Rabada in the 49th over, delighting a packed stadium as fans chanted his name. He remained unbeaten on 101 from 121 balls, with 10 boundaries, showcasing his excellent form in the tournament. Anticipation had built up since the Indian team’s arrival in Kolkata, home to the historic Eden Gardens. In the previous match against Sri Lanka at Wankhede Stadium, Kohli was dismissed for 88 while Sachin Tendulkar watched from the stands. Earlier, Kohli scored 95 off 104 balls against New Zealand at the Himachal Pradesh Cricket Association Stadium, leading India to a four-wicket win. Kohli matched Tendulkar’s record in just 277 innings, whereas Tendulkar needed 452. It’s worth noting that Kohli has consistently played as a top-order batter, while Tendulkar initially batted lower in the order before becoming a top-order batsman. Playing conditions have also changed: in Tendulkar’s era, five fielders were allowed outside the 30-yard circle and a single ball was used, compared to just four fielders and two balls from different ends today. Separately, India has recently outperformed other Asia Pacific markets, including China, for major global consumer goods companies in the last quarter, according to management commentaries. Employee productivity at Indian companies has steadily increased over the past five years, even as staff costs remain consistent at 10% of total revenue. Furthermore, the government has banned 22 illegal betting and gambling apps and websites, including the Mahadev Book Online app, which has been linked to bribery allegations involving Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel.
translated_content: भारतीय क्रिकेट स्टार विराट कोहलीले आइतबार दक्षिण अफ्रिकाविरुद्ध विश्वकप खेलमा आफ्नो ३५औँ जन्मदिनको अवसरमा कोलकाताको ऐतिहासिक ईडन गार्डेन्समा शतकीय इनिङ्स खेल्दै सचिन तेन्दुलकरको ४९ ओडीआई शतकीय कीर्तिमान बराबरी गरेका छन्। कोहलीले इन्डियन इनिङ्सको ४९ औँ ओभरमा कागिसो रबाडाको बलमा एक रन लिएर ४९ औँ शतक पूरा गरे, जहाँ उत्साहित भिडले उनको नाम जोरसँग नारा लगाएको थियो। उनले १२१ बलमा अविजित १०१ रन बनाए, जसमध्ये १० चौका थिए। उनको यो प्रदर्शन प्रतियोगितामा उत्कृष्ट लय झल्काउँछ। भारतीय टोली कोलकातामा पुगेयता ऐतिहासिक ईडन गार्डेन्समा ठूलाे उत्साह सञ्चार भएको थियो। श्रीलंकाविरुद्धको अघिल्लो खेलमा वानखेडे स्टेडियममा कोहली ८८ रनमा आउट भएको बेला सचिन तेन्दुलकर स्ट्यान्डमा थिए। त्यसअघि, हिमाचल प्रदेश क्रिकेट एसोसिएसन स्टेडियममा न्यूजिल्याण्डविरुद्ध कोहलीले १०४ बलमा ९५ रन बनाउँदै भारतलाई चार विकेटको जित दिलाएका थिए। कोहलीले तेन्दुलकरको ४९ शतकीय कीर्तिमानसम्म पुग्न २७७ इनिङ्स खेले, जबकी तेन्दुलकरले यो ४५२ इनिङ्समा पूरा गरेका थिए। कोहली सधैं माथिल्लो क्रमका ब्याट्सम्यान हुन्, तेन्दुलकरले भने करियरको सुरुवातमा तलको क्रममा ब्याटिङ गरेका थिए। खेलका नियमहरूमा परिवर्तन भएको छ; तेन्दुलकरको समयमा ३० यार्ड सर्कल बाहिर पाँच जना फिल्डर allowed थिए र एउटा बल मात्र प्रयोग हुने, अहिले चार जना allowed छन् र दुई बल फरक छेउबाट प्रयोग गरिन्छ। अर्कोतर्फ, पछिल्लो त्रैमासमा भारतले विश्वका ठूला उपभोक्ता सामान कम्पनीहरूको लागि अन्य एशिया प्यासिफिक बजारहरू — चिन्लाई समेत — पछि पारेको छ, व्यवस्थापन प्रतिकृयामा उल्लेख छ। भारतका कम्पनीहरूमा कर्मचारी उत्पादकता पाँच वर्षदेखि निरन्तर बढ्दो छ भने, कर्मचारी खर्च कुल आम्दानीको १० प्रतिशतमै स्थिर छ। त्यस्तै, सरकारले २२ गैरकानुनी बेटिंग र जुवा एप तथा वेबसाइटहरू, महादेव बुक अनलाइन सहित, प्रतिबन्ध गरेको छ, जुन छत्तीसगढका मुख्यमन्त्री भूपेश बघेलसँग जोडिएको घूस प्रकरणसँग सम्बन्धित छ।

article_content: The German national team, led by captain Philipp Lahm, arrived in Berlin today holding the World Cup trophy, greeted by enthusiastic fans gathered at Tegel Airport. The atmosphere was electric as the champions made their way to the Brandenburg Gate, where an estimated 400,000 supporters filled the 'fan mile', many having arrived overnight to secure a view. Meanwhile, England captain Steven Gerrard spent his post-World Cup break in Ibiza with his family, following England's disappointing exit from the tournament in Brazil. Unlike their rivals, the England squad quietly returned home weeks earlier with little public attention after finishing at the bottom of Group D. Germany's victory—its fourth World Cup title and first since 1990—is credited to years of modernization under coach Joachim Löw. Addressing the crowd, Löw said, 'We're all world champions! Of course, it was a long way to the title, and an incredibly tough one in the end. But we're incredibly happy to be here with the fans now.' Star players like Mario Götze, who scored the decisive goal in the final against Argentina, were greeted with loud cheers and a sea of black, red, and gold German flags. England's lackluster World Cup run highlights ongoing challenges on the international stage. Steven Gerrard, who will be nearly 36 at the next major tournament (Euro 2016), is now focused on preparing for the Premier League season with Liverpool, set to play friendlies against Brondby and Borussia Dortmund.

article_content: Gideon Cody, the Kansas police chief who authorized the controversial raid of a small-town newspaper in August, has officially resigned. Cody turned in his badge on Monday, less than two months after approving the police raid of the Marion County Record. Officer Zach Hudlin, who participated in the raid, has been named acting chief of the Marion Police Department. This development comes less than a week after Marion Mayor David Mayfield formally suspended Cody, while the Kansas Bureau of Investigation continues to review the incident. On August 11, local law enforcement officers conducted raids on the offices of the Marion County Record, the home of its publisher, and a city councilwoman's residence. During the operation, officers seized computers and phones belonging to several reporters. The move drew immediate backlash from First Amendment advocates. Joan Meyer, the 98-year-old co-owner of the newspaper, died at home one day after the raid. According to the Record, she was 'stressed beyond her limits and overwhelmed by hours of shock and grief following the police raids.' To justify the search warrants, Cody alleged that the newspaper had violated the state's identity theft laws to obtain a local business owner's driving records. While a judge initially approved the warrants, authorities were later ordered to return the seized property after a local prosecutor determined there was insufficient evidence to justify the raid. Before serving as the Marion police chief, Cody was a captain at the Kansas City Police Department. He left that position while under internal investigation for allegedly making derogatory and sexist remarks to a fellow officer.
translated_content: कन्सास प्रहरी प्रमुख गिडियन कोडीले अगस्टमा सानो शहरको पत्रिकामा विवादास्पद छापा अनुमति दिएपछि औपचारिक रूपमा राजीनामा दिएका छन्। कोडीले Marion County Record मा छापा पारित गरेपछि दुई महिनाभित्रै सोमबार ब्याज फिर्ता गरे। छापामा सहभागी अधिकृत जाक हडलिनलाई मेरियन प्रहरी विभागको कार्यवाहक प्रमुख नियुक्त गरिएको छ। यो घटना मेरियनका मेयर डेविड मेफिल्डले कोडीलाई औपचारिक रूपमा निलम्बन गरेपछि र कन्सास ब्यूरो अफ इन्भेस्टिगेसनले घटनाको समीक्षा गरिरहेको बेला आएको हो। अगस्ट ११ मा, स्थानीय प्रहरीले Marion County Record को कार्यालय, प्रकाशकको घर र एक सिटी काउन्सिल सदस्यको घरमा छापा मारेका थिए। छापाको क्रममा प्रहरीले कैयौं पत्रकारहरूको कम्प्युटर र फोनहरू जफत गरेको थियो। यसले अभिव्यक्ति स्वतन्त्रता पक्षधरहरूबाट तुरुन्तै आलोचना आएको थियो। ९८ वर्षीया सह-स्वामिनी जोआन मेयर छापापछि अर्को दिन घरमै निधन भइन्। Record का अनुसार, उनी प्रहरी छापापछि अत्यधिक तनावमा थिइन् र सद्मा तथा पीडामा परेकी थिइन्। छापा मार्न अनुमति पाउन कोडीले पत्रिकाले एक स्थानीय व्यवसायीको गाडीको विवरण लिन राज्यको पहिचान चोरी कानून उल्लंघन गरेको दाबी गरेका थिए। न्यायाधीशले सुरुमा वारन्ट स्वीकृत गरे तर पछि पर्याप्त प्रमाण नभएको भन्दै स्थानीय अभियोजनकर्ताको सिफारिसमा जफत गरिएका सामग्री फिर्ता गर्न आदेश दिइयो। मेरियन प्रहरी प्रमुख हुनु अघि, कोडी कन्सास सिटी प्रहरी विभागमा कप्तान थिए। उनले एक सहकर्मीप्रति आपत्तिजनक तथा लैङ्गिक टिप्पणी गरेको आरोपमा विभागीय छानबिन भइरहेका बेला उक्त पद छाडेका थिए।

article_content: On Christmas Day 2013, tens of thousands in southern England lost electricity after storms and floods damaged power systems. Southern Electric, which earned £1.4 billion the prior year, failed to restore electricity to about 19,500 customers in south Hampshire, Surrey, and West Sussex. Similarly, UK Power Networks had around 30,000 customers in Sussex, Surrey, and Kent without power. Both companies announced they would pay £75 to each customer who experienced an outage, a figure much higher than the legal minimum of £27 for outages longer than 48 hours. The overall cost to Southern Electric is expected to be about £1.5 million, while UK Power Networks’ bill will be at least £2.5 million. Southern Electric plans to notify customers eligible for the payout, while UK Power Networks is asking affected customers to make claims. Some UK Power Networks customers were still without electricity even five days after the storm. CEO Basil Scarsella acknowledged delays were partly because many engineers were on holiday. Politicians and the public have strongly criticized the energy companies. MP Tim Yeo stated executives would be questioned by Parliament about the long outages and criticized the slow repair work, also highlighting inadequate oversight by regulator Ofgem. Environment Secretary Owen Paterson said companies failed to prepare for bad weather and allowed too many staff to be off-duty. Both officials labeled the response unacceptable. According to regulations, companies must pay £27 after a 48-hour outage, with additional payments for longer periods, capped at £216. In this case, both companies increased the initial compensation to £75 as a goodwill gesture with further payments for extended outages.

article_content: South Africa's unequivocal support for Palestinians in the Israel-Hamas conflict has deepened rifts at home. The government has withdrawn its diplomats from Israel and questioned the position of Israel’s ambassador, actions that drew sharp criticism from the nation’s Jewish Board of Deputies, which has called for immediate talks with President Cyril Ramaphosa. Support for Palestine is rooted in South African history, reaching back to Nelson Mandela, who famously linked the Palestinian cause to South Africa’s own struggle against apartheid. Despite the recent Hamas attack on Israel—which led to around 1,400 deaths, including two South Africans, and another citizen held hostage—the ruling African National Congress (ANC) has maintained its sympathy for Palestinian demands for independence. President Ramaphosa likened Palestinians’ fight to South Africa’s historic pursuit of justice. While condemning Hamas’s violence, Ramaphosa and ANC members publicly demonstrated for Palestinians, waving flags and wearing keffiyehs. The government’s criticism of Israel intensified; Foreign Minister Naledi Pandor accused Israel of imposing collective punishment in Gaza, where airstrikes reportedly killed over 10,000 people. She suggested these actions might qualify as genocide, though Israel disputes the charge. Jewish organizations, the South African Zionist Federation, and the main opposition Democratic Alliance have all rebuked the government’s stance. Public debate is heated, with talk shows reportedly limiting discussion of the conflict due to its divisiveness. Pro-Palestinian protests have drawn large crowds, while smaller pro-Israel events have also been held. A symbolic protest saw Jewish South Africans string up 221 red balloons in Johannesburg to highlight Israeli hostages’ plight. Internal disagreement surfaced within the ANC itself when Gabriella Farber resigned, citing exclusion of Jewish voices and the party’s approach to the conflict. She criticized the delayed condemnation of Hamas and the simultaneous accusation of genocide against Israel. Chief Rabbi Warren Goldstein lambasted the government, saying the ANC does not represent all of South Africa by supporting ‘brutality’—but the Jewish community is not unified on the issue. Cartoonist Jonathan Shapiro (Zapiro) highlighted that many anti-apartheid Jewish leaders were critical of Israel’s policies and that ANC’s position is part of a longer tradition. Historically, the ANC allied with other liberation movements, including the PLO and leaders such as Yasser Arafat, Fidel Castro, and Muammar Gaddafi, all of whom supported the anti-apartheid cause. After Mandela’s release, he met Arafat; later, the PLO recognized Israel’s right to exist through the Oslo Accords. Foreign Minister Pandor faced criticism for speaking with Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh but defended this contact as consistent with South Africa’s peacemaking legacy and experience negotiating with adversaries. President Ramaphosa has said South Africa is ready to help mediate the Israeli-Palestinian dispute, drawing on its experience with conflict resolution. Nonetheless, Jewish leaders argue that expelling Israel’s ambassador would contradict South Africa’s principle of engaging all sides.

परे पनि, सत्तारूढ एएनसीले फिलिस्तिनीहरूको स्वतन्त्रता मागप्रति सहानुभूति राख्दै आएको छ। राष्ट्रपति रामाफोसाले फिलिस्तीनीय संघर्षलाई दक्षिण अफ्रिकाको ऐतिहासिक अन्यायसँग तुलना गरेका छन्। रामाफोसाले हमासको हिंसाको निन्दा गरे पनि, उनले र एएनसी नेताहरूले फिलिस्तीन समर्थनमा झण्डा फहराउँदै र केफियामा सजिँदै प्रदर्शन गरे। सरकारले इजरायलप्रति आलोचना बढाउँदै गाजा हवाई आक्रमणमा १०,००० भन्दा बढी मृत्यु भएको भन्दै सामूहिक दण्ड दिएको आरोप लगाएको छ। परराष्ट्र मन्त्री नालेडी पाण्डोरले यस्ता कार्यहरूलाई नरसंहार भन्न सकिने संकेत दिइन्, जसलाई इजरायलले अस्वीकार गरेको छ। यहूदी संगठन, दक्षिण अफ्रिकी सियोनिस्ट फेडेरेसन, र प्रमुख विपक्षी दल डेमोक्रेटिक अलायन्सले सरकारको दृष्टिकोणको आलोचना गरेका छन्। विषयको कारण संवाद कार्यक्रमहरूमा समय सीमित गरिएको छ। फिलिस्तीन समर्थनमा ठूलो प्रदर्शन भइरहेका छन् भने, साना इजरायल समर्थक कार्यक्रमहरू पनि भएको छ। जोहान्सबर्गमा यहूदी दक्षिण अफ्रिकीले इजरायली बन्धकप्रति ध्यानाकर्षण गर्न २२१ रातो बेलुन टाँगेका थिए। एएनसीमा पनि असहमति देखिएको छ—गेब्रिएला फार्बरले यहूदी आवाज उपेक्षा भएको र पार्टी दृष्टिकोण प्रति असन्तुष्टि जनाउँदै पदबाट राजीनामा दिइन्। उनले हमासको आलोचना ढिलो हुनु र इजरायलमाथि नरसंहारको आरोपसँग असहमत रहेको बताइन्। मुख्य रवी वारेन गोल्डस्टिनले सरकारले सम्पूर्ण दक्षिण अफ्रिकालाई प्रतिनिधित्व नगर्ने र क्रूरता समर्थन गरेको आरोप लगाए—तर यहूदी समुदायमा एक मत छैन। कार्टुनिस्ट जोनाथन शापिरो ‘जापिरो’ले थुप्रै यहूदी रंगभेदविरोधी नेताहरू इजरायलनीतिका आलोचक रहेको र एएनसीको दृष्टिकोण यस्तै परम्परामा आधारित रहेको उल्लेख गरे। इतिहासमा, एएनसीले पिएलओ, यासिर अराफात, फिदेल क्यास्ट्रो, मुअम्मर गद्दाफी जस्ता नेताहरूसँग मित्रता गाँसेको थियो, जसले रंगभेदविरोधी संघर्षमा समर्थन गरेका थिए। मण्डेलाले रिहाइपछिकै भेटमा अराफातसँग भेटेका थिए; पछि पिएलओले ओस्लो सम्झौतामा इजरायलको अस्तित्व मान्यता दिएको थियो। परराष्ट्रमन्त्री पाण्डोर हमास नेता इस्माइल हानियेसँग संवाद गरेकोमा आलोचित हुँदै आएकी छिन्, तर उनले यो वार्ता दक्षिण अफ्रिकाको वार्तामा आधारित परम्पराअनुसार भएको बताएको छ। राष्ट्रपति रामाफोसाले इजरायल–फिलिस्तीन द्वन्द्व सुल्झाउन दक्षिण अफ्रिका मध्यस्थता गर्न तयार रहेको बताएका छन्। यहूदी नेताहरू भने इजरायली राजदूत हटाउनु संवादको सिद्धान्तविपरीत हुने मत राख्छन्।

article_content: Aidan Dumuje-Abili became globally recognized at age eight for his exceptional swimming abilities. In 2019, he was named the fastest swimmer for his age by various media outlets. Now, at 12 years old, Dumuje-Abili continues to pursue his dreams of competing at the Olympics and breaking world records. Besides swimming, Aidan plays football, basketball, and tennis. He looks up to Michael Phelps, the world’s most decorated swimmer, and eight-time Ballon d’Or winner Lionel Messi. Speaking about his idols, Aidan said, "My idol is Lionel Messi because of his leadership and determination on the pitch. I also play football, basketball, and tennis, but I will swim professionally because I’m best at that. I really admire Michael Phelps." Balancing sports with his academics, Aidan also runs his own online store for T-shirts and sports merchandise, called ‘goldfin’. His remarkable talents have been evident from a young age and continue to improve. Friends call him 'bullet' due to his speed in the water. In May, he won two gold, two silver, and two bronze medals at the World Schools Swimming Championships in London. At the last National Youth Games in Asaba, Aidan won the 100m, 200m, and 50m butterfly events, and took silver in the 200m medley relay. His 1:03.73 in the 100m butterfly is the fastest-ever time for a 12-year-old in Nigeria. Earlier, Aidan was named best overall swimmer for boys at the fourth Dolphin Swimming League, claiming 15 gold medals in the U-11 category. He has started the current school competition season strongly, and could again dominate the awards at the four-leg meet. "It's exciting to have everyone cheering for each other. I'm always delighted to represent my school, and the competition level here matches the youth games. It's tough, but I'll see how the other rounds go," Aidan said after the opening leg of the Dolphin Swimming League Season Five. Aidan began swimming as a life skill at age four. His mother, Irene, explained after his wins at the National Youth Games, "It's still a journey. He started as a life skill at age four-plus, got varied technical training, and has attended multiple camps in Nigeria and abroad." Although Nigeria has long coastlines, it hasn’t produced a world or Olympic swimming medalist yet. However, success on the continent suggests strong potential for global achievement. Aidan aims high: "I would also like to break the 100m and 50m butterfly and 100m and 50m freestyle world records," he told reporters. At every competition, attention is on the 12-year-old, but he remains unfazed and enjoys competing, just like his idols, Phelps and Messi.
translated_content: आइडन डुमुजे-अबिली आठ वर्षको उमेरमै आफ्नो अद्वितीय पौडी क्षमताका कारण विश्वव्यापी रूपमा परिचित भए। २०१९ मा उनलाई विभिन्न संचारमाध्यमहरूले उमेर समूहकै सबैभन्दा छिटो पौडी खेलाडी घोषणा गरेका थिए। अहिले १२ वर्ष पुगिसकेका आइडन अझै ओलम्पिक भाग लिन र विश्व कीर्तिमान तोड्ने सपना पछ्याइरहेका छन्। पौडीबाहेक, आइडन फुटबल, बास्केटबल, र टेनिस पनि खेल्छन्। उनले सबैभन्दा धेरै पदक जितेका स्विमर माइकल फेल्प्स र आठ पटक बलन ड’ओर विजेता लिओनेल मेस्सीलाई आफ्ना आदर्श मान्छन्। 'मलाई लिओनेल मेस्सी मनपर्छ, किनभने उनको नेतृत्व क्षमता र मैदानमा दृढता छ। म फुटबल, बास्केटबल, टेनिस पनि खेल्छु, तर पौडीचाँहि पेशागत रूपमा खेल्नेछु, किनभने म त्यहीमा सबैभन्दा राम्रो छु। मलाई विश्वकै सबैभन्दा धेरै पदक जित्ने माइकल फेल्प्स निकै मनपर्छ,' आइडनले भने। खेलसँगै पढाइमा सन्तुलन राख्दै, आइडनले ‘गोल्डफिन’ नामक आफ्नो अनलाइन टी-शर्ट तथा खेल सामग्रीको स्टोर पनि चलाउँछन्। सानै उमेरदेखि देखिएको उनको अद्भुत प्रतिभा निरन्तर निखारिँदै गएको छ। पानीमा छिटो पौडी खेल्ने भएकाले साथीहरू उनलाई 'बुलेट' भन्छन्। मे महिनामा, उनले लन्डनमा भएको वर्ल्ड स्कूल्स स्विमिङ च्याम्पियनसिपमा दुई स्वर्ण, दुई रजत, र दुई कांस्य पदक जिते। असाबामा भएको नेशनल युथ गेम्समा आइडनले १०० मि, २०० मि, र ५० मि बटरफ्लाई जिते र २०० मि मिडली रिलेमामा रजत पदक पाए। १०० मिटर बटरफ्लाईमा उनले १:०३.७३ सेकेन्डमा सम्पूर्ण गरेर १२ वर्ष उमेर समूहका लागि नाइजेरियामा अहिलेसम्मकै छिटो समय कायम गरे। यसअघि, उनले चौथो डल्फिन स्विमिङ लिगमा केटातर्फ उत्कृष्ट खेलाडी घोषित हुँदै १५ वटा स्वर्ण जितेका थिए। यो शैक्षिक सिजनमा पनि उनले राम्रो सुरुवात गरेका छन् र चार चरणको प्रतिस्पर्धामा फेरि स्कुलका अवार्डहरू जित्न सक्ने सम्भावना छ। 'यहाँ सबैले एकअर्कालाई हौसला दिन्छन्, रमाइलो लाग्छ। आफ्नै स्कुल प्रतिनिधित्व गर्दा खुशी लाग्छ। यहाँको प्रतिस्पर्धा युथ गेम्सजस्तै कडा छ। गार्हो छ, तर अगाडि के हुन्छ हेर्नेछु,' आइडनले डल्फिन स्विमिङ लिग सिजन फाइवको पहिलो चरणपछि भने। आइडनले चार वर्षको उमेरमा जीवन सीपको रूपमा पौडी खेल्न थालेका थिए। आमा आइरीनका अनुसार, 'यो यात्रा अझै जारी छ। उनले चार वर्षको उमेरदेखि जीवन सीपको रूपमा सुरु गरे, विभिन्न प्रविधिमा तालिम लिए, र नाइजेरिया तथा विदेशी क्याम्पहरूमा सहभागी भए।' नाइजेरियामा ठूलो समुद्री तट रहे पनि अहिलेसम्म विश्व वा ओलम्पिक पौडीमा पदक जितिएको छैन। यद्यपि अफ्रिकी स्तरमा सफलता रहेकोले विश्वस्तरमा पनि प्रतिस्पर्धा गर्ने सम्भावना रहेको धेरैको धारणा छ। आइडनको ठूलो लक्ष्य छ: 'म १०० मिटर र ५० मिटर बटरफ्लाई र १०० मिटर, ५० मिटर फ्रिस्टाइलका विश्व कीर्तिमान तोड्न चाहन्छु,' उनले भने। हरेक प्रतियोगितामा १२ वर्षे आइडन सबैको ध्यानको केन्द्र हुन्छन्, तर उनी दबाब बिना रमाइलैसँग प्रतिस्पर्धा गर्छन्—ठ्याक्कै आफ्ना आदर्श फेल्प्स र मेस्सीजस्तै।

article_content: Susan Klebold, the mother of Columbine High School shooter Dylan Klebold, is preparing a memoir in which she will address the overwhelming grief and shame she has felt since the 1999 tragedy. Crown Publishers announced on Tuesday that it has acquired her forthcoming book, which currently has no title or release date. Klebold was motivated to share her story after other school shootings, including the tragedy at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut. She has committed to donating all author proceeds from the book to mental health research and charitable organizations. During the Columbine attack, Dylan Klebold and fellow student Eric Harris killed 12 students and a teacher, and injured 26 others at their Colorado high school before dying by suicide in 1999. At that time, it was the deadliest school shooting in U.S. history. The attack included the use of a fire bomb intended to distract firefighters. Susan Klebold has previously spoken about her feelings in an essay for Oprah Winfrey’s O Magazine and in interviews for Andrew Solomon’s book 'Far from the Tree.' Susan and her husband, Tom Klebold, have rarely engaged with the media since the tragedy and did not move or change their names, as reported by The New York Times. In her O Magazine essay, Susan described deep sorrow for the suffering her son caused and for the loss of her child. She also discussed the pain of not being viewed as a victim by most people, but rather being seen as responsible for raising her son. In her interview with Andrew Solomon, Klebold revealed her struggle over whether her son’s actions were predetermined or triggered by external events. Diaries left by Harris and Klebold detailed their planning, including lists of purchases, supplies, and hit lists. Harris’s journal from October 1998 communicated violent intentions, while Klebold’s planner outlined the attack’s timeline for April 20, 1999.
translated_content: कोलम्बाइन हाई स्कूलका शूटर डिलन क्लेबोल्डकी आमा सुसान क्लेबोल्डले १९९९ को घटनापछि महसुस गरेको अत्यधिक दु:ख र लाजको बारेमा लेख्दै आफ्नो संस्मरण तयार गर्दैछिन्। क्राउन पब्लिशर्सले मंगलबार घोषणा गर्‍यो कि उसले उनको आगामी पुस्तक भर्खरै प्राप्त गरेको छ, जसको हालसम्म शीर्षक र प्रकाशन मिति छैन। स्यान्डी हुक एलिमेन्ट्री स्कुल लगायत अन्य विद्यालयमा भएको घटनापछि आफ्नो कथा साझा गर्न प्रेरित भएकी उहाँले पुस्तकबाट प्राप्त सम्पूर्ण रकम मानसिक स्वास्थ्य अनुसन्धान र समाजसेवामा दिने वाचा गरेकी छन्। कोलम्बाइन आक्रमणमा, डिलन क्लेबोल्ड र अर्का विद्यार्थी एरिक हेarrisले १९९९ मा आफ्नै कोलोराडो हाई स्कूलमा १२ विद्यार्थी र एक शिक्षकको हत्या गरेर २६ जनालाई घाइते बनाएका थिए र पछि आत्महत्या गरेका थिए। त्यो समयसम्मको अमेरिकी इतिहासमै सबैभन्दा घातक विद्यालय आक्रमण थियो। घटनामा दमकलकर्मीलाई ध्यान अन्यत्र मोड्नको लागि फायर बमसमेत प्रयोग गरिएको थियो। सुसान क्लेबोल्डले पहिले ओप्रा विन्फ्रीको 'ओ म्यागजिन' र एन्ड्र्यु सोलोमनको ‘फार फ्रम द ट्री’ पुस्तकका लागि अन्तर्वार्ता दिँदै आफ्ना भावना व्यक्त गरेकी छन्। सुसान र उनका श्रीमान् टम क्लेबोल्डले घटनापछि मिडियासँग कमै मात्र बोलेका छन् र घरबास परिवर्तन नगरेका, न त नाम परिवर्तन गरेका, न्यूयोर्क टाइम्सका अनुसार। ओ म्यागजिनका लागि लेखिएको आफ्नो निबन्धमा सुसानले छोराले पुर्‍याएको पीडा तथा छोराको गुमाउदाको गहिरो दु:ख उल्लेख गरेकी छन्। उनलाई समुदायले पीडितको रूपमा नहेरी दोषीको रूपमा हेरिएको महसुस भएकाले थप पीडा भएको बताएकी छन्। एन्ड्र्यु सोलोमनसँगको अन्तर्वार्तामा उनले छोराको यस्तो व्यवहार जन्मजात थियो कि बाह्य कारणले भयो भन्ने द्विविधा व्यक्त गरेकी छन्। ह्यारिस र क्लेबोल्डले छोडेका डायरी तथा योजनाले घटनाको योजनाबद्धता देखाउँछ। उनीहरूले खरिद गरेका सामान, आवश्यक सामग्री र हिट लिस्ट उल्लेख गरेका थिए। ह्यारिसको १९९८ को अक्टोबरको डायरीमा हिंसात्मक मनसाय देखिन्छ भने क्लेबोल्डको योजना पुस्तकमा अप्रिल २०, १९९९ को आक्रमणको समयतालिका उल्लेख गरिएको छ।
